string.name: name
string.value: Borrowing Sera's Mirror

string.name: parent
string.value: Sera's Mirror
Go talk to Heena.
You meet Heena, who is worried the sun will damage her skin. Go get a mirror from her sister, Sarah, so she can check.
Heena asked you to get a mirror from her sister, so you walked all the way to Sarah.

string.name: name
string.value: Bringing a Mirror to Heena

string.name: parent
string.value: Sera's Mirror
You got the mirror from Sarah, who was doing her laundry. You have to take it to Heena.
You got the mirror from Sarah, who was doing her laundry and took it to Heena.

string.name: name
string.value: What Sen wants to eat

string.name: parent
string.value: Nina and Sen's Dinner Menu
Talk to Nina.
Nina is wondering what to make her brother, Sen, for dinner. Go talk to Sen, who's next to Nina, and ask him what he wants to eat.
You asked Sen, Nina's brother, what he wants for dinner. He said he wants #bMushroom Soup#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Returning to Nina

string.name: parent
string.value: Nina and Sen's Dinner Menu
Sen wants Mushroom Soup for dinner. Better tell Nina now.
You told Nina what Sen wants for dinner.

string.name: name
string.value: Letter for Lucas

string.name: parent
string.value: Please bring this letter to Lucas
Maria needs someone to help her...
Maria needs someone to help her. She wants you to deliver a latter to Lucas in Amherst.
You delivered Maria's letter to Lucas in Amherst.

string.name: name
string.value: Lucas' Reply

string.name: parent
string.value: Please bring this letter to Lucas
You delivered Maria's letter to Lucas who was in Amherst. He wrote her a reply, which you should bring to Maria.
Maria looked relieved after reading the reply from Lucas. Now you want to read it, too. Wonder what this was all about...

string.name: name
string.value: Biggs's Collection of Items
Biggs has a task for you.
You meet Biggs in Southperry. He wants you to get him #b10 orange mushroom caps and 30 blue snail shells#k. He doesn't look too convinced that you can do it, but it sounds like a piece of cake.
You gathered #b10 mushroom caps and 30 blue snail shells#k for Biggs in Southperry. The weapon he gave you as a reward was pretty decent.

string.name: name
string.value: Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods
Pio wants you to help collect recycled goods.

You ran into Pio, who is famous in Amherst for fixing broken goods. He asks you to break down scrap boxes from around town and bring back #t4031161#s and #t4031162#s. 

#t4031162# #c4031162# / #r1#k
#t4031161# #c4031161# / #r1#k
You broke the boxes and collected supplies for Pio. It was fun because you found other useful items in the boxes as well.

string.name: name
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz 1

string.name: parent
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz
You're not a beginning anymore. Talk to Rain and take the Maple Quiz!
You're not a beginning anymore. Talk to Rain and take the Maple Quiz!
Rain's first question was about which hotkey to press to open the Item Inventory. The answer is I!

string.name: name
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz 2

string.name: parent
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz
Solve Rain's second question.
What's Rain's second question?
Rain's question was about equippable items, which can be worn by double-clicking on them.

string.name: name
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz 3

string.name: parent
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz
Rain's third question.
Time for Rain's thirds question.
E is the hotkey for opening the Equipment Window. You can take off what you're wearing by double-clicking on the item in the Equipment Window.

string.name: name
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz 4

string.name: parent
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz
Time to answer #b#p12101##k's fourth question.
You can answer Rain's questions if you think carefully.
Rain's fourth question was about using Z to pick up items from the ground. 0 on the numpad also works.

string.name: name
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz 5

string.name: parent
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz
#b#p12101##k's fifth question. Wonder what it's about.
What's the fifth question?
Rain asked job advancements. For Warriors, Thieves, and Bowmen, you need to be at least level 10, while for Magicians, you can advance at Level 8.

string.name: name
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz 6

string.name: parent
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz
Time to answer #b#p12101##k's question.
Finally, the sixth question.
When you level up, you get 5 Ability Points (AP) to use to upgrade your abilities. Use the hotkey S your AP.

string.name: name
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz 7

string.name: parent
string.value: Rain's Maple Quiz
This is #b#p12101##k's last question. Excited?
Finally the last question. After this, you'll no longer be a beginning.
Rain advised that it's time to leave Maple Island. In Victoria Island, you can choose a job and start a lot of new adventures. Head to Southperry to get to Victoria Island!

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's Training

string.name: parent
string.value: Mai's Training
Mai on Maple Island seems like a martial arts specialist who can train beginnings.

You're under the tutelage of the famous swordmaster, Mai, in Amherst. She wants you to hunt Snails, Blue Snails, and Shrooms.

#o100100# #r#a10161# #k
#o100101# #r#a10162# #k
#o120100# #r#a10163##k

 Ah, Mai also said to meet with #p20002# in South Ferry to get another quest.
Mai trained you, and you feel stronger.

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's Final Training

string.name: parent
string.value: Mai's Training
Ready for Mai's last training?
Mai wants you to try hunting stronger monsters now. \n\n#o1210102# #r#a10171# #k
After Mai's training, you feel much, much stronger. Time to get off Maple Island! Go to South Ferry and take the boat to Victoria Island.

string.name: name
string.value: Todd's How-to-Hunt
You hear that Todd can teach you how to hunt...

Todd asks you to attack and defeat a #bJr. Sentinel#k, then talk to #p2002#.

Jr. Sentinel #b#a10181##k
#t4000142# #b#c4000142#/1#k
You defeated the monster, just as Todd instructed.

string.name: name
string.value: Sam's Suggestion
Sam suggests that you talk to Mai.
When you talk to Sam, he tells you to head to the east and hunt #r10#k #b#o100100##k before meeting #p12100#. \n\n#b#o100100# #r#a10191##k
As Sam suggested, you hunted #r10#k #o100100#s#k, then met #p12100#.

string.name: name
string.value: Pio and the Recycling
You gathered the recycling materials that Pio asked for, and he said he'd make you something nice in return.
Pio promised to make you a nice relaxing chair with the recycling materials you gathered for him.
You helped Pio gather recycling materials, and he made you a nice comfortable chair in exchange.

string.name: name
string.value: Roger's Apple
Talk to #b#p2000##k.
By pressing the hotkey I, you can consume #b#t02010007##k in the Use window. Now talk to #b#p2000##k.
You learned how to use items! This will make life much easier!

string.name: name
string.value: Lucas' Cute Daughter
Elder #b#p12000##k in #b#m1010000##k has a request.

#p12000# is worried that his daughter in #b#m60000##k is too scared of monsters to come home. To clear a path for her, he asked you to defeat 7 #r#o0130101#s#k and let #b#p20100##k know. \n #k \n#o0130101# #r#a10221# #k
You let #p20100# know you got rid of all those troublesome #o0130101#s. Yes!

string.name: name
string.value: Here Little Piggy...
#b#p20002##k in #b#m60000##k looks upset. What's going on?

#p20002# heard that somebody says he looks like a #o1210100#. That's why he's so mad. To be honest, he does sort of look like a... Anyway, for #p20002#'s sake, you should defeat #r2#o1210100##k. \n #k \n#o1210100# #r#a10231# #k
You defeated 2 #o1210100#s! #p20002# seemed satisfied.

string.name: name
string.value: Love Counseling?!
#b#p2005##k says he needs to ask you something. This better not be some weird favor...

#p2005# is helping #b#p20001##k, part of the crew of #b#m60000##k, to find materials for his girlfriend's present. He asked you to get #b3 #t4000003#es#k and hand them to #p20001#. #t4000003#es? Defeat #r#o0130100#s#k to get them. \n\n#i4000003##t4000003# #b#c4000003##k/3
You gave #p20001# the #t4000003#es. #p20001# is going to make a boat.

string.name: name
string.value: Maria's Nutritious Juice

string.name: parent
string.value: Maria and Shanks
#b#p2103##k wants to speak to you...

#p2103# wants to make some #bnutritious juice#k and asked you to get these ingredients: #b#t4000004##k and #b#t4000011##k... Wonder what kind of juice this is...

#i4000004##t4000004# #b#c4000004##k/1 
#i4000011##t4000011# #b#c4000011##k/5
You gathered all the ingredients for #p2103#. #p2103# seemed to need another favor...

string.name: name
string.value: Delivering Nutritious Juice to Shanks

string.name: parent
string.value: Maria and Shanks
#b#p2103##k seems to need your help again.
#p2103# asked you to give nutritious juice to #b#p22000##k, the captain of #b#m60000##k. Hmm... Are they dating?
You gave #p22000# #p2103#'s nutritious juice. #p22000# looked happy...#p2103# and #p22000# are dating. The juice looks...pretty nasty, actually, but #p22000# seemed happy.

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: For a new world
#b#p12100##k stands at #b#m50000##k. They say she is the strongest person on Maple Island... Why is she here? What's her life story? Go talk to #p12100#.

#p12100# was a new adventurer and worker on Victoria Island. But the elder, #p12000# in #m1010000# hired her to protect against dangerous situations on Maple Island. #p12100# says it's a hard because of all the work... Tell #b#p12000##k what #p12100# said.

#p12000# agreed with what #p12100# said. He said it's better to hire more workers. Then he asked you to tell #b#p1002101##k in #b#m104000000##k... #m104000000# is on Victoria Island... You have to go to #b#p22000##k in #b#m60000##k.

string.name: name
string.value: To Lith Harbor!

string.name: parent
string.value: For a new world

To deliver a message of #p12000# to #p1002101#, you need to go to Victoria Island. The only way you can get there is to pay #p22000# in #m60000#... Fortunately, #p12000# said he will ask #p22000# a favor. Go to #b#p22000##k.
#p22000# let you board for free as #p12000# request. Good, now on to Victoria Island! #m104000000#! Once there, you have to find #b#p1002101##k.
You met #p1002101# in #m104000000#. Hmmm. This tough and stubborn guy is a friend of #p12000#! Amazing! Fortunately, #p1002101# will do a favor for #p12000#.

string.name: name
string.value: Sam's Advice
A kind guy on Maple Island, #bSam#k wants to give you some advice...

Sam taught you #bhow to use AP#k, which you get whenever you get a new level. The investment of AP determines your power (STR), intelligence (INT), agility (DEX), and luck (LUK). It can also increase your HP and MP. \n\nWhoa... Fantastic! You learned a lot thanks to him. Sam said there is one more thing he has to tell you.

Sam said to go to Victoria Island to become a stronger adventurer through a Job Advancement. You can choose from Warrior, Magician, Bowman, and Thief on Victoria Island. Each job has a stat requirement: #bWarriors need STR 35, Magicians need INT 20, Bowmen need DEX 25, and Thieves need DEX 25# k. You should remember that and invest your AP in the proper stats of the job you want!

string.name: name
string.value: Maria's Map Reading
You're at a crossroads. Where should you go? Hmm, maybe you should ask Maria for help.
Maria showed you how to read the World Map. If you press W, the world map will appear. You can see some places that you haven't been...
You think the world map will make it easier to go around Maple World.

string.name: name
string.value: Heena and Sera
#bMaple World#k, where fantasy and reality meet...and enjoy a nice slice of pie together! This is the world of adventure and humor meet! Go talk to #bHeena#k first.
Heena says her sister #bSera#k likes to meet new travelers. Apparently, Sera's nearby, hanging laundry. Head to your #bright#k to find her.
Sera told you to take the #bportal to the right#k to continue your journey into Maple World.

string.name: name
string.value: Nina's Brother Sen

string.name: parent
string.value: Nina's Request
Apparently, #bNina#k, a proud resident of the Mushroom Town, has a little brother...
Nina asks you to see what her brother #bSen#k wants to eat. Since Sen's inside #ba house in Mushroom Town#k, you should enter and see what he says.
Sen told you he wants some tasty #bMushroom Candy#k.

string.name: name
string.value: What Sen Wants

string.name: parent
string.value: Nina's Request
What Sen wants is some nice, tasty #bMushroom Candy#k. You better tell this to #bNina#k.
You told Nina what Sen wanted to eat.

string.name: name
string.value: Tasty Mushroom Candy

string.name: parent
string.value: Nina's Request
You tell Nina that Sen wants Mushroom Candy. She then takes ten out of her pocket and asks you to give those to him. Better go see #bSen#k now!
When Sen received the Mushroom Candy, he seemed very grateful and even gave you a couple to enjoy.

string.name: name
string.value: Todd's Hunting Method
There's a fellow named #bTodd#k who can teach you how to hunt in Maple World.

Todd says the #bCtrl#k key lets you perform basic attacks on monsters and wants you to hunt the Jr. Sentinel nearby. Hunt the #rJr. Sentinel#k, obtain 1 #bJr. Sentinel Shellpiece#k, and bring it to #bPeter#k. 

Jr. Sentinel #r#a10351##k 

#i4031802# #t4031802# #b#c4031802##k/1

You learned that skills can be accessed by pressing #bK#k to open the Skill Inventory. Unlike regular attacks, you need to raise a skill's level by assigning Skill Points. Peter also said that it's much more convenient to assign skills to the Quick Slot bars.

string.name: name
string.value: Robin the Walking Encyclopedia
#bRobin#k, who mutters excitedly to himself as he stands at Snail Hunting Ground 1, knows a lot about job advancement. Perhaps you should speak with him.

Robin promises to teach you everything you could ever want to know about stats, AP, and job advancement. But you have to take a quiz afterwards. He seems awfully fixated on that quiz... Guess you should talk to him and study up before continuing with the quest 'Robin the Walking Encyclopedia.'
You passed Robin's quiz! He looked a little wistful as you walked away, as if he wanted to give you another one...

string.name: name
string.value: Help Hunt the Snails

string.name: parent
string.value: Sam's Request
#bSam#k in the Dangerous Forest is waiting for you to help him.
Sam wants you to take care of some snails. Slay #r10 Snails#k, then tell #bLucas#k that the field is clear.\n\nSnail #r#a10371##k
You told #bLucas#k that you took care of the snails.

string.name: name
string.value: Maria's Letter

string.name: parent
string.value: Sam's Request
Maria is relieved the Snails are gone. Now she can now concentrate on collecting mushrooms. To make sure no one worries about her, she wants you to give this letter to #bChief Lucas#k in #bAmherst#k.
After reading the letter, Lucas seemed quite relieved and told you he wanted to introduce you to someone #bwho can train you#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Helping Out Yoona
#bYoona#k is in a bit of trouble after wandering out of Amherst.

Yoona is trapped by monsters between her and Amherst. To help her return home, she needs you to take care of some #rBlue Snails#k and #rSpores#k.

Blue Snail #r#a10391##k 
Spore #r#a10392##k
You took care of the Blue Snails and Spores and told Yoona.

string.name: name
string.value: Chief's Introduction
For helping Maria, #bLucas#k offers to introduce you to a person who can train you. Hmm, who could he mean?

Lucas tells you to head to #bthe East Field of Amherst#k and find #bMai#k, who trains there. He thinks you'd benefit from her tutelage. #k

#y1041# #b (#u1041#)#k
#y1042# #b(#u1042#)#k
#y1043# #b(#u1043#)#k
#y1044# #b(#u1044#)#k
You completed all of Mai's Trainings and returned to Lucas.

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's First Training

string.name: parent
string.value: Mai's Training!
Lucas introduces you to someone who can train you. #bEast of Amherst#k, you can find #bMai#k. Better head over.
Mai instructs you to hunt #r5 Stumps#k and collect #b3 Tree Branches#k. \n\nStump #r#a10411##k #i4000003# #t4000003# #b#c4000003# #k/3
You managed to hunt 5 Stumps, gather all the branches, and report it all to Mai.

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's Second Training

string.name: parent
string.value: Mai's Training!

After you finished hunting Stumps, Mai thought you had some talent and turned the training up a notch. This time, you must hunt #r5 Red Snails#k. They are faster than Stumps, so watch out. \n\nRed Snail #r#a10421##k
Red Snails have much higher endurance than Snails and Blue Snails. They also move faster than Stumps. You better not underestimate those sneaky creatures.

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's Third Training

string.name: parent
string.value: Mai's Training!

After you hunted five Red Snails, Mai says it's time for even more powerful monsters. She wants you to hunt #r3 Slimes#k and bring back #b1 Squishy Liquid#k. \n\nSlime #r#a10431##k #i4000004# #t4000004# #b#c4000004# #k/1
After successfully hunting Slimes, you obtained the Squishy Liquid and reported to Mai.

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's Last Training

string.name: parent
string.value: Mai's Training!
You defeated the Slimes and brought back the Squishy Liquid to Mai. She seemed impressed and now wants you to hunt a really powerful monster, #r3 Pigs#k.\n\nPig #r#a10441##k
You defeated 3 Pigs and reported the result to Mai.

string.name: name
string.value: Bari's Test
#bStanding close to Mai#k, #bBari#k seems to be looking for you...

Bari has been instructed by Mai to test your skills. He wants you to defeat the most powerful monster on Maple Island, an #rOrange Mushroom#k, and bring back #b1 Orange Mushroom Cap#k. 

Orange Mushroom #r#a10451##k
#i4000001# #t4000001# #b#c4000001# #k/1
You defeated an Orange Mushroom and brought back an Orange Mushroom Cap to Bari. Ah, Mai's training...officially complete! Ready to take on Victoria Island?

string.name: name
string.value: Biggs's Story on Victoria Island.
Go to #bSouthperry#k and meet up with #bBiggs#k to learn more about Victoria Island, like Bari suggests.
Biggs tells you the basics of Victoria Island and advises that you speak with Olaf once you land there. Okay, gotta remember that. #bLith Harbor#k. Meet #bOlaf#k. Okay!
Olaf seemed genuinely happy to meet a new traveler and said if you want to learn more about job advancement, he's your man!

string.name: name
string.value: Designated Monster Effect
Designated Monster Effect
Collect 5 #b#M1047# cards#k and receive bonus EXP when hunting.\r\nWhen hunting #r#M1047##b, receive #r#x1047# #b#k
You have received bonus EXP from the Monster Book effect after hunting the designated monster.

I was still just getting my feet wet in this game, so the Maple Administrator decided to help select a job for me.

string.name: name
string.value: Cygnus Knights
Neinheart suddenly approaches you...
The Cygnus Knights... Neinheart wonders if you are interested in joining...
The Cygnus Knights... What is that?

First, eliminate Pigs and gather the Primrose Seeds they carry.
Next, plant the seeds at their designated location. The Moon Bunny will appear if 6 Primroses bloom.
Protect the Moon Bunny until it has time to make #r10 Rice Cakes#k.
Bring the Rice Cakes you received from Growlie back to Tory to collect your reward.

string.name: name
string.value: Mysterious Discovery
#p1002001# pulled up an odd wooden relic from the sea while he was fishing around #m104000000#. He said it gave off an ominous energy. It might be best if you went to check it out.

You found out that #p1002001# received a request from #p1090000# after seeing #m120000100# anchored at Victoria Island. The request was related to the odd wooden relic he discovered. When you inquired about the relic, he asked you to deliver it to #p1092007# in #m120000100#.
#p1092007# told you that she felt the same ominous feeling when she saw the wooden relic.

string.name: name
string.value: Investigating the Discovery
The Wooden Relic pulses with a strange and dark energy. It feels like a raincloud is following you around. Take it to #p1092007# and see what he thinks about it.

#p1092007# noticed a strange symbol carved into the Wooden Relic, but it was covered in a thick coat of sea-moss that will require a delicate hand to peel off. Would you like to go and try to remove the moss now?
Peeling off the moss summoned a host of monsters! What kind of power does this relic possess?!

string.name: name
string.value: The Black Mage's Commander 1
The Wooden Relic was marked with a very carefully carved emblem. #p1092007# might know something about it.
#p1092007# wasn't certain about the Wooden Relic's origin. He sent you to ask #p1090000# if she recognized it. Her research on the Black Mage may help in identifying where the relic came from.
#p1090000# identified the emblem on the Wooden Relic as belonging to one of the Black Mage's commanders!

string.name: name
string.value: The Black Mage's Commander 2
Who are these commanders?! What do they have to do with the Black Mage?! Ask #p1090000# to tell you more.

#p1090000# told you of the Black Mage's Seven Commanders; the most dangerous and evil creatures known to Maple World! The relic bears the mark of Guwaru. The news seemed to upset #p1090000# greatly and she's asked that you take the relic to #p1012100# immediately.
#p1012100# thinks this relic is an omen of the Black Mage's imminent invasion of Maple World. The relic, along with the rumored return of the Lion King, seem to point to bad times ahead.

string.name: name
string.value: A Dangerous Warning
#p1012100# recognized Guwaru's mark on the Wooden Relic immediately. Ask her what it means.

#p1012100# thinks that Guwaru's mark could just be a leftover from hundreds of years ago, but she is concerned that it may be a sign of the Black Mage's resurrection. She recommended trying to purify the relic, but the process could be dangerous...
I am not certain, but this could be a sign that the Black Mage is returning to Maple World...

string.name: name
string.value: Athena Pierce's Decision
The Black Mage's resurrection and the appearance of Guwaru. What will #p1012100# decide to do?!

A few days ago, #p1012100# received a letter from #p1101000# requesting her help in holding a continental conference to discuss the formation of the Maple Alliance. #p1012100#'s concerns over the alliance's reach and their potential control over the adventurers of Maple World overwhelmed her desire to see it formed. However, this new crisis has forced the issue and #p1012100# has decided to commit. Return to #p1101000# with the good news.
#p1101000# has requested your participation in the Maple Alliance. Will you join and battle the Black Mage with her, or will you continue adventuring freely on your own?

string.name: name
string.value: The Birth of an Alliance

string.name: name
string.value: Cassandra's Prophecy
Cassandra wants to talk to you...for some reason.

Cassandra seems to think some historic event is about to occur in Maple World, but what could it be? She also hinted that the outcome may hinge on your training.

#b[Complete all story quests up to Lv. 75 for each job to proceed to the new story quest, The Birth of an Alliance. (The Explorer does not have a separate story quest.)]#k

#b[Once you join the Alliance, you can learn the Willpower of the Alliance skill, a new passive skill that will allow you to gain the Member of the Alliance Emblem.]

#b[You will only be able to access the Silent Crusade and Arkarium quests after joining the Alliance.]

string.name: name
string.value: Rise of the Alliance
The time for the decisive battle draws near. What will #p1012100# choose?

A few days ago, #p1012100# received a letter from #p1101000# requesting her help in holding a continental conference to discuss the formation of the Maple Alliance. #p1012100#'s concerns over the alliance's reach and their potential control over the adventurers of Maple World overwhelmed her desire to see it formed. However, this new crisis has forced the issue and #p1012100# has decided to commit. Return to #p1101000# with the good news.
#p1101000# has requested your participation in the Maple Alliance. Will you join and battle the Black Mage with her, or will you continue adventuring freely on your own?

#p1105012# showed you an invitation to the continental conference sent by the #p1101000# Knights. She's excited to see you finally being recognized as a true Hero. You have traveled to Ereve and met the Cygnus Empress. Could this little girl really be an Empress?

string.name: name
string.value: Rise of the Alliance
What should the Resistance do about those that want to resurrect the Black Mage? Ask #p2152004#.

The Resistance has met and decided to participate in the continental conference, led by Empress #p1101000#. They're not certain they can defeat the Black Mage, even with the other leaders of Maple World at their side, but they know they can't do it on their own. Bring word of the Resistance's official acceptance back to Empress #p1101000#.
The Alliance would give you a chance to avenge #p2151005#, wouldn't it?

string.value: EXP 3,700\n

string.name: name
string.value: Rise of the Alliance
Neinheart, a member of the Cygnus Knights, speaks to you suddenly.

Empress Cygnus is on the verge of making an important decision, but she wants some advice from you, the ruler of the Elves and hero of the past. What could be so important to cause her to waver? Go to Ereve and find out.

The fate of Maple World hinges on the alliance. If each continent joins its forces, the heroes stand a chance of victory against the Black Mage. The mistakes of the past must be mended, Maple World must unite against the Black Mage!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 3,700\n

She told you to bring some Alexandrite from the mysterious mine and bring it to the Empress at the Conference Pavillion of the Alliance.
With the Alexandrite to help channel her powers, the Empress Cygnus unlocked the hidden powers of the Resistance. Now, they are truly a force to be reckoned with!

Through the combined powers of the Alexandrite and Empress Cygnus, your potential has been unlocked! Behold your awesome power!

string.name: name
string.value: [Silent Crusade] Mystic Fields Appear
Professor Moon, who's affiliated with the Silent Crusade, suddenly wishes to speak to you. What's going on?

Professor Moon says that enormous amounts of Mystic Energy has gathered at various locations in Maple World. He wants you to do something about it, and soon. The places in danger right now are Henesys, Pantheon, and Leafre. Head to those #bMystic Field#k locations by foot or via the warp portal that Professor Moon provided.

According to Professor Moon, a commander of the Black Mage used the mystic energy to create a copy of a powerful enemy. Since the energy isn't complete, it will eventually disappear, but you must protect the towns in the meantime! Eliminate enemies and protect the town!

string.name: name
string.value: [Silent Crusade] Eliminate Mystic Zakum
Professor Moon has more to say to you about the Mystic Gates.
The professor says that a copy of Zakum called 'Mystic Zakum' might be inside a Mystic Gate. He asks you to eliminate it if you run into it.
You eliminated Mystic Zakum. You can eliminate Mystic Zakum once per day, just be sure to let Professor Moon know afterwards.

string.name: name
string.value: Spiegelmann's Gonzo Gallery Opening
Spiegelmann has something he wants to show you.
You've been invited to the grand opening of Spiegelmann's Gonzo Gallery. It's going to be an artsplosion of epic artportions!
You arrived at Spiegelmann's Gonzo Gallery.

string.name: name
string.value: A Season of Admiration
Take a look around the Gonzo Gallery.
Spiegelmann created the Seasonal Series to represent his viewpoint throughout the year. Make sure to give each of them a good click to make him feel like a good artist.
You checked out all of Spiegelmann's painting, like a good friend!

string.name: name
string.value: Ominous Artwork
Ask Spiegelmann about his artwork.
This is his most recent work, but he's been getting a weird feeling from it. Maybe you should give it a click to investigate.\r\n
Something funky is going on in this gallery and it isn't just Spiegelmann's cologne.

string.name: name
string.value: Lip-Warmer Confidential
Find Spiegelmann and see what he's so excited about.
Find the phone booth to place Spiegelmann's order.
Spiegelmann's order to the Moustache Factory has been placed. As a bonus, you now know that a Moustache Factory exists and somehow stays in business!

string.name: name
string.value: The Shimmering Bristles of Victory
Go back to Spiegelmann and let him know that his order is on the way.
Spiegelmann wants to be prepared for when his new moustache arrives. Travel to the #e#bQuiet Strolling Path#k#n using the #bWestern Portal#k and recover his Dapper Drip from Water Thief Monsters.
You gave Spiegelmann a good supply of Dapper Drip.

string.name: name
string.value: The Great Moustachiolanche
Spiegelmann looks sad. Ask him what's wrong.
Spiegelmann's pretty sure his order got lost.\r\nUse the #bEastern Portal#k to travel to the #eSecluded Park#n to find his lost Delivery Box.\r\n
You returned Spiegelmann's moustache box to him, along with a lot of other people's packages. That was probably illegal.

string.name: name
string.value: Proof of Delivery
Spiegelmann is sporting a stache that just doesn't suit him. Maybe you should talk to him about it... you know, as a friend.
The package you brought back for Spiegelmann wasn't the one he ordered.\r\nGive Spiegelmann a chance to look through the other Delivery Boxes and talk to him again.
The package you brought back for Spiegelmann wasn't the one he ordered.\r\nGive Spiegelmann a chance to look through the other Delivery Boxes and talk to him again.

string.name: name
string.value: How Spiegelmann Got His Groove Back
Spiegelmann's moustache is still a hideous mistake. You really have to help him out.
The package you brought back for Spiegelmann wasn't the one he ordered.\r\nGive Spiegelmann a chance to look through the other Delivery Boxes and talk to him again.
Spiegelmann found his moustache!

string.name: name
string.value: Every Whisker in its Right Place
Spiegelmann's looking quite pleased with himself. He looks like he has something to tell you.
Get him a sweet comb from the Baby Boulder Munchers at the Mine Entrance.
Spiegelmann will be grooming himself for the next few hours...

string.name: name
string.value: This Moustache Comes Fully Loaded
Spiegelmann has one last request for you in his quest for beautification.
Spiegelmann needs something to take his moustache to the next level. Go to the Mine Depths to defeat Cart Bears get their Channeling Jewels.
Spiegelmann now has a fully tricked out moustache... but it looks pretty much exactly like it always did.

string.name: name
string.value: Jewel of the Desert
What did #p9074200# have to go through to so perfectly capture the summer in Ariant? Go into the picture and ask him.
#p9074200# came to Ariant because he'd heard how beautiful #p9074201# is. Go draw a sketch of her so that he can prepare himself before he begins his portrait.
You gave #p9074200# your portrait of the queen.

string.name: name
string.value: Impromptu Artist
Meet Queen #p9074201# for #p9074200#.
Visit Queen #p9074201# to draw her portrait... as well as you can.
You completed the #t4033210# and took it back to #p9074200#.

string.name: name
string.value: Silk for the Queen
#p9074200# is in awe of the woman in your portrait.
#p9074200# refuses to meet up with the queen empty-handed. Bring #t4033212#, put it into the #p9074204#, and spin it into a wonderful silk for her.
#p9074200# is happy with the silk!

string.name: name
string.value: Weaving for the Queen
Use the #p9074204# to make silk for #p9074200#.
The soft fur of the #o9810200# is required to make silk with this particular loom. Go get a batch of #t4033212#.
The #t4033212# you gathered got magified into silk!

string.name: name
string.value: Diamonds for the Queen
#p9074200# is happy with the silk. But maybe it's still not enough?

#p9074200# thinks a queen should have some diamonds to go along with her silk, but the only place to get one is from #p9074203#, the Suspicious Merchant. Go to the Oasis and see if he has a rock to sell.
#p9074200# seems happy with the diamond!

string.name: name
string.value: Brokering for the Queen
Go get a Diamond from #p9074203#, the Suspicious Merchant. #p9074203# is at the Oasis.
#p9074203# will get you a Diamond, but he wants you to take revenge on all the #o9810201# who stole from him.
You got a diamond from #p9074203#.

string.name: name
string.value: Audience with the Queen
#p9074200# now has both Silk and a diamond! Maybe he'll finally be brave enough to meet the queen.

#p9074200# thinks he smells bad, which he does, but now he wants you to get him some new cologne. Anyway, go take out some #o9810202# in the Red Desert and get a good stock of #t4033214# for #p9074200#.
#p9074200# put on the #t4033214# Cologne and left for his audience with #p9074201#.
Spiegelmann needs help with something in the jungle. Go ask what it is.
Spiegelmann needs help incubating a Manon's Egg he... procured. Go collect Cozy Feathers from the Rash in Peach Monkey Forest to make a nest.
You made a nice nest for Manon's Egg!
Spiegelmann looks really serious for some reason. Go find out why.
Hobi's keep trying to steal the egg! You must protect it!
No Hobi will bother that egg ever again.
It seems that Spiegelmann wants to ask something of you.
The Hatchery needs new insulation. Get some Warm Feathers from Harps to stuff in the walls.
This should be enough Warm Feathers to make this place nice and draft-free.

string.name: name
string.value: Questionable Hatchtions
Spiegelmann looks anxious. Check in with him.
The egg appears to have a small crack in it. This is it!
The egg hatched... a baby White Tiger?! What sort of abomination is this?!

string.name: name
string.value: Top Hats and Tigers 1
Spiegelmann is looking at the White Tiger with an odd look. Make sure he doesn't decide to eat it.

Collect Nependeaths from the Wild Plant Habitat to purify and warm the air in the Hatchery.\r\nReduce a Nependeath's HP, then double click on #i2270024:#, the pouch Spiegelmann gave you, to capture them.\r\n
The Hatchery is now surrounded by Nependeaths. That's probably a good thing?

string.name: name
string.value: Top Hats and Tigers 2
Spiegelmann needs help one more time.
The Baby White Tiger is getting hungry. Get some Delicious Grass and Red Dragon Turtle Meat from the Dragon Forest.
You brought some food.

string.name: name
string.value: Snowy Mountain Survivor
You were sucked into a strange space while looking at the picture of #p9074200#. Where...?
You are trapped in a valley piled high with snow. It would be best to start a #p9074401# with any nearby #t4033215# you can find.
Everything is better with a #p9074401#.

string.name: name
string.value: The Snowy Valley
Light a #p9074401# and take a look around you.
This sort of looks like El Nath, but you can't figure out how you got here. Maybe you'll have better luck if you can get out of the valley.
The valley looks deep and treacherous.

string.name: name
string.value: Frosty Meal
A deep valley... and still no sign of #p9074200#.
You need to recover some health before you go look for #p9074200#. You'll feel better if you hunt some #o9810402# for their meat.
Much better! #t4033216# is always good!

string.name: name
string.value: Howl at the Snow
The meat was delicious, but it may also be trouble...
#o9810403# sighting! Take out 100 to put the fear into them.
The #o9810403# pack has been defeated!

string.name: name
string.value: Icy Escape Route
The wolves have left you alone after that mighty display of toughness.
Get yourself out of the valley. It's unlikely that #p9074200# is anywhere near here.
You found the exit. But with the slippery ice surrounding the whole place, there is no way to get out.

The rope is ready to go!
You lassoed a good hold to the #p9074402# perfectly! Time to escape this cold valley!
You found #p9074200# outside the valley. He called this place his work area...

string.name: name
string.value: Fixing Blackbull's House
You hear that Blackbull in Perion is fixing up his house.

In the dusty town of #m102000000#, you run into an oddly-dressed man named #p1020000#. He needs to fix his house and asks you to help by getting #b10 #t4000003#es#k and #b5 pieces of #t4000018##k. If you do, you'll get a nice shield. You wonder what would happen if you refuse... The man wouldn't eat you or anything, right? At least, you hope not.

You brought #p1020000# of #m102000000# #b10 #t4000003#es#k and #b5 pieces of #t4000018##k so he could fix his house. You received a shield as a reward. With scratch marks and blemishes all over it, the shield looks pretty old. You wonder if it's even usable.

string.name: summary
string.value: You need to gather materials to fix Blackbull's house.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
EXP 220
#Wprob#
#i1092000:# #t1092000:# 1 
#i1092001:# #t1092001:# 1 
Unlocks 'Building Blackbull's New House' quest

string.name: name
string.value: Building a New House For Blackbull
You hear Blackbull in Perion is building a new house...

You run into '#p1020000#' again, the guy whose house you helped fix. He has a much harder task for you this time, though. His cousins from #m100000000# are all moving to Perion, so he needs to build a brand new house, from scratch! He needs the deed to his land, but it was stolen from his son by #r#o3230100##k. You'll need to go see the Curse Eyes who roam the Northern Forest areas...
So that all of Blackbull's cousins could move to Perion, you got him the item he requested. It was really tough, and you hope he doesn't ask you to BUILD a house for him next time...

string.name: name
string.value: Maya of Henesys

string.name: parent
string.value: Maya and the Weird Medicine
You hear that #p1012101# is very sick...

A girl named Maya in Henesys has been ill for a long time. It looks like she can't live a normal life at all. You agree to help her. #bWeird Medicine#k... What a strange name! She says she'll get a little better by taking that... You should go to Lith Harbor and see this guy Teo...

Maya wanted you to go see Teo of Lith Harbor, so you did just that. He promised to give you the Weird Medicine only after you get him a Sparkling Rock. Geez, he won't even give any free medicine for a sick girl?

string.name: name
string.value: Finding Sophia

string.name: parent
string.value: Maya and the Weird Medicine

In Lith Harbor, you meet a heavily-bearded crewmember of The Victoria called Teo. He says he has some #bWeird Medicine#k but he isn't willing to give it up for free. Instead he says he'll trade it for a #bsparkling rock#k. He seems like he knows Maya pretty well, yet he still wants a favor first, knowing how sick Maya is? Creep. Anyway, to get the #bsparkling rock#k, you should head to Perion and talk to #rSophia#k, the daughter of the owner of the General Store there.
You met Sophia. To make the sparkling rock, she said she needs #bArcon's blood#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Making a Sparkling Rock

string.name: parent
string.value: Maya and the Weird Medicine

You meet Sophia in the General Store in Perion. She's working on her dream to be an alchemist. To make the sparkling rock, she says she needs #b50 squishy liquids, 50 leaves, 20 octopus legs#k and #b1 Arcon's blood#k. Everything looks reasonable enough...wait, Arcon's blood?! Fortunately, Sophia knows where to get some. She says to have a chat with Manji, who's somewhere around Perion.
Sophia told you that Manji has some Arcon's Blood, a key ingredient to make a sparkling rock.

string.name: name
string.value: Arcon's Blood?

string.name: parent
string.value: Maya and the Weird Medicine

You find Manji in Perion, but he is unwilling to give you any #bArcon's Blood#k for free. He wants you to go to the underground tunnel in the middle of the island and gather up #b10 Wild Boar Teeth#k first. You practically shiver at how coldly Manji treats you... You almost regret agreeing to help Maya, but no one else seems willing to...
Manji asked for #t04000020# in return for some Arcon's Blood.

string.name: name
string.value: Getting Arcon's Blood

string.name: parent
string.value: Maya and the Weird Medicine

You gather the #bWild Boar Teeth#k and give them to Manji in Perion. Still as cocky as ever, he hands over the #bArcon's Blood#k. Maybe he isn't so horrible...at least he followed through with his promise.
You brought the Charms of the Undead to Manji and finally got some Arcon's Blood. Hurry back to Sophia...

string.name: name
string.value: Making Sparkling Rock

string.name: parent
string.value: Maya and the Weird Medicine

Sophia looks genuinely surprised when you hand her all the materials needed for the #bsparkling rock#k. Well, it wasn't easy! Anyway, she hands over a #bsparkling rock#k made of the materials you gathered. Hmm, the #bsparkling rock#k...gives off a strange light and then...starts glittering, and...whoa, now you understand why people want this! It's mesmerizing! Well, now you just have to do it trade it with Teo in Lith Harbor.

Sophia looked genuinely surprised when you handed her all the materials needed for the #bsparkling rock#k. Well, it wasn't easy! Anyway, she handed back a #bsparkling rock#k made of the materials you gathered. Hmm, the #bsparkling rock#k...gives off a strange light and then...starts glittering, and...whoa, now you understand why people want this! It's mesmerizing! Well, now you just have to do it trade it with Teo in Lith Harbor.

string.name: name
string.value: Delivering the Weird Medicine

string.name: parent
string.value: Maya and the Weird Medicine

You traded the #bsparkling rock#k to Teo in Lith Harbor for the #bweird medicine#k. Now, to get it to #rMaya#k. Anyway, the medicine looks quite tasty. If you're ever thirsty and have no water handy, you'd be tempted to drink it yourself!

You returned to Henesys and handed Maya the weird medicine. Hopefully she'll get better after taking this. As a sign of thanks, Maya gave you 5,000 mesos and a #bbrown bamboo hat#k. The hat, er, well, it should keep your head protected under the hot sun, but it's kind of old and raggedy. And when you wear it, you feel like insects are crawling around. Nah, must be your imagination, right?

string.name: name
string.value: Pia and the Blue Mushroom
Find Pia in Henesys.

Under the watchtower in Henesys Park, you see Pia, wearing a teddy bear costume. How cute! She tells you that she ran into a bully #o2220100# on her way to Ellinia, and now she wants you to show the rude mushroom who's boss! Collect #b10 #t4000009#s and 10 #t4000012#s#k as proof. You contemplate telling Pia she's asking to be teased, walking around the forest in a bear costume, but you decide against it.

You delivered #b10 #t4000009#s and 10 #t4000012#s#k to Pia in Henesys Park. She was thrilled that she got vengeance on the mushrooms and gave you a Scroll for defense. All you have to do is click on it in the Use tab of your Item Inventory and drag it to your helmet in the Equipment window... Oh, and you'll have to cross your fingers and hope the Scroll doesn't fail.

string.name: name
string.value: Jane and the Wild Boar
Look for Jane in Lith Harbor.

In Lith Harbor, you find Jane, a girl wearing bunny ears. Jane says she wants to travel the world, but her dad won't let her. She thinks if you can get her #b10 Wild Boar Teeth and 10 Horny Mushroom Caps#k, her father will change his mind.

You delivered the #t4000020# and #t4000015##k to Jane. You wonder if this will really change her father's mind...she's wearing bunny ears, for goodness sake! Ah well, it's none of your business. In return, Jane gave you a Scroll for ATT. Your weapon's going to be awesome...if the Scroll works.

string.name: name
string.value: Jane's First Challenge

string.name: parent
string.value: Jane the Alchemist
You hear Jane's got herself a new life ambition...

Last time, you got Jane some boar's teeth to convince her dad to let her travel. That didn't work. Now she has a new dream. She wants to be an alchemist! A bit fickle, but whatever. Now, she needs materials... You can guess where this is going. She wants you to get her #b1 Pure Water, 30 Medicines with Weird Vibes, and 20 Malady's Experimental Frogs#k so she can make some Elixir.
You got the materials Jane needed to make some elixir. If she fails...is the whole place going to blow up?

string.name: name
string.value: Jane's Second Challenge

string.name: parent
string.value: Jane the Alchemist

This time, Jane promises to make an even better item, so she needs you to gather #b1 Mushmom Spore, 3 vials of Drake's Blood, 100 Medicine with Weird Vibes, and 30 Malady's experimental frogs#k. She said something about making Power Elixirs, something that restores both HP and MP.
You got Jane the materials she needed. If she does well, you'll get some nice elixirs. If not...er, you're not sure you really want to take what she gives you...
Jane will make you something better.

string.name: name
string.value: Jane's Final Challenge

string.name: parent
string.value: Jane the Alchemist

For this last experiment, Jane promises to make you a mysterious Scroll. For that, she needs #ba Moon Rock, 2 Dragon Skins, and 3Ancient Tree Saps#k. Maybe you should ask the fairies at Ellinia for the Moon Rock...

You got the materials Jane needed and the scroll for glove for ATT was made without a hitch. Sweet! Jane expressed a strong desire to keep experimenting. Maybe next time you return you'll be able to buy something from her that's not sold in stores...
Jane will make you something better.

string.name: name
string.value: Alex's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Alex the Runaway Kid
There is a runaway kid called Alex in Kerning City...

At the top of a building in Kerning City, you meet Alex, who ran away from home after a spat with his father. Now, with no money and a severe case of boredom, he wants to go home. He wants you to convince his father, Stan, who happens to be the chief of Henesys, to let him return home... Not only that, he also wants you to get a #bold gold watch#k, which belonged to Alex's mother, from his father as proof that he's calmed down.
As Alex requested, you looked for his father in Henesys to get Alex's mother's #bold gold watch#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Talking to Stan

string.name: parent
string.value: Alex the Runaway Kid
At the entrance of Henesys Park, you meet Alex's father, Stan, the chief of Henesys. Before you can even start a conversation, he asks you to get him #b10 #t4000007#s and 30 #t4000002#s#k.
Only after you brought the #t4000007#s and the #t4000002#s did Chief Stan start talking to you.

string.name: name
string.value: Mother's Gold Watch

string.name: parent
string.value: Alex the Runaway Kid

At the entrance of Henesys Park, you met Alex's father Stan, the chief of Henesys. He was even more blunt and difficult to talk to than you'd anticipated, but you finally convinced him to accept Alex back with open arms. You also got Alex's late mother's #bgold watch#k as proof. Now, all you need to do is get this watch to Alex in Kerning City.

You gave Alex his late mother's #bgold watch#k. As a sign of appreciation, he gave you an earring he received from friends he met while traveling. Well, Stan forgave Alex, but it doesn't seem like Alex plans to head home right away. Maybe you should keep an eye open next time you're in Henesys.

string.name: name
string.value: Arwen and the Glass Shoe
Arwen the fairy from Ellinia has lost something...

Arwen the fairy from Ellinia says she lost her #bglass shoe#k a couple of days ago, on her way to Perion. A monster covered in flame stole it! Fairies obsess over glimmering, shiny objects so she obviously wants it back... Time to hunt some monsters near Perion.

You returned the glass shoe to Arwen in Ellinia. You got lucky, finding it off a nasty Fireboar As a sign of gratitude, she gave you a fairy item. It's gorgeous and glimmers like a star. Dang, maybe you can use this to make something special.

string.name: name
string.value: Luke the Security Guy
Meet Luke the Security Guy at the entrance of the Henesys Dungeon.

At the entrance of the dungeon, you meet Luke the security guy. He wants to make a healthy dish for his mom and asks you to get him #b100 pieces of Jr. Necki's skin, 10 wings of Stirge, and a bowl of salad#k. He says he's too busy, but it looks like he's just napping on the job...

You got Luke the stuff he asked for. Since he's making the Snake Drink... you want a taste, too! Luke gave you a nicely refined jewel he found from around the area. Anyway, you should drop by later when he's done making the Snake Drink.

string.name: name
string.value: A Clue to the Secret Book

string.name: parent
string.value: Mr. Wetbottom's Secret Book
Mr. Wetbottom in Sleepywood is in a pickle...\nGo visit Mr. Wetbottom in the luxurious sauna in the Sleepywood hotel.

Mr. Wetbottom, the bald man in Sleepywood's luxurious sauna, lost his favorite book to his runaway son Ronnie. He's offered you some very cushy sauna gear if you get the book back. Ronnie's known for watching the Drakes, so he's likely to be around the #bSilent Swamp#k. It's a weird request, but that robe looked very comfortable.
You found Ronnie in #bSilent Swamp#k for Mr. Wetbottom.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2,570\nHungry Ronnie now available.\n

string.name: name
string.value: Hungry Ronnie

string.name: parent
string.value: Mr. Wetbottom's Secret Book

You found #bRonnie#k, Mr. Wetbottom's son, in the #m105010000#, but he won't give you the book. He did appear to be very hungry, and might be more receptive to giving up the book if you get him an #bUnagi Special and some Fresh Milk#k. Ronnie says one of the hotel lobby workers has the Unagi Special and Copper Drakes drop Fresh Milk. You should go to the hotel first.

You got Ronnie the food he needed and received the #bSecret Book#k Mr. Wetbottom desperately wanted back. It's a weird-looking book with a red cover... You have a feeling that you should not open this book... Anyway, gotta return this to Mr. Wetbottom at the VIP sauna in Sleepywood before it's too late.
You accepted Mr. Wetbottom's request from the Sleepywood sauna and found Ronnie in #m105010000#.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 10,285\nCan proceed to the Returned Secret Book quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Unagi Special
You'll have to help the hotel employee to get the Unagi Special.

You found #bRonnie#k, the son of Mr. Wetbottom, in the #m105010000#. He seemed hungry, but wouldn't give you the book. If you bring him some food, he might give you the book. You took care of some business for Sleepywood Hotel and received Unagi Special. Take the Unagi Special to Ronnie.
Go find the Sleepywood Hotel lobby employee and ask for Ronnie's food.

string.name: name
string.value: Cold Milk

To get the Unagi Special and some Fresh Milk, you need to gather some ingredients. Rina of Henesys wants #b50 Curse Eye Tails and 5 Pig's Heads#k for the Unagi Special. Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia wants #b5000 Mesos#k in exchange for Fresh Milk.

엘리니아 나무통로 안에서 시워언해 아저씨의 아들인 #b로니#k를 찾을 수 있었다. 빨간책은 절대 넘겨줄 수 없다고 말은 하지만 꽤나 배가 고픈 모양인걸? 결국 #b루팡의 바나나 20개, 리나의 특제 장어구이, 신선한 우유#k를 가져다 주면 책을 주기로 약속했다. 로니의 말에 의하면 리나라는 사람은 헤네시스에서 찾을수 있고 신선한 우유는 엘리니아의 요정에게서 얻을 수 있을 거라고 하니... 조금 귀찮기는 하지만 가봐야 겠는걸...

string.name: name
string.value: Returned Secret Book

string.name: parent
string.value: Mr. Wetbottom's Secret Book
Talk to Ronnie.
You got the Secret Book from Ronnie. What could be inside? It's probably nothing interesting. Return the book to Mr. Wetbottom in the Sleepywood Hotel sauna.
You returned the Secret Book to Mr. Wetbottom in Sleepywood and got a sweet sauna robe for the trouble! You should go relax with your swanky new robe!

string.name: name
string.value: Collecting 50 Cursed Dolls

string.name: parent
string.value: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
I think Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia has something to ask me...

You run into #bRowen#k again, the fairy who gave you fresh milk for Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son. Back then, she seemed to be keeping her guard up against humans, but now, it looks like she accepts you as Ronnie's friend... Rowen is assistant to the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, and she tells you that Grendel is concerned about the cursed dolls that he made with his black magic a long, long time ago. The dolls had been sealed up for a while, until a bunch of Lupins took them and ran away. The Lupins have since become zombies and have been destroying the forest. To return the forest to how it was before, someone needs to take down the Zombie Lupins and take away the #bcursed dolls#k from them... So, you readily accept the request to collect #b50 cursed dolls#k, but fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...
You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b50 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you 7 ores. You hope the forest will return to normal...

string.name: name
string.value: Collecting 70 Cursed Dolls

string.name: parent
string.value: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
70? Well, that shouldn't be too hard...
You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b70 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you 10 ores. You hope the forest will return to normal...

string.name: name
string.value: Collecting 100 Cursed Dolls

string.name: parent
string.value: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
Rowen asks for your help again, this time to collect #b100 Cursed Dolls#k. It's getting quite serious now...

You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b100 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you 5 very rare ores. You hope the forest will return to normal...

string.name: name
string.value: Collecting 150 Cursed Dolls

string.name: parent
string.value: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
Rowen asks for your help again, this time to collect #b150 Cursed Dolls#k. Now that's a lot of Cursed Dolls!\n\n#i4000031# #t4000031# #b#c4000031##k/150

You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b150 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you the Scroll for gloves. You hope the forest will return to normal...

string.name: name
string.value: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls

string.name: parent
string.value: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
Rowen asks for your help one last time, this time to collect #b200 Cursed Dolls#k. You wonder why she needs so many... Is she trying to sell them or something?

You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b200 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you a nice hat. You've collected so many dolls for her, but it seems like the Zombie Lupins aren't decreasing in any way, shape, or form... you wonder what's going on. However, it seems that the fairies may not have such animosity toward humans now... at least that's a good thing.

string.name: name
string.value: Don Hwang's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Request
You hear that Nella at Kerning City is the one to talk to if you're looking for work...

You give Nella 1000 mesos as commission for telling you about various requests from the citizens of Kerning City. The first request is to get materials for Don Hwang, the owner of the armor shop. You must find #b5 #t4000042#s#k and #b5 #t4000035#s#k that Wraiths are known to drop. It won't be too hard, since you can easily find Stirges and Jr. Wraiths at the Subway.

You delivered what Don Hwang asked for and you got bunch of lemons in return. You wonder what kind of armor Don Hwang will make. Nella said there are many more requests you can do. You should visit Nella every once in a while.

string.name: name
string.value: Shumi's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Request
You delivered what Shumi asked for and you got bunch of cakes in return. Now, Shumi's little puppy has her own house. Return to Nella for another gig.
Shumi, who sits in front of the Subway, wants to build a house for the puppy she received from her friend. Bring #5 Tree Branches#k to Nella for the puppy house.

string.name: name
string.value: Andre's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Request

You got a third request from Nella. Andre from the Hair Salon wants some Seafood Soup. You should get #b15 Octopus Legs#k and #b1 Pure Water#k.

#i4000006# #t4000006# #b#c4000006##k/15
#i2022000# #t2022000# #b#c2022000##k/1
You delivered what Andre asked for and got a glove in return. You hope he enjoys his hearty bowl of Seafood Soup. Return to Nella for another gig.

string.name: name
string.value: Dr. Faymus's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Request

Nella says that you look much stronger. She wants you to get some ingredients for Dr. Faymus, the owner of the potion shop. He needs #b10 Jr. Necki Skins#k. Taking on Jr. Neckis might be little tough, but you know you can handle it!
You delivered what Dr. Faymus asked for and got bunch of white potions in return. You wonder what kind of potion Dr. Faymus will make using those materials. Return to Nella for another gig.

string.name: name
string.value: Chris's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Request

You got another request from Nella. Chris's pillow was stolen a few days ago and now he can't sleep. To make a new pillow, he needs #b10 pieces of Leather#k. You should get them as soon as possible, so Chris can get some sleep!


#i4000021# #t4000021# #b#c4000021##k/10
You delivered what Chris asked for and got some refined steal and bronze. Chris can finally sleep well in his new pillow. Return to Nella for another gig.

string.name: name
string.value: Cutthroat Manny's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Nella & Kerning City Citizen's Request

You got another request from Nella. Cutthroat Manny needs to get #b20 Evil Eye Tails#k so he can make a nice dinner of Evil Eye Stew. Now, that sounds delicious...in a gross, disgusting, putrid type of way!\n\n#i4000007# #t4000007# #b#c4000007##k/20
You delivered what Cutthroat Manny asked for and got a pair shoes in return. Now... Cutthroat Manny doesn't have to worry about his dinner menu for a while. Return to Nella for another gig.

string.name: name
string.value: Luke the Security Man's Wish to Travel
You hear that Luke the Security Guy made up his mind on something...

You meet Luke at the entrance of the dungeon. Now that his mom's had her fill of Snake Drink, Luke wants to leave his boring life behind and see the world. Mr. Smith of Perion says he can make good traveling gloves for Luke with #b1 Black Feather, 30 Dragon Skins, and 3 Horns of Taurospear#k. And, of course, he wants you to collect them for him. Luke says that the fairies in Ellinia may know something about the feather...

I got Luke all the materials he needed for the nice glove, and return, he gave me a very precious item that has been passed down from generation to generation, an #bold bronze normal Helm#k. I feel like I'm losing out on this deal...but I can't get mad at him since it's been passed down from generation to generation. I heard Mr. Thunder can make this helmet even better...I should go there sometime later.

string.name: name
string.value: First Material for Building a New House
Go meet Ronnie in the woods in Ellinia.

Ronnie from the forest of Ellinia asked you to gather up materials to build a house for newborn fairies. #b50 of each of the following: Orange Mushroom Caps, Leaves, Squishy Liquid, and Red Snail Shells#k. You can get most of these from the monsters around the prairie.
You got all the items Ronnie requested, but when do you get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do you have to do this?

string.name: name
string.value: Second Material for Building a New House

This time Ronnie wanted #b50 of each of the following: Octopus Legs, Curse Eye Tails, Wild Boar Teeth, and Charms of the Undead#k. These are probably available from the monsters around Deep Forest, the Highlands, and the Ant Tunnels.
You got everything Ronnie needed! He'd better have something amazing waiting for you at the end!

string.name: name
string.value: Third Material for Building a New House

string.name: parent
string.value: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.
Meet Ronnie in the #m105010000#.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 10,000 Can proceed to the Last Material for Building a New House quest
Ronnie asked you to gather the necessary materials to make homes for newborn fairies. He asked you to collect #b50 Drake Skulls#k.
You got everything Ronnie needed. Now where's that amazing reward he promised?!

string.name: name
string.value: Last Material for Building a New House

string.name: parent
string.value: Ronnie & the Fairies Building a New House.
Meet Ronnie in the #m105010000#.

Ronnie revealed the last of the materials he needs. This time, he wants #b10 Medicine With Weird Vibes, 10 Wild Kargo Eyes, 10 Tauromacis Horns, 10 pieces of Dark Stone Golem Rubble, and 1 Diamond#k. Hunt at the Subway, Deep Forest, and Cursed Temple.

You got Ronnie the stuff he needed. As your reward, he gave you a pair of shoes that he can't wear. Hopefully, you can equip them!

string.name: name
string.value: Maya's First Collection

string.name: parent
string.value: Collecting For Maya
Go see Maya in Henesys.

I got a favor request from Maya of Henesys, who has been collecting various items. She wanted #b50 each of snail shells, blue snail shells, mushroom spores, and tree branches#k. Maybe...well it looks like I can get these from the monsters around the prarie...
I got all the items Maya requested, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??

string.name: name
string.value: Maya's Second Collection

string.name: parent
string.value: Collecting For Maya

This time Maya wanted #b50 each of Fireboar teeth, Bubbling's huge bubbles, pig ribbons, and tablecloths#k. Apparently, I can get those by hunting down the monster around the plateau, subway station, and prairies ... well, that's easy!
I got them all for Maya. Please don't tell me she wanted all these for free...

string.name: name
string.value: Maya's Third Collection

string.name: parent
string.value: Collecting For Maya

This time, Maya requested #b10 Lupin Dolls and 50 each of Cold Eye's tail, Tortie's shell, and Iron Hog's Steel Hoof#k. Apparently I can get those through monsters at the highland, beach, and prairie. This is getting harder now...
I got them all for Maya. I'm still not getting anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??

string.name: name
string.value: Maya's Last Collection

string.name: parent
string.value: Collecting For Maya

Maya requested, for the last time, #b50 each of Clang's claws, Dark Stone Golem's pieces of rock, the eyes of Wild Kargo, and Tauromacis's horns, along with one diamond#k. Apparently I can get those through monsters at the beach, deep forest, and deep into the Cursed Temple... this is RIDICULOUS! It's too hard!

I got all the items Maya requested for the last time...or is it? As a sign of appreciation, she gave me a pair of shoes her grandma made for Athena Pierce, the chief of this town. It may be really old, but it still looks solid like brand new!!
Go see Maya in Henesys.

string.name: name
string.value: Looking for the Red Cape

string.name: parent
string.value: Pia's Present For a Friend
Visit Pia in Henesys.

Pia's friend has decided to go on an adventure and she wants to bring back a gift! She needs 5 Dragon Skins and 10 Screws#k to make a neat claw. She also needs the #bRed Cape#k that Rina in Henesys borrowed. Pia will probably give you a reward.
I decided to go to Rina to get the #bRed Cape#k back, which she has borrowed from Pia.

string.name: name
string.value: What Pia has Borrowed

string.name: parent
string.value: Pia's Present For a Friend
You agreed to visit Rina to take back Pia's cape.

You see Rina at Henesys, and she tells you that she took that red cape, because Pia didn't return the items she borrowed. Rina says that if she gets her items back, the cape is Pia's again. Go find #b1 Black Crystal, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 30 horns of Tauromacis.

#i4021008:# #t4021008:# #c4021008# / 1
#i4000028:# #t4000028:# #c4000028# / 15
#i4001005:# #t4001005:# #c4001005# / 1

I went to Rina to get Pia's cape, but Rina told me that she is keeping the cape until Rina brings back what she borrowed from Rina. She said she will return the cape if she gets back what Pia has borrowed from her.

string.name: name
string.value: Pia's Present For a Friend

string.name: parent
string.value: Pia's Present For a Friend
You went to get Pia's cape back, but Rina won't give it up until she gets back all the stuff Pia borrowed.

You delivered #b1 Black Crystal, 1 Ancient Document, and 30 horns of Tauromacis#k to Rina, and in return, you received Pia's #bRed Cape#k. You should take the cape, along with #b15 Silvers, 50 Dragon Skins, and 40 screws#k to Pia.

#i4000030:# #t4000030:# #c4000030# / 5

#i4011004:# #t4011004:# #c4011004# / 5
You got Thief clothes for bringing Claw materials to Pia in Henesys. These are made personally, so you should wear them at least once.

string.name: name
string.value: Hero's Gladius

string.name: parent
string.value: Manji's Old Gladius
Let's look for Manji in Perion

I ran into Manji from Perion again, the same Manji that I met while I was helping the little Maya get her medicine. He was shocked by my stronger appearance, and wanted to ask me for a favor. Long long ago, he was in danger of being attacked by Balrog, only to be saved by the legendary hero Tristan. He died in place of Manji, and for that, he's been keeping that sword to this day. Too bad the sword has been soaked in Balrog's evilness and is as ragged as possible. It's too embarrassing to even call it a sword now. Anyway, he gave me the #rOld Gladius#k and wanted me to reawaken it for him. If it indeed gets reawakened, it becomes the #bHero's Gladius#k ...I should go see Chrishrama of Sleepywood just the way Manji said it...

It seems that this Gladius which Manji told me is one fine sword. I had to make a hard decision choosing one bwtween the #bGladius#k and the #bSkull Earring#k which Manji offered me, but I will not regret.

string.name: summary
string.value: I need to reawaken the Hero's Gladius and take it to Manji.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
EXP 7,556
#Wselect#
#i1302015:# #t1302015:# x 1
#i1032012:# #t1032012:# x 1
Manji's Request now available

string.name: name
string.value: Reawakening the Gladius

string.name: parent
string.value: Manji's Old Gladius

You showed Chrishrama the #bOld Gladius#k that Manji gave you, and he claimed to have made it himself. He said that he needs #b1 Piece of Ice, 1 Ancient Scroll, and 1 Flamed Feather#k to awaken it. Unfortunately, you've never heard of any of those items... He recommended talking to Mike in Sleepywood to find them.

I got all the materials needed to reawaken the sword to Chrishrama. He couldn't believe his eyes, but went on with it, and reawakened the sword into #bHero's Gladius#k. It gives off a mystic light...and it's a really nice sword! Hmmm...I don't know if I should really give it to him...

string.name: summary
string.value: I need to find the materials needed to reawaken the Gladius and take it to Chrishrama.
See Chrishrama in Sleepywood to awaken the #bOld Gladius#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Mar' the Fairy and the Water of Life

At Ellinia, I ran into a fairy that's been busily studying the magic of life. Her name is 'Mar' and after taking a look at my pet that's been turned into a doll, she told me she can make it come back alive with #bThe Water of Life#k and #bThe Scroll of Life#k. I heard that she knows Cloy of Henesys... since it looks like a pet trainer named #bTrainer Bartos#k of Henesys knows something about the scroll of life, I should head over there...

After easily passing the test from Trainer Bartos of Henesys, I got a hold of #bThe Water of Life#k and #bThe Scroll of Life#k, and got that to 'Mar' the fairy. With her magical power and the items I got her, she turned the doll back into a living pet. I can hang out with him for a while longer now ... sweet ...

string.name: name
string.value: Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
Let's go look for Sabitrama in Sleepywood.

In front of Sleepywood Hotel, I met #bSabitrama#k, a medicinal herb trader who seems to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He said he found a place where he can finally find the herb that he needed for this medicine he's working on...and that he asked if I could go in that forest and grab an herb called #bPink Anthurium#k. It consists of green grass and a small pink flower ... I better remember this well and get him the exact same one. I heard the place is near Ellinia ... I should go there and talk to this guy #bShane#k ...

Thankfully I got the flower that Sabitrama wanted from the Forest of Patience, and as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a #bscroll for the overall armor#k. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay Shane of Ellinia. Based on what I've heard, the diet medicine Sabitrama's working on is for Shane's fiance... I better get back in the Forest of Patience when I have some time ...

string.name: name
string.value: Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine
I heard that Sabitrama in Sleepywood is making a new medicine...

I ran into #bSabitrama#k again in front of the Sleepywood hotel, the same one I helped get herbs before. This time, he said he found a place where I can get the important herb that he needed for his new medicine. He asked me if I could go into that forest and grab #bDouble-Rooted Red Ginseng#k for him. The root is in two, and red ... I should remember it well and find the same one once I get to the top. I should speak to #bShane#k of Ellinia ...

Thankfully I got the one that Sabitrama asked me to get, and for that, I got rewarded with a mysterious rock. And from here on out, I don't have to pay Shane every time I go in the Forest of Patience. From what I hear, that anti-aging medicine Sabitrama is working on may be what Shane needed ... if I have time, I should go back in there ...

string.name: name
string.value: John's Pink Flower Basket
Let's go meet John at Lith Harbor.

At Lith Harbor, I met a fisherman named John. He wanted to get his wife a nice flower basket for their upcoming anniversary. He asked me if I could get him #b10 Pink Violas#k for her. According to him, a mysterious statue can lead me to where the flower is. Sleepywood ... SLEEPYWOOD?!That's FAR!

I got John all #b10 Pink Violas#k. With these, he can make a beautiful flower basket for his wife on their anniversary. As a sign of appreciation, John got me a whole bunch of screws left over from ships here and there. By the way, if there are this many screws that have fallen out of ships, then how in the world are they even working...? Are they carrying passengers on it?

string.name: name
string.value: John's Present
Let's go see John at Lith Harbor again.

I ran into John the fisherman again at Lith Harbor. This time, he wanted to get his wife Blue Viola for her birthday. He asked me to get #b20 Blue Violas#k for him. The scent of Blue Violas last over 500 years...and according to John, they can be found through the mysterious statue again, where the flower may be found. Man ... do I HAVE to go in there again??

I got John all #b20 Blue Violas#k. It has a nice scent to it, but 20 of them? Makes my head spin...As a sign of appreciation, John got me a nice glove he found inside a ship. I mean, it looks like someone accidentally left that glove in there...is he allowed to give it to me like that? What if I wear this around town and run into the actual owner of it??

string.name: name
string.value: John's Last Present
I heard John has one final thing to ask me...

I ran into John the fisherman again at Lith Harbor. John says his mother recently passed away. He wants to place some White Violas at her headstone to pay his respects. They're supposed to possess a delicate scent that lasts for over a thousand years. According to John, they can be found through the mysterious statue... Yeah, it's a touching gesture, but really, there AGAIN?!

I got John all #b30 White Violas#k. It has a nice scent to it, but 30 of them? Makes my head spin...As a sign of appreciation, John gave me a set of his mother's earrings. These earrings look like they are made of some common flowers, but it seems there's something to it...

string.name: name
string.value: Shumi's Lost Coin
Let's start looking for Shumi in Kerning City.

I met this girl named Shumi in Kerning City. She was devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she was asking me to find it for her. She also told me that a bunch of guys draped in white cloth took it from her in the subway, and that they may be found at the #bConstruction Site B1#k, deep in the station ... I should go there first ...

I found the lost coin that Shumi of Kerning City was looking for, and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh ... as a reward, she gave me a whole bunch of the return scrolls ... not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at #bConstruction Site B1#k ... I should check it out later ...

string.name: name
string.value: Shumi's Lost Bundle of Money
Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.

I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. She seemed really worried about how she lost her rent money because a Stirge flew over and snatched a bundle of money away from her. Man ... do I have to walk back in there again ... can I just pay the rent for her? Anyway like last time, I need to go back in there, this time to #bConstruction Site B2#k and find the bundle of money she lost. Aye, better go in there now...

I got Shumi from Kerning City the lost bundle of money. I guess she can pay her rent now...and as a reward, she got me #b100 Mana Elixirs#k...she also said I may find other items at the #bConstruction Site B2#k...I should go check it out sometime...

string.name: name
string.value: Shumi's Lost Bundle of Money
Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.

I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. A while ago, she got a favor from JM From the Streetz to get an elixir for him, only to have the sack of money fall down and lose it all in the process. I guess I can find it at the deep part of the subway station, the #bConstruction Site B3#k, again.

I got Shumi of Kerning City the lost sack of money. With that, she can finally get the stuff JM requested. As a sign of thanks, she gave me #bscroll for shoes for speed#k. Since there are other items that can be found at #bconstruction site B3#k , maybe I should head back in there sometime...

string.name: name
string.value: Special Taste of Florina Beach
A beautiful girl by the name of Riel from Florina Beach seems to be in need of help...
Riel introduced me to a part time job, where I have to collect #b10 Coconuts#k. Why don't I start collecting those delicious looking Coconuts over there on the right?\n\n#t4000136# #c4000136#/10
I brought back fresh coconuts just like Riel said. Riel told me I can come back for work anytime I want. I guess I won't be starving here in Florina Beach.

string.name: name
string.value: Special Taste of Florina Beach II
Riel in Florina Beach asks me a question about Florina Beach. Piece of cake. I can answer that before I start my work.

You have to prepare the recipe ingredients for 12 people, then bring them to Riel in Florina Beach.

#i4000029:# #t4000029:# #c4000029# / 12
#i4000136:# #t4000136:# #c4000136# / 5
#i4000043:# #t4000043:# #c4000043# / 20
I answered all the questions that Riel gave me. I passed Riel's tests and she took the recipe for 12 people.

string.name: name
string.value: Special Taste of Florina Beach III
Emergency for the girl living in Florina Beach.
I worked part-time gathering recipes for cooking meals for the tourists coming to Florina Beach.

string.name: name
string.value: Special Taste of Florina Beach
Riel is trying to develop special dish of Florina Beach.

string.name: name
string.value: The Stump Horror Story
Ayan of Perion says she can't take one step out of town. I wonder why...

I met Ayan of Perion. Apparently, she cannot remember anything about her childhood, and she lives every day in fear of Stumps. So scared, in fact, that she can't even dare to look at it. Accompanied by this paralyzing fear of Stumps, she cannot take one step out of Perion, and asks me to take them out for her sake. Are they really THAT scary? \n\n#o0130100# #r#a20821##k
I took out Stumps for the sake of Ayan in Perion. She can finally venture outside without having to worry about them!

#b#p1052106##k on the rooftops of Kerning City wants to make a hang glider, and is offering to take you with him when he flies. It may not be a great idea, but he's definitely got passion. Gather materials for his hang glider.

I should go see Bruce in Henesys...
