string.value: The Lost Letter

I found a letter in the trash, all crumpled up in a ball. It looked like someone was in the middle of writing the letter when they decided to throw it away...It's hard to read what's written there because of all the creases everywhere, but I think I see the name ''Athena Pierce'' faintly across the page. I wonder if I can find the person to whom this letter belongs.

While I was trying to read the letter, Muirhat approached me with a suspicious look and started asking why I am reading Kyrin's letter. I told him that I had found it in the trash, and to that, he asked if I would be interested in delivering Kyrin's letter to #bAthena Pierce#k in #bHenesys#k.
I've delivered the letter to Athena Pierce as Muirhat had asked me to.

string.name: name
string.value: Athena Pierce's Smile

string.name: parent
string.value: The Lost Letter
I wonder how Kyrin and Athena Pierce know each other. Let me see what Athena Pierce has to say about that.
How surprising! Athena Pierce and Kyrin used to be practically family! I had no idea that the two had such a deep history.

string.name: name
string.value: Athena Pierce's Gift

string.name: parent
string.value: The Lost Letter

I'd better hurry and bring this orgel to Kyrin who is onboard on The Nautilus waiting for me, especially for Athena Pierce's sake. She's dying to see Kyrin. Anyhow, it's amazing how deeply their fates are intertwined...
I've delivered the orgel to Kyrin per Athena Pierce's request. Kyrin seemed so happy- I guess it was a good thing that I picked up the letter from the trash after all?

string.name: name
string.value: The Prince's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Whalians and The Nautilus
There's apparently a mysterious dolphin in the corridors of the Nautilus' lower deck. Seems very strange... What would a dolphin be doing out of the water and onboard a ship?

The mysterious dolphin is claiming that he is actually a Whalian prince and that he can't transform back to being a Prince because he is low on mana. Perhaps I should go find a bottle of #bmana elixir#k for the Whalian Prince?
Finally, the Whalian Prince has been replenished with mana. I thought he was just an ordinary dolphin... I mean, who would have known that he could turn out to be such a handsome prince?

string.name: name
string.value: Shining Stone

string.name: parent
string.value: Whalians and The Nautilus

I can't believe that The Nautilus' power is generated by this mystical Shining Stone... That's pretty interesting, I must say. I wonder what the Shining Stone looks like. I should go check out the stone in #bThe Nautilus' Generator Room#k.
While I was touching the Shining Stone, I could actually feel the stone's mystical powers traveling through my entire body.

string.name: name
string.value: Sea Firefly 1
Sharyl, the Prince of Whales, hanging out on the lower deck of The Nautilus, says he's got another problem. Let me see what he has to say.

Sharyl, the Prince of Whales tells me some mystical story about a Sea Firefly. I guess there are many other mystical objects on The Nautilus besides the Shining Stone? Anyway, according to Sharyl, the Prince of Whales, the mystical Sea Firefly's powers are diminishing, which is making him worried. I'd better help Sharyl, the Prince of Whales by going to the #bOlaf#k in #bLith Harbor#k to fill the magic flask with some #bVigor of the Sea#k.
You went to see the Olaf, who filled the Magic Flask with the Vigor of the Sea.

string.name: name
string.value: Sea Firefly 2
You should be getting the bottle back from Olaf and heading back to the Nautilus...

Olaf gave the magic flask back to you, filled with the Vigor of the Sea. You'd better get the bottle to #bSharyl, the Prince of Whales#k right away, before it starts getting dark. \n\n#i4031842##t4031842# #b#c4031842##k / 1
As the Vigor of the Sea is unleashed in The Nautilus, the overall atmosphere turns bright. But why is it that Sharyl, the Prince of Whales is blushing while saying that Kyrin should be so happy?

string.name: name
string.value: The Large Pearl
Apparently Sharyl, the Prince of Whales has yet another problem. Should I go find out what it is?

Sharyl, the Prince of Whales claims that he had left a #bMother of Pearl#k in The Nautilus' #bGenerator Room#k a long time ago. He thinks that there must be a #bLarge Pearl#k in there by now, and wants me to go get the pearl to take to Kyrin. I wonder why Sharyl, the Prince of Whales wants to give the pearl to Kyrin? Anyway, I should remember to beware of #bMuirhat#k while I'm on my way. The Prince warned me to watch out! \n\n#i4031843##t4031843# #b#c4031843##k / 1

Just as I am about to enter the Captain's cabin, Muirhat appears and stands in front of the door, blocking my way. He says that Sharyl, the Prince of Whales must give up hope, and wants me to hand over the pearl! Then he tells me to comfort Sharyl, the Prince of Whales if I see him again... Stay strong, dear Sharyl, the Prince of Whales.

string.name: name
string.value: Information for Dr. Kim

Do you know Rolonay, the smartest genius alive in all of The Nautilus? He is possibly the smartest person in all of Maple World. But he's apparently stuck in a jam, because of all the requests he's been getting from people asking for more and more information. I'd better give Rolonay a hand- But first, I should go see him in the central corridors of The Nautilus.

Rolonay's been working hard to compile all the information #bDr. Kim#k had requested, but says he's too tied up with all the analysis he has to do, to bring the research documents all the way to the Omega Sector. I should help out Rolonay and bring all the research documents to the Omega Sector for him.
I've delivered all the research documents to Dr. Kim, on Rolonay's behalf. That Rolonay, despite his looks, is quite a brainiac!

string.name: name
string.value: Can you please give Baine a helping hand?

string.name: parent
string.value: A Mysterious Entity Onboard The Nautilus

Baine's job is to monitor the sound waves of The Nautilus. The way the ship sounds is a good indicator of the overall well-being of the ship. Recently, Baine had apparently detected a strange sound coming through the walls on the lower deck. Could this be an ominous sign of things to come?

When Baine detects the strange sound waves coming from The Nautilus, he asks #bBart#k, the #bkeeper of the Watchtower#k, whether he's noticed any changes in sight. The watchtower is apparently on the eastern end of the shipping dock so I'd better look around carefully.
Bart says that he's noticed some strange movements. I wonder what he saw.

string.name: name
string.value: What is it that Bart saw?

string.name: parent
string.value: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus
Let me take Bart's status report to #bBaine#k.
I've delivered Bart's report to Baine. By the look on Baine's face, it seems that there's something fishy going on.

string.name: name
string.value: The Truth Behind the Black Shadow

string.name: parent
string.value: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus

Baine's eyes light up as he reads Bart's report, as if he's discovered something! He thinks that the ominous feeling he's been getting recently may have something to do with the Disciples of the Black Mage... Baine thinks it's possible that the Black Mage's Disciples are still in Victoria Island. He wants you to hunt down 15 #rRibbon Pigs#k and 15 #rPigs#k and bring back 1 #bBlack Mage's Token#k. 

#i4031846##t4031846# #b#c4031846##k / 1 
#o1210101# #r#a21731##k
#o1210100# #r#a21732##k
I've hunted down the monsters and found the Black Magician's Token, and brought it to Baine. I'm afraid there's something much bigger going on than it appears.

string.name: name
string.value: Report to Muirhat

string.name: parent
string.value: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus

Baine discovers that the Black Magician's Disciples have been secretly observing The Nautilus. And with that discovery, Baine's report is now ready to be delivered to Muirhat. Baine wants me to bring the report to Muirhat myself, since I gave him so much help with writing the report...

This report contains the Black Magician's Token which I found, plus a description of the strange sound waves that Baine had heard. It also includes information about the suspicious movements that Bart saw. I should take this to #bMuirhat#k.
When Muirhat receives the report, he is surprised and shocked to find that the Black Magician's influence has spread as far as here.

string.name: name
string.value: Disciples of the Black Magician

string.name: parent
string.value: A Mysterious Presence On-board The Nautilus

Muirhat thinks that Disciples of the Black Magician are most likely still lingering by Henesys and The Nautilus. He says that they are probably hiding in deserted house in the forest, disguised. I should get rid of them myself and preserve the peace on The Nautilus. \n\n#o9300156# #r#a21751##k
I've gotten rid of all the Disciples of the Black Magician. Have we finally restored the peace on The Nautilus?

string.name: name
string.value: Cleaning The Nautilus 1

Mrs. Reade, who is in charge of keeping The Nautilus clean, says she is in need of help. Apparently the wash cloths that she uses for cleaning the ship have become tattered from incessant cleaning and she's in need of some new wash cloths... I should go talk to Mrs. Reade myself in the upper deck corridors where she's cleaning.
Go find the #bPig's Ribbons#k, which Mrs. Reade can use as a wash cloth.\n\n#i4000002##t4000002# #b#c4000002##k / 10
Looks like Mrs. Reade's making good use of the pig's ribbon I brought her, but poor Mrs. Reade, she's cleaning all day long...as usual.

string.name: name
string.value: Cleaning The Nautilus 2

Mrs. Reade, who is in charge of keeping The Nautilus clean, says she's worried about the sanitary conditions of the ship because there has been a huge influx of mice on The Nautilus since the ship has been docked at Victoria Island. Should I help Mrs. Reade get rid of the mice?

The Nautilus has been docked at Victoria Island for some time now, and apparently that causes more rats to board the ship. Mrs. Reade is hyper-anxious having had to deal with all the vermin. I think I'll bring her #b50 Rat Traps#k. I've heard that I could obtain mouse traps from the #rRatz#k in Ludibrium. \n\n#i4000095##t4000095# #b#c4000095##k / 50
We set up 50 mouse traps. I don't think we'll see any more mice around here... would we?

string.name: name
string.value: Cleaning The Nautilus 3
Mrs. Reade says her problems just never end...

So we took care of all the rats on The Nautilus but there's still one more problem. And that problem happens to be the main cause of all of Mrs. Reade's problems on The Nautilus- and he still needs to be cleaned! Mrs. Reade's biggest problem is Jack, the one who's to blame for every bit of the mess on The Nautilus! Let me go get some #bPure Water#k so #bJack#k can get a good wash down. \n\n#i2022000##t2022000# #b#c2022000##k / 1
Will Jack ever get clean? All this scrubbing doesn't seem to be making him any cleaner... and I'm scrubbing and scrubbing...

string.name: name
string.value: Protect The Nautilus' Emergency Food Supply

string.name: parent
string.value: Special Recipe for The Nautilus

Apparently, pigs and ribbon pigs have been coming onto The Nautilus every night to eat up the ship's emergency food supply. At this rate, the people on The Nautilus may end up starving! I should go see Tangyoon, the ship's Head Chef and talk to him about this.

Tangyoon says pigs and ribbon pigs keep coming onto The Nautilus' emergency food supply and eating up all the food, and there's only a little bit left in storage! I'm gonna have to teach these #rpigs#k and #rribbon pigs#k a lesson they'll remember. 

#o1210100# #r#a21791##k 
#o1210101# #r#a21792##k
I think they must've learned their lesson by now. They'd better stay away from The Nautilus' food supply!

string.name: name
string.value: Find Fresh Milk

string.name: parent
string.value: Special Recipe for The Nautilus

According to those who've tasted Tangyoon's cooking, Tangyoon's dishes give you a mystical experience... They say that Tangyoon's dishes will either transport you to the happiest moment of your life or make you experience a flood-like rush of fantasy the moment you take a bite of it. What IS his secret?

The secret behind Tangyoon's cooking is none other than fresh ingredients! So I guess that means that freshness is the basis of all great cooking? Tangyoon is so serious about making sure that he has the freshest ingredients that he actually raises his own milk cows on The Nautilus for milk... Now that's impressive! Tangyoon wants me to go milk the cows and bring him some milk if I want to try some of his newest dish. Well, I definitely want to try some of his food, so I guess I'll go milk the cows and fill this bottle with milk. I'd better remember that I can only fill up 1/3rd of the bottle from a single mother cow. \n\n#i4031850##t4031850# #b#c4031850##k / 1
Wow! I can't believe I'm telling you this, but Tangyoon's dish was truly amazing. I was touched!

string.name: name
string.value: Porchay's Letter

string.name: parent
string.value: A Banquet for the Whalians
Porchay, who stays with the Whalians in the Generator Room, says that there is an emergency. I wonder what it is.

I can't believe that the Whalians have completely run out of food! According to Porchay, Kenta has plenty of food ingredients so I should go to #bKenta#k and talk to her. I should take Porchay's letter with me too, right?
I gave Porchay's letter to Kenta.

string.name: name
string.value: Ingredients to Get for the Banquet

string.name: parent
string.value: A Banquet for the Whalians

Of all the ingredients, I can't believe they ran out of sea horse tail... The Whalians are probably starving so I'd better go get #b40 cans of sea horse tails#k from #bKenta#k and get them some food to eat. \n\n#i4000161##t4000161# #b#c4000161##k / 40
I've collected 40 cans of sea horse tail. This should be enough to cook a dish, right?

string.name: name
string.value: A Banquet for the Whalians

string.name: parent
string.value: A Banquet for the Whalians
I'm finally done cooking the special entree for the Whalians. I'd better take it to #bPorchay#k quick!
I don't think the Whalians will have to worry about food for a while.

string.name: name
string.value: Black Bark's Worry

string.name: parent
string.value: For Kyrin
The Nautilus' First Officer and handsome muscle man, Black Bark has a worry? I should go talk to him in the conference room of The Nautilus' central corridor.

Black Bark wants to give Kyrin a pretty dress for her birthday, something that expresses everyone's warmest regards toward her. He's apparently asked his old friend and dressmaker, Mrs. Ming Ming, to make the dress, but she's run out of bright white material. She says that a table cloth made of Jr. Wraiths is best for the dress she's making... You need to gather #b15 Table Cloths#k and bring them to #bMrs. Ming Ming#k. \n\n#i4000035##t4000035# #b#c4000035#/15#k
I've collected the table cloths and have brought them to Mrs. Ming Ming. I wonder what the dress will look like!

string.name: name
string.value: Dress for Kyrin

string.name: parent
string.value: For Kyrin
The dress for Kyrin is finally done. It looks so nice! I should hurry and bring the dress to #bBlack Bark#k.
I wonder if Miss Kyrin will be wearing the dress at her birthday party. Can't wait to see her in the dress!

string.name: name
string.value: Help Me Find My Glasses
Apparently there's someone on the harbor, in trouble. He says he's lost something that's practically like a body part of his...

Having lost his glasses, Abel is unable to see anything. Let me help Abel find his glasses in the bushes near the #bwatchtower#k, located on the east end of The Nautilus harbor where the seagulls have gathered. And remember, #bAbel's glasses#k have horn-rimmed frames! \n\n#i4031853##t4031853# #b#c4031853##k / 1
Oh. Abel seems so happy to have his glasses back. But now that he's got his glasses back, he seems like such a different person. Do those glasses have some kind of power?

string.name: name
string.value: A Hole in The Nautilus

Code red! There's a hole in the ship and The Nautilus is in danger! The Nautilus' crew, Bonnie, is trying everything to stop the hole all by herself... We can't let The Nautilus sink like this! I must go and help!
The hole on the ship must be stopped with a Solid Horn. You should go find #b30 Solid Horns#k before Bonnie loses all her strength. \n\n#i4000073##t4000073# #b#c4000073#/30#k
Whew, I can't believe we saved The Nautilus from sinking into the ocean. Bonnie and I saved The Nautilus!

string.name: name
string.value: Unidentified Strangers
#b#p1012003##k of #b#m100000000##k seems to be facing a pretty serious problem...
#p1012003# says that a group of unidentified strangers have appeared on the eastern coast of #m100000000#, and wants me to find out who they are. I should go to #b#m100030000##k.

There's a huge wooden entryway leading into #m100030000# which I'd never seen before. It almost looks like an entryway to a fortress...I should try talking to #p1094000#, who was standing in front of me. I remember him telling me that a #bpirate #p1072008##k fort is being built here. PIRATES!?

string.name: name
string.value: How to become a Brawler
In order to become a Brawler, I must go see Kyrin.

Kyrin says that she wants to test how far I have gotten on my training before she will help me job advance into a Brawler. I must first hunt down the #rOctopusesrates#k on the testing grounds and collect #b15 Potent Power Crystals#k. I must remember to use the #rFlash Fist#k skill in order to defeat the Octopusesrates. \n\n#i4031856##t4031856# #b#c4031856#/15#k
I've passed Kyrin's test! I'm ready now to become a Brawler!

string.name: name
string.value: How to Become a Gunslinger
In order to become a Gunslinger, I must see Kyrin.

Kyrin says that she wants to test how far I have gotten on my training before she will help me job advance into a Gunslinger. I must first hunt down the #rOctopusesrates#k and collect #b15 power wind crystals#k. I must remember to use the #rDouble Shot#k skill in order to defeat the Octopusesrates.
I've passed Kyrin's test! I can now become a Gunslinger!

string.name: name
string.value: The Beginner Pirate's First Training Session
You're now a Pirate! Now what? Perhaps Kyrin can help you.
Kyrin suggests monster hunting as a form of basic training. She wants you to hunt #r11 Pigs#k. There are apparently a lot of Pigs near Henesys. \n\n#o1210100# #r#a21931##k
You eliminated 11 Pigs and reported the results to Kyrin. No sweat!

string.name: name
string.value: The Beginner Pirate's Second Training Session
You feel stronger, but you still have a long way to go. Talk to #bKyrin#k for more training!
Kyrin says the best way to learn is to keep hunting monsters. She says to hunt #r26 Pigs#k this time. \n\n#o 1210100# #r#a21941##k
Ah, 26 Pigs, slain and looted. You reported the news to Kyrin.

string.name: name
string.value: Beginner Pirate's Third Training Session
You're really starting to get into this training thing. #bKyrin#k wants to give you another lesson.
According to Kyrin, Pirates need great composure and perseverance. She wants you to hunt 40 Pigs this time. #r40 Pigs#k? That's no joke! \n\n#o 1210100# #r#a21951##k
You took care of 40 Pigs. Phew! It wasn't easy, but you did it!

string.name: name
string.value: Beginner Pirate's Fourth Training Session
You're really starting to look like a Pirate. #bKyrin#k wants to help you with one last training session.
Kyrin wants you to slay #r10 Green Mushrooms#k. Green Mushrooms are much stronger than Pigs. Stay alert. \n\n#o 1110100# #r#a21961##k
You destroyed 10 Green Mushrooms. Wasn't easy, but you feel like you're well on your way to becoming an amazing Pirate.

string.name: name
string.value: Tienk, the Monster Book Salesman
As soon as you arrive in #m104000000#, find #b#p0002006##k, the motor-mouth salesman.
As soon as you arrive in #m104000000#, find #b#p0002006##k, the motor-mouth salesman.
You've talked to #b#p0002006##k the salesman about the #bMonster Book#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate the Stone Golems
Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go talk to Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.

Victoria Island is infested with evil spirits, but you can't give up. You need to eliminate #r20 Stone Golems#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their wickedness in Victoria Island. \n\n#o 5130101# #r#a21981##k
You eliminated 20 Stone Golems and can only hope that you've made a difference in Victoria Island.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate the Dark Stone Golems
Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go talk to Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.

Victoria Island is infested with evil spirits, but you can't give up. You need to eliminate #r20 Dark Stone Golems#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their wickedness in Victoria Island. \n\n#o 5130102# #r#a21991##k
You've eliminated 20 Dark Stone Golems and can only wonder if you've made a difference in Victoria Island.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate the Mixed Golems
Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go see Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.

Victoria Island is infested with evil spirits, but you can't give up. You need to eliminate #r20 Mixed Golems#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their wickedness in Victoria Island.\n\n#o 5150000# #r#a22001##k
You've eliminated 20 Mixed Golems. You can only hope that you've made a difference in Victoria Island.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate the Skeletons
Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go talk to Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.

Victoria Island is infested with evil spirits, but you can't give up. You need to eliminate #r20 Skeleton Soldiers#k and #r20 Skeleton Generals#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their wickedness in Victoria Island. 

#o 5150001# #r#a22011##k
#o 6230602# #r#a22012##k
You eliminated 20 Skeleton Soldiers and 20 Skeleton Generals. You hope you've made a difference in Victoria Island.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate the Drakes
Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go see Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.

Victoria Island has already been infused with evil spirits. But I refuse to give up like this. I need to eliminate #r50 Drakes#k and #r50 Ice Drakes#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their evilness in Victoria Island. 

#o 5130100# #r#a22022##k
#o 6230600# #r#a22021##k
I've eliminated 50 Red Drakes and 50 Ice Drakes. I wonder if I've made a difference in Victoria Island.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate the Tauromacis
Muirhat is worried about the evil spirits that have infiltrated Victoria Island as of late. I wonder what I could do to help. I should go see Muirhat on the top deck of The Nautilus.

Victoria Island has already been infused with evil spirits. But I refuse to give up like this. I need to eliminate #r30 Tauromacis#k and #r100 Cold Eyes#k to stop these evil creatures from further spreading their evilness in Victoria Island.

#o 7130100# #r#a22031##k
#o 4230100# #r#a22032##k
I've eliminated 100 Tauromacis. I wonder if I've made a difference in Victoria Island.

string.name: name
string.value: Strange Dish 1

I've lost my appetite as of late... I wonder if Tangyoon could help me find a newfound appreciation for food by cooking me something new. I'm definitely ready for the challenge now so I should go talk to Tangyoon in The Nautilus' cafeteria. Oh yea, the cafeteria's on the upper deck.

Tangyoon has been experimenting with a new dish recently, using an ingredient that no one has ever used before. He's apparently been working with Evil Eye Tails! He says that he could make something new and fresh if only you would bring him #b10 Evil Eye Tails#k... You wonder if Evil Eyes are even edible. \n\n#i 4000007##t 4000007# #b#c 4000007#/10#k
Man, just as I'd suspected, Evil Eyes definitely aren't as tasty as I had hoped. But in a burger, well, it's not all that bad after all.

string.name: name
string.value: Strange Dish 2
Tangyoon says he's found a new ingredient to work with. I wonder what Tangyoon has in mind now?

Tangyoon has been experimenting with a new dish recently, using an ingredient that no one has ever used before. This time, he says he's been working with Curse Eye Tails! He says that he could make something new and fresh if only you would bring him #b10 Curse Eye Tails#k... You hope it comes out tasty! \n\n#i 4000013##t 4000013# #b#c 4000013#/10#k
Just as I'd thought... Curse Eye Tails aren't meant to be eaten.

string.name: name
string.value: Strange Dish 3
Tangyoon says he's found a new ingredient to work with. I wonder what Tangyoon has in mind now?

Tangyoon has been experimenting with a new dish recently, using an ingredient that no one has ever used before, Cold Eye Tails! He says that he could make something new and fresh if only you would bring him #b10 Cold Eye Tails#k... You hope it comes out tasty! \n\n#i 4000023##t 4000023# #b#c 4000023#/10#k
Just as I'd thought... Cold Eye Tails aren't meant to be eaten.

string.name: name
string.value: Lazy Little Calico

At The Nautilus, there's a kid who is forever curious and loves to make pranks. Bartol tells me now he has a good prank to pull on someone. If I want to join in, I better head over to the middle hallway of The Nautilus to find Bartol!

All #bCalico#k ever does is sleep, sleep, sleep, when he should be keeping an eye out on the crew's bedrooms. Bartol thinks it would be funny to throw an #bEvil Eye Tail#k at Calico and see how he reacts. You think it might be a fun little prank... \n\n#i 4000007##t 4000007# #b#c 4000007#/7#k
Calico awakes, in total shock. C'mon, Calico, you've got to stop falling asleep!

string.name: name
string.value: Bartol's Requests
If I'm passing through the central corridors of The Nautilus, I should make sure to stop by and see Bartol. He said he could teach me an easier way to get there...

Well, Bartol says that if I fulfill his request then he would give me a coupon that would allow me to use the warp machine to be warped to the Omega Sector. He says that he has some business to attend to with Shulynch, Muirhat and Black Bark and could use my help...

I fulfilled Bartol's request and received the Omega Sector Warp Coupon in return. I can use this coupon to use the Warp Machine in The Nautilus' Control Room to be warped immediately to the Omega Sector.

string.name: name
string.value: Bring a Lemon for Shulynch
I wonder what it is that Bartol wants me to do.
Bartol wants me to take this lemon to #bShulynch, who is in the ship's Training Room on the upper deck#k. \n\n#i 2010004##t 2010004# #b#c 2010004#/1#k
I've delivered the lemon to Shulynch.

string.name: name
string.value: Take the Gold Pouch to Muirhat
I wonder what it is that Bartol wants me to do.
I should bring the #bGold Pouch#k to #bMuirhat#k as Bartol asked me to. Muirhat is standing #bin front of the Control Room on the upper deck#k.
I've delivered the Gold Pouch to Muirhat.

string.name: name
string.value: Deliver the Tattered Map to Black Bark
I wonder what it is that Bartol wants me to do.
I should deliver this #bTattered Map#k to #bBlack Bark#k in the #bCentral Conference Room of The Nautilus#k.
I've delivered the Tattered Map to Black Bark.

string.name: name
string.value: The Path of a Pirate
What does it mean to be a Pirate? Talk to #p1002101# in Lith Harbor.

You have taken the list of informants out and left 2000 Mesos inside the trash can.

string.name: name
string.value: A Mysterious Small Egg
It sounds like someone is calling out my name. The dreamy eyes... the luscious purple hair... who are you?

The fairy with the dreamy eyes and the flowing purple hair talks for a bit, but it's not understandable at all. After the fairy disappears, you find a #bMysterious Small Egg#k inside your inventory. The fairy said something about it being your friend... Anyway, you better go visit the fairy at #bEllinia#k, the town of Fairies.\r\n#b<Message from the Fairy>\nCome to Ellinia, home of green trees too tall to measure. I will wait for you here.

The fairy with the dreamy eyes... and the luscious purple hair talked for a bit, but it wasn't understandable at all. After the fairy disappeared, I found a Mysterious Small Egg inside my inventory. Reliving the message the Fairy left for me, I went to the area and found Mar the Fairy hiding behind a huge bellflower. Mar mentioned something about being responsible for taking care of a living being, and then gave me a pet as a gift. The mysterious small egg turned out to be a Snail's egg.\r\nAlong with a message that this small snail can only be with me for 5 hours.

string.name: name
string.value: Captain Al, Who Are You?

A middle-aged gentleman who claims to have been the leader of a Family for 30 mind-boggling years... the rumors about this man, #bCaptain Al#k, who can be found in #bLith Harbor#k and #bOrbis Park#k, are running rampant. What exactly are a Family and a Leader anyway? They sound interesting... better ask #bCaptain Al#k that question myself.
#bCaptain Al#k seemed much more pleasant than the rumors suggested. I have a lot to ask... and he said ask him when I'm ready. How about now?

Captain Al's passion for adventure and the Family is palpable. Forget the tear-jerking adventures of Captain Al; I'm more interested in the concept of the Family... \nFortunately, Captain Al told me to ask him anytime about the Family. Should I become a Leader myself? Well, first I'll need to find a Junior I can support.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 230

string.name: name
string.value: Find a Junior!

string.name: parent
string.value: Captain Al's Passing of Knowledge
#bCaptain Al#k told me to see him if I was ever interested in starting a Family. Better go visit him at either #bLith Harbor#k or #bOrbis Park#k.

Captain Al's mission was simple! He just asked me to find a Junior that I want to support. I better register at least one Junior, then report the results to him.

#rAdd at least one Junior#k
(From the Family window[Hotkey : F], press the Pedigree button to check )
I succeeded in adding a Junior under me! Of course, that's how great my leadership is... Haha.

string.name: name
string.value: Raise the Rep!

string.name: parent
string.value: Captain Al's Passing of Knowledge

#bCaptain Al#k's next mission is for me to reach #r1,000 Rep#k! It's not an easy task by any means. According to Captain Al, this number cannot be achieved without the leadership and the overall support I provide to the Juniors. Captain Al gave me a clue in that I should help Juniors acquire EXP and help them Level Up as much as they can. EXP... Leveling up... HOW?

#rAchieve 1,000 Rep#k
(Open the Family window to check the Rep)
I finally reached 1,000 in Rep! ...I have to thank the Juniors that really helped me get there.

string.name: name
string.value: Enjoy the Entitlement!

string.name: parent
string.value: Captain Al's Passing of Knowledge

This task is to enjoy your hard-earned #rEntitlements#k! #bCaptain Al#k's mission is for me to use the Entitlement to spend the #rcurrent Rep down to 500#k. He also wanted to make sure I stacked up enough Reps by saving all the way up to 2,000. Better return to Captain Al once I complete the mission.

#rTotal of at least 2,000 Rep
Current Rep under 500#k
(Open the Family window to see both the current Rep and the total Rep)

Captain Al commended my efforts for successfully accomplishing all the missions, and told me I have the looks to become a great Senior. He also reiterated the fact that it's very important to provide a full support to my Juniors and everyone in the Family. I better ask Al if I have any questions about the Family. Time for me to start a big Family of my own!

string.value: Mr. Lim and the Subway

#eJake#k, who works at the #eKerning City Subway Turnstile#k, wants to ask you for a favor. You'd better go talk to him.\r\n#bTip - At the entrance of the subway station in Kerning City, you'll see Shumi sitting outside.

Jake at the Kerning City Subway Station needs help. Up north, there's a #e#bSubway Station that is only partially built. Will Blake's dream ever come true?

string.value: EXP 1,800\nCan proceed to the Lana's Decision quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Lana's Decision
#bLana#k the CEO of Big Hit Records says she needs a few moments to decide whether Blake has what it takes to make a big debut. Talk to her in a minute to see what she decides.
Finally! Blake will be able to make his debut! But first, you must convince the seven star chef #bRobby Fray#k to cater Blake's after party.
What? #bRobby Fray#k needs a favor? Well, you gotta do what you gotta do to help Blake make his debut. Talk to Robby Fray again.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,850\nCan proceed to the Convince Robby Fray quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Convince Robby Fray
#bRobby Fray#k needs a favor? If that's what it takes to convince a seven star chef to cater Blake's party, then that's what it takes. Get to it!
I need you to make drinks for our guests! Take bubbles to the Bubble Teas in the #r1st-2nd Floors of Kerning Square#k.
#bRobby Fray#k needs a favor? Well, you gotta do what you gotta do to help Blake make his debut. Talk to Robby Fray again.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 7,650\nCan proceed to the Secret Recipe quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: The Secret Recipe
You perform a favor for #Robby Fray#k so he would agree to cater the party, but when you go to turn it in, he screams in dismay. It seems like you'll have to do him another favor...
The recipe is lost?! Find it quick, before somebody spills the secret!\nHunt the Doll Claws on the #r3rd-4th Floors of Kerning Square#k. The recipe might be around there.\n
Whew! Finally, you convinced Robby Fray, the seven star chef, to cater the party. Report the good news to #bLana#k.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 7,950\nCan proceed to the Reception Party Preparation, Done! quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Reception Party Preparation, Done!
After all that, you were finally able to convince Robby Fray, the seven star chef, to help. Report the good news to #bLana#k.
Next on the list is getting a makeup artist. Head over to #bTina#k and see if she'll help.
You met and talked with #bTina#k, but it seemed like she wanted you to do something for her first.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,200\nCan proceed to the Tina's Proposal quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Tina's Proposition
Help #bTina#k with her request, then ask her to help with Blake's debut.
You need key chains for a grand opening promotion! Collect key chains and dolls from the Doll Claw game on the #r3rd-4th Floors of Kerning Square#k.
You were able to get a makeup artist for the job. Deliver the good news to #bLana#k.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 8,150\nCan proceed to Makeup Artist, Booked! quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Makeup Artist, Booked!
You booked a makeup artist. Report the good news to #bLana#k.
This time, you must book a hair stylist. Go over to #bMarshall#k and ask for help.
#bMarshall#k says he can't design Blake's hair. Why not? This can't be good. Discuss it with #bLana#k.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,250\nCan proceed to the Marshall's Refusal quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Marshall's Refusal
Marshall refuses to help. What is stopping him? Report the bad news to #bLana#k.
Open the #blocker#k in the Subway Station with the key that Marshall lost. He thinks he lost the key on the #r5th-6th Floors of Kerning Square#k, but did he?
You found the Locker Key #bMarshall#k lost, but the locker closed shortly after you opened it. Try opening the locker one more time.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 8,250\nCan proceed to the Legendary Scissors quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Legendary Scissors
Open the #bLocker#k again.
When you open the Locker, you find the #bLegendary Scissors#k. Hurry and deliver the scissors to Marshall.
#bMarshall#k was ecstatic when you delivered the Legendary Scissors and agreed to style Blake's hair in a heartbeat. Give #bLana#k the good news.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 1,300\nCan proceed to the Hair Stylist, Booked! quest

string.name: name
string.value: Hair Stylist, Booked!
Thanks to your hard work, Marshall agreed to take the gig. Give #bLana#k the good news.
Lana suggested that you ask #bLala#k, Blake's number one fan, for help with the costumes.
#bLala#k was thrilled to hear that Blake was finally make a debut, and asked you to give her some time to brainstorm.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,900\nCan proceed to the Costume Preparation quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Costume Preparation
Lala is thrilled to hear that Blake is finally making his debut and happily agrees to help with the costumes. Assist #bLala#k to prepare the costumes.
Bring the costumes for Blake's debut performance to #bLala#k. The mannequins on the #r5th-6th Floors of Kerning Square#k should have all the costumes and props he'll need.
#bLala#k was thrilled to hear about Blake's debut and asked you to give her some time to think about which costumes would be best for the performance.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 7,800\nCan proceed to the Costume Preparation, Done! quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Costume Preparation, Done!
You've completed the costume preparation, but she says something is still missing. What could possibly be missing? Ask #bLala#k what else she needs.
#bLala#k doesn't think the costumes are going to be enough. They need some perfume! Pink Perfume, Yellow Perfume, and Blue Perfume can be obtained from the #r3rd - 4th Floors of Kerning Square#k.
#bLala#k wasn't sure which scent would go best with which costume, so she gave you some time to think about it. \r\nHm, you don't seem too sure either. Why don't you leave it up to #bLala#k?\r\n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 7,900\nCan proceed to the Rose Scent quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Rose Scent
You aren't sure which scent would go best with which costume. Why don't you leave it up to #bLala#k?
Rush to #bLana#k before the scent fades and ask her which costume this rose scent would best complement.
#bLana#k said the rose scent would go best with the Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit. Time to tell #bLala#k.

string.name: rewardSummary

string.name: name
string.value: Freesia Scent
Lana says the rose scent is perfect for the Kid Mannequin's Bunny Suit. Time to let #bLala#k know.
Rush to #bLana#k before the scent fades and ask her which costume this freesia scent would best complement.
#bLana#k said the freesia scent would go best with the Female Mannequin's Wig. Go tell #bLala#k.

string.name: rewardSummary

string.name: name
string.value: Lavender Scent

Rush to #bLana#k before the scent fades and ask her which costume this lavender scent would best complement.
#bLana#k said the lavender scent wasn't exactly perfect for the Fedora, but that it would work. \r\nAsk #bLana#k what other tasks are left on her to-do list.

string.value: Music Preparation

You have to find an awesome song for Blake to perform. Get a CD at the music store on the #r7th - 8th Floors of Kerning Square#k and take it to #bLana#k.
Lana said the existing hits weren't good enough and asked you to get a new song from #bMaestro Rho#k.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 7,700\nCan proceed to the Request for a New Song quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Request for a New Song

Lana wants you to request a new song from a genius composer? Maestro Rho is not only known for his talents but is also infamous for his arrogance. Oh well, gotta do what you gotta do. Go talk to #bMaestro Rho#k and request a new song.
Eliminate Cheap Amplifiers and bring the lost MP3 back to Maestro Rho. It seems like the sound is coming from the #r7th - 8th Floors of Kerning Square#k, where #bZune#k stands guard. Go check it out!

When you found the MP3 player and returned it to Maestro Rho, he said he wanted to listen to some music before helping you. How rude! But this is for Blake, so you should ask him again... And try to be nice.

string.name: rewardSummary

string.name: name
string.value: Composition Fee
You found and returned Maestro Rho's MP3 player. That ought to be enough to get a new song, right? Ask #bMaestro Rho#k for a new song Blake can perform during his debut concert.

A composition fee?! I guess a fancy composer like you would expect that kind of money. Would you do me a favor and get some fancy amplifier cables for #bMaestro Rho#k while I work on getting those mesos?
You have paid the fee, but he still seems reluctant to give you the song. What's up with that? Talk to #bMaestro Rho#k again.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 8,450\nCan proceed to the Say No to Plagiarism quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Say 'NO' to Plagiarism
Master Rho doesn't seem like he's ready to hand over the new song even though you've already paid the fee. Why is he so hesitant? Ask #bMaestro Rho#k if everything is okay.

Spirit of Rock is playing Maestro Rho's music without proper approval. Defeat Spirit of Rock and listen to the last song he plays.\r\n\r\nIt is highly recommended that you turn up the volume a bit in the system options so you don't miss any important parts of the song while you're listening.
You have destroyed Spirit of Rock as Maestro Rho requested. But he's still reluctant to let go of his Composition Notes. You don't have much time left. Ask #bMaestro Rho#k for the new song.

Although they are not serious, the frequency of the occurrences bothers him.\r\nOne incident involves the thieving #b#o120100##k who have infiltrated Victoria Island. string.name: name
string.value: Seventh Mission: Eyewitness
Shiba at The Secret Garden has an urgent message for you. What could it be about?

#bShiba#k, the legendary Dual Blade, assigns your seventh mission. Your mission is to find an eyewitness to the disappearance of the former Dark Lord, but it's going to be difficult since it's been such a long time. Perhaps you should talk to Mr. Pickall, who previously told you about the former Dark Lord...

#bShiba#k, the legendary Dual Blade, assigned your seventh mission. Your mission was to find an eyewitness to the disappearance of the former Dark Lord. Although it was a difficult task, you were able to speak with Manji who was an eyewitness and discover that the former Dark Lord was very close to Tristan.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Complete the #b'Eyewitness Holding the Key'#k quest.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2,100\nUnlocks 'Dual Blade: The Dark Lord's Diary' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Eyewitness Holding the Key
Talk to Mr. Pickall who seems to know about everything.

You ask Mr. Pickall about the former Dark Lord and he says that while he isn't too familiar with him, he does know that the former Dark Lord was close with Tristan. He also recommends that you talk to #bManji in Perion#k since he knows a lot about Tristan.

You asked Mr. Pickall about the former Dark Lord and he said that while he wasn't too familiar with him, he was certain that the former Dark Lord was close with Tristan. He also recommended that you talk to #bManji in Perion#k since he knows a lot about Tristan. Though Manji seemed very reserved in his speech, he told you about the former Dark Lord as best as he could recall.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #b'Manji'#k.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2,200\n

string.name: name
string.value: Dual Blade: Time for the Awakening
Lady Syl has something to ask of you.

Lady Syl says she is furious after hearing Manji's story. She has decided to initiate a war against the Dark Lord and asks that you go to the hidden room inside the Jazz Bar to recover the former Dark Lord's diary. She asks that you exercise caution since the current Dark Lord could have potentially set a trap... You are to come see her again with the Diary once you've reached Lv. 30.

Lady Syl said that she had become furious after hearing Manji's story. She decided to initiate a war against the Dark Lord and asked that you go to the hidden room inside the Jazz Bar to recover the former Dark Lord's diary. \r\nInside the secret room in the Jazz Bar, you were attacked by the Dark Lord's subordinates. Luckily, you were able to defeat them and come out with the diary. When you returned to Lady Syl with the diary after reaching Lv. 30, she advanced you as a Blade Acolyte.

string.name: parent
string.value: Eighth Mission: In the Presence
Lady Syl has something to ask of you.

Lady Syl has finally recovered from her shock and says that she now knows the direction that the Dual Blades must travel. For the Dual Blades to rise from the shadows and become an organization recognized by all, it must receive the recognition of #bArec#k, the elder thief in El Nath. She asks that you meet with Arec as her messenger and find out how the Dual Blades can receive his official recognition...

Lady Syl after recovering from her shock said that she now knows the direction that the Dual Blades must travel. She said that for the Dual Blades to rise from the shadows and to become an organization recognized by all, it must receive the recognition of #bArec#k, the elder thief in El Nath. She asked that you meet with Arec as her messenger and find out how the Dual Blades can receive his official recognition... What will Arec require for the Dual Blades to receive his recognition?

string.name: name
string.value: Sky High
The Maple Administrator wants to let you know something...
The Maple Administrator told you that if you want to soar through the sky, meet #bInstructor Irvin#k in the Stations of Victoria, Ereve, Orbis, Mu Lung, Ariant, Edelstein, or Leafre.
Instructor Irvin gave you the #b#t2430249##k as a gift, saying it was for people who want to take to the skies.

string.name: name
string.value: The Monkey of Destiny
Where are you? You definitely took the boat that goes to Maple Island... But then Balrog showed up... You don't remember anything after that. And what's the deal with this monkey? Talk to him.
The monkey is gesturing wildly with his hands and feet. You think he's saying that... He saved you from the ocean? This monkey saved your life?!
You thanked the monkey. Still, on your quest to be a great and powerful Explorer...you were saved by a monkey. Not a very good start, is it?

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1096003##k#n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 5

string.name: name
string.value: Rest and Recover
The monkey is rummaging around for something. Looks like he has something to say, too. What does he want?
The monkey has an apple! Say, is this monkey trying to give you an apple? What a kind monkey! Eat the apple, and then thank the monkey.
This monkey seems quite fond of you.

string.name: name
string.value: Are We Alone?
The monkey looks like he wants to talk to you. Can't you read his expressions by now...?

The monkey is trying to tell you something. He's pointing at the right side of the island, and gesturing... Wait, is he saying there is someone else here? Could Skipper or Reiting have fallen overboard? Or is it someone else? You should check it out.
The other person on the island was neither Skipper nor Reiting. This fellow looks like he's been here for a very long time...not a good sign. Who is he?

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1096005##k#n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 55

string.name: name
string.value: The Stranded Cutter
The castaway is named Cutter, and he's been here for a long time. Now, how did he end up here?

Cutter told you that he was once a pirate, and also the designer of the Battleship Nautilius. You asked him a little about how he got stranded here, and he said it was a long story. If a guy like him has been stuck here for so long, that's bad news for you...
Cutter said he got washed out to sea while working on a new weapon for his pirates. You asked him about the weapon, and he boasted about how it was more powerful than any other weapon. Hmmm...

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1096005##k#n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 95

string.name: name
string.value: Stranded 1
Is there really no way off the island? There must be a way. Ask Cutter.

Cutter told you that the island isn't really that bad, once you get used to it. When you asked about getting off the island, he dodged your question and told you that Starfish Meat is really delicious. If he's not going to answer your question, you might as well try out this Starfish Meat.\n
Cannon travel? It sounds ridiculous...but it's not like you have any better ideas.

string.name: name
string.value: Stranded 2
You tried to roast the Starfish Meat yourself, but there's no more Kindling. Where can you get more? Ask Cutter.

Cutter told you that you can get more Kindling from Oak Barrels that were swept ashore. To find them, go through the portal on the top right of the cannon. Get some #t4032980#s by destroying Oak Barrels with your #bRegular Attack#k.

#i4032980##t4032980# #b#c4032980#/1#k

After obtaining plenty of #t4032980#s, you asked Cutter about the small island that you saw on your way back. Cutter finally told you that there might be a way to escape, and the key is on that small island. However, he also said that it probably wouldn't work...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 550

string.name: name
string.value: Replacement Part
So there is a way to escape from this island? Why does Cutter say it is impossible? Ask him for details.

Cutter told you that if you can install an Ignition Device on the cannon, then you can #rride the cannon#k to the Nautilus. Ride the cannon...? Sounds strange, but it's worth a try! The Ignition Device was lost on the small island, so swim over and find it!

#i4032985##t4032985# #b#c4032985#/1#k
You recovered the Ignition Device! It'll take Cutter a while to get it installed, so you have some time to do...something.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 850

string.name: name
string.value: Farewell, My Monkey
Ask Cutter if there is anything you can do for him while he gets the cannon ready.
Cutter told you to visit your savior, the monkey. You totally forgot about the monkey, didn't you? Since the monkey was so nice to you, you should at least say goodbye.
Your farewell was a little sad, but the monkey didn't seem so upset. You thought he was your friend, but... Oh well.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1096003##k#n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 700\nTo the Nautilus 3 is now available.\n

string.name: name
string.value: The Great Escape!
Is the cannon ready yet? Ask Cutter.
Finally, you can escape! Climbing into a giant cannon probably isn't the smartest thing you've ever done, but it beats being stuck here!
Whoa... Where did you end up...? Hey, it's the Nautilus! You escaped the island! And you didn't get blown to bits! Hooray!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,400\n

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1096006##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: My Friend, Monkey!

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
You have escaped the island! And it looks like you weren't the only one. How did the monkey follow you here? Ask Cutter.

Cutter told you that the monkey was very worried about you when you first washed ashore. He quickly grew attached to you, and was planning on escaping with you. No wonder he wasn't sad when you said goodbye! Looks like you have a new friend. Give him the Propeller Kit from Cutter.
All right! The monkey has a new name, and it's Monkey! What adventures await you and Monkey?

string.name: name
string.value: Job Advancement to Cannoneer

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

So, what should you do now? Since you finally made it to Victoria Island, you could become an Explorer like you originally planned. While you consider your options, go visit Cutter. He has something to tell you.

Cutter wanted you to become a #bCannoneer#k. He said you are a perfect candidate to use his new pirate weapon. He also said you won't regret your decision once you start blowing monsters away with giant hand-held cannons. Is he right? Probably, but go see the Pirate Job Instructor, Kyrin, just to be sure.
After Kyrin's pep talk, you have agreed to become a Cannoneer. It's very exciting, though the thought of meeting Balrog again is a little scary...

string.name: name
string.value: The New Adventure Begins
Time to start a new adventure on Maple Island!\nIsn't it exciting? Who knows what awaits you out there?

You have boarded the ship to Maple Island.
Your future looks pretty promising right now.

Nothing could go wrong, right?
You have boarded the ship to Maple Island.

string.name: name
string.value: Back Again, and Ready to Leave
Your farewell was a little sad, but the monkey didn't seem so upset. You thought he was your friend, but... Oh well. Better get back to Cutter.
Your farewell was a little sad, but the monkey didn't seem so upset. You thought he was your friend, but... Oh well. Better get back to Cutter.
Now that you've said goodbye to the monkey, you're ready to leave the island. Farewell, dinky island in the middle of nowhere!

#o100001# #r#a26021##k

#o100002# #r#a26031##k

Turns out, Shiba was purposely picking on you to see your reaction. You never let Shiba's words get to you, so Ryden thinks you're ready to meet #bLady Syl#k for a special mission. Cool.
You met Lady Syl, the leader of the Dual Blades.

string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1056000##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Into the Darkness
Lady Syl is one heck of a lady.

Here's the tale: The 'Dark Lord' that currently trains Thieves in Kerning City isn't the first Dark Lord. It's a name that's adopted by the current head of the Thieves. It just so happens that #bLady Syl is the daughter of the previous Dark Lord#k..

Well, there's a reason she's in hiding. The #rcurrent Dark Lord murdered the previous Dark Lord#k, forcing Lady Syl and all her Dual Blade followers to go underground. 

But Lady Syl's been building up her own forces and thinks it's just about time for the Dual Blades to take their rightful place in Kerning City, but it won't be easy...

For now, Lady Syl wants to send a #bspy#k to get close to the Dark Lord. She needs someone who's calm and collected under pressure. Do you have what it takes?
There's no chance you'd turn down a mission as crucial as this one. Time to become a spy!

#o9300521# #r#a26061##k

Um, does that mean it IS poisonous?\r\n\r\n#rTip: You cannot complete the quest if the effects of the poison wears off. If that happens, abandon the quest and restart it to get another potion.

Lady Syl was amused and revealed that this was just a test. But she reminds you that an act of betrayal would make you an enemy of the Dual Blades forever, so remember this lesson. Now you're officially a member of their faction...

Your job is to infiltrate Kerning City, pretending to be a normal Thief and get close to the #bDark Lord#k. Then, you're to talk to the people in Kerning City about the Dark Lord and dig up some dirt on him..

#o1120100# #r#a26111##k

#o2300100# #r#a26121##k

#o9300524# #r#a26141##k

#o4230102# #r#a26151##k

#i4000034##t4000034# #b#c4000034#/40#k

#i4033180##t4033180# #b#c4033180#/1#k

#i3800279#

Jeppi, the owner of the Kerning City bookstore, was mentioned in the Dark Lord's Diary... The very same Jeppi that the Dark Lord banished. Might be worth it to talk to him, but first you have to track him down. Mr. Pickall might know where Jeppi is.
You met with Mr. Pickall.

string.name: name
string.value: The Kerning City Book Store Owner 1
Ask Mr. Pickall about Jeppi, the owner of the Kerning City book store.

Mr. Pickall seems to know something, but he wants you to do him a favor first. Go to the #bSwamp Region#k, defeat #rMuddy Swamp Monsters#k, and bring back #b70 Mud Clumps#k.\r\n#i4000623##t4000623# #b#c4000623#/70#k\r\n

string.name: name
string.value: The Kerning City Book Store Owner 2

Jeppi seems to be living by the #bGiant Tree#k in the forest near Ellinia. Go find him.

string.name: name
string.value: The Meeting with Jeppi
Wait. Something's not right. Jeppi doesn't think of the Dark Lord as his enemy... So he WASN'T banished from Kerning City for knowing the truth about the Dark Lord's corruption?

This is Jeppi's story: The Dark Lords of Kerning City have been fighting a mysterious enemy for a long, long time, someone who #rexists in the shadows, fabricating the history of the Maple World...#k

The previous Dark Lord lost his life to this enemy, and the current Dark Lord thought that Jeppi, who was helping with the investigation, was also in danger, so he hid him in Ellinia. Jeppi's been continuing the investigation alone...

If this is true, it means #bLady Syl is mistaken about the current Dark Lord, Jin#k. Jin didn't kill her father. Instead, he's been fighting all this time to save Maple World from darkness! #bRyden#k has got to hear all of this.
Ryden doesn't believe a word of it. He thinks Jeppi's lying.

string.name: name
string.value: Tristan's Pupil
Ryden doesn't believe Jeppi's story. He seems confused.
Ryden wants you to venture deep into Sleepywood and locate Tristan's apprentice, Mu Young. As someone else who's also lost his master, he might be able to shed light on things.
You have ended your conversation with Tristan. Ask Mu Young for Tristan's Keepsake.

string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1061014##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Tristan's Spirit
You hear a Mysterious Voice as soon as you step foot in the Bottom of the Temple.
Follow where the voice leads.
You met Tristan at Tristan's Tomb, where the Lord Balrog dwells. He says the current Dark Lord is innocent.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1061017##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Tristan's Keepsake
Obtain Tristan's Keepsake from Mu Young.

Mu Young tells you to get Tristan's Keepsake from the Storage Room yourself. Look for the Keepsake in the Storage Room.\r\n\r\n#rTip: You cannot complete the quest without finding the Keepsake from the Storage room. If something goes wrong, abandon the quest and try again.
You were attacked by an unknown enemy! You got Tristan's Keepsake, but what's going on? Is there REALLY a mysterious enemy, like Tristan said?

string.name: name
string.value: The Unspeakable Truth
Obtain Tristan's Keepsake from Mu Young.
Deliver Tristan's Keepsake to #bRyden#k and tell him everything you've learned.
Ryden is speechless when you give him Tristan's Keepsake. He doesn't want to have to tell the harsh truth to Lady Syl, who's worked so hard to take down the Dark Lord.

string.value: Becoming a Blade Acolyte 1
You've reached Level 30. Lady Syl would like to speak with you.
It is time for you to progress to Blade Acolyte. Go to #bThe Secret Garden#k and meet with Lady Syl.
You met with Lady Syl.

string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: Becoming a Blade Acolyte 2
Hm, what's it like to be a Blade Acolyte?

Lady Syl has agreed to help you progress to Blade Acolyte by awakening the Mirror of Insight if you bring back a Dark Marble from the Shadow Blade Lord.

#rTip: You cannot complete the quest without obtaining the Dark Marble. If something goes wrong, abandon the quest and try again.
You have become a Blade Acolyte.

string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: The Truth Cannot Be Hidden
Ryden wishes to speak to you.
Ryden wants you to return to the #bKerning City Jazz Bar#k and meet someone.
The Dark Lord apologized for hiding the truth. He said this was the only way to protect Lady Syl. What a moron. Didn't he realize that he only hurt her more?

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1052001##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Dazed and Confused
Talk to the grim-faced Ryden.
As the Secret Garden's leader and the daughter of the previous Dark Lord, #bLady Syl#k deserves to know the truth. And guess who gets to tell her...
Lady Syl seemed dazed by your explanation.

string.name: name
string.value: Becoming a Blade Specialist 1
Is Lady Syl still shaken? She's asked you to return to the #bThe Secret Garden#k to pursue the path of the Blade Specialist.
Lady Syl does not look well, but she does her duty with aplomb. Listen to her instructions on how to become a Blade Specialist.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
You've reached Lv. 45. Lady Syl wants to talk to you.

string.name: name
string.value: Becoming a Blade Specialist 2
Lady Syl has not forgotten her responsibilities as the leader of the Dual Blades.

To become a Blade Specialist, you must undergo the same training as the previous Dark Lord. Head to #bSleepywood#k and defeat #r99 Ice Drakes#k.



#o6230600# #r#a26421##k
You have embarked on the path of the Blade Specialist.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: A Difficult Decision
Lady Syl was dazed when she learned the truth. You wonder what decision she'll make now.

Lady Syl has decided to make amends with the Dark Lord, but first, she wants him to demonstrate that he is not a weakling. She seemed to grow more confident when she said that. #bGo meet the Dark Lord in the Jazz Bar#k.
The Dark Lord apologized for keeping the truth hidden all this time. He acknowledges Dual Blades as a branch of the Thieves and says he will fight at their side.

string.name: name
string.value: The Shadow Owl
Receive the #bShadow Owl#k mount, the symbol of Dual Blade 4th Job Advancement.
Receive the #bShadow Owl#k mount, the symbol of Dual Blade 4th Job Advancement.
You have received the #bShadow Owl#k mount, the symbol of Dual Blade 4th Job Advancement.

string.name: name
string.value: Blake's Autographs
Someone wants to talk to you in Kerning Square. Hm, who might this person be...?

Blake wants to hold an autograph event in Kerning Square. Enin, one of his fans, desperately wants to be there and also wants to get the word out so that more fans would attend. Maybe you can do something to help.
You ran into Enin at Kerning Square.

string.name: name
string.value: The Autograph Ticket Hunt
Enin is a huge fan of Blake. She's very excited to meet Blake in person, but you have a feeling that something will go wrong...

Enin was spreading the word about the autograph event, but she ended up losing her own ticket. Tragic! Get her another ticket to the event. Supposedly the Cherry Bubble Teas have been selling tickets on the side...
You scratched off the Autograph Ticket Coupon, but you didn't win any tickets. Aww.

string.name: name
string.value: The Ticket Hunt Continues
Enin didn't get a ticket to the Blake autograph event. She's probably not going to give up, though.
Enin refuses to give up on Blake just yet and wants you to get more coupons. She wants you to hunt Mango Bubble Teas this time and bring back 50 coupons.
You got her a bunch more coupons. One of these HAS to be a winner! ...Right?

string.name: name
string.value: The Ticket Hunt Ends
Another string of busts. It's not easy to win a ticket to Blake's autograph event, but Enin still refuses to give up.
One last shot! Enin wants you to bring back 60 Autograph Ticket Coupons from the Melon Bubble Teas this time. Will she give up if this one doesn't work out...?
Finally, a ticket to Blake's autograph event!

string.name: name
string.value: From Blake's Biggest Fan
Enin is ecstatic about Blake's autograph event, but her joy seems fleeting.
Enin needs your help to find a gift for Blake. She wants you to find him some Yeti Keychains.
Enin wrapped up the Yeti Keychains for Blake, but this is probably not the end...

string.name: name
string.value: Also From Blake's Biggest Fan
The autograph event is about to start, but Blake is nowhere in sight. Enin wants to get him more gifts while she's waiting.
Enin wants to get Jr. Pepe Keychains in case Blake doesn't like Yetis. She's covering all her bases...
You got more Jr. Pepe Keychains for Enin. Blake better love these things.

string.name: name
string.value: One Last Gift for Blake
Blake is still not here. Enin is starting to worry.
Enin wants to get another gift for Blake before he arrives! She wants Orange Mushroom Dolls this time.
You brought back all the Orange Mushroom Dolls that Enin wanted. Blake better show up before Enin runs you ragged.

string.name: name
string.value: A Shower of Gifts
Enin is ecstatic to see Blake in person. She seems to be hesitating, though...
Enin wants you to deliver her gifts and a letter to Blake for her. She's too embarrassed to do it herself. What a strange girl.
Blake wants you to set the gifts aside, since he gets so many and can't keep track of them all. He sounds...kinda like a jerk.
It seems like the rumors were true... Blake is quite a...well, a jerk. Lana, one of his managers, wants to talk to you.
Lana is disturbed that Blake changed so drastically after he got his fame. He never seems to listen. She wants you to help out with the autograph event because of how big it's gotten. Talk to Tina.
Tina, Blake's stylist, also seems to be displeased with Blake. Still, she has to get the preparations done.

string.name: name
string.value: Celebrity Stinks
Tina doesn't seem real thrilled about the autograph event. What needs to be done?
Tina wants you to find a suitable cologne for Blake's autograph event. She wants 3 samples to try. The perfume shop is on the #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A Music Shop#k.
Blake doesn't seem to like any of the colognes. He's from Kerning Square, yet he badmouths the place constantly. What's his problem?

string.name: name
string.value: Clothes Make the Man
You could see why Tina would be upset with Blake. Go talk to her.
Tina wants you to find outfits for the autograph event. The theme for the outfit is cute & cuddly. She wants you to bring back a Bunny Suit from Kid Mannequin.
Blake pitched a fit when he saw the Bunny Suit. He said he would wear it before, so why is he being so difficult now?

string.name: name
string.value: Wigging Out
Tina still has a job to do. She's thinking about trying a new concept for the event.

Tina is thinking about a cool and chic blonde-hair concept. She wants you to go to the #b5th and 6th floor#k and bring back wigs from the Female Mannequins for you to take to Marshall, the hairstylist. Marshall is sure to have some fabulous ideas.
You brought the wigs to Marshall.

string.name: name
string.value: A Hairy Situation
What kind of magic did Marshall work on the wig?
Marshall did a bang-up job on that wig! Time for the moment of truth... Will Blake approve? Take it to him and find out.
Blake says that Marshall has passed his prime and refuses to wear the wig. Seriously?

string.name: name
string.value: Hat Trick
Let Tina know that Blake doesn't like the wig either.
Tina is at her wit's end. She's willing to try a hat, any hat, just to get this over with. Get the hats off the Male Mannequins.
Blake's willing to wear the hat. Progress!

string.name: name
string.value: Is This Okay?
Let Tina know that Blake's done with his styling preparations.
Tina looks disgusted with Blake's poor attitude. She wonders how ANY stylists could possibly work with a jerk like him. Lana should probably know about this.
Lana looks worried after hearing about Tina.

string.name: name
string.value: Blake's Next Hit
Convince Maestro Rho to compose more songs for Blake.

Maestro Rho says that Blake's recent songs don't feel like the ones from before and he doesn't want to compose more songs for him. He needs the latest hits CDs to listen for differences, which can be found on the 7th and 8th floor.
You listened to the Latest Hits Compilation, but can't make out the differences. Maestro Rho seems frustrated.

string.name: name
string.value: Bringing Back the Oldies
Maestro Rho seems frustrated that you can't make out the difference. What can you do, really? Talk to him.
Maestro Rho wants you to bring back Greatest Oldies so that you can listen for differences between his old and new songs.
Well, you still can't really tell the difference. You're not really an expert anyway.

string.name: name
string.value: The New Groove
You still can't tell how Blake's musicianship changed just by listening to his songs. Maestro Rho wants to try something different.
As per Maestro Rho's suggestions, ask Lala how Blake's songs have changed.
Lala says that Blake's latest song sound as if someone pretending to be Blake is singing them. Well, she's a huge fan, so she might be on to something.

string.name: name
string.value: Back to Basics
Lala wants to help Blake find his old passion.
Lala wants you to meet with June, an old friend of Blake, to put him on the road to recovery. June is on the 7th/8th floor of the Shopping Center.
You found June, Blake's old friend.
Listen to what June has to say about Blake. It's pretty interesting.

June says that Blake's been weird lately. He says that Blake feels like a completely different person...he can't remember things from the past, puts up a polite facade around June, and just acts strange in general. June thinks that it all started after Blake bought a guitar. Ask Blake about that guitar.
Blake seems surprised that you asked about the guitar. He's clearly hiding something.

string.name: name
string.value: The Star Returns
Blake's reaction is pretty fishy. Did his new guitar really change him? Ask Lana.

Lana says that she put Blake's new guitar in the #b7th Floor 8th Floor Area D#k to keep it safe. Area D is for authorized personnel only, but #bJune will let you in if you tell him it's to help Blake#k.\n\n#rTip: You can obtain Blake's Memories from [Like the First Time] quest. If you discard the item, however, then you must forfeit Reasoning for Changing quest then start over.
You've restored Blake's memory!

string.name: name
string.value: Like the First Time
Take Lana's suggestion, and go to the top floor of the shopping center.
Get rid of Spirits of Rock, Cheap Amplifiers, and Fancy Amplifiers for Blake.
Blake is grateful that you returned his memories.

string.name: name
string.value: Finding Your Roots
You returned Blake's Memories.
You returned Blake's Memories.
You returned Blake's Memories.

You brought a pile of Dark Stone Golem Rubble for Dr. Bruce to examine. Could they contain the blue substance, as well?

string.value: Living Forest

string.name: rewardSummary

string.name: name
string.value: Blue Material's Identity

The Dark Stone Golem Rubble did not contain the blue material. Dr. Bruce thinks the substance might be Blue Mushmom Spores, and he suspects that these spores might have some kind of mysterious power. He asked you to collect 3 Blue Mushmom Spores and take them to Pia, who knows a lot about mushrooms and magic.\n
You collected 3 Blue Mushmom Spores, and took them to Pia for her take on what these spores can do.\n

string.name: name
string.value: The Mixed Golem Threat
Go see Rina, who apparently sneaks into the Golem's Temple under the full moon. As bizarre as that is, she might have seen something important.

Rina goes to the Golem's Temple when the full moon is out to pick Primroses to make her soaps and tea with. It's full moon tomorrow, and she wants to go to the temple, but she says the Mixed Golems have been growing more dangerous. She'd like you to eliminate 60 Mixed Golems for her. Report to Dr. Bruce once you finish eliminating the Mixed Golems.
You eliminated the dangerous Mixed Golems, and went back to Dr. Bruce with your findings.

string.name: name
string.value: Mixed Mutation

Bruce thinks the vitality of the Primroses is what gives the Golems life. Since it is a random effect, it also creates mutants like the Mixed Golems. It all sounds impossible, but bring 50 Mixed Golem Rubbles to Bruce so he can continue his research and perhaps convince you.
You brought Bruce the Mixed Golem Rubbles so he could continue with his research. Could the Primroses really have such power?

string.value: Charms for Info

Bruce wants additional information about Golems from Roca, the Cygnus informant, but Roca wants 3 Zombie Mushmom Charms in return. Defeat Zombie Mushmoms at the Zombie Mushmom Hill off the Ghost Mushroom Path. Collect 3 charms and deliver them to Roca.
You defeated the Zombie Mushmoms got the 3 charms, and delivered them to Roca. Roca didn't seem to trust you, though, and insisted on speaking to Dr. Bruce directly. Whatever.

You found plenty of Frozend Mixed Golems in the Golem's Temple, eliminated them for their Frozen Stones, and took the stones to Jay.
