string.value: Anne Needs Friends 1
Looks like #p1012110#, one of #p1032104#'s daughters, is very lonely. Makes sense, since she has no friends in #m101000000#. Go try to help her out.

#b#p1012110##k wants to be friends with #b#p1032106##k, but there's just one teeny problem... #b#p1032106##k doesn't like humans. #b#p1012110##k thinks that if she gives a #b#t4000037##k to #b#p1032106##k, that might change her mind. It's worth a try, right? Give a #b#t4000037##k to Wing the Fairy.
You gave a #t4000037#, on behalf of #p1012110#, to #p1032106#.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 600 Can proceed to the Anne Needs Friends 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Anne Needs Friends 2
Hey, it worked! Now #p1032106# wants to give a gift back, in return for the #t4000037#. Go see #p1032106#.
#p1032106# gave you a #b#t4033008##k to give to #b#p1012110##k. Isn't that nice? Get this to #b#p1012110##k near the west entrance to #b#m101000000##k.
#p1012110# got really sad when you gave her the #t4033008#. What gives? What's wrong with the #t4033008#? Ask #p1032101#.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 500 Can proceed to the Anne Needs Friends 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Anne Needs Friends 3
Why did #p1032106# give the #t4033008# to #p1012110#? What does it mean? Get some answers from #p1032101#.

#p1032101# explained that the #t4033008# is a symbol of her friendship, meaning that she wants to be friends forever. Well, that's a relief! Go tell #b#p1012110##k the good news. #b#p1012110##k is still at the #bWest Entrance to #m101000000##k.
Once #p1012110# understood the meaning behind the #t4033008#, she almost cried with joy. You've done a great thing, bringing these two together.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 500 #bFame +2#k

string.name: name
string.value: Hersha's Paranoia 1

#p1103003# was once a Cygnus Knight, but left to investigate #m101000000#. He has a reputation for being VERY suspicious of everything. That being said, he claims to have found something...suspicious. You might want to check it out, just in case.

#p1103003# found a #t4000029#, and is convinced it is a bomb disguised as a banana, so he wants you to bring him #b20#k #b#t4000029#s#k from #r#o3210800#s#k. This may be one of the dumbest requests you've ever gotten, but what's the harm in humoring him? #r#o3210800#s#k usually appear around #b#m101040000##k.
#p1103003# discovered the bananas were not, in fact, bombs. Shocking. However, he is still suspicious of Lupin's Bananas.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,500 #Wbasic# #i2040707:# #t2040707:# x 1 Can proceed to the Hersha's Paranoia 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Hersha's Paranoia 2
#p1103003# has further suspicions. No surprise there. See if you can get him to relax.

#p1103003# thinks someone is trying to curse him, using #b#t4000031#s#k from #r#o4230101#s#k, so he wants you to collect every #b#t4000031##k you can find. Bring #b20 #t4000031#s#k to #b#p1103003##k, and just tell him that's all of them. #r#o4230101#s#k appear around #b#m101040200##k.
As soon as #p1103003# saw your #t4000031#s, he snatched them away, set them on fire, poured acid on them, and buried them in a ditch. This guy needs professional help.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2,000 #Wbasic# #i2041004:# #t2041004:# x 1 Can proceed to the Hersha's Paranoia 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Hersha's Paranoia 3
#p1103003# has proof of a dark conspiracy! Whatever. You're not busy...go listen to his ramblings.

#p1103003# asked you to collect #b#t4000041#s#k because he thinks that #r#o5300100#s#k are going to send experimental mutant frogs to rampage through #m101000000#, take over the governments of the world, and use their mind-control... Look, it's stupid, but just do it before the guy cracks completely. #r#o5300100#s#k usually appear around #b#m101040310##k.
#p1103003# is very proud that he saved #m101000000# from mutant frog mind-control...stuff. Good job, Hersha.

string.name: name
string.value: First Friend in Perion
Dances with Balrog told you that he would introduce you to a friend to help you settle into life in Perion.
Dances with Balrog wants you to meet Ayan, to lear more about living in Perion. Visit Ayan in Perion.

Ayan explained that she is not from Perion, but rather was saved by the people of Perion. She lost her memory when she was little, so she doesn't actually know where she's from. According to her, everyone in Perion is quite nice, once you get to know them. Everyone, except maybe Blackbull.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 850

string.name: name
string.value: Helping the Town 1
Ayan was wondering if you wanted to help the village. Ask her what you can do.
Looks like you can train and help the village at the same time! Go to #m102020000# by following the arrow signs, eliminate Stumps, and bring Tree Branches back to the village.
You eliminated a bunch of Stumps, and got a bunch of Tree Branches for the village. Everyone wins!

string.name: name
string.value: The General Store of Perion
Ayan wanted you to bring the Tree Branches to...someone. Maybe you should ask her again.
Ayan told you to take your Tree Branches to Sophia at the General Store. Follow the arrow signs to the General Store tent to meet Sophia.
You gave Tree Branches to Sophia. Good work. #bReturn to Ayan.#k

string.name: name
string.value: The Eccentric Blackbull
Ayan doesn't look so good. She told you to go see someone in Perion...but didn't tell you who. Ask her again.
Oh...it was Blackbull. Ayan advised bringing him some Leaves when you meet him. Collect some Leaves and take them to Blackbull.
You visited Blackbull, and gave him nome nice Leaves.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 524

string.name: name
string.value: Perion Homestyle Cooking
Blackbull seems to like you well enough...he wants to enjoy a salad with you, in fact. What a nice guy! Get some details from him.

Blackbull wants a #bFire Flower#k to cook his Wild Boar's meat just right. That sounds like a noble cause. #rYou can find many Fire Flowers in #m102020200# and #m102020100#. Deal with the #bDark Stumps#k there while you're at it!

Blackbull wants a #bFire Flower#k to cook his Wild Boar's meat just right. That sounds like a noble cause. #rYou can find many Fire Flowers in #m102020200# and #m102020100#. Deal with the #bDark Stumps#k there while you're at it!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 524

string.name: name
string.value: Helping the Town 2
Ayan would like you to help the village out. How can you refuse? See what she needs.

Ayan told you that the people at the Excavation Site near Perion are running out of supplies. Eliminate some Axe Stumps to get Firewood, and deliver it to Winston. #rAxe Stumps usually appear in #m102020200# or #m102020300#.#k
You eliminated plenty of Axe Stumps, and collected plenty of Firewood. Winston should be pleased, right?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 529

string.name: name
string.value: Help the Excavation Site
Winston has another favor to ask of you. Ask him what you need to do.
You need to eliminate Dark Axe Stumps in #r#m102020400##k, and collect Axes from them. It almost sounds like you're doing the Stumps a favor...
You eliminated Dark Axe Stumps, collected Axes, and delivered them to Winston. Looks like the excavators are making progress, thanks to you! Axes are an important part of excavating, after all.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 568

string.name: name
string.value: The Strange Lives of Ghost Stumps
Winston has been studying the bizarre Ghost Stumps in his spare time, and needs some help. See what he needs.
Winston needs samples for his Ghost Stump research. Go to #bGusty Peak#k and eliminate #r30 Smiling Ghost Stumps and 30 Ghost Stumps#k, and collect #b30 #t4000195#s#k.
You brought all the necessary research materials to Winston.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 586 \n#Wbasic# \n#i2030003:# #t2030003:# x 10 Can proceed to the Excavation Report quest

string.name: name
string.value: Excavation Report
Winston has something that needs to be delivered to Dances with Balrog. Find out what it is.
You received a black pouch that contains seedlings, and a letter on the status of excavations. You are to deliver these items to Dances with Balrog in Perion.
You delivered all the requested items to Dances with Balrog.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 486

string.name: name
string.value: 10 Boogies
Dances with Balrog has a favor to ask you. Talk to him.

Deliver the Seedling Pouch from Winston to 10 Boogies. Dances with Balrog mentioned that the seeds will help the Cygnus Knights gather information. You're not sure how, but lots of things are hard to understand.
You met 10 Boogies. She's nice...but not the sharpest tool in the shed.

string.name: name
string.value: A Gift of Boogies
10 Boogies wants to give a gift to Dances with Balrog. Thing is, she's too shy, so she needs someone to deliver it for her.
Deliver a gift to Dances with Balrog on behalf of the bashful secret agent, 10 Boogies.
You delivered a gift to Dances with Balrog.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 386

string.name: name
string.value: The Surprise Gift
You delivered 10 Boogies' gift to Dances with Balrog. What was it? Ask him about it.
The gift exploded into Smiling Ghost Stumps! Is 10 Boogies insane, or just criminally stupid? Eliminate all of the Smiling Ghost Stumps.
So...Blackbull booby-trapped the gift 10 Boogie had. Dances with Balrog doesn't seem to mind, but 10 Boogies should know how badly she was fooled.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 486

string.name: name
string.value: The Gullible Boogies
Dances with Balrog has a message for 10 Boogies.
Dances with Balrog wants you to thank 10 Boogies for the gift, without mentioning what happened. Still, you feel like you should explain Blackbull's trick...
10 Boogies believes that Blackbull is a good man. Guess there's no helping some people.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 386

string.name: name
string.value: Dehydrated Trees
10 Boogies has another favor to ask you. Better see what it is.
10 Boogies said that Stumps are starting to dry out. She wanted you to ask Winston in #m 102020400# to find out why this is happening. Science must not be 10 Boogies's specialty.
You asked Winston about why plants in Perion get dehydrated.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 564

string.name: name
string.value: Dehydrated Tree Branches

When you asked Winston about the dried-out plants in Perion, he stopped and thought about it quite seriously. Maybe this is more complicated than you thought. See if there's something you can do to help.
Dr. #p1022006# found something suspicious in the #m102000000# area, which might be causing the dehydration. He wanted to find out more, so he asked you to bring him #b20 Dehydrated Tree Branches#k.
You brought the Dehydrated Tree Branches to Dr. #p1022006#. Hopefully, Dr. #p1022006# can come to a conclusion soon...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 664

string.name: name
string.value: Stumpy the Ent
Ask Winston about the research.
All of Perion is dried out because #o3220000# is sucking nourishment from the land of #m102000000#. If nothing is done, #m102000000# is doomed! Winston asked you to eliminate #r#o3220000##k.
As Dr. #p1022006# requested, you eliminated #o3220000#, and saved #m102000000# from devastation.

string.name: name
string.value: Peace for Perion
Winston has something to say.
Winston told you to deliver the news about Stumpy to 10 Boogies. Go tell her the good news.
10 Boogies is happy that you've made Perion safe again. Aww.

string.name: name
string.value: Clearing Things Up
10 Boogies wants to clear things up with Blackbull. The mess with the present must still be bothering her.
10 Boogies told you that Blackbull would never endanger anyone like that, so she wanted to talk to him directly. 10 Boogies seems way too trusting.
10 Boogies spoke to Blackbull. Wonder how it went?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 668
You visited Blackbull to see if he's had a change of heart. He didn't, and he wants something from you. Oh, boy....
Blackbull pressured you into doing him a favor. Great. Go to #m102030000# by following the arrow signs, eliminate 100 Wild Boars, and obtain 50 Wild Boar Teeth.
You gave the requested materials to Blackbull.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,168 Can proceed to the Peaceful Tea quest

string.name: name
string.value: Peaceful Tea
Ayan saw your dealings with Blackbull, and called you over.

Although Blackbull is a strong warrior, he likes to give others a hard time. She was afraid you might not get along with him. Some nice tea might help you relax, so go see Sophia in the General Store for something soothing.
You really should go see Sophia in the General Store, and have some nice tea to calm yourself down a bit.

string.name: name
string.value: Poor, Lost Christopher
Now that you're nice and calm...Sophie has a favor to ask you. It's always something!

Christopher the Excavator gets lost a lot. He's lost right now, in fact. He was last seen wandering around #bthe Burnt Lands west of Perion#k. Find Christopher, give him directions home, and give him some Refreshing Stump Sap for the road.
You gave Refreshing Stump Sap to Christopher, and sent him off in the right direction.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1127

string.name: name
string.value: Lost Blueprints
Christopher had some Refreshing Sap, but his face still doesn't look so good. See if he's okay.
Eliminate nearby monsters, and find Christopher's Lost Blueprints.
Christopher thanked you for the Refreshing Sap, and for finding his Lost Blueprints. He said he'd find his way back to the Excavation Site on his own. Don't expect to see him again anytime soon.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1441

string.name: name
string.value: Mr. Smith, the Blacksmith
Where are my Lost Blueprints? Please, find them for me!

Mr. Smith needs more Iron to work. He said any kind of Iron is fine, so eliminate Iron Hogs and Iron Boars, and collect #t4000178#s and #tIron Hog's Metal Hooves#s for him. Most Iron Hogs and Iron Boars live in #m102030200#, so you should start there.
You brought the requested materials to Mr. Smith.

string.name: name
string.value: A Warrior of Perion
Christopher has something to say before he heads back to the Excavation Site. Famous last words?

Christopher told you that Stands With Bulls in #m102030300# wants to deliver something to town, so Christopher wants you to help him out. Since Christopher can't be trusted to find his way, go to #m102030200# and see Stands With Bulls.
You met Stands With Bulls in #m102030200#.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1292

string.name: name
string.value: Perion's Residency Qualifications
Tell Stands With Bulls that you are here to help him.

Stands With Bulls told you that without word from Dances with Balrog, he will not believe you are part of the Perion community. You must show your courage and strength by eliminating 150 Iron Boars. Pretty harsh guy.
You showed Stands With Bulls your courage and strength, and he seems more open to listen to you.

string.name: name
string.value: Duties of Perion Residents
Stands With Bulls is looking for a warrior who can eliminating Fire Boars. Visit him in #m102030200#.
Many adventurers get injured in the Burning Land. For the safety of everyone in Perion, eliminate Fire Boars in #r#m102030300##k and #r#m102030400##k.
You eliminated 100 Fire Boars. This area should be a bit safer now, right?

string.name: name
string.value: Arcon's Blood
Stands With Bulls has something very urgent to deliver to town.
You need to deliver Arcon's Blood to Manji in Perion.
You delivered Arcon's Blood to Manji. What does this Arcon monster look like?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1742

string.name: name
string.value: The Transformation Potion
10 Boogies wants to see you. What's happening?

10 Boogies told you to see #bSophia at the General Store#k. She's is studying in Alchemy, and 10 Boogies wants to know if there is any way to enhance the Transformation Potion. This could be entertaining!
You asked Sophia if there is any way to enhance the Transformation Potion.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1484

string.name: name
string.value: A Beginner Alchemist
You asked Sophia if there is any way to enhance the Transformation Potion.

Sophia looked over her notes a bit, and finally told you that she needs 50 Fire Boar's Teeth to make the Enhanced Transformation Potion. Many Fire Boars live in #m 102030300# and #m102030400#, so go eliminate 150 Fire Boars there and collect Fire Boar's Teeth.
You brought 50 Fire Boar's Teeth to Sophia. Will the Enhanced Transformation Potion actually work?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2034

string.name: name
string.value: Sophia's Ambitions
Sophia is making an Enhanced Transformation Potion out of Fire Boar's Teeth. Ask her how it's going.
Sophia wants you to deliver her Enhanced Transformation Potion to 10 Boogies. Take it to him, and hope it doesn't make him croak...
You delivered Sophia's Enhanced Transformation Potion to 10 Boogies.

string.name: name
string.value: A Gift For Ayan
10 Boogies wants to share the Enhanced Transformation Potion with Ayan.
Take Sophia's Enhanced Transformation Potion to Ayan. And maybe say a little prayer for her, too.
You delivered Sophia's Enhanced Transformation Potion to Ayan.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1664

string.name: name
string.value: Ayan's Rage
You delivered Sophia's Enhanced Transformation Potion to Ayan.
Ayan was caught off guard by a giant Orange Mushroom, and now she's on a tear. You see Blackbull laughing in the distance. Is this his doing?
Blackbull might be strong, but there's something wrong with the man. Maybe there's a potion that will fix his personality.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1906

string.name: name
string.value: Monsters of the Excavation Site
10 Boogies wants to talk to you.
A new type of monster recently showed up at the Excavation Site. Ask Winston what's going on.
You asked Winston about the new monsters that appeared at the Excavation Site.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2153

string.name: name
string.value: Behind the Mask
Winston needs some materials from the monsters so he can figure out where they came from.
#p1022006# needs #b30 #t4000196#s and #t4000197#s#k from the #b#o2230110#s#k and #b#o2230111#s#k so he can figure out where they came from.
Winston will need some time to analyze the #t4000196#s and #t4000197#s.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2463

string.name: name
string.value: Destructive Science 1
#p1022006# is busy analyzing #t4000196#s and #t4000197#s.
#p1022006# finished analyzing the #t4000196#s, and seems disturbed by his findings. He isn't telling what he learned, but he wants you to eliminate 150 #o2230110#s.
Winston thanked you for taking care of the #o2230110#s. He's almost done with his research on the #t4000197#s.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2603

string.name: name
string.value: Destructive Science 2
Winston is done analyzing #t4000197#s. What could he have discovered?
#p1022006# is shocked by what he discovered from the #t4000197#s, but he still won't tell you what he discovered. For now, he wants you to eliminate 150 #o2230111#s.

Winston said you helped cull the monster population, but it almost seems like for every monster you eliminate, a new one takes its place. There's something strange going on in the Excavation Site, that's for sure...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2938

string.name: name
string.value: Mysterious Strength
There's something about the monsters in the Excavation Site that #p1022006# isn't telling you.
#p1022006# wants you to deliver a letter to Dances with Balrog. It contains the results of all the research you helped him with, but it's sealed so you can't read it.
You delivered Winston's Letter to Dances with Balrog. What's going on at the Excavation Sites?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2988

string.name: name
string.value: How to Survive
The Dark Lord has some simple training for you.
Eliminate the #b8 Octopuses#k in the Thieves' Hideout.
Remember: Never trust anyone and be ready for everything. It's the Dark Lord way.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 475

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: #questorder1##o1120100# #a28501#\r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Dangerous City
A man named Ryden calls out to you as you leave the Thieves' Hideout.
Ryden asks you a bunch of questions about the Dark Lord. When he realizes you don't know a whole lot, he sends you off to see JM From tha Streetz.
You went to see JM From tha Streetz as Ryden told you.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 274

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1052002##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: The Middleman
JM From tha Streetz has a job for you.
JM gave you a simple task. Go to the #bpharmacy#k, take the item from the drawer, and bring it back to him. #rThe item he wants is in the rightmost drawer on the second row from the top.#k
You delievered the item to JM. It was an Emergency Kit... Was someone hurt?

string.name: name
string.value: Alex the Runaway
A kid named Alex is calling to you. He looks like a punk, but really, who are you to judge?
Alex lost a keepsake from his mom. See if JM From tha Streetz has heard anything about an Old Gold Watch.
JM told you nothing is free. He may need some convincing.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 224

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1052002##k#n
Ask JM From tha Streetz about the #bOld Gold Watch#k.
JM says that Mr. Pickall runs a pawnshop in Kerning City. Maybe he's seen the Old Gold Watch.
Ask Mr. Pickall about the #bOld Gold Watch#k.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 224

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p9000008##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Mr. Pickall the Lock-picker
Ask Mr. Pickall about the Old Gold Watch.

Mr. Pickall will tell you where the Old Gold Watch is...for a price. He needs materials to make a key for a particularly tricky lock. Take the portal on the right side of Kerning City to go to the #b#m103010000##k and gather #bUseful Scrap Iron#k. And eliminate some #bOctopuses#k while you're at it. Mr. Pickall doesn't take kindly to Octopuses.
You gave the materials to Mr. Pickall, and he gave you the Old Gold Watch.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 254

string.name: name
string.value: Recovered Watch
Ask Mr. Pickall about the Old Gold Watch again.
You gave the Old Gold Watch back to Alex.
Alex got the Old Gold Watch back, and should be able to return home soon. Something about the look on his face makes you think he's not leaving the city anytime soon, though...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 224

string.name: name
string.value: First Request
JM From tha Streetz has a job for you.
Search the #bSubway Trash Cans #m103020100##k. While you're at it, check up on Jake at the Subway Ticketing Booth.
For some reason, you only found garbage in the trash cans.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 374

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1052002##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Jake's Dilemma
It looks like Jake at the #bSubway Ticketing Booth#k could use a hand.
The #o2300100#s have been giving Jake some trouble. He wants you to eliminate #r30 of them#k. They've been fluttering #b#m103020100##k and in the #b#m103020200##k lately.
You helped Jake with the monsters, but there always seem to be more of them.

string.name: name
string.value: Nella's Proposal
Nella in Kerning City wants to see you. Alone.
Nella wants you to hunt Jr. Wraiths and gather up their Tablecloths. These tablecloth-wearing fiends hang out in the #rSubway #m103020200#k and in #r#m103020300##k.
You brought Nella the tablecloths she ordered.

string.name: name
string.value: Nella's Second Request
Nella has favor to ask of you.
Nella's afraid of Naora Hospital and wants to know if there really is a ghost there. Check it out for her...if you dare!
You found Jane Doe, a girl with bandages on her head, in the Naora Hospital.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 268

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1052105##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Jane Doe's Request
Ask Jane Doe in Naora Hospital about the rumors.
#p1052105# wants to see how her surgery came out, but she doesn't have a mirror to look at herself with. She wants you to eliminate #r50 Wraiths#k and bring her #b20 Broken Mirror Glasses#k.
You collected Broken Mirror Glasses for Jane Doe. Good luck putting them all together...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 318

string.name: name
string.value: The Mystery of Naora Hospital
Jane Doe is shocked to learn that she's dead.
It turns out #p1052105# in Naora Hospital is a ghost. Nella doesn't REALLY need to know that, does she?
You told Nella that there weren't any ghosts in Naora Hospital. Did she really believe you? Or was she just pretending?

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1052103##k#n\n

string.name: name
string.value: JM's Second Request
Go see JM From tha Streetz.
JM has another job for you. Eliminate #b50 #o4230102#s#k in the Subway, collect #b20 Medicines With Weird Vibes#k, and place them inside the #rleft drawer of the bottommost row at the pharmacy#k.
You put the medicine in the drawers. What kind of job was that, anyway?

string.name: name
string.value: Icarus the Delinquent
Find Icarus on the rooftops.
Apparently Shumi near the Subway needs help. Why can't Icarus take care of it himself? Well, do you want the job, or not?
Shumi was looking for something she lost.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1052102##k#n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 386

string.name: name
string.value: Shumi's Forgetfulness
Ask if Shumi would like some help.
Shumi lost her bag in the Subway and wants help finding it. She thinks it was taken by something wearing black cloth. Eliminate #b50 Shades#k in the Subway and retrieve her #bLost Bag#k.
You returned the Lost Bag to Shumi. But how are Shumi and Icarus related? They look nothing like each other! Anyway, rumor has it JM From tha Streetz is looking for you...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 586

string.name: name
string.value: JM's Third Request
See JM From tha Streetz.
JM From tha Streetz wants you to look around Subway #m103020420# for anything suspicious.
You found a hat at Line 2 Area 3. Isn't this Jake's?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 464

string.name: name
string.value: Owner of the Hat
You found a hat while fighting Shades. What were they doing with this? Find Jake at the Subway Ticketing Booth and find out whose hat it is.

Eliminate Muddy Swamp Monsters, retrieve the stolen First-aid Box, and place it in Naora Hospital. Muddy Swamp Monsters can be found in the #m103030300# and the #m103030400#.

string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1092006##k#n\n

string.value: Abel in Charge

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1094001##k#n\n

string.value: For Wont of Glasses

string.value: In Search of a Prince

#b#p1094001##k is supposed to welcome the Prince of Whales to the Nautilus. But this prince never showed up, and you need to help find him.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1094001##k#n\n

string.value: Help a Whale Out
There's a strange whale on the beach. What's the big idea, whale?

The prince transformed. He wasn't just any other whale, after all.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 742

string.value: The Prince's Request 1

You defeated the #r#o1220002#es#k and retrieved gifts from #bPrince #p1092003##k.

string.name: name
string.value: The Prince's Request 2

string.value: Kyrin's Second Orders

string.name: name
string.value: Black Energy Analysis
You found a strange energy and gave it to #b#p1092007##k. He didn't know what to do with it, but maybe he knows someone who would.
#b#p1092007##k thinks #b#p1096006##k might be able to figure out where the strange energy came from. #b#p1096006##k is usually at Nautilus's harbor.

string.value: EXP 961

string.value: Dangerous Loyalties 1

She doesn't want any worthless whales following her captain around, so she wants to make sure #b#p1092003##k isn't a coward. She asks you to collect #rCool Jellyfish Bodies#k and show them to the prince.
#b#p1092003##k has spent his whole life in the sea, so of course he isn't afraid of jellyfish! Let Valerie know that her plan was a failure.

string.value: Dangerous Loyalties

string.name: name
string.value: Dangerous Loyalties 2

Now #b#p1095003##k wants you to get a scary #r#t4033014##k and show it to #b#p1092003##k. #rGo to Valerie's Beach and find the Stump's Eyeball. If you leave the beach, you'll have to start this quest over, so look carefully!

string.value: Dangerous Loyalties

string.name: name
string.value: Dangerous Loyalties 3
The Prince of Whales thought the Stump's Eyeball was pretty. How long will #b#p1095003##k make you help with her ridiculous schemes?
#b#p1095003##k is fed up! This time, she wants you to get as many #r#t04000043#s#k as you can and pinch #b#p1092003##k with them. How many claws does it take to pinch a whale, anyway? Twenty?

Today you learned an important lesson. According to whale customs, when you pinch someone with a claw, you're asking them to marry you. You almost proposed to #b#p1092003##k! Maybe you should stop listening to #b#p1095003##k...

string.name: parent
string.value: Dangerous Loyalties

string.name: name
string.value: Cutter's Concerns
#b#p1095003##k is just getting you in trouble. Why don't you see how #b#p1096006##k is doing with that energy you brought him?

#b#p1096006##k says you should just ignore #b#p1096006##k, and make yourself useful instead. He wants you to check on #b#p1092013##k, who was looking for help earlier. #b#p1092013##k is on #r#m120030100##k.
You met #b#p1092013##k on #r#m120030100##k. Now what?

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1092013##k#n\n

string.name: name
string.value: Porchay's Request 1
Porchay says that monsters have been showing up on Florina Beach and causing trouble lately.
#b#p1092013##k asks you to eliminate the Lorangs on Florina Beach. At the very least, you should help keep the Nautilus safe.
You eliminated some Lorangs, but there are so many of them. Does it ever end?

string.name: name
string.value: Porchay's Request 2
There are still plenty of monsters besides the Lorangs.
You should take down the Clangs, too. The fate of the Nautilus depends on you!
You made quick work of the Clangs.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 5,316 Can proceed to the Porchay's Request 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Porchay's Request 3
Even without the Lorangs and the Clangs, there are plenty of monsters on the beach.
Now take care of the #b#o4130101#s#k. The whole crew of the Nautilus is cheering you on! Maybe!
You beat those #b#o4130101#s#k right out of their shells.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 6,379 Can proceed to the Guardian of the Sea quest

string.name: name
string.value: Guardian of the Sea
You've beat up the Lorangs, Clangs, and Torties who live on Florina Beach. Beating up the wildlife is what being a Pirate is all about!
There's a giant monster on Florina Beach! You only have two choices: beat it because it's a threat to the Nautilus, OR beat it because you wanna!
You eliminated the #b#o5220000##k. You are one bad Pirate! The seven seas have never seen the likes of you before!

string.name: name
string.value: Pupa's Request
#b#p1093000##k is looking for you on Florina Beach.

#b#p1093000##k wants you to collect Coconuts so she can make coconut juice. Coconut juice is a Pirate-y drink, isn't it? Help her out by knocking coconuts out of the trees with your #rRegular Attack#k.
#b#p1093000##k made you coconut juice with the coconuts you brought her.

string.name: name
string.value: There's a Hole in the Nautilus
Bonnie found a hole in the bottom of the Nautilus, and she might sink! And just when you were getting used to this whole Pirate thing, too! Help Bonnie patch it up.
Bonnie needs Glue to fix the hole, and Bartol's the only guy who can make it. Get some Glue from Bartol before Bonnie gets too tired to hold the water back!
You and Bonnie saved the Nautilus from sinking!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 970

string.name: name
string.value: Bartol's Tortie Glue
Bartol can make #b#t04033013##k, but he doesn't have the ingredients he needs.
#b#t04000045#s#k are the main ingredient used in Glue. Hunt down some Torties on Florina Beach and make some Glue, before the Nautilus sinks!
Bartol used the #b#t04000045#s#k to make you some #b#t04033013##k.

string.name: name
string.value: Glue Delivery
You brought Bartol the #b#t04000045#s#k he needed. Now all that's left is to wait for him to make the #b#t04033013##k.
Bring Bartol's #b#t04033013##k to #r#p1092001##k. Feel free to take your time, if you don't mind the Nautilus sinking.
You delivered the #b#t04033013##k to #r#p1092001##k. Just in time, too!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 820

string.name: name
string.value: Sparkling Clean
#b#p1092009##k the Pirate Maid needs your help. Something about dust and poor ventilation on the Nautilus. Whatever it is, it sounds important!
Collect #bJellyfish Bodies#k for #b#p1092009#k to use for dusting.
Mrs. Reade went back to dusting, leaving a thin sheen of jellyfish slime in her wake.

string.name: name
string.value: The Strange Water Filter
You've heard rumors of a talking Water Filter in the Nautilus Bedroom. Weird, right?
The Water Filter is...thirsty? It wants a...#b#t02000003##k...
The Water Filter gulped that #b#t02000003##k down and gave you a Magnifying Glass to thank you. Okay...

string.name: name
string.value: The Suspicious Water Filter
The Water Filter in the Nautilus Bedroom is thirsty again. Why can't it just drink its own water?
Now it wants a #b#t02000006##k. At least the Water Filter has good taste...
The Water Filter gulped the #b#t02000006##k down all at once and gave you a #r#t02040500#k#k as thanks.

string.name: name
string.value: The Weird Water Filter
The Water Filter in the Nautilus Bedroom is thirsty AGAIN. There's something wrong with this Water Filter!
Now it wants #b#t02022000##k. A Water Filter that purifies water wants a #b#t02022000##k. Maybe it should be replaced...
The Water Filter drank down the #b#t02022000##k in an instant! At least it gave you a #r#t02040700##k as thanks.

string.name: name
string.value: The Prince of Whales
The strange whale on the beach was Sharyl, Prince of Whales.
Tell Abel that you found Prince Sharyl.
Abel told you to make sure Sharyl gets everything he wants. Is there something he's not telling you?

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1094001##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Pork Delivery 2
#b#p1091003##k is really excited about the Pork you collected. Ask her how she wants it cooked.
#b#p1091003##k told you to ask #b#p1092000##k, Nautilus's chef, to cook the Pork for you. Tangyoon is in the Nautilus Cafeteria.
You brought the Bag of Pork to Tangyoon. Time to eat!

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] A Golden Opportunity
Gold Richie has a special offer for you. What could it be?
You're on Gold Richie's VIP list! Visit the luxurious Gold Beach Resort before it actually opens. Take the plane to get there.
You came to Gold Beach. Thanks, Gold Richie!

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Flying Blind
You reached Gold Beach as per Gold Richie's invitation, but why the plane took you to this forest is beyond you. Ask the pilot.
Hunt the Palm Tree Slimes? Well, you might as well get on the pilot's good side since you have to take the plane back.
So much for the Palm Tree Slimes. The plane should now be able to take off without issues. Just like #p1082101# mentioned, it's time to head for #bGold Beach#k.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] A Mission of Great Importance
You found a strange boy looking for something on your way to Gold Beach Resort.
Defeat #o3401000# and #o3401001# monsters in Beachgrass Dunes 2 and find a #r#t4033625##k. Return to #b#m120040000# and talk to Little Richie#k when you're done.
You found the #t4033625# for Little Richie. This whole thing is weird...

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Fun With the Son
Let Little Richie know that Gold Richie invited you here.
Talk to #b#e#p1082000##n#k, the manager of Gold Beach Resort.
You talked to #p1082000#.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Golden Fruit
Ask #p1082000# to show you around.
Find the #btropical fruit#k in #e#m120040100##n from #b#o3401001##k. Take it to #p1082000# in #m120040000#. Wait, how did you get roped into this? This is your vacation!
You reclaimed all the tropical fruit from #o3401001# monsters.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Housekeeping!
Ask #p1082000# for the grand tour.
Prevent #o3401002# monsters from messing up any more rooms. #o3401002# monsters are usually at #m120041000#, which can be accessed by taking the portal to the east of #m120040000#.
Now that you took care of those troublemaker #o3401002# monsters, let everyone know you're actually a guest!

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Danger on the Coast
Convince #p1082000# that you're not an employee.
#p1082000# offered to fill you in on the resort. Find out what happened before the resort opens.
The presence of Black Slimes drove the local wildlife into a frenzy.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Little Troublemaker
Little Richie barged in while you were talking to #p1082000#. See what he has to say.
Have #p1082000# write a report on the resort's current status.
You helped #p1082000# with his report.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Status Report
Take the #t4033632# from #p1082000# to Little Richie.
Little Richie ordered you to eliminate all Black Slimes. Then he drank his slushy drink.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] The Day the Lights Went Out
You've been working hard since you reached Gold Beach. It's about time you asked #p1082000# where you'll be staying.
Tell #p1082003# in the #e#m120041100##n that the beach lighting is broken.
You found #p1082003# in the #m120041100#. Tell him about the broken beach lighting.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Shine a Light
You found #p1082003# in the #m120041100#. See if you can keep his concentration for a few minutes.
Take care of the #o3401003# monsters in the #m120041100# and find the lost #t4033631# items.
You took care of #o3401003# monsters and found #t4033631# items. The lighting issue should be resolved.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Locals and Yokels
You encountered a local man around the #m120041100#. See what he's up to.
You need to find #p1082004#'s #t4033626#. One of the #o3401003# monsters hid it.
You found #p1082004#'s #t4033626#. He claims to be a native from around here, but he seems to be hiding something.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Submarine Dreams
Maybe the natives of this area will know more about the Black Slimes. Ask #p1082004#.
#p1082004# told you about a strange boat that appeared one night.
#p1082004# told you about a strange boat that appeared one night.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Private Beach
#p1082000# appeared in #m120041100#. Strange, there's no breakfast food here.
Hunt 100 #b#o3401004##k monsters, then report back to #p1082000##k in #b#m120041100#. You will find #o3401004# monsters in #e#m120041200##n.
You took down 100 #o3401004# monsters.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Put a Ring On It
#p1082003# in #m120041200# is looking for something. Find out what.
Take care of #o3401004# monsters to find the missing #t4033630#.
You found the #t4033630# for Ralphio. Maybe he'll be able to return to his fiancee after all the resort constructions are completed.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] The Hunt for Black November
#p1082003# wants to talk to you.
#p1082000# is staring out at the sea in #m120041300#. Ask him what's up.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Black Wave
#p1082000# is staring out at the sea in #m120041300#. Ask him what's up.
Eliminate #b#o3401005##k monsters to create a more pleasant beach. Return to #m120040000# with the #bkeycard#k from #p1082000#.
You got rid of the #o3401005# monsters and returned to #m120040000#.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Floating Away
Hunt down #o3401005# and #o3401006# in #m120041300# and #m120041400#, and find the missing #bfloaties#k they took. Return to #b#p1082005##k in #m120041400# when you're done.
You returned the #t4000758# and #t4000759# items to #p1082005# in #m120041400#.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Fresh Flavors
You ran into Little Richie in the #m120041400#. What's he up to?
Obtain 50 #t4000760# items from #o3401007# monsters in the #m120041500# for Little Richie.
You got some fresh ingredients for Little Richie. He seems to be at ease while everyone else is working hard.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Shrimpy Situation
Why is Little Richie not back in #m120040000# with those shrimp already?
Take down 100 #o3401007# monsters for Little Richie and his dog, Lil Willy.
You took care of things for Little Richie... again. What a little weinie!

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] The Sad Tale of Lil Willy
#p1082000# is in the #m120041500#. Find out what he's up to.
Eliminate 120 #o3401008# monsters in the #m120041600# and find a #t4033622# for Little Richie.
You found Lil Willy's lost ball for Little Richie.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Ferry Frustrations
#p1082000# seems worried. Find out why.
Eliminate 100 #o3401009# and #o3401010# monsters in #b#e#m120041700# and #m120041800##n#k. Report back to #p1082000# in #e#m120041500##n when you're done.
You cleared off the beach and now the boats can launch... hopefully.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] The Original Slime-ster
Talk to #p1082000# in #m120041500# again.
There's a path to the strange submarine in #m120041800#. Go check it out.
You ran into #p1082004#, the 'native', in #m120041800#.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Going Tribal
You ran into #p1082004# in #m120041800#. Find out why.
Eliminate the #b#o3401010##k monsters in #m120041800# and find #p1082004#'s lost #b#t4033627##k.
You found #p1082004#'s lost #b#t4033627##k. Looks like he wasn't a native after all. Get back to #p1082000##k in #r#m120040000#. Use the Gold Beach Entry Pass (1 use) to get there quickly.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Chef's Special
Little Richie prepared a meal for you. Talk to #p1082000# about it.
The meal was terrible, but it probably won't kill you.

string.name: name
string.value: [Gold Beach] Terror from the Deep
Little Richie needs you urgently in #m120040000# .
Take care of the #b#o3401011##k monsters in #e#m120041900##n. Take the eastern portal in #m120041800# to get to #m120041900#.
The strange submarine took off when you eliminated #b#o3401011# monsters.

string.name: name
string.value: Title - Beach Bum
Little Richie prepared something special to show his appreciation for helping Gold Beach Resort.
Little Richie wants to give you the #b <Beach Bum>#k title for helping out Gold Beach Resort.
You got the #b<Beach Bum>#k title.

string.name: name
string.value: Missing Staff Sergeant Charlie

string.name: parent
string.value: Alpha Platoon's Network of Communication
Let's go meet Master Sergeant Fox.

Inside El Nath, I found #bMaster Sergeant Fox#k, who seemed to have crash-landed here. He asked if I can find 3 of his men and if they are doing their job wherever they are. The ones I need to meet up are #bStaff Sergeant Charlie, Corporal Easy, and Sergeant Bravo#k, and they should be around Ossyria. He'd prefer that I meet them in the order of their ranks... that sounds pretty difficult to me ...

string.name: summary
string.value: Find Staff Sergeant Charlie

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: 1,200 EXP\r\n Can proceed to the 'A Request from Staff Sergeant Charlie' quest.\r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Missing Sergeant Bravo

string.name: parent
string.value: Alpha Platoon's Network of Communication

Inside El Nath, I found #bMaster Sergeant Fox#k, who seemed to have crash-landed here. He asked if I can find 3 of his men and if they are doing their job wherever they are. The ones I need to meet up are #bStaff Sergeant Charlie, Corporal Easy, and Sergeant Bravo#k, and they should be around Ossyria. He'd prefer that I meet them in the order of their ranks. I found #bStaff Sergeant Charlie#k at Orbis. Now I have to find #bSergeant Bravo#k next.

I found #bSergeant Bravo#k in the middle of a snowfield far from El Nath. He said he's been doing his duties and that, while investigating around the area, he found this piece of an ancient document that he wants me to deliver to Master Sergeant Fox.

string.name: summary
string.value: Find Sergeant Bravo

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: 1,200 EXP\r\nCan proceed to the 'A Request from Sergeant Bravo' quest.\r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Missing Corporal Easy

string.name: parent
string.value: Alpha Platoon's Network of Communication

Inside El Nath, I found #bMaster Sergeant Fox#k, who seemed to have crash-landed here. He asked if I can find 3 of his men and if they are doing their job wherever they are. The ones I need to meet up are #bStaff Sergeant Charlie, Corporal Easy, and Sergeant Bravo#k, and they should be around Ossyria. He'd prefer that I meet them in the order of their ranks. I found #bStaff Sergeant Charlie and Sergeant Bravo#k. Now I have to find #bCorporal Easy#k next.

I found #bCorporal Easy#k in the middle of an old-looking tower far from El Nath. He said he's been doing his duties and that, while investigating around the area, he found this piece of an ancient document that he wants me to deliver to Master Sergeant Fox.

string.name: summary
string.value: Find Corporal Easy

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: 1,200 EXP\r\nCan proceed to the 'A Request from Corporal Easy' quest.\r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Returning to Master Sergeant Fox

string.name: parent
string.value: Alpha Platoon's Network of Communication

Master Sergeant Fox asked me to meet #bStaff Sergeant Charlie, Sergeant Bravo, and Corporal Easy#k in order. I met them all just as Master Sergeant Fox told me. I should be returning to him right away.

Just like the way Master Sergeant Fox requested, I met his men in order of ranks and got the 3 pieces of an ancient document to him. He was really happy about it, and gave me the scroll made out of those pieces. He also wished that I could drop by sometime later and see how the other men are doing...maybe I should...

string.name: summary
string.value: Go back to Master Sergeant Fox

string.name: name
string.value: The Descendent of the Author of the Book of Ancient

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
I should go see Alcaster of El Nath right now...

You met an ancient scholar named #b#p2020005##k in #m211000000#. He told you about a book you might be able to use, #bThe Book of Ancient#k. It's seems to hold a great deal of power and was used during the war. Very few have even heard of it, but you were told that Jade has been hunting for it as well.
You should ask Jade about The Book of Ancient.

string.name: summary
string.value: Find Jade in El Nath.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,631\nCan proceed to 'A Small Tomb Hidden' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Hella's Missing

Alcaster told me to go to Hella's house in Orbis, to no avail. She wasn't anywhere to be found, as I had to resort to talking to her housekeeper, #bElma#k. According to her, Hella hadn't been home in months, and no one knows where she went or why. She did tell me to go see her best friend, #bJade of El Nath#k, so I should go there immediately.
Jade...she looks like she has a big mouth. Maybe she knows something about Hella?

string.name: summary
string.value: I should go see Hella's friend, Jade, at El Nath.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,200\nCan proceed to the 'Where is Hella?' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Where's Hella?
Jade suspected that Hella may have gone on a search to find the #bkeepsake of her late mother#k, and told me to go see Hella's housekeeper again.
Elma the Housekeeper should know that Hella's been robbed, right?

string.name: summary
string.value: I should go back to Housekeeper Elma in Orbis.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,200\nCan proceed to the 'One Clue' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: One Clue
Elma the Housekeeper told me she heard Hella mention something about a #bold lady#k. She also told me to go talk to Jade again if I want to know more about her.
Would Jade know the Old Woman that Hella was talking about?

string.name: summary
string.value: I should go see Jade in El Nath.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,200\nCan proceed to the 'In Search of an Old Woman' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Looking For the Old Lady
Jade said the 'old lady' may be #bSpiruna#k, who lives in a small house around where the Orbis park monsters walk around, and recommends that I go see her immediately.
What's Spiruna doing in Orbis Park? It's dangerous there! Maybe she knows about Hella?

string.name: summary
string.value: I should go see Spiruna in Orbis.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,200\nCan proceed to the 'Spiruna's Black Crystal' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Spiruna's Black Crystal

Spiruna promised to tell me everything that she knows, as long as I find the #bBlack Crystal#k that she lost in the snowfield while on a search for some materials for spells. Now where in the snowfield must that be...?
You have found the Rock Covered in Snow in the snowfield. Maybe the Black Crystal is here somewhere?

string.name: summary
string.value: I should go find the Black Crystal, hidden somewhere in the snowfield.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,200\nCan proceed to the 'Cracked Black Crystal' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: The Cracked Black Crystal
I found Spiruna's #bBlack Crystal#k underneath a rock at the snowfield, but it has some serious cracks on it. Anyway I should give this back to Spiruna immediately.
Spiruna doesn't look so happy after receiving the smashed Black Crystal. She's been like this since it was found...is she angry?\n

string.name: summary
string.value: I should go back to Spiruna in Orbis.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 14,680\nCan proceed to the 'Restoring the Crystal' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: To Restore the Crystal
Just as I expected...Spiruna went livid over the cracked Black Crystal, and blames it all on me!!! Maybe I should seek some help from that lady standing next to her.
Spiruna is pitching a fit. What to do? The lady next to her seems to calm... Maybe she has an idea?

string.name: summary
string.value: I should talk to the mysterious girl who lives in Spiruna's house.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,200\nCan proceed to the 'The Advice of an Assistant' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: A Word from the Assistant

Spiruna's assistant quietly tells me that at this point, nothing will bring her back to her senses, unless I bring an item called #bFairy Dust#k, the only item that'll restore the cracked black crystal to its original state. #bKriel the Fairy#k of Orbis General Store may have it.
Fairies don't like human all that much... Will Kriel the Fairy give you some #bFairy Dust#k?

string.name: summary
string.value: I should go see Kriel the Fairy at the Orbis General Store.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,200\nCan proceed to the 'Acquiring Fairy Dust' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: To Acquire the Fairy Dust

#bKriel the Fairy#k wanted to make a deal with me, and I complied. For her to give up the #bFairy Dust#k, I'll have to get her #b100 Star Pixie Starpieces, 50 Lunar Pixie Moonpieces, and 30 Luster Pixie Sunpieces#k. I'll have to go on a serious Pixie hunting spree for a while. 

#t4000061# #b#c4000061##k/30
#t4000059# #b#c4000059##k/100
#t4000060# #b#c4000060##k/50
I gave all ingredients to Kriel the Fairy. She will give me Fairy Dust.

string.name: summary
string.value: I should gather all the ingredients Kriel the Fairy needs and bring it back to her.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 14,680\nCan proceed to the 'Fairy Dust in My Hand' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Acquiring the Fairy Dust
I got #bKriel the Fairy#k all the items she asked for, and got the #bFairy Dust#k in return. Now all I need to do is get this to Spiruna and see what happens.
You gave Fairy Dust to Spiruna. She's suddenly acting very differently... Maybe she'll tell you about Hella now?

string.name: summary
string.value: I should take the Fairy Dust back to Spiruna.

string.name: name
string.value: The Truth Comes Out...

Spiruna was utterly ecstatic over receiving the #bFairy Dust#k, and proceeded to tell me everything she knew about Hella. Oh my goodness... Are you kidding me? That assistant there is the Hella I've been looking for all this time??
Hella was Spiruna's assistant! Yikes! Ask the name first next time!

string.name: summary
string.value: I should talk to Spiruna's assistant, whom now I know is Hella.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 2,400\nCan proceed to the 'Hella is Finally Found' quest\n

string.name: name
string.value: Hella is Found!

Hella requested that I get this #bpendant#k to Jade. She also mentioned something about an old diary that she found at home years ago, and it mentioned the existence of the Book of Ancient, and that the owner lost it somewhere deep in the valley of the snowfield. Jade should fill up the rest for me. I got to go see him right now and inform him of her whereabouts.
You gave Jade the pendant you received from Hella.

string.name: summary
string.value: I should deliver Hella's pendent to Jade in El Nath.

string.name: name
string.value: The Small Grave That's Hidden

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
The Small Tomb that Jade mentioned must be somewhere in the Icy Cold Field.
Small Tomb... A place no one ever goes to... Could the key to the ancient book really be there?

string.name: summary
string.value: I should go to the small grave in the snowfield Jade mentioned.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 3,262\nCan proceed to the 'An Old Ring' quest\n
Ask Jade what she knows about The Book of Ancient.

string.name: name
string.value: An Old Ring

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
I found an anonymous grave somewhere deep in the valley of the snowfield. I also removed an old ring from the corpse's finger. Maybe Alcaster knows what to do with it.
You gave the ring to Alcaster.

string.name: summary
string.value: I should take the ring I found at the grave and take it to Alcaster in El Nath.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 3,262\nCan proceed to 'The Secret Behind the Ring' quest\n
Check out the Small Tomb in the Icy Cold Field.

string.name: name
string.value: The Secrets Behind the Ring?

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Talk to Alcaster again.
Alcaster took time observing the ring, and felt an incredible force emanating from it. He recommended that I go see Scadur the Hunter around El Nath.
After receiving the ring, Scadur looks like he knows something.

string.name: name
string.value: Collecting Wolf Skin

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Ask Scadur about the ring again.
#bScadur#k promised to fess up and give back the ring if you bring him 50 Hector Tails and 50 White Fang Tails to cover the rising cost of wolf skins.
Being satisfied with Hector Tails and White Fang Tails, Scadur said he would give the ring back. \n\n#t2000004 # #b#c2000004 #/1#k

string.name: name
string.value: Looking for the Wiseman in Perion

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Talk Scadur into giving you back the Old Ring.

I handed Scadur the wolf skins he asked for, and he gave me back the #bold ring#k. He reminisced the old days where heard about the ring through the four wise men he had met as a young man. He recommended me to go visit Victoria Island and meet up with all four of the wise men, starting with the one in #bPerion#k.
You met a person named Dances with Balrog. Looks a bit wild to be called a sage... Will he recognize the old ring?

string.name: name
string.value: Dances with Balrog and His Recovery

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Find #bDances with Balrog#k in Perion.

I went to Perion and met up with #bDances with Balrog#k. After I showed him the ring, he conceded that he may have an item that'll provide enough clues to help me ultimately find the Book of Ancient. Of course, he also didn't want to just give it away like that. Since he's spent too much energy trying to help other warriors, he wanted #b2 Power Crystals#k to recover his strength, in return for handing me the item that holds the clue.
You gave Dances with Balrog the Power Crystal.

string.name: name
string.value: Looking for the Wiseman in Ellinia

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Talk to Dances with Balrog again.

I handed Dances with Balrog 2 Power Crystals and received the 1st #bold piece of map#k. The map is cut in four pieces, each piece held by a wise man. He wanted me to gather up all four pieces of the map, find the Book of Ancient through it, and seal it up for good. Next up: The wise man in #bEllinia#k.
Grendel the Really Old seems more a like sage than Dances with Balrog.

string.name: name
string.value: Grendel the Really Old and His Recovery

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Talk to Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia again.
The wise man of Ellinia, #bGrendel the Really Old#k, promised to give me the map piece in exchange for #b2 Wisdom Crystals#k.
I gave Grendel the Really old Wisdom Crystals. Now I can get the map piece.

string.name: name
string.value: Looking for the Wiseman in Henesys

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Get the Old Piece of Map from Grendel the Really Old.

I met my end of the bargain by handing Grendel the Really Old the 2 Wisdom Crystals, and he met his end of the bargain by handing me the 2nd #bold piece of the map#k. Next up: The wise woman at #bHenesys#k.
A young face, with experienced eyes... Reminds you of the sage of Henesys, Athena Pierce.

string.name: name
string.value: Athena Pierce and Her Recovery

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Meet with Athena Pierce in Henesys.
The wise man of Henesys, #bAthena Pierce#k, promised to give me the old piece of map in exchange for #b2 DEX Crystals#k.
You gave Athena Pierce the DEX Crystal. Will you get the third Old Piece of Map?

string.name: name
string.value: Looking for the Wiseman in Kerning City

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Get an Old Piece of Map from Athena Pierce.
I met my end of the bargain by handing Athena Pierce the 2 DEX Crystals, and she met her end of the bargain by handing me the 3rd #bold piece of map#k. Last up: The wise man at #bKerning City#k.
A sage hiding in a place this, how strange! With a name like Dark Lord, he must be an odd character.

string.name: name
string.value: Dark Lord and His Recovery

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Go to the Dark Lord, the wise man in Kerning City.
The wise man of Kerning City, #bDark Lord#k, promised to give me the map piece in exchange for #b2 LUK Crystals#k.
You gave Dark Lord the LUK Crystal. Maybe this will complete your collection of map pieces.

string.name: name
string.value: All the Map Pieces in One Place

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Get an Old Piece of Map from the Dark Lord.
I have obtained all #b4 map pieces#k from the four wise men in Victoria Island, and this map supposedly locates where the Book of Ancient is currently hidden. I should get back to Alcaster now.
Alcaster should know what to do with the four map pieces.

string.name: name
string.value: Restoring the Map

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Ask Alcaster what to do.
You need #bMemory Powder#k to combine the maps into one. #bCorporal Easy of Alpha Platoon#k in Cloud Park VI should have it.
So, Corporal Easy should have the Memory Powder...

string.name: name
string.value: Acquiring the Memory Powder

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Talk to Corporal Easy in Orbis.

Corporal Easy promises that he will give you Memory Powder if you bring him #b30 Lucida Tails#k. He says you can find Lucidas in the Garden of Darkness in Orbis...\n\n#i4000074##t4000074# #b#c4000074##k/30
You delivered Lucida Tails to Corporal Easy.

string.name: name
string.value: The Map is in One Piece

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Get the Memory Powder from Corporal Easy.
I got the #bMemory Powder#k from Corporal Easy. Now I need to get this to Alcaster.
You gave the Memory Powder from Corporal Easy to Alcaster. He looks like he's about to cast special magic.

string.name: name
string.value: The Secrets Behind the Statue

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
Alcaster is going to repair the map with the Memory Powder you got.
With the Memory Powder, Alcaster was able to attach the four map pieces and turn it into a map. According to the map, the Book of Ancient lies somewhere #baround Orbis Tower at some statue#k.
You opened the Statue at the Orbis Tower with the old ring. Is the ancient book really here?

string.name: name
string.value: The Book of Ancient is Back!

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search of the Book of Ancient
The old ring opened the statue in Orbis Tower. The Book of Ancient must be near.
I can't believe I finally have a hold of the #bBook of Ancient#k. Now I need to turn this over to Alcaster...

A lot of time and effort were put into this, but the Book of Ancient is finally back in Alcaster's hands as he will begin working on the process of sealing up the book for good. As a sign of appreciation, he rewarded me with a special cape. I really hope he finds a way to seal up the book for good.
I should go check up on Alcaster in El Nath soon.

string.name: name
string.value: Alcaster and the Star Rock

Alcaster advised you to bring a #bStar Rock#k to seal the #bThe Book of Ancient#k. Star Rocks can be obtained from master monsters such as Eliza, Snow Witch, and Snowman. 


#i4021009##t4021009# #b#c4021009#/1#k
You brought Alcaster a #bStar Rock#k. Although Alcaster lost half of his power sealing the #bAncient Book#k, he looked very happy.

string.name: name
string.value: Traces of Nick

string.name: parent
string.value: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter
I should go see Scadur the Hunter in El Nath.

You see Scadur for the first time since the whole Book of Ancient fiasco. He says he lost his wife when the monsters from the Dead Mine invaded, and his son, Nick, left home to travel El Nath in an attempt to avenge his mother's death. But, Scadur has not heard from his son and wants you to find #bNick's Ring#k. He thinks it may be in Ice Valley somewhere. He also wants you to grant his son's last wish and bring 80 #bWhite Fang Tails#k. It sounds like a rigorous adventure awaits you!
I went into the innermost part of the lava cave, where I found a chipped part of a statue. I have a feeling something is in here.

string.name: name
string.value: Nick's Ring

string.name: parent
string.value: Nick, the Son of Scadur the Hunter

You find a #bRing#k in Ice Valley, below a statue fragment that could belong to Nick. The ring has a name engraved on it... Show it to Scadur and confirm that it belonged to Nick...

#i4000052##t4000052# #b#c4000052##k/80
#i4031060##t4031060# #b#c4031060##k/1

You found Nick's Ring and collected some White Fang Tails in Ice Valley. When you brought them to Scadur, he gave you a cape from Scadur that has been passed down from generation to generation. Not too shabby!

string.name: name
string.value: Collecting Huckle's Magic Ingredients
I heard there is an old man called #bHuckle#k inside a hidden secret room in Orbis Tower...

You meet an old man named Huckle in the Hidden Room in the middle of Orbis Tower. He's been living there for 30 years, studying the physics of the self-moving stones. He wants you to gather #b15 Jr. Sentinel Shellpieces, 15 Ice Sentinel Shellpieces, and 15 Fire Sentinel Shellpieces#k. No problem!

#i4000085##t4000085# #b#c4000085##k/15
#i4000083##t4000083# #b#c4000083##k/15
#i4000084##t4000084# #b#c4000084##k/15

I got Huckle, the old man living in the hidden room at the Orbis Tower, the items he had requested, and in return, got the Statue-Teleporting Scroll. It allows me to teleport between the statue at the 20th floor of Orbis Tower, and the 1st floor. Huckle looks like he needs more samples, so I guess I'll need to keep looking for those ...

string.name: name
string.value: A Request from Staff Sergeant Charlie

string.name: parent
string.value: Alpha Platoon's Network of Communication
Staff Sergeant Charlie in Orbis asks you to deliver an item to Master Sergeant Fox. He also wants #b8000 Meso#k as an information fee.
You brought Staff Sergeant Charlie his information fee. What was the item he needed delivered to Master Sergeant Fox?

string.name: name
string.value: A Request from Sergeant Bravo

string.name: parent
string.value: Alpha Platoon's Network of Communication
I found Sergeant Bravo at the snowfield, and he asked me to get him #b2 refined #t4011003#s#k while giving me an item which is to be given to Master Sergeant Fox.
I brought two Adamantium to Sergeant Bravo. He seems to give something to Master Sergeant Fox...

string.name: name
string.value: A Request from Corporal Easy

string.name: parent
string.value: Alpha Platoon's Network of Communication
Corporal Easy in Orbis Tower wants you to deliver an item to Master Sergeant Fox. He also asks for #b20 refined #t4000061#s#k.
You brought #b20 refined #t4000061#s#k to Corporal Easy. You should be able to go see Master Sergeant Fox now.

string.name: name
string.value: A World Apart

string.name: parent
string.value: To the New World
Go to the #b#p1061011##k in Sleepywood.
Manji asked if you wanted to become more powerful, but he had an ulterior motive. He wanted you to give something to #bKriel the Fairy#k in Orbis.
You gave the Tears of Kelvelos to Kriel.

string.name: name
string.value: Helping Kriel Out

string.name: parent
string.value: To the New World
I need to go see Kriel the Fairy at Orbis.
Busy Kriel the Fairy asked for your help. You must collect empty bottles from the town.
I'm glad I got to help Kriel the Fairy out.

string.name: name
string.value: The Nependeath Juice

string.name: parent
string.value: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice
I should go see Alfonse Green, who should be somewhere near Orbis.

I met up with Alfonse Green, and needless to say, he is a big fan of the Nependeath Juice. He asked me if I could make one for him. To make one, I'll need to acquire the Sap of Nependeath, and I'll need Ericsson for that.
I met up with Ericsson.

string.name: name
string.value: Ericsson Loves Cats

string.name: parent
string.value: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice
I should go see Ericsson.
Ericsson was way too busy playing around with his cats and didn't have enough time to make the sap of Nependeath. What can I do to make one?
I got the Lunar Wristband for Ericsson's beloved kitty, Nero.

string.name: name
string.value: A Present for Nero
I need to see Elma the Housekeeper, who is in Orbis.
Elma will make a Lunar Wristband to get Ericsson back to work (and to make Nero look adorable), but she's going to need some things.
I got Nero's present through Elma. Now if only I can convince Ericsson...

string.name: name
string.value: Ericsson's Reward

string.name: parent
string.value: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice
I need to look for Ericsson.
Ericsson said he'd make some #bSap of Nependeath#k for your efforts.
I got the #bSap of Nependeath#k from Ericsson. I should take this to #bElma the Housekeeper#k immediately!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
EXP 19,037
#Wbasic#
#i4031200:# #t4031200:# 1
Can proceed to the 'Elma's Nependeath Juice' quest

string.name: name
string.value: Elma's Nependeath Juice

string.name: parent
string.value: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice
I should ask Elma the Housekeeper to make a glass of Nependeath Juice.
Elma will make you a bottle of Nependeath Juice, you just need the ingredients.
Elma fixed me a tasty-looking Nependeath Juice. I better get this to Alfonse Green quickly!

string.name: name
string.value: Sweet Syrup
Ask Kriel the Fairy in Orbis for #b#t4031201##k.
Kriel the Fairy wants a favor before she will give you the Sweet Syrup.
You received Sweet Syrup.

string.name: name
string.value: A Happy Fellow

string.name: parent
string.value: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice
I better go see Alfonse right now. I'm sure he's been dying to see me!
I got Alfonse Green exactly what he wanted, the Nependeath Juice.
I've never seen anyone so happy over a glass of juice as Alfonse Green was with his glass of Nependeath Juice.

string.name: name
string.value: Lisa's Letter of Recommendation

string.name: parent
string.value: Scadur's New Fur Coat
I should go see Lisa of Orbis.
I've decided to go see Scadur of El Nath with the help of Lisa.
He said he needed my help in order to make a new fur coat.

string.name: name
string.value: A Man and His Furs

string.name: parent
string.value: Scadur's New Fur Coat
Go meet Scadur in El Nath.
Apparently, Scadur has been wanting to get a nicer fur coat for quite some time. He asks you to gather the finest set of materials for his new fur coat.
I helped Scadur make the finest fur coat available in Ossyria.

string.name: name
string.value: Moppie the Lone Dawg
I should go see Moppie, who seemed tired and weary of waiting for his master.

I saw Moppie in Orbis, and he seemed unresponsive to my commands. You could tell he's been waiting for his master for a long time judging from the wrinkly, dirty, unruly hair he features. I wanted to help him out, but I cannot understand whatever Moppie is uttering. I need someone as a translator so I can talk to him, but ... should I ask for a person, or a fairy?
I had no idea what Moppie was saying, so I got to ask Lisa for some help.

string.name: name
string.value: Fairy's Horn Flute
According to Lisa, there is a way to communicate with Moppie the dog, as long as the horn flute is there. They are usually featured by the fairies.
Only a Fairy's Horn Flute will let you talk to Moppie. Get the ingredients and bring them to Lisa.
The horn flute for the fairies is finally made. Wow, this thing feels weird...

string.name: name
string.value: Fairy's Horn Flute II
Lisa of Orbis made me a horn flute. Hopefully this will help me finally understand what Moppie is saying ...
Should I try this horn flute on Moppie?
I used the horn flute for fairies on Moppie, and I could finally understand what he's saying!!

string.name: name
string.value: Lisa's Special Medicine
Thanks to the horn flute, I can clearly comprehend what Moppie is saying. What kind of help is Moppie looking for...?

Thanks to the horn flute, I could finally understand what Moppie was saying. Apparently he was just sitting at the same spot waiting for his master until one day, he decided to take matters into his own hands (or paws) and wandered out of town. He was attacked by a monster, and he's been hurt ever since. I need to find someone that can help Moppie get healthy again.
I found that someone that can make the ultimate medicine for Moppie.

string.name: name
string.value: Lisa's Special Medicine II
To cure Moppie, I need Lisa's Special Medicine...

To make Lisa's Special Medicine, I'll need 40 Orange Potions, 20 Blue Potions, 1 Antidote, and... 10 Star Pixie's Starpieces. Be careful fighting the Star Pixies!

#t2000001# #b#c2000001#/40#k
#t2000003# #b#c2000003#/20#k
#t2050000# #b#c2050000#/1#k
Lisa's Special Medicine is finally made! The sweet scent of it just makes it look that much more appealing to me, and I'm sure it will for Moppie.

string.name: name
string.value: Lisa's Special Medicine III
With Lisa's Special Medicine, Moppie's injuries will heal in an instant. Hurry over to Moppie.
With Lisa's Special Medicine, Moppie's injuries will heal in an instant. Hurry over to Moppie.
Thanks to Lisa's Special Medicine, Moppie is completely healed!

string.name: name
string.value: A Request from Moppie
I should check up on Moppie, as he is waiting for his master who left him with the words 'I'll be back' as he went on his studies.

I should find Moppie's master, Huckle, since he was the one that Moppie with the words 'I'll be back' as he went on his studies. Huckle should be somewhere safe in Orbis Tower working on his studies ... but where exactly?
I found Huckle, who was diligently working on his studies at the Orbis Tower. He looked like he hadn't bathed in weeks.

string.name: name
string.value: Food-Hunting for Moppie
Moppie's master Huckle had completely forgotten about his trusty dog as he was conducting his studies in Orbis Tower. He felt so horrible that he wanted to at least feed Moppie with something...
Huckle wants you to get some fish for Moppie. Head down to the bottom of Orbis Tower and collect fish from Jr. Pepe. 50 fish should make Moppie happy. \n\n#i4000088##t4000088# #b#c4000088#/50#k
You got 50 Jr. Pepe's Fish and delivered them to Moppie for Huckle.

string.name: name
string.value: Food-Hunting for Moppie II
Moppie's master, Huckle, wants to ask me for another favor...

Huckle's time is entirely consumed by his studies, and he wants you to get some more fish for Moppie. This time, he wants 100 of them! Deliver them to Moppie. \n\n#i4000088##t4000088# #b#c4000088#/100#k
You gathered 100 of Jr. Pepe's fish and delivered them to Moppie.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
EXP 5,400
2,000 mesos
#Wbasic#
#i2020006:# #t2020006:# 15 
#i4001019:# #t4001019:# 2
