Can proceed to the 'Food-Hunting for Moppie Ⅲ' quest

string.name: name
string.value: Food-Hunting for Moppie III
Moppie's master, Huckle, wants to ask me for another favor...now what?
Huckle's time is still consumed by his studies, and he wants you to get even more fish for Moppie. This time, he wants 150 of them! Deliver them to Moppie. \n\n#i4000088##t4000088# #b#c4000088#/150#k
You gathered 150 of Jr. Pepe's fish and delivered them to Moppie, but...

string.name: name
string.value: Nero's Necklace
I heard somewhere around Orbis Park, there's a guy strolling along with a black cat on his head. I should check him out.

I met #p2012018# at Orbis Park, and despite his intimidating appearance, seemed like a genuinely nice guy who has an affinity for cats. He was concerned about the fact that his cat Nero wandered around and came back without the necklace that he personally made for him. #p2012018# asked if I could buy the materials necessary for him to make a new necklace for Nero at the store. 

#t4031191# #b#c4031191##k/1
#t4031192# #b#c4031192##k/1
As a favor from #p2012018# of Orbis Park, I purchased the necessary materials for #p2012018# to make a new necklace for Nero.

string.name: name
string.value: Protect Nero!
I should check #p2012018# out at Orbis Park.
#p2012018# was furious about the monsters near Orbis tormenting Nero. He wants you to teach them a lesson!
Ericsson was livid towards the fact that the monsters outside Orbis had been making his cat Nero's life miserable, so with his blessing, I proceeded to teach those monsters a lesson or two.

string.name: name
string.value: Hughes's Hobby
I should go visit #p2012017#, the weird scientist living at the basement of Orbis Tower.

At a small dinky room in the basement of the Orbis Tower, which also happened to have flooded, I met up with #p2012017#. I accidentally broke #p2012017#'s favorite toy baby seal. He proceeded to really get angry and demanded that I take out #b50 Scuba Pepe's#k and gather #b10 #t4000154#s#k.

#t4000154# #b#c4000154##k/10
Scuba Pepe #r#a30651#
I accidentally broke Hughes's Toy Baby Seal, so I got him some #t4000154# as well as kill off some Scuba Pepe's. Fortunately, Hughes seems to be okay by now.

string.name: name
string.value: Hughes's Weird Invention
#p2012017#, the mad scientist who lives at the basement of Orbis Tower, apparently has invented something incredible.
#b#p2012017##k in the basement of Orbis Tower says he made a brilliant device that allows you to breath under water. He promises to make you one if you bring him some materials.
I went to the basement of the Orbis Tower where Hughes lives, gave Hughes all the materials needed, and got #b#t1102061##k in return, to breathe underwater.

string.name: name
string.value: A Healthy Snack for the Huskies
I should go see #p2060000#, who's at the Whale Island that's covered in snow.

You meet #p2060000#, who lives with her huskies in the Snowy Whale's Island. #p2060000# asks you to bring her #b50 #t4000161#s#k for her huskies, which can be obtained from #bSeacles#k.\n\n#i4000161##t4000161# #b#c4000161##k / 50
You brought 50 nutritious #t4000161#s to Nanuke. Her huskies are so happy!

string.name: name
string.value: Hughes's Research Material
I heard Hughes ran out of materials to conduct research ... I should go check him out.

The mad scientist living at the basement of Orbis, Hughes, wanted me to gather up some materials for his new research. 

#t4000155# #b#c4000155# / 20#k 
#t4000156# #b#c4000156# / 20
I got him #t4000155# and #t4000156# for his research.

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Sap of Nependeath
I lost the sap of Nependeath. I better go talk to Ericsson about it.
Fortunately Ericsson had some left over from the last time he made them. He wasn't very pleased with the fact that I lost it, but...I think he'll make me another batch.
I got a new batch of sap of Nependeath from Ericsson.

string.name: name
string.value: Shammos's Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Ready for Revival
I should go meet up with Shammos, who lives somewhere around El Nath.

I met Shammos at the basement of Chief's Residence. Apparently a plan from back then had backfired and rendered him to where he is today ... it seems like he was planning up something sinister, and the four chiefs found out about it and sealed him up. Anyway, he looks really intimidating, and he seems to be cooking up something terrible again. He's not telling me what it is, but he wants me to head over to Perion to get the item he needs. Am I doing the right thing by helping him out?
I met up with Manji, who knows a thing or two about the #b#t4031218##k.

string.name: name
string.value: The Secrets Behind the Contract of Darkness

string.name: parent
string.value: Preparing For the Revival
I met up with Manji, who knows something about the #b#t4031218##k.

Manji tells you about the #b#t4031218##k, but you wonder if it's true... Can it really bring the dead back to life? The unfathomable force of #b#t4031218##k... Find it and return to Shammos. \n\n#i4031218##t4031218# #b#c4031218##k/1
I gathered up the #b#t4031218##k and gave them back to Shammos.

string.name: name
string.value: The Bottled-up Letter

string.name: parent
string.value: Lost in the Ocean
In the currents near Aquarium, you got hold of a letter from someone in need. Who could have writtin it...?

You found a message in a bottle. Through the dry sand inside the glass bottle, you were able to find Robinson, who had been looking for help for a while. He seemed tired from his long solitary stay on the island, and he wanted you to get him some pure water. \n\n#t2022000# #b#c2022000##k/1
You gave Robinson a bottle of clean water. How did he end up getting lost in the first place?

string.name: name
string.value: Robinson's ID

string.name: parent
string.value: Lost in the Ocean

You met Robinson in the middle of the island right at the center of the ocean, and he said he used to be a pilot for the army of Omega Sector, but while fighting aliens, he fled, only to be swept by strong currents. He wishes to return to the Omega Sector, but he has no idea where he is. All he knows is that he's now covered in scars.
You went to see #b#p2051001##k at the Omega Sector and handed him Robinson's ID. He said everyone's been wondering where he went and wanted you to describe the position of the island in detail.

string.name: name
string.value: Sending Relief

string.name: parent
string.value: Lost in the Ocean

Kay of the Omega Sector complained of the lack of members available due to the battle against the aliens, and asked me if I could give this warp capsule, specially made in Omega Sector, to Robinson. A warp capsule that takes the person to the Omega Sector regardless of the place of origin? That's awesome!! I wanted to take it myself for a split second, until I found out that only the Omega Sector members can use it. Darn it...

Kay needed help from me, since he couldn't send the rescuers to save Robinson, and so I got the specially-made warp capsule and gave it to Robinson. Now he can go back to the Omega Sector and get himself fixed.

string.name: name
string.value: Carta the Sea Witch

string.name: parent
string.value: Carta the Sea Witch
#p2060006#, who works at the Aquarium Zoo, asked me for help, and wanted me to go see Carta at the Aquarium. What does she need from me...?

#b#p2060006##k, who works at the Aquarium Zoo, asked me to go see Carta. #b#p2060006##k said she wanted to find out the whereabouts of her boyfriend #bGail#k, who has volunteered to be part of the exploration team that heads deep in the underwater, and asked me if I could go talk to #b#p2060100##k the sea witch about him.
At the request of #p2060006#, I went to see #p2060100# the sea witch. #p2060100# lived inside the cave at #m230040000#.

string.name: name
string.value: Carta's Demand

string.name: parent
string.value: Carta the Sea Witch
At the request of #p2060006#, I went underwater to meet up with the Sea Witch, #p2060100#. Unfortunately, when I got there, she said she can't foresee the future.

#b#p2060100##k flat-out claimed she couldn't predict the future, but she said she can at least see what the person in question is doing right now. She also said that since the spell is really difficult to pull off, so I'll need to gather up the items if I want to find out what's in store for Gail. She requested that I get #b3 #t4031256#s#k and #b10 #t4031251#s#k from #r#o8140600##k, and #b1 #t4031253##k that can be obtained through #r#o8510000##k while it's dying.

string.value: Carta's Fortune-Telling

string.name: parent
string.value: Carta the Sea Witch
I gathered up all the materials that #p2060100# asked me get. Maybe I can now find out what happened to Gail.
According to #b#p2060100##k, something terrible indeed happened to Gail. What can possibly happen underwater? Anyway, I should let #b#p2060006##k of this immediately. I hope he takes it well...

I told #b#p2060006##k the result of #b#p2060100##k's fortune-telling. What does it mean by the dark fog that surrounds Gail? #p2060006# was trying to act calm, but I could tell she's feeling nervous about Gail. Is #p2060100#'s stuff really worth believing?

string.name: name
string.value: The Blocked Path of the Ocean
I should be able to see #p2060101# deep in the underwater... somewhere around #m230040400#.

I met #b#p2060101##k in between #m230040400# at an empty ship that's been wrecked. He said he's been looking for the traces of his missing men. He came down here to check out the irregular activities that have been taking place here, and one day he lost contact with his men. Not only did he lose them, but he said the path to the bottom of the ocean is blocked too, so he asked me for help on looking for traces of his men. I should wander around looking for #bitems that can be used as evidence#k. If the items the men have used are still here, then maybe the #bsharks#k that have been roaming around #b#m230040400##k is the one to blame... I should find a #bflashlight#k, a #bcamera#k and a #bnotebook#k, and give them back to #b#p2060101##k.

#p2060101#, whom I've met at #m230040400#, asked me to find traces of his men that have disappeared. I was able to gather up the flashlight, the camera, and the notebook that his men used at the time of the attack. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to find any of the missing men.

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Nependeath Juice
If I ever lost the Nependeath Juice, at least I know who to talk to... Elma.
I went to see Elma to get another glass of Nependeath Juice that I lost.
I got a new glass of Nependeath Juice from Elma.

string.name: name
string.value: Kenta's Research 1
#p2060005#, the animal instructor at the Aquarium Zoo, has a quandary. I should go talk to him and see what's up.

#b#p2060005##k, a veteran animal instructor at the Aquarium Zoo, seemed to be concerned over the fact that the animals at Aqua Road have been acting strangely since the storm that occurred not too long ago. I couldn't see the difference myself, but I'm sure the expert sees it differently. \n#b#p2060005##k wanted to investigate this phenomenon, and asked me to gather up the DNA samples of the animals at Aqua Road.

I gave #p2060005#, the animal trainer at Aquarium, the DNA samples of some of the animals at Aquarium. If it's indeed true that some animals have started to act differently since the storm, then how is he going to prove it through research? I'm anxious to find out...

string.name: name
string.value: Kenta's Research 2
I wonder how #p2060005#, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, is doing these days... I want to find out what he got out of his research. I better go see him.

I met up with #p2060005#, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, again. He mentioned that he was on the verge of finding out what was wrong, but was missing something. He then asked me to gather up another set of DNA samples.

Has #p2060005#, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, been getting the results he wanted? I better go find out...

I met up with #p2060005#, the animal instructor at Aquarium Zoo, again. He wanted me to gather up another set of DNA samples for him.

string.value: Nanuke's Ingredients
Deep in the snow at the Snowy Whale Island, #p2060000# found something he really wants to eat... I wonder what it is...

Deep in the snow at the Snowy Whale Island, #p2060000# wanted to eat something that he'd never eaten before in his life. Apparently, his friend #p2060006#, who lives at #m230000000#, offered to make him a tasty new dish, so long as he gathers up the ingredients for her. The problem is... those ingredients are really difficult to gather up. I better go gather up #b150 #t4000183#s#k and #b80 #t4000181#s#k for #p2060000#, so I can deliver them to #b#p2060006##k.

#t4000183# #b#c4000183##k / 150
#t4000181# #b#c4000181##k / 80

He also said if I gather up 150 #t4000183#s and 80 #t4000181#s, then #p2060006# will make a tasty meal for him... So I gathered up the ingredients and met up with #p2060006#. #p2060006# wanted me to wait while she makes the tasty dish for Nanuke, and asked to see her later.

string.name: name
string.value: Muse is Cooking
Is #p2060006# done cooking?

#p2060006# made what seemed like a very tasty dish from the ingredients I got for her. I couldn't see the dish because it was inside a box, but judging from the tasty aroma that filled the room, I knew this was indeed a winner. #p2060006# warned me that this was best eaten when hot, and wanted me to get this to #b#p2060000##k before it turned cold. Basically, I have #r1 hour#k to deliver this to #b#p2060000##k. Can I do this?
I delivered the food that #p2060006# made to #p2060000# on time. I had to really run to make it here in 1 hour. Phew, at least seeing #p2060000# chow down on the dish made it all worthwhile.

string.name: name
string.value: Spiruna's Prophecy

string.name: parent
string.value: Orbis in Danger

I heard that #p2032001#, who resides at the Cloud Park of #m200000000#, made a disturbing prophecy. She may not have the best of personalities, but she's a prophet who correctly saw the future. What must it be that she saw...?

I ran to the Cloud Park of Orbis just to hear the disturbing prophecy from #b#p2032001##k herself. She said nonchalantly that #m200000000# will crash to the ground soon. I asked her of the ways to save #m200000000#, only to hear her say it's all going to be in vain, and decided not to help me out. I can't let #m200000000# crash down like that! I better go talk to #b#p2032001##k again.

I went to see #p2032001# again, but she sat down, motionless, as if she was meditating right then and there. Will #m200000000# crash and burn just like that? But then, a girl standing next to #p2032001# is looking at me as if she has something to say on this matter. Who must she be...?

string.name: name
string.value: Lightening Up Orbis

string.name: parent
string.value: Orbis in Danger
Talk to the girl you met at #p2032001#'s house.

You ran into a strange girl at #p2032001#'s house. She thinks Orbis is sinking is because there are too many monsters on the Cloud Terrace. The only way to stop it is to cut down both the #r#o3230200##k and #r#o4230106##k populations by #b50#k.

You beat up a whole lot of pixies for the mysterious girl at #p2032001#'s house. Orbis will stay afloat for a while longer, but the crash is inevitable at this rate. Talk to the girl again and see if she has any other ideas.

The girl in #p2032001#'s house said that Spiruna had discovered the cause of Orbis's sinking. The Pixies have been absorbing the magic from the enchanted clouds that hold it afloat. Now the #o3230200#, #o4230106#, and #o5120000# monsters have taken #b25 #t4031309##k items needed for maintenance!\n
Just the way the mysterious girl at #p2032001#'s house requested, I gathered up 25 #t4031309#s from the Pixie's and gave them to her.

The key tool used to fix the Orbis clouds is the Cloud Sprayer, but ever since Elma the Housekeeper borrowed it some 50 years ago, the sprayer hasn't been seen since. 50 years, and still no return??? I better go see #bElma the Housekeeper#k.
I met up with Elma and received the #t4031308# that she borrowed 50 years ago. I should go back to Spiruna's house now.

I received the Cloud Sprayer from Elma the Housewife. The cloud fixing should be a breeze now with this in store. This better stop the freefall of Orbis.

string.value: The Ocean View : Kriel's Offer

string.name: parent
string.value: The View of the Ocean

Kriel, a fairy that resides in Orbis, surely has never been underwater before, right? I mean, she has wings that are good for navigating the friendly skies, and definitely not for navigating underwater. Anyway, I should go see Kriel the Fairy.

Kriel, a proud owner of a set of wings, was blowing off travelers that weren't fortunate enough to have wings themselves. I don't think she has a clue that there are numerous breathtaking places that just cannot be reached by flying. According to Lisa, Kriel's not too enthused that she can only hear rumors about Aqua Road and not go there in person. Anyway, Lisa suggested that I buy Kriel 'The Official Aqua Road Photo Album' from #bMuse#k. Muse, huh? Time for a trip underwater... \n\n#i4031310# #t4031310# #b#c4031310##k / 1

I gave Muse 100 snow crystals and purchased the Official Aqua Road Photo Album, then gave it to Kriel for the viewing. After seeing her admit how beautiful Aqua Road is, I must say I felt validated by it, but it also seems like she set the whole thing up for this from the get go. Oh well, at least Kriel's happy, and that's good enough for me.

#p2020006# says that he was attacked by a huge yeti while skiing in the snowy mountains of El Nath. What could have attacked #p2020006#? #b#p2020007##k knows a lot about snowfield creatures. Let's go and ask about them.

Elma finished dolling herself up. You might not recognize her the next time you meet.

string.name: name
string.value: Tale of the Ice Knight
#bGordon#k of El Nath wants to tell you some old story...

#bGordon#k tells you the origin of Ice Knight Battle Mode. He claims it's no fairy tale because #t1072510# are real. He promises to give #t1072510# to anyone who proves themselves.\n\n#rWin Ice Knight mode 10 or more times.#k
Gordon gave you #t1072510#.

string.name: name
string.value: Desolate Castle
A letter came for you, but there isn't a name on it. Go ahead. Give it a read!
#b#p2161012##k, a Silent Crusade agent, wrote the letter and he's trying to investigate the #rLion King's Castle#k. How would you even get there?
The spell cast on the letter teleported you! While you're here, help #b#p2161012##k investigate the Dark Energy that's pouring from the Lion King's Castle.

string.name: name
string.value: The First Spell Breaker
A magical barrier is keeping you outside the Lion King's Castle. There must be a way to break the spell.
The first crux of the spell lies in the #r#o8840002##k on the Roof of the First Tower. Talk to #b#p2161003##k to get the key and go eliminate them.
The first step in breaking the spell is complete! Two more steps remain.

string.name: name
string.value: The Second Spell Breaker
A magical barrier is keeping you outside the Lion King's Castle. There must be a way to break the spell.
The second crux of the spell lies in the #r#o8210006##k on the Roof of the Second Tower. Talk to #b#p2161003##k to get the key and go eliminate them.
The second step in breaking the spell is complete! One last step remains.

string.name: name
string.value: The Final Spell Breaker
A magical barrier is keeping you outside the Lion King's Castle. There must be a way to break the spell.
The final crux of the spell lies in the #r#o8210007##k on the Roof of the Third Tower. Talk to #b#p2161003##k to get the key and go eliminate them.
You broke the spell! Hurry to #b#p2161002##k, the chief knight, to find out what to do next!

string.name: name
string.value: The Lion King's Gatekeeper

You defeated #o8210013#, the ultimate gatekeeper of the Lion King's Castle. The only thing left now is the Lion King himself. However, #p2161002# says you're not strong enough yet. How can you become stronger?

#p2161001#, wife of the Lion King, told you why the Lion King transformed. The only thing left to do is to drag him out of the darkness. However, in order to do so, you'll need to go back to see #b#p2161002##k.
#o8210013# says you'll be able to go through the #rbottom right passage of the #m211061000##k to get to Ani's Jail. Return to #p2161002# if you survive!

string.name: name
string.value: Looking Into the Lion King 1
#b#p2161012##k wants to ask you something. Aren't you just dying to know what it is?!

#b#p2161012##k says that his investigation is being bogged own by powerful monsters and strange warding spells at the Lion King's Castle. Defeat the monsters and make it through the castle, then return to #b#p2161012##k.
Your investigation of the Lion King's Castle went well, but #b#p2161012##k seems to have more favors to ask of you.

string.name: name
string.value: Looking Into the Lion King 2
The of the deep parts of the castle that #p2161012# recommended was a success. You might be able to investigate the Dark Energy now that the castle's magic wards are down.

#p2161012# asked you to find something related to the Dark Energy. Defeat the monsters around the Lion King's Castle and locate enough of the #b#t4033113##k.\n\n#i4033113# #t4033113# #b#c4033113#/200#k
You brought the #t4033113# to #p2161012#. It's exuding a nasty aura, so it must be related to the dark energy.

string.name: name
string.value: Looking Into the Lion King 3
#p2161012# should have completed his research on the #t4033113#. Talk to him and find out.

#p2161012# says he needs a perfect #t4000630# to answer his remaining questions. Eliminate the roaming monsters in the Lion King's Castle and get your hands on enough #b#t4000630##k to use for research.\n\n#i4000630# #t4000630# #b#c4000630#/50#k
All that's left is to wait for #p2161012#'s research results. Could the Lion King's Castle have been consumed by the Dark Energy?

string.name: name
string.value: Looking Into the Lion King 4
Talk to #p2161012# and see how the research is coming along.

#p2161012# needs more evidence of the Dark Energy. Defeat the monsters that are roaming around the Lion King's Castle and find enough #b#t4033119##k to help his research.\n\n#i4033119# #t4033119# #b#c4033119#/10#k
You gave the #t4033119# to #p2161012#. He says he'll be able to reach a conclusion faster if you can bring more.

string.name: name
string.value: Looking Into the Lion King 5
#p2161012#'s research is finally complete! Find out what he knows.

#p2161012# thinks the #b#t4033114##k could be the cause of all of this. Go deep into the Lion King's Castle, defeat the #r#o8210013##k, and bring back the #b#t4033114##k.\n\n#i4033114# #t4033114# #b#c4033114#/1#k
You brought the #t4033114# to #p2161012#. Your contribution may bring some hope to the Lion King's Castle.

string.name: name
string.value: Luden's Gift
#p2161002# seems to have some words of wisdom he'd like to share with you. Whatever he has to say may help you in your future battles. It should be worth a listen.
#p2161002# says you should open up #r#t2430559##k. You've got nothing to lose, so open the Use window and try it out.
In order to become a stronger adventurer after your 4th job advancement, you must upgrade your skills using a #rmastery book#k. Find the mastery book of the skill you wish to advance.

string.name: name
string.value: Luden's Warning 1
#p2161002# seems to have some words of wisdom he'd like to share with you. Whatever he has to say may help you in your future battles. It should be worth a listen.
To learn what #p2161002# wants to teach you, you must have #rat least 1 Lion King's Weapon Scroll#k from #r#t2430558##k. Defeating #o8210013# at Ani's Jail is the only way to get one.
#p2161002# taught you how to obtain a better weapon using this scroll.

To find out what #p2161002# wants to teach you, you must first get #rat least 1 #t2049400# or #t2049401##k from #r#t2430558##k, which you can get by defeating #o8210013# at Ani's Jail.
#p2161002# taught you how to unlock hidden potentials on regular equipment by using the Potential Scroll.

string.name: name
string.value: Title - Heart of a Lion
#p2161002# wants to show his gratitude for defeating the #o8210013# purging the Lion King's Castle of dark energy. Go see him to receive the #b<Heart of a Lion>#k title.
#p2161002# wants to show his gratitude for defeating the #o8210013# purging the Lion King's Castle of dark energy. Go see him to receive the #b<Heart of a Lion>#k title.
#p2161002# thanked you restoring peace to the Lion King's Castle by giving you the #b<Heart of a Lion>#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Snow Crystal
#p2020005# seemed a bit busy. Maybe he's looking for an assistant.
#p2020005# said you need #b30 #t4031311##k items to make the #t4031312#. Apparently you can obtain #t4031311# from a monster called #b#o5300000##k in Orbis Tower...
You brought the 30 #t4031311# items that #p2020005# wanted. #p2020005# is super happy that the #t4031312# can be completed soon, so it was probably worth it.

string.name: name
string.value: Rescue the Residents!
The Lion King's minion, Ani, is kidnapping townspeople.\n\nDefeat Ani and rescue the town residents.
Defeat the minion of Lion King, Ani, and protect the peace in Maple World.

It wasn't as easy as you had expected.

Ani, the prison guard, leaves the castle at the top of every hour from 10 am to 10 pm to patrol. It might be wise to plan an attack once a day.

string.name: name
string.value: The Adventure of Jenn the Locksmith
#p2161003#, the locksmith, seems to have something urgent to tell you from the deep end of El Nath. What could it be?
#p2161003# came to find his brother, but now he's trapped! He needs your help in a castle deep inside El Nath.

#p2161003#, the locksmith, says he was roaming around El Nath in search of his missing brother, and somehow ended up at the castle of the Red Lion King. He says he's surrounded by powerful monsters, so he couldn't rescue his brother. Instead, he has been looking for someone that could help him. But where is this place? And who is the Red Lion King?

string.name: name
string.value: Jenn's Brother
#p2161003#, who has been searching for his brother, is in dire need of help. What is going on at the Red Lion King's castle? First, help #p2161003#.

#p2161003# requested that you rescue his brother, who is held captive on the Roof of the First Tower. Although the gate to the roof of the tower is always locked, #p2161003# can make a key that can open the gate. Use the key to open the gate and rescue #b#t4032831##k.\n\n#i4032831##t4032831# #b#c4032831##k / 1
You have rescued #t4032831# from the roof of the tower. Who kidnapped #t4032831#, and why? What is going on at the Red Lion King's castle?

string.name: name
string.value: Key to the First Tower
#p2161003# promised to stay behind to help others even after his brother was rescued. In order to go to the tower, you must have the #t4032832# that #b#p2161003##k carries.

#p2161003# knows how to make the key, but he's asked you to bring the materials. Defeat #r#o8210000##k and find enough of the #b#t4000625##k items to make the key.\n\n#i4000625# #t4000625# #b#c4000625#/200#k
#p2161003# made you the #t4032832#. Use it to unlock the Roof of the First Tower, and face #o8840002#.

string.name: name
string.value: Key to the Second Tower
#p2161003# promised to stay behind to help others even after his brother was rescued. In order to go to the tower, you must have the #t4032833# that #b#p2161003##k carries.

#p2161003# knows how to make the key, but he's asked you to bring the materials. Defeat #r#o8210001##k or #r#o8210002##k and find enough of the #b#t4000626##k items to make the key.\n\n#i4000626# #t4000626# #b#c4000626#/200#k
#p2161003# made you the #t4032833#. Use it to unlock the Roof of the Second Tower, and face the #o8210006#.

string.name: name
string.value: Key to the Third Tower
#p2161003# promised to stay behind to help others even after his brother was rescued. In order to defeat #o8210007#, you must have the #t4032834# that #b#p2161003##k carries.

#p2161003# knows how to make the key, but he's asked you to bring the materials. Defeat the evil #r#oo8210003##k and its kin to find enough of the #b#t4000627##k items to make the key.\n\n#i4000627# #t4000627# #b#c4000627#/200#k
#p2161003# made you the #t4032833#. Use it to unlock the Roof of the Third Tower, and face the #o8210007#.

string.name: name
string.value: Knight of the Lion King
The Lion King's castle is full of dangerous monsters! What is the owner of such a castle like? And what goes on here? Someone who can answer all these questions is approaching you.

#p2161002# was a knight of a small kingdom a long time ago. Now, he is but a ghost. He is enraged at the corruption of his king, brought on by the Black Mage. If he's involved, then what is the relationship between the Lion King and the Black Mage? Talk to #b#p2161002##k.

Hundreds of years ago, before the Black Mage appeared, there was a small kingdom that was poor but filled with loyalty and compassion. However, the kingdom crumbled, leaving only the Lion King and monsters.

string.name: name
string.value: The Transformed King

This kingdom, once small yet filled with happiness, has suffered a drastic transformation. #p2161002# says the king, who has been corrupted by the Black Mage, must be stopped. Hear what #p2161002# has to say.

#p2161002# says the current king has changed so much that he isn't the same king he once served. He asks that you stop the king, and claims that this is the last act of loyalty he will permit himself.



According to #p2161002#, the Lion King can be found in the Audience Room, located in between the Fourth and Fifth Towers. Before you can enter the Audience Room, however, you must eliminate the nearby #o8210004#. Defeat the #o8210004#.

#o8210004##r #a31691##k
You have weakened the forces of the Black Mage by eliminating the #o8210004#. Perhaps you can enter the Audience Room now?

string.name: name
string.value: The Knight's Magic Scroll

You have defeated the #o8210004#. Now, all you have to do is find the #t2030021#. Ask #b#p2161002##k about the #t2030021#.





#b(Can be completed once a day.)#k

#p2161002# said his scroll was used up and disappeared a long time ago, and suggested that you look for other knights who have turned into #r#o8210005##k with the #t2030021# in their possession. Eliminate the #o8210005#s and find a #b#t2030021##k.

#i4032835##t4032835# #b#c4032835##k/1





#b(Can be completed once a day.)#k

The #t4032835# has been purified by the power of #p2161002#. Double-click the #t2030021# in the Use tab of your Inventory to be taken to the Lion King's Audience Room. Gather some friends and eliminate the Lion King. 





#b(Can be completed once a day.)#k

string.name: name
string.value: Defeat the Lion King
Preparations are complete. It is time to eliminate the Lion King. Talk to #b#p2161002##k.

Head to the Audience Room and defeat the transformed Lion King. He once was a normal warrior, only skilled with the sword, but no one knows what he's capable of now under the influence of the Black Mage. If you're alone, this will be a tough battle.

#o8840000##r #a31711##k

You have defeated Von Leon, the Lion King. However, with the power of the Black Mage preserving him, it is impossible to eliminate him entirely. In addition, according to the Lion King, the forces of the Black Mage are looming closer to Maple World.

string.name: name
string.value: The Weeping Queen
The sound of a woman weeping is coming from the Fifth Tower of the Lion King's castle. Could it be...a ghost? Answer the voice.
#p2161001#... She is saddened because her voice isn't being heard. Who is she? And to whom does she wish to speak? Head to the #bRoof of the Fifth Tower#k and talk to #p2161001#.
The beautiful ghost is #p2161001#, the wife of the Lion King. That means she's the queen of this castle... But even she can't see the Lion King. What kind of person is this Lion King?

string.name: name
string.value: The Mistrustful King
Queen #p2161001# is weeping in her castle, the castle ruled by the transformed Lion King. Who is the Lion King? Has he forgotten about #p2161001#?

#p2161001# wants you to go to the #bAudience Room#k to meet the #bLion King#k, since he doesn't seem to hear her. She'd like you to deliver her message to him. How will the Lion King react to the news of his wife? Use #p2161001# to get to the Lion King.
The Lion King is furious and tells you not to lie, as Queen #p2161001# died a long time ago. Since he hasn't forgotten about #p2161001#, he really must not hear her voice.

string.name: name
string.value: Key to the Rose Garden

The Lion King doesn't seem to believe that Queen #p2161001# has become a ghost. Could that be why he doesn't hear #p2161001#'s voice? What else is there to do? Go back to the #bQueen#k and ask for her advice.

When you tell the Queen how the Lion King reacted, she suggests that he may believe she's a ghost if you bring him a memory that only he and the Queen know. She says to look in the rose garden, which the King made for the Queen. Defeat the #r#o8210004##k and find the key.\n\n#i4032836##t4032836# #b#c4032836##k/1

As soon as she sees the #t4032836#, the Queen becomes very happy. She says she was selling flowers at the market when she met the Lion King, who had secretly escaped the castle. Their love began that day, which led to marriage. Based on the Queen's story, the Lion King seems like a hopeless romantic.

string.name: name
string.value: The Deluded King
Will #p2161000# change his mind when you remind him of his memory with the Queen? Ask Queen #p2161001#.

#p2161001# found the #t4032837# which she made with #p2161000# in the rose garden a long time ago. She is certain that it will change Von Leon's mind. She says he will believe #p2161001# then. Go back to the #bAudience Room#k.

You showed him the #t4032837#, but #p2161000# is angry that you touched his belongings. It doesn't seem like he'll believe anything you say. According to #p2161001#, he was a nice, romantic person. What changed him like this?

string.name: name
string.value: Why Did the King Change?
Why did Von Leon, who was once a warmhearted king, change like this? Why did he become the Black Mage's general? Does #p2161001# know why? Talk to #b#p2161001##k.

#p2161001#, who doesn't remember much about what happened at the time of her death, doesn't seem to know why the Lion King changed like this. Perhaps #p2161002# can explain it to you a little better. Talk to #b#p2161002##k.

The only thing Von Leon wanted for his kingdom was to maintain peace. Hence, he refused to cooperate and get involved with the Alliance and, as a result, lost his kingdom. Furious, he sacrificed his soul to the Black Mage and swore to seek revenge on the Alliance.

string.name: name
string.value: A Frozen Heart
Ultimately, the reason the kingdom of the Lion King fell was not because of the Black Mage, but because of the Alliance. How could this be? Get the details from #b#p2161002##k.

#p2161002# said you should try hunting the #rnearby #o8210005##k if you don't believe what happened with the Alliance. Most are the Lion King's minions, but there are also spies that were sent from the Alliance. He says some of these monsters will drop the #t4032838# item.\n\n#i4032838##t4032838# #b#c4032838##k/10

#p2161002# was right. Does that mean the Red Lion King is the victim here? #p2161002# shook his head when you questioned. He believes that the king should never have joined the Black Mage, no matter his reasons. However, the Lion King's rage doesn't seem entirely unreasonable...

string.name: name
string.value: Is There Any Hope?
The Lion King had been overcome by sadness and rage, which left him no choice but to join the Black Mage and seek revenge. Could his icy cold heart ever return to how it was? Talk to #b#p2161001##k.

#p2161001# seems shocked at the past events that occurred at the castle, though she tries to hide it. She is determined to speak with the King herself and convince him. Use the #bSecret Path#k that only the King and Queen used to confront the Lion King.

Has #p2161001# moved the Lion King's heart? The King never said he would stop helping the Black Mage. However, #p2161001# said there still is good in the Lion King's heart, and that she will do everything it takes to turn him back to the way he was.

string.value: Murt's Letter

#p2161004# says he entered the castle in search of the Lion King's medal, but was cursed by the Lion King, which turned him into a ghost. He asks that you deliver his letter to Alcaster in El Nath.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 47,914\nCan proceed to the 'Men in Black' quest\n
I heard something happened to Korin of Ludibrium... I better go check up on her.

You met a girl named Korin in a small house outside Ludibrium. Korin went missing for 10 months before and claims she doesn't remember anything from that period. She asked you to find the men in black who came to her to find out what had happened. Men in black... They seem to be from the #bOmega Sector#k...

I met Korin, who was suffering from partial loss of memory, at Ludibrium. I was able to meet Agent Marco at the Omega Sector. He's the man wearing the black suit who held the clue regarding her lost memory.

string.name: name
string.value: The Man in the Black Suit

string.name: parent
string.value: Korin's Memory

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 105,411\n5,500 Mesos\n

You met #bAgent M#k in the Omega Sector Safety Zone, and found out that Korin was kidnapped by the aliens that invaded Omega Sector. You were told to eliminate #rMateon#k and bring #b5 #i4031090##t4031090##k items containing Korin's memories back. Go to #bBoswell Field#k as quickly as you can!\n

You eliminated the aliens that stole Korin's memory and brought the Pieces of Memory back to Agent M. He combined the pieces into one, but he can't return it to Korin. It seems she won't be able to get her memory back after all...

string.name: name
string.value: The Recovered Memory

After defeating a bunch of #bMateons#k at the Boswell Field, I went through their stuff and found 5 #bMemory Pieces#k that contained Korin's lost memories. I gave them to Agent Marco, and he proceeded to put the 5 together into one whole piece of #bKorin's Memory#k. Now all I have left to do is give this piece of memory back to Korin.

I gave Korin her lost memories through the man in Omega Sector wearing black suits, #bAgent Marco#k. She was initially disoriented after recovering her memories, but she promised to fully enjoy life the way she used to before the kidnapping. Hopefully that'll never happen again.

string.value: Grandpa Clock's Crisis

string.name: parent
string.value: A Delivery to a Lost Time

You took the Pendulum from the broken Doll's House to the abandoned space under the Ludibrium Clocktower and met a fellow named Grandpa Clock. He can fix the clock in the Clocktower, but the evil #bTick-Tock#k is in his way, and Grandpa Clock's time is running out. Bring him the #bMulti-functional Clock Spring#k before it's too late!
I got the #t4031098# from Tick Tock. I need to get this to the #p2040029# before it's too late.

string.name: name
string.value: Delivering the #t4031094#

At the Lost Time in the Ludibrium Clocktower, I gave #p2040029# the #b#t4031098##k from Tick-Tock's. I'm glad I got to give this to him before too late. Now I should wait to hear a word from #bOlson#k.

At the Lost Time in the Ludibrium Clocktower, I gave #p2040029# the #b#t4031094##k, an essential part of the clocktower. Now all I have to do is wait for the #p2040029# to fix the clocktower. Will this work?

string.name: name
string.value: The Clocktower Headache
I should check on #p2040029#, who is working hard at the Lost Time.

You met Grandpa Clock deep in the halls of Lost Time of Ludibrium. He's bothered by the tiny Ticks that have been going inside the clocktower and destroying parts of it... You must eliminate 80 #bTicks#k at #b#m220040200##k for Grandpa Clock.

I took care of the request #p2040029# made, by taking out the #bTicks#k. The Ticks were another one of the reasons the clocktower seemed to have something wrong at all times, so this should give #p2040029# a good night's sleep.

string.name: name
string.value: The Clock Workers' Batteries
I should check on #p2040029#, who is working hard at the Lost Time.

You met Grandpa Clock again deep in the halls of Lost Time of Ludibrium. Grandpa Clock says he can work on a clock spring, but modern clocks all work on batteries, and many of the Clocktower's clocks have run out of power. #b100 cheap batteries#k should get everything moving again.

I got the cheap batteries needed for the new battery-operated worker clocks. #p2040029# seemed ecstatic over the prospect of those workers finally showing life and lessening his work burden in the process. Anyway, what exactly are they doing in there...?

string.name: name
string.value: Assembling a Toy
I should go see #p2041018# at Toy Factory.

You met #bHans#k who's a toy assembler in the Ludibrium toy factory. Hans offered to make something fun if you give him materials to assemble a toy with. Sounds like fun! You need #b20 Mechanical Hearts#k from #rMaster Robos#k and #b30 Cogs#k from #rChronos#k. #rMaster Robos#k patrol around #b#m220030000##k and #rChronos#k are found near #b#m220040100##k.

At the toy factory in Ludibrium, I gave Hans the parts needed to assemble a toy. Hans put together the parts and made a very unique sack out of it. He said he put some toys inside, but... I don't know, something may pop up that'll scare the daylight out of me. I better be careful with it...

string.name: name
string.value: Rocky's Parts
I better go talk to #p2041019#
At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, I gave Rocky the cogs and screws needed for him to fix anything that is broken. Hopefully that was enough to undo the damages done by those pesky monsters.

You met Rocky the Repairman inside the Ludibrium Clocktower toy factory. Rocky said many parts are needed to fix all the machines broken by monsters. He asked you to bring #b50 Cogs#k from #rChronos#k found near #b#m220040100##k.

string.name: name
string.value: Mac the Mechanic's Maintenance Manual
I'll need to have a word with Mac the Mechanic.

You ran into Mac the Mechanic in the Ludibrium toy factory. He asked you to retrieve the #bMaintenance Manual#k that was stolen by the nearby #rMaster Robo#k. It contains various machine manuals and useful references.
I found the documents Mac the Mechanic lost, and he seemed very much relieved by it. Something's strange, though. Why would the toy soldiers feel the need to steal this in the first place...?

string.name: name
string.value: The Missing Mechanical Parts
Go see Manager Karl in #b#m220020300##k.
Manager Karl asked you to find the missing Toy Factory Machine Parts. You must #btalk to Manager Karl again#k and collect 10 #i4031092##t4031092# items at the Toy Factory <Main Process 1> Area 4.
You found the 10 Machine Parts lost in the Ludibrium Toy Factory and gave them to Manager Karl. Hopefully, the Toy Factory will run more efficiently now.

string.name: name
string.value: Scroll of Life

Somewhere around Ludibrium, I saw a small fairy that was glowing all over her body. Her name was Wisp, and is a part of Mar the Fairy. She saw my pet in a state of doll and claimed that she can turn my doll pet back into a real-life pet with #bwater of life#k and #bMcDonald's#k. The Scroll of Life is apparently at #bCloy's House#k in Ludibrium, which should be empty at this point.

I found the #bscroll of life#k at #bCloy's house#k in Ludibrium. I gave this, along with the #bWater of Life#k, to Wisp and he helped turn my pet back alive. I need to have some play time with my pet now!

string.name: name
string.value: Cleaning Up Helios Tower
With the recent opening of the Helios Tower to travelers, #b#p2041004##k is facing headaches from the influx of #o3210208#...
#p2041004# claims to be seeing a lot more #o3210208##k mice now that Helios Tower is open. Reduce the #r#o3210208##k population in #bHelios Tower#k.
With a request from #p2041004#, the security guard of Ludibrium, I went into Helios Tower and eliminated 20 #o3210208#s, the striped rats that have been destroying the elevators at the tower.

Ratz #r#a32421##k
Black Ratz #r#a32422##k
Ratz #r#a32423##k

string.value: Disgruntled Roly-Poly Worker
#b#p2040005##k of #b#m221022800##k is always skipping lunch because of work.

#p2040005# has a problem with the #o3210205# mob that has taken over Eos Tower. He hasn't had lunch in a long time because of it. Reduce the #r#o3210205##k population by #r20#k and bring him #b5 #t4000096##k.
#p2040005# finally got a lunch!

string.value: Spider's Out at Eos Tower

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 19,425\r\n15,000 Meso\r\nFame 1
The King's #b#p2041022##k is in need of help. What must it be? I better head over to #b#m220000400##k.

#p2041022# received orders to deliver the King's Royal Letter to #m221000000#, but he's having a little spider problem at Eos Tower. Go take out #r20 each#k of the #r#o2230103##k and #r#o2230104##k bugs in #b#m221022500##k and #b#m221022600##k so he can get through.
I was able to eliminate #o2230103# and #o2230104#. I'm sure now #p2041022# can do his job. I thought #p2041022# was unafraid of anything else in life besides the King. Spiders? That was unexpected...

string.name: name
string.value: A Mysterious Letter
#b#p2041004##k of #b#m220000000##k is concerned about a mysterious letter... what could it be?

#p2041004# said he's been concerned about a mysterious, anonymous letter sent to the king of #m220000000#, and believes something huge is developing. He then asked me to head over to #b#m100030000##k and find out who wrote the letter...

There's a huge wooden entryway leading into #m100030000# which I'd never seen before. It almost looks like an entryway to a fortress... I should try talking to #p1094000#, who was standing in front of me. I remember him telling me that a #bpirate #p1072008##k fort is being built here. I wonder who the captain is...

string.name: name
string.value: Rightful Donation Culture
I should go to #b#m220000000##k and listen in on #b#p2041022##k's problem.

#b#m220000000##k #b#p2041022##k's problem was more difficult than I imagined. It's hard enough finding a #b#t04021005##k, but to freely donate it to the king of #b#m220000000##k!? But if it's true that every great adventurer must learn to generously donate, maybe I need to consider donating as well. 
Plus, according to #b#p2041022##k, the king is a very generous person so it will probably be used to help those in need... This is stressful.

I don't know if I made the right decision, but I gave away #b#t04021005##k to #b#p2041022##k. I feel like I've somewhat wasted it but I guess it does feel good to know that I've helped someone in need. Overall, it was a good experience.

You brought the pile of stuff back to #p2040009# and he looked really excited.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 88,046\r\nFame 1

string.name: name
string.value: A Deal with the Broker

There's a new, unknown and mysterious town called #m261000000#. It's an alchemist town, which explains the mysterious aura around it... I better go see #b#p2111007##k to gain some information on #m261000000#.

When I asked #p2111007# about #m261000000#, he requested #b10,000 mesos#k for information, as if it's an accepted practice. Is he really a broker...? Come to think of it, #p2111007#'s reputation isn't that great either...what do I have to lose?

After giving #p2111007# 10,000 mesos, I was able to obtain some information on #m261000000#. A long time ago, after the death of the Black Magician, the alchemists came together and set up a town called #m261000000#. Nowadays, the town is split into #b2 societies, Zenumist and Alcadno. They seem to be in constant conflict with one another.#k

string.name: name
string.value: Test from the Head of Zenumist Society

string.name: parent
string.value: Joining Zenumist

Bourne of a true union of science and magic... #bZenumist, is a society of pure alchemy#k. With the conflict raging in #m261000000#, however, Zenumist doesn't seem to accept outsiders. I really want to join them, though... I better go see #b#p2111007##k.

#p2111007# told me in order to join Zenumist, I'll have to run the rigorous test of showing my lab results to the president of the Zenumist Society. But he also said if I can get him #b2 ores of jewels, regardless of type#k, then he'd take care of the rest...
After giving #p2111007# 2 ores, he told me to wait. I hope I get in!

string.name: name
string.value: Zenumist Cape

string.name: parent
string.value: Joining Zenumist

After visiting the Broker once more, he gave me a bottle that contained some strange-looking water. He then told me to take it to #bZenumist Society#k, and place it next to the blue alchemy pillar, which will automatically create the item for me. He then told me to give it to #b#p2111000##k... is the broker really telling the truth? Seems impossible...

When I left #t4031705# next to the alchemy pillar, I heard a deafening explosion, followed by the creation of a useless tree branch. I had no idea what that was, but I gave it to #p2111000#. He seemed VERY satisfied with the result, and gave me #b#t1102135##k in return. Why would he want a tree branch?

string.name: name
string.value: Test from the Head of Alcadno Society

string.name: parent
string.value: Joining Alcadno

A true union of alchemy and mechanical engineering, #bAlcadno, is a society that celebrates new alchemy#k. With the conflict raging in #m261000000#, however, Alcadno doesn't seem to accept others. I really want to join Alcadno, though... I better go talk to #b#p2111007##k.

#p2111007# told me in order to join the Alcadno Society, I'll have to compile a series of lab reports and present it. He said he could obtain a legitimate report if I pay him #b2 ores, regardless of type#k. He'd then take care of the rest...
After giving #p2111007# 2 ores of jewels, he told me to wait.

string.name: name
string.value: Alcadno Cape

string.name: parent
string.value: Joining Alcadno

I received #t4031704# from the broker. I was told to give it to #p2111001# and answer the questions in the order that the broker told me in order to become a member of Alcadno... I better remember the sequences that #p2111007# gave me when I go see #p2111001#.

After a number of tough, tough questions, #p2111001# finally accepted me as a member of Alcadno. Flashing his trademark glass eye as he gave me #t1102136#, the head of the Alcadno Society may look intimidating, but he's a really nice person.

string.name: name
string.value: Re-acquiring Zenumist Cape
I lost #t1102135#. Without it, I can't prove that I'm Zenumist. What should I do? I better go talk to the president of the Zenumist Society, #b#p2111000##k.

#p2111000# gave me that look of disappointment as he asked me to bring the items required to make another #t1102135#. Those items are #b#t4000021##k and #b#t4021003##k, with #b10,000 mesos#k. Thank goodness I can make another one. 

#i4000021##t4000021# #b#c4000021##k/10 
#i4021003##t4021003# #b#c4021003##k/5
I got #t1102135# again. Without it, I can't be accepted as a Zenumist. I better not lose it again.

string.name: name
string.value: Re-acquiring Alcadno Cape
Oh no...! I lost #t1102136#, the one item that proves that I'm a member of Alcadno. What should I do? I better go talk to the president of the Alcadno Society, #p2111001#.
I got Alcadno Cape again. Without it, I can't be accepted as an Alcadno. I better not lose it again.
#p2111001# says he can make you the cape if you bring him the materials. As long as he can make it, that's no problem! You just need #b#t4000021##k and #b10,000 Mesos#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Helping Out Bedin
#b#p2111008##k, an alchemist from Zenumist, seems to be looking for help with his experiment...

#p2111008# told me he was short on some items for his experiment and asked me to get #b5 refined #t4010004#s#k and #b50 #t4000352#s#k for him.

#i4010004##t4010004# #b#c4010004##k/5 
#i4000352##t4000352# #b#c4000352##k/50
I gave #p2111008# #t4011004# and #t4000352#. This #t4011004# seems to have a peculiar power of registering spells into it. I learned something new today.

string.name: name
string.value: Getting in the Way of Alcadno
#b#p2111008##k, an alchemist from Zenumist, seems to have a plan in store. Now that I'm Zenumist, I should help him out, right? I better go see #p2111008# immediately.

Zenumist is in conflict with Alcadno... I knew that fact, but I never thought he'd ask me for a favor like this! Anyway, since #p2111008# made the request, I better follow through with it, or I may be in trouble. I'll have to destroy #r200 #o5110300#k that Alcadnos have been working on. \n\n#o5110300# #r#a33081#
I destroyed the #o5110300#s that Alcadnos have been working on, at the request of #p2111008#. Hmmm... Was I allowed to do this? Why do Zenumist and Alcadno have such a huge conflict between them?

string.name: name
string.value: An Incident, and the Missing Alchemist
#b#p2111008##k, the alchemist from Zenumist, seems to need me for something else. What must it be this time? I better go see #p2111008#.

Bedin told me to enter the lab of Alcadno when no one is present, and steal the #b#t4031708##k for him. Apparently, it can be found on top of the table at #b#m261020700##k... but in order to get to #m261020700#, I'll have to use the portal from #m261020600#. Since all the lights are off at the lab, I'll have to really search for the document in the dark... \n\n#i4031708##t4031708# #b#c4031708##k/1

An incident from long ago. It all started with a flawed experiment from an alchemist. The failure brought a massive explosion, and the accompanying earthquake destroyed many parts of Magatia. The Magic Pentagram that was destroyed left the Homun into a rage ever since. To make matters worse, the alchemist responsible for this seems to have gone missing...

string.name: name
string.value: Carson's Experiment

string.name: parent
string.value: Zenumist and the Missing Alchemist

I found out through Bedin about the incident that happened a long time ago, and there are two people who hold the final clues. One is the missing alchemist himself; the other is the president of the society! Seems like he knows something about the missing alchemist...

Carson told me if I wanted to know more about the incident, then I'll have to prove him my worth, by entering the #bclosed-off lab#k where #rHomun#k is, and acquire the Magic Control Device and control the monsters through that. Once I throw the device into the Pentagram of Alchemy in the lab, the monsters can be controlled in an instant, and then I'll need to bring back #b#t4031709##k as evidence... \n\n#i4031709##t4031709# #b#c4031709##k/1
After I told him I successfully controlled Homunculi, that's when the president started discussing serious matters with me.

string.name: parent

I entered #m261020401# without really thinking too much about it... As usual, #b#p2111006##k the talkative ghost starts up a conversation. I don't really want to listen to him go on and on about his life. What should I do?
When I asked about #p2111002#'s past that I saw through him in the past, Parwen's face lit up and showed me #p2111002# again. Hmmm... He looks like a bit of time has passed since I last saw him...

I tried to start up a conversation with an obviously tired #p2111002#. His face may have the look of exhaustion, but he managed to smile just a bit. He may have failed the experiment, but he said he has succeeded in creating a new medicine for #p2111005#...

string.name: name
string.value: De Lang's Potion

string.name: parent
string.value: Who is De Lang?

#p2111002# confessed his research hasn't taken steps forward these days, but then he lightened up and told me he found a cure for #p2111005#... What? #bA medicine for #p2111005##k? But everything in #p2111002#'s house seemed to have been cleaned out. \n\nIf he didn't try so darndest to hide this, then someone from Alcadno that might have gotten through #p2111002#'s Lab Report. I better go see #b#p2111001##k of Alcadno, since he searched #p2111002#'s whole house.
When I told #p2111001# of #p2111002#, he seemed genuinely shocked.

string.name: name
string.value: The Memories of Humanoid A

string.name: parent
string.value: Who is De Lang?

#p2111001# seemed to think long and hard about #p2111002#'s research, then said maybe #b#p2111003##k might know something about the medicine. #p2111003#? The one who can't even remember his past? How??
When I asked #p2111003# about #p2111002#, he had no clue who he was. However, he did mention something about this medicine that he held on from the moment he opened his eyes.

string.name: name
string.value: Who is De Lang?

string.name: parent
string.value: Who is De Lang?

I explained to #p2111003# that the medicine might cure #p2111005#, and received the medicine from him. I did bring this half suspecting this might be a scam, but really... is it enough to cure #p2111005#? The president of Alcadno Society, #b#p2111001##k, might correctly find out the list of ingredients for this.
#p2111001# said this medicine indeed cures #p2111005#'s sickness... Why in the world was #p2111003# holding on to the medicine #p2111002# made all this time??

string.name: name
string.value: De Lang and Humanoid A

string.name: parent
string.value: Who is De Lang?

#p2111001#'s eyes normally scare me off, but his eyes seem sad today. According to him, #p2111003# was found at #p2111002#'s lab when the lab exploded because of the failed experiment. No one knows when or how it was made... and Humanoid himself doesn't remember his origins. \n\nMaybe #p2111002#'s experiment didn't fail as everyone believes... the one item that #p2111003# is holding on to, despite not remembering anything from the past, says it all. I better go to #b#p2111005##k and give her #p2111002#'s piece of mind.

#p2111005# seemed stunned when receiving the medicine, but then turned into pure joy and happiness. #p2111005# seemed determined to get better with the medicine, so she can really improve her alchemy skills to one day turn #p2111003# into a human being. Hopefully her experiment will end up being successful.

string.name: name
string.value: Parwen's Pass

string.name: parent
string.value: The Secret, Quiet Passage
#p2111006# is the chatty ghost at the basement lab of #m261000000#. Apparently, he knows a secret passage in #m261000000# that no one is aware of... I better go talk to #b#p2111006##k.

#p2111006# said that a long time ago, when he was an alchemist at #m261000000#, he had a #bpass#k that gave him access to the secret passage that connects Zenumist to Alcadno. ...a Secret Passage? That sounds very interesting! #t4031745# believed that #rCytis#k might have taken it, so I'll have to find the pass myself and use it at the entrance of the Secret Passage.\n\n#i4031745##t4031745# #b#c4031745##k/1
I brought #t4031745# to the entrance of the Secret Passage, but the door didn't open. What the...

string.name: name
string.value: Searching for the Master Key

string.name: parent
string.value: The Secret, Quiet Passage

I told #p2111006# that his pass was useless, and he told me that since it's such an old pass, that its verification code might have expired. Why did I put so much hope into this? But, says #p2111006#, he will do everything in his power to give me an entry to the Secret Passage, and asked me to find #b100 #t4000363#s#k from #r#o6110301##k.\n\n#i4000363##t4000363# #b#c4000363##k/100
I fell for #p2111006#'s promise, and got 100 #t4000363#s from #o6110301#. That's when #p2111006# started making new combination of verification codes out of the #t4000363#s.

string.name: name
string.value: Verifying the Password

string.name: parent
string.value: The Secret, Quiet Passage

#p2111006# said he came up with the master code that'll allow me to gain free access to the Secret Passage, and gave me a long list of numbers. Sigh... this is so complicated, I'll have to write it down somewhere.
When I entered the master key #p2111006# gave me, the Secret Passage opened up, and now I have unlimited access to the passage. Hmm... He's much more helpful than I thought.

string.name: name
string.value: Zenumist and the Ostracized Research
Apparently, #b#p2111008##k, an alchemist from Zenumist, wants something...

#p2111008# mentioned that there was an alchemist that has been ostracized by everyone for trying to combine the works of Zenumist and Alcadno, #b#p2112014##k, and he was interested in obtaining the Lab Report. He wanted me to acquire #b#t4031774##k for him, and in order to do so, I'll have to find someone that is aware of #p2112014#'s current whereabouts... \n\n#i4031774##t4031774# #b#c4031774##k/1
I acquired #t4031774# and gave it to #p2111008#. Peering through the results, Bedin's eyes were flashing with interest.

string.name: name
string.value: Alcadno and the Ostracized Research
Apparently, #bRussellon#k, an alchemist from Alcadno, wants something...

Russellon mentioned that there was an alchemist that has been ostracized by everyone for trying to combine the works of Zenumist and Alcadno, #bYulete#k, and he was interested in obtaining the Lab Report. He wanted me to acquire #b#t4031774##k for him, and in order to do so, I'll have to find someone that is aware of #p2112014#'s current whereabouts... \n\n#i4031796##t4031796# #b#c4031796##k/1

I was able to find Yulete's Lab Report, and gave it to Russellon. According to him, Yulete's studies were released at the height of the conflict between Zenumist and Alcadno, and mentioned that if he released it at an opportune time, then he could have received a much more favorable response.

string.name: name
string.value: Studying Frankenroid 1

string.name: parent
string.value: Keeny's Research on Frankenroid
Magatia's diminutive Fairy alchemist, #bKeeny#k, is lately studying hard on mechanical dolls, Roids.

Keeny said she heard a rumor that the mysterious alchemist #bYulete#k invented a new type of Roid, and wanted to study more on his Frankenroid. Good thinking, except finding Yulete, who has been virtually banished from Magatia, and actually #btalking#k to him might be difficult...
While helping Romeo and Juliet out, I was able to learn of Yulete's true intentions and was able to meet with him.

string.name: name
string.value: Studying Frankenroid 2

string.name: parent
string.value: Keeny's Research on Frankenroid

Yulete seemed ecstatic to help Keeny out. Then he proceeded to bring out the well-organized blueprint of Frankenroid and told me to tell her if she had any questions, she's more than welcome to ask him herself. I better give this blueprint to #bKeeny#k.
After receiving the blueprint of Frankenroid, Keeny seemed beyond words. She felt like this would really help her make Humanoid A's wish come true.

string.name: name
string.value: Yulete's Request

For a while, he was so jaded that he wanted to take on Magatia all by himself, but now that someone recognized and appreciated his greatness, Yulete seems to finally find some peace in himself... I better find #bYulete#k, who might be hiding somewhere in #bMagatia#k.

Yulete made a promise that from here on out, instead of conducting experiments to be accepted by others, he's going to do it for his own satisfaction. Conducting these studies and experiments alone seems a little difficult, though. I better help Yulete out. #k

#y3366# #b (#u3366#)#k
#y3367# #b(#u3367#)#k
#y3368# #b(#u3368#)#k

I was able to really help Yulete complete his experiments. He may not have been universally accepted by his peers, but he's indeed a genius alchemist. An alchemist like him is more than capable of raising the bar of alchemy in Magatia much higher.

string.name: name
string.value: Making the Reagent
To help Yulete out, I volunteered to assist him on his research. What can I do for him? I better go see #bYulete#k.

Yulete asked me to help him #bmake the Reagent#k. I'll need to pour the prepared liquid in the beaker and make the reagent, but I heard that the liquids have to be poured in sequence. .. And the sequence is #bred, green, yellow, blue, and purple#k! Let's make this. \n\n#i4031798##t4031798# #b#c4031798##k/1
After successfully making the reagent, I reported the results to Yulete. He thanked me for helping him with something that he considered was a difficult task.

string.name: name
string.value: Organizing the Lab Report
To help Yulete out, I volunteered to assist him on his research. What can I do for him? I better go see #bYulete#k.

Yulete asked me to organize his Lab Report. At his #bLab 2#k, there are so many reports that he had written that have been spread out all over the place that it needs to be organized in the worst way. I better start gathering up some #breports#k. \n\n#i4031797##t4031797# #b#c4031797##k/20
I gathered up the reports and gave to Yulete. Organizing all these reports will keep Yulete busy for a while.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminating Obstacles
To help Yulete out, I volunteered to assist him on his research. What can I do for him? I better go see #bYulete#k.
Yulete asked me to eliminate the monsters that stand in his way of conducting experiments. It seems like the monsters he created from the past have come back to haunt him. \n\n#o9300153# #r#a33681##k
I was able to eliminate all the monsters that were of hindrance to Yulete in the lab. Yulete breathed a sigh of relief that he can now use that lab.

string.name: name
string.value: Romeo's Present

string.name: parent
string.value: Romeo's Flowers
Romeo had finally received the okay to date Juliet, but he had been hard at work researching. Has he been dating well? Let's check up on #bRomeo#k.

Romeo was still worried about what to get her, so I advised him to get Juliet a flower. Like a true alchemist, Romeo thought of the Snowfield Rose and asked me to help him get one. Thankfully, he knew how to make the seeds, so all I need to do is get the #bMay Mist#k. \n\n#i4000361##t4000361# #b#c4000361##k/20
I found the Snowfield Rose and gave it to Romeo. Romeo told me to wait as he wants to finalize the process himself, with all his heart.

string.name: name
string.value: Romeo's Flowers

string.name: parent
string.value: Romeo's Flowers

Romeo was able to complete the making of Snowfield Rose, but he's terribly shy. So shy that he was too terrified to give the flower to #bJuliet#k himself, and asked me to deliver the flower to her for him. I didn't know he was like this...
I gave Juliet Romeo's flower. Thankfully, she seemed very satisfied with the choice of the present. Good thing he didn't give her something like a Scorpion Needle.

string.name: name
string.value: Juliet's Feelings

string.name: parent
string.value: Juliet's Response
Juliet received a Snowfield Rose with Romeo's true feelings laden in it. I better go see her and see how she feels about the present.

Juliet was so happy about Romeo's Present that she wanted to give Romeo something in return. After taking some time wondering what would be the perfect present for him, she decided to... make him some clothes. She's an alchemist... how will she make clothes for him? Anyway, since Juliet asked for help, I'll need to see #bSirin#k of #bAriant#k.
When I told Sirin of Juliet's story, she told me to wait for a second. She didn't seem to be sweating it one bit.

string.name: name
string.value: Sirin's Tailoring Methods

string.name: parent
string.value: Juliet's Response

Sirin was more than happy to accommodate, by giving me the pattern to the nicest clothes she has in store. So all I need to do is give this to Juliet? Hmmm... Something tells me this might not end up the way I planned. Anyway, I better give #bJuliet#k the patterns first.
After giving Juliet the pattern, she jumped for joy. That's the good part. Can she really make the clothes based on the pattern, though?

string.name: name
string.value: Juliet's Response

string.name: parent
string.value: Juliet's Response

Juliet was able to make the clothes. It was very well-made, actually. She must be good with her hands. There's one slight problem, though... I wonder if she'll really give it to Romeo, because it is DEFINITELY FOR WOMEN!! I knew something wasn't right. Despite the concerns, Juliet asked me to give this 'dress' to #bRomeo#k.
Romeo seemed very happy to receive the clothes that Juliet made for him. Seriously, is he going to wear that dress with the pink ribbon on? Alchemists are really strange, that's for sure.

string.name: name
string.value: Writing Romeo's Letter

string.name: parent
string.value: Romeo's Love Letter

Romeo is an alchemist from Magatia. I don't know about his alchemy skills, but his dating skills leave a lot to be desired, and he seems to be really concerned about that as well. I'll need to talk to #bRomeo#k.
Romeo wanted to write a love letter to Juliet that conveyed his true feelings towards her, but he seemed to be struggling with words. I'll have to come up with something very creative for Romeo...
Struggling, but slowly making progress with the letter, Romeo sure is trying to impress Juliet. I wonder how the letter will end up.

string.name: name
string.value: Romeo's Love Letter

string.name: parent
string.value: Romeo's Love Letter
After finally completing the letter, Romeo asked me if I could deliver the letter to #bJuliet#k for him. What am I, their loyal servant???
After receiving Romeo's heartfelt letter, Juliet shed a tear of joy. I don't understand how that letter brought her to tears, but...

string.name: name
string.value: Juliet is Impressed

string.name: parent
string.value: Juliet's Lunchbox
Juliet seemed very much in love with Romeo after receiving the letter, which meant one thing. Juliet wants to repay the love with a present of her own. I better go see #bJuliet#k.

Juliet decided the best way to respond to the letter was to cook for him by making a lunchbox. ...A lunchbox by an alchemist from Alcadno... I better help her make one before Juliet poisons Romeo to death with her toxic cooking skills. I better buy the #blunchbox recipe#k from #bHan the Broker#k. \n\n#i4031785##t4031785# #b#c4031785##k/1
I handed Juliet Han the Broker's recipe for lunchbox.

string.name: name
string.value: Han the Broker's Recipe
I better stop Juliet before she accidentally poisons Romeo with her toxic cooking skills. I'll need to hurry up and see #bHan the Broker#k so I can buy a recipe for a nice food from him.

Han the Broker was noticeably complaining, and told me if I wanted his #blunchbox recipe#k, then I'll have to fork over #b20,000 mesos#k. That's really pricey, but he's the only way I can acquire the recipe here in Magatia...
I got the recipe from Han the Broker. This recipe also gives me this uneasy feeling. This time, it's not the contents, but the broker himself that worries me...

string.name: name
string.value: Juliet's Lunchbox

string.name: parent
string.value: Juliet's Lunchbox

Juliet's Lunchbox is now complete. It doesn't look all that great, but... seriously, she made this for Romeo, a person she dearly loves, so come on, it can't be toxic, right? Whatever happens to him, I'm sure the great alchemists in Magatia can save him. I'm worried about the lunchbox, but I better still give this to #bRomeo#k.
Romeo seemed very ecstatic to receive the lunchbox. Hopefully he won't die on me.

string.name: name
string.value: Romeo Proposes
Romeo is an alchemist in Magatia that's currently dating Juliet like there's no tomorrow. He has finally decided to pop the question to Juliet. I better go visit #bRomeo#k.

Romeo told me although he may not be perfect, he's sure that Juliet will understand and take him regardless, and that's how he came to conclusion to propose to her. He then asked me to find a perfect engagement ring for her. The ring can be purchased at #bWedding Village#k through #bAllegro#k.\n\n#i4031806##t4031806# #b#c4031806##k/1

I got the engagement ring and gave it to Romeo. Now, all he has to do is come up to her and propose successfully. They may be an odd couple, but they do fit like a glove. Hopefully their love will come to fruition.

string.name: name
string.value: Allegro, the Master of the Rings
Romeo had decided to propose to Juliet. To help facilitate that, I better get him a nice ring. The ring can be acquired through Allegro, the master of rings at Wedding Village.

Allegro said the perfect ring for Romeo and Juliet might be the Silver Wing Ring that represents purity, and asked me to gather up the materials for him. 

#i4021007##t4021007# #b#c4021007##k/2 
#i4011004##t4011004# #b#c4011004##k/2
I received the ring from Allegro. I better give this to #bRomeo#k now.

string.name: name
string.value: The Unidentified Group
#b#m261000000##k's #b#p2111007##k seems to be concerned about something. What must that be? I better go see #p2111007#.

#p2111007# said recently, someone purchased an inordinate amount of jewels and machinery, so much so that he wanted to make sure who that person might be that made the massive order. These items seemed to have been shipped to #b#m100030000##k...

At #m100030000#, I saw a tree entrance that had not been seen before. It looked like an entrance to a fort... So when I tried to speak to #p1094000#, who was standing in front of the entrance, he said a new fort for #bPirate #p1072008##k is currently being built.

string.name: name
string.value: Yulete's Reward
#b#p2112014##k, a genius alchemist who isn't universally accepted but deserved to be, may know what #t4001159# and #t4001160# are for. I better go talk to #p2112014#.

After carefully examining #t4001159# and #t4001160#, #p2112014# stated that #bby combining the marbles that contain the essence of the two studies, he can actually form a whole new power that encompasses them all#k. I have a feeling that the materials required for this might be extensive... I better get #t4001159# and #t4001160# first.
Only #p2112014# might be capable of combining the two distinctive styles of work like Zenumist and Alcadno and make something out of it.

string.name: name
string.value: Moren's Upset

string.name: parent
string.value: Gordon Passes His Magic

Keol and Ramain have been concerned lately because Moren seemed to be letting out a heavy sigh every other minute. They may not try to show it, but the two are struggling right now, so for the sake of these three, I better ask Moren what's up.

Gordon's Secret Technique! This is something I didn't even see coming. A secret technique that even the creator of the Maker skill cannot execute. Moren had high expectations that this technique would further advance the Maker skill. I decided to visit Gordon in El Nath without notifying Moren. Who knows, I might be the one learning that skill instead.

After calmly answering Gordon's questions, I was able to have this rolling in no time. Gordon at first seemed taken aback that the very existence of the technique had been exposed, but seemed to have gotten over it quickly. He then made a proposition where if I pass his test, then he'll share his technique with me. I wonder what that test is...

string.name: name
string.value: Gordon's Magic Iron

string.name: parent
string.value: Gordon Passes His Magic

Just as Gordon says, being a great craftsman requires patience and stamina. Gordon then gave me a test where he assigned me to gather up some Jr. Yeti Skins, which are also used as primary materials for shoemaking. I wonder what that secret technique is... I better come back ASAP.\n\n#i04000048# #t04000048# #b#c04000048##k / 50

I finally found the secrets to Gordon's technique! Well, the important aspects here are the two types of Magic Pentagrams that's used to create a new scroll, and the Magic Iron that helped press them. The Magic Iron that Gordon gave me... it seemed like it had some sort of a story behind it, but I was not able to listen to it in detail. I should ask him about that the next time I see him.\nAccording to Gordon, when summoning the Maker skill, when I have the Magic Iron equipped in my hand, then I'll be able to create new scrolls.

string.name: name
string.value: Gordon's Warm Heart

Oh my gosh... I wound up losing #b#t1122013##k! I swear I kept it with me, but while I looked away, I wound up... misplacing it. Sigh, there's nothing I can do, I better just visit #b#p2020002##k and tell him what happened. Do I really have to go to #b#m211000100##k and face the music?

He knew I had misplaced it? He picked it up from the streets? I was shocked to hear what #b#p2020002##k told me. Honestly, losing it really made me feel guilty about it, but at least it's back in my hands now! Phew... I'll need to start another conversation with him.

I really didn't see it coming. I was totally unaware that he had left #b#m211000100##k and was watching me from the back... thankfully, #p2020002# had the item with him, and he just gave me back the item without much of a lecture. I felt so bad and embarrassed that I vowed never to misplace the item ever again.

string.name: name
string.value: Chief Stan's Letter
Chief Stan wants to ask me for something... I wonder what it is...

I met with #bChief Stan#k, who was at Henesys in Victoria Island. He handed me what appeared to be an old, sealed letter, and wanted me to deliver it to Dr. Kim of Omega Sector. He said to get to Omega Sector. I'll need to first get on board a ship from Ellinia to Orbis, followed by the ride to Ludibrium from there.

I met Dr. Kim at Omega Sector, and handed him the #bsealed letter#k that Chief Stan gave me. This place seems to be full of facilities designed in anticipation of the alien invasion... I should talk to Dr. Kim whenever I have a chance...

Dr. Kim gave me a mission to show Chury the blueprint of the new robot that he's currently making, and I did just that. Chury seemed impressed by it.
