I met up with Gunny at a field around Omega Sector, handed him his #bLaser gun#k, and showed him the #bBlueprint Machine#k. Gunny appreciated my effort and requested that I report this all to Dr. Kim. This Command Center warp capsule seems like a useful item.

As Dr. Kim requested from the Command Center in the Omega Sector, I showed the blueprint of the new robot to Chury, Hoony, and Gunny, while simultaneously solving their problems. Dr. Kim was very pleased with the results, and wanted me to drop by again sometime, for he could use my help.

string.name: name
string.value: An Important Robotic Part

string.name: parent
string.value: Supplying the Robotic Parts
I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.

From the Command Center in the Omega Sector, Dr. Kim requested that I receive 3 important mechanical parts from Cheng the Assistant at the Toy Factory of Ludibrium. Man ... when am I going to find time to go all the way up to Ludibrium?
Dr. Kim of the Command Center in the Omega Sector gave me a mission to receive some stuff from Cheng the Assistant of the Toy Factory. The parts I received seem to be very important for something.

string.name: name
string.value: Delivering the Robotic Parts

string.name: parent
string.value: Supplying the Robotic Parts

I met with Cheng the Assistant at the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, and he handed me 3 boxes full of robotic parts, which will be used to make the robot. Now I should just hand them over to Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.

At the Toy Factory in Ludibrium, Cheng the Assistant gave me 3 boxes of robotic parts so I could deliver them to Dr. Kim of the Command Center in the Omega Sector. After delivering the goods to Dr. Kim, he gave me a Warp Capsule, which will enable me to transport to Ludibrium in an instant. Hmmm... This looks like something I can use!

string.name: name
string.value: Retrieving the Robotic Parts
I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.

I met with Dr. Kim again at the Command Center. Dr. Kim was furious over the fact that someone stole 3 boxes full of robotic parts. He requested that I check into the hidden place at the Boswell Field, break all the Alien boxes, and recover the 3 missing boxes.

#t4031141# #b#c4031141##k/1
#t4031142# #b#c4031142##k/1
#t4031143# #b#c4031143##k/1
I retrieved the 3 boxes full of robotic parts that were stolen by the Aliens, and gave them back to Dr. Kim at the Command Center. This should speed up the development of the new robot.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminating Aliens
I should go see Dr. Kim at the Command Center in the Omega Sector.

Dr. Kim in the Omega Sector Command Center asked you to take care of #b#p2050001##k in Boswell Field. His new robot isn't finished yet, so it's up to you. Find the hiding place of #rMachine MT-09#k through the hidden entrance in #b#m221030600##k and eliminate #r5#k of them.
I managed to eliminate all 5 MT-09's that Dr. Kim of the Command Center requested. I really hope that the new robot is made soon, so I don't have to ever do this again.

string.name: name
string.value: Where is Dogon's HQ?
I should go see Chury of Omega Sector.

I met with Chury at the Silo of the Omega Sector again, and he requested that I find a secret base of an apparent alien-worshipper. I'll need to find Dogon's HQ, which is hidden somewhere around the Fields nearby Omega Sector, find #bDogon's Report#k from the box at the Dogon's HQ, and give them to Chury.

I gave Chury, who was waiting for me at the Silo of the Omega Sector, the #bDogon's Report#k that I found from Dogon's secret base. I can't believe someone is actually helping aliens... now THAT's quite shocking.

string.name: name
string.value: Hoony's Toothache

string.value: EXP 341,600\r\nCan proceed to 'Barrier' quest\r\n
I received permission from #p2140000#, but once I went deep inside the temple, something was stopping me and I couldn't go further. What did I lose this time? I should go see #b#p2140000##k.

#p2140000# scratched his head and said he didn't know what happened this time. He said unless I lost my Oblivion, which doesn't make sense, there should be no reason I can't pass through the Road to Oblivion . \n\nHe suggested that maybe the #bGoddess' Promise#k has been broken and told me to go see #b#p2140003##k to check the records of the promise.

I met with #p2140003#. He said he was waiting for me and began explaining things to me as if he already knew what happened. He said that the blessing of the Goddess of Time will never disappear or be taken away, and it was still valid... However, he said that there is another reason why I can't go deep into the temple.

When you told #p2140003# everything you heard from #p2140000#, he seemed to figure something out. The temple is being blocked by an #routside force#k! #p2140000# thinks that the #rforce field was set by an intruder#k. You'll need the power of the guardians of each past in order to break the force field and find the perpetrator!
I brought him all the items. The Keeper of the Temple gave me a marble with special powers, and said that I should be able to break the force field with this...

string.name: name
string.value: Breaking the Force Field
I wanted to go deep inside the temple, but I couldn't because of the intruder's force field. I should try making the item that can destroy the force field with help from #p2140000#.

In order to make the #t4032002#, the item that can destroy the force field, you need #b10 Smiley Masks, 10 #t4000451#s, 10 #t4000456#s, and 1 of each of the following: #t4000460#, #t4000461# and #t4000462##k. All these items are only found in the Temple of Time.
When I brought all the ingredients to #p2140000#, he made me the #t4032002#. Now I should be able to go deep inside the temple again.

string.name: name
string.value: Beyond the Ruins
#p2140000# made the intruder's force field ineffective. What was this intruder planning to do? I should ask #b#p2140000##k.

#p2140000# said that he has no idea what the intruder wanted especially when there's nothing but a ruin deep in the temple and nothing to take from the Path of Past. 'Perhaps the #rMirror of the Goddess#k...?' he mumbled and then shook his head and said 'no way...'. But just in case, he told me to go past #b#m270040000#, to #m270050000##k and check...
When I told #p2140000# that someone summoned a strange monster from the Mirror of the Goddess, his face turned pale.

string.value: Tae Gong's Love For His Wife
I should go visit Tae Gong, who's gone fishing floating around in the middle of Aqua Road.

Tae Gong, who's in the middle of the ocean fishing on a raft, was concerned that he couldn't gather up #t4000166# for his wife. I made a deal with him to gather up #b20 #t4000166#s#k for him and deliver them to his wife #bGrandma Yeon#k at the Korean Folk Town.\n\n#t4000166# #b#c4000166##k/20

Tae Gong, who was busy fishing in the middle of the ocean, requested that I gather up 20 #t4000166#s and deliver them to his wife Grandma Yeon, which I did. Grandma Yeon was very thankful, yet sorry that I had to go through all kinds of trouble just for her.

string.name: name
string.value: The Brothers' Stack of Rice 1

string.name: parent
string.value: Brotherly Love
I better go visit Chil Sung at the Korean Folk Town.

Chil Sung and Chil Nam are brothers living in Korean Folk Town. Chil Sung was worried that his brother Chil Nam didn't have much food with him, and asked me if I could secretly place his sack of rice on Chil Nam's stacks.
I received a sack of rice from Chil Sung, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Nam's house.

I received a #t4031229# from Chil Nam, and placed it on top of a stack of rice in front of Chil Sung's house.

string.value: Brotherly Love

string.name: parent
string.value: Brotherly Love

While I was busy secretly placing sacks of rice on both Chil Sung's and Chil Nam's stacks back and forth, I was finally caught red-handed by Chil Sung. Chil Sung thanked me for strengthening the love and bond between the brothers even more. He also said that Chil Nam might have noticed it himself, and wanted me to go see him.

I was busy transferring multiple sacks of rice for Chil Sung and Chil Nam on each other's stacks, but was caught red-handed. The brothers seemed genuinely thankful for helping them strengthen their love and bond even more. Chil Nam even offered me the best pork and buckwheat paste meal in Korean Folk Town!

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Seed
Apparently, a Swallow hurt its wing and is lying down around the village shrine. I better go check it out ...

I met Swallow near the village shrine, its wings clipped. Swallow was on a delivery, but lost the item that it was supposed to deliver: a rare seed. Swallow wanted me to find it. Apparently, it dropped the seed somewhere around where a bunch of suspicious rabbits looked on. Maybe the rabbits took it...\n\n#t4031241# #b#c4031241##k/1

I met Swallow near the village shrine, its wings clipped. Swallow was desperate to find the lost seed, and asked me for help. Swallow claimed to have lost the seed where a bunch of suspicious-looking rabbits gathered up, so I asked each and every one of them about the whereabouts of the seed. The seed was eventually found, and I gave them back to Swallow.

string.name: name
string.value: Opening Nolbu's Gourd
I have this seed that Swallow gave me. Should I give this to Nolbu?

I took this seed that Swallow gave me and gave it to Nolbu. When notified that the seed was indeed from Swallow, Nolbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that may be inside.

I gave Nolbu the seed that Swallow gave me. Nolbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that maybe inside. When the gourd grew and was big enough to open, it contained the warrant of attachment. Greedy Nolbu collapsed and started bawling over his misfortune.

string.name: name
string.value: Opening Hongbu's Gourd
I have this seed that Swallow gave me. Should I give this to Hongbu?

I took this seed that Swallow gave me and gave it to Hongbu. When notified that the seed was indeed from Swallow, Hongbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that may be inside.

I gave Hongbu the seed that Swallow gave me. Hongbu requested that I plant the seed on his rooftop, and when it grows into a gourd, open it and give him whatever that maybe inside. When the gourd grew and was big enough to open, it contained a chest full of treasures.

string.name: name
string.value: The Seed That Swallow Lost
I lost the seed that Swallow gave. I better go visit again.
I lost the seed that Swallow gave, so I had to explain the circumstances to it. After some deliberation, it decided to look for another seed, and asked me to wait for a bit, then talk to it again.
I went to see Swallow because I have lost the seed myself, and it gave me a new one. Now, who should I give this to?

string.name: name
string.value: Preparing to Eliminate Goblins

string.name: parent
string.value: Goblin at Black Mountain
Apparently, Chumji, who is the landlord of the Korean Folk Town, have a request for me.

Chumji, who resides in Korean Folk Town, requested that I take out the Goblins who have been appearing at the mountain. The Goblins that have appeared at the Black Mountain are the goblins that have run away from the storybook on the Goblin Story, and they have been hiding out at an abandoned home. In order to draw them out of the seclusion, he told me I needed three different types of baits: #b#t2022050#, #t2022051#, #t2022052##k. I'll need to move around town and gather those items up. and then return to Chumji.

#t2022050# #b#c2022050##k/1
#t2022051# #b#c2022051##k/1
#t2022052# #b#c2022052##k/1

Chumji, who requested that I eliminate the Goblins that have run away from the Goblin Story book and are currently hiding at an abandoned house in a mountain, told me that in order to draw them out, I'll need to have three things that they love: buckwheat paste, roasted pork, and rice wine. He wanted me to gather them up for him. In the end, I was able to do so with help from Kong Ji, Hongbu, and Chil Nam.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate Goblins

string.name: parent
string.value: Goblin at Black Mountain

Armed with 3 types of food that Goblins cannot resist, the quest to defeat the Goblins has now officially begun. Chumji advised that I drop the baits at various spots near the abandoned house in the Black Mountain to draw the Goblins out, and proceeded to give me the details on exactly where to drop them: roasted pork in front of a stack of rocks; buckwheat paste inside a tree hole; rice wine in a stone lantern?

#o7130400# #r#a36113##k
#o7130401# #r#a36111##k
#o7130402# #r#a36112##k
#t4031232# #b#c4031232##k/1

I was able to successfully draw the 3 King Goblins out from the house and defeated all of them. When the Goblins were defeated, they dropped a bunch of jewelry, and after bringing them all to Chumji, he decided to give me one as a gift.

This time, the stepmom ordered her to fill up a pot with water, but the pot had a hole at the bottom, which made it impossible to fill up the pot. She asked me if I could get her a new #t4031230#. I heard that Grandma Yeon, who lives at the place where the water mill is, sells pots, and if I keep her up to date on his husband's whereabouts, then she may give me the pot. \n\n#t4031230# #b#c4031230##k/1

I gave Kong Ji, who was panicking because her pot had a hole at the bottom, the #t4031230# that Grandma Yeon made at the water mill. Apparently, Grandma Yeon only sells these pots to the closest few. I should go check on Kong Ji again down the road.

Kong Ji felt that only a durable steel hoe can help her plow the field, so I have decided to get #t4031222# for her. Needless to say, she was ecstatic when given the steel hoe. She was thankful for my work, and went out to start weeding the garden. Kong Ji's been through a lot; hopefully something good happens to her down the road.

string.value: The Truth Behind that Man
A mysterious man rushed past you. When you turned to look, you noticed he dropped something shiny. What is it?

The mysterious man dropped a Pocket Watch. You don't see anything special about it, but it doesn't seem to work, and the name #b#p2082004##k was engraved inside. Hey, what does that button on the top do?

When you pressed the button, you were instantly transported to a forest you've never seen. The mysterious man was there, staring at you in shock. His name is #b#p2082004##k, but who is he? And for that matter, what is this watch?

Do Gong pleaded with me to defeat Master Goblin, who's responsible for tricking Tae Roon and is primed to trick his way into Mu Lung. Master Goblin reiterated he had no hard feelings towards Mu Lung, and that all this hatred stems from Do Gong, who's jealous of Master Goblin's mastery on spells. No way... I better talk to Master Goblin and find out myself.

string.name: parent

Master Goblin offered to give me an #bantidote marble#k if I manage to answer all three of questions... but the true answers were NOWHERE to be found. He NEVER meant to give me the antidote!! What should I do? I better go see Do Gong now.

After receiving the #t4011008#s, #p2101002# told you that you had enough patience to be a Sand Bandit. Now you just have to pass the tests of the other members. Hmm, the wall also mentioned a bow and an iron hammer.

string.name: name
string.value: The True Identity of Sand Bandits
You have passed all the tests, and you have heard from each member of the Sand Bandits that they accept you. Now you should find their secret headquarters.

The captain of the Sand Bandits, #b#p2101010##k, tells you a story about the queen of #m260000000#. He then requests that you look around #m260000000# and decide if you really want to join the Sand Bandits.
You are finally member of the Sand Bandits, thanks to #p2101010#. As a member, your job is to do your best for the people of #m260000000#.

string.name: name
string.value: First Mission

string.name: parent
string.value: First Mission of Sand Bandits
The Sand Bandits are here for the residents of #m260000000#. Now that you are a member, you should go get your first mission! Talk to #b#p2101010##k.

#p2101010# says he wants to steal an expensive order of silk that the queen is buying and use it to pay for food for the people. The plan is for someone to transform into the guard from the palace to trick the merchant into giving up the silk! But first, you need to get a piece of #b#p2101004#'s hair#k. \n\n#i4031570# #t4031570# #b#c4031570# /#k1#k
You gave #p2101010# a piece of #p2101004#'s hair, er, beard. Now you just have to wait for the potion to be completed...

string.name: name
string.value: Tigun's Hair
You promised #p2101010# to get a strand of #p2101004#'s hair, but how are you going to manage that? Better go see #b#p2101004##k.
#p2101004# says he cannot give you any hair, but he can give you a strand of beard. However, you need to give him #b10 expensive #t4000326#s#k first...\n\n#i4000326# #t4000326# #b#c4000326# / 10#k
You got a strand of beard from #p2101004# in exchange for #t4000326#s. It's not hair but it should be good enough. Go talk to #p2101010#.

string.value: Mission Complete!

You received the queen's order of silk from #p2101004# and gave it to #p2101010#. Awesome! Your first mission as a Sand Bandit... Complete!

string.value: Stealing Queen's Order of Silk

#p2101013# keeps giving you suspicious looks. Arrrgh... You better be a smooth talker and just get the #bsilk#k.
You finally got the silk from #p2101013#. Phew, it really is hard to pretend to be someone else. Better return to #p2101010# now!

Sirin says you've more than made up for accidentally helping the Red Scorpions with your other good deeds. She says you should look for some #bcompensation#k. Compensation? Who's going to pay you?

How many arrows does #b#p2101011##k shoot every day? \n You might've heard somewhere that they sell #b#t02060001##k in either #r#m220000000##k or #r#m222000000##k...

#b#p2101011##k started practicing with his bow again, now that you've given him the arrows. You wanted to ask #b#p2101011##k how many arrows he shoots each day, but he looked so focused that you felt bad bothering him.

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search for His Sister

#p2101001# really misses his sister. #p2101001# plans to buy a #b#t04031582##k from #b#p2101004##k to get into the palace. Since #p2101001# has no money, you agree to buy it for him.\n\n#i04031582# #t04031582# #b#c04031582##k / 1

#p2101001# looked so happy when he received the #b#t04031582##k .Just like that, he ran off to the palace. You should ask him about it later. But...was he supposed to write his name on the #t04031582#? You've never heard of that before.

string.value: Dealing with Tigun

string.name: parent
string.value: In Search for His Sister

string.value: The Tree Cutter's Test

If you don't convince #p2071011# that you're strong enough to handle yourself here, he might physically drag you out of #m222000000#!

#r30 minute time limit
#k#o5100003# #r#a39511##k

string.name: parent
string.value: The Desert Bounty
#b#p2101000##k of #b#m260000000##k has heard a rumor...

#r#o3220001##k, the cactus monster, is threatening the desert! The #bSand Bandits#k have put a bounty on #o3220001#'s head. The Sand Bandits? When asked, #p2101000# suggests asking #bthe leader of the Sand Bandits#k...

You met the leader of the Sand Bandits, #p2101010#. #p2101010# says that the Sand Bandits have put a bounty on #o3220001#, but there is a problem. Some people worship #o3220001# as the guardian deity of the desert. He says the first thing to do is to convince #p2100001#, the spokesman for the people who worship him.

string.name: name
string.value: Convince Muhamad

string.name: parent
string.value: The Desert Bounty

Go talk to #p2100001#. He says to shush about the nonsense of #o3220001# being a monster. It will take more than words to convince him. Perhaps #b1 bottle of the #t4011008##k that #p2100001# likes might help the conversation. \n\n#i4011008##t4011008# #b#c4011008#/1
You have successfully convinced #p2100001#! He is infamous for being stubborn... Sweet! Report to #p2101010#.

string.name: name
string.value: Defeat Deo

string.name: parent
string.value: The Desert Bounty
You've managed to convince #p2100001# somehow. Go report to #p2101010#.

You report that #p2100001# has been convinced. #p2101010# grins, nods, and then suggests that you defeat #r#o3220001##k. Hmm, now he wants you to defeat a monster? Sigh...but don't forget that there is a bounty. That should motivate you a little. \n\n#k#o3220001# #r#a39541##k

You defeated #o3220001# and told #p2101010#. #p2101010# laughed heartily and said you did well. Huh? Is that it? What happened to the bounty? #p2101010# said the bounty didn't include members of the Sand Bandits. No way!

string.name: name
string.value: In Search of the Long Lost Pyramid

#bByron#k, who studies the everyday life of the desert people of the #bAriant Back Street#k, says that he's found something strange in the desert. You should go visit Byron.\r\n#bTip - Take the ship from Orbis heading toward Ariant, the oasis of Nihal Desert.

Byron claims that a huge sandstorm recently covered the path between Ariant and Magatia and completely changed the landscape of the area, revealing a #e#bmysterious pyramid#k#n. He's currently seeking explorers willing to help unlock the mysteries surrounding the Pyramid. First up, you'd better head over to Sahel 3 and talk to #e#bDuarte#k#n, who stands near the Pyramid.

As Byron requested, you headed to Sahel Desert in search of the giant, mysterious Pyramid. At its entrance stood Duarte, who warned about the dangers of the Pyramid, but opened its doors to any who dare risk their lives to unlock its mystery.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to Duarte who stands near the Pyramid at Sahel 3.

string.name: name
string.value: [Fight for Azwan] Sun-Scorched Obelisk
Somebody is talking to you.
Ariant's guard, Tigun told you about the strange phenomenon in the Wasteland. What's going on? Go to the #bAzwan Obelisk#k by choosing #bFight for Azwan at the Dimensional Mirror Portal#k.
You came upon the Cygnus Knights where you arrived. What are they doing here?

string.name: name
string.value: [Fight for Azwan] City Underground, Under Siege
Take the #bDimensional Mirror Portal#k to the #bAzwan Obelisk#k and talk to Knight Gardin of the Cygnus Knights.
Gardin tracked Hilla, the Commander of the Black Mage's Army, here. Below the huge Obelisk, he found Hilla's stronghold, the #bUnderground City of Azwan#k. #bGo inside the Obelisk#k.
You'd heard there were no people here, but there sure are a lot of ghosts. And many of them seem to be high ranking. Is that... a king?!

string.name: name
string.value: [Fight for Azwan] Destructive Tendencies
Azwan's king, Iason, is not replying. Talk with Medina the Shamaness to see if you can find out why.

According to Medina, Hilla used to be a high female shaman who was respected and loved by the people of Azwan. However, she turned on them all and gave them to the Black Mage as a present. Go see the aftermath of her treachery in Azwan.\n\n#rTip: Participate in Fight for Azwan.
Hilla's army... is the entire city of Azwan!

string.name: name
string.value: [Fight for Azwan] Remnants of Azwan
The people have Azwan have lost both their bodies and their souls, but perhaps there is still hope to save them. Talk to Medina.
Medina said that the only way to rescue Hilla's soldiers is to defeat them and set their souls free. She offered a reward for your help. Talk to Longorias to see what he has to offer.
You received a reward from the Longorias, the former Prime Minister of Azwan.

string.name: name
string.value: [Fight for Azwan] Fighting Blind
The Azwan fight holds a lot of promises, but prime minister Longorias seems to be worried. Why?

Longoria said that the battle will be tough, since Hilla's strength is influencing the entire Azwan region, excluding the top floor near the Obelisk. 

Countless people have come to aid Azwan, but they cannot distinguish one another as enemies or foes due to Hilla's power. They just may end up destroying one another... 

Longorias is worried about people fighting blindly in Azwan and getting hurt... but the battle can't be avoided.

string.value: [Fight for Azwan] Shamaness Marbles
Medina wants to talk to you now that you've completed a few battles.

Hilla's power is far too great for Medina. She can't save souls faster than they are recaptured. She needs #bShamaness Marbles#k to overcome this difference in power. Visit #bIason#k to see if he can help.
Iason seems to be quite upset.

string.name: name
string.value: [Fight for Azwan] A Fool and His Marbles 1
Ask Iason for the Shamaness Marble. Maybe you can also findo ut whe he dislikes Medina?
Iason told you to get the Shamaness Marble from Longorias, but why did he look so uncomfortable?
Longoria told you that Hilla had all of the Shameness Marbles, so he has to make new ones.

string.name: name
string.value: [Fight for Azwan] A Fool and His Marbles 2
What? Hilla has all the Shamaness Marbles? Speak to Longoria.

Iason favored Hilla long ago and gave her control of the Shamaness Marbles. If you want to have any chance against her magic, you'll need to make new marbles. Bring back the materials.

string.value: The Secret Method

string.name: parent
string.value: Trainer's Command
I'm nearly there; I should visit Bartos and see if I can finally learn Bartos's secret method of handling multiple pets at once.
In order to learn various commands, I'll have to give Bartos the Pet Snack. Hmm, he mentioned a bigger store...
I finally learned the secrets of commanding multiple pets through Bartos. I shall display my talent to the world!

string.name: name
string.value: Robo Upgrade!
Once the Baby Robot has been nurtured to reach level 15, I better take it to Garnox, who specializes in nurturing evolving pets.

Robots, a beautiful product of a perfect blend of technology and magic, can apparently transform into a more mature being. The process just requires some materials to work with. I'll need to get #b1 #t5380000##k and #b50 #t4000111#s#k and bring them to Garnox.
What used to be a small robot pet has grown up and became an Adult Robot.

string.name: name
string.value: Educating Smart Pets (Pet Summon)
You have a very smart pet with you. Please take it to Bartos the pet instructor. With his guidance, the pet may do something different.
In order to request Bartos for help in teaching the evolving pet new movements, I'll need to bring him his favorite drink.
I gave Bartos the drink and taught the evolving pet. I can now order the pet to come right next to me. Type /petcome to have your pet come to you.

string.name: name
string.value: Educating Smart Pets (Speech by Itself)
You have a very smart pet with you. Please take it to Bartos the pet instructor. With his guidance, the pet may even start a conversation...
In order to request Bartos for help in teaching the evolving pet new language, I'll need to bring him his favorite drink. The drink can be obtained through merchants.
I gave Bartos a drink and taught the evolving pet. Apparently the pet may start the conversation at times...what would it say...?

string.name: name
string.value: Naomi's Invitation 1
#p9105002# seems to be holding a very fascinating event. I better go check it out.
#p9105002# gave me all the information on the newest event that she planned. I should talk to her again in a bit.
#p9105002# gave me an entrance ticket to participate in the event.

string.name: name
string.value: Naomi's Invitation 2
I better talk to #p9105002# again and hear more about the event.

#p9105002# explained to me in greater detail about the event that's taking place. It looks like I'll need to gather some #t4032056#s, bring them all to #p9105002#, and receive a special prize in return.

I gave #p9105002# some #t4032056#, and she gave me a present in return. I guess I can only enter this event once a day. Seriously, is there no way I can enter again today? Perhaps I could find a ticket elsewhere...

string.value: Chair King Medal
If you have #t3010171#, I'll give you Chair King medal.
Oh, you have the #t3010171#. I'll give you the Chair King Medal since you own a special chair.
Here is a Chair King Medal for you. Remember, in the next event, the Chair King Medal will go to someone who has a different chair.

string.name: name
string.value: Urban Jungle
There's a Masked Man in New Leaf City... what's his deal?

I spoke with Jack Masque. He's a bandit prince from Amoria. He's in love with Princess Restless, and is trying to win her love from afar. He's got a passionate hatred for #o9400545#s, as one bit her just as she was giving him a kiss. So, I've agreed to hunt down 100 #o9400545#s in return for his thanks and something special he picked up. I should be able to find them in the MesoGears...

*Phew* I wiped out 100 of those pesky #o9400545#s, and in return, I received 5 #t2022194#s from Jack Masque. I can come back every 72 hours to help him if I want. I wonder what he did to get kicked out of Amoria...?

string.name: name
string.value: Subani's Legacy - Discovery

string.name: parent
string.value: Subani's Legacy
I heard there's an adventurer over at the MesoGears underneath Bigger Ben. What mysteries does it hold? I should find out!

I spoke with the famous John Barricades' one-half of the world famous Barricade Bros. Treasure Hunting Co. He spoke to me about Subani, the legendary mage responsible for the Dark Scrolls throughout the Maple World. He believes there is something within the MesoGears that may be a treasure of his. I've agreed to help clear the way. I'll have to defeat #b50 #o9400540#s, 30 #o9400545#s, and 40 #o9400542#s#k so I can explore deeper into the MesoGears...\r\n
I cleared a path straight through the MesoGears, and now I can explore there in peace. When I'm ready, I can see John Barricade to continue with the next part of this adventure!

string.name: name
string.value: Subani's Legacy - Transgression

string.name: parent
string.value: Subani's Legacy
John Barricade is awaiting me in Bigger Ben! He's found something!

I spoke with John, and he's found a set of weird markings in the MesoGears that he can't decipher. He's mentioned that he'll need special crystals known as #b#t4031680#s#k. I've agreed to snag #b50#k of them so he can decipher the markings. #o9400543#s...John thinks that the mechanism on their heads may have those Hyper Glyphs inside. I'd better be careful-I don't want to get shocked, since he wants me to hunt #b100#k of them!
I got the #b50 #t4031680#s#k that John needed, and he's hard at work deciphering the markings. I should come back soon to see if he's finished!

string.name: name
string.value: Subani's Legacy - Deliverance

string.name: parent
string.value: Subani's Legacy
John has finished deciphering the markings! I need to get back to the Temple Hive now!

John and I spoke again, and something unforeseen happened. I'll have to track down #b25 #t4031681#s#k so he can put together the map! He mentioned the robots he "borrowed" for some assistance went all crazy, kept saying "#bI.AM.ROBOT#k" as they scurried into the Krakian Jungle... I need to hunt at least #b50#k of them.

Finally done! I took the pieces back to John, and he's going to start piecing the map together. However, he did come across a strange ring that passed on to me. If this was the first treasure, I wonder where the rest is...
There's a mysterious traveler in New Leaf City-he doesn't look like he's from anywhere around here. I should ask him what's going on. It could be interesting...

I spoke with Elpam Gorlab, and he's a traveler from Versal, the mirror-world of MapleStory. He traveled here to observe us and our celebration, but due to the appearance of Amoria, he was thrown off-course and landed in New Leaf City. I've agreed to help get him home by collecting #b30 #t4031674#s#k. He's mentioned that the only creatures that have them here are the #o9400542#s, and I'll need to hunt at least #b60#k of them. I'll have to head to Bigger Ben and track them down. I didn't know that there was a mirror-world...I wonder if I have a double there...
I got the #b30 #t4031674#s#k and returned them to Elpam. In return, he gave me 10 #t2002015#s, something that's sure to help me. It looks like he needs more help though...
Elpam has adjusted his compass, but he still needs my help. I should travel back and see what he needs!

I went back to Elpam for more information, and he's explained that while he was able to adjust the compass, he needs to head back to the moment of his travel glitch to get back to his home safely. I have to hunt #b120 #o9400543#s#k down and collent #b60 #t4031675#s#k, then hand them over. That's a full minute worth of fragments and the perfect amount of time for him to travel back.
I got all #b60 #t4031675#s#k and returned them to Elpam. In return, he's given me a very nice prize he found floating in the rift...!
Icebyrd looks like he needs my help. I'd better get over to New Leaf City and see him!

I spoke with Icebyrd, and he was glad to see me. He's been trying to build the new areas, but the #o9400544#s have been wreaking havoc on the construction crews. If that wasn't enough, those pesky #o9400547#s are also attacking the machines. I've agreed to help by taking out #b100 #o9400544#s#k (located in the Jungle Clearing) and collecting #b2 #t4031937#s#k dropped by them, and defeating #b150 #o9400547#s#k and collecting #b150 #t4000391##k to show them that this city is off-limits!

Man, what a day. I de-clawed the #o9400544#s and defused the #t4031937#s. Now the city can continue building in peace. Icebyrd said that they may act up again, so I should come back to see if they've been rowdy...

string.name: name
string.value: Cleaning Up The Streets\t
There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is!

I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out #b200 #o9400543#s and 200 #o9400544#s#k around New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
I...I did it! 200 #o9400543#s and #o9400544#s have fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a 'Thank You!' I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...

string.name: name
string.value: Urban Warrior
This is Icebyrd Slimm, mayor of New Leaf City. I want to thank you for helping us get the city up and running. I have something for you, so come see me immediately!
As a bonus for helping get the city up and running, Icebyrd has given me a Warrior's Throne! This is sure to help me in the battles to come!
As a bonus for helping get the city up and running, Icebyrd has given me a Warrior's Throne! This is sure to help me in the battles to come!

string.value: Welcome to New Leaf City Quiz - END

string.name: parent
string.value: Welcome to New Leaf City Quiz
I've successfully solve all the questions but I am still curious of some things...
I was talking with Icebyrd Slimm and wow, there is more to this land of Masteria and New Leaf City than what I learned from the quiz. I want to know more of what happened in this place.
I've asked about the old fable of Masteria and Icebyrd Slimm didn't quite answer my question. Maybe when I become stronger, he will tell me more about it.

string.name: name
string.value: Brand Materia

string.name: parent
string.value: Brand Materia

Looks like the Glimmer Man is looking for a rare material from the alternate dimension of Versal, the very #b#t4031760##k that I now possess. Perhaps I should visit him in New Leaf City and see what he wants with it. Maybe he'll reward me for bringing him some...

I visited the Glimmer Man, and discovered that he's an ultra-powerful mage whose ability to turn his entire body into pure diamond (hence his name) has allowed him to journey to space and other inhospitable environments. Through the vast knowledge he's acquired during his explorations, he's also become somewhat of a renowned weapons creator and arms dealer.\r\nThe Glimmer Man has landed in Masteria looking for something called #b#t4031760##k, a rare element from the alternate dimension of Versal he's been dying to experiment with. To thank me for recovering some and bringing it to him, he's promised to make me a weapon of my own from it. However, I've got to also track down #b7 #t4021008#s#k and return these to him as well. Only then can he reduce the naturally unstable Materia down to a useable form. A weapon made from an otherworldly material! I wonder what it does...

I returned to the Glimmer Man and he synthesized the #b#t4031760##k and the #b7 #t4021008#s#k I gave him to form a Materia Orb. He's said his precocious friend Spindle can turn this into a weapon, so I should see him when I'm ready to make the weapon...WOOT! Spindle is currently residing in New Leaf City. Additionally, anytime I find more White Versal Materia, I can bring it to the Glimmer Man and he'll create another Materia Orb for me so I can make another weapon!

string.name: name
string.value: Interstellar Relics

Professor Foxwit spoke with me about the space-based Artifacts suddenly being discovered. He's believes he can invent new and different items with them by using the knowledge he's acquired over years of time-travel. He is willing to experiment on any Artifacts I should find. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and give me a blueprint to make it...

Professor Foxwit spoke with me about the space-based Artifacts suddenly being discovered. He's believes he can invent new and different items with them by using the knowledge he's acquired over years of time-travel. He is willing to experiment on any Artifacts I should find. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and give me a blueprint to make it...

string.value: Ancient Artifacts

John Barricade has told me about the Ancient Artifacts I've found in my offline travels (playing the MapleStory Trading Card Game). He thinks that these can be used to construct powerful weapons and items. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and how to make them.

He thinks that these can be used to construct powerful weapons and items. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and how to make them.

string.name: name
string.value: Jay's Curiosity

It's weird... When I walked passed #bJay from Henesys#k the other day, he didn't answer my greetings and didn't even notice me there. It looked like he was working on some kind of riddle by himself. Let's find out what Jay is up to these days.

I don't believe I actually offered to help him on finding a historical figure just out of curiosity! I guess it won't hurt to check out the dungeon as #p1012109# requested... But I really doubt I would find anything there. It's a legend, myth, a fairy tale.
I found Bob from #m105090300# and talked with bunch of people about him. He is famous around this world.

string.name: name
string.value: Gwin's Thanks
When I passed by, #b#p1061013##k, someone I really never got to spoke with, looked like he had something to talk to me. Let's go and find out what he has to say to me.

#p1061013# was looking at #t4031447# very closely to see if I did anything to hurt him. I don't know what the deal is but he was scaring me. It makes me wonder why he is obsessed with this particular snail. I should find out by talking to #b#p1061013##k again.
#p1061013# told me what happened between him and Bob. It's amazing that a simple snail actually tried to save human being... Those little monsters we hunt aren't really little at all...

string.name: name
string.value: The Rememberer's Passion Part 1

string.name: parent
string.value: The Rememberer's Passion
The Rememberer sure would know who Bob is. He's the Rememberer! I should talk with The Rememberer to find out what he knows.
The Rememberer isn't really being helpful today. Very slow talking, not really informative. I wonder why he is so... depressed.
He is MEAN! MEAN, MEAN, MEAN! He took away Bob's Snail Shell from me without me letting him! Now, what do I have to do?

string.name: name
string.value: The Rememberer's Passion Part 2

string.name: parent
string.value: The Rememberer's Passion

I found it! I found Bob again! He must have escaped from The Rememberer by himself! I feel really terrible that I let this kind of things happen. I am going back to The Rememberer to tell him to lighten up.

I don't think The Rememberer gets the whole idea of me doing this. Bob may be just another monster but I know what is right or wrong. And I am going to pay back just the way he did to me. I need to get 1 #b#t4000019##k other than Bob's to pull this off.
I got him! The Rememberer will always remember this day. The day he got tricked by me! Ok. I should stop doing things like this though.

string.name: name
string.value: Grendel The Really Old's Glorious Days
Grendel The Really Old... He lives deep in the forest of Ellinia. Since he's really old, he has to know SOMETHING about Bob. I shall see him now.

Grendel The Really Old was talking out of himself but I got to make him hear what I had to say. He is getting glasses. I hope his eyesight isn't too bad to recognize Bob... After all, Grendel is probably the oldest guy in this world.

Grendel The Really Old got very mad at me for hitting Bob to make him go into his shell. I knew he would know something but never would have guessed they were old friends. I guess I owe Bob a big apology. But how am I going to be able to do that to a snail, especially if he's not coming out from his shell?

string.name: name
string.value: Cody's Confession

string.name: name
string.value: Manji's Approval

string.name: name
string.value: Blackbull's Mistake

string.name: name
string.value: Bruce's Research
Bruce, the monster researcher, might know something. Maybe he can tell me how old Bob actually is. If I get to know how old he is, wouldn't that be a discovery of something remarkable?
He does seem to know something about his age but he looks spooked. I shouldn't hesitate to ask him what is wrong!

Wow... Bruce told me that Bob's age is incalculable. This is getting serious, isn't it? A snail that even professional monster researcher can't tell the age. Maybe he was right about asking me to go see Winston. Maybe an archeologist knows more about the history and the age issue than Bruce.

string.name: name
string.value: Dances with Balrog's Barbarism Part 1

string.name: parent
string.value: Dances with Balrog's Barbarism
This is a wild guess but... Wouldn't Dances with Balrog know a little bit about Bob? Who knows, I heard that he likes snails. Maybe I will go check with him.
I didn't know Dances with Balrog likes to EAT the snails... Now, what am I suppose to do?! It doesn't look like he is going to give me back Bob's Snail Shell anytime soon...
I had to take off from Dances with Balrog. Who can STAND all that endless talking? I should figure out a way to get Bob back other than talking him through...

string.value: Dances with Balrog's Barbarism Part 2

string.value: Dances with Balrog's Barbarism

string.value: Winston's Scheme Part 1

string.value: Winston's Scheme

string.name: name
string.value: A Word to the Wise

string.name: parent
string.value: Old Man Tom's Word
I hear that Old Man Tom has been hearing noises from the old Prendergast Mansion on the outskirts of New Leaf City. A haunted house? Sounds like the perfect Halloween adventure!

Old Man Tom told me about the haunted Prendergast Mansion. Apparently, the doors won't open for just anyone... I've got to figure out how to get in. Tom mentioned that the toymaker Prendergast used to hold parties for kids for holidays, including Halloween costume parties around this time of year. Maybe if I wear a costume I can get in! Hmmm... Now where can I buy one?

I made it into the old Prendergast Mansion, against the advice of Old Man Tom. I wonder why he's so dead set on keeping people out of the house? Maybe if I explore the house, I can find out more about what happened here...

string.name: name
string.value: The Past in the Present

string.name: parent
string.value: Old Man Tom's Word
Jonas gave me his Toy Workshop Key. He wants me to find someone who will keep it safe and ensure that his twisted toys can't escape his house.

Turns out Old Man Tom is Thomlin Prendergast, Jonas' younger brother. I gave him Jonas' Toy Workshop key to keep. He gave me Sophilia's Necklace, for helping put the spirits in Prendergast Mansion to rest.

string.name: name
string.value: A Cold Hearth
I heard there's an old butler in the Haunted House. Maybe he needs help cleaning it...

I spoke with Edmunds, Butler of the Prendergast Estate. It seems that he' run out of #t4000018# to heat the house, which would explain the chill. I've agreed to help him out and bring back #b60 #t4000018##k so he can refill the fireplaces throughout the house and re-heat the mansion.
I brought back #b60 #t4000018##k to Edmunds; he can get the fireplaces going again now. Hmmm... It seems like there are quite a few fireplaces around this labyrinthine house.

string.name: name
string.value: Eat This!
I keep seeing these fireplaces around the house. I wonder if they lead anywhere...maybe Edmunds knows? He mentioned something about a key. I should press him a bit more.

My hunch was right. The fireplaces are interconnected through the mansion's Chimney; perhaps I can use them as an alternate way of navigating through the house. However, they're locked and Edmunds holds the only key. He will reluctantly give me the key if I collect #b20 of each type of Gummy Slimes#k. There's Red, Green, Purple and Orange ones; so I'll need to hunt all over the house to get them. It'll be tempting to eat them first.

Edmunds reluctantly gave me the Omni Key after I collected the Gummy Slimes for him. With it, I can enter the fireplaces throughout the house and the Chimney to which they all connect. Hmmm... Who knows where all these fireplaces lead?

string.name: name
string.value: Special Delivery
There's a beautiful woman in the Prendergast house that looks mildly annoyed... perhaps I should speak with her.

Man! I spoke-no, tried to speak with Ludmilla, and she wouldn't give me the time of day until I agreed to get her #b5 slices of #t2022190##k for Jonas from Olde Sapp Village. A bit strange that she referred to New Leaf City as that, but Miki should have them at the potion shop. What a cranky woman...

Well, I got Ludmilla her #b#t2022190##k, and learned a bit about Jonas and her love...for his money. No wonder Edmunds hates her. I should press that woman for more info about what's going on around here.

string.name: name
string.value: Family Jewels
Oh...looks like Ludmilla is not quite done with me yet. I'd better head back and see what that nag wants now...

I spoke with Ludmilla, and big surprise---her Cherry Pie Ghoulash didn't lure Jonas out. I think he probably pushed a bookcase in front of the door to ensure he never sees her again, but that's just a theory. At any rate, it looks like now her prized jewelry has mysteriously disappeared. She thinks Sophilia's taken it, but I'm not sure if I buy that, seeing as how she's...not around to do that. I have to gather #b20 #t4031769#s#k and #b10 #t4031770#s#k and bring them back to her. The woman complains way too much... sheesh.
I found Ludmilla's beloved jewelry for her. In return she gave me a worn, but well-loved doll. It's seen better days, but it has charm. Someone is probably looking for this...

string.name: name
string.value: A Lost Girl
There's a girl wandering around the Prendergast Mansion. I wonder what she's looking for.

Sophilia is looking for her favorite toy - the very first doll her father made for her when she was a child. She seems to have been looking for it for quite awhile. She mentioned something about Ludmilla having a history of hiding her toys. If I can find Sophilia's doll for her, maybe I can put her spirit at ease.
I gave Sophilia back her favorite doll. She was so happy to get it back that she gave me some of her favorite candy.

string.name: name
string.value: A Father's Love
Jonas gave me a new doll he made to give to his daughter. I don't think Sophilia'll like it as much her favorite one, but I guess I should give it to her anyway, per her father's wishes.
I gave Sophilia the new doll her father made. It made her sad. She asked me give Annabelia, the first doll Jonas made for her, back to her father.
Jonas was very confused by the doll I gave him. He was almost speechless. I hope he is not going any more insane than he is right now.

string.name: name
string.value: The M-Files
I heard there's a MBI (Maple Bureau of Investigation) agent in the Phantom Forest! I should investigate what he's investigating!

I spoke with MBI Agent Falcon. He's on the trail of a dangerous specter, but it looks like that crafty ghost gave him the slip by scattering his #b#t4031764#s#k all over the place. I've agreed to collect #b50#k of them so he can continue the hunt!
I tracked down all 50 of Agent #b#t4031764#s#k that he asked for! In return, he's given me Smores! Mmm...If only he had a napkin...

string.name: name
string.value: File Under Incomplete
MBI Agent Falcon is still snooping around the old Haunted House, even after I helped him find some of the Paranormal Activity Report Pages! I wonder why... maybe he still needs help.

Looks like MBI Agent Falcon spoke too soon... 50 pages led him to the wrong, uh, dead guy... but he thinks that if I collect #b100#k more of them, he'll be able to catch Mr. Bones for sure! Whew... 100 pages. I wonder how many pages in total were in his original report.
I tracked down all of the 100 more #t4031764#s#k Agent Falcon requested! Now he can finally go track Mr. Bones... I hope.

string.name: name
string.value: The File Thickens Part 1

string.name: parent
string.value: The File Thickens
Agent Falcon is still hanging out in front of the Haunted House?! Doesn't he have other ghosts to catch, myths to debunk? Maybe I should go see if something's wrong...

I'm starting to think that Agent Falcon spends too much time writing reports, and not enough time doing actual investigative work! The elusive Mr. Bones turns out to be Prendergast, the former owner of this house! Falcon wants me to find Jonas in the Haunted House, give him this Paranormal Subject Questionnaire to fill out, and return the completed form to him.
I got my questionnaire from Jonas. Now is time for me to hand over this document to Falcon. Maybe he can go back to MBI if I hand him this?

string.name: name
string.value: The Infernal Toy Machine
I keep hearing the groans and bellows of machinery echoing through the house. What is making this racket? Is it where these infernal toys are coming from?

I found Jonas Prendergast in his Toy Workshop at the top of the house, in front of a huge toy machine which seems to be the source of all these infernal toys! It seems that his machine is not functioning properly. If I collect #b50 Firewood#k, #b25 Screws#k, and #b25 Loaded Springs#k, Jonas can build the replacement part to get his machine working properly again. I know that the Rocking Horses will have the #bFirewood#k and the Psycho Jacks will have the #bScrews and Loaded Springs#k. I've got to get what Jonas needs-perhaps this will stop it from churning out all these crazy toys!
I collected the parts Jonas needed to fix his machine. I hope I haven't simply helped a madman create more of his messed up toys.

string.name: name
string.value: In Her Likeness
Looks like Jonas fixed the machine... yet it's still cranking out these crazy toys. Maybe he is bonkers. Or maybe he needs some more help.

Looks like Jonas needs help building a new doll, a more perfect likeness of Sophilia. I don't think he realizes she's dead. In any case, I have to collect #b30 Locks of Doll's Hair, 10 Heartstoppers, 10 Maple Candies, and 10 Pumpkin Taffies#k. Why the candies? I may never know...
I collected everything Jonas needed to build his new doll in the likeness of his daughter. I have to say though... it looks nothing like her.
Jonas was very confused by the doll I gave him. He was almost speechless. I hope he is not going any more insane than he is right now.

When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awakened him from his madness. He's realized that his Toy Machine has been corrupted and is churned out twisted versions of his former creations. Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible. For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.

Jonas gave me all of his Toymaker Gear in return for helping him destroy his twisted creations. He also gave me the key to his Toy Workshop, asking me to give it to someone who will help keep it safe and find a way to restore the Prendergast name.

string.name: name
string.value: Psycho Jack

When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awakened him from his madness. He's realized that his Toy Machine has been corrupted and is churned out twisted versions of his former creations. Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible. For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.
Looks like he wants me to destroy #b50 Psycho Jacks#k. It shouldn't be too hard, I think.
I destroyed some of Jonas' creations and he rewarded me with some of his fantastic Toymaking gear! It seems like a grim endless battle against the tireless Infernal Toy Machine...

string.name: name
string.value: Sophilia Doll

When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awakened him from his madness. He's realized that his Toy Machine has been corrupted and is churned out twisted versions of his former creations. Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible. For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.
Looks like he wants me to destroy #b50 Sophilia Dolls#k. It shouldn't be too hard, I think. But they are scary looking for sure...
I destroyed some of Jonas' creations and he rewarded me with some of his fantastic Toymaking gear! It seems like a grim endless battle against the tireless Infernal Toy Machine...

When I gave Sophilia's favorite doll to Jonas, it seemed to have awakened him from his madness. He's realized that his Toy Machine has been corrupted and is churned out twisted versions of his former creations. Because the machine can't be destroyed, Jonas has asked me to destroy as many of his creations as possible. For every 50 Psycho Jacks, 50 Nightmares, or 50 Sophilia Dolls I destroy, Jonas has promised to reward me with something special.
Looks like he wants me to destroy #b50 Nightmare#k. It shouldn't be too hard, I think. Or is it?
I destroyed some of Jonas' creations and he rewarded me with some of his fantastic Toymaking gear! It seems like a grim endless battle against the tireless Infernal Toy Machine...

string.name: name
string.value: Halloween : Entering the house
I've made it into the Prendergast Mansion! I don't know what Old Man Tom would react to my success though...
I've made it into the Prendergast Mansion! I don't know what Old Man Tom would react to my success though...
I've made it into the Prendergast Mansion! I don't know what Old Man Tom would react to my success though...

string.name: name
string.value: The File Thickens Part 2

string.name: parent
string.value: The File Thickens
I got my questionnaire from Jonas. Now is time for me to hand over this document to Falcon. Maybe he can go back to MBI if I hand him this?

I gave Agent Falcon's Paranormal Subject Questionnaire to Jonas and had him fill it out. Finding him in the labyrinthine mansion was the hard part... Jonas was actually quite cooperative, especially for a spirit. In any case, I returned the completed form to Falcon, who was ecstatic that he didn't have to set foot inside the creepy old mansion again.

string.name: name
string.value: Smores No More
MBI (Maple Bureau of Investigation) Agent Falcon has been standing in front of the Prendergast Mansion for quite some time. Maybe I should go see why he's still loitering around.

Looks like the bumbling MBI Agent Falcon just can't get a break. Just when he was ready to pack up and leave to report the findings for his Halloween mission, a mysterious little boy appeared and stole all the Smores Falcon had cooked up for his colleagues! Falcon has agreed to pay you 100,000 mesos (from his Agency discretionary account) if you recover #b25#k of his #bSmores#k for him. Easy money - or is it? The Smores look pretty tasty... I guess I'll have to try not to eat them myself as I collect them!

I collected Agent Falcon's #bSmores#k for him... they were a bit dirty but still good, so his colleagues back at the MBI Agency should be happy! In return, Falcon paid me the 100,000 mesos he promised. He also gave me some old medicine bottles that he'd found lying outside the house. They look pretty potent...

string.name: name
string.value: Dinner Fixins
It's time for Thanksgiving and I'm ready for some home cookin'! I should pay Mom and Dad a visit over in Henesys!

I'm helping Mom and Dad make Thanksgiving dinner! I have to gather one of each ingredient: 1 ear of #b#t2020029##k, a can of #b#t2022262##k, a #b#t2022263##k, bowl of #b#t2022264##k and best of all, #b#t2022261##k. They promised me an #b#t4031529##k if I return quickly. I guess the Turkeys stole all the ingredients to make Thanksgiving fixins... I guess they think that without the fixins', there'll be no dinner! No dinner? No way! Time to defeat some battle-hardened Turkeys!

My trusty weapon did a fine job of ruffling those rowdy turkeys' feathers, and I obtained all of the ingredients for Mom and Dad. In return, they gave me my #b#t4031529##k! I guess doing chores does pay off! I can take this to any of the Store Vendors in New Leaf City, and receive a #bNexon Game Card#k for it! ...I'd better get out of here before Aunt Petunia shows up! Mom mentioned that I can help her with dinner once a day until it's time to eat!

string.name: name
string.value: Game On! <CVS>
I helped Mom and Dad with Thanksgiving dinner and received my #ballowance#k! Now I can head to #bHenesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City#k and obtain a #bNexon Game Card#k from one of the Vendors!

I have my #ballowance#k, and I'm on my way to #bHenesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City#k! I just have to speak with one of the Vendors there to receive a #bNexon Game Card#k! Just have to make sure I have some room in my ETC slot for it...

I spoke with one of the vendors, and in return for my #ballowance#k, I received a #bNexon Game Card#k! I can also take this to any of the Store Vendors in #bHenesys, Amoria, or New Leaf City#k if one store happens to be sold out. I can help Mom and Dad every day until the end of the event, receive #ballowance#k and get another #bNexon Game Card#k. I should get as many as possible, because when the event ends, it will turn into MaplePoints that I can use in the Cash Shop! Free money! WOO HOO!

string.name: name
string.value: Little Suzy's X-Mas Dilemma

There's a little girl with a puzzled look on her face in New Leaf City. With X-mas time just around the corner, she should be happy... I wonder why she looks so puzzled and confused instead? Looks like she may need some help with her Maplemas spirit!

Little Suzy was all excited for Maplemas this year... until she learned all about a similar holiday called 'Versalmas' from a strange green mouse named O-Pongo. Now she doesn't know what sounds more exciting - Maplemas... or Versalmas? Suzy needs my help to help her decide which version of X-mas she should celebrate this year. In order to do that, I'll have to speak to both Maple Claws and this O-Pongo character, and then come back and talk to her. Maplemas holiday from an alternate dimension, huh? Very curious...

I spoke to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo. It seems that both Maplemas and Versalmas have their merits. In the end, Suzy's put the decision on me: she's asked me to deliver her X-mas Wishlist to one of the two 'Santas,' which will determine which holiday she's celebrating this year. I have a feeling that this decision is important, that I'm not just making a choice for her... but also one for myself. Which holiday do I believe in?

string.name: name
string.value: The Spirit of Maplemas
To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to Maple Claws. I'm sure she's back in town now in Happyville.
To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to Maple Claws about Suzy's dilemma. Maple Claws listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy. I should talk to her in a bit.

Maple Claws gave me a message for Suzy: that as long as she remembers the essence of the Maplemas Spirit, it doesn't really matter what holiday traditions she chooses to follow this year. I should return to Suzy with Maple Claws' message once I've also spoken to O-Pongo.

string.name: name
string.value: A Versal Tradition
To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to O-Pongo. I'd better speak with this strange green mouse and find out more details about Versalmas.
To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to O-Pongo about Suzy's dilemma. O-Pongo listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy. I should talk to her in a bit.

Versal Power! I spoke with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, who is the 'Santa' for the Versal version of Maplemas, and learned a great deal about Versalmas. He told me about the customs for their holiday--quite different from the Maple World! The world of Versal is usually shrouded in darkness; Versalmas is an annual holiday that celebrates the emergence of the sun in their world, which shines for 90 straight days and only for these 90 days. For Versalmas, children receive presents every day for the first 30 days, and get cool treats like Sugar-coated Olives and Caramel Onions! Sounds pretty awesome... Now I'd better speak with Maple Claws and head back to Suzy... It makes me wonder for myself though, which holiday would I pick to celebrate? Hmmm...

string.name: name
string.value: A Very Merry Maplemas
Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo. I'm thinking I should give it to Maple Claws; I should go see her in Happyville.

I can give Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws. In doing so, she'll be counting on me to help me recover her presents for her this year. All I have to do now is to give Maple Claws the list to cement my decision. Yes... it's going to be a very Merry Maplemas this year!

I thought that Maplemas was the better holiday so I gave #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k to Maple Claws. In return, she gave me a red #bMaplemas Hat#k that I can wear proudly to show my Maplemas Spirit! Every time I help Maple Claws recover the presents stolen by monsters, she'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents with her in batches of #b10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100#k. I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards! I'll need to bring her presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing Maple Claws more presents will also help me earn #bMaplemas Spirit#k! If the total amount of #bMaplemas Spirit#k accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of #bVersalmas Cheer#k, Maple Claws will have a special something for me at the end of the event!

string.name: name
string.value: Happy Versalmas to You
Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo. I should go see O-Pongo in New Leaf City if I want to give it to him. Decisions, decisions...
I'm thinking it's Versalmas for me this year! All I have to do now to cement my decision is to actually give Little Suzy's Wishlist to O-Pongo. I can't wait! It's time for a change of pace!

Looks like I'm celebrating Versalmas this year! I gave #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k to O-Pongo, and he gave me this awesome #bVersalmas Hat#k for me to wear proudly! Every time I bring O-Pongo presents I've collected from monsters, he'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents to him in batches of #b10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100#k. I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards! I'll need to bring him presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing O-Pongo more presents will also help me earn #bVersalmas Cheer#k! If the total amount of #bVersalmas Cheer#k accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of #bMaplemas Spirit#k, O-Pongo will have something really nice for me at the end of the event!

string.name: name
string.value: Elpam's Gift
Looks like Elpam is celebrating a new holiday. I should head over to New Leaf City and check it out!

Elpam is celebrating the holiday known as Versalmas! He'd like me to speak with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, and the one who gives presents. Looks like Elpam has received his gift from O-Pongo, who is also in New Leaf City, so doing this shouldn't be too tough...

Elpam offered me a slab of #bMelting Cheese#k as a Versalmas gift! Er, a strange gift but I gladly accepted this as a token of friendship! He also said that I should speak with O-Pongo to learn more about this Versal tradition...

string.name: name
string.value: Giant Snowman's Purple box
Bill is frantically looking for a Purple box. I wonder why...
If I find the Purple box for Bill, she promised to open the box for me. I wonder what's inside that box...
Bill was gracious enough to open the Purple box for me. It also felt good to contribute 50 mesos towards kids that are less fortunate in MapleStory.

string.name: name
string.value: Easter : Mad Bunny's Easter(Red)
I heard Mad Bunny isn't too happy with Easter. I should go talk to him and see what's up.

Mad Bunny needs #b10 Red Easter Eggs#k and an #bEaster Basket#k from me. He may be one angry bunny, but he did promise to pay me well for my service. 

#t2022538# #b#c2022538#/10#k
#t4031283# #b#c4031283#/1#k
I gave him #b10 Red Easter Eggs#k with the #rEaster Basket#k and he gave me an #bEaster Charm#k with some EXP. Not bad.

string.name: name
string.value: The Wandering Alchemist Eurek's New Skill
#b#p2040050##k has figured out a simple way to use scrolls on items. Talk to Eurek the Alchemist.
Learn the Legendary Spirit skill which allows simple usage of scrolls on items.
You learned the simple way to use scrolls on items from #b#p2040050##k.

string.name: name
string.value: Monster Riding
The keeper of the #bAquarium#k, #b#p2060005##k, is researching a way to tame and possibly ride monsters. I should take a trip to Aqua Road and see if there's anything I can do to help!

#p2060005# found out that someone is trying to steal his research. #p2060005# asked me to #b watch the wild boar#k and bring back #b#t4031508##k to him. On top of that, he asked me to get the wild boar's #b#t4031507##k as well...I'd better stay alert for this one--I don't want someone to steal his research before I learn how to tame and ride monsters! 

#i4031508##t4031508# #b#c4031508#/5#k
#i4031507##t4031507# #b#c4031507#/5#k.
#p2060005# taught you about #bMonster Riding#k in exchange for helping him with his research.

string.name: name
string.value: Pheromone Perfume
0 = #b#p2060005##k is performing further research about monster riding. I wonder if he's finished researching #t4031507#? Time to grab my swimming trunks and head back to Aqua Road!

#p2060005# said that he not only did more research on #t4031507#, he's discovered a way to make it work! However, he'll need a special perfume from #bChief Tatamo from Leafre Village#k to make #t2270000# which trains the monster. Leafre is in Ossyria, so I've got a bit of a journey on my hands...\n\n#i4031509##t4031509# #b#c4031509#/1#k.

After a long journey to Leafre, I traveled back to the Aquarium with the perfume in hand and gave it to #p2060005#. He believes that this method should work and gave me #b#t2270000##k for the monster. He told me that if I take it somewhere in the #bnext town#k I would be able to train wild boars!

string.name: name
string.value: Lost Saddle
I lost the #t1912000# that I received from #b#p2060005##k! What should I do? Hmmm... Maybe I should go see #p2060005#. I hope he's nice enough to give me another one!

#p2060005# says that making a #t1912000# for monster riding requires special ingredients. He needs #b200#t4000171#, 200 #t4000030#, 200 #t4000055##k. #p2060005# says he will also need #b5 million mesos#k for 'research purposes'. I believe this is otherwise known as 'extortion'. He's probably a bit upset at me for losing the first one. Oh well, looks like I've got some work to do...


#i4000171##t4000171# #b#c4000171#/200#k
#i4000030##t4000030# #b#c4000030#/200#k
#i4000055##t4000055# #b#c4000055#/200#k

I returned to #p2060005# with the proper materials and the 5 million meso extortion--I mean 'Research Fee'. In return for my efforts, I received #t1912000# from #p2060005#. I should be able ride monsters again with this. I'll be sure not to lose it again!

string.name: name
string.value: Lost Perfume

I lost #t2270000#. I can't train the monster without it. What should I do? I should head back to Aqua Road and go see #b#p2060005##k. Maybe I can tell him that I met someone in Amoria and had to go on a date...

#p2060005# says he's heard of this phenomenon of people using that perfume on dates. He doesn't understand why, it smells a lot like raw garlic and hot feet to him. Luckily, he has plenty of #t4031507# and he will make me another #t2270000# if I bring him #b#t4031509##k.\n\n#i4031509##t4031509# #b#c4031509#/1#k. I'd better hurry back--I want my new mount!
I received #t2270000# from #p2060005#. Phew...I should go train my monster now. On the way, I'll think of a better excuse if I lose the perfume again--this kinda does smell like hot feet...

string.name: name
string.value: Silver Mane
I've heard that #p2060005# has furthered his research and found a way to upgrade my existing mount. A faster monster to ride? I should go see #p2060005# in Aqua Road immediately!

#p2060005# said you needed #b#t4000261# and a #t4000262# in order to make your mounts bigger, faster, and stronger. However, he wants you to donate #b50,000,000 mesos#k so he can conduct further research to develop methods to help people co-exist with monsters. 

#i4000261##t4000261# #b#c4000261#/500#k
#i4000262##t4000262# #b#c4000262#/500#k

It took a bit of time, but I returned with the needed items and 'donation' he asked for. #p2060005# made my #t1902000# into a #t1902001#. What a difference! My mount is so much sharper and stronger than before! I can run over almost anything now!

string.name: name
string.value: Dragon's Perfume Bottle
It's time to take my mount to another level! Let's go see #p2081000# in Leafre and see if he has any methods to improve my mount!

After reaching Leafre, I spoke with #p2081000#. He confirmed that he does have a way to improve my mount--by turning it into a powerful dragon! However, like most good things in life, this is not free. He's agreed to sell me the dragon's perfume for the low, discounted price of #r20 million meso#k because it is rare. Really rare. So rare, in fact, that he still has his original stockpile. At 20 Million mesos per, I'm not surprised...

After thinking it over, I gave #p2081000# 20 million mesos and got the dragon's perfume. I took a whiff, it smells like candy, chocolate, and roses...I'm tempted to drink it! However, I want an awesome dragon mount, so I'll have to pass. I can't wait to ride it!

string.name: name
string.value: Ramain's Amazing Skills

I was finally able to learn the 'Maker' skill through Moren. Awesome!! Does this mean I can make something right now from scratch? But... where should I start? While I was standing there not knowing what to do, that was when a man came up to me to tell me something. That man happened to be Moren's friend and a legend in the field of making Monster Crystal, Ramain.

Ramain works with Moren and happens to be known as the master of producing Monster Crystals. He's a nice fellow, but his stuttering makes him really hard to understand. Anyway, after watching me being unsure of myself what to do with the skill, he offered to teach me how to produce a Monster Crystal. He then asked me to make one right there on the spot...\n\n#i4260000# #t4260000# #b#c4260000# / 1#k

Ramain, the master of producing Monster Crystals who is Moren's coworker, taught me how to produce a Monster Crystal. It was a bit difficult to understand him due to his constant stuttering, but it was very helpful. Then, he asked me to make one right there on the spot, challenging me to make 1 #t4260000#, the easiest Monster Crystal to make. After making one, Ramain took a look at it, and commended me for my effort. Hah! Does this mean I can be considered an Item Producer now?

I gave Moren the royal compliment that Abdullah VIII made for him. Moren in turn told me how proud he was of the progress I made as an item-producer. As gratifying as it was to receive compliments from someone like Moren, it also put a lot of pressure on me.

string.name: name
string.value: Moren's New Discovery

#b#m261000000##k is the land where Alcadnos and Zenumists form an uneasy truce in... One day, a news exploded in the Maple World where an alchemist from Zenumist, #b#p2110004##k, discovered a new method that will change the way alchemy works. #p2110004# was also looking for a capable apprentice that will spread his work to mainstream, and this caused a huge number of people to head over to #m261000000#...\r\nHe's apparently staying at #m261000002# of #m261000000#, which is a town of alchemists at Nihal Desert.

After spending a number of years conducting experiments, #b#b#p2110004##k, an alchemist under Zenumist Society, finally discovered a #bnew method#k of producing items, where the item can be created solely out of alchemy. To learn his new method, I visited #p2110004#. He said in order to acquire this new method, I'll have to take three classes... #bthe fundamentals of alchemy, the basic theory of science, and the actual application of alchemy#k...Sheesh, when can I attend all those classes?

#b#m261000000##k is the land where Alcadno and Zenumist form an uneasy truce in... I managed to stay awake for Carson's class on the Fundamentals of Alchemy. Yay!

I was able to keep track of Hughes the Fuse's disorienting science class. Yay!!

Moren told me he needs some time to prepare the materials for the class, and told me to talk to him when I'm ready.
I went through Moren's class on the actual application of the new method. This was fun!

string.name: name
string.value: Moren's Second Round of Teaching

I think I have gotten quite familiar with producing items, and I am sure Moren would be shocked to see my prowess in it. Right at that time, Moren called me and told me if I ever had anything to do in Magatia, make sure to stop by and see him.

I wound up heading to Magatia after seeing Moren's message. As soon as I saw him, however, instead of a hearty hug, he gave me a huge scolding. Apparently, he saw one of the items I made at the Free Market, and he was so disgusted by my poor quality of work that he vowed to set me straight by giving me a test.
The test is actually making an Intermediate Monster Crystal. Hmmm... this is quite intense.

#i4260003# #t4260003# #b#c4260003# / 1

Moren gave me a lecture on how I had become complacent, and told me I had to start again from scratch. After passing his test by successfully creating the Intermediate Monster Crystal, he let me go, and I realized my item-producing skills have gotten that much better as a result of his words.

Moren had been devoting all of his time to creating a new item. When I visited him at Magatia, he seemed so into his work that he didn't even realize I was there, and kept on mumbling illegible things. That's when I noticed something dropped behind his back. What is that?

I visited Moren at a lab in Magatia, but he seemed very much into his work that he didn't notice me walking in. That's when I noticed a piece of paper dropped from behind his back. The note contained a whole bunch of notes. What does it say?

string.value: The Book of Invisible Ink

string.name: parent
string.value: Extreme Temptation

I found a mysterious book deep in the #m230000000# sea while exploring. It is Bowman-related and mentions mastery of a skill known as Eye of the Heart. There's also a fading inscription about obtaining something from the book itself. Could this be a skill book? I must find out! #p2040052# knows a lot about books. I should ask if he can decipher anything useful from this book...

#b#p2040052##k read the book and speculated that the book must've been written with invisible ink to conceal valuable information. Clever...but not impossible to break. He says I have to get a special type of ink in order to read it. He can use the ink to restore the inscriptions so it is once again readable. The ingredients are #b#t04000183#, #t02022000#, and #t04006000##k...I hope this isn't all for naught...

#i4000183##t4000183# #b#c4000183# / 50#k
#i2022000##t2022000# #b#c2022000# / 10#k
#i4006000##t4006000# #b#c4006000# / 30#k
#i4161018##t4161018# #b#c4161018# / 1#k.
I found the ingredients and returned them to #p2040052#. He said making the ink takes a bit of time, so I'll have to wait until it's ready.

string.name: name
string.value: The Ancient Book

string.name: parent
string.value: Extreme Temptation

After I handed him all the ingredients, #p2040052# sprinkled the ink on the book. Before our eyes, the ink soaked into the pages and restored the words! It revealed information about the bowman's ultimate skill! What could that be? It sounds powerful...I should go ask #b#p1012100##k. \n\n#t4161024# #b#c4161024# / 1#k.

I related the entire tale of the ink restoring the pages, and how #p2040052# mentioned it was made with invisible ink to prevent knowledge of this technique from spreading into unworthy hands. She has agreed to take a further look into the book to find out more.
