string.name: name
string.value: Manji's Test

I obtained a book I can't read. It looks like it's written in a strange language. The writing is crude, almost like an animal wrote it...a kind of monster language. I wonder if #b#p1022002##k would know how to read it. Couldn't hurt to speak with him...

My hunch paid off. When I asked #b#p1022002##k about the book, he examined the language closer and came to a conclusion. He said the book is about the #bRush#k skill. He offered to translate, but he said that I must prove myself as one worthy to obtain such power--a true warrior in his eyes. I must eliminate #r200 #o9300087##k in #m910500100# located at the entrance of the Sanctuary, deep in Sleepywood. Manji saw that I was surprised by the high number and advised me to make a party with a few of like-minded companions to ensure victory. This is precisely what friends are for...\n\n#o9300087# #r#a61101##k

With a bit of help from my trusty weapon, I easily defeated the requisite number that #p1022002##k requested. As promised, he translated the book, and it revealed the famed skill known as Rush. I can't wait to try it out!

string.value: The Secret Behind Space Time Transformations

When I told Papulatus that I had come from the future, he seemed very interested in learning more about me. I guess he got even more excited when I told him that he, in the future, was doing some pretty major things... Little does he know that he's doing some pretty radical, negative things... Anyway, how am I supposed to get back to the future now?

Papulatus asks me to be his guinea-pig for the research he's been working on, which is almost complete. He says he'll send me back into the future where I came from... I don't like the idea that I'm a guinea-pig for his research, but I can't stay in the past like this forever. I guess I should trust Papulatus for now and get back to the future to tell Rolonay about what had happened.
I don't know if it's a remnant of the power I felt during my transition between dimensions but I've somehow acquired the power to control space and time. I'll call this skill 'Time Lift'.

string.name: name
string.value: How to Improve Your Strength
I hear that Kyrin is looking for me, now that I've become a Captain. She apparently wants to teach me some new skills...
I must show Kyrin my skills to prove what I'm capable of. I'd better make sure I'm ready to show her everything I've got and stand up to her for at least 2 minutes.
I've finally gained Kyrin's confidence. Kyrin taught me the Battleship Skill in return.

string.name: name
string.value: Observe the Spirit Vikings
I've learned the Battleship Skill but I don't really know how to use it freely as of yet. I can't figure out what the problem is! I'd better ask Kyrin.

So I guess I still need to learn some more skills before I can use the Battleship Skill, plus I need to learn how to properly control the battleship before I can learn how to use the skill itself... Let me go watch the Vikings in Ludibrium, and to prove that I've completed my training, I must defeat #r150 Spirit Vikings#k and bring back #b50 Spirit Viking Flags#k for Kyrin.
I took the proof of my training to Kyrin and she taught me the Battleship Cannon Skill in return.

string.name: name
string.value: Observe the Gigantic Spirit Vikings
I've learned the Battleship Skill but I don't really know how to use it freely as of yet. I can't figure out what the problem is! I'd better ask Kyrin.

So I guess I still need to learn some more skills before I can use the Battleship Skill, plus I need to learn how to properly control and attack from the battleship while riding on it before I can learn how to use the skill itself... Let me go watch the Gigantic Spirit Vikings in Ludibrium, and to prove that I've completed my training, I must defeat #r150 Gigantic Spirit Vikings#k and bring back #b50 Vikings' Token#k for Kyrin. 

#i4031874##t4031874# #b#c4031874# / 50#k 
#o8141100# #r#a63901##k
I took the proof of my training to Kyrin and she taught me the Battleship Torpedo Skill in return.

string.name: name
string.value: Jonathan's Court
I should go and meet with Bart. His royal highness is asking for me so...
You're telling me he's the Ruling King of the Seagulls? Why would the King of the Seagulls be looking for me? Well, let me go see him and find out.
Jonathan... The King of the Seagulls. Well he certainly has a presence about him.

string.name: name
string.value: Mission Free the Monsters
Shulynch is sending me an SOS signal. Is there an emergency?

Rolonay's old friend, Delli, who, in the past, worked with Rolonay to rescue the monsters that were spellbound by evil powers, is apparently now in grave danger. Shulynch wants me to help rescue her. I'll go and rescue Delli!
I rescued Delli and learned how to become friends with monsters in return.

string.name: name
string.value: Excessively Charming
#b#p1012117##k wants to talk to you since you reached Lv. 30 Charm. His work in the #b#m100000104##k isn't keeping #p1012117# busy enough, is it?

#p1012117# wants you to meet him at the Hair Salon in #m100000000# so he can tell you about true Charm. What is he going to tell you? Get a #b#t1162005##k, as per his request, and go see him. You can find one while harvesting herbs.\n\n#i4032933##t4032933# #b#c4032933# / 1#k
#p1012117# explained that truly Charming people care about what they put in their pockets. Even the unseen is important when it comes to fashion... Well, now you can use the Pocket slot.

string.name: name
string.value: Star of Maple World
#b#p1052121##k, the CEO of Big Hit Records in #bKerning Square#k, has something to tell you. Maybe a new record deal?
#p1052121# thinks you are the one she's been looking for and she wants you to come see her in person at Kerning Square. Take the subway from #m103000000# to reach Kerning Square.
#p1052121# was sure you had what it took to be a star! Even after you turned her down, #p1052121# suggested you take acting lessons. After all, you could always change your mind!

string.name: name
string.value: Suspicious Expression
#p1052121# is convinced you should take an #bacting class#k. What kind of class might it be? Talk to #p1052121# in #bKerning Square#k.
#p1052121# says acting is all about observing others and impersonating them. She wants you to go to #b#m100000000##k and observe #b#p1012003##k so you can copy his expressions...
You learned a suspicious expression from observing #p1012003#.

string.name: name
string.value: Surprised Expression
#p1052121# is convinced you should take an #bacting class#k. What kind of class might it be? Talk to #p1052121# in #bKerning Square#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Weapon of Choice
You reached your 4th job advancement before 2013/04/30! Go to Neville to claim your special reward.
You reached your 4th job advancement before 2013/04/30! Go to Neville to claim your special reward.
You reached your 4th job advancement before 2013/04/30 and went to Neville to claim your special reward.

string.name: name
string.value: An Arrangement from the Goddess.
After countless battles... the goddess has prepared something for me. I better go visit the Statue of Goddess at Orbis.

The statue was always silent, but all of a sudden, I could hear a voice. The goddess told me as a person that has reached the highest level that is available, and challenged me to step up and put in the effort to help others. She told me to let her know of my decision. Hmm...

I received a new skill from the Goddess called the Echo of the Hero. This isn't for my own benefit, but for everyone else around me. The statue, which always had a sad face on, seems to be smiling as I look at it once more.

string.value: Protect Ludibrium

A mysterious power appeared in Ludibrium, and then suddenly disappeared. Chaos ensued. Now is the time to straighten up the screwed-up time of Ludibrium. I'll need to go see #b#p2041021##k, who's at the #bPath of Time#k under Ludibrium.
I met up with #b#p2041021##k at the Path of Time. I promised him to find a new source of energy that may replace the original Time Sphere, which had been the main source of power for Ludibrium.
I gathered up enough #b#t4031170#s#k and gave them to #b#p2041021##k as a replacement for the Time Sphere. I think he can make a new source of power with #i4031170#.

There is, however, a way to recover the energy from those monsters; defeat them and they'll cough up the item that stores the energy. I'll need to gather up 300 Tachions and 100 Mysterious Powders.

string.value: The Lost Piece of Crack
I lost the #t4031179# that #p2041023# gave me. I better go back to #p2041021# and tell him the truth

I lost the #t4031179# that's been given to me by #p2041023#. After telling #b#p2041021##k of the situation, he wanted me to talk to Flo again. I'm afraid #b#p2041023##k may be less than pleased by the fact that I lost a very valuable #b#t4031179##k.

After telling #p2041021# that I lost #t4031179#, he wanted me to go see #p2041023# again and talk to him. #p2041023# was pretty upset that I lost the valuable #t4031179#, but then wanted me to really make sure not to ever lose it again, while giving me the #rlast remaining #t4031179##k that he kept to himself. He warned me that this is the last one, and that if I ever lose it again, #rI won't be able to get it back ever again.#k. I better make sure not to lose it, and give it to #p2041021#.

string.value: Papulatus's counterattack

string.name: name
string.value: Moira's Whereabouts

string.name: parent
string.value: War of the Dragons
I heard recently #p2081000# in #m240000000# often looks up at the sky. Who is he waiting for? Let's go see #p2081000#.

#p2081000# in #m240000000# was concerned about #b#p2081006##k, a close magician friend, because he had recently lost contact with her. #p2081006# is very close to dragons in Minar Forest and a few days ago, she went to the forest because she heard that the dragons were under danger. Since then, she lost all contact with her. What could've possibly happened to the dragons in Minar Forest and where has #p2081006# disappeared to? Wouldn't I be able to find her somewhere #bbeyond Dragon's Forest#k?
#p2081000# asked me look for magician #p2081006#. After getting lost for awhile, I was finally able to meet #p2081006# at the top of the entrance of the Cave of Life at the dragon's nest.

string.name: name
string.value: Secret Medicine for Transformation

string.name: parent
string.value: War of the Dragons

Moira, whom I met at the entrance of the Cave of Life, asked me to defeat Horntail. She said that she would make me a secret medicine that allows one to transform into a dragon, which I'll need to pass through the entrance of the cave that is guarded by Horntail's follower, Keroben. 
Let's get back to Moira with all the ingredients.

Moira said that she will make me a secret medicine to transform if I bring her all the ingredients she had asked of me, which I would need to get passed #p2081005# and enter Horntail's cave.. Let's get all the ingredients to Moira. Moira made me a secret medicine that can transform me into Cornian.

string.name: name
string.value: Badge of a Squad Member
Moira says she has a personal request...

Moira tells me that she was once a member of the Dragon Squad, and that she is worried about other members, now scattered to the winds. She asked me to look for the badge of the members. She said if I bring three badges from the members and the certificates from Zakum, Papulatus and Pianus by defeating them in battle, she would appoint me as an #rHonorary Squad Member#k and show me the #bsecret passage to cave#k that only members know about...

string.name: name
string.value: Sabitrama's Life Work
Sabitrama of Sleepywood is apparently losing sleep over something. What must that be?

A committee member? What the...
I feel like being pushed into this by Sabitrama, but I think it'll be fun solving the riddles of the ancient archives. The archive stated as such. 

Regarding the 1st Herb: 
The spirit of black and white bids adieu to the land and appears before me. Mark on the two silent spirits, and the spirit will intermingle to transform into the 1st Herb

Regarding the 2nd Herb: 
What do you think of the one that snuffs loneliness and darkness in the cradle, while the soul is vacated from the body? The soul that cannot return must find a soul mate that shall spend the eternity with. You're the doll, and inside, you shall find the 2nd Herb.

Hmmm...where do I begin?

Being called a committee member stinks, but I got paid well, and it was fun. The clues to the 3rd Herb are still nowhere to be found, but ... I actually feel like helping him out once more.\nI should drop by sometime later.

Sabitrama found the clues needed for the 3rd Herb.
The message was still too hard to understand. The archive said something like this! ...
What kind of an ominous herb is this?? This herb cannot be placed near a human being, so seal up the force in a spherical object, and never let it see the day of light again...

If it's anything like the herbs before, then I'll still have to obtain this through monsters again. Arrrgh, this is frustrating!

We found the 3rd Herb, but it is tightly sealed inside Lazy Buffy's Marble. It seems like it's been attached for so long, that I don't think we can just pluck it out of the sphere. Sabitrama then mentioned something like applying modern science to opening this. We've come so far, that there's no way we're about to give up.\nBut then again, who am I supposed to find?'

string.name: name
string.value: Ancient Artifacts

John Barricade has told me about the Ancient Artifacts I've found in my offline travels (playing the MapleStory Trading Card Game). He thinks that these can be used to construct powerful weapons and items. If I bring him a valid set of those I find, he'll be able to tell me what I can make and how to make them.

string.name: name
string.value: Summer Break: Cody's BBQ - Start
Hooray for Summer! I heard Cody's having a barbecue! I better head over and see if I can help!

I spoke with Cody, and it looks like he needs help. I'll need to bring 10 #b#t4031664#s#k 10 #b#t4031665#s#k and 10 #b#t4031666##k to Cody so he can finish cooking. Just the sound of all that makes me hungry!
I got all the ingredients Cody needed to start the barbecue! With the items he gave me, I can continue to enjoy the summer in style!

string.name: name
string.value: Finding Jack
I heard that John Barricade has received news from his brother Jack! I should go find John in Bigger Ben and see what he's learned.

Apparently, Jack Barricade is in Masteria and has discovered Crimsonwood Keep deep in the Phantom Forest. However, the last letter John received from his brother was dated over a month ago. John wants me to head to Crimsonwood after him and see why Jack's communiques have stopped. Looks like I need to make my way through the Phantom Forest... I'd better stock up on potions!

I found Jack Barricade resting in a cave on Crimsonwood Mountain. It turns out that after exploring the Masterian wilderness for weeks, Jack finally came across the ancient stronghold - only it wasn't deserted. Jack was captured and imprisoned in the Keep by the evil soldiers I've been seeing around, but luckily managed to escape. John will be relieved that Jack is okay.

string.name: name
string.value: Translated Communique
I lost the translated communique. Let's go to Elpam Gorlab!
I told Elpam Gorlab what I want.
I got the translated communique from Elpam Gorlab again. Thank You!

string.name: name
string.value: The Mark of Heroism

Lukan told me about the Valley of Heroes and the giant Menhir columns barring the way through. He mentioned that the Heroic Statues that line the valley would also act as teleporters, for only someone who had an artifact known as the #t3992039#. Perhaps someone well-versed in ancient artifacts would know something about these items... I think I may have an idea on who to ask. Otherwise, it's time for some ledge hopping!

I was right: John Barricade's extensive knowledge about ancient civilizations and items has paid off again! He'll give me the Barricades' #t3992039# if I reimburse him for the materials they had to acquire to recreate it: #b1 #t4004000##k, #b10 #t4010006#s#k and #b4 #t4032005#s#k. I also need to beat #b100 #o9400574#s#k. The only problem: Typhons nest in the upper reaches of the mountain! To get up the mountain, I'll have to go through the Valley first! Ugh! Looks like a catch-22! Hmmm, I guess I could see if someone else might have these feathers... I wonder if anyone else has already made it through the Valley on their own?

JJohn gave me the #t3992039# artifact after I brought him the hard-to-find #t4032005#s and the other materials. Now I'll be able to the Heroic Statues to get through the Valley. However, it's not all candy and cake yet; I still need to figure out the correct statues to use, but at least it'll make it easier for me to move around. Guess I'll try each statue as I go along and see where they lead!

string.name: name
string.value: The Brewing Storm

I've heard tell that many travelers get lost in the spooky Phantom Forest. If I come across any of them, perhaps one of them will have an interesting tale to tell about the area. I should search them out, but I better make sure I don't become one of these lost travelers myself... yikes!

I met a knight lost in the Phantom Forest named #bLukan de Vrisien#k. His armor is very ancient-looking, and he seems to be from another era. Lukan asked if I knew anything about the unfriendly #b#o9400581##k warriors wandering the forest. He seems to hate them, though strangely, his armor looks almost exactly like theirs...lightning bolts and all! Regarding this, Lukan remains tight-lipped... at least until I prove I'm not in league with them. To gain his trust, and prove my fighting prowess, I need to #bdefeat 100 of these #o9400581#s#k and #bcollect 15 of their badges#k to bring to him.

After defeating the Stormbreakers as he requested, Lukan explained that he is a #bStormcaster Knight#k from Crimsonwood Keep. When I told him that Crimsonwood Keep was ancient history, and that Masteria had been lost for a millennium, he seemed at a loss for words. Somehow, he has been transported to this time period, his future. Strange things are brewing indeed.

string.name: name
string.value: Storming the Castle

To enter the Grandmaster Hall of Crimsonwood Keep and find the new twisted Masters, Jack Barricade says I'll need to find some way to open the gate to the Keep's Inner Sanctum. Perhaps someone who has firsthand knowledge of the Keep will know what I need... and I know just who to ask!

I asked Lukan about the Inner Sanctum Gate, and as I surmised, he knew how to get in. Being a well-respected Stormcaster Knight, he was given a #bCrimsonwood Keystone#k by the Keep's Grandmasters. However, Lukan thinks that I'm mad to assault the castle and refuses to give me the key, calling it a suicide mission. However, if I can whittle down the Keep's defenders, he'll relent and give me the Keystone. I've already put the hurt on the #o9400581#s, but I'll need to defeat at least #b75 #o9400576#s, 75 #o9400578#s#k, and #b75 #o9400579#s#k more to put a sizeable enough dent in this evil army!

I defeated the twisted Crimsonwood warriors! And true to his word, Lukan gave me his #b#t3992041##k. He also said that although the Keystone will physically unlock the Inner Sanctum Gate, the red energy field that surrounds them is foreign to him, and likely a new addition by the Keep's new Masters. I should take the key back to Jack Barricade and let him know what I've discovered.

string.name: name
string.value: The Fallen Woods

I've heard people say that there's a band of bandits in the Phantom Forest. Maybe they're responsible for the travelers that go missing in the woods. Perhaps I should investigate and see if there is any truth to this story

Turns out that these so-called bandits are not responsible for any disappearances, at least so they say. However, I'm still not really sure why they're camped out here in the middle of these haunted woods. Their leader, a mysterious tough named #bTaggrin#k, seems quite unfriendly to strangers. Taggrin said that there was one thing I could do however: #bcut down 25 of each type of the possessed Phantom Trees#b and bring him #b25#k of their #bseeds#k. I'm not sure why he wants them, but I guess the fewer angry trees around the better for everyone.

I fulfilled Taggrin's request and brought him the fallen seeds from the Phantom Trees. He seemed to warm up to me for doing this, and has opened the bandit's camp up to me. Now I can buy and sell things from their provisioner, Mo. Whew, this has definitely saved me the effort of having to trek all the way back to NLC!

string.name: name
string.value: The Right Path

Jack Barricade has given me the #b#t3992040##k that he took from Taggrin. He explained that he was forced to steal it from Taggrin, who had refused to give it to him even after he'd won it in a bet fair and square. Now that Jack's made it up to the Crimsonwood Mountain, he's given the map to me for my own use. Perhaps I should return it to Taggrin? If I keep it, the map will come in handy while navigating the tricky Phantom Forest, #ballowing me to use the marked shortcuts#k and save time traveling. But at the same time, there's a part of me that feels that this map still rightfully belongs to Taggrin. What should I do? It's a dilemma...

I told Taggrin that I'd found Jack up the Crimsonwood Mountain, and explained Jack's purpose. Taggrin was surprised when I offered to return his Map of Phantom Forest to him... and was moved by my gesture. He seems to have warmed up to me, and ask that I return and speak to him. What could he want?

In return for making the honorable gesture of returning his map, Taggrin let me in on a secret of his own: he and his band are not bandits at all, but are actually #bRaven Ninjas#k, descendants of the ancient #bShadowknights#k! They're here to discover what happened to their ancestral Keep and the reason behind the disappearance of Masteria. As such, Taggrin is offering a bounty on the Keep's unrightful occupiers. I can now speak to Joko to redeem any #rbadges#k I find off these twisted warriors (the #r#o9400576#s#k, the #r#o9400581#s#k, the #r#o9400578#s#k, and the #r#o9400579#s#k) as well as #t4032012#s from the corrupted #o9400582#s for bounties, and includeing special equipment, scrolls, crafting items, and #bRaven Ninja gear#k!

string.name: name
string.value: The Fallen Warriors
I should speak to Taggrin to see if he has another task for me.

Taggrin has one more task for me: he wants me to hunt down #b50 #o9400580#s#k and collect #b50 of their #t4032010##k. Warning me that this would be no easy task, he explained that the wraiths are the souls of brave Crimsonwood Keep warriors who fell in battle in the forest, protecting the Keep from the invading Krakians. Never given a proper burial, they have become mindless undead, threatening the Keep's foes and innocent travelers alike. With these ashes, Taggrin intends to give these noble lost souls the final rest they so rightfully deserve.

Taggrin was impressed that I manage to collect the ashes from the #o9400580#s. I can now speak to #bFiona#k about #bupgrading any Raven Ninja gear#k I may have! Taggrin also mentioned that the talented ninja smith has experimented with some weapon designs of her own; I should speak to her about the possibility of #bcrafting new items#k from scratch.

string.name: name
string.value: Lost in Translation 1
I should see if Jack Barricade needs my help with anything...

Jack needs John's help, and needs me to be the go-between. He wants me to deliver a letter to his brother in NLC; the #bCoded Communique#k contains a transcription of some strange symbol code that he saw while being held in Crimsonwood Keep. Hopefully, with his expertise in ancient languages, John should be able to decipher it. I should hop to it! I have a feeling some serious events are unfolding...

Looks like Jack was right about the symbols he saw in the Grandmaster Council Hall; the Versalian code seems to indicate that the new Masters are planning to attack NLC with the soldiers they're training! It's going to be up to us to stop them!

string.name: name
string.value: Lost in Translation 2
I should see if John needs my help with anything...

After showing John the #bCoded Communique#k that Jack gave me, John used a #t4031680# to try to decipher the symbols... to no avail. While John attempts to fix and recalibrate the #t4031680#s to work on these symbols, he asked me to show the letter around to the #bother experts in town#k. Maybe they can shine some light on all this...
I told John about Elpam's translation, and John was able to fill in some more of the blanks for me. I need to get this new information Jack and see what else he knows...

string.name: name
string.value: Lost in Translation 3

I showed the #bCoded Communique#k to Elpam Gorlab, and he recognized the symbols as being #bVersalian#k! Elpam translated what he could and gave me a #bTranslated Communique#k. I should show this to John immediately!
I must traverse Crimsonwood Mountain and get this new information Jack and see what else he knows...!
I reached Jack and gave him the info-he's going through it all now...

string.name: name
string.value: Stemming the Tide

The Versalian code that Jack uncovered and that Elpam translated points to some sort of imminent attack on New Leaf City by the Twisted Masters' army. It's up to us to stop them! I should talk to John...
Someone who has firsthand knowledge of the Keep. I think I have an idea who might be able to help.

I brought Lukan's #bCrimsonwood Keystone#k to Jack. I explained what Lukan told me: that this would unlock the gate mechanically, but the red energy field was a new development. Jack thinks he can figure out a solution for the magical barrier, but he'll need some time. I should check in with him later and see if he's made any progress.

string.name: name
string.value: Fool's Gold

With all the strange occurrences in Masteria and New Leaf City, Lita Lawless must be busy! I'll bet that she's willing to accept my help...maybe I can earn some mesos in the process! A quick jaunt to the Kerning City subway and I'll be on my way to New Leaf City!

I spoke with Lita, and it looks like there a trickster roaming about the Phantom Forest. It caused her quite a bit of trouble-surprising for a warrior of her caliber. I've agreed to help rid the Forest of #b50#k these nefarious #o9400583#s, and as proof, I have to bring her #b50 of the strange silver clovers#k - she called them #b#t4032031#s#k. I'll be on guard-that forest is haunted...or so I've heard...

I ventured into the maddening Phantom Forest and came into contact with a number of the Leprechauns and after a series of battles, got 30 #t4032031#s. I returned them to Lita for the Bounty! She thanked me for my help, and mentioned that I can return to her for more bounty work!

I navigated the Phantom Forest and collected 50 of the #t4032011# the Elder Wraiths had upon them. It was strange to finally fight one. They were eerily quiet for being so vicious. I wonder if there's more to their story...perhaps someone in the Phantom Forest would know...

He was a former warrior of Crimsonwood Keep that was experimented on by the mysterious Alchemist, the same one who corrupted the Krakians. He now roams the Phantom Forest, and I must defeat him and bring his #t4031903# head to Lita as proof of my triumph!
It was a tough fight, but I brought down the mighty horseman and returned his #t4031903# to Lita. I wonder how many other lives the mysterious Alchemist has ruined...

I spoke with Lita, and I'm pretty sure I'm getting the short end of the stick on this one. I have to venture into the Phantom Forest and find this creature they've named #o9400575# and claim its toe as proof I defeated him. Everyone else who's gone after this thing has never come back - I'd better stock up on potions and keep my guard up-who knows when it could appear?

I found this mysterious creature, and Lita wasn't kidding when she said it wrecked everyone that came after it! Although, when I was fighting it, I got the feeling that the Leprechaun on its back was just luring him into things...maybe it just doesn't know better? At any rate, I returned the toe to Lita and claimed the bounty. The more mesos, the better!

string.name: name
string.value: Bounty Master
I've completed all Bounty Hunter bounties for Lita Lawless! I think it's about time I'm deputized! I should head to New Leaf City and find out more!
I spoke with Lita, and she's all set to deputize me whenever I'm ready! Completing all those quests was hard, but well worth the effort!

I've been deputized by Lita Lawless as an official protector of New Leaf City! I've sworn to defend the area, and Masteria in general from all future threats...and from what it looks like, there's going to be a lot of them!

string.name: name
string.value: Attendance Check
So If I head over to #b#p9010000##k, then I'll be able to receive an attendance sheet? I see... so this is to check my ardent attendance to MapleStory. Sounds very intriguing...

#b#p9010000##k told me if I take this attendance sheet to #b#p9200000##k, then I'll be able to receive PB & J Sandwich, Chocolate Milk, Chips, Cookie, and Fruit Roll Up in return. If I continue to gather the items for 14 days, then on the 15th day, I can get a special prize! Apparently I have to come back every day to claim the prize!

As I was successful in checking my attendance, I received scrumptious lunch items in return. I better keep these items that I received from #p9200000# somewhere safe. \n#p9200000# told me if I give him all the items on the 15th day, I'll get something nice as well!

string.name: name
string.value: Attendance Check
I wonder what #b#p9200000##k will give me if I give him these items I collected for the last 2 weeks.
I came to MapleStory everyday and collected all the scrumptious lunch items. From what I hear, it has something to do with the 5 types of snacks I collected...
I gave #b#p9200000##k the lunch snacks I had collected for 14 days. Hope they didn't rot! Anyways, he seemed ecstatic and gave me a cool lunchbox that can be used as a weapon.

string.name: name
string.value: Donate Your Notebook
I wonder what all the commotion is about. Rumor has it that there's a race going on. The team that collects the most Notebooks will win. The reward is also said to be very nice...
I'm really anxious to find out which team is winning. I gotta get more players involved to win this race!
I gave Maple Administrator the Notebook. She seemed very ecstatic, as if it was for him... seriously, what did she do with all those notebooks?

string.name: name
string.value: Maple 7th Day Market opens tomorrow!
Tomorrow is the day of the Maple 7th Day Market!
Maple 7th Day Market opens tomorrow! Come join us!
Maple 7th Day Market opens tomorrow! Come join us!

string.name: name
string.value: Maple 7th Day Market
Today is the day of the Maple 7th Day Market!
Today is the day of the Maple 7th Day Market! It's here every Sunday!
Maple 7th Day Market is here today.

string.name: name
string.value: Helping the daughter of the poultry farm owner, Lazy Daisy
Let's go to the Maple 7th Day Market and find Lazy Daisy, the daughter of the poultry farm owner.

You will be rewarded for tending to Lazy Daisy's egg. The egg grows every time you hunt, and leaving the UI open will bring optimal results. And for the egg to grow into a chicken, you must apply the growth powder which is distributed by the Maple Admin daily. If you have succeeded in growing your egg to a chicken, you should go see Lazy Daisy who is visiting Henesys on Saturday.
You have successfully hatched Lazy Daisy's egg! You will be rewarded if you succeed more than 5 times, so let's try again!

string.name: name
string.value: Hatch the egg
There are things to be done in order to tend Lazy Daisy's egg successfully. Let's go see the GM.
You must go find the GM every day from Monday through Friday, and receive the growth powder and apply it on the egg.
You receive the growth power for today. Hurry up and apply it on your chicken.

string.name: name
string.value: Lost Spirits

string.name: parent
string.value: Lost Spirits
A new traveler is in the town of El Nath, I wonder what his story is... Perhaps something to do with Zakum? I should pay him a visit; I heard his name is Adonis.
I visited El Nath, and found Adonis. He's speaking to me now...

Adonis and I had an enlightening conversation about Zakum, and the residents of the former town. It appears that Zakum gains additional power from what Adonis calls 'Zakum Diamonds'. They are souls of those who fell in battle against the mighty Zakum. As they were fellow warriors and adventurers like me, their souls must be released. If I can find a relic of the old town, such as a Crystal Blade, Miner's Hat, El Nathian Cape or Cloak of Corruption and combine it with a Zakum Diamond, I can perform a 'Liberation Ritual' that will free the soul by transferring their power into that item. I can then wear the enchanted item for extra strength in battle! Only thing is, Zakum Diamonds only come from one place, Zakum himself. This won't be easy...

string.name: name
string.value: Dinner Fixins'
It's time for Thanksgiving and I'm ready for some home cookin'! I should pay Mom and Dad a visit over in Henesys!

I'm helping Mom and Dad make Thanksgiving dinner! I have to gather one of each ingredient: 1 ear of #b#t2020029##k, a can of #b#t2022262##k, a #b#t2022263##k, bowl of #b#t2022264##k and best of all, #b#t2022261##k. They promised me an #b#t4031529##k if I return quickly. I guess the Turkeys stole all the ingredients to make Thanksgiving fixins'... I guess they think that without the fixins', there'll be no dinner! No dinner? No way! Time to defeat some battle-hardened Turkeys!

My trusty weapon did a fine job of ruffling those rowdy turkeys' feathers, and I obtained all of the ingredients for Mom and Dad. In return, they gave me my #b#t4031529##k! I guess doing chores does pay off! I can take this to any of the Store Vendors in New Leaf City, and receive a #bNexon Game Card#k for it! ...I'd better get out of here before Aunt Petunia shows up! Mom mentioned that I can help her with dinner once a day until it's time to eat!

string.name: name
string.value: Game On! <CVS>
I helped Mom and Dad with Thanksgiving dinner and received my #bAllowance#k! Now I can head to #bHenesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City#k and obtain a #bNexon Game Card#k from one of the Vendors!

I have my #bAllowance#k, and I'm on my way to #bHenesys, Amoria, and New Leaf City#k! I just have to speak with one of the Vendors there to receive a #bNexon Game Card#k! Just have to make sure I have some room in my ETC slot for it...

I spoke with one of the vendors, and in return for my #bAllowance#k, I received a #bNexon Game Card#k! I can also take this to any of the Store Vendors in #bHenesys, Amoria, or New Leaf City#k if one store happens to be sold out. I can help Mom and Dad every day until the end of the event, receive #bAllowance#k and get another #bNexon Game Card#k. I should get as many as possible, because when the event ends, it will turn into MaplePoints that I can use in the Cash Shop! Free money! WOO HOO!

string.name: name
string.value: Little Suzy's X-Mas Dilemma

There's a little girl with a puzzled look on her face in New Leaf City. With X-mas time just around the corner, she should be happy... Why does she look so puzzled and confused instead? Looks like she may need some help with her Maplemas spirit!

Little Suzy was all excited for Maplemas this year... until she learned all about a similar holiday called 'Versalmas' from a strange green mouse named O-Pongo. Now she doesn't know what sounds more exciting - Maplemas... or Versalmas? Suzy needs my help to help her decide which version of X-mas she should celebrate this year. In order to do that, I'll have to speak to both Maple Claws and this O-Pongo character, and then come back and talk to her. Maplemas holiday from an alternate dimension, huh? Very curious...

I spoke to both Maple Claws and O-Pongo. It seems that both Maplemas and Versalmas have their merits. In the end, Suzy's put the decision on me: she's asked me to deliver her X-mas Wishlist to one of the two 'Santas,' which will determine which holiday she's celebrating this year. I have a feeling that this decision is important, that I'm not just making a choice for her... but also one for myself. Which holiday do I believe in?

string.name: name
string.value: The Spirit of Maplemas
To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to Maple Claws. I'm sure she's back in town now in Happyville.
To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to Maple Claws about Suzy's dilemma. Maple Claws listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy. I should talk to her in a bit.

Maple Claws gave me a message for Suzy: that as long as she remembers the essence of the Maplemas Spirit, it doesn't really matter what holiday traditions she chooses to follow this year. I should return to Suzy with Maple Claws' message once I've also spoken to O-Pongo.

string.name: name
string.value: A Versal Tradition
To help her decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, Little Suzy wants me to go talk to O-Pongo. I'd better speak with this strange green mouse and find out more details about Versalmas.
To help Little Suzy decide between Maplemas and Versalmas, I spoke to O-Pongo about Suzy's dilemma. O-Pongo listened and asked me to deliver a message to Suzy. I should talk to her in a bit.

Versal Power! I spoke with O-Pongo, the Versalmas Mouse, who is the 'Santa' for the Versal version of Maplemas, and learned a great deal about Versalmas. He told me about the customs for their holiday--quite different from the Maple World! The world of Versal is usually shrouded in darkness; Versalmas is an annual holiday that celebrates the emergence of the sun in their world, which shines for 90 straight days and only for these 90 days. For Versalmas, children receive presents every day for the first 30 days, and get cool treats like Sugar-coated Olives and Caramel Onions! Sounds pretty awesome... Now I'd better speak with Maple Claws and head back to Suzy... It makes me wonder for myself though, which holiday would I pick to celebrate? Hmmm...

string.name: name
string.value: A Very Merry Maplemas
Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo. I'm thinking I should give it to Maple Claws; I should go see her in Happyville.

I can give Little Suzy's Wishlist to Maple Claws. In doing so, she'll be counting on me to help me recover her presents for her this year. All I have to do now is to give Maple Claws the list to cement my decision. Yes... it's going to be a very Merry Maplemas this year!

I thought that Maplemas was the better holiday so I gave #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k to Maple Claws. In return, she gave me a red #bMaplemas Hat#k that I can wear proudly to show my Maplemas Spirit! Every time I help Maple Claws recover the presents stolen by monsters, she'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents with her in batches of #b10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100#k. I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards! I'll need to bring her presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing Maple Claws more presents will also help me earn #bMaplemas Spirit#k! If the total amount of #bMaplemas Spirit#k accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of #bVersalmas Cheer#k, Maple Claws will have a special something for me at the end of the event!

string.name: name
string.value: Happy Versalmas to You
Now that I have Little Suzy's Wishlist, I need to give it to either Maple Claws or O-Pongo. I should go see O-Pongo in New Leaf City if I want to give it to him. Decisions, decisions...
I'm thinking it's Versalmas for me this year! All I have to do now to cement my decision is to actually give Little Suzy's Wishlist to O-Pongo. I can't wait! It's time for a change of pace!

Looks like I'm celebrating Versalmas this year! I gave #bLittle Suzy's Wishlist#k to O-Pongo, and he gave me this awesome #bVersalmas Hat#k for me to wear proudly! Every time I bring O-Pongo presents I've collected from monsters, he'll reward me; I'll now be able to redeem presents to him in batches of #b10, 20, 30, 40, 60, 90, or 100#k. I'll get different rewards at different tiers; the more presents I bring at one time, the better the rewards! I'll need to bring him presents appropriate to my level though.\r\nBringing O-Pongo more presents will also help me earn #bVersalmas Cheer#k! If the total amount of #bVersalmas Cheer#k accumulated on my world beats out the total amount of #bMaplemas Spirit#k, O-Pongo will have something really nice for me at the end of the event!

string.name: name
string.value: Find the Ghost-scaring Chinese Firecrackers

The Lunar New Year is dawning upon us, and unfortunately, the town has been invaded by ghosts. In Asian mythology, the firecrackers are set off on New Year's to scare away ghosts. Apparently, the firecrackers made with the mysterious Asian powers have the power to produce explosions loud enough to totally eliminate these ghosts, and bring peace to the start of the new year. Better find Mr. Moneybags in Henesys for more information.

The God of Goods uses his special powers to create special firecrackers for these occasions. These firecrackers have the special power of scaring away ghosts with their ear-ringing explosions. \r\n#t4001128# #b#c4001128##k/30
I got a firecracker. Now I can able to repel ghost.

string.name: name
string.value: Finding the Ghost
Now that I have the Chinese Firecrackers with mysterious powers laden in it, the next stop for me is to go find a town where the ghosts are, and eliminate them with the firecrackers.
These Chinese Firecrackers with mysterious powers have to be set off near the ghosts. These ghosts are not necessarily easy to find, so I better keep my eyes open. \n\n#o9500197# #r#a85701##k
Awesome... this should bring peace and happiness to this year.

string.value: Spot On

I visited Mr. Spot and got the Mouse for Mom and Dad. I can get a #bNexon Prepaid#k from Mr. Spot if I ask them for #bAllowance#k. I'll cross my fingers...
I got my #bNexon Prepaid#k! I should keep it, because it will turn into Maple Points soon! SWEET!

string.name: name
string.value: Circle of Trust - Repaired Ring
I've lost the Ring I got from Moony on the way back to Gary and Shatima. Maybe Moony can help me out...
Moony has the Ring! I am saved. This time I should be very careful.
I got the Repaired Ring from Moony again, and now Gary and Shatima can get married! Phew, a lot of work, but well worth it!

string.name: name
string.value: Easter : Easter Basket
I better go check and see the Maple Administrator. She may have something in store for me...

The Maple Administrator needs #b100 Tree Branches#k, #b100 Squishy Liquids#k to make me an #rEaster Basket#k. I better go get those right now! 

#t4000003# #b#c4000003#/100#k
#t4000004# #b#c4000004#/100#k
I got the Easter Basket from the Maple Administrator. Mad Bunny may need this for something... I should go see him now.

string.name: name
string.value: Easter : Mad Bunny's Easter(Yellow)
I heard Mad Bunny isn't too happy with Easter. I should go talk to him and see what's up...

Mad Bunny needs #b10 Yellow Easter Eggs#k and an #bEaster Basket#k from me. He may be one angry bunny, but he did promise to pay me well for my service...

#t2022065# #b#c2022065#/10#k
#t4031283# #b#c4031283#/1#k
I gave him #b10 Yellow Easter Eggs#k with the #rEaster Basket#k and he gave me an #bEaster Charm#k with some EXP. Not bad...

string.name: name
string.value: 2nd Anniversary : Birthday Present (Red)
I should go visit the MapleStory Administrator. I heard MapleStory is celebrating its 2nd birthday, and she may have something in store for me...

The MapleStory Administrator said we'll be celebrating the anniversary in style and that there is a #bRED birthday present#k for me to look for. Now, where must that be...\n\n#t4031306# #b#c4031306#/1#k
I found the #bRED birthday present#k and gave it to the Maple Administrator. She opened the present for me, and gave me what was inside. That was pretty sweet!

string.name: name

string.name: name
string.value: 2nd Anniversary : Cody's Quest
Cody is supposedly in need of help. I should go see him at Henesys...

Cody said he's preparing a big party for the MapleStory staff with food and everything, but he forgot to buy the birthday candles for the cake! He seemed to be in a state of emergency, and asked me if I could gather up #b10 Birthday Candles#k for him. #bBirthday Candles#k? That's weird...

I gave him the #b10 Birthday Candles#k he requested. He seemed very much relieved by the fact that the party won't be ruined after all. He gave me a #rMaple Flag#k as a reward. Wow, I haven't seen these in a while!

string.name: name
string.value: About the Amorian Challenge!
Ames the Wise has good news for me. It looks like his brother, Amos the Strong, has finished his hunting ground for married couples. I should stop by and get some more info!

I visited Ames the Wise, and he explained the Amoria Party Quest in detail\n\nI must visit Amos the Strong at the end of Purplewood Forest, and if I'm #bmarried,#k I can enter. I can either bring my #bspouse or go at it solo#k. I must team up with #b5 other married people#k, and from there, the adventure begins!

That wasn't so bad! Amos the Strong seems much different from his brother Ames--he had muscles coming out of his muscles! To enter his hunting ground, I must be married, and can either bring my spouse or go at it with 5 other married people. I should visit Amoria more often...I wonder what else is in this land...

string.name: name
string.value: Summer Break: Cody's BBQ - Start
Hooray for Summer! I heard Cody's having a barbecue! I better head over and see if I can help!

I spoke with Cody, and it looks like he needs help. I'll need to bring 10 #b#t4031664#s#k 10 #b#t4031665#s#k and 10 #b#t4031666##k to Cody so he can finish cooking. Just the sound of all that makes me hungry!
I got all the ingredients Cody needed to start the barbecue! With the items he gave me, I can continue to enjoy the summer in style!

string.name: name
string.value: Deciphering the Scroll of Secrets
Maybe I should see Geanie at Ludibrium to seek help in deciphering the Scroll of Secrets.
Geanie said to open this magic box, she'll need #b#t4031072##k for it, and the only way to obtain it is by defeating #b#o2230103#s#k.
I requested Geanie to decipher this scroll of secrets, and received the magic box as a reward. Once I opened the box with the key, I was shocked by what I found inside.

string.name: name
string.value: Teo's reminiscence
I think I can get some help from Teo in Lith Harbor...

I met #bTeo#k at Lith Harbor. Teo told me I remind him of his youth when he went for many journeys. Reminiscing about his past, Teo told me he wanted to help me. He said if I bring #b50 #t4000016##k and #b30 #t4000004##k, he will recognize my potentials and support me...ha! This is a Piece of cake!
I proved how good I am to Teo at Lith Harbor. Teo has acknowledged my abilities and financially supported me. With this support, I'll be a great adventurer.

string.name: name
string.value: Teo's Nostalgic Reminiscing
You hear that you can receive help from Teo in Lith Harbor...

You meet #bTeo#k in Lith Harbor. Teo says that you remind him of when he was younger, and he wants to help you. He says that he will recognize your potential and support you if you bring him #b50 #t4000016#s#k and #b30 #t4000004#s#k... For an awesome adventurer like you, this should be a piece of cake.

#t4000016# #b#c4000016##k/50

#t4000004# #b#c4000004##k/30
You showed your potential to #b#p1002001##k, who you met in Lith Harbor. #b#p1002001##k recognized your potential and gave you some mesos that should come handy during your adventures.

string.value: 깜짝이벤트 : 스페셜 알파벳?
추석 당일 메이플 운영자가 한과 알파벳 중 스페셜 알파벳을 선물로 준다는데? 추석날 하루 뿐이라니 찾아가볼까?
추석 당일에만 깜짝 이벤트로 스페셜 알파벳 중 원하는 알파벳을 1종 준다고 한다.
추석날 깜짝 이벤트로 스페셜 알파벳을 받았다.

string.name: name
string.value: 추석 송편 만들기
쌀가루와 꿀, 솔잎을 메이플 운영자에게 모아가면 추석 음식인 송편을 만들어 준다고 한다.
송편의 재료인 쌀가루와 꿀, 솔잎을 모아 분홍 송편을 만들었다.

string.name: name
string.value: 추석 금송편 만들기
추석 음식으로 만든 분홍 송편 10개를 금송편 1개와 바꿀 수 있다는데? 금송편이라.. 이걸 유용하게 쓸 수 있을 것도 같은데...
추석 음식으로 만든 분홍 송편을 10개 갖고 갔더니 금송편으로 바꿔준다고 하였다.\n\n#t2022037:# #b#c2022037#/10#k
분홍송편 10개를 모아 금송편으로 바꾸었다.

string.name: name
string.value: 풍요로운 추석
헤네시스의 웃어른이신 스탄 장로님께 금송편을 선물해보는 건 어떨까?
헤네시스의 웃어른이신 스탄 장로님께 금송편을 드리며 추석 인사를 드려볼까?
헤네시스의 웃어른이신 스탄 장로님께 안부를 여쭈어 보는 보람찬 추석이다.

string.name: name
string.value: 월묘와 함께하는 풍요로운 추석
#t4031187#을 간절히 원하는 사람이 있다는데, 누굴까? #b#p9010000##k를 찾아가 보자.
#p9010000#는 #b달나라#k에 살고 있는 #b#p9001103##k가 맛있는 #b#t4031187##k을 구하고 있다고 말했다. 월묘가 송편을? 무슨 일이지? 금송편을 가지고 달나라로 가보자.
#p9001103#는 요즘은 월묘의 떡보다 인간의 떡이 더 맛있는 것 같다며 그 비결이 뭔지 알기 위해 #t4031187#을 구하고 있다고 말했다. 비결을 알아내기 전까지 계속 #t4031187#을 구한다고 하니, #t4031187#이 생기는대로 가져다 주자.

string.name: name
string.value: 추석 한과(유과) 만들기
찹쌀가루와 꿀 단지, 기름병을 메이플 운영자에게 모아가면 추석 음식인 유과를 만들어 준다고 한다.

유과의 재료인 찹쌀가루와 신선한 식용 기름이 들어있는 기름병, 달콤한 꿀이 들어있는 꿀단지를 모아오라고 하였다.

#t4031184:# #b#c4031184#/1
#k#t4031185:# #b#c4031185#/1
#k#t4031186:# #b#c4031186#/1#k
재료를 모아 유과를 만들 수 있었다. 유과는 한과 중 하나로 찹쌀가루를 반죽하여 튀겨낸 다음 맛있는 꿀을 바르고 다시 고물을 묻혔다. 달콤한 향이 유과에서 풍겨 나온다.

string.name: name
string.value: 추석 한과세트 만들기
유과 20개를 모아 한과세트로 만들어보는 건 어떨까? 선물하기에는 안성맞춤이겠는 걸?
유과 20개를 모아가니 정성이 가득 담긴 한과세트로 만들어준다는데.. \n\n#k#t2022038:# #b#c2022038#/20#k
유과 20개를 모아 정성이 가득 담긴 한과세트로 만들었다.

string.name: name
string.value: 풍요로운 한가위
마련한 한과세트를 루디브리엄의 공장장 카호님께 갖고 가 추석 안부를 여쭤볼까..
루디브리엄의 공장장 카호님께 추석 안부를 여쭤볼까?
루디브리엄의 공장장 카호님께 한과세트를 선물하며 추석의 풍성함을 기원했다.

string.name: name
string.value: 월묘와 함께하는 풍요로운 한가위
#t4031188#에 대한 연구를 하는 사람이 있다던데, 누굴까? #b#p9010000##k를 찾아가 보자.
#p9010000#는 #b달나라#k에 살고 있는 #b#p9001104##k가 #b#t4031188##k를 구하고 있다고 말했다. 월묘가 #t2022005#라니, 무슨 일일까? #t4031188#를 가지고 달나라로 가보자.
#p9001104#는 인간이라는 종족에 대한 근원적인 연구에 몰두중이라며, 그를 위해 인간의 전통음식인 #t2022005#를 구하고 있다고 말했다. 연구를 마치기 전까지 계속 #t4031188#를 구한다고 하니, #t4031188#가 생기는대로 가져다 주자.

string.value: 추석 화양적 만들기

string.name: name
string.value: 추석 화양적 한 접시 만들기
#t2022352# 30개를 모아 #b#t4032040##k를 만들어 보면 어떨까?
#t2022352# 30개를 모아 맛도 모양도 좋은 #t4032040#로 만들었다.

string.name: name

string.value: 메이플스토리 1000일 기념 이벤트
몬스터들이 출현하기 시작하면서 평화로운 메이플스토리의 세계가 흔들리기 시작했다. 메이플스토리의 평화를 위해 여행자들의 발걸음이 시작된지 그로부터 1000일이 지났다. 메이플스토리를 구하기 위해 가장 먼저 용기를 내 이 곳을 찾았던 그 영웅의 행방은?? 리스항구에서 그를 가장 처음 만났다던 #b존#k을 만나보자.
말이 없을 것 같던 존에게 말을 걸자 그는 "소문을 들었어요?"라는 말로 자신의 영웅을 만났던 이야기를 시작하였다. 자신에게 용기를 준 그의 행방이 궁금하다고 하였다. 그건 나도 마찬가지인 걸? 존은 그 영웅에게 만지를 소개시켜 주었다고 하였으니... 전사의 마을로 가볼까?
리스항구의 존이 말하던 그 영웅의 흔적을 조금은 찾은 것 같다. 만지에게 메이플스토리의 혼란이 시작된 경위를 전해듣고 지금까지 줄곧 여행을 다니며 몬스터를 퇴치하고 있다는데...

500일도 전 그 영웅이 온 몸에 상처투성이로 나타나 자신의 가방을 잃어버린 일에 대해 이야기 해주었다고 하였다. 그 가방 안에는 앞으로 그 여행자의 계획에 대해 적혀 있었다고 하는데... 와일드보어 지역을 지나오던 길에 급습한 와일드보어에게 가방을 빼앗겼다는데...
와일드보어에게서 되찾아온 그의 가방에는 각 종 포션들과 메이플깃발...그리고 그의 일기장이 들어있었다. 만지는 나에게 그의 일기장을 주면서 일기장에 적힌 단서를 보고 그를 찾아 떠나라고 했다.

가방에서 나온 일기장을 펼쳐보자 이 곳에 와서 적은 여행 기록이 적혀있다. 그의 앞으로의 계획에 대해서도 알 수 있을 것 같은데.. 일기장을 뒤져 그가 어디로 갔을지 찾아보자.
던전의 또 다른 문 앞에서 그윈을 만났다. 그의 이상을 이루기 위해 저토록 희생하는 모습이라니... 그윈을 도와 메이플스토리의 평화가 찾아오는 날까지.. 모험을 멈추지 말아야겠다는 생각이 들었다.

string.value: 켄타의 부탁

#b#p9010000##k는 아쿠아로드의 동물원에 있는 #b#p2060005##k에게서 도움이 필요하다는 연락을 받았지만 어린이날 준비로 바쁘다고 했다. #b#p9010000##k 대신 #b#p2060005##k를 도와주자.
#b#p9010000##k대신 #b#p2060005##k를 도와주러 가보자. #b#p2060005##k는 아쿠아로드 어딘가에 살고 있다고 했는데..

string.name: name
string.value: 동물들을 위한 특식
아쿠아리움 동물원의 사육사 #b#p2060005##k가 부탁할 것이 있다고 한다.
#b#p2060005##k대신 동물원 식구들에게 준 특식을 준비해주고 #b#t04140103##k를 받았다.

string.name: name
string.value: 아쿠아로드 청소하기
아쿠아리움 동물원의 사육사 #b#p2060005##k가 어린이날 준비로 바쁘다고 하는데..

#b#p2060005##k는 어린이날을 맞아 동물원을 찾는 방문객들을 위해 근처의 물고기들을 물리쳐 줄 것을 부탁했다. 

#o4230201# #r#a93961##k 
#o4230124# #r#a93963##k
#o4230123# #r#a93962#
#b#p2060005##k가 어린이날 준비하는 것을 도와주고 #b#t4140103##k를 받았다.

string.name: name
string.value: 햇님이에게 선물을
얼마 전 #b#p1061004##k가 잃어버린 아쿠아리움 초대권을 찾아준 적이 있는데, #b#p1061004##k는 #b#p9010000##k님께 감사의 뜻을 전해 달라고 했다. 메이플 운영자를 찾아가 보자.
어린이날 선물로 #b#p2071008##k에게 인형들을 선물하고 보답으로 #b#t4140103##k를 받았다.

string.name: name
string.value: The Secrets Behind the Mundane Statue
Apparently, the truth behind the long-time legend of mysterious Monster Statue is out... I better go see #b#p9010000##k and hear the story behind it.
I better go see #b#p2040050##k, the one responsible for uncovering truth behind these strange Monster Crystal Statues.
I met up with #b#p2040050##k, who knows the secret behind these Monster Crystal Statues...

string.name: name
string.value: The Mysterious Monster Crystal Statue
Apparently, #b#p2040050##k discovered the hidden secrets behind the Mundane Monster Statues. I better go visit #b#p2040050##k.
After gathering up the gems, #b#p2040050##k gave me a new Monster Crystal Statue. I can turn into a monster for a short period of time with this!

string.name: name
string.value: Maple GM's Congrats on the 3 year Anniversary
#b#p9010000##k wanted to show his appreciation to everyone in MapleStory for the support, and wants people to see him.
MapleStory is now 3 years old all thanks to you!
Hope you enjoy MapleStory for many years to come! The best is yet to come!

#b#p9010000##k는 #b#t04161002##k를 주면서 엘리니아의 마법사 #b#p1032001##k님께 보여드리면 아주 좋아하실 거라고 했다.
#b#p1032001##k님께 #b#t04161002##k을 보여드렸더니 작은 선물을 주셨다. 매일 찾아 뵙고 성실함을 보여드리면 좋은 일이 생길 것만 같다.

자네는 진정 성실한 여행자인 것 같네.
성실함을 증명 받고 #b#t04031019##k를 받았다.

string.name: name
string.value: Hughes Needs the Eraser
Hughes seems to be in need of help. I better go see him.
Hughes has been trying to go on with his research, but told me he needs an eraser to continue...
I got Hughes the eraser he's been seeking.

string.name: name
string.value: A Revenge on Gray the Alien
I should go see Alien Gray.
Whoa... Gray is taking an interest to this eraser... I mean, it's really nothing but a piece of rubber... okay, this is a good time to avenge the prank he pulled on me...
I wound up trading a useless eraser for a very useful item.

string.name: name
string.value: An Immovable Sword
I heard there's a #bMysterious Sword#k at Perion. I should check it out.

I saw a long sword stuck in a pile of ashes, so as I approached it, I heard a deep voice resonating the area. The voice introduced itself as the rightful owner of the sword, and asked me to free him from the sword by pulling it out of the ashes. In order to do so, I'll need #bMonster Eraser#k and #b#t4001115##k...

#t4001115# #b#c4001115#/1#k
#t4001038# #b#c4001038#/1#k
#t4001039# #b#c4001039#/1#k
#t4001040# #b#c4001040#/1#k
#t4001041# #b#c4001041#/1#k
#t4001042# #b#c4001042#/1#k
#t4001043# #b#c4001043#/1#k

After bringing both the Monster Eraser and #t4001115#, the power of the sword seemed to have come back, and freed the sword from the ashes. In the end, I was able to get my hands on #t01302063#. Hopefully the owner of the sword is also set free in the process.

string.name: name
string.value: Hectagon Crystal Necklace and the Seal Cushion
#bArwen#k of #bEllinia#k seems to be enamored with jewelry...

Arwen's eyes after seeing the Hectagon Crystal necklace told a whole story. She really seemed to want one. She said she'll give me the precious Seal Cushion if I give her #bHectgon Crystal Necklace#k and a #bMonster Eraser#k...

#t4001116# #b#c4001116#/1#k
#t4001038# #b#c4001038#/1#k
#t4001039# #b#c4001039#/1#k
#t4001040# #b#c4001040#/1#k
#t4001041# #b#c4001041#/1#k
#t4001042# #b#c4001042#/1#k
#t4001043# #b#c4001043#/1#k
After giving her the Hectagon Crystal Necklace and a Monster Eraser, I was able to obtain a lovely Seal Cushion.

string.name: name
string.value: Han the Broker and the Mystical Mineral
#bHan the Broker#k seems to want the strange mineral you got recently... Go to Magatia and meet with him.

Han the Broker says that he has been looking a long time for that mineral and requests a trade. When you refuse, he tells you that he will reward you handsomely if you bring him the mineral along with monster erasers... He seems a bit shady but rumors do say that he is a fair guy when it comes to business... 

#i4001197##t4001197# #b#c4001197#/1#k
#i4001038##t4001038# #b#c4001038#/1#k
#i4001039##t4001039# #b#c4001039#/1#k
#i4001040##t4001040# #b#c4001040#/1#k
#i4001041##t4001041# #b#c4001041#/1#k
#i4001042##t4001042# #b#c4001042#/1#k
#i4001043##t4001043# #b#c4001043#/1#k

Once Han the Broker received all the items, he mumbled to himself while smiling happily. Something about how he can now overpower the man in blue tights who wears his underwear outside... Huh? You think you might know who he is talking about... Then does that mean that bluish mineral is...?

별을 좋아하는 #b#p9001001##k에게 반짝이는 #t04000214#을 선물했다.

string.value: 북극곰 포치의 썰매 만들기

#b#p9001002##k가 형에게 선물할 썰매를 만드는 것을 도와주었다.

string.name: name
string.value: 동생을 아끼는 북극곰 푸치
#b#p9001005##k가 개구쟁이 동생 때문에 걱정이 많다고 한다. 코-크 타운에 살고 있는 북극곰 푸치를 찾아가보자.
#b#p9001005##k의 동생이 안전하게 마을 밖을 돌아다닐 수 있도록 도와주었다.

string.name: name
string.value: 북극곰 형제의 이글루 짓기
코-크 타운의 소문난 의좋은 형제 포치와 푸치가 살고 있는 이글루가 많이 훼손 되었다고 한다. 도와 줄 일은 없는지 #b#p9001005##k를 찾아가 보자.
북극곰 형제 푸치와 포치가 이글루를 짓는 것을 도와주었다.

string.name: name
string.value: 심심한 북극곰 포치
코-크타운에 있는 #b#p9001002##k를 찾아가 보자.
#b#p9001002##k가 심심하지 않도록 카드를 모아다 주었다.

string.name: name
string.value: 북극곰 포치의 코카-콜라
#b북극곰 포치#k가 코카-콜라를 만드는 비법을 알아 냈다고 하는데... 코-크 타운으로 가려면 #b코-크베어 운영자#k를 먼저 만나야겠지?

#b북극곰 포치#k는 코카-콜라를 만들려면 코-크 플레이닷컴(#bwww.cokeplay.com#k)에서만 구할 수 있는 재료들을 가지고 와야 한다고 했다.

string.value: 산타 고양이의 선물준비
크리스마스 선물을 준비중인 #b#p9201030##k가 도움이 필요한 일이 있다고 한다. 행복한 마을에 살고 있는 #p9201030#를 찾아가 보자. 행복한 마을에 가려면 먼저 #b#p1022101##k의 도움을 받아야 하지?
생쥐들에게 나눠 줄 선물상자를 몬스터들로 부터 구해서 행복한 마을에 살고 있는 #b#p9201030##k에게 가져다 주자. \n\n#t04031504# #b#c04031504#/25#k
생쥐들에게 나눠 줄 선물상자를 구해서 #b#p9201030##k에게 가져다 주었지만 아직 부족한 듯 하다.

string.name: name
string.value: 북극곰 푸치의 골든 스노우보드
#b#t1442015##k를 가지고 싶다면 행복한 마을의 #b#p9001006##k를 찾아가 보자.

string.name: name
string.value: 주인없는 스노우보드
행복한 마을의 #b#p9001006##k가 스노우보드를 주워서 주인을 찾고 있다고 한다.
#b#p9001006##k는 잠시 후 스노우보드를 보여주겠다고 했는데, 내 것이라고 거짓말을 해볼까?
#b#p9001006##k에게서 스노우보드를 받았다. 역시 솔직하게 말하길 잘했어.

string.name: name
string.value: 달을 부르는 자:월묘의 떡
#b#p9010010##k가 부탁하고 싶은 것이 있다는데…
#b#p9010010##k는 달에서 떡을 만드는 토끼 월묘에 대해 말하며, 월묘가 달을 땅으로 이끌고 와야만 한다고 말했다. 하지만 월묘는 땅에서는 몬스터들의 공격을 받기 때문에 잘 내려오려 하지않는다는데… 헤네시스 공원의 #b#p1012112##k에게 가면 월묘를 소환할 수 있는 땅으로 보내 준다고 한다. 가서 월묘와 달을 불러 보자.
월묘를 소환했다. 정말로 달도 함께 불렀는데…#b#p9010010##k의 수정구는 힘을 얻었을까?

string.name: name
string.value: Collaborative Effort: First Time Together
#b#p9010010##k says that she has some advice...
#b#p9010010##k spoke about the importance of collaboration and said that #b#p9020000##k in Kerning city can teach you a lesson on that. A trip to Kerning City may be in order.
In Kerning City, you learned a different method of fighting.

string.name: name
string.value: The Crystal Ball: Dimensional Schism
There seems to be a problem with #b#p9010010##k's Crystal Ball...

#b#p9010010##k says that she uses the Crystal Ball to watch over the entire Maple World and that the crack in the Crystal Ball indicates a Dimensional Schism... #b#p9010010##k asks that you head over to Ludibrium to stop the Dimensional Schism.
You stopped the Dimensional Schism and #b#p9010010##k's Crystal Ball became fixed as well. #b#p9010010##k's Crystal Ball really is amazing!

string.name: name
string.value: Consoler of the Goddess: Remnant of the Goddess
#b#p9010010##k says that her Crystal Ball revealed an interesting phrase...

#b#p9010010##k says that her Crystal Ball revealed to her the phrase, 'Who will console the Goddess...' She says that you have the ability to solve this riddle and asked that you go see #b#p2013000##k in Orbis.
You and the other party members awakened the Goddess Statue. Has this helped the Goddess recover from her sadness?

string.name: name
string.value: Cassandra's Revenge: Lord Pirate
Lord Pirate...the infamous pirate whose whereabouts are unknown. But #b#p9010010##k claims that she knows where he is...

#b#p9010010##k says that an old friend of hers was previously victimized by Lord Pirate and asks that you go to Mu Lung to defeat him. Will you be able to defeat Lord Pirate? Go see #b#p2094000##k in Herb Town.
You had no idea that #b#p2094000##k would be a bellflower. In any case, it's a good thing you were able to defeat Lord Pirate.

string.name: name
string.value: Cody's Valentine
I heard Cody was acting like he's madly in love. I better go see for it myself.

#p9200000# seemed to have a big-time crush on Maya, and wanted to surprise her with a Valentine's day gift. Since he couldn't go anywhere, he asked me if I could deliver chocolate for him, so I obliged. No one's better at making chocolate Cookers.\n\n#t04140100# #b#c04140100#/1#k
On behalf of Cody, I gave Maya the #b#t04140100##k. She seemed very much ecstatic. Hopefully this is the start of something good...

string.value: 외로운 에스텔

화이트 데이인데도 사탕을 못 받은 #b#p1032105##k에게 #b#t4140102##k를 선물하자. 사탕은 뭐니뭐니해도 제과사 #b#p2041017##k가 만든 것이 최고겠지?\n\n#t4140102# #b#c4140102#/1#k

string.name: name
string.value: 가면신사의 초대
메이플 월드의 많은 사람들을 알고 있는 #b#p9010010##k가 갑자기 말을 걸어 왔다. 무슨 일일까?
#p9010010#는 전해줄 물건이 있다며 잠시만 그녀에게 와달라고 말했다. 주변 마을로 가서 #b#p9010010##k를 만나자.
#p9010010#에게서 #r#t2031000##k을 받았다. 할로윈 파티를 연다는 내용인 것 같다. 이름도 얼굴도 모르는 사람의 파티 초대라니. 이상한걸...?

string.name: name
string.value: 끝나지 않은 파티
할로윈 파티는 아직 끝나지 않았다. 다시 한 번 #r헌티드 맨션#k으로 가려면 어떻게 해야 할까? #b#p9010010##k를 찾아가 보자.
#p9010010#는 #p2120000#에게 초대장이 다시 왔다며, 그 중에 네 이름이 다시 있는지 찾아보겠다고 했다. 좋아, 다시 파티에 가고 싶으니 잠시만 기다렸다가 다시 말을 걸자.
#p9010010#에게서 #t2031000#을 다시 받았다. 파티가 끝나기 전까지 #p2120000#는 끊임없이 초대장을 다시 보낼 것 같다...

string.name: name
string.value: 고양이의 충고
#p2120000#의 할로윈 파티가 열리고 있는 #r헌티드 맨션#k에 도착했다. 하지만 거만한 문지기는 파티에 어울리는 복장이 아니면 들여보내줄 수 없다는데... 어떻게 하지? 맨션 앞 표지판에 앉아 있는 #b#p2121000##k에게 조언을 청해 보자.
#p2121000#는 유령이 되면 할로윈 파티에 참가할 수 있다고 말했다. 유령? ...위험한 거 아닐까? 고양이는 절대 위험하지 않다고 호언장담하며 무덤가로 가서 #b네 개의 비석에 새겨진 이름#k을 외워 온다면 유령으로 변신시켜 주겠다고 말했다.
뭐, 뭐지? 고양이의 질문에 차례대로 대답하자 이상한 기운이 몸에 스며들더니 유령으로 변신하게 되었다! ...굉장한걸? 다시 사람으로 돌아갈 수 있는 건 맞겠지? 고양이는 다시 유령으로 변신하고 싶거든 #b5분 후#k에 찾아오라고 말했다.

string.name: name
string.value: Collect Pumpkin Pieces
#p2120000# is hosting a Halloween party at the #rHaunted #m229000000##k. The friendly yet slightly eerie looking #r#p2120003##k awaits your arrival...

#p2120003# wants me to collect and bring her the #b#t2022255##k left over from making halloween Jack-o'-Lanterns. She says that she will give me a #b#t1002699##k which she made herself, as a gift in return. Let me follow #p2120003# to go make a Jack-o'-Latern. \n\n#i2022255# #t2022255# #b#c2022255#/50#k.
I brought the #t2022255# to #p2120003# and received a #t1002699# in return. Apparently, only 1 pumpkin hat is made per day, so I should go get myself a pumpkin hat to wear to the party.

섬뜩한 가면과 달리 의외로 유쾌한 #p2120000#는 문득 파티를 연 저택, #r헌티드 맨션#k에 관한 이야기를 했다. 그가 파티를 열기 위해 빌린 이 저택은 한 때 메이플 월드 최고의 인형장인의 것이었다는데...

string.value: 인형장인 조나스

굴뚝 너머에는 낡고 오래되어 보이는 기계와 기계만큼 낡은 옷을 입은 #b#p2120004##k라는 사람이 있었다. 바쁘게 인형을 만드는 그에게 파티에 참가하지 않냐고 묻자 그는 인형을 만들어야 해서 불가능하다고 한다.

string.value: 눈사람의 나뭇가지
거대 눈사람을 퇴치하고, 눈사람의 나뭇가지를 줏었다. 그런데 왠지 따뜻한 느낌이 드는 이유는 뭘까?
거대 눈사람을 퇴치하고 바닥에 떨어진 눈사람의 나뭇가지를 줏어드는 순간, 행복한 마을에 있던 나뭇가지 눈사람으로부터 나뭇가지를 가지고 찾아와 달라는 전언이 왔다. 나에게 해주고 싶은 이야기가 있다고 하는데... 행복한 마을로 찾아가 봐야할 것 같다.
행복한 마을에 있는 나뭇가지 눈사람은 마을에 나타난 꼬마 눈사람에 대해 이야기 해줬다. 장난이 심하긴 했지만, 사람들을 좋아하던 꼬마 눈사람을 미워하지 말아달라면서 나뭇가지에 깃든 눈의 마법으로 루돌프의 뿔에 새로운 마법을 깃들게 해주었다.

#b#p9010010##k says she forgot to tell you something, and wants you to come to her immediately... What could it be about?

#p9010010# has a message she forgot to deliver. She wants you to find #b#p2101018##k, but she didn't know where to go? The name kind of sounds like someone from #m260000000#... Try looking in #b#m102000000##k, #b#m260000000##k, #b#m100000000##k, #b#m220000000##k, or #b#m120000000##k.
#p2101018# was just standing there grim-faced, holding a spear... It looked like trouble.

string.value: Ariant Coliseum Opening
With a grim face, #p2101018# told you that only the determined can enter the #bColiseum Arena#k. He wouldn't tell you what it was, but he said you could enter if you had no fear.
#p2101009#'s is holding a Royal Hunt! That's what the #b#m260000000# Coliseum#k is all about about. #bHunting monsters to create jewels in a competitive match between adventurers#k? Sounds fun!

string.value: 카산드라의 새해선물
HAPPY NEW YEAR! 새해를 맞아 #b카산드라#k가 특별한 선물을 준비했다고 하는데...
#b카산드라#k가 준비한 선물은 뭘까~
새해를 맞아 #b카산드라#k가 1월 22일까지 접속만 해도 선물을 준다고 한다.

string.name: name
string.value: 새해 운세보기
#b카산드라#k님께서 새해를 맞아 운세를 봐준다고 하는데...
내 운세를 알아보기 위해서는 운세종이에 마법진을 완성해야 한다. 몬스터로 부터 얻은 #i04031896# #b#t04031896##k을 부어 마법진이 다 나타나면 카산드라에게 가져가자.
#b카산드라#k님께서 새해 운세를 봐주셨다. 올 한해도 행운이 있기를...

치즈창고에서 맛있는 #b#t04031895##k을 구해 가자. 치즈창고에 들어가려면 먼저 #b#p9010015##k의 허락을 받아야겠지?\n\n#i04031895# #t04031895# #b#c04031895#/20#k

메이플운영자가 2월13일부터 2월29일까지 특별한 이벤트를 준비했다고 하는데...
별별Festival이 진행중입니다.
메이플운영자가 준비한 이벤트에 참가하고 별도장을 받았다! 획득한 별도장은 메이플운영자를 찾아가거나 메이플스토리 홈페이지#b(http://maplestory.nexon.com)#k에서 확인할 수 있다.

string.value: 페티트의 수리부품
#b#p9010010##k가 중요한 부탁이 있다고 한다. 그녀에게 찾아가 보자.
구해온 부품을 #b#p9010010##k에게 가지고 갔다. 라디오가 제대로 작동하자 페티트가 매우 기뻐했다.

string.value: 카산드라의 어린이날선물
#b카산드라#k가 어린이날을 기념하여 선물을 나눠 준다고 하는데...
카산드라가 어린이날 선물을 나누어 준다고 한다. 카산드라에게 가보자.
5월 10일까지는 접속만 해도 상품을 준다고 한다.

Tienk, who is at Lith Harbor, said he would give me a monster card as a 4 Year Anniversary gift...
Tienk said he will give me a monster card as a gift if I bring him a Maple Leaf.
I gave a Maple Leaf to Tienk and received a Monster Card as a gift.

string.name: name
string.value: 5개의 촛불
#b#p9000021##k에게 가면 양초를 받을 수 있다고? 메이플 5주년을 기념하는 특별 이벤트라... 기대되는데?
#b#p9000021##k는 양초를 30분간 잘 지키면 #b#t04001167##k을 얻을 수 있다고 가르쳐 줬다. 접속을 유지해야만 촛불을 지킬 수가 있다고 하니 오랜만에 게임을 마음껏 즐겨봐야지.
#b#t04001167##k을 얻었다!\n촛불을 잘 지켰더니 #t04001167#을 받았다. #p9000021#에게 받은 #b#t04220045##k에 잘 보관해둬야겠다.\n#p9000021#는 5개의 케이크 조각을 모아 생일 케이크를 완성하기만 하면 무언가 큰 선물을 주겠다고 했다.

string.name: name
string.value: 5주년 축하 케이크
#r메이플스토리 5주년#k을 축하하는 생일 케이크를 완성했다! \n#b#p9000021##k에게 완성한 케이크를 가져가자.
#r메이플스토리 5주년#k을 축하하는 생일 케이크를 완성했다! \n#b#p9000021##k에게 완성한 케이크를 가져가자.
#b#p9000021##k에게 완성한 케이크를 주었다. 마치 자신의 생일 케이크인양 기뻐하던데... #p9000021#와 메이플스토리는 대체 무슨 관계인 거지?

string.name: name
string.value: Putting the Maple Leaf in my mouth...
I should go see #b#p9010010##k. She said she was going to tell me some special information in light of MapleStory's 4 Year Anniversary...

Collect #t04001126#? It's hard to believe that it's a #b#t01012098##k... but it is said to be very potent. It's not like I need to collect a large amount. I should give it a try\n\n #i04001126# #t04001126# #b#c04001126##k / 50

I got a #b#t01012098##k! After I put it in my mouth, I feel like my abilities increasing. It feels invigorating. Oh, but what if it doesn't increase the abilities I need?\n...I'll just go see #p9010010# in two hours. I'm sure she'll know what to do.

string.name: name
string.value: Making Maple Syrup
I should go see #p9010010# and learn how to make #b#t01012098##k better.
#bMaple Syrup#k? I should get this done right away. I can enhance my Maple Leaf by doing just that? What a bargain!.\n\n#i04001126# #t04001126# #b#c04001126##k / 25

#p9010010# really made the Maple Syrup for me just like that. I wonder if she didn't already have it pre-made. #p9010010# said to come back in 30 minutes and she'll make Maple Syrup for me again. \n I did hear that Maple Syrup can corrode the #t01012098# so I should use it carefully.

string.name: name
string.value: Cassandra's Latest Information

string.name: parent
string.value: Snow Silk and the Mysterious Fabric
Cassandra, maple world's informant, is said to have obtained some new information hot off the press. I'm curious what it is.
Cassandra told me about the Snow Silk. But for some reason she wouldn't explain in detail and kept telling me to just go see the archeologist, #bWinston#k...
Maple world's informant, Cassandra, notified me of her latest information, the Snow Silk. I went to go see Winston, the archaeologist who is looking for this Snow Silk.

string.name: name
string.value: Materials for the Mysterious Fabric

string.name: parent
string.value: Snow Silk and the Mysterious Fabric

Winston the archaeologist said the reason he is looking for the Snow Silk is to get the #bMysterious Fabric#k, which is made from Snow Silk. The Snow Silk is said to add Mysterious Power to any object that is made with it and he said if I'm interested in this #bMysterious Fabric#k, to gather #b10 Snow Silks#k and to go see Arwen the Fairy.\n\n#i4001166# #t4001166# #b#c4001166# / 10

As Winston the archaeologist advised, I gathered 10 Snow Silk and went to go see Arwen the fairy. Arwen was amazed that I collected 10 Snow Silk and secretly made the Mysterious Fabric for me without the other fairies knowing. Arwen warned me of the Mysterious Fabric's power and advised me that if she were to have a Mysterious Fabric, that she would go see #e#bFrancois #k#n.

string.name: name
string.value: Francois' Latest Work

string.name: parent
string.value: Snow Silk and the Mysterious Fabric
Mysterious Fabric that I got from Arwen... What should I make with this? Should I go see Francois like Arwen mentioned? But she seems a little strange though...

As Arwen suggested, I went to go see Francois with the Mysterious Fabric. Francois said she will make me her latest creation and asked me to bring her one more ingredient; an item that is common but not ordinary, small but possessing great power... She wants me to bring her #b50 Maple Leaves#k...\n\n#i4001126# #t4001126# #b#c4001126# / 50

After contemplating what to do make with the Mysterious Fabric I received from Arwen, I decided to go see Francois as Arwen suggested. Francois told me she would make me an item she just recently created and asked me to bring her 50 more Maple Leaves. She then made me a #bMaple Cape#k. Wow~ this is great!

string.name: name
string.value: Gaga's Maple Leaf
A Golden Maple Leaf fell from a full grown maple tree. I should take it to Gaga who is the keeper of the maple trees.
I took the golden Maple Leaf to Gaga, the keeper of the maple tree.

I should take the Golden Maple Leaf that fell from the Maple Tree to Gaga, the Maple Tree keeper. Gaga said that this Maple Leaf can be used to plant another Maple Tree and gave me a gift for bringing it to him.

string.name: name
string.value: Speed Quiz
I hear Cassandra has prepared a speed quiz in time for winter break.
I should try again in a little bit!

string.name: name
string.value: Vanished Mysterious Fabric
The Mysterious Fabric disappeared from me all of a sudden. I should go talk to Arwen.

The Mysterious Fabric disappeared from me all of a sudden. I went to go see Arwen and she said if the Mysterious Fabric isn't kept properly, it can melt away and disappear... She could make me another one but she would need more materials this time. As Arwen requests, I should gather #b12 Snow Silks#k and bring it to her.\n\n#i4001166# #t4001166# #b#c4001166# / 12
The Mysterious Fabric disappeared from me all of a sudden. Arwen said it was because I didn't properly take care of it. I brought her 12 more Snow Silks and she made me another one.

string.name: name
string.value: Repairing the Maple Cape
I think my Maple Cape has a hole. I should go see Francois.

When I went to go see Francois to repair my Maple Cape, she told me she doesn't know how to repair it. Instead, she told me to go see #Lisa#k from Orbis who taught her how to make the cape. She also told me to take #b10 Snow Silks#k just in case she needs it to repair the cape.

#i4001166# #t4001166# #b#c4001166# / 10
#i1102166##k #t1102166# #b#c1102166# / 1

Francois told me to go see #bLisa#k in Orbis to repair the hole in the Maple Cape... When I took the Maple Cape along with 10 Snow Silks to Lisa, she not only perfectly repaired it with her hidden sewing skills but she also made the cape stronger than before. I had no idea Lisa had this kind of skill.

string.name: name
string.value: Alcaster's Advice
I get the feeling that my Maple Cape's vibrant color has faded a bit. It seems less shiny... I should go see Lisa who repaired the cape before.

I decided to go see Alcaster on Lisa's referral... Lisa did mention that I'll probably need #b10 Snow Silks and 10 Maple Leaves#k, so I should gather all the materials before I go see Alcaster.

#i4001166# #t4001166# #b#c4001166# / 10#k
#i4001126# #t4001126# #b#c4001126# / 10#k
#i1102167# #t1102167# #b#c1102167# / 1

With Alcaster's help, I was able to recharge the power into the Maple Cape. It even seems to fit me better than before. Alcaster told me that the cape is excellent item which is rare to find these days. I will take good care of it and use it for a long time.

string.name: name
string.value: Operation MS-07
Agent W is on an important mission to transport something of great value. But who are the unidentified beings that are following Agent W? You begin a conversation with Agent W.
You defended the memory chip Agent W entrusted to you.

Agent W was headed towards headquarters to transport #b#t3994089##k #i3994089#, which contains important information about #e#rMaster M#k#n. However, some unidentified assailants started chasing him, so he had no choice but to hand the memory chip to you. \r\nHe said that he will give you an #e#rExcellent Agent Badge#k#n if you can protect the memory chip for #r1 hour#k.

An urgent message was sent from #b#p9000021##k.
An urgent message was sent from Agent #b#p9000021##k.

#bGaga#k asked you to become an agent out of nowhere...and you agreed! Now what? Hmm, come ot think of it, the #bMaple Admin#k and #bCassandra#k both looked suspicious with their black sunglasses. Time to interrogate #bGaga#k for more details.

#i4031988# #t4031988# #b#c4031988# / 1

Special Agent O asked you to disarm the Agent Box in the mini dungeon and retrieve a Special Agent Badge, and you successfully completed his mission.

string.name: name
string.value: Agent W's Watermelon Investigation
The Maple Admin wants to talk to you.

The Maple Admin said that #e#rMaster M#k#n has planted bombs Chumji's watermelons and asked you to retrieve them. Get to Chumji's watermelon field with the Maple Admin's help, then collect #b5 #t4031701##k and take it to #rAgent W#k at agent headquarters.\r\n#i4031701# #t4031701# #b#c4031701# / 5#k

There was intelligence that #rMaster M#k planted a bomb in Chumji's watermelon field. You carefully picked 5 watermelons and delivered them to Agent W, who's a self proclaimed demolitions expert. You don't feel all that safe around him...

string.name: name
string.value: 추석맞이 달나라 여행
추석을 맞아 메이플 월드에서 풍성한 이벤트가 진행중이라는데...
#p9010000#는 추석을 맞아 월묘들이 #b달나라 여행#k을 준비했으니 달나라로 가보는 게 어떠냐고 말했다. 달나라 여행 외에도 #b명절 음식 만들기#k, #b알파벳 모으기#k 등 다양한 이벤트가 진행중이라는데...
#p9010000#는 추석을 맞아 월묘들이 달나라 여행을 준비했으니 달나라로 가보는 게 어떠냐고 말했다. 달나라 여행 외에도 명절 음식 만들기, 알파벳 모으기 등 다양한 이벤트가 진행중이라니 참가해 보자.

string.name: name
string.value: 달은 어떻게 생겼나요
#b달나라#k에 사는 #b#p9001102##k는 달이 어떻게 생겼는지 모른다는데... 달나라에 살면서 달의 생김새를 모른다니, 무슨 말일까? #p9001102#를 찾아가 보자.

달의 전체 모습을 본 적이 없는 #p9001102#를 위해 지상의 월묘들이 달 사진을 보냈다. 그런데 달나라로 점프하면서 그만 사진이 찢어져 조각조각 흩어져 버렸다. #p9001102#에게 도착한 것은 액자뿐... 아기 월묘의 말에 의하면 사진 조각들은 #b누군가의 손에 있을 수도, 몬스터들이 가지고 있을 수도, 꽃들 속에 숨어버렸을 수도 있다고 한다#k. 흩어진 #b사진 조각#k을 모아 원래의 달 모습을 보여주자.
달의 사진을 본 아기월묘는 너무나도 아름다운 달의 모습에 깊이 감동한 모양이다.

string.name: name
string.value: 카산드라의 도움
#p9001102#의 달 사진 조각들은 어디에 흩어져 있을까? 메이플 월드의 모든 일을 꿰고 있는 #p9010010#라면 알고 있지 않을까? #b#p9010010##k를 찾아가 보자.
#p9010010#는 맛있는 추석 음식 #t2022004#, #t2022005#, #t2022352# 중에 #b아무거나 한 개#k 주면 달 사진 조각이 어디 있는지 알려주겠다고 말했다.
음식을 받은 #p9010010#는 생글생글 웃으며 주머니에서 달 사진 조각을 꺼내주었다. 사진 조각을 주운 건 다름아닌 #p9010010#였던 것이다. #p9010010#를 통해 세 개의 사진 조각 중 한 개를 구할 수 있었다.

string.name: name
string.value: Taking Care of Baby Bird
You haven't seen #p9000042# around these days. What could he be up to?

#p9000042# has been busy these days #btaking care of an egg#k. A bird that flew into Maple World left an egg and #p9000042# felt sorry for it. #p9000042# says that he simply can't take care of the egg by himself anymore and needs help. Time to go see #b#p9000042##k.

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Snipe
A #p9000043# that has been separated from his flock is looking for help...

A snipe that was migrating to a warmer place got lost and is now separated from his flock. He wants to fly towards his friends but he can only take off by jumping off the #bJump Stand#k... To help the Snipe, talk to him using the keyword #bHelp the Snipe#k.
You helped the Snipe get up the branch. He should now be able to jump and take off. But why do you feel so uneasy...

string.name: name
string.value: Baby Bird Feather

The Baby Bird that hatched from the egg flew away freely with an indifferent and almost smug expression. The only thing left are some of its soft feathers. Hmm... Looks like #b#p9000042##k wants to say something.

#p9000042#, with tears flowing down his smiling face, says that he is thrilled the cute Baby Bird hatched. He wants to keep a #b#t4032066##k as a momento. The Baby Bird really wasn't all that cute...but maybe you should just give him a feather.
#p9000042#, after receiving the #t4032066#, jumped for joy saying that he would always treasure it. Now he's preparing to take care of the next egg...

string.name: name
string.value: 메이플 2000일의 이야기
메이플 월드에 모험가들이 첫 발을 내딛은 지도 어느새 2000일이 되었다. 메이플 운영자가 이 날을 기념하기 위해 작은 일을 계획중이라고 하는데... 내 도움이 필요한 것은 아닐까? #b#e메이플 운영자#n#k를 찾아가보자.

메이플 월드에 모헙가들이 첫 발을 내딛은 지도 어느새 #r2000일#k이 되었다. 메이플 운영자는 이 날을 기념해서 그 동안의 모험담을 모아서 책을 만들어 보겠다는 계획을 세웠다. 
메이플 운영자는 책을 만들기 위해서는 여러 모험가들의 이야기가 필요한다고 하면서 #e#b2000개의 이야기#k#n가 필요하다고 했다. #b몬스터를 사냥#k하거나, #bNPC들의 이야기#k를 모아서 메이플운영자에게 가져다 주자. 2000개의 이야기를 모두 모으면 운영자의 특별 선물을 받을 수 있다고 한다.

string.name: name
string.value: Gaga's Complaint
Gaga's face appears sad for some reason. What could be wrong? You should hear Gaga's story.

You ask Gaga why he is so sad. Gaga says that he has tried very hard at doing the things he wants to do and that nothing has worked out. He says that effort alone isn't enough. You try to console him but he seems to just get more sad.

string.name: name
string.value: Cassandra's Truth?!
Cassandra seems to have something she wants to say to you.

Cassandra grumbles saying that she is bored because Gaga is so lethargic these days. She always has fun teasing Gaga, but it's not fun when he's like this. In order to cheer him up, she asks you to gather some White Monkey Puppets of Luck for him. She emphasizes that she is not asking because she feels bad about teasing him so much.\n\n#i4032087# #t4032087# #b#c4032087# / 10

Cassandra grumbles saying that she is bored because Gaga is so lethargic these days. She always has fun teasing Gaga, but it's not fun when he's like this. So you gathered some White Monkey Puppets of Luck for Gaga.\nCassandra emphasized that she doesn't feel bad about teasing him so much but you don't think she is being honest. Gaga seemed really happy about the gift and was filled with anticipation about good luck coming his way. Gaga said luck should always be shared and gave you a Mysterious Box.

string.name: name
string.value: 가가의 크리스마스 추억
어렸을 적 가가가 받았던 크리스마스 선물은 뭘까? 따뜻한 집에서 행복하게 보낸 크리스마스의 추억을 그리워하는 가가에게 가 보자.
가가에게 크리스마스의 추억을 떠올릴 수 있는 물건을 가져다주자! 가가가 어렸을 적 받았던 선물을 모아 가가에게 가져다주면 보답을 하겠다고 한다. 어떤 물건이었지? 으음... 이번에는 어쩔 수 없네. 기억이 안 나면 가가에게 다시 가서 물어보는 수밖에...
가가가 부탁한 선물을 찾아 주었다. 어릴 적의 행복했던 크리스마스를 회상하느라 마음이 여유로워진 가가는 손수 만들었다는 루돌프의 빨간코에만 붙일 수 있는 특제 반창고를 주었다. 다시 갖고 싶은 선물이 또 있었는데...라고 중얼거리는 가가를 보니 다음에 말을 걸면 또 다른 선물을 부탁할 것만 같다. 10분 후에 다시 와 봐야지...
