string.value: Making Pure Perfume 1
The young adventurers of Maple World seem to have become frightened by something! What could have happened? Go to #p9010010# and find out.

#p9010010# says that there is a hidden monster that attacks young children. This giant monster identfies children by their scent. In order to be camouflaged as a young child, you'll need their scent...
Cassandra made #t2430009# which smells just like a child. The monster is sure to mistake you as a child if you put on this perfume.

string.name: summary
string.value: Collect #b30#t4032271#s#k which are the ingredients for the #b#t2430009##k and give them to Cassandra!

string.value: Defeating the Hidden Monster
You received the #b#t2430009##k. It smells so pure. How are you supposed to use this? Find out from #p9010010#.

The children say that they saw the monster in various places outside of town. Try going to the places where the children saw the monster and spritz on the perfume. If you bring back the toys that the monster took from the children, #p9010010# will cast a magical buff on you...
You defeated one monster. The children should be a bit safer now!

string.name: name
string.value: Gaga's Love Letter 1
The shy #p9000021# has a concern. Go find out what #p9000021# is troubled about.

#p9000021# wants to know what #p9020000# thinks of him. He wants to express his feelings without facing her reaction... Bring him some materials so that he can write a letter. If she refuses him, he can always say that it's April Fools' Day!
Love requires a pure heart and true courage. Don't be like him and confess your love pretending it is a April Fools' Day joke. Muster up your courage and confess your true love.

string.name: summary
string.value: Bring Gaga the materials he needs to write a letter!

You were told if you have Maple Gage currently equipped or in your Inventory, you can't receive it again. Failed equipment should be thrown away.

string.value: Aramia's Golden Maple Leaf
A shiny gold colored Maple Leaf has fallen off a fully grown Maple Tree. Bring it to #p9000055# who is in charge of the Maple Tree.

When you brought a Goldem Maple Leaf, that fell off a fully grown Maple Tree, to #p9000055#, the Maple Tree caretaker, said that the Golden Maple Leaf can be used as a seedling for a Maple Tree and gave you a gift as your reward.

Bon voyage!\r\nYou must help the Witch make her Broomstick 5 times by #rDecember 8th#k. Otherwise, it all goes to waste!

string.name: name
string.value: A Petrified Mouse
You found a Mystical Artifact while analyzing artifacts.
If you take this Mouse to a Maple Admin, you will receive something as a token of appreciation.

You have taken the Mouse, which was once involved in a Macro, to a Maple Admin. The Maple Admin thanked you and reminded you that MapleStory is much more fun when you actually play the game than when you use some illegal program to play it for you.

string.name: name
string.value: Gaga's Glasses
You have found an interesting artifact.
You have found a pair of glasses that look like Gaga's. Let's take them to Gaga and see if he recognizes them.
Gaga was thrilled that you found the glasses he lost when he was abducted by a UFO.

string.name: name
string.value: Cassandra's Crystal Ball
You have found an interesting artifact.
This item looks like Cassandra's Crystal Ball. Let's go talk to Cassandra.
She thanked you for finding her cracked Crystal Ball and said she'd restore it and put it to a good use.

string.name: name
string.value: A Shiny Watch
You have found an interesting artifact.
A watch...? Whose is this? Let's report it to a Maple Admin!
This fancy watch apparently belongs to Corba. Will you take it to Corba yourself? Or will you leave it with the Maple Admin?

string.name: name
string.value: A Nice Cleat
You have found an interesting artifact.
A cleat... Who does this belong to? Let's report it to a Maple Admin first.
Perhaps it belongs to Vaughn Lee, Stan, or Louie?

string.name: name
string.value: Quest Completion Book
You have found an interesting artifact.
You have found a Quest Completion Book. Just as you are about to report it to a Maple Admin, you wonder what it was used for.
Upon returning it to the Maple Admin, he thanked you and said more and more Maplers participate in quests nowadays.

string.name: name
string.value: A Pretty Hair-Tie
You have found an interesting artifact.
This pretty Hair-Tie has [Manji] written on it. Let's take it over to Manji.
Manji seemed a bit flustered and quickly took the Hair-Tie. Something's fishy...

string.name: name
string.value: An Old Shoe
You have found an interesting artifact.
You have found an Old Shoe that belongs to a Maple Admin. How in the world does anyone lose a shoe?
The Maple Admin says he lost his shoe when he was chasing after someone who was using an illegal macro program. He has given you a reward for returning his shoe to him.

string.name: name
string.value: Artifact Hunt 1000 points acquired!
You have acquired 1000 points in Artifact Hunt.
You have acquired 1000 points in Artifact Hunt.
#Gaga#k congratulated you for reaching 1000 points in the Artifact Hunt Contest, and offered you double points up to a score of 10,000. Not bad, huh?

string.name: name
string.value: 2012 Artifact Hunt Contest Participation
You can receive a Participation Prize for reaching 5000 points in the Artifact Hunt Contest.
You can receive a Participation Prize for reaching 5000 points in the Artifact Hunt Contest.

Reaching 5000 points in the Artifact Hunt Contest earned you a medal and a Weapon Attack, Magic Attack, and Speed buff. If you push yourself harder, you might be able to reach the top 10 and get a special gift.

string.name: name
string.value: Artifact Hunt Gift Box
You got 10,000 points in the Artifact Hunt Contest.
You got 10,000 points in the Artifact Hunt Contest.
You reached 10,000 points in the Ancient Artifact Contest and received a #v2028075# #b#t2028075##k.

string.name: name
string.value: Artifact Hunt Participation Prize

You can receive presents as well as a boost in your AP if you rank within the top 10. Would you like to take the challenge?

string.value: Louie's Cleat

You have decided to return the Louie to Vaughn Lee. Let's take the Louie over to Vaughn Lee in Magatia!
When you hand the Cleat to Louie, he praises you, saying you're a great judge of character.

string.name: name
string.value: Corba's Watch
Corba says he lost his watch during his transformation.
You told the Maple Admin that you would take the watch to Corba yourself. Let's go find Corba in Leafre!
Corba sincerely thanked you and gave you an amazing present as a token of his appreciation.

string.name: name
string.value: Start the Artifact Hunt
Gaga informed you that Artifact Hunt has started.
Gaga informed you that Artifact Hunt has started.
Gaga informed you that Artifact Hunt has started. He says a high score can earn you an awesome reward, so do your best!

string.name: name
string.value: Challenge! Honorable Mesoranger
Dr. Kim at the Omega Sector HQ is holding a Physical Fitness Event! Check the #bEvent Schedule on the website#k to see what time the event will occur on your world.
Transform into an Alien Gray and go to the top of the Henesys Pet-Walking Road after you answer the agents' questions. The Maple Admin will tell you which agents you need to meet.
You have completed Dr. Kim's Omega Physical Fitness Footrace.

string.name: name
string.value: Special Order! Find Agent E!
Agent M says to go see Agent E. Get the information you need from the Maple Admin and find out where Agent E is.
You must answer some questions if you want to become an Honorable Mesoranger. Get your thoughts together and tackle Agent E's questions.
Shall we head over to see Agent S now?

string.name: name
string.value: Special Order! Find Agent S!
Agent M says to go see Agent S. Get the information you need from the Maple Admin and find out where Agent S is.
You must answer some questions if you want to become an Honorable Mesoranger. Get your thoughts together and tackle Agent S's questions.
Shall we head over to see Agent O now?

string.name: name
string.value: Special Order! Find Agent O!
Agent M says to go see Agent O. Get the information you need from the Maple Admin and find out where Agent O is.
You must answer some questions if you want to become an Honorable Mesoranger. Get your thoughts together and tackle Agent O's questions.
Shall we head over to see Agent C now?

string.name: name
string.value: They're Coming Back!
Cassandra, looking into her Crystal Ball, says they will soon return… But who are 'they'? For details, let's go see #bCassandra#k.
Cassandra said you'll find answers if you look into the Crystal Ball.
What you saw in the Crystal Ball was the revival of the Arans. The Arans… Don't you want to know more about them?

string.name: name
string.value: The Revival of the Arans
The Arans! They are going to revive. But who are the Arans? And why did they disappear from Maple World? Talk to #bCassandra#k if you'd like to find out more about them.
Cassandra seems to know a lot about them...
The 12 Aran Memory Fragments? Perhaps you should go see Cassandra to find the Aran Memory Fragments.

string.name: name
string.value: Vague Aran Memories
If you're curious about the Arans, talk to #bCassandra#k.
She says you must collect Vague Aran Memories in order to obtain an Aran Memory Fragment.
You have collected an Aran Memory Fragment. Cassandra told you a story about a girl who's waiting for the heroes in Rien. What was her name...? Li...Lilin?

string.name: name
string.value: Cassandra's Album
Cassandra says something extremely bad has happened!

Cassandra says she's lost her album and suspects it has something to do with Gaga's artifacts. Hm, but you're busy collecting the Aran Memory Fragments. Perhaps that can wait until after you're done helping Cassandra, who seems desperate. If you collect artifacts, you may naturally find Cassandra's Album.
You have acquired an Aran Memory Fragment for returning Cassandra's Album.

string.name: name
string.value: Dim Aran Memories
Go over to #bCassandra#k if you're curious about the Arans.
She says you must collect Dim Aran Memories if you wish to find out more about the Arans.
You have finished collecting an Aran Memory Fragment. What happens when you collect all 12?

string.name: name
string.value: Signs of Their Revival
There have been subtle signs that indicate the revival of the Arans. Talk to Cassandra for details.
Ice Shards from the ice the Arans were sealed in have been found near town. Where are those Ice Shards?
The Aran Memory Fragments...How long will it take for you to collect all 12?

string.name: name
string.value: Faint Aran Memories
Many have begun to forget the Arans… But if you're still gung-ho about finding their Memory Fragments, go talk to #bCassandra#k.
Cassandra says you must collect Faint Aran Memories.
You seem to have collected about half of what's required.

string.name: name
string.value: Wolves Waiting for their Masters
You must first go see Cassandra in order to collect an Aran Memory Fragment.
You must look for the wolves that are waiting for their masters.
When you approached the wolf, it jumped up and left an Aran Memory Fragment.

string.name: name
string.value: Cloudy Aran Memories
Let's go talk to Cassandra and ask her about the Aran Memory Fragments.
Let's collect Cloudy Aran Memories.
You have collected an Aran Memory Fragment.

string.name: name
string.value: Preparing for Their Arrival
Cassandra says she needs your help.
Cassandra has asked you to bring a weapon from the town Weapons Shop for the heroes who will be reviving soon.
The weapon you brought will be used by the legendary Arans. Isn't that exciting?

string.name: name
string.value: Lingering Aran Memories
You don't have enough memories of the Arans. You better go see Cassandra.
Let's search for Lingering Aran Memories.
You have collected an Aran Memory Fragment.

string.name: name
string.value: The Memory of the Heroes
You're getting close to collecting the 12 Memory Fragments Cassandra mentioned, but you're not quite there yet. Let's go back to #bCassandra#k.
What the...She was talking as if she were going to give you an Aran Memory Fragment but...Hmpf, it's annoying, yes, but what else can you do? Let's talk to Cassandra and see what she has to say.
You're close to collecting all 12 Aran Memory Fragments. But what are these...?

string.name: name
string.value: Flickering Aran Memories
Of the 12 Aran Memory Fragments that Cassandra mentioned, you just need one more! And as you may have guessed, you must go see Cassandra to find the last memory.
Let's collect Flickering Aran Memories.
Finally! You've finished collecting all 12 Aran Memory Fragments. But what are all these memories anyway?

string.name: name
string.value: The Hidden Meaning Behind the Memory Fragments
You have collected 12 Aran Memory Fragments. But they seem meaningless… What is the logic behind this? Cassandra probably knows the answer to the mystery.
Hm? What? Huh? Each fragment has its place? Switch the order of the fragments around.
July 9th, 2007. Will the Arans really revive?

string.name: name
string.value: Who Deserves Cassandra's Album?
You were digging and digging.
After diligently digging around, you discovered Cassandra's Album. Hm, should you return it to its owner, Cassandra? Or should you take it over to Gaga for fun?
You received an Aran Memory Fragment for returning the Album.

string.name: name
string.value: Delivering Cassandra's Album
Cassandra's Album that has all of her baby pictures… Oh, wow! Is that really Cassandra? Gaga will get a kick out of this!
You have taken Cassandra's Album to Gaga, and he jumped for joy saying he can finally be free from Cassandra!

string.name: name
string.value: Delivering Cassandra's Album
As a good citizen of Maple World, you've decided to take it over to Cassandra, its rightful owner.
Cassandra, who had been extremely anxious, was ecstatic when you returned the Album.

string.name: name
string.value: Aran Welcome Celebration
To commemorate the launch of Aran, Cassandra has prepared an event that has the odds of you winning at 100%!
In celebration of the legendary hero Aran's release, Cassandra has prepared a foolproof lottery event!
In celebration of the legendary hero Aran's release, Cassandra prepared a huge event. #bFrom December 10th through January 19th#k, this daily event is a guaranteed win for everyone who participates!

string.name: name
string.value: Find the Master of Combos
You reach Level 15 and #b#p9010010##k approaches you to start a conversation...
Highest Score : #e#r#R10335##b#n Combo#k\n
You were able to check your highest combo score. You're think you're starting to get used to combos now.

string.name: name
string.value: Aran's Return
You reach Level 20 and #b#p9010000##k suddenly starts talking to you about something…

Aran has returned to Maple World! Maple Admin and #p1201000# have teamed up to host an event in celebration of the return of Aran. Apparently, if you reach #bLevel 30(50, 70) as Aran#k, #p1201000# will reward you with a special gift.

Aran has returned to Maple World! Maple Admin and #p1201000# have teamed up to host an event in celebration of the return of Aran. Apparently, if you reach #bLevel 30(50, 70) as Aran#k, #p1201000# will reward you with a special gift.

#p9010000# tells you since you have reached Level 70, you can receive a #bspecial gift#k from #p1201000#.

#i1112405:#

Your received #t1112405# from #p1201000#. A special ring that can be worn by any character within the same account. It looks like an item that is not just for an Aran, but for any character.

You can apparently get some help from #b#p1002001##k at Lith Harbor...

string.name: name
string.value: 달은 어떻게 생겼죠?
달이 어떻게 생겼는지 궁금해 하는 귀여운 #b아기 월묘#k를 찾아가 보자.
대체 달은 어떻게 생긴거죠? 마을 어딘가에 보름달이 보인다고 했는데.. 보름달 가까이 가면 #i2430031:#를 더블클릭하여 달사진을 찍어오자.\n\n사진찍는데, 실패했다면 #b아기 월묘#k에게 부탁하여 폴라로이드를 다시 얻을 수 있다.
달사진을 보고 신기해 하는 월묘는 달사진을 보자 매우 기뻐했다. 하루에 한번씩 아기 월묘를 찾아가서 사진을 찍어주자.

string.name: name
string.value: 폴라로이드가 필요해요.

달사진을 찍을 폴라로이드가 필요하다면 #b아기 월묘#k를 찾아가 보자.
폴라로이드는 보름달 가까이에서 더블클릭해야 사진을 찍을 수 있다.

string.name: name
string.value: Picture of a Rainbow
Rainbow Week has begun! Cassandra (who's not good at drawing) wants to ask you a favor. \r\n#b\r\n April 11, 2011 - April 24, 2011.

Cassandra, who loves to draw but is pretty bad at it, asks you to finish the Rainbow Drawing for Rainbow Week. She tells you that Gaga has all 7 colors of crayons, but he might not let you borrow them if you tell him Cassandra is the one who needs them.
On top of that, he only lends one crayon a day, and the color depends on the day of the week! How can you finish the Rainbow Drawing? #b
 - Monday: Red
 - Tuesday: Orange
 - Wednesday: Yellow
 - Thursday: Green
 - Friday: Blue
 - Saturday: Indigo
 - Sunday: Violet
Sadly, the Rainbow Week is over. \r\n#b\r\n April 11, 2011 - April 24, 2011.

string.name: name
string.value: The Birth of a New Hero
The #p9010000# wants to talk to you. What could it be about?

A new Maple World Hero, Dragon Master Evan, has appeared! To celebrate Evan, #p9010010# has prepared a gift...

#i1022097#

#bYou can receive a gift by reaching Lv. 30 as Evan before #bMay 5#k, and then talking to #p9010010#.#k You can also receive #bScrolls#k that can be used on the #t1022097# by reaching higher levels as Evan, so don't miss out!

A new Maple World Hero, Dragon Master Evan, has appeared! To celebrate Evan, #p9010010# has prepared a gift...

#i1022097#

#bYou can receive a gift by reaching Lv. 30 as Evan before #bMay 5#k, and then talking to #p9010010#.#k You can also receive #bScrolls#k that can be used on the #t1022097# by reaching higher levels as Evan, so don't miss out!

string.name: name
string.value: The Maple Administrator's Congratulations
When you reach Lvl. 20, the #p9010000# starts talking to you...

The Maple Administrator congratulates you for reaching Lvl. 20 and casts the Dragon's Blessing on you. According to her, #p9010010# is also very excited about the growth of the Dragon Master... #bShe says that you can receive a gift from #b#p9010010##k by reaching #bLv. 30#k by May 5.

The Maple Administrator congratulates you for reaching Lvl. 20 and casts the Dragon's Blessing on you. According to her, #p9010010# is also very excited about the growth of the Dragon Master... #bShe says that you can receive a gift from #b#p9010010##k by reaching #bLv. 30#k by May 5.

string.name: name
string.value: A Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lvl. 30, #p9010000# starts talking to you...
#p9010000# says that you can now receive a gift from #p9010010# and that you should go to town and meet #b#p9010010##k. She will be very happy to see you...
You received a #t1022097# that #p9010010# made herself. Work harder and reach Lv. 50 before #bMay 5#k to receive a scroll that can be used on it.

string.name: name
string.value: A Second Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lvl. 50, #p9010010# starts talking to you...
#b#p9010010##k congratulates you for reaching Lv. 50 and asks that you come see her so that she can give you a scroll that can be used.
You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says she will give you another scroll if you reach Lv. 60 by #bMay 5#k.

string.name: name
string.value: A Third Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lv. 60, #p9010010# starts talking to you...

#p9010010# congratulates you for reaching Lv. 60 and asks that you come see her so that she can give you another scroll. Just how many scrolls has #p9010010# prepared? In any case, go to town and meet #p9010010#.
You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says that she will give you an even better scroll if you reach Lv. 80 by #bMay 5#k.

string.name: name
string.value: A Fourth Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lv. 80, #p9010010# starts talking to you...

#p9010010# congratulates you for reaching Lv. 80 and asks that you come see her so that she can give you the scroll she mentioned before. How will she react after seeing how much the Dragon she called cute before has grown? Go to town and meet with #b#p9010010##k.
You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says that she will give you another scroll if you reach Lv. 100 by #bMay 5#k.

string.name: name
string.value: A Fifth Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lv. 100, #p9010010# starts talking to you...
#p9010010#, in a sincere voice, congratulates you for reaching Lv. 100 and asks that you come see her so that she can give you the final scroll. Go to town and meet with #p9010010#.
You received a scroll from #p9010010#. #p9010010# says that she has given you everything she could and that all that is left is for you to work hard and believe in yourself.

string.name: name
string.value: Evan Everyday Event
Cassandra has something to talk to you about. What could she want?

Cassandra says that she's decided to raise a Mini Dragon as a way of commemorating the launch of Dragon Master Evan. But she says that she doesn't think she will do a good job and asks that you take care of the Dragon Egg for her. She says that if you #bhatch the egg by taking good care of it for 1 hour#k, she will give you a nice gift... \r\n\r\nIf the egg disappears because you log out, forfeit the quest and accept it again.
Cassandra seems to be raising a Mini Dragon in order to commemorate the launch of Dragon Master Evan. She is planning to hatch new Dragons from #bMarch 31 to May 4#k, so keep helping her until then.

string.name: name
string.value: Evan Launch Commemoration 2PM Event
Go to Cassandra to receive the gift she has prepared to celebrate the launch of Dragon Master Evan.
You have to go grab Cassandra's gift that you didn't get earlier. If you don't go get it by 4:30, you won't be able to get it at all.
You received the gift that Cassandra prepared in celebration of the launch of Dragon Master Evan.

string.name: name
string.value: Evan Launch Commemoration 2PM Event
Go to Cassandra to receive the gift she has prepared to celebrate the launch of Dragon Master Evan.
You have to go grab Cassandra's gift that you didn't get earlier. You have to get it within the alloted time. \r\n
You received the gift that Cassandra prepared in celebration of the launch of Dragon Master Evan.

string.name: name
string.value: Teo's Nostalgic Reminiscing I
You hear that you can receive help from #b#p1002001##k in Lith Harbor...

You meet #b#p1002001##k at Lith Harbor. #b#p1002001##k says that you remind him of his younger days when he was starting out on his adventures, and he would like to help you. He says first that you need to bring him #b50 #t4000016#s#k and #b50 #t4000004#s#k. For a talented explorer like you, this should be a piece of cake.
You showed your potential to #b#p1002001##k, who you met in Lith Harbor. #b#p1002001##k recognized your potential and gave you some mesos that should come handy during your adventures.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: 150,000 Mesos\nUnlocks 'Teo's Nostalgic Reminiscing II' quest\n

string.value: Teo's Nostalgic Reminiscing II
Go to #b#p1002001##k, who helped you before.
#b#p1002001##k wants you to prove how strong you've become.
You proved to #b#p1002001##k that you've gotten much stronger.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: 250,000 Mesos\n

string.name: name
string.value: Henesys Winter Preparations
#p1012106#, a housekeeper in #m100000000#, is preparing for winter. She may need some help, so go find #b#p1012106##k in #b#m100000000##k.
The thermals #p1012106# has prepared for the townspeople were stolen by the #bmonsters around Henesys#k. She asks you to bring back #b20 pairs of #t4032558##k from the #bmonsters around Henesys#k.

Mischievous monsters stole the thermals that #p1012106#, a housekeeper in #m100000000#, had prepared for the townspeople to stay warm during the winter. You gave the monsters a lesson and recovered #p1012106#'s red thermals. Although they look a little embarrassing, #p1012106#'s thermals are very warm.

string.name: name
string.value: Ellinia Winter Preparations
Wing of Ellinia is making winter preparations for the fairies. How do fairies prepare for winter? If you're curious, go find Wing the Fairy in Ellinia.

Wing the Fairy begrudgingly tells you that fairies can't stand the cold weather. Normal cotton is too heavy for them, so they use a special cotton that's as light as air to stay warm. \nThey haven't been able to obtain this rare cotton yet, and while he doesn't ask for your help out loud, he has a desperate look in his eyes. \nThey say that the cotton, Air-Light Fluff, can be found on the monsters up in Ellinia's treetops.
Wing the Fairy didn't seem very grateful, but you brought him Air-Light Fluff from the monsters of the forest.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
EXP 70
#Wbasic#
#i4310014:# #t4310014:# x 1
#bEnter the Snowdrop Gift Event#k

string.name: name
string.value: Perion Winter Preparations
Ayan of Perion is beginning winter preparations for the tribesmen. She looks like she could use some help. Go find Ayan in Perion and give her some help.

Ayan of Perion says that the tribesmen need plenty of firewood to prepare for winter. The campfire burned out while she was gathering firewood, so she asks you to bring her 20 pieces of Burning Firewood.
You helped Ayan restore her campfire. Hopefully the burning campfire will keep Ayan warm through the winter.

string.name: name
string.value: Kerning City Winter Preparations
Nella of Kerning City is shivering from the cold. Of course she's cold! She's outside in this cold weather, meddling in everybody's business! Go see Nella.

Nella of Kerning City says that she feels like she will freeze to death, and that her Heat Pack has gone cold. She begs you to get her a new one and tells you that the monsters wandering around Kerning City have been seen carrying Heat Packs.
You got Heat Packs from the monsters and delivered them to Nella. She should be able to stay warm for a while now.

string.name: name
string.value: Sleepywood Winter Preparations
Sabitrama of Sleepywood is looking for a rare plant and needs help from travelers. Go to Sabitrama in Sleepywood.

Sabitrama of Sleepywood tells you that rare Fire Flowers were recently found in Sleepywood dungeon. However, the monsters of the dungeon are eating the flowers. Sabitrama wants you to eliminate those monsters and bring him the flowers.
You brought the Fire Flowers back to Sabitrama of Sleepywood. Sabitrama let out a sigh of relief, as the monsters could have eaten the Fire Flowers into extinction.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
EXP 800
#Wbasic#
#i4310014:# #t4310014:# x 1
#bEnter the Snowdrop Gift Event#k

string.name: name
string.value: Orbis Winter Preparations
Ericsson in Orbis thirsts for royal red tea, which is a delicacy of winter. Go see Ericsson.

He may look rough, but Ericsson longs for a taste of elegance. He asks you to bring him 20 Red Tea Bags so that he can try some Nependeath Royal Red Tea, a winter delicacy. It probably won't taste very good, but you should let him find that out for himself.

Ericsson of Orbis wanted to drink Nependeath Royal Red Tea, a winter delicacy, and asked you to bring him Red Tea Bags from monsters. He seemed to enjoy it, but you are still not convinced about its taste.

string.name: name
string.value: El Nath Winter Preparations
Jade is searching for something in order to prepare for winter. Go see Jade in El Nath.

In order to stay warm during the winter, Jade in El Nath wants to get Tepid Lava from the Dead Mine. She says that Tepid Lava is a perfect heat source because it's cooler than normal lava.You can get the lava from the Dead Mine, but you might also find it on monsters who took it with them into the snowfield.
Jade of El Nath asked you to gather Tepid Lava so she could keep warm.

string.name: name
string.value: Ludibrium Winter Preparations
Marcel, who is in charge of security for Ludibrium, seems to be worried about something. Go see Marcel.
Marcel, the guard at Ludibrium, wants to create a new toy for the children's winter playtime. He needs yellow felt pieces to make the toy. Get the felt from the toy monsters in Ludibrium.
You gathered felt from the monsters in Ludibrium and delivered it to Marcel. He said it will be used to create a new toy. What kind of toy could he be making?

string.name: name
string.value: Omega Sector Winter Preparations
Jr. Officer Medin in the Omega Sector has an urgent request for their winter preparations.

Jr. Officer Medin says that some key supplies for their winter operations were lost during transportation. The lost items are Jumper Inner Layers, which are used as the base layer for military jumpers... He suspects that the aliens are responsible. Defeat the aliens and recover the lost Jumper Inner Layers.
You recovered the Jumper Inner Layers that were stolen by the aliens and delivered them to Jr. Officer Medin. Medin thanked you on behalf of the troops.

string.name: name
string.value: Korean Folk Town Winter Preparations
Chumji in the Korean Folk Town has a request regarding the Haenim siblings.

Chumji wants to make clothes and blankets for the Haenim siblings, who have been bravely living on their own without their parents. He needs you to get Quilting Cotton from the monsters at Black Mountain, and bring them back to him.

Chumji in the Korean Folk Town asked you to get Quilting Cotton from the monsters at Black Mountain so he could create clothes and blankets for the Haenim siblings. When you brought him the Quilting Cotton, Chumji happily got to work preparing the Haenim siblings for winter.

string.name: name
string.value: Aquarium Winter Preparations
Kenta in Aquarium has a request regarding winter preparations for the animals at the Zoo.
Kenta thinks that the land animals are not adapting to the sea's cold winter. He wants you to get Warm Bubbles from the bottom of the sea.
You delivered the Warm Bubbles that Kenta requested for the animals at the Zoo. Kenta was very happy that he could keep the animals warm through the winter.

string.name: name
string.value: Leafre Winter Preparations
Chief Tatamo in Leafre wants your help preparing for winter.
Chief Tatamo of Leafre says that he must prepare for the approaching winter. He wants you to bring him the Hot Stones that can only be found in Leafre.
You gathered the Hot Stones for Chief Tatamo. The Haflingers of Leafre should now have a warm winter.

string.name: name
string.value: Mu Lung Winter Preparations
Tae Sang in Mu Lung says that he knows the secret to staying warm during the winter. Go and see if you can learn the secret from him.

Tae Sang of Mu Lung says that there is a way to stay warm by using a little magic. The secret scroll called 'Temperature Secret' contains the magic. He wants you to get the Temperature Secret, which can be obtained from Mu Lung monsters.
You delivered the Temperature Secret scrolls to Tae Sang. Tae Sang says that with training, he will be able to go through the winter without feeling cold.

string.name: name
string.value: Herb Town Winter Preparations
Mr. Ku in Herb Town is well advanced in years. Listen to how he goes through the winter.

Mr. Ku in Herb Town is known for staying healthy through the winter despite his old age. They say that the secret to his health has something to do with the Yellow Bellflower Bud... The Yellow Bellflower Bud is very rare and can only be found during the winter. Help Mr. Ku by getting Yellow Bellflower Buds.
You gathered Yellow Bellflower Buds for Mr. Ku. The Yellow Bellflower Bud has amazing healing effects. It would certainly be a hot seller if you could only collect a massive amount of it...

string.name: name
string.value: Ariant Winter Preparations
The land of the scorching sun, Ariant, is also preparing for winter. How does such a place prepare for winter? Go see Jiyur at the Town of Ariant.

Jiyur says that Ariant does not have winter. Instead, it endures the scorching sun all year round. However, Ariant exports Fire Sand, a key ingredient in heat packs, to the other cities during the winter. Deliver some Fire Sand to Jiyur.
You delivered the Fire Sand to Jiyur in Ariant, who is poor yet passionate. Perhaps Jiyur will be able to live well this winter by selling the sand...

string.name: name
string.value: Magatia Winter Preparations
Humanoid A in Magatia says that it has something that it must do before the winter ends. Go see the warm, steel-hearted Humanoid A.
Humanoid A is worried about Phyllia and Keeny, and wants to build a fool-proof heater for them. He needs Cast Iron to create the heater, so find some for him.

You obtained the Cast Iron from the Iron Mutae and delivered it to Humanoid A. Humanoid A thanked you for giving him the opportunity to help Phyllia and Keeny. Could it be that you saw tears rolling down his cold, robotic face?

string.name: name
string.value: Warm Thermometer
Cassandra has a fun request for you. What could it be?
Cassandra gives you a Warm Thermometer, saying that she will reward you if you raise the temperature to 15 degrees with the 1 Degrees that are dropped by monsters.
You raised the Warm Thermometer's temperature to 15 degrees and delivered it to Cassandra. You received the Warm Winter Box as a reward.

#p9010010# is talking to you. What kind of event could be planned this time? Respond to #p9010010#.

If you go now, #b#p9000078##k, the PR Manager, will give you a #t4001431# that will allow you to use the mini dungeons located near the temple. string.name: name
string.value: Recycled Golden Ticket

#p9000078# says that he would like to save resources. If you bring him #b10#k #bGolden Ticket Pieces#k, he will issue you another #t4001431#. You can obtain Golden Ticket Pieces from #rany monster#k. \n\n#i4032605# #t4032605# #b#c4032605# / 10#k
You obtained a Golden Ticket in return for 10 Golden Ticket Pieces. If you want another #t4001431#, you can come back after a day has passed.

#p9000076# is praying for her wishes to come true, but she needs to offer a little motivation. Defeat the #r#o8144004##k and bring her some #b#t4000564##k items to offer to the gods of luck. You can enter the Goblin Cave by talking to #b#p9000075##k.

#o8144004##r #a105861##k
#p9000076# gave her offerings, but it will take some time to see if anything comes of it. Wait #b1hour#k to see if her prayers have been answered, then come to see if she needs more help.

string.value: Truth and Lies

string.name: parent
string.value: Gaga's Selfish Lie
You've uncovered the truth behind Cassandra's missing letter. Gaga has something to tell you.

Gaga, who's suffered the sneezy wrath of the #t4032640#, tells you that Cassandra's cherished love letter, which she's never opened, is actually a break-up letter. He wanted to protect Cassandra, but it's now up to you to either tell Cassandra the truth or not.

Cassandra's missing letter incident is over for the time being. Gaga's friendship for Cassandra must be great for him to got to such lengths to protect her feelings. \nWhat's the right choice? Telling the truth knowing that it would break someone's heart, or telling a lie so that she can be happy?\nIt's a tough question to answer.

민족의 큰 명절 한가위가 돌아왔다. 메이플월드에서는 올해도 어김없이 모두와 함께 나눠먹을 송편을 만들기 시작했다는데… 카산드라를 찾아가서 도와줄 일이 없는지 물어보는 것은 어떨까?
민족의 큰 명절 한가위를 맞이해서 올해도 어김없이 메이플월드의 모든 친구들과 나누어 먹기 위해 카산드라가 송편을 만들기 시작했다. 카산드라를 도와 #b#t2022716##k의 재료를 모아서 가져다 주자.\n필요한 재료는 몬스터들에게서 얻을 수 있다고 하는데...
카산드라를 도와서 #b#t2022716##k의 재료를 모아주고, #b#t2022716##k을 하나 받았다. 먹어도 맛있고, 친구들에게 나눠주어도 좋을 것 같다.

string.name: name
string.value: 송편을 만들기 위해 필요한 것
맛있는 송편을 만들기 위해서는 필요한 것이 더 많다는데… #b#p9010010##k를 찾아가서 도와줄 일이 없는지 물어보자.
#p9010010#는 맛있는 송편을 만들기 위해서는 송편이랑 같이 찜통에 넣을 #b#t4032824# 50개#k와 송편끼리 달라붙지 않게 하고 윤기를 내기 위한 #b#t4032825# 10개#k가 필요하다고 했다.\n필요한 재료는 몬스터들에게서 얻을 수 있다고 하는데...
송편을 쪄내기 위해 필요한 솔잎과 기름병을 모아서 카산드라에게 가져다 주었다. 카산드라는 매일매일 와서 자신을 도와달라고 부탁했다.

string.value: Moonlight Sonata's Whereabouts

string.name: parent

Meanwhile, on the moon, Grandpa Moon Bunny has a request for you.

Grandpa Moon Bunny tells you about the forgotten song #bMoonlight Sonata#k. Grandpa Moon Bunny tells you that he wants to play Moonlight Sonata to Baby Moon Bunny before he dies. He asks you to find the Moonlight Sonata Sheet Music for him.\nFirst thing's first. Go ask #bCassandra#k if she knows anything.

Grandpa Moon Bunny told you that he wants to play the lost #bMoonlight Sonata#k to Baby Moon Bunny before he dies. He asked you to find the Moonlight Sonata Sheet Music for him.\nYou went to #bCassandra#k to hear what she had to say.

You asked Rowen, Wing, and Arwen the Fairy about the Moonlight Sonata and found out that #bGold Richie bought some very rare sheet music at auction. You aren't sure what kind of sheet music it was, but you also heard that Gold Richie said something like 'Soon the moonlight will be mine' before the auction started.#k

Gold Richie says that he bought the sheet music, but lost it when monsters attacked him on the way to his safe. He cannot remember what kind of monster attacked him... Maybe you have to start hunting random monsters?

Gold Richie told you that he lost the sheet music on the way to his safe when he was attacked by monsters. Luckily you were able to retrieve the sheet music. You wanted to take the sheet music directly to Grandpa Moon Bunny, but since it was sealed so tightly you were afraid of ripping the sheet music by opening the seal. You had to take the sheet music back to Gold Richie.

string.name: rewardSummary

string.name: name
string.value: Music Box Parts

string.name: parent
string.value: Moonlight Sonata

Gold Richie refuses to let you borrow the sheet music, since it's so valuable. However, he says that he can make a music box that plays Moonlight Sonata for you to take to Grandpa Moon Bunny.\nAll he needs is the right parts... Hunt some monsters and bring him the parts for an music box.
Gold Richie thanked you for retrieving the lost sheet music, but he said he can't let you borrow the sheet music. Instead, you brought him Music Box Cylinders for him to make a music box with.

string.name: rewardSummary

Gold Richie gives you the music box that plays Moonlight Sonata. Take it to Baby Moon Bunny.
Visit Baby Moon Bunny on the moon.

#b#eTip:#n You can go to the moon through the [Dimensional Mirror] in town.

You delivered the music box made by Gold Richie to Baby Moon Bunny. Baby Moon Bunny looked surprised by the unexpected gift.\nBaby Moon Bunny says that the music is very beautiful and told you that it would treasure the music box. #bGrandpa Moon Bunny#k no doubt looks forward to hearing this.

Grandpa Moon Bunny thanks you for bringing the Moonlight Sonata Music Box to Baby Moon Bunny. The sound of Baby Moon Bunny's music box playing Moonlight Sonata beautifully resonates on the small, peaceful moon.

Grandpa Moon Bunny thanked you for bringing the Moonlight Sonata Music Box to Baby Moon Bunny. The sound of Baby Moon Bunny's music box playing Moonlight Sonata beautifully resonated on the small, peaceful moon.

string.name: name
string.value: New World Map Function
Maple Admin wants to talk to you.

Maple Admin wants you to try the new World Map function. The new search function allows you to search for NPCs, monsters, and locations all at once. The new search function also allows you to search for monsters around your level so that you can easily find them. Press W to open the World Map.
Use the new World Map function.

The bleak fall wind brings a shiver to your bones. Cassandra is putting together Starlight Festival Season 5! If you want to participate, visit Cassandra between #bNovember 25th and December 10th#k.

Starlight Festival Season 5 started with a bleak fall wind! You hear that you will be given one Star Stamp that is usable at the website every 45 minutes if you hold on to the 'Hot Stone' Cassandra gave you...

Captain Kyrin says the elders of Victoria Island feel they're still not ready to stand against the Black Mage, even with the aid of the Explorers and Cygnus Knights. She believes they need the help of the Resistance. She asks you to travel across the sea to meet with them, resolve your differences, and ask them to join forces with you.\nDeliver her message to Claudine at #bSecret Plaza#k.

Captain Kyrin of the Nautilus said the elders of Victoria Island feel that the Explorers and Cygnus Knights are not enough to face the Black Mage. She told you they need the help of the Resistance, and asked you to meet with them and resolve your misunderstandings. However, it doesn't seem likely that you'll see eye to eye...\n#bFor now, meet with Claudine.

Claudine had other things on her mind. Vita, who was recently rescued from the Black Wings, started acting weird and disappeared. When you offered to help find her, Claudine refused your help, claiming the Resistance could take care of their own. Headmaster Ferdi was hesitant to act in this age of chaos. As you were speaking with Ferdi, a massive explosion from the mine rocked the town.\n#bClaudine should know what's going on.

string.value: Big Bunnies!
Find Grandpa Moon Bunny in one of the cities.

Grandpa Moon Bunny asks you to defeat the 2 Gigantic Moon Bunnies attacking #bGrandpa's House#k. You can go there by clicking on the Moon Bunny Invitation that comes #bevery 30 minutes between the hours of 10 AM and 10 PM#k.
Grandpa Moon Bunny asked you to defeat the 2 Gigantic Moon Bunnies attacking #bGrandpa's House#k. You returned after defeating both the #bGigantic Boy Moon Bunny and Gigantic Girl Moon Bunny#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Arena of the Ice Knight
#p9070005#, guide of #m960000000#, has something to tell you.
#p9070005# asks you to try out the new Ice Knight mode in #b#m960000000##k. You will get a gift for \rgetting a score of 200 in Ice Knight mode\k... Talk to #b#p9070004##k and go to #m960000000#.
You received a #t4310015# from #p9070005#.

string.name: name
string.value: Ice Knight 500
Talk to #b#p9070005##k in #b#m960000000##k about the new Ice Knight match in Battle Mode.
You can receive one #t4310015# for reaching a #bscore of 500 in Ice Knight mode#k via the Battle Mode event. The event will last for about 2 weeks till #bAugust 9th 2011#k. Try to join every day!
You were rewarded for getting a score of 500.

string.name: name
string.value: The Ice Knight's Curse
Rumors tell of a #r#p9070006##k appearing in #b#m100000000##k between the hours of 2 PM to 3 PM! What could the #p9070006# be after?
In his malice, the #p9070006# cursed you to turn into an Ice Knight...perhaps #b#p9070005##k knows what to do.
You were cursed to turn into an Ice Knight.

string.name: name
string.value: Battle Mode Participation Prize
Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that there is a Battle Mode challenge mission. Hurry over and challenge yourself!

Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that if you participate in any mode 5 times, she will give you a gift.\n\n#rTip! You must fully complete a battle in order to get credit for it. If you leave in the middle or if one day passes, your quest progress will reset.
You have completed the mission and received a gift.

string.name: name
string.value: Free-for-all Professional
Rosette told you that there is a Battle Mode challenge mission. Go and challenge yourself!

Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that if you score 1000 points in one day in Free-for-all mode, she will give you a reward. Give it a try!\n\n#rTip! You must achieve a score of 1000 in one day in Free-for-all mode. If one day passes, your quest progress will reset.
You have achieved a score of 1000 in Free-for-all mode and received a reward.

string.name: name
string.value: Battle Mode MVP
Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that there is a Battle Mode challenge mission...

Rosette, the Battle Square guide, told you that if you win Team Match mode 3 times, she will give you a reward. Why not try it?

#rTip! You must win the Team Match mode 3 times in one day. If one day passes, your quest progress will reset.
You have won Team Match mode 3 times and received a reward.

string.name: name
string.value: Fluttering Maple Leaves
Rosette, the Battle Square guide, wants you to come to the special event celebrating the #bMaple 8th anniversary#k. But what kind of event is it?

Battle Square provides rewards for celebrating the MapleStory 8th anniversary! You could receive #b#t4001523#s#k based on your accumulated scores from any Battle Mode you participate in. Challenge yourself and win big!

Battle Square provides rewards for celebrating the MapleStory 8th anniversary! You could receive #b#t4001523#s#k based on your accumulated scores from any Battle Mode you participate in. Challenge yourself and win big!

string.value: Monster Breakup
As White Day comes near, loving monsters are appearing throughout Maple World...
Talk to Cassandra in town to ask about the monsters...of LOVE!
Cassandra explained the loving monsters to you, and you have resolved to hunt them down.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,000\n

string.name: name
string.value: Spring Picnic Fashion
You heard that monsters stole all of Cassandra's spring clothes for her picnic. Should you go and help her out?
Hunt those monsters and take back Cassandra's clothes.
Now that Cassandra has her clothes back, she should be able to fully enjoy the spring picnic.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: More Spring Picnic Fashion now available.\n\n

string.name: name
string.value: Preparing Picnic Food
The Maple Administrator has a favor to ask of you, about the spring picnic.
The Maple Administrator told you to bring her various foods and an #bEmpty Lunch Box#k. She also told you that the best place to find these is from monsters, so you'd best get hunting!

You gave a bunch of food and an Empty Lunch Box to the Maple Administrator, and got a delicious Spring Picnic Lunch Box. If you receive more than 50 lunch boxes from the Maple Administrator, you could win a big prize!

string.name: name
string.value: Perfect Picnic Day
Poor Gaga has another serious problem. Go see what it is.
Gaga told you that if you keep the Sunshine Doll safe for 30 minutes, it will become a Shining Sunshine Doll. Something seems odd about all this, but you might as well give it a try... \n
The sky is dark and overcast, and on the day of the picnic, too! Hopefully, Gaga's wish for a clear, sunny day will come true.\n

string.name: name
string.value: Spring Picnic Treasure Hunt!
Time for a Treasure Hunt to celebrate the spring picnic! If you do well enough, you could receive a gift!\n
Visit Gaga in town and ask him about the Treasure Hunt in detail.
Ha, so if you work really hard in the Treasure Hunt, you can get treasure? Time to get to work, then!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,000\n

string.name: name
string.value: More Spring Picnic Fashion
Sounds like Cassandra is having more problems with her clothes. See what's wrong.
Cassandra wants you to get more clothes from the monsters. You want to help Cassandra out, right?
Cassandra should be happy now...right? Hope she enjoys her spring...and doesn't need anything else.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Even More Spring Picnic Fashion now available.\n

string.name: name
string.value: Even More Spring Picnic Fashion
Cassandra is having another fashion disaster. Go figure. Visit Cassandra in town.
You might as well accept her request. This IS the last one...isn't it?
Finally, Cassandra seems to be at peace, and so is Maple World. Good job.

string.value: [Join] I am a Cygnus Fan
3 citizens of Maple World are competing to be the Maple Rising Star! Become a fan of Cygnus, and help her live her dream!
#bCygnus#k has a noble background and a gifted voice. By cheering her on, maybe you can help her win! Head to the Rising Star Hall via Dimensional Mirror to meet her.
Cheer for your chosen star, Cygnus!

string.name: name
string.value: [Vocal] You've Got Talent!
Help Cygnus's Singing!

8 Handbells, 8 tones... You already have the 'Do' Handbell from the Maple Administrator. She told you that you can find the other 7 Handbells by hunting monsters.


#bIt seems like monsters 11 levels higher or lower than your current level do not have the Handbells, unless they are level 150 or higher.
You've been working so hard for your Star... It's all worth it, right?

string.name: name
string.value: [Instrument] The Challenge of Orpheus!
Help Cygnus's Music!

Cassandra told you to bring all of the Sheet Music left by the legendary bard, Orpheus. You're not sure how all these little dots and lines are supposed to help, though...


#bIt seems like monsters 11 levels higher or lower than your current level do not have the Sheet Music, unless they are level 150 or higher.
Someday, you might be able to play instruments well. Don't be jealous.

string.value: [Dance] Shall We Dance?

You don't know how useful this machine is, but it was worth the experience, right?

string.name: name
string.value: [Fame] What Do Stars Live For?
Make Cygnus Famous!

Stars live a fast and fabulous life, but even they are vulnerable sometimes. Cygnus could use some support, so get her Encouragement Placards from monsters.


#bIt seems like monsters 11 levels higher or lower than your current level do not have the Encouragement Placards, unless they are level 150 or higher.
What do stars live for? The fans, of course!

string.name: name
string.value: [Reputation] The Tabloids Strike!
Save Cygnus's Reputation!
A star's reputation is their life. Teach those Star Paparazzi a lesson for taking humiliating pictures of Cygnus, and bring her those pictures!
Good thing you eliminated those Star Paparazzi. Her pictures were embarrassing, but that won't stop you from being Cygnus's biggest fan!

string.name: name
string.value: The Rising Fanatic!
Your favorite star, Cygnus, has something to say to you... Wonder if this is something about her fan club?
Wow! If you help your Star with her Rising Star training 30 times or more, you can be her official crazed fan! You need to work really hard!
You are an official Cygnus fanatic! The yellow balloon says it all!

string.name: name
string.value: [Join] I am a Valerie Fan
3 citizens of Maple World are competing to be the Maple Rising Star! Become a fan of Valerie, and help her live her dream!
Valerie has great dance moves and a fantastic voice, but can be a little unruly. By cheering her on, maybe you can help her win! Head to the #rRising Star Hall#k via Dimensional Mirror to meet her.
Cheer for your chosen star, Valerie!

string.name: name
string.value: [Vocal] You've Got Talent!
Help Valerie's Singing!

8 Handbells, 8 tones... You already have the 'Do' Handbell from the Maple Administrator. She told you that you can find the other 7 Handbells by hunting monsters.


#bIt seems like monsters 11 levels higher or lower than your current level do not have the Handbells, unless they are level 150 or higher.
You've been working so hard for your Star... It's all worth it, right?

string.name: name
string.value: [Instrument] The Challenge of Orpheus!
Help Valerie's Music!

Cassandra told you to bring all of the Sheet Music left by the legendary bard, Orpheus. You're not sure how all these little dots and lines are supposed to help, though...


#bIt seems like monsters 11 levels higher or lower than your current level do not have the Sheet Music, unless they are level 150 or higher.
Someday, you might be able to play instruments well. Don't be jealous.

string.name: name
string.value: [Dance] Shall We Dance?
Valerie is in a rut, practicing the same dance moves over and over. See if Gaga has any ideas.
This Funky Machine will record all of your moves for 30 minutes. Will that help?
You don't know how useful this machine is, but it was worth the experience, right?

string.name: name
string.value: The Tale of the Knights of Virtue
Cassandra has something very important to tell you. It seems something very strange is going on...
What could be happening in Maple World? Perhaps Cassandra knows something about it.

You should make the most of the Stone of Virtue. By using its power, you can challenge monsters stronger than you have ever faced before. 


You can charge your Stone of Virtue at the following locations. The numbers in parenthesis are the levels of the monsters there.


#b[Henesys] Golem's Temple (Lv. 20-26)
[Mushroom Castle] Skyscraper (Lv. 33-34)
[Kerning Square] Field (Lv. 32-41)
[Orbis] Garden of 3 Colors 2 (Lv. 46)
[Sleepywood] Swamp (Lv. 50)
[Chryse] Field (Lv. 55-62)
[Korean Folk Town] Field (Lv. 55-64)
[Omega Sector] Boswell Field (Lv. 66-71)
[Edelstein] Verne Mine Shaft (Lv. 70-79)
[Ariant] Sunset Road (Lv. 76-84)
[Mu Lung] Training Center (Lv. 82-83)
[Magatia] Alcadno Research Institute (Lv. 83-89)
[Red-Nose Pirate] Pirate Den (Lv. 99-105)#k\##b[Leafre Battlefield] Kentaurus (Lv. 118)
[Leafre Dragon Forest] Dragon Forest (Lv. 127-142)
[Temple] Road of Regrets (Lv. 151-157)#k

string.value: Using the Stone of Virtue
Cassandra wants to talk to you regarding the Stone of Virtue.

When you eliminate monsters while possessing the Stone of Virtue, it will absorb power and boost the Virtue gauge. By clicking on the Knight of Virtue icon on the left side of the screen, you can view a list of hunting grounds to charge the Stone in.
If there is no Knights of Virtue icon, then your Stone of Virtue may be missing from your Inventory.

Cassandra is worried about something...
Eliminate 200 monsters threatening to destroy the Tempest Festival. Remember that only monsters between 11 levels below and 21 levels above you count!
You got a reward for your efforts! You can help Cassandra with this quest every 10 minutes.

string.name: name
string.value: Fighting Heat with Heat
Arturo says that weird customers have been stopping by lately seeking meds to beat the heat, but he thinks the best way to handle the sizzling temperature is to eliminate monsters!\n\n

string.name: name
string.value: Forecasting Rain

Bruce says it's a pain not knowing when the summer rains will fall. However, certain animals have a sense about these things, so he placed #e#bBrain Wave Recorders#k#n on them. He wants to you retrieve 100 of them so he can check the weather.

string.name: name
string.value: Gentle Breeze Fan

Mar the Fairy says poor pets are getting worn out by the heat. However, a Gentle Breeze Fan would cool them right off. Eliminate monsters, find the Gentle Breeze they 'borrowed,' and bring it back to Mar the Fairy,

string.name: name
string.value: Sabitrama's Logic

Here's what Sabitrama thinks: If you sit around indoors eating ice cream to beat the heat, you'll only wind up getting fat, which'll make you even hotter. Instead, you should exercise...by eliminating monsters!

string.name: name
string.value: Beating Heat Stroke

Icarus just adores his new hobby: hang gliding. Unfortunately, too much hang gliding in this heat has given him heat stroke! Some #e#bForeverfreeze ice#k#n from the Ice Pillar should fix him right up, though. Collect some from the #b#eIce Pillars#n#k that can be found throughout Maple World and help Icarus cool off.

string.name: name
string.value: Gale Gourd

Lisa wants to help the wind fairy retrieve her lost wind. Take the gourd she gave you to Cassandra and ask her for a #bGale Gourd for Windy the Wind Fairy#k.\n\nComplete #r#e[Tempest] The Gale Gourd quest#k#n to obtain a #e#bGale Gourd for Windy the Wind Fairy#k#n.

string.name: name
string.value: Catch the Cat Burglars

Nolbu says that Street Cats broke into his house while he was on summer vacay and stole his gold coins! Now they're disguising themselves as balls of yarns and hiding amongst monsters. Eliminate monsters, find the disguised Street Cats, and teach them a lesson!

string.name: name
string.value: The Ultimate Soup

Mr. Do created a soup that can reinvigorate people suffering from the heat, but he lost the recipe in Tae Sang's backyard. He says to search in a red box beneath the peach tree there. To enter Tae Sang's House, you need #e#bTae Sang's Emblem#k#n, which Tae Sang ALSO lost. Defeat monsters to find the emblem so you can retrieve that recipe!

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Obtain #bTae Sang's Emblem#k from monsters, go to Tae Sang's backyard, and search the wooden box underneath the peach tree.

string.name: name
string.value: [Red Leaf High] Chapter3 : Ghost in the Music Room
Go talk to Homeroom Teacher #p9000127#.

There is a story about a girl from Red Leaf High who loved the piano. The girl played the piano every day after school in the music room and one day she fell asleep because she was too tired. That night, the caretaker without knowing that the girl had fallen asleep had locked the classroom. And on the next day after realizing the girl was missing, the people opened up the doors to the classroom to find something shocking. There was no trace of the girl but only distinct nail marks left on the doors to the music room. She must tried to claw her way out because she was so scared. People looked for her everywhere in the school but she was nowhere to be found. After that day, every night, sound of piano being played in the music room can be heard but because the piano sounds are so horrible, they are frightening. The Sheet Music of the girl have to be taken away so that the frightening music can be stopped from being played.\n

string.name: name
string.value: Greetings from the Young Empress.
You have decided to become one of the Knights serving the young Empress and battle the indestructible Black Mage. You better first meet up with #b#p1101000# and formally introduce yourself.
#p1101000# expressed her gratitude on your decision to become a Cygnus Knight and made a promise that she will always be there for you.
#p1101000# claims that it is ultimately in your hands to defeat the Black Mage. She says that her trustworthy Tactician, #p1101002#, will be responsible for molding you into a formidable Knight.

string.name: name
string.value: Neinheart the Tactician
Now you have to meet up with #p1101000#'s Tactician, #b#p1101002##k, and discuss what you have to do in the future.

#p1101002# claimed that you may be too weak to fight for Maple World, and therefore refused to name you as a Knight-in-Training. He stated that the training period towards becoming a Knight-in-Training is already set up, and that you need to meet up with #b#p1102000#, the Training Instructor#k.

#p1101002# claimed that you may be too weak to fight for Maple World, and therefore refused to name you as a Knight-in-Training. He stated that the training period towards becoming a Knight-in-Training is already set up, and that you need to meet up with #b#p1102000#, the Training Instructor#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Kiku the Training Instructor
As stated by #p1101002#, you have to first raise your level to 10 and become a Knight-in-Training. You have to visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and enter the Training Forest.

You met with #p1102000# at the entrance of the Training Forest. According to #p1102000#, Ereve is bereft of monsters, and instead, everyone trains against fantasy creatures created by #p1101001# called 'Mimi'. He then proceeded to give you a potion called #p1102000#...
#p1102000# shot a warning saying that training will be tough. You better pack up the potions that he gave you and get ready for the training.

string.name: name
string.value: Kiku's First Training Session
Visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive some training.

The first session involved facing off against the weakest Mimi in all of Ereve, #r#o0100120##k, and defeating #r5#k of them in the process. You better hunt down those #o0100120#s in #b#m130010000##k \n\n#o0100120##r #a200031##k
You managed to defeat all 5 #o0100120#s and return. Off to the next session.

string.name: name
string.value: Kiku's Second Training Session
Visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive some training.

The second session involved facing off against the 2nd weakest Mimi in all of Ereve, #r#o0100121##k, and defeating #r10#k of them in the process. You better hunt down those #o0100121#s at or near #b#m130010000##k. \n\n#o0100121##r #a200041##k
You managed to defeat all 10 #o0100121#s and return. Off to the next session.

string.name: name
string.value: Kiku's Third Training Session
Visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive some training.

The third session involved facing off against the third weakest monster of Ereve, #r#o0100122##k, and defeating #r15#k of them in the process. You better hunt down those #o0100122#s in #b#m130010100##k. \n\n#o0100122##r #a200051##k
You managed to defeat all 15 #o0100122#s and return. Off to the next session.

string.name: name
string.value: Kiku's Fourth Training Session
Visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive some training.

#p1102000#'s fourth session involves facing off against the fourth weakest... you get the drill. Anyway, an easy Mimi called #r#o0100123##k, and defeating #r20#k of them in the process. You better hunt down those #o0100123#s in #b#m130010100##k. \n\n#o0100123##r #a200061##k
You managed to defeat all 15 #o0100122#s and return. Off to the next session.

string.name: name
string.value: Kiku's Last Training Session
Visit #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k and receive his fifth training session.

#p1102000# said you've done a good job, and wanted you to defeat #b3 #o0100124#s#k for the last time. He warned you that unlike other Mimis, #o0100124# has significantly higher stamina, so you better be careful... \n\n#o0100124##r #a200071##k
You managed to defeat the #o0100124#s and return. #p1102000# greeted you with a smile and said you are now eligible to become a Knight-in-Training. He then advised you to go see #p1101002# again.

string.name: name
string.value: The Path of a Knight
It's time to receive the last test given by #b#p1102000# the Training Instructor#k in order to become a Knight-in-Training.

An eternal loyalty towards the Empress. The courage to stand up to the Black Mage. The will power required to keep your faith intact. As long as you don't forget these three, you'll be able to fight until the very end as a proud member of Cygnus Knights.

string.value: Welcome to Ereve
You have entered Maple World with a determination to become a #p1101000# Knight. But where is this place? Double-click #b#p1102004##k and start a conversation.

At the request of the Empress, #p1102004#, with his brothers, guides Noblesses who aspire to become a part of #p1101000# Knights. If you #bfollow the arrow to the left#k you'll meet #p1102004#'s brother #b#p1102005##k.

You have come back after hunting the #o0100120#s. #p1102005# says you can meet his brother #p1102006# if you continue to your left.

string.value: How Well Do You Know Your Skills?

#p1102006# informed you that you can open your Skill window by pressing the #bK key#k and suggested that you hunt #r3 #o100121#s#k and bring #b1 #t4000483##k to prove that you know how to use your skills.

string.name: type

While slaying the zombies, I was able to obtain an item called #t4001207#. Once I did that, #p2032001# approached me.

#b#p2032001##k warned me that #b#t4001207##k contained a curse-like power that spread all over this world, and that since it's a dangerous item, he wanted me to hand it in to him so he could break the curse. While listening to #p2032001# talk, however, I noticed #p1103000#'s name being mentioned... \n\n#i4001207# #t4001207# #b#c4001207# / 1#k
I gave #p2032001# the #t4001207#. #p2032001# told me that #p1103000# gave him #t4001207# too the other day, and that he recently moved to #m240000000# to find out more about #t4001207#.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]

According to #p2081000#, #p1103000# went to visit the #bDragon Outcast#k outside town. Apparently, the scale of the Dragon Outcast is similar to #t4001207#'s... I better go visit Dragon Outcast. His house is #bconnected to #m240020401# or #m240020101##k.

When I asked #p2081012#, the Dragon Outcast, about #p1103000#, he seemed perturbed by my question and got mad at me for it. Apparently, #t4001207# is not his. He thought it might have to do instead with the stolen dragon egg incident at #m240000000#...

string.name: name
string.value: The Stolen Egg

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]
#o9001010#? Something about it seems suspicious... I better ask #b#p2081012##k, the Dragon Outcast.

#p2081012# told me if I wanted to find out more about #o9001010#, then I'll have to eliminate one #r#o8180000##k and one #r#o8180001##k. He wanted to leave the house, but not with those creatures out there... I better help #p2081012# out. 

#o8180000##r #a204041##k 
#o8180001##r #a204042##k

The one responsible for stealing the dragon's egg in #m240000000# turned out to be #o9001010#. Even the name seemed quite suspicious. Maybe #p1103000# looked into #o9001010#. I better go visit #o9001010# right now. #b#o9001010#'s cave is located near the dragon's nest#k.

string.value: The Cave of the Black Witch

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]
I better go visit the #bCave of the #o9001010##k as instructed by #p2081012#.

There was a note posted on the wall of the cave. After reading the note, I noticed that it may have been written by #p1103000#. The subject of the curse was not found, but the device was found, recovered, and sent back to Ereve. I may have been one step too late. #p1103000# must have completed his assignment already. I better return to #bEreve#k.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]

I was going to complain to #p1101002# about doing all that work for nothing, but he seemed more concerned that #p1103000# hasn't come back and that something might be up. He then asked me if I could return to the #bCave of the #o9001010##k and find out if there's another note somewhere inside.

#p1101002# told me #p1103000# has not yet come back and that something might be up. He then asked me if I could return to the #bCave of the #o9001010##k and find out if there's another note somewhere inside.

string.name: name
string.value: The Curse of the Black Witch

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]

...Wait, is this Ereve? But Ereve's usually not like this. And why are the Chief Knights standing like that? No one's answering! Only #p1101001# seemed to be barely awake. I better talk to #b#p1101001##k.

#p1101001# told me the lady in front is actually #r#p1104002# the #o9001010##k and that she has put a curse on everyone in Ereve. He mentioned that most of them on the island should be able to weather it, but the Empress might be in grave danger... I better defeat #o9001010# and break the curse now! \n\n#o9001010##r #a204071##k

The cunning #o9001010#, after realizing that Ereve, which is protected by #p1101001#, may be hard to enter, used #p1103000# to throw in cursed items, then cursed the whole island through that! Fortunately, after defeating #o9001010#, the curse seems to have been lifted.

I received a call from #p1101000#, the young Empress herself.
The young Empress thanked me for my efforts in saving Ereve and decided, through my accomplishments and past work, that I would be promoted to the position of Chief Knight. Chief Knight?

I wound up being anointed as the new Chief Knight for the Cygnus Knights. I made a promise to the Empress that the moment the Black Mage reawakens, I will be the first in line to defeat the Black Mage.

string.value: Mounts for Knights
I better talk to #b#p1101002##k and get some information on Monster Mounts for Knights.
#p1101002# told me I'll need to visit #b#p1102002# the Mount Trainer#k, who's at the #bHatchery#k raising the Mimis for Mounts.
I met with #p1102002# the Mount Trainer.

string.name: name
string.value: Raising Mimiana
I better visit the #bHatchery#k and talk to #b#p1102002# the Mount Trainer#k about the Mounts for knights.

#p1102002# told me the Mounts for the knights are through #t1902005#, a type of Mimi, and told me I'll have to raise #t1902005# on my own. He then handed me a small egg... #t1902005# can be raised by #bsharing my experiences with it#k.
After fully raising #t1902005#, I handed it back to #p1102002#.

string.name: name
string.value: Riding Mimiana
How does a fully-grown #t1902005# act? I better talk to #b#p1102002# the Mount Trainer#k for the answer.

#p1102002# told me that #t1902005# may have grown quite a bit, but it's not ready to be mounted, and told me I'll need to make it stronger by feeding #t1902005# with some of #b#p2060005#'s Supplements#k. He then instructed me to go purchase #p2060005#'s Supplements. Aren't they quite expensive?
#p1102002# handed me a mountable #t1902005# and #t1912005#, and taught me the Monster Mount skill.

string.name: name
string.value: Supplements for Mimiana
In order to strengthen #t1902005# so I can Mount it, then I must feed the creature with #p2060005#'s Supplements. I better go visit #b#p2060005##k at #b#m230000000##k.
#p2060005# told me he would give me a discount on his supplements since I knew him, then proceeded to charge me 10 million mesos for them. Seriously, what's inside these Supplements?
Saddened, but undeterred, I managed to purchase #p2060005#'s Supplements.

string.name: name
string.value: Making a Saddle
I lost the #t1912005# for Mounts. What should I do...? I better talk to #b#p1102002# the Mount Trainerk# for help.

#p1102002# tells you that because of budget issues, he can't give you a spare #t1912005#. He suggests that you come up with a new #t1912005# on your own. It is rumored that #p2060005# of #m230000000# is a great maker of #t1912005#s, but it will probably be very expensive. You'll have to bring the materials and the service charge for the #t1912005# to #p2060005#.


#i4000030# #t4000030# #b#c4000030# / 200#k
#i4000055# #t4000055# #b#c4000055# / 200#k
#b5,000,000#k Mesos
I handed #p2060005# the materials for #t1912005#, along with the service charge, and received #t1912005# in return. I better make sure not to lose #t1912005# ever again.

string.name: name
string.value: Re-raising Mimiana
I lost #t1902005#. What should I do? I better talk to #b#p1102002# the Mount Trainer#k about this situation.

#t1902005# is a fantasy creature that naturally dissolves if it stays away from its master for a prolonged period of time. In short, if I want #t1902005# back, I'll have to #bawaken the creature from the egg stage, starting over from scratch#k. #p1102002# said he can get the Supplements for me, but I'll have to pay for it again... sigh. I'll have to rack up enough experience to awaken #t1902005# once more.
I was able to awaken #t1902005# once more. I better not lose it again.

string.name: name
string.value: A Knight's Pride
