Maybe #b#p1061011##k of #m105040300# can tell me something useful about #o9300285#...
#p1061011# told me he can give useful information on #o9300285# if I can eliminate #r250 #o2230101#s#k for him. \n\n#o2230101##r #a207261##k
According to #p1061011#, #o9300285# is a little boy whose name is #r#p1104000##k...

string.name: name
string.value: Sabitrama's Information
Maybe #b#p1061005##k of #m105040300# can tell me something useful about #o9300285#...
#p1061005# says he can give you useful information on #o9300285# if you can eliminate #r100 #o2230100#s#k for him. \n\n#o2230100##r #a207271##k
According to #p1061005#, #o9300285# lives somewhere around Perion.

string.name: name
string.value: Chrishrama's Information
Maybe #b#p1061000##k of #m105040300# can tell me something useful about #o9300285#...
#p1061000# told me he can give useful information on #o9300285# if I can collect #b100 #t4000015#s#k for him. \n\n#i4000015# #t4000015# #b#c4000015# / 100#k
According to #p1061000#, #o9300285# seems to doodle in front of #p1061006# when busy. If I look closely into #p1061006#, I may be able to find something...

string.name: name
string.value: Mysterious Statue's Information
According to #p1061000#, there may be some clues of #o9300285# on the surface of #b#p1061006##k. I'll have to talk to #p1061006#.
Something seems to be written on it, but it's hard to see. I'll have to move #p1061006# around.
At the back of #p1061006#, I found some writings on it with a horrible handwriting. It said: The password is XXXXXXX is a genius #o9300285#!

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1061006##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Find the Puppeteer!
I better report the information gathered in #m105040300# to #b#p1101002##k.

#p1101002# told you he's certain the boy carrying the doll is #o9300285#, so he wants you to enter the #bhome of #o9300285##k at the Perion #m102010100# to defeat #r#p1104000# the #o9300285##k. \n\n#o9300285##r #a207301##k

I was able to defeat #p1104000# the #o9300285#. Afterwards, when I asked #p1101002# of the word 'Black Wings' that I picked up during our battle, he revealed that the Black Wings are a group that follows the Black Mage and #p1104000# was also a member as well.

string.name: name
string.value: Ultimate Explorer
Empress Cygnus in Ereve has an urgent matter to talk to you about...
For the Empress, please be reborn as the Ultimate Explorer.
You have made the Ultimate Explorer, the special project for the Captain Knights.

string.name: name
string.value: The Mind of a Knight: Beginnings
#p1101002# is requesting your presence.
#p1101002# asked to see you in #m130000000#. Pay him a visit.
You have begun the long journey towards a noble mind; the ultimate virtue for any Cygnus Knight.

string.name: name
string.value: The Mind of a Knight: Part Two
#p1101002# is requesting your presence.
This is the opportunity #p1101002# spoke of. Go to #m130000000#.
#p1101002# has approved of your training, but the journey for a noble mind does not end so soon...

string.name: name
string.value: The Mind of a Knight: Part Three
#p1101002# is requesting your presence.
This is the opportunity #p1101002# spoke of. Go to #m130000000#.
#p1101002# has approved of your training, but the journey for a noble mind does not end so soon...

string.name: name
string.value: The Mind of a Knight: Part Four
#p1101002# is requesting your presence.
This is the opportunity #p1101002# spoke of. Go to #m130000000#.
#p1101002# has approved of your training, but the journey for a noble mind does not end so soon...

string.name: name
string.value: The Mind of a Knight: Part Five
#p1101002# is requesting your presence.
This is the opportunity #p1101002# spoke of. Go to #m130000000#.
#p1101002# has approved of your training, but the journey for a noble mind does not end so soon...

string.name: name
string.value: The Mind of a Knight: The Finale
#p1101002# is requesting your presence.
This is the opportunity #p1101002# spoke of. Go to #m130000000#.
Your mind is noble, your heart is clear. You have become a true Cygnus Knight.

string.name: name
string.value: Advanced Knight
If you complete your 3rd Job Advancement, you can earn the #b<Advanced Knight>#k title.
If you complete your 3rd Job Advancement, you can earn the #b<Advanced Knight>#k title.
You protected Shinsoo's Teardrop, and earned the title of #b<Advanced Knight>#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Chief Knight
Break the Black Witch's curse and obtain the #b<Chief Knight>#k title!
Break the Black Witch's curse and obtain the #b<Chief Knight>#k title!
You broke the Black Witch's curse and rescued the Empress! You may now use the title of #b<Chief Knight>#k!

string.name: name
string.value: The City of Ereve
Empress Cygnus is putting together an elite group of knights to stand up against the Black Mage.\n\nWhat must you do to become a knight? Talk to #p1102101# and find out.
Go with Training Instructor Kimu to the Knight's Orientation.
You followed Training Instructor Kimu to the Knight's Orientation.

string.name: name
string.value: Knight's Orientation
You have reached the Knight's Orientation. Talk to Kimu.
Talk with Training Instructor Kiku. Click the NPC button on the minimap if you need to find him.\n
You found Training Instructor Kiku amongst the crowd.

string.name: name
string.value: The Path of Bravery
Talk to Training Instructor Kiku.
Talk to #bKimu#k about continuing your training.
Start training with Kimu to become a knight.

string.name: name
string.value: Question and Answer
Your training has begun. Talk to Kimu.
Ask Kimu any questions you may have.
You found out more about the Empress, the Black Mage, and the Cygnus Knights.

string.name: name
string.value: Knight's Cavalier
Kimu has prepared something for you.

Try out the #bKnight's Cavalier hat#k Kimu gave you.


#e[How to Equip]#n

1. Open the item inventory window by pressing the hotkey I.

2. Double-click on the hat, or left-click and drag it into your Equip window to equip.

3. Open the Equip window by pressing the hotkey E to make sure it's equipped.

You have learned how to equip items! Press the hotkey I to open the inventory window, and then double-click on the item to equip it. Open the Equip window by pressing the hotkey E, and double-click on the item to unequip it.\n

string.name: name
string.value: Well-Behaved Student
Greet Training Instructor Kinu.
Kinu told you to sit down and focus on the class. Press X in front of the wooden chair, sit down, and PAY ATTENTION.\n
Sit in the chair and focus on Kinu's class.

string.name: name
string.value: Lesson 1 - Ereve History
Double-click on Kinu and go through the class.
So Hawkeye, the Knight of Thunder, was the jerk who interrupted class? Time to regulate!
Hawkeye is quiet and Kinu has resumed class. Good work, teacher's pet!

string.name: name
string.value: What's Next?
Now that his class is over, ask Kimu what's next.
Go to the Basic Training site for the second training.
So...this is the Training Site.

string.name: name
string.value: Lesson 2 - Physical Training
Go through the Basic Training with Kimu. He'll know what to do next.
Try climbing ropes and jumping towards the targets. You can handle that!\n
That's it for basic training.

string.name: name
string.value: Lesson 3 - Battle Basics 1
Talk to combat instructor Kizan and start the next training.

#bDefeat 3 #o9300730# monsters#k and report to Kizan.

#rYou can press the Ctrl key to attack the monsters.#k
You have defeated 3 #o9300730# monsters with regular attacks.

string.name: name
string.value: A Much-Needed Break
Kimu, who is next to Kizan, is smiling at you. That probably means he has something to say.\n

Kimu gave you a cool drink. You should try it!

Press the hotkey I to open the inventory window, and then double-click on the drink to, y'know, drink it.
Whoo! That was refreshing! You also feel a bit stronger now.

string.name: name
string.value: Lesson 3 - Battle Basics 2
Talk to Kizan and continue training.

Review regular attacks again.
Defeat 3 #o9300730# monsters, and collect 3 #t4000489# items.

You can press the Ctrl key to attack monsters,
and the Z key to pick up items.

You have completed basic battle training.

[Regular Attack]
Press the Ctrl key to attack.

[Pick Up Items]
Press the Z key to pick up items.

string.name: name
string.value: Lesson, Interrupted
Talk to Kizan and continue on to the next lesson.
You were about to begin the power battle training, but Training Instructor Kiku appeared! What could this be about?
He said that there's something urgent going on with the new knights, and he wants you to wait here. Really? That sounds boring...

string.name: name
string.value: Tiny Bird
While waiting for Kizan, a tiny bird appeared. This might be important!
It looks as if the tiny bird wants you to follow it. You'd better scoot before Kizan returns.
You followed the tiny bird and arrived at a garden.

string.name: name
string.value: The Tranquil Garden
You followed the tiny bird and met a girl. She doesn't look like a new knight, so who could she be? \nClick on the girl and talk to her.\n

While talking to the girl about the Empress and the knights, some people showed up. There's someone with glasses, and someone who... Is that Hawkeye, the Chief Knight of Lightning?! \nTalk to the one who is wearing glasses.\n
Politely greet Neinheart and the Chief Knight again.

string.name: name
string.value: The Chief Knights
Neinheart called the girl Empress. Wait, were you just talking to the Empress? Yikes! Talk to Neinheart again.
The Chief Knight of Lightning, Hawkeye, has something to say.
You met the Empress, the Tactician, and the 5 Chief Knights at the Tranquil Garden.

string.name: name
string.value: Lesson, Resumed
You tried to return before Kizan, but he found you at the Tranquil Garden. Talk to Kizan.
You must return to the Drill Hall with Kizan and continue training.

You heard about skill attacks from Kizan.

Hotkey K – Open skill window
Hotkey ] – Quickslot
You can drag the skill icon to the quickslot, and then use the skill.

string.name: name
string.value: Lesson 5 - Skills
Ask Kizan about the details of skill attacks.
#bAttack 5 #o9300731# monsters#k with the #rElemental Slash skill#k.
That's it for Battle Training! Just pass the Knight-in-Training test, and you're done!\n\nGo to the Test Site by going through the Portal on the left.

string.name: name
string.value: Certified Knight
You met Kia at the Knight-in-Training Test Site.

You must defeat the monsters that appear when you break the boxes scattered around, and collect 3 Proof of Exam items.

You can break boxes with regular attacks (Ctrl).
You passed Kia's test! You're really going to be a Cygnus Knight!

string.name: name
string.value: Meeting with the Empress
After finishing Kia's test, Kiku appeared. Talk to Kiku.
You must go find the Empress at the center of Ereve. Follow the arrow to the left.
You met Empress #p1101000# again. She looks weak, but has a warm smile.

string.name: name
string.value: Knight Maintenance
Hawkeye says that he has some advice for you about being a Knight.

You get AP and SP if you train hard and level up. You can use these to enhance your abilities.

[AP Distribution]
You can open up the stats window with the hotkey S, and then you can assign AP to increase the stats needed for the class.
Use the Auto-Assign button to increase whatever is most useful for your character.

[SP Distribution]
Open up the skill window with the hotkey K, and then use available SP (Skill Points) to increase the level of your #1st attack skill#.
You can become an even stronger knight if you use the AP and SP you received after becoming a Knight-in-Training. Train hard and bring honor to the Cygnus name.

string.value: Knight Maintenance

string.name: name
string.value: The First Mission
Meet #b#p1101002##k, the great tactician of #p1101000#, and ask what your next step should be.

Go find 10 Boogies in #b#m130000200##k.

1. Press the hotkey Q to open the quest info window.
2. Click on the Navigation button. 
3. Click on the shining area in the World Map UI and select it as your destination.
4. Press the Enable Navigation button on the World Map UI.
5. You can follow the direction of the red arrow on top of your head to find 10 Boogies.
You met 10 Boogies at the Crossroads of Ereve.\nAsk 10 Boogies what kind of mission you have to do.\n

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Permit 1
You met 10 Boogies, and she seems to have lost something...\nThis isn't the best start, but she might have something useful for you to do.\n

10 Boogies lost the Ereve Investigation Permit!
Follow her to where she thinks she lost it. It was near Timu.

You can search for 'Timu' in the World Map UI (Hotkey W) to find the location.
You can find the location more easily if you add it to your Navigation.
You went to #m130010110# as 10 Boogies asked, but the Ereve Investigation Permit is nowhere to be found.

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Permit 2
10 Boogies seems to have brightened up. See what's on her mind.

She said you should check all the paths you've seen so far. Great.

Press the hotkey W to open up the World Map UI, search for Tiguru's Forest in the World Map UI, add it to Navigation, and then go there.
You have arrived at #m130010210#, just like 10 Boogies asked.

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Permit 3
10 Boogies looks unhappy again. She's staring at her feet.
So the Tigurus took the Ereve Investigation Permit! Defeat the Tigurus in Tiguru's Forest and recover the precious permit.
You found the Ereve Investigation Permit! 10 Boogies will be overjoyed.

string.name: name
string.value: Reporting to Neinheart
10 Boogies looks satisfied with the permit. Now might be a good time to ask about your next mission.

You must report to Neinheart that the first mission has been completed.

Press the hotkey Q to open the quest info window and then click on the Navigation button. You can follow the red arrow over your head to meet Neinheart.
You have reported your success to Neinheart.

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Treasure
Neinheart says he has something urgent to ask of you...

The Black Wings aren't out of Ereve yet, so you must search everywhere for the lost treasure.

The problem is that #o9300743# can take the form of other people, so you must talk to everyone to make sure they're not an impostor.

Focus your search on #m130010010#, #m130010020#, and #m130010120#.
You defeated the Black Wing members #o9300743# and #p1104001# and recovered the lost treasure.

string.name: name
string.value: The Mock Training
Talk to Neinheart again.
Listen to Neinheart explain the Mock Training.
Sounds like Neinheart approves of your capabilities based on the Mock Training.

string.name: name
string.value: Learn to Combo
Someone with a clear and strong voice calls to you. Who could it be?
Someone with a clear and strong voice calls to you. Who could it be?
You have learned about linked attacks from Hawkeye, the Chief Knight of the Thunder Breakers.

string.name: name
string.value: The Five Paths
Go to #b#p1101002##k and get approval to be a Knight-in-Training.
There are five paths to choose from: a Swordsman of light, a Magician of fire, a Bowman of wind, a Thief of darkness, or a Pirate of lightning. What is your choice?
There are five paths to choose from: a Swordsman of light, a Magician of fire, a Bowman of wind, a Thief of darkness, or a Pirate of lightning. What is your choice?

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: The Path of a Dawn Warrior
The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Dawn Warrior, the Swordsman of light, talk to the #bChief Knight of Light #p1101003##k.
If you want to become a brilliant, glorious #bDawn Warrior#k of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101003#.
You are now Dawn Warrior!

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: The Path of a Blaze Wizard
The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Blaze Wizard, the Magician of fire, talk to the #bChief Knight of Fire #p1101004##k.
If you want to become a hot-blooded #bBlaze Wizard#k of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101004#.
You are now a Blaze Wizard!

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: The Path of a Wind Archer
The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Wind Archer, the Bowman of wind, talk to the #bChief Knight of the Wind #p1101005##k.
If you want to become free-spirited Wind Archer of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101005#.
You are now a Wind Archer!

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: The Path of a Night Walker
The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Night Walker, the Thief of darkness, talk to the #bChief Knight of Darkness #p1101006##k.
If you want to become a shadowy Night Walker of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101006#.
You are now a Night Walker!

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: The Path of a Thunder Breaker
The time has come to make your choice. If you want to know about the Thunder Breaker, the Pirate of lightning, talk to the #bChief Knight of Lightning #p1101007##k.
If you want to become a thrill-seeking Thunder Breaker of the Cygnus Knights, then select #p1101007#.
You are now a Thunder Breaker!

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: End of the Knight-in-Training
As you reach Lv. 30, you hear #p1101002#'s voice in your head...
#p1101002# says that with your level of experience, you are ready to become an official knight. He suggest that you attempt the #bKnighthood Exam#k. Go to Ereve if you want to become a true knight.
#p1101002# says that with your level of experience, you are ready to become an official knight. He suggest that you attempt the Knighthood Exam. Go to Ereve if you want to become a true knight.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: Dawn Warrior Knighthood Exam
According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Light #b#p1101003##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101003#.
The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, and defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters.
You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. The honor of the Cygnus Knights rests on your shoulders.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: Blaze Wizard Knighthood Exam
According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Fire #b#p1101004##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101004#.
The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, defeat the Tiguru of Exam monster, and return to #p1101004#.
You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. Maintain your passion for the traditions of the Cygnus Knights.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: Wind Archer Knighthood Exam
According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Wind #b#p1101005##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101005#.
The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, and defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters and return to #p1101005#.
You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. Keep your wits about you as you boldly serve the Cygnus Knights.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: Night Walker Knighthood Exam
According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Darkness #b#p1101006##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101006#.
The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters, and return to #p1101006#.
You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. Be the dark shadow of the Cygnus Knights, untainted by evil.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: Thunder Breaker Knighthood Exam
According to #p1101002#, you can take the Knighthood Exam from Chief Knight of Lightning #b#p1101007##k. Go to Ereve and meet #p1101007#.
The Knighthood Exam has begun. It's quite simple. Go to #bThe 2nd Drill Hall#k at the end of the Training Forest, defeat 30 Tiguru of Exam monsters, and return to #p1101007#.
You have completed the Knighthood Exam. You are no longer a Knight-in-Training, but a full-fledged official knight. May your raucous adventures serve the Cygnus Knights in some way.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: The Secret Mission

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
It seems like #p1101002# has a new mission for you...
You must go to #b#m222020000##k and return the Book of Ancient to Ereve.
Wiz the Librarian told you where to find the book.

string.name: name
string.value: The Book of Ancient
Ask Wiz the Librarian about the book you must take to Ereve.
You must take the Book of Ancient that Wiz the Librarian told you about to Ereve.
Is this the book Wiz the Librarian was talking about? Let's take a peek... Huh? It's unreadable!

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: A Close Call

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
You found an old book. Take it back to Ereve.
You were almost home free when the minions of the Black Mage swooped in! Defeat them and protect the book.
You defeated the fiends that tried to steal the book.

string.name: name
string.value: A Knight's Valor

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Chief Knight Hawkeye has approved of your courage in standing up to your enemies.
Chief Knight Hawkeye has approved of your courage in standing up to your enemies.\nReturn to Ereve and report to Neinheart.
Your courage was recongnized, and you have been granted the title of official knight.

string.name: name
string.value: Moonlight Text
What could the Book of Ancient be about? Something ancient, maybe? Whatever it is, it needs to stay away from the Black Mage... Maybe Shinsoo might know more.
Ask Shinsoo about the contents of the book.
You have learned about the Transcendents from Shinsoo. Among the three Transcendents, what could have happened to the World Tree?

string.name: name
string.value: The Secret Mission

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
It seems like #p1101002# has a new mission for you...
You must go to Ludibrium Library and take the Book of Ancient to Ereve.
Wiz the Librarian told you where to find the book.

string.name: name
string.value: Dark Sea Investigation

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
It seems like #p1101002# has a new mission for you...
You received a new mission. Minions of the Black Mage seem to be showing up in the Aqua Road Deep Sea region of #b#m230040400##k. Find out what their goal is.
You ran into the Black Mage's minions at #b#m230040400##k.

string.name: name
string.value: A Dark Place

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Just as you were about to grab the minion, you were whisked away to an unknown place.
You ended up all alone in some kind of void, but...\nIs that Hawkeye's voice you hear?
As soon as you heard Hawkeye's voice and returned to your senses, you were back to where you were before.

string.name: name
string.value: Return to Ereve

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Return to Ereve and report what you went through at #b#m230040400##k.
Neinheart says he will look into the Black Wing forces you encountered at the Deep Sea. He asks you to report to the Empress.
You tried to report to the Empress, but she was asleep! Maybe you should just quietly leave the report next her?

string.name: name
string.value: The Nightmare

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Quietly place the report next to the sleeping Empress.
As you were about to leave the report, you were again whisked away to a strange place, just like at the Deep Sea.
You saw the Empress and Future Empress inside the Empress's dream.\nThe Future Empress you heard from the rumors... Why would Cygnus have such a dream?

string.name: name
string.value: The Empress' Chief Knight

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
The young Empress received a calling from #p1101000#.

The #rBlack Wings#k are an evil group in service of the evil #r#p 2159359##k, who tried to destroy Maple World hundreds of years ago. It sounds like they are trying their hardst to revive #r#p 2159359##k... They're just chock full of evil, so you were told that they #bmust be stopped#k.

string.name: name
string.value: The Black Wings and the Puppeteer
Go to #bInformant #p 1103001##k and hear about the #rPuppeteer#k.
The #rBlack Wings' Puppeteer#k can use #rpuppets#k to #bcontrol monsters#k. It would help to know what the Puppeteer was like in the past, so get #b#o9300274##k and find the #rPuppeteer's Puppet#k.\n
The ability to use puppets to #rcontrol a monster completely#k... In the past, the Puppeteer used these powers for evil on Victoria Island, and was then banished by the Cygnus Knights.

string.name: name
string.value: The Puppeteer Returns
Talk to #bInformant #p 1103001##k and hear about the #rnew clues#k in the Puppeteer case.

#p 1103001# says that the #rHorny Mushrooms#k are #racting strange#k just like the Orange Mushrooms, and that there must be a reason. If you find a puppet, it's probably the Puppeteer up to something again... Defeat the #rEnraged Horny Mushrooms#k and look for a #bpuppet#k.\n
Those #rEnraged Horny Mushrooms#k and the #rPuppets#k discovered on them... It certainly looks like the #rPuppeteer#k is at it again.

string.value: The Puppeteer Returns 2

#p 1103001# says that a #m100000000# resident, #b#p 1012102##k, has #rinformation about the Horny Mushrooms#k. You should meet #b#p 1012102##k on the left side of Henesys. \n
#b#p 1012102##k says she saw a #rHorny Mushroom#k in #m100000000# #b#k... Wait, she saw the monster inside the town?

#p 1012102# says she saw a #rHorny Mushroom#k inside #btown#k. Could it have anything to do with the Puppeteer? Probably! Listen to what #b#p 1012102##k has to say.

string.value: The Awakening
Shinsoo is gone and the Empress has awakened... Has Ereve recovered in all this time? Find Neinheart.

It seems like Ereve has nearly recovered. However, there are also some big changes. The Empress has awakened and become an adult quite suddenly. Her awakening has made the knights even more powerful than before. But Shinsoo has left us... How is the Empress handling all this?
Shinsoo may be gone, but the Empress has resolved to carry on. She strongly believes that Shinsoo will return someday...

string.name: name
string.value: Shinsoo's Call
After meeting with Empress, you were about to leave Ereve. However, a strange voice is echoing in your head. Is that...Shinsoo?
Shinsoo called you here...but why?

Shinsoo talked about the three Transcendents in Maple World, and about the fourth that is to come. The descendant of the Empress might be the fourth, but the Empress awakened her powers from the shock of Shinsoo's passing.

This sudden awakening has proven to be quite unstable...she has some of the Transcendent's power, but she's not quite a Transcendent herself. Not even Shinsoo could've predicted this.

Shinsoo's worried about the Empress's safety, so he wants to either revert or finish the awakening. Shinsoo wants you to protect the Empress while he goes to Ereve to gather more info...

string.name: name
string.value: Shinsoo's Gift
It seems like Shinsoo has something to give you before he leaves. What would it be?
It seems like Shinsoo has something to give you before he leaves. What would it be?
To protect the Empress, Shinsoo has granted you some of his power.

string.name: name
string.value: [Party Quest] Crimsonwood Altar

#b#p2135000##k is in the #bCrimsonwood Keep basement#k, waiting for brave warriors. Go to #r#m930100000##k and unravel the secrets of the Keep! 



Stage 1: Activate the portals for the Twisted Masters

Stage 2: Evade the obstacles and activate all portals

Stage 3: Defeat all Twisted Masters and return the legendary weapons to the altar

Stage 4: Accept your reward and enter the bonus stage



- #eRecommended Level#n: 130 and up

- #eTime Limit#n: 30 minutes

- #eParty Size#n: 3-5

- #e-Route#n: Take the Dimensional Mirror to Crimsonwood Keep, then move to #m930100000#.

string.value: [Theme Dungeon] Crimsonheart Castle

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] A Giant of a Rumor
Tatamo, the Chief of Leafre, wants to tell you about the Stone Colossus.
Go to Chief Tatamo in Leafre to learn more about the Stone Colossus.
Chief Tatamo told you what he knew about the Stone Colossus.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] It Ain't Natural
Talk to Chief Tatamo about the Stone Colossus.
The Great Spirit Guwaru believes that the Stone Colossus is an abomination of nature. Talk to Chief Tatamo in Leafre to find out more.
The Great Spirit Guwaru believes that the Stone Colossus is an abomination of nature. Talk to Lavi at the Explorer Base to start your investigation.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Lavi the Thinker
You located the Explorer Base, now talk to Lavi.
Lavi was too deep in thought to respond to you. See if Kona will listen up.
You talked to Kona after Lavi gave you the cold shoulder.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Mantis Infestation
Continue the conversation with Kona at the Explorer Base.
According to #bKona#k at the #bExplorer Base#k, monster populations are making exploration difficult. Go to #bColossus West Road#k, and clear out #r80 Mantises and 80 Blood Mantises#k.
You went to #bColossus West Road#k, and cleared out #r80 Mantises and 80 Blood Mantises#k to help #bKona#k continue her exploration.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Lavi the Listener
Talk to #bLavi#k at the Explorer Base again.
#bLavi#k told you about the first appearance of the #bStone Colossus#k.
Lavi told you about the first appearance of the Stone Colossus.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Test Your Might
Continue your conversation with Lavi at the Explorer Base.
Lavi at the Explorer Base wants to see what you're made of. Hunt #r100 Mantises and Bloody Mantises#k on the #bColossus West Road#k and #r150 Poison Mantises#k on the #bColossus Dangerous Road#k.
You proved your strength to #bLavi#k. Talk to #bKupo#k to press on with the exploration.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Rolling with Kupo
Talk to Kupo at the Explorer Base to proceed.
Kupo told you that the Colossus Road was inaccessible on foot. Perhaps you can catch a ride...
You'll need to take Kupo's Ride to access the Colossus Road. Talk to Kupo.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Kupo Needs Fuel Badly
Talk to Kupo at the Explorer Base.
Kupo wants you to hunt the Floras on Colossus East Road to collect 100 Damp Seeds as fuel.
You collected 100 Damp Seeds from the Floras as fuel for Kupo's Ride.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Kupo Needs Fuel Badlier
Continue your conversation with #rKupo#k at the #bExplorer Base#k.
#bKupo#k still needs more fuel at the #bExplorer Base#k. Hunt #rDark Floras#k on the #bColossus East Road#k, and return with #r100 Oily Seeds#k.
You collected 100 Oily Seeds from Dark Floras for Kupo.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Kupo's Ride
Kupo's ride is up and running. Time to explore!
There was a massive earthquake while you were cruising in Kupo's Ride. Talk to Kupo in Kupo's Station.
There was a massive earthquake while you were cruising in Kupo's Ride.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] My Pal Chino
Talk to Kupo in Kupo's Station.
Head east to meet with Chino at Chino's Station. Collect 100 Hornet Honeys from the Hornets and 100 Large Poison Glands from the Poison Hornets.
You collected 100 Horney Honey items from the Hornets and 100 Large Poison Glands from the Poison Hornets for Chino at Chino's Station.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Snipe Hunt
Talk to Chino at Chino's Station.
Chino wants you to hunt 150 Hornets and Poison Hornets in the Swarm Habitat.
You took out 150 Hornets and Poison Hornets for Chino.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Wanderin' the Colossus
Take the elevator up to the Stone Colossus with Chino.
You fought off the Hornet swarm on your way up to the Stone Colossus. Talk to Chino at the top.
You and Chino are safe from the Hornets. It's time to talk to the Colossus.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Colossal Problems
Talk to the Stone Colossus
The Stone Colossus speaks English! See what it has to say.
You talked to the Stone Colossus. It is afraid of a darkness growing within.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Risen from Stone
Respond to the Great Spirit Guwaru's calling.
Guwaru told you to look for #rsigns of contamination#k in the #bStone Colossus#k. Go and talk to the #bStone Colossus#k.
The Great Spirit Guwaru told you to be on the lookout for signs of contamination in the Stone Colossus, so you decided to help.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Colossal Clean Up 1
Talk to the Stone Colossus.
The Stone Colossus is scared of the creatures that live on its torso. Eliminate 250 Polluted Tree Spirits.
You cleared off some of the Polluted Tree Spirits, but it did not seem to help the Stone Colossus.

string.name: name
string.value: [Stone Colossus] Colossal Clean Up 2
Talk to the Stone Colossus.

string.name: name
string.value: The Empress's Council
As a Lv. 75 hero of Maple World, #p1101002# has something to say to you.
Empress #p1101000# has called her knights to meet with her. Head to #m130000000#.

Empress #p1101000# is worried about the role the Cygnus Knights should play in Maple World.\n\nThe Black Wings and the Resistance continue to battle for dominance, the Black Master has returned, and rumors from the Temple of Time accuse #p1101000# of being a traitor. Something must be done.

string.name: name
string.value: The Knights' Path
Listen to Empress #p1101000#'s fears.

Empress #p110100# is worried about rumors that the Cygnus Knights have betrayed Maple World. Go to the Temple of Time to discover the origin of this rumor. An agent of the Cygnus Knights has been sent ahead, and is waiting for you.
You met #p1103006# in the #m270000100#. Ask her what she's found out.

string.name: name
string.value: Behind the Rumor
Talk to #p1103006# in the #m27000100# and find out why people think #p1101000# is a traitor.
A gateway in the temple leads to a future world in which #p1101000# joined the Black Mage and invaded Maple World. Tell Empress #p1101000# what you found out.
Empress #p1101000# was shocked by what you told her. She was worried she didn't have the strength to prevent that horrible future from coming true.

string.name: name
string.value: The Continental Conference
Empress #p1101000# is shocked by the report from the Gate to the Future. Help her decide what she must do next.
Empress #p1101000# realizes that the Cygnus Knights can't protect Maple World on their own. She is calling for an Alliance between all the people of Maple World. Deliver her message to #p1101002#.
#p1101002# will need your help executing #p1101000#'s plans.

string.name: name
string.value: The Explorers' Invitation
#p1101002# needs your help preparing for the continental conference.

Deliver #p1101000#'s letter to #p1012100# at the Bowman Instruction School. Since Ereve has some history with #p1012100#, #p1101002# hopes that she will be open to the idea of a continental conference.
#p1012100# accepted the invitation.

string.name: name
string.value: The Resistance's Invitation
#p1101002# needs your help preparing for the continental conference.
#p1101002# wants you to deliver an invitation to #p2152004#, a representative of the Resistance. It will be difficult to win the Resistance's trust...
You delivered the letter to #p2152004#, but she didn't seem too happy. What will it take to win her over?

string.name: name
string.value: Gesture of Good Will
#p2152004# doesn't want to talk. See if there's any way you can win her over.
#p2152004# will read the letter if you enter the Black Wings' mine and find the entrance to a specific laboratory. Start by finding the area #bBehind the Mine#k, in the direction of the #bEntrance#k.
#p2152004# read the letter and said she'd think about it. There wasn't much more that you could do.

string.name: name
string.value: Lilin's Invitation

string.value: Arkarium's Barrier

1. Retrieve the Lambent Essence from Neinheart.
2. Collect 50 Dragon Warrants from the monsters around Leafre, Dragon Forest.

- You can use the portal at the bottom right of Shinsoo's wings.

How to collect the Spirits of Light
- Click the special glass jar that Neinheart gave you when the spirit's HP falls below 30%.

#p1201000# told you while she was excavating heroes from ice, she found a weapon used by one of the heroes. She placed it in town. She wondered if it was yours. If it was, then you would be #bAran, the hero that used a polearm#k...

string.value: [Job Adv.]

The moment you touch the #p1201001#, you feel memories flood through you, but you aren't sure if you're really reminiscing or just imagining things. You should try holding the #p1201001# one more time.

You remembered a time when you held the weapon, flashbacks of gripping the polearm in your two hands...while standing in front of the Black Mage. Yes, you were Aran, the warrior that wielded the polearm to perfection.

string.value: [Job Adv.]
As soon as you reach Level 30, #b#p1201000##k strikes up a conversation with you...
#p1201000# tells you that the polearm is acting strange and that it might be trying to send you a message. You'd better head to #b#m140000000##k and check on the state of the #bpolearm#k.
Standing in front of the polearm is a strange-looking boy who you've never met before. Who is that? That kid does look a bit familiar. What? That boy is #p1201001#? No way...!

string.name: name
string.value: The Mirror of Desire

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]
The polearm introduces itself as Maha and demands that you remember him. What are you supposed to do? You'd better consult #b#p1201000##k about this.

#p1201000# states that the voice is really #p1201001#'s voice, and that you need to remember something about #p1201001# to appease him. If you head west of #b#m140000000# to #m140030000##k, you'll find the Mirror of Desire, which has the power to display whatever you desire. Maybe you should check it.

You were able to faintly encounter your past through the mirror. You saw the time you first got your polearm. When you mentioned the story, #p1201002# seemed relieved. Thanks to #p1201002#'s help, you were able to recover some of your dormant abilities.

string.name: name
string.value: In Search of the Ultimate Weapon

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]

You look into the Mirror of Desire. There's a split second when you think you've lost your mind, but then... Where are you? Are you in the past? This feels like deja vu. You remember this, from a long, long time ago, when you begged #b#p1203000##k to make you the best polearm in the world.

When you ask #p1203000# for the best polearm available, #p1203000# takes a long look at you and says you'll need to prove your worth. Your mission is to battle the #r#o9001012#s and defeat them. You also have to gather #b#t4032311#s#k.

You managed to gather all the #t4032311#s required. #p1203000# liked you fearless attitude, and handed you the polearm wrapped in cloth. The polearm, #p1201002#, and... Unfortunately, that was the extent of your memories.

string.value: A Weapon Never Leaves Its Owner

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]

#p1201002# told you that a thief came to the island late one night and removed a Red Jade from his body! He asked you to catch the thief and told you that the thief headed toward #m140020300#...
You've hit Lv. 60, and #b#p1201000##k suddenly wants to talk to you. What could she want?

string.name: name
string.value: Catch that Thief!

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]
So what exactly happened to make you return to the island? You'd better go talk to #b#p1201002##k.

string.value: Making Red Jade

string.value: [Job Adv.]

You brought the #t4032312# that you saw in the Mirror of Desire, and it seems that #p1201002# is satisfied with the result. With help from #p1201002#'s skill with jewels, a little bit of the power you once had has returned.

string.value: Friendship with Yeti

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]

So, you follow #p1201000#'s instructions and look in the Mirror of Desire once more. Your vision gets dark for a second, but then you find yourself in #m211000000#, once again returning to the past. Standing before you is a Yeti in tears. What's going on? You'd better talk to #b#p1203001##k.

Sniffling heavily, #p1203001# says a thief stole his gem. He is distraught that his red gem is gone, after he had so painstakingly created it. A red gem? It must have something to do with the #t4032312#! You should find the thief on behalf of #p1203001#.

#o9001013##r #a213031##k
#i4032339# #t4032339# #b#c4032339# / 1#k
#b#p1203001##k was satisfied with just seeing the gem and handed you the #b#t4032312##k. Make sure to take this to #b#p1201002##k!

string.value: Weapon Starts a Fight... with His Owner?

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]

#p1201002# seemed to be in great pain. What's going on here?
You've hit Lv. 100, and #b#p1201000##k suddenly wants to talk to you. What could she want?

string.name: name
string.value: Taming the Polearm

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Adv.]
Something must be wrong with the #b#p1201002##k. What's going on, you wonder? Why is he in so much pain?

#p1201002# confesses that, because he spent the last few hundred years without a master, the hint of darkness that existed in his heart has begun to spiral out of control in the form of rage. He's begging you to get rid of the rage. Apparently, if you defeat #p1201002#, the rage will stop. It doesn't look easy by any means, but it is what a master must do. You'd better take on the #r#o9001014##k.\r\n\r\n#o9001014##r #a214011##k
You were able to defeat the #o9001014#. Once the rage subsided, #p1201002# helped awaken more of your past powers.

string.value: Weapon Acknowledges Its Owner

string.value: [Job Adv.]
As soon as you reach Level 200, #b#p1201002##k strikes up a conversation with you...?!
#p1201002# tells you to come to #b#m140000000##k. He has something he wants to tell you.
#p1201002# tells you that you are almost back to you old, heroic self, and as proof, gives you a powerful skill called Hero's Echo.

string.value: Pucci's Request
#b#p1202007##k, a penguin from #b#m140000000##k, apparently has something to tell you.

He wants you to ask around for some tips on how to raise a wolf. Somewhere around Aqua Road, you know that #b#p2060000##k knows a little something about raising wolves...

#i4032331# #t4032331# #b#c4032331# / 1#k

string.value: Kenta's Wolf Pup Formula

Since adolescent #t1902015# is going through puberty, you should visit #b#p2020007##k of #b#m211000000##k and ask for some good advice.

string.value: Rebellious Wolf
The wolf that you lost, then recovered, seems to have decreased in size and has quite an attitude too. What should you do? Better head to #b#m140000000##k and talk to #b#p1202007##k.

According to #p1202007#, a wolf who has lost its way is often unable to get over its trauma, to the point where it shrinks and even acquires a rebellious attitude. The owner, apparently, needs to re-teach the wolf some life lessons. They say you need to invest in some educational expenses...\r\n\r\n#b80,000,000 mesos#k
You paid the educational fees and let the wolf just enjoy himself for once. Fortunately, the wolf seemed to be back to normal size.

#b#p1202007##k, the penguin from #b#m140000000##k, wants to have a word with you.

#p2060005# tells you that the #t4032335# that was given by the wolves living in #m230000003# is available, but only at a price. She says it'll cost you 80 million mesos.\r\n\r\n#b80,000,000 mesos#k
You purchased the #t4032335# from #p2060005#. You'll use it to make some #t4032334#.

string.value: The Chief Wolf's Rage
