string.value: Reacquiring the Life Water Ingredients
You need to make the #t4032334# again. You know #b#p2060005##k in the #b#m230000003# of #m230000000##k sells this so you'd better go see #p2060005# for another #t4032335#.
#p2060005# tells you it'll cost you 100 million mesos to buy the #t4032335# because the supply has become more limited since the last time you purchased it.\r\n\r\n#b100 million mesos#k
You paid #p2060005# 100 million mesos and purchased the #t4032335#... You'd better make some #t4032334# right now.

string.name: name
string.value: The Wolf's Evolution
#b#p1201002##k wants to talk to you about something...
#p1201002# says that he's noticed a formidable force surrounding you and tells you to come see him because he wants to find out what it is. You'd better head over to #b#m140000000##k right now.

#t1902017#, the Silver Wolf, apparently grows with its master. The wolf is able to go through an awakening to get a whole new look once it gains enough strength from its master. This seems to explain your #p1201002#'s transformation into a #t1902018#.

string.name: name
string.value: New Beginnings

You discovered that you were a hero that used to wield a Polearm, and just like that, you started to remember a number of your former skills. Your recovered skills are far from optimal, but... You should report this to #b#p1201000##k anyway.

#p1201000# seems amazed that you were able to recover so many of your abilities and urges you to start training seriously. She then recommends that you go see #b#p1202006# the Penguin Master#k, an old penguin that's studied the intricacies of various hero skills. He's located in the west side of town at #m140010100#.
You met with #p1202006# in #m140010100#.

string.name: name
string.value: Train or Die! 1
You certainly have doubts, but you'll give #b#p1202006##k the benefit of the doubt and receive some training from him.

According to #p1202006#, the first training lesson involves eliminating #r#o9300341#s#k. He makes it seem like it's some huge hurdle but they don't sound too difficult.\r\n\r\n#o9300341##r #a217011##k
You eliminated the #o9300341#s with ease. Judging from how enthusiastic #p1202006# reacted, you are even less inclined to trust him.

string.name: name
string.value: Train or Die! 2
You still don't trust this #b#p1202006##k, but you might as well receive some training from him.

According to #p1202006#, the second lesson involves eliminating #r#o9300342#s#k. Again, he still makes it sound like it's some huge hurdle, but again, they don't sound very tough.\r\n\r\n#o9300342##r #a217021##k
You defeated the #o9300342#s with ease! #p1202006# may be giving you words of encouragement, but his words are worth very little.

string.name: name
string.value: Train or Die! 3
This #b#p1202006##k is so full of it, but you might as well receive more training from him.

According to #p1202006#, the third lesson involves eliminating #r#o9300343#s#k. He says it's a terribly scary monster to fight, but seriously, how scary could a #o1210100# be, really... \r\n\r\n#o9300343##r #a217031##k

You finished off the #o9300343#s without breaking a sweat! #p1202006# then tells you he's taught you everything that he knows about combat and says that you can go back down the mountain. What...?! You're not even standing on a mountain!

string.name: name
string.value: Baby Steps
After receiving some lessons from #p1202006#, you remembered the Combo Ability skill! You'd better relay this to #b#p1201000##k.

#p1201000# says you were probably able to regain your memories of the skill because you swung your polearm around just like how you did in the past. Muscle memory, or something. She seems confident that the more you train, the stronger you will become and the more skills you will remember.

The small step of remembering the Combo Ability skill has opened a world of possibilities for you. You now have the confidence to continue training in the hope of one day returning to your old, heroic self.

string.name: name
string.value: To Victoria Island
Your training continues. You must keep progressing until the Black Mage is defeated once and for all. You should ask #b#p1201000##k what to do next.

#p1201000# says you can only train so much in #m140000000# and suggests you venture to #bVictoria Island#k. She directs you to an ally of hers, #b#p1002104# the Information Dealer#k, in #b#m104000004##k.

In order to reach #m104000000#, you must leave #m140000000# by boarding a ship. From town, head to your right and continue past the snow-covered field to arrive at a small port operated by penguins. 
Once there, talk to #b#p1200003##k to board the ship.

#p1002104# the Information Dealer was once a resident of #m140000000# eagerly awaiting the Hero's revival, but he eventually lost hope and left town. He's a distant cousin of #p1201000#. He must have felt bad about leaving #p1201000# all by herself, because he promised to help #p1002104# anytime she needed it.

string.name: name
string.value: An Information Dealer's Work
You should start training in Victoria Island and ask #bthe Information Dealer of #m104000000##k, named #b#p1002104##k, for some help.

#p1002104# tells you there's no better way to learn the inner workings of the world than to be an Information Dealer, and he offers you a position working with him. #p1002104# then gives you a simple quest to introduce you to the roles of an Information Dealer and informant. The quest involves finding out the latest rumors the crewmembers of #b#p1002001##k have been talking about.\r\n\r\n#y21707# #b(#u21706#)#k
You relayed to #p1002104# all the rumors you heard from #p1002001#. You guess this is the type of thing that informants do all the time.

string.name: name
string.value: Teo's Information
For the time being, you're working as an informant for #p1002104#. Your first task is to approach #b#p1002001##k and ask about any rumors circulating among the crewmembers.

#p1002001# tells you that revealing a rumor is no big deal, but he'll only do it under one condition. Turns out he wants some snail shells to treat his arthritis. Fair enough. The area surrounding #m104000000# is infested with snails, so this shouldn't be hard. 

#i4000019# #t4000019# #b#c4000019# / 10#k
#i4000000# #t4000000# #b#c4000000# / 10#k
#i4000016# #t4000016# #b#c4000016# / 10#k
You gave him all the #t4000019#s, and in return, he told you that the crew is currently stressed about the certain revival of the Black Mage. You'd better relay this bit of info to #p1002104#.

string.name: name
string.value: Your First Informant Assignment
Now that you have an idea of what an informant does, it's time to get your hands dirty. #b#p1002104##k will tell you what to do.

Your first information gathering assignment is to find out why the #o1210102#s near #m100000000# have started acting so wildly. They're usually so tame! #p1002104# tells you to ask the mushroom monster scholar about the occurrence and see if he can shed some light on what's been going on. #b#p1012111##k can be found in #b#m100000000##k.
You met with #p1012111#.

string.name: name
string.value: Check Out the Orange Mushroom
This is your first assignment as an informant. You're here to ask #b#p1012111##k in #b#m100000000##k about possible causes of the #o1210102#'s strange behavior.

#p1012111# needs to find out what is happening to the #o1210102#s. He wants you to find out if any horns can be salvaged from the #o1210102#s. Defeat the #r#o1210102#s#k and search for the #b#t4032314##k.\n\n#i4032314# #t4032314# #b#c4032314# / 20#k
You brought the #t4032314#s you found to #p1012111#. He says he's going to start studying the horns and asked you to come back later.

string.name: name
string.value: A Monster War?

This is your first assignment as an informant. You wonder if #p1012111# of #m100000000# has been able to pinpoint the cause of the #o1210102#'s recent changes yet. Maybe you should go ask #p1012111# right now.

#p1012111# says that the change in #o1210102#s may indicate that a war is brewing between the #o1210102#s and the #o1210100#s. In order to confirm his theory, #p1012111# needs to investigate the #o1210100#s, as well. Please bring him #b50 #t4032340#s#k...

He says that the pigs can be found near the beach.

#i4032340# #t4032340# #b#c4032340# / 50#k

#p1012111#, who studied the #t4032340#s, came to the conclusion that the #o1210100#s are not properly prepared for combat, which of course threw out the whole theory of a possible monster war. He then asked you to stop by later since he'd like some time to come up with another hypothetical theory to explain this mess.

string.name: name
string.value: Enter the Cynical Orange Mushrooms!

This is your first assignment as an informant. You're hopeful that this time #p1012111# of #b#m100000000##k has found the cause of the #o1210102#s' strange change in behavior. You'd better go talk to #b#p1012111##k.

#p1012111# says that #ra cynical group of #o1210102##ks was seen hanging around #m100000000#. He thinks they may have influenced the regular #o1210102#s as well. He then instructs you to eliminate #r50 #o9300274#s#k and give him #banything you find that might be considered odd#k...

#o9300274##r #a217111##k
#i4032315# #t4032315# #b#c4032315# / 1#k
You eliminated the #o9300274# and brought back the #t4032315# for #p1012111#. He found it unusual and asked you to wait while he gives it a detailed analysis.

string.name: name
string.value: First Assignment, Completed!

Since this is your first assignment as an informant, you are eager to find out whether #p1012111# of #b#m100000000##k has solved the mystery behind the #t4032315#. Go visit #b#p1012111##k and find out.

#p1012111# says he discovered a faint noise coming out of the #t4032315#, which only #o1210102#s can hear, and that's what's been causing their aggressive behavior. In other words, #bthe #r#o1210102#s' behavior is all because of a puppet#k! Now that you have this case pretty much wrapped up, your should report the info to #b#p1002104##k.

You notified #p1002104# about the cause of the strange behavior among the #o1210102#s, which officially concluded your first ever assignment as an informant. You should probably spend some time leveling up and training yourself now.

string.name: name
string.value: Your Second Informant Assignment
You have reached Level 18, which means #p1002104# will give you your second assignment as an informant. Head over to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k.

The second assignment involves dealing with the suddenly-violent #o1110100#s. Seems quite similar to the first assignment... You should head over to #b#m101000000##k and meet with #b#p1032101##k to discuss the cause of the #o1110100#s' distress.
You met with #p1032101# in #m101000000#.

string.name: name
string.value: Green Mushrooms at the Secret Forest to the South
This is your second assignment as an informant and you need to ask #b#p1032101##k in #b#m101000000##k why the #o1110100#s have suddenly turned so aggressive.

#p1032101# says she's heard that a lot of monsters have been going crazy and that they all seem to have something in common: their strange behavior is tied to an odd puppet. Maybe this too is tied to the puppet? You should eliminate the #r#o1110130#s#k and find a #b#o1110100# puppet#k if you can.

#o1110130##r #a217141##k
#i4032316# #t4032316# #b#c4032316# / 1#k
You gave #p1032101# the #t4032316#. #p1032101# seemed shocked that the rumors were actually true and wanted to find out who was responsible for placing a puppet on the #o1110100#s.

string.name: name
string.value: Tree Witness
This is your second assignment as an informant and the question remains, who planted the puppet on the #o1110100#s? Talk to #b#p1032101##k in #b#m101000000##k for some answers.
#p1032101# says that the #b#p1032112##k at #m101010000# should have seen who put the puppet inside the #o1110100#s. He wants you to find out from the Talking Tree who the culprit is.
#p1032112# stated that recently a little kid was seen carrying puppets in the South Forest. Since then, the #o1110100#s have gotten much more aggressive.

string.name: name
string.value: Second Assignment, Completed!
This is your second assignment as an informant and you must relay #p1032112#'s eyewitness account to #b#p1032101##k in #b#m101000000##k.

#p1032101# is sure that the changes happening to the #o1110100#s is connected with the kid carrying the puppets and tells you to be extra cautious. Now that this case is pretty much wrapped up, you should relay the information to #b#p1002104##k.

You told #p1002104# why the #o1110100#s have become so aggressive, and that concluded your second assignment as an informant. But you wonder, will the fairies be able to watch over the forest all by themselves?

string.name: name
string.value: Rowen's Request 1
You wonder how #p1032101# is doing overseeing the forest. You feel like you should head to #b#m101000000##k to see her.

It seems like the kid with the puppets was once again seen in #m100040000#. Time to eliminate the #r#o1110100#s#k so you can retrieve the #bpuppet#k. 


Regardless of Personality #o9101000##r #a217171##k
#i4032317##t4032317# #b#c4032317# / 1#k
You defeated the #o1110100#s and retrieve the #t4032316#, but you were unable to apprehend the actual criminal. Hopefully the kid will show up again...

string.name: name
string.value: Rowen's Request 2
You should talk to #b#p1032101##k in #b#m101000000##k and see if the puppet-toting kid has made any more appearances in the South Forest.

#p1032101# says that the kid with the puppet has showed up once again in #m100040003# and wants you to eliminate the #o1110100#s and retrieve the puppet yet again.


Regardless of Personality #o9101000##r #a217181##k
#i4032318# #t4032318# #b#c4032318# / 1#k
You defeated the #o1110100# and retrieved the #t4032318#. So far, you've managed to foil the kid's plan many times. Perhaps the kid'll give up now...?

string.name: name
string.value: The Puppeteer's Invitation
A mysterious figure starts talking to you...

When you accept the invitation from the mysterious figure, you find yourself in front of a strange-looking cave! Inside the cave...is the kid with the puppets! So that's the kid responsible for manipulating the monsters in #m100000000# and #m101000000#? Talk to the kid and see what's up.

When you accept the invitation from the mysterious figure, you find yourself in front of a strange-looking cave! Inside the cave...is the kid with the puppets! So that's the kid responsible for manipulating the monsters in #m100000000# and #m101000000#? Talk to the kid and see what's up.

string.name: name
string.value: The Puppeteer's Warning
What would #p1002104# say about the Black Wings? You should talk to #b#p1002104##k, the Information Dealer in #b#m104000000##k, and find out.

He tells you that the Black Wings are an organization conspiring to resurrect the Black Mage and says that this information must be relayed to #b#p1201000##k as well, so he wants you to let #p1201000# know about the situation. In the mean time, Tru plans on utilizing his network as an Information Dealer to gather as much information on the Black Wings as possible.
#p1201000# urged you to keep training, since the existence of the Black Wings means that the Black Mage has returned.

string.name: name
string.value: Your Third Informant Assignment
You have now reached Level 23, which means #p1002104# will soon be giving you your third assignment as an informant. You should head to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k.

#p1002104# suspects that the #o1140100# case in #m102000000# is similar to the ones in #m100000000# and #m101000000# and asks you to gather some information related to the present case. To get the details, you have to head over to #b#m102000000##k and talk to #b#p1103004##k...
You met with #p1103004# in #m102000000#.

string.name: name
string.value: Ghost Stumps
This is your third assignment as an informant and this one involves studying the strange-acting #o1140130#s with #p1103004# in #b#m102000000##k. You'd better go talk to #b#p1103004##k.

#p1103004# already knows that the puppet is the reason behind the changes in the #o1140130#s. She asks that you go to #bGusty Peak#k, defeat #r100 #o1140130#s#k, and bring back #o1140130#'s puppet. She adds that you should just come back even if you don't discover a puppet after eliminating all 100... \n\nAny #o9101002##r #a217221##k
You eliminated 100 #o1140130#s but didn't discover any puppets. #p1103004# says that something is very strange, because the puppet can be detected amongst the #o1140130#s...

string.name: name
string.value: Find the Puppet
This is your third assignment as an informant and you're at #b#m102000000##k with #p1103004#, investigating the causes of the #o1140130#s' erratic behavior. You should talk to #b#p1103004##k.

#p1103004# tells you that the #o1140130#s' erratic behavior was definitely caused by a puppet, but the puppet is not necessarily on the #o1140130#s' bodies. It could be somewhere outside... You should search the #bPile of Relics#k in #b#m102020500##k and find the #b#t4032319##k.\n\n#i4032319# #t4032319# #b#c4032319# / 5#k
You retrieved all of the #t4032319#s. #p1103004# seemed genuinely shocked that the puppets were used for such a purpose and told you she'd have to write a report on this. A report? What report?

string.name: name
string.value: Third Assignment, Completed!

This is your third assignment as an informant and this one involves investigating the suddenly-erratic #o1140130#s in #b#m102000000##k. With the help of #p1103004#, you were able to locate the cause of the madness. The case seems to be nearing its end. You should talk to #b#p1103004##k.

#p1103004# says that the puppet doesn't necessarily have to be on a monster's body, it's enough just to be near a monster. She says that she will take measures to beef up security so the kid with the puppet can't get close to #m102000000# ever again. This concludes the case, and you are going to send the information to #b#p1002104##k.
You updated #p1002104# on what happened in #m102000000#, which concluded your third assignment as an informant.

string.name: name
string.value: 10 Boogies's Request
After the #o1140130# case closed, #p1103004# still seems to need you for something. You wonder what. Better go talk to #b#p1103004##k and find out.

#p1103004# thanks you for helping her solve the mystery, but tells you she has a little predicament. She can't leave her post to submit her report! She wonders if you could deliver the report to her boss. Your new task is to deliver the #t4032320# to #b#p1101002##k in #b#m130000000##k.\n\nTake the ship headed to #b#m130000000# from the #bEreve Bound Platform#k north of #b#m104020000##k.

You delivered the report to #p1101002# and received a reward. You noticed that he had a very peculiar way of speaking which, to you, seemed totally inappropriate yet absolutely proper in tone. It reminded you of someone...

string.name: name
string.value: Your Fourth Informant Assignment
You have now reached Level 28, which means #p1002104# will be giving you your fourth assignment as an informant today. Head to #b#m104000000##k and meet with #b#p1002104##k.

Many reports have been filed concerning a bunch of depressed #o2230101#s in #m105040300#. This has to be the work of the puppeteer. Head over to #b#m105040300##k and talk to the person who first discovered this. They say it's a boy named #b#p1061019##k.
You met with #p1061019# in #m105040300#.

string.name: name
string.value: Zombie Mushrooms

This is your fourth assignment as an informant and you need to gather information about the erratic behavior of the #o2230101#s in #b#m105040300##k. You'd better talk to #b#p1061019##k, the witness that reported the incident.

#p1061019# is terrified to see so many #o2230101#s with such irritated faces. They are preventing him from going to the Ghost Mushroom Forest, so he's asked you to find out what has happened to all the #o2230101#s. Looks like you'll have to eliminate the #r#o2230101#s#k and retrieve the #b#t4032321##k.

#o9101001##r #a217271##k
#i4032321# #t4032321# #b#c4032321# / 1#k
You eliminated the #o2230101#s and retrieved the #t4032321#. #p1061019# seemed to know something about the puppet...

string.name: name
string.value: The Puppeteer's Cave

This is your fourth assignment as an informant and it involves #p1061019#, who apparently remembered something when he looked at the #t4032321# retrieved from #o2230101#. Go talk to him at #b#m105040300##k.

#p1061019# says that he saw a kid carrying around a #t4032321# some time ago. That must have been the Puppeteer! According to #p1061019#, the puppeteer may be hiding near the Perion... You should #bgo up to the Rocky Wasteland and look for the Puppeteer's Headquarters#k.
You spotted the Puppeteer's Headquarters, but you need a password to enter.

string.name: name
string.value: 4th Assignment Completed

This is your fourth assignment as an informant and while you've found the puppeteer's cave, you need a password to enter. Maybe #p1061019# knows what the password could be? Go talk to #b#p1061019##k in #b#m105040300##k.

#p1061019# says that he doesn't know anything about the password but says that he saw the puppeteer scribble something onto #p1061006# that just might be the password. Find out what the password is by talking to #b#p1061006##k and tell #b#p1002104##k the password is as well.\r\n\r\n#y21730# #b(#u20730#)#k
So you found out the password but decided to first return to #p1002104# and debrief him on the case. This concludes your fourth Informant Assignment. Next up, Operation Puppeteer Headquarters?

string.name: name
string.value: The Cave's Password

This is your fourth assignment as an informant and even though you found the puppeteer's cave, you couldn't enter because you didn't have the password. The code might be written on #p1061006#. Go talk to #p1061006# at #m105040300#.

Rotating the #p1061006# might reveal the scribbles, but it's not moving. Wait a minute. The statue seems to be talking to you directly. 'I want 50 #t4000007#s.' Now, you've heard of some outrageous demands, but a statue demanding something from you? Really? Oh well, you better find some #t4000007#s.\r\n\r\n#i4000007# #t4000007# #b#c4000007# / 50#k

You found the scribble on #p1061006#. It's written in a near-illegible scribble, but you can still make it out. It says: 'Francis is a genius puppeteer!' All the words in the password have to be exact, including the capitalization and spacing, so be careful.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate the Puppeteer!
You have now reached Level 29, which means it's time for you to ambush the #o9300344#, no? You should head over to #b#m104000000##k and notify #b#p1002104##k that you are ready for action.

#p1002104#, seeing that you're determined to attack the #o9300344#, decides to rent a powerful weapon for you. It's a disposable weapon, but it'll be put to good use. Now everything is set for the ambush in #b#m910510201##k. Remember, the password is 'Francis is a genius Puppeteer!'

#o9300344##r #a217311##k
The Black Wings' Clue #t4032322# #b#c4032322# / 1#k

You defeated the Puppeteer, but he ran away before you could finish him off. All you have left is a document the Puppeteer dropped while running away. When you showed #p1002104# the document, he suddenly looked dead serious.

string.name: name
string.value: The Black Wings' Conspiracy

The document you extracted from #o9300344# turns out to be a Black Wings document! Unfortunately, the document is written in code. What should you do? Go to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k for some advice.
Looks like the only person that can decode the document is #p1201000#. Head over to #b#m140000000##k and ask #b#p1201000##k to help.

The document says that the Black Wings possess an item known as the #t4032323#. #p1204002#, the puppeteer, is utilizing his special skills in mob manipulation to look for a certain Seal Stone. But what does that mean? What exactly are the Black Wings after?

string.name: name
string.value: Gathering Some Strange Information
The moment you reach Level 31, you receive a message from #b#p1002104##k. Is it about a new Informant Assignment? But he's never mentioned anything about it before...
#p1002104# says he has an urgent message for you and asks you to come to #b#m104000004##k right away. You wonder what's going on.
One of the Black Wings diguised himself as #p1002104#. It was a trap by the Puppeteer! He got away, but at least you defeated him for now... The trap was set while you were seeing #p1201000#.

string.name: name
string.value: Traces of the Puppeteer
As soon as you reach Level 37, #b#p1002104##k sends you a message. Is there a new lead?

#p1002104# says he's found hidden traces of the #o9300346# and that the puppeteer is hidden in the #bPuppeteer's Hideout#k somewhere in the #bForest of Evil Energy#k. He gives you the green light to finish off the #o9300346# if you run into him again...


#o9300346##r #a217341##k
You defeated the #o9300346# without a definite clue to lead you to the #t4032323#. But then, #p1002104# flashed a comforting smile as if to tell you not to worry about a thing...

string.name: name
string.value: The Seal Stone of Victoria Island
You weren't able to gather any information on the #t4032323#, but #p1002104# seems strangely confident about where you stand. Go talk to #b#p1002104##k.

#p1002104# says that ever since he got ambushed by the #o9300346#s, he's been using any means necessary to find the Seal Stone. He feels that holding on to the Seal Stone would be dangerous, so he wants to store it in #b#m140000000##k, the deserted island. I'd better deliver the #bSeal Stone to #p1201000##k.
You didn't learn what the #t4032323# was for, but it seemed the Black Wings were after it.
#b#p1002104##k wants to talk to you now that you're level 48.

#p1002104# notifies you of some new information regarding the Black Wings and asks you to head to #b#m200000000##k to meet #b#p2012012# the fairy#k. #p2012012# will probably have some more details about this.
You met #p2012012# the fairy in #m200000000#.

string.name: name
string.value: The Giant Nependeaths Appear
It seems that something related to the Black Wings is happening in #b#m200000000##k. You should talk to #b#p2012012##k.

#p2012012# the fairy has noticed that the number of #r#o9300347#s#k has been steadily increasing in #b#m200060001##k and wants you to look into the #o9300347#s there. Apparently, if you're not careful and enter the wrong path from #b#m200060000##k, you may end up in #m200060001# instead, so you should head there right now, eliminate the #o9300347#s, and retrieve any strange items they might drop.\r\n\r\n#i4032324# #t4032324# #b#c4032324# / 5#k

After defeating the #o9300347#s, you brought back a #t4032324#. #p2012012# was curious to see who would do such a thing and seemed to worry even more that the sheer weight of the Nependeaths might cause Orbis to sink. She wanted you to discuss the problem about #m200000000# with someone who might know more.

string.name: name
string.value: Sealed Garden
You wonder if #m200000000# will come crashing down because of the sheer weight of the #o9300347#s. You'd better talk to #b#p2032001##k who lives in #b#m200050000##k before that happens.

#p2032001# says that she's worried about the possibility of the #o9300347#s causing #m200000000# to sink, but she says she's actually more worried about another issue entirely. The fact that the Nependeaths in Orbis have grown so huge may be connected with the path to #m920030001#. #m920030001#? This may be related to the Seal Stone somehow. You'd better keep asking #b#p2032001##k more questions.
#p2032001# first had her doubts about whether you could be trusted and was shocked to discover your true identity. She says that she has seen your grand fate...

string.name: name
string.value: To the Sealed Garden
You'll find #m920030001# in #m200000000#... You wonder if it's related to the Seal Stone. You bet #b#p2032001##k in #b#m200050000##k can explain a thing or two.

According to #p2032001#, #m920030001# is where the #bSeal Stone is hidden#k. The only way to enter #m920030001# is through a stem of the Nependeath which connects #m200060001# to #m920030001#. An intruder has actually grown the #o9300347# for this specific purpose. #p2032001# is desperately asking you to prevent the intruders from entering...

So you came face to face with a #o9300348# in #m920030001# and successfully defeated it, but ended up losing the Seal Stone to a member of the Black Wings, #o9300349#, who snatched it away from you. When you asked #p2032001# what you should do, she told you that she doesn't know what they want the Seal Stone for and sat quietly with a grim expression.

string.name: name
string.value: The Stolen Seal Stone of Orbis
You lost the Seal Stone of Orbis. What does this mean? Head to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k to get some advice.
After explaining to #p1002104# everything that took place in #m200000000#, #p1002104# felt that this information should be relayed to #b#p1201000##k as well.
#p1201000# told you that the Black Wings are after Seal Stones. She thanked you for verifying the existence of multiple Seal Stones.

string.name: name
string.value: Investigating Mu Lung
As soon as you reach Level 54, you hear from #b#p1002104##k.
#p1002104# says they've just received word regarding the Black Wings and urges you to go to #b#m250000000##k. Talk to #b#p2090004##k in #m250000000# for more details.
You met with #p2090004# in #m250000000#.

string.name: name
string.value: The Black Scroll
So what does #b#m250000000##k have to do with the Black Wings? You should talk to #b#p2090004##k to find out.

#p2090004# received a #t4220151# a few days ago from a man who claimed to be the #r#o9300351##k of the Black Wings. But because he took such poor care of the #t4220151#, the contents of the scroll seems to have faded away. You think the only way chance to restore the content is through #b#p2091008# the painter#k.
You gave the restored #t4220151# to #p2090004#.

string.name: name
string.value: The Special Ink
You want to restore the #t4220151# that the Black Wings gave to #p2090004#. The one person in #b#m250000000##k who is capable of doing the restoration is #b#p2091008# the painter#k.

#p2091008# states that to restore the #t4220151#, one must make a #b#t4032342##k and pour it all over the Scroll. He then asks you to bring the materials necessary to make the ink, so he can make some for you.\n
You handed #p2091008# the materials and received #t4032342# in return. You should now open the #t4220151# and pour the #t4032342# over it.

string.name: name
string.value: The Shadow Knight's Letter
You wonder how #p2090004# will take the contents of the #t4220151# now that it's restored. You should talk to #b#p2090004##k in #b#m250000000##k.
You met #p2091007# and handed him #o9300351#'s Letter of Warning.

#p2090004# wants you to bring a #t4220151# to #b#p2091007##k. How are you going to reach #p2091007# on top of Mu Lung Dojo? #p2090004# tells you about the weakness of #p2091007#'s apprentice, #b#p2091005##k. Find the way to the #bBack Alley of Mu Lung Dojo from #p2091005# and see Mu Gong#k!

string.name: name
string.value: How to Meet Mu Gong

The letter issued by #o9300351# of the Black Wings... In order to deliver the letter to #p2091007#, you first must win over #p2091011#, who is one of his students. You'd better head over to #b#m925020000##k and start sweet-talking #p2091011#.

You ask nicely to see #p2091007#, but #p2091011#'s stance remains the same: NO! So, you decided to sweeten the pot, as instructed by #p2090004#, by offering healthy items for the body, which worked like magic. You'd better start gathering some #b#t400591#s#k.\r\n\r\nYou can find good Bellflowers by going through the #rSecret Portal behind the pillar#r right of So Gong.

When you brought the #t4000591#s to him, #p2091011# discreetly told you the way to #m925020000#'s back alley. In front of #m925020000# are some flags. You need to use the portal under the green flag on the right side to get to #p2091007#.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 6,500\n

string.name: name
string.value: Mu Gong's Test

You wonder what #p2091007# is going to say about #o9300351#'s letter. You should meet with #b#p2091007##k on the #btop floor of #m925020000##k and find out. You can get there via the shortcut in the back alley that #p2091005# told you about.

When you ask #p2091007# about the Seal Stone of Mu Lung, he says that #o9300351# is a dangerous fellow, but tells you that he also has his guard up around you. He also says that he's wants to test you to see if you're trustworthy. All you have to do is beat #o9300350# in battle.\r\n\r\n#o9300350##r #a217461##k
You emerged victorious over #o9300350#. #p2091007# seemed absolutely shocked to see someone using skills from hundreds of years ago...

string.name: name
string.value: Catch the Shadow Knight!

You passed #p2091007#'s test. You should now talk to #b#p2091007##k in #b#m925020000##k and find out more about the Seal Stone. You can get there by going through the back alley that #p2091005# told you about.

According to #p2091007#, the Seal Stone of #m250000000# is stored in a place called #m925040100# and the entrance is somewhere between the pillars of #m250000100# and #b#m250020100##k. Find the pillar that has 'Entrance' engraved on it and say the password to enter the premises. The password is #bActions speak louder than words#k. You'd better enter #m925040100# and stop #r#o9300351##k, then return to Mu Gong.\r\n\r\n#o9300351##r #a217471##k

You defeated #o9300351# in #m925040100#, but the Seal Stone of #m250000000# was taken from you by the Gentleman of the Black Wings. It seems to be a recurring pattern. When you told #p2091007# that the Seal Stone was stolen, he admitted that he himself did not know the true use of that stone and reassured you that all is well in #m250000000# even if the Seal Stone has been taken.

string.name: name
string.value: The Stolen Seal Stone of Mu Lung
You lost the Seal Stone of Mu Lung. What does this mean? You'd better head over to #b#m104000000##k and talk to #b#p1002104##k to get some advice.
When you tell #p1002104# about everything that took place in #m250000000#, #p1002104# felt it was necessary for you to tell #b#p1201000##k in #b#m140000000##k about it.
#p1201000# suggested you research heroes, since they are the ones who brought the Seal Stone to town.

string.name: name
string.value: Back to the Past
When you reach Level 63, #b#p1002104##k sends you a message.

According to #p1002104#, one of the clocktowers in #m220000000# has broken down. This clocktower manages time, and when it broke, it somehow created a path to the past. Exploring the past could reveal some information about Seal Stones. #bThe busted clocktower with the time-control room can be accessed through the ladder on the top floor of Helios Tower#k, so you should make you way over there.

According to #p1002104#, one of the clocktowers in #m220000000# has broken down. This clocktower manages time, and when it broke, it somehow created a path to the past. Exploring the past could reveal some information about Seal Stones. #bThe busted clocktower with the time-control room can be accessed through the ladder on the top floor of Helios Tower#k, so you should make your way over there.

string.name: name
string.value: She Remembers Me
Just as #p1002104# instructed, you use the #m220000000# clocktower to travel to the past. Just as you arrive in the past, someone calls out your name...

#p2131002# seems shocked to see you and greets you like a long-lost sibling. Do you know this person? While you stand there dumbfounded, #p2131002# tells you that #b#p2131000##k is also waiting for you, and that you should make your way to the #bCamp Conference Room#k to let #p2131000# know that you are alive and well.
You finally met #p2131000# in Ellin Forest. #p2131000# seemed glad to see you alive and well, but then learned that you have no recollection of the past and seemed sad to hear it.

string.name: name
string.value: Seal Stone of Ellin Forest
You ran into someone from the past who apparently knew you. Maybe #p2131000# in Ellin Forest knows something about the Seal Stone. You'd better go talk to #b#p2131000##k and find out.

#p2131000# says that she stored a rock in #m300000011#, which the heroes left for her, and she thinks it might be the Seal Stone. Entering #m300000011# to verify whether the rock is actually a Seal Stone requires a #b#t4032325##k. #p2131003# in #b#m300000000##k apparently has the #b#t4032325##k.\n\n#i4032325# #t4032325# #b#c4032325# / 1#k
You received the #t4032325# from #p2131003#. #p2131000# told you to head to the #m300000011#.

string.name: name
string.value: Find the Key
Apparently, #p2131003# has the #t4032325# that can open the safe where the Seal Stone of Ellin Forest is stored. You'd better head over to #b#m300000000##k and talk to #b#p2131003##k.

You ask #p2131003# for the keys, but she starts to panic. She tells you that she may have lost it. It looks like the #r#o9001024#s#k nearby have the key, so it's up to you to defeat them all and retrieve it.\n
She found one of keys that #p2131003# lost and gave you the #t4032325#. Be sure to take it to #p2131000#.

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Seal Stone of Ellin Forest
It turns out that the Seal Stone of Ellin Forest was taken by #o9300353# of the Black Wings. How did this happen? You'd better go talk to #b#p2131000##k in Ellin Forest.

#p2131000# reveals that she has a letter that contains information about another Seal Stone and promises to hand it to you. Unfortunately, you can't take the letter since #b#p2131000# and you are from two separate times#k. \n\nJust when you think it's all over, #p2131000# tells you that she's a fairy with a very long life, and that she will in fact carry the letter to your time. What you need to do now is leave Ellin Forest and #bmeet #p2131000# in your own time#k. You wonder where #p2131000# is. You'd better ask #b#p1002104##k.

You asked #p1002104# whether he knew anyone named #p2131000#. It turned out that #p1002104# is one of the most well-known people in all of Victoria Island. You should head to #m100000201# in #m100000000# to meet Athena Pierce at the Bowman Instructional School.

string.name: name
string.value: Info on Another Seal Stone

You met #p1204031# in the #b#m100000201# of #m100000000##k. Thankfully, the letter hadn't gotten lost, but you think #p2131000# must have been shocked to see you. You'd better to talk to #b#p2131000##k.

#p1012100# flashed a big smile, saying that she knew she'd someday meet you again. She then handed you the letter. It's a great feeling, knowing that you have a friend that remembers you hundreds of years later. You'd better show the letter to #b#p1002104##k.

#p1002104# tells you that the letter is unreadable and that it actually might be cursed. He recommends that you show #p1201000# the letter. Since she seems to be good with spells, she might be able to break the curse.

string.name: name
string.value: Decoding the Letter
You can't read the letter given by #p2131000#. What is this, anyway? You'd better head over to #b#m104000000##k and ask #b#p1002104##k what to do with it.
According to #p1002104#, the letter is written in a secret code. Thankfully, you have a master decoder in #b#p1201000##k, so take the letter and head over to #b#m140000000##k.
#p1201000# said that decoding the letter may take some time and told you she'll let #p1002104# know once it's complete.

string.name: name
string.value: A Letter to the Queen
When you reach Level 68, #b#p1002104##k send a message.

Apparently, #p1201000# succeeded in decoding the letter and it contains some surprising information! Better head over to #b#m140000000##k immediately and talk to #b#p1201000##k about the contents of the letter.
Amazingly, the letter written by the heroes was addressed to the Queen of the time. The actual content of the letter simply asked that the Queen take good care of the Seal Stone of #m130000000#.

string.name: name
string.value: Neinheart the Strategist
Now that you know what's written in the letter... what should you do? You'd better go to #b#m140000000##k and talk to #b#p1201000##k.

#p1201000# says that it's essential to warn #m130000000# about the Seal Stone and writes a letter urging them to protect it at all cost. Your job is to go to #b#m130000000##k and hand the letter to the Queen, but with that annoying strategist of the Queen, Neinheart, blocking the way, it might be difficult. Maybe you should just talk to the #bStrategist#k instead.
You met the Queen's strategist, #p1101002#. He took the letter and told you he'd take it into consideration, but his eyes tell you otherwise.

string.name: name
string.value: Neinheart's Thanks
#b#p1101002##k is sending you a message...
#p1101002# thanks you for protecting the tears of the Divine Bird and wants to give you a reward for it. You'd better head over to #b#m130000000##k.
#p1101002# told you that you and he will have a chance to fight...and gave you a meaningful smile.

string.name: name
string.value: Suspicious John
#p1002001# has noticed that #p20000# has been acting weird lately. You'd better head over to Lith Harbor and talk to #p1002001# to see what's up.
Apparently, #p20000# started displaying some strange behavior ever since he started carrying some wooden box with him. Your task now is to investigate the wooden box that's next to #p20000#.
As you promised to #p20000#, you did not reveal to #p1002001# that the wooden box contained medication for arthritis.

string.name: name
string.value: Secrets of the Wooden Box
#p1002001# asked you to investigate the wooden box that #p20000# always carries around.
You find unidentified medication inside the box.

It turned out that #p20000# had been taking his own special arthritis medicine behind #p1002001#'s back. You made a deal with him, promising not to tell anyone about the contents of his wooden box in exchange for a small reward. You shouldn't tell #p1002001# about the wooden box. Just make something up.

string.name: name
string.value: Lilin's Call
You received a surprise message from #p1105012#!
#p1105012# wants you to come to #m140000000# to see something she found.
#p1105012# showed you an invitation to the continental conference sent by the #p1101000# Knights. She's excited to see you finally being recognized as a true Hero.

string.name: name
string.value: Friends of Aran
#p1105012# seems more excited than usual, more excited than ever, actually.

#p1105012# thinks it would be best for you to go with someone who recognizes you as a Hero. She suggested #p1012100#, but what about her? She seemed to dodge your questions when asked, but you have to wonder why she wouldn't want to go.
#p1012100# was glad for your good timing and asked you to escort her to #m130000000#.

string.name: name
string.value: Strange Dream
A dragon asleep in a forest covered in fog... What a strange dream. \r\n\r\nYou feel a bit tired from dreaming about the dragon but #byou should say good morning to your family.#k.

When you tell your Mom about the dream, she says that it's a very interesting dream and that you should share it with #b#p1013101##k, who is in the #b#m100030102##k. Hmm... #p1013101# will probably just laugh at you. Still, you should go tell #p1013101#.
#p1013101# just laughed, saying your dream was stupid. Just as you suspected.

string.name: name
string.value: Feeding Bull Dog
Say good morning to #b#p1013101##k.

#p1013101#, after laughing for awhile, says to stop talking nonsense and asks you to give #p1013102# some breakfast. Give some food to #b#p1013102##k, who is to your #bleft#k, since #p1013101# is too scared to do it himself.
You fed #p1013102# breakfast.

string.name: name
string.value: Sandwich for Breakfast
You fed breakfast to #p1013102#. Come to think of it, you're hungry too... Go ask #b#p1013101##k about breakfast.

#p1013101# gave you a sandwich for breakfast. He tells you to #bgo inside the house again once you're done with your sandwich#k. Mom must have something she wants to ask you to do... In any case, eat your sandwich first.
Mom suddenly handed you a #t1003028#. Huh? Why did she give this to you?

string.value: Delivering the Lunch Box
#bMom#k seems to have something she wants you to do. Talk to her.
Mom asks you to deliver the #t4032448# to #bDad#k who is working at the #b#m100030300##k. Go to the #m100030300#. Leave the house and head #bto your left#k.
You delivered the #t4032448# to Dad.

string.value: Collecting Eggs

#p1013101# says that there are too many foxes in #b#m100030103##k these days and suggests eliminating the #r#o9300385#es#k together. #p1013101# tells you to go to the #m100030103# first to start the elimination and that he will follow later... \r\n\r\n#o9300385##r #a220081##k

#p1013000# says that it shouldn't be too difficult to carry someone your size. Ah, so it is possible to mount an Onyx Dragon. Go inform Grendel the Old of this fact.

A person named #p1101002#, who is the Tactician in #m130000000#, tells you to leave since this island is only for Knights. He says that all the saddles for the Knights are made by #b#p2060005##k in the #b#m230000000##k... Would he be able to make a Dragon Saddle?

#p2060005#, after measuring #p1013000#, says that a Dragon Saddle must be custom made to fit #p1013000#. He says he will make you a saddle if you pay for the materials and labor.\n\nYou can obtain the materials by entering the door of the Mushroom House between the Ribbon Pigs upstairs.

#p1013000# grumbles that the saddle is painful because he's gotten too big. He definitely does look very uncomfortable. Maybe you shouldn't mount him until a new saddle can be made. Does that mean you have to go to #b#m230000000# again for a new saddle...?

#p1013203##r #a225961##k

string.value: After Shedding 2

string.value: Meet Hiver 1
#p1013000# looks like he wants to tell you something.

#p1013000# doesn't think you'll be able to find #p1013203# without some detective work. The Black Wings may have some information and #p2152016# in #m310000000# appears to be a person of high rank. It might be worth looking into.
#p1013203# seemed caught off-guard when you asked about #p2152016#. He certainly appears to be a high ranking member of the Black Wings, but...

string.name: name
string.value: Meet Hiver 2
#p1013203# must be a high-ranking member of the Black Wings if he's that hard to get ahold of. See if #p2152016# knows how to meet up with him.
#p2152016# offered to contact #p1013203# on your behalf, but he wants you to eliminate some #o7150002#s and bring him a heaping helping of bear meat. How much can this guy eat?!
#p2152016# took the bear meat and told you he received #p1013203#'s response.

string.name: name
string.value: Into the Mine
Ask Bavan if he's contacted Hiver yet.
Hiver is waiting for you at the Mine? He must not be threatened by you at all. Hurry to the Mine!
Hiver laid a trap for you! But a suspicious girl intervened in the mine. Go to Edelstein and confront Bavan!

string.name: name
string.value: Claudine, Lady of Mystery
As soon as you entered #m310000000#, #p1013000# started yelling at you! What's going on?

#p1013000# claims that the suspicious woman you saw at the Mine is #p2152004#, the doctor in #m310000000#! They look so different, but #p1013000# seems really sure of himself. Maybe you should look into it.
#p2152004# acted like she didn't know anything about it, but something fishy is going on. Keep pressing her for information.

string.name: name
string.value: IF we really do have the same enemy.
It appears that #p2152004# is hiding her identity from the Black Wings. Meet her at #m310000000# Park 3.

#p2152004# introduced herself as a member of the Resistance, an organization formed to fight the Black Wings. Being on the same side, you suggested a team-up, but #p2152004# doesn't trust you yet...\n\n#p2152004# asked you to enter #bGelimer's Laboratory using the entrance Behind the Mine#k. Bring back 30 Black Wing Emblems and she'll accept your offer.
The enemy of my enemy is my ally...

string.name: name
string.value: With More People
I feel better knowing we're not alone in our fight against the Black Mage. I only hope #p1013000# feels the same.
#p1013000# is excited about the turn of events. With enough help, the Black Mage and his Black Wings won't stand a chance!
Will you escort me to the continental conference?

With a kind expression on his face, the Headmaster tells you that your level will go up naturally as you gain more experience while helping the various people in town. Go and #bhelp the townspeople who are in need#b.#k.

You brought the #t4000595#s to #p2152001#, and he told you that the children will be very happy. He really doesn't fit the image of a Kindergarten teacher, but he really cares about his kids, which is the important thing.

string.name: name
string.value: Request from a Police Officer

string.value: Mysterious Invitation

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

You raised your Level thanks to the Headmaster's suggestion. The Resistance should be contacting you soon, but you still wonder how they will do it... In any case, the Headmaster seems to have something to say to you. Go see #b#p2152000##k in front of the school.

The Headmaster congratulates you for raising your level and gives you a #b#t2031010##k. You want to refuse it, since you're still waiting to be contacted by the Resistance, but you end up taking it. Those fighting the Black Wings are none other than the townspeople who appeared to live ordinary lives! \n\nIf you want to become a member of the Resistance to fight for peace and freedom, choose your job now!

#p2151005# wanted to repay you for your kindness since she recovered her health and can move freely.

string.value: Request of the Test Subject 3

#p2151005#'s medicine is finished, but it still needs to be tested. Help her test the medicine by drinking it and successfully defeating the #rTraining Robot#k in #b#m310010500##k. Then, report to #p2151003# while the medicine is still in effect.\n\n#o9300413##r #a231181##k

#p2151005#'s medicine was incredible! When you informed #p2151003# that the medicine had no side effects and you were able to successfully defeat the Training Robot, she was ecstatic! She said she would think about how the members of the Resistance can use it in the future.

string.value: The Second Mission
Upon reaching Lv. 20, #p2151003#, a member of the Resistance, talks to you.

#p2151003# says your second mission is to go talk to #b#p2152010##k and solve the problem he's having. Since #p2152010#'s in charge of supplies and support for the Resistance, it must be important. Go talk to him!
You met with #p2152010# and found out the problem he was having.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2152010##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Catching the Water Thief Monster
Go see #b#p2152010##k, who is in charge of Resistance supplies, and help him with his problem.

#p2152010# engages in bartering in order to find financial support for the Resistance. Of the items he trades, water is one of the most important commodities. However, it appears that #o2150000#s have come and stolen all the water. Head over to #b#m310030200##k and teach the #r#o2150000#s#k a lesson, then bring the #b#t4000601#s#k over to the #bstorage tank next to Surl#k to fill up the tank. You must fill the #bwater tank#k all the way.

#bFill the water tank with water
#bCaution: You must drop one bottle of water at a time, with the correct timing. It takes each bottle a few moments to be absorbed into the tank.
#p2152010#'s water tank was successfully filled.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2152010##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Water Trade
#b#p2152010##k, a Resistance colleague, has a favor to ask.

#p2152010# says he should stop selling the water he's been collecting, because the Black Wing surveillance is getting to be too much. He says the water delivery is being done via the airship, so head over to #b#m310000010##k and deliver water to #b#p2150008##k.
Although you had an encounter with a group of thieves, you were able to safely deliver the water.

string.name: name
string.value: Abuses of the Black Wings
The group of thieves dropped a strange item, a #b#t4032745##k... Very suspicious. Perhaps #b#p2152010##k knows why the thieves were carrying a #b#t4032745##k.
#p2152010# was surprised and upset to see the #t4032745#. In fact, #p2152010# is enraged, demanding that you rush over to the #bUnderground Base#k and show the #t4032745# to #b#p2151003##k.
#p2151003# was furious and said that the Black Wings were probably disguising themselves as thieves to steal from people.

string.name: name
string.value: A Gift for the Test Subject 1

#b#p2150006##k may look like just another Assistant Plastic Surgeon, but she's actually in charge of mending wounds and healing the Resistance. She has something to ask you, so head over to the #bUnderground Base#k.

#p2150006# says #p2151005#'s medicine has helped her focus on taking care of her patients. She is so grateful that she would like to give a present to #p2151005# to thank her. Collect the ingredients that are required for the present. You can find #b#t4032746#s#k by hunting #r#o2150002#s#k in #b#m310030310##k.\n\n#i4032746# #t4032746# #b#c4032746# / 10#k
#p2150006# began to make a present for #p2151005#, so you gave her a few moments.

string.name: name
string.value: A Gift for the Test Subject 2
Talk to #b#p2150006##k at the #bUnderground Base#k to see if she's finished the present.
#p2150006# made a #t4032747# for #p2151005#. Since #b#p2151005##k doesn't have a hometown, she thought this would allow Vita to feel at home here. #p2150006# wants you deliver the present.
#p2151005# was so excited to when she received the present, and said she would work even harder for the Resistance.

string.name: name
string.value: Delivering the Test Subject's Medicine
#b#p2151003##k, a member of the Resistance, wants to speak with you. Head over to the #bUnderground Base#k.

#p2151003# says it isn't a secret mission, but a simple favor. She wants you to meet with a #bResistance Secret Agent#k to deliver some medicine. The medicine appears to be something that was concocted by #p2151005#. Go to the Secret Meeting Place via the back alley near #m310030110#'s Phone Booth.

The Resistance Secret Agent was #p2159010#, who rescued you in front of the Laboratory a long time ago! #p2159010# said that he's seen a lot of medicine with the initial V on it and wondered who made the medicine.

string.name: name
string.value: The Third Mission
Upon reaching Lv. 29, #p2151003#, a member of the Resistance, talks to you.

#p2152010#, a member of the Resistance, is in danger! He left town for a business deal, and the Black Wings attacked him. Hurry and rescue #p2152010#! You can find him in #b#m931000440##k, located behind #b#m310020100##k's Observation Binoculars.
#p2152010# seems to be safe for now.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2159201##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Protecting Surl

#p2152010#, a Resistance supporter, is in danger and could be attacked by the Black Wings any minute now! Hurry and rescue #p2152010#! Go to #b#m931000440##k, behind #b#m310020100##k's Observation Binoculars.

The Black Wings have begun attacking #p2152010#! #bDuring the given time, you must protect #p2152010# from the Black Wings#k. Defeat all nearby members of the Black Wings and prevent #p2152010# from getting injured.
You were successful in protecting #p2152010#. #p2152010# thanked you and said that with people like you to stand up to the Black Wings, peace is imminent.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2159201##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Secret Meeting
#p2159200# the Resistance agent has something to tell you.
#p2159200# wants you to meet him in secret, without telling any other Resistance members. How mysterious! Meet #p2159200# at the secret rendezvous point by taking the path from #bSerpent Path#k.
You met #p2159200# at the secret rendezvous point.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2159200##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Suspicions 1
#p2159200# is up to something. Find out what he wants from you.
#p2159200# gave you a package and asked you to take it to #p2012012# in #m200000000#. He's hiding something... What could be in the package?
You delivered the package to #p2012012# in #m200000000# for #p2159200#.

string.name: name
string.value: Suspicions 2
You delivered a package to #p2012012# for #p2159200#, but you have no idea what's inside.
#p2012012# says she needs #t4000063# to complete her analysis.
#p2012012# is almost finished with her analysis.

string.name: name
string.value: Suspicions 3
The analysis is done. Can #p2012012# finally tell you what #p2159200#'s mysterious item is?
#p2012012# says the item was poison disguised as medicine. Take the results of the analysis back to #p2159200#.
#p2159200# was worried by the results from #p2012012#. If Vita was the one who made the medicine, does that make her a traitor?

string.name: name
string.value: Spy or Victim?
Is #p2151005# really a spy? #p2159200# needs to explain himself!

#p2159200# felt strange after taking some of #p2151005#'s medicine. He kept an eye on her after that, and discovered that it was actually poison. He wants you to report his findings to #p2152004#, and keep an eye on #p2151005#.
#p2152004# couldn't believe the report, but agreed to keep a close eye on #p2151005#.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2151003##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: An Unsettling Discovery
#p2152004# has something to tell you. Could it be about #p2151005#?
#p2152004# says that #p2151005#'s medicine did contain poison, after all. So she was a spy, after all? Speak with #p2151005# to get an answer.
#p2151005# was locked away in prison...

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2159346##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Truth and Lies
Is #p2151005# really a spy? Ask her.
#p2151005# claims she didn't know the medicine was poisonous, and she seems to mean it. But you can't just release her! Ask #p2152004# what happens next.
#P2152004# told you that the people who took the medicine must be treated.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2151003##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: In Search of an Antidote
Help #p2152004# make an antidote for #p2151005#'s poison.
You need Feather Plant from Victoria Island in order to make an antidote. Go to #m105000000# and ask #p1061005# for the Feather Plant.
How will #p2152004# solve this problem? There's nothing you can do but pass the time until something new comes up.

string.name: name
string.value: Feather Plant
Buy Feather Plants from #p1061005#.

#p1061005# has a lot of medicinal plants, but he's low on Feather Plants. He can dig up about half of what you need, but getting more could be tough. You decided to take what you could get and let him take his time looking through storage.
You received a pouch with 200 Feather Plants from #p1061005#.

string.name: name
string.value: Cygnus Knight Favor
You received a message from a mysterious person...
The man who calls himself #p1101006# told you that he'll be waiting at #m310000010# in #m310000000#. It's very sudden, but it might have something to do with the Resistance.
#p1101006# came from the #p1101000# Knights!

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2159352##k#n
What are the #p1101000# Knights doing here? #p2152004# said they were all traitors! Talk to #p1101006# to get his side of the story.
#p2152004# was really peeved when you returned with the Feather Plants. You're not sure why, but it must have something to do with the #p1101000# Knights. She must really hate those guys.
#p1101006# told you the full story from #p1061005#, and gave you Feather Plants on behalf of the #p1101000# Knight's to prove his sincerity.\n\nTake the Feather Plants to #p2152004#.

string.name: name
string.value: Vita's Disappearance
#p2152004# wants to talk to you all of a sudden! Have the suspicions about #p2151005# been confirmed?

#p2151005# has disappeared! Was she really a spy? Did the Black Wings help her escape from the hideout?\n\n#p2152004# go after #p2151005#! If she really is a Black Wing spy, she'll most likely have gone to the mines. Find her and bring her back to #m310010000# immediately!

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2151003##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Gelimer's Trap
#p2154009# needs you to find #p2151005#. Go see #p2152004#, and get her permission to take on this mission!
#p2152004# knew the mission was a trap, but your mind was made up. You cannot let #p2154009# treat #p2151005# as his experiment! Hurry to the mines and rescue #p2151005#!

string.name: name
string.value: I Repent!

#p2151005#, was caught in the explosion, another casualty in #p2154009#'s evil conspiracy. Unfortunately, you failed to rescue her before the blast. Report back to #p2152004# and give her the bad news.
#p2152004# seems to be regretting her choices. If she had only asked for help, #p2151005# could have been saved...\n\nWe can't do this alone. But things might go differently with some help.
#p2152004# seems to regret her decision to send you after #p2151005# alone. If she hadn't mistrusted her, none of this would have happened.

string.name: name
string.value: Their Purpose
#p2152004# contacted you, but she didn't say why.

#p2152004# asked you to investigate the area where you lost #p2151005# to #p2154009#'s trap. It will be difficult, but you might be able to find some clue's to #p2154009#'s true plans if you look through the rubble.
#p2154009# is most certainly experimenting on humans somewhere! How could he do this?! Investigate the Research Diary A.

string.name: name
string.value: Black Wing Master
#p2152004# has gone over #p2154009#'s Research Diary A. See what she's found.

#p2152004#'s review of the diary revealed that #p2154009# is trying to make a superhuman! She gave you an exerpt from the diary:

Upon completion of the experiment, the subject appeared to be successful. Visually, it appeared to be an exact replica of The One. I named it #p2151005#, thinking it would be my greatest achievement. However, after multiple tests, I am now certain the experiment was a failure. It exhibits no extraordinary capabilities. It is, in fact, a quite ordinary human female. The subject will be purged during the next clean cycle. I must go back to formula.

Was #p2151005# really just a disposable reject?! And who is The One? This research diary is missing too much information. Go back to the area where you found it and see if you can find Research Diary B.
You met...the found of the Black Wings?! Her name is Orchid. What could she be doing here?!

string.name: name
string.value: Time To Make a Decision

Orchid, the founder of the Black Wings and one of the Black Mage's Commanders, has come forward in an attempt to intimidate you into backing down. How will the Resistance deal with a group trying to revive the Black Mage? Inform #p2152004# about these developments immediately.

The Resistance has met and decided to participate in the continental conference, led by Empress #p1101000#. They're not certain they can defeat the Black Mage, even with the other leaders of Maple World at their side, but they know they can't do it on their own. Bring word of the Resistance's official acceptance back to Empress #p1101000#.
The Alliance would give you a chance to avenge #p2151005#, wouldn't it?

string.name: name
string.value: Defeat the Guards!

string.name: name
string.value: The Strange Beast

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Now that you have reached Lv. 30, #b#p2151000##k is calling you.
Defeat the #r#o9001036##k that has terrorizing Edelstein. It was last seen near the fountain at #m310020100#.
#r#o9001036##k claims that it is really #b#p2151009##k. Maybe you should hear it out.

string.name: name
string.value: The Monster's Identity

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
The #r#o9001036##k that was terrorizing Edelstein claims to be #b#p2151009##k. Could it be...?
The cat is indeed #b#p2151009##k. Listen to the events that led up to this.
#o9001036#'s true identity is #p2151009#. Mastema was mortally wounded in the past, but survived by becoming a summoned creature. #p2151009# has explained everything.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2153006##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Contract with Mastema

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

#b#p2151009##k, who settled down in #b#m310010000##k, has a proposition for you. #b#p2151009##k wishes to give you strength through a contract. You don't like the sound of a contract, but it does make sense. What will you do?
Talk to #b#p2151009##k at #b#m310010000##k and accept the contract.
You feel the power of #p2151009##k added to your own. You're still not sure about #p2151009# being in your head all the time, but #p2151009# says it's okay...

string.name: name
string.value: Did it work? Are your powers back?

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
What kind of training could #p2151009# be talking about? You have been asked to come to the open lot near the fountain at #m310020100#. Better get moving.
Fighting against someone from another dimension? Sure, why not?
Now that you have reached Lv. 60, you hear #p2151009#'s voice in your mind. It sounds like Mastema has some thoughts on your training methods.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2153006##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Sparring with Mastema

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
You never expected to be trained by #p2153006#. Once you are ready, go and talk to #p2153006#.
Use the Dimensional Schism to travel to a new dimension and spar with #r#o9001037##k. Don't hold back! If you wish to spar again, forfeit the quest and restart.

Since you have sparred against Mastema in the past, your body responded automatically. The memories of some of your old powers and techniques have started to return. Who would have thought that fighting #p2153006# would be so helpful?

string.name: name
string.value: True Awakening

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

Through the break in time at #b#m220050300##k, you can return to the past and fight...yourself? It sounds just crazy enough to work. Go to #b#m220050300##k and meet #b#p2151009##k again. #b#p2151009##k will open a Crack in Time for you.
You've finally recovered all of your lost power. All that remains is to push yourself further than before, in preparation for the day that you face the Black Mage!
Even at Lv. 100, you know that you haven't reached your former level of power. You've hit a wall, and you need some guidance. #p2151009# can probably help.

string.name: name
string.value: Sparring with Mastema

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
You never expected to be trained by #p2153006#. Once you are ready, go and talk to #p2153006#.
Use the Dimensional Schism to travel to a new dimension and spar with #r#o9001037##k. Don't hold back!

Since you have sparred against Mastema in the past, your body responded automatically. The memories of some of your old powers and techniques have started to return. Who would have thought that fighting #p2153006# would be so helpful?

string.name: name
string.value: True Awakening

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

Through the break in time at #b#m220050300##k, you can return to the past and fight...yourself? It sounds just crazy enough to work. Go to #b#m220050300##k and meet #b#p2151009##k again. #b#p2151009##k will open a Crack in Time for you.
You've finally recovered all of your lost power. All that remains is to push yourself further than before, in preparation for the day that you face the Black Mage!
Even at Lv. 100, you know that you haven't reached your former level of power. You've hit a wall, and you need some guidance. #p2151009# can probably help.

string.name: name
string.value: Love Lost, but not Forgotten
#p2151009# speaks directly into your mind.

#p2151009# met an another version of you in a different dimension, and was taken to the Temple of Time. The other version of you pointed to a certain place sorrowfully, and disappeared. After returning to this dimension, #p2151009# visited the place he pointed to. You have received what was found there...your precious locket.

#p2151009# found your locket, containing a picture of your family. This picture stirs your heart, and brings back all the emotions you kept buried as one of the Black Mage's terrible commanders. You feel a warm, surging strength in your body... You have rediscovered the power of revenge, locked away in your heart!

string.name: name
string.value: Calm Before the Storm

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Something blocks you from accessing your power. Seek advice from #p2151009#.
Your rage has transformed into a quiet determination. One day, the Black Mage will pay, and you will be there.
Can your rage be controlled? Perhaps, in time. Forfeit the quest and talk to #b#p2151009##k again. #r(You will have to forfeit the quest and restart if you fail.)#k

string.name: name
string.value: The Resistance and You
The Resistance is watching over you, and wishes for you to join them. You should find out a bit more about what this Resistance really is.
The leader of the Resistance is the woman named #b#p2151003##k. Go ask #b#p2151003##k at #b#m310010000##k about the Resistance.
Sounds like the Resistance is at war with the Black Wings, a group devoted to reviving the Black Mage. How terrible that he can cause such pain even now...

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2151003##k#n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 700

string.name: name
string.value: Agility Training
#p2151003# thinks you should do some training. Go to #p2151000# at #m310010010# for training.

This is a training program for improving the agility of Resistance trainees. You have to eliminate 30 #r#o9300409#s#k at #b#m310010100##k. Since they can vanish at will, you'll have to time your strikes carefully.
You've finished the first training program. It seems like an eternity since you last did something so basic, but it felt good to have a little refresher after all those years.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 735

string.name: name
string.value: Attack Training
Ready for another training course from #b#p2151000##k? Talk to #b#p2151000##k at the #m310010010# in the Resistance Headquarters.
This program is focused on honing attacks. Go inside the #b#m310010200##k and eliminate #r#o9300410#s#k within. Since #o9300410#s can self-destruct, you must strike quickly and forcefully.
The second training course is behind you. #p2151000# might only be an amateur, but these courses aren't too shabby.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 740

string.name: name
string.value: Endurance Training
Time for the third training course from #b#p2151000##k. Talk to #b#p2151000##k at the #m310010010# in the Resistance Headquarters to begin.
The next course is meant to build endurance. Go inside the #b#m310010300##k and eliminate #r#o9300411#s#k within. Since #o9300411# has very high HP, eliminating it will take time and patience.
You finished #p2151000#'s without breaking a sweat. All this basic training is making you eager to build your strength back up.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 910

string.name: name
string.value: Final Training Course
#b#p2151000##k has one final training course for you. Talk to #b#p2151000##k at the #m310010010# in the Resistance Headquarters to begin.

All Resistance trainees have to go through this final course as a sort of final exam. Go inside the #b#m310010400##k and eliminate 15 #r#o9300412#s#k within. Since #r#o9300412#s#k can fly, it's a well-balanced challenge...for rookies.
You completed the final training. No problem.

string.name: name
string.value: Demon Fury Training 1
You have lost most of your power. Even your Demon Fury's is weak, and hard to control. You need to train it back up.

Practice charging your Demon Fury by landing normal attacks. Once it is charged, use an attack skill such as #b#q31001000##k. Use #b#q31001000##k to eliminate 1 #r1 #o9300409## inside #b#m310010100##k. To use #b#q31001000##k, open your Skill Inventory (Hotkey: K) and select the skill.
You managed to charge up your Demon Fury, and eliminate some foes by using it. Better keep practicing, just in case.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 600

string.name: name
string.value: Demon Fury Training 2
Keep practicing with your Demon Fury to get better control of it.
Use #b#q31001000##k to eliminate 10 #r#o9300410#s#k in #b#m310010200##k.
Managing your Demon Fury is no problem, but you might need to practice a bit more to use it efficiently.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 800

string.name: name
string.value: Demon Fury Training 3
There's still a long way to go with your Demon Fury. A real battle would be good practice.
Use #b#q31001000##k to eliminate #r30 #o1150000#s#k at #b#m310030000##k. The key is to fill up your Demon Fury quickly, and use #b#q31001000##k whenever you can.
You feel pretty confident with your Demon Fury again. Using it with other skills should come naturally.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 1200

string.name: name
string.value: Black Wing Spy!
Something happened at the Resistance Headquarters. Go see #b#p2151003##k at #b#m310010000##k to find out what's going on.
A Black Wing spy? You've got time...why not find the spy yourself? Instead of going to the Secret Plaza where everyone else is, go search #b#m310010010##k.
Was he really trying to hide from you with the power of darkness? You're a Demon Slayer...you can see right though such dark tricks! The Resistance really appreciates your help.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 1200

string.name: name
string.value: Joining the Resistance
#p2151003# thanked you, and has something to discuss with you. Go talk to #b#p2151003##k at #b#m310010000##k.
#b#p2151000##k at #b#m310010010##k has prepared something for you. Go see him.
Looks like you're part of the Resistance now. It's a strange feeling...having comrades again.

string.name: name
string.value: The First Mission
As a member of the Resistance, you'll have missions to undertake. #b#p2151000##k has your first mission already.
Talk to #b#p2151003##k in #b#m310010000##k to start your first mission.
You asked #p2151003# about your first mission.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 500

string.name: name
string.value: Where Did the Kids Go?
#b#p2152005##k in the #m310000000# downtown is upset because children seem to be disappearing. Go get some details on the situation.

Checky told you that #b#p2159317##k and #b#p2159318##k have disappeared. He last saw them heading for the Strolling Path, and he's worried that they got lost and ended up at #b#m310030110##k. Search #b#m310030110##k.
You found #p2159318#. #p2159318# told you that she got separated from #p2159317#. Find #p2159317# somewhere around #m310030110#.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2159318##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Getting Home
#p2159318#, who you found in #m310030110#, asked you to find #b#p2159317##k. He should be somewhere around #m310030110#.
You found #p2159317#, and he told you that he's too scared of #o1150002# to leave. Eliminate 30 #o1150002#s so that the kids can get home safely.
The kids are safe. You feel a warm tingling in your heart.

string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,800
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/6/0# 1
#i2001001:# #t2001001:# x 5
#p2152010# tells you that kids these days don't know how to save. He wants you to prove that you're good with money. Really?

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2152010##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: My Old Armor
Your armor has served you well, but its become a worn-out, rusty mess. How can you replace your armor?
Visit #b#p2152010##k, and look for better armor.
#b#p2152010##k told you that if you prove you know how to save, that he will give you a decent piece of armor.

#p2152010# explained that people throw away lots of useful things in #b#t4032754##k, and so he wants to recycle those things to make your armor. Bring him #b30#k #b#t4032754#s#k by eliminating #r#o2150001#s#k.
You brought #t4032754#s to #p2152010#, and after rambling a bit about being frugal, gave you a pretty nice piece of armor. #p2152010# might be a bit of a pain, but he does good work, at least.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,800\r\n#i1082004:# #t1082004:# x 1

string.name: name
string.value: Darkness on Our Side
#b#p2151003##k wants to speak with you about missions.\nGo to #b#m310010000##k.
#p2151003# told you that the Resistance mainly operates under cover of darkness. That means too much light can foil their plans. You are to get rid of 50 #r#o2150002#s#k in #b#m310030310##k.
Without those lights, night missions should go much more smoothly.

string.name: name
string.value: Too Many Streetlights
#b#p2152007##k at #m310000000# City Hall has something to tell you.

#p2152007# told you that there are too many city streetlights, and they're wasting electricity. He wants you to collect light bulbs to cut down on power consumption. Eliminate #r#o2150002#s#k in #b#m310030310##k, and bring him #r30 #t4000603#s#k.
#p2152007# specifically told you to bring him #t4000603#s. Sounds like he might be looking to profit off them. Later, he gave you 1 #t4000603# to earn your silence. Smart guy.

string.name: name
string.value: The Outside World
Why would the Resistance request help from the outside? Find some answers.
Visit #b#p2151003##k, and ask about what's happening in the outside world.
After the Cygnus Knights abandoned the Resistance, the remaining Resistance members decided to work on their own, and shut everyone else out. Cygnus...that name brings back a lot of memories...

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2151003##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: A Special Gift
After you eliminated the monster near #m310000000#s, #b#p2151000##k called on you to thank you. Turns out the monster was #p2151009#.
Visit #b#p2151000##k, and talk to #b#p2151000##k in #b#m310010010##k.
#b#p2151000##k gave you a good weapon for eliminating the monster near #m310000000#.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2151000##k#n
