string.name: name
string.value: The Ancient One
#p2151009# introduced you to #p2020005#, who has lived for hundreds and hundreds of years. If anyone knows what has happened with the Black Mage's forces, it would be him.
Visit #b#p2020005##k to find out more about the years you missed. #b#p2020005##k is in the #m211000000# town.
The moment #p2020005# felt your Demon Fury, he refused to speak to you. How can you convince him to talk?

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2020005##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: Alcaster's Concerns
The moment #p2020005# felt your Demon Fury, he refused to speak to you. How can you convince him to talk?
#p2151009# told you that if you find out what #b#p2020005#'s#k needs and help him out, he might come around. Try listening in on him during his research. He might mention something.
Since you got #p2020005# a #t4032970#, he said he will listen to your story.

string.name: name
string.value: The Story Thus Far
You finally got #p2020005#'s attention. Time to learn what you can from him.
You've learned of the fate of the Black Mage and his commanders from #b#p2020005##k in #m211000000#. Before you go, ask him about the Black Wings.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2020005##k#n\n
You've heard plenty about the Black Wings and #p2159310# from #p2151009#.

string.name: name
string.value: Once A Villain
Why does the Elven Hero want to talk to you? Does she have a bone to pick?
The Elven Hero said that the damage you did to the Black Mage helped them finish him off...but that doesn't make up for what you did in his service.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Talk to #e#b#p2159322##k#n\n
While traveling on Victoria Island, someone called out to you. It was an Elf, one of the heroes who sealed the Black Mage.

string.name: name
string.value: Turn Me Back!
#p2151009# sounds trange. Did something important happen?
#p2151009# crafted a #t4032971#, and it seemed like it might work, but something went wrong. You never liked this idea, anyway... #p2151009# is still looking for a way to turn back, though.
#p2151009# asked you to eliminate #b#o4230121##k in #b#m221030600##k, and obtain a #r#t4032971##k, which could undo what was done to Mastema.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 70,000 

Can proceed to the [Alchemy is the Key!] quest

string.name: name
string.value: Alchemy is the Key!
#p2151009# sounds really excited, and that makes you nervous. After the ray gun incident, what could Mastema want?

#p2151009# crafted a transforming potion by mixing chemicals into #t4000419#. This will supposedly let Mastema change form. After drinking the potion, #p2151009# certainly changed form, but into you! And then Mastema changed right back! Guess this was a failure, as well...

#p2151009# heard a rumor about some kind of alchemy that can change things any way you like. Since #m261000000# is well-known for alchemy, collect a #r#t4000419##k from #r#o9800045##k, who is in #bZenumist #m261010003##k, and bring it to Mastema.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 120,000

string.name: name
string.value: Time for a Change!
#p2151009# is speaking to you. What is it?
#p2151009# finally turned back to normal...until speaking. That didn't last long at all, but #p2151009# seems pleased with even a temporary success.

#p2151009# told you that you could obtain a #r#t04032972##k by eliminating #r#o8200000#s#k in #b#m270000100##k. Mastema seems to think that this Sand Glass can revert appearances through time. If you find one in the Temple of Time, you might as well bring it to Mastema.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,000,000

string.name: name
string.value: Stronghold of the Black Wings
The time has come to investigate Verne Mine, stronghold of the Black Wings. Find out who commands the Black Wings while you're there.
Security is quite tight in Verne Mine. To make this easier, eliminate 50 #r#o6150000#s#k. #r#o6150000#s#k can be found in #r#m310050200# and #m310050300##k.
The mine's security has thinned out, but you can do better than this.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 20,000 

Can proceed to the [Clearing the Stronghold] quest

string.name: name

string.name: name
string.value: A Village on Guard

You come to a newly-discovered area, #m310000000#, but no one will talk to you. All the residents seem to go about their business without saying a word... you wonder what's going on... Ask Headmaster #b#p2152000##k, who looks the most gentlemanly out of everyone.

The residents of this town aren't hard of hearing or unable to speak, and they certainly don't value silence. Apparently, they just don't like talking to you, but you don't know why... There might be #ba resident who is willing to answer your question#k. See if you can find someone.

#y23901# #b(#u23901#)#k
#y23902# #b(#u23902#)#k
Everyone in this town seems to have a grudge against the #p1101000# Knights. You wonder why...

string.name: name
string.value: Jun's Thoughts
No adult in #m310000000# seems approachable, but a child may be different. Talk to #b#p2152008##k, and see if you can find out why people aren't talking to you.

Although the child gives you a little more reaction than any of the adults, #p2152008# isn't what you would call friendly. You wonder how you can befriend #p2152008#... Perhaps you can give #p2152008# a gift. He seems to dote on #bthe puppy he's carrying#k...

After you gave him some delicious Dry Treats for his puppy, #p2152008# opened up to you. According to #p2152008#, keeping distance from outsiders doesn't seem to be a part of the town's culture. He says the townspeople just avoid people like you. You wonder what that means... You couldn't possibly be worse than the Black Wings.

string.name: name
string.value: Ulrika's Thoughts
No adult in #m310000000# seems approachable, but a child may be different. Talk to #b#p2152009##k, a girl who looks bright, and ask her if she knows why the townspeople refuse to talk to you.

Although she gave you a bit more of a response than the adults of the town, #p2152009# still seems to distance herself from you. You try to think of ways to befriend #p2152009#... Perhaps you can give #p2152009# a gift. After all, she seems to be in search of #bFruits to give her big sister#k.

#p2152009# opened up to you a little more after you give her a #t2010003# that is known to energize and rejuvenate. According to #p2152009#, the residents of this town hate anyone who is a part of the #p1101000# Knights. You can't imagine what the #p1101000# Knights have done to the townspeople...

string.name: name
string.value: Can You Help Edelstein?

The townspeople seem to hate anyone who is a part of the #p1101000# Knights just as much as they hate the Black Wings. But, you still don't know why... Talk to #b#p2152000##k in front of the school. He seems friendly enough to answer your questions...

Apparently, the #p1101000# Knights have broken their promise to this town. You, personally, may not be responsible, but it is your duty as a Cygnus Knight to regain their trust. When you tell him that, #p2152000# says he will have the townspeople open up to you if you find #b#t4000603#s#k for the children.\n\n#i4000603# #t4000603# #b#c4000603# / 40#k

#m310000000# is a town that has been taken over by the Black Wings, and for some reason, they hate the #p1101000# Knights, as well... #p2152000# said that you should know the answer to that question better than anyone, and avoided giving you a straight answer.

string.name: name
string.value: Cygnus the Betrayer
You can't figure why the people of #m310000000# hate the #p1101000# Knights so much... Since you've come to Ereve, ask the #bEmpress#k.

When you ask Empress #p1101000# about #m310000000#, she grimaces and says it's because the Knights have broken their promise to the town. You still don't know what happened between the Cygnus Knights and the residents of Edelstein... Ask #b#p1101002##k.

#m310000000# is a town taken over by the Black Wings. Apparently, the people of #m310000000# formed the Resistance and fought against the Black Wings for years in order to drive them out of their town. Empress #p1101000# had her Knights join forces with the Resistance in order to stop the revival of the Black Mage.

One day, the Resistance decided to launch their ultimate attack and asked the Knights to help them. Without hesitation, the Empress willingly agreed to provide support. However, the Cygnus Knights broke their promise and #m310000000# was defeated, resulting in more severe oppression and surveillance of its residents. 

Since then, the townspeople have despised the Empress and her Knights as much as they do the Black Wings.

string.name: name
string.value: Town Filled With Suspicion

You come to a newly-discovered area, #m310000000#, but no one will talk to you. All the residents seem to go about their business without saying a word... you wonder what's going on... Ask Headmaster #b#p2152000##k, who looks the most gentlemanly out of everyone.

Headmaster #p2152000# says the reason the townspeople are avoiding you is probably because they think you are one of #r<them>#k. He says to talk to #bpeople dressed in black in this town#k if you want to learn more about it.\n\n#y23906# #b(#u23906#)#k

The Black Wings rule #m310000000#, and the townspeople have no choice but to accept it. Because everyone in #m310000000# despises the Black Wings, the overall climate of the town is far from happy and inviting. But, since you've resolved the misunderstanding, you should be able to talk to the residents.

string.name: name
string.value: Their Identity
You wonder who <they> are why the residents wouldn't talk to you because of <them>... Talk to the #bcorpulent man in black#k.

#p2152016#, a watchman dressed in black, says they are the ones who rule this town now and demands that you pay a fee if you want to stay in this town. He's a rather unpleasant man, but you can tell he isn't lying. You don't seem to have any other option but to find the item #p2152016# wants.\n\n#i4000603# #t4000603# #b#c4000603# / 40#k
#p2152016# was pleased when you handed him 40 #t4000603#s. He nodded his head, slightly and arrogantly, and says you can stay in this town.

When #p1201000# receives the information you acquired in #m310000000#, she's surprised, yet accepts it easily. It's as if she expected it... #p1201000# requests that you continue to hide your identity and collect more information. She warns you not to do anything rash, since you could get yourself hurt by going on the attack alone.

When #p1201000# received the information you acquired in #m310000000#, she was surprised, yet accepted it easily. She warned you not to do anything rash, as you could get yourself hurt by going on the attack alone.

The Black Wings seem to be extremely suspicious. They were not exactly seen as heroes in #m310000000#, but maybe they're a good organization, anyway...

string.value: Who Should We Be Angry At?
The Black Wings have tricked and betrayed you. You don't know what to do, because their headquarters is in #m310000000#. Discuss it with #b#p1013000##k.

#p1013000# says you shouldn't attack them, because they belong to the Black Wings. #p1013000# also suggests that you hide your identity and slowly investigate #m310000000#. You decide you will attack, if and when Hiver returns.

#p1013000# says you shouldn't attack them just because they belong to the Black Wings. It also suggests that you hide your identity and slowly investigate #m310000000#. You decide to attack if and when Hiver returns.

When you delivered #t4000102#, #p2154002# was extremely happy. Dargoth can't be a human...no human eats such things.\n\nIn any case, the Black Wings don't appear to be all that vicious.

string.name: name
string.value: Please Help Repair Baroq's Wall
Black Wings' secretary #b#p2154002##k at the #m310050000# in the Mine is still struggling with so many things to do. Talk to #p2154002#.

#p2154002# says #p2154000# and #p2154001# destroyed the wall, which must be repaired. However, the #o7150000#s aren't listening, so she wants you to teach the #o7150000#s a lesson. Defeat those #o7150000#s.\n\n#o7150000##r #a239561##k
#p2154002# was really happy that you taught those #o7150000#s a lesson.

string.name: name
string.value: Please Catch Eleanor's Pet
After all that, Black Wings' secretary #b#p2154002##k at the #m310050000# in the Mine still seems to be struggling with so many things to do. Talk to #p2154002#.

#p2154002# says Eleanor's pet escaped its cage and is running around the room. She asks that you catch it and put it back into the cage. She says that first you have to exhaust the pet's strength, then use the item inside the cage to catch the pet. You wonder what kind of pet Eleanor has... Go to Eleanor's room.\n\n#i4032769# #t4032769# #b#c4032769# / 1#k
Eleanor's pet was a giant #t4032769#. After all sorts of struggle, you were finally able to catch the pet. You never figured a secretary's job could be this dangerous!

string.name: name
string.value: Everything is for the Mission
Android #b#p2154003##k, who guards the #m310050100# inside the Mine, needs something. Talk to #p2154003#.

#p2154003# says he wants to upgrade his abilities for his mission and asks that you find the necessary parts. The parts can be obtained by eliminating the #r#o6150000#s#k.\n\n#i4000608# #t4000608# #b#c4000608# / 50#k
Once you delivered the materials, #p2154003# began working on upgrading his system. He lacked the emotions to properly thank you, as with all #o8105003#s. Don't take it personally...

string.name: name
string.value: Warriors Get Hungry, Too
Black Wing management #b#p2154000##k at the #b#m310050100##k in the Mine appears to be extremely hungry.

#p2154000# and #p2154001# only seem to do the work of one person. They don't go on as many business trips, because they prefer training, unlike others in management. Find food for #p2154000#, who has become famished due to heavy training. #r#o7150002##k seems to have the meat #p2154000# wants.\n#i4032770# #t4032770# #b#c4032770# / 100#k
#p2154000# was very happy with #t4032770#.

string.name: name
string.value: Unpleasant Mechanical Doll
Talk to #bWatchman #p2154006##k who guards the #b#m310050200##k in the Mine.

Watchman #p2154006# says he, too, was in #m310050400#, but left because he didn't want to live next to Androids. #p2154006# apparently hates robots, because they have no real feelings. 

He says he's curious whether Androids would get scared of creepy things, so he wants you to catch some #r#o7150001#s#k and show their #bTentacles#k to #bAndroid #p2154007##k.

#i4000610# #t4000610# #b#c4000610# / 80#k
#p2154007# wasn't bothered by the #t4000610# at all.

string.name: name
string.value: I am a Doll With No Feelings
Talk to #bAndroid #p2154007##k at the #b#m310050400##k in the Mine.

#p2154007#, the mechanical doll with no feelings, thrives on bio energy. He says he has to steal energy to #bfill his Energy Cartridge, which activates his heart#k. This time, though, #p2154007# wants you to fill his Energy Cartridge for him... #bThe Energy Cartridge will be automatically filled when you hunt#k.
#p2154007# politely thanked you when you handed him a full Energy Cartridge. Oddly enough, it seemed like #p2154007# didn't really need to fill his Energy Cartridge. You were fooled...

string.name: name
string.value: Please Check on Her
Android #b#p2154007##k at the #m310050400# in the Mine has a favor to ask. Talk to #p2154007#.
#p2154007# is worried about his sister deep inside the cave. He wants you to deliver an Energy Cartridge to #bhis sister#k. First, talk to #p2154007#'s sister...she can be found past #m310060000#.
You met #p2154007#'s sister, #p2154012#. She has even less feelings and emotions than #p2154007#!

string.name: name
string.value: Trivial Tasks are Boring
Talk to #bResearch Intern #p2154008##k at the #b#m310050400##k in the Mine.

#p2154008# says he's extremely bored, because all the fun experiments go to senior researchers, leaving him with only the trivial tasks no one else wants to do. He wants you to be his puppet and put yourself in the abnormal status he names... 

If he says Poison, then you get poisoned, and if he says Curse, then you get cursed and come back to him. All the abnormal status potions are in #p2154008#'s laboratory, so go and drink the potion according to the abnormal status he names. 

You find this to be a pretty strange way to entertain...
You sacrificed yourself and became whichever abnormal status #p2154008# named. #p2154008# was entertained, but you wondered what was so enjoyable about it...

string.name: name
string.value: Materials for the Experiment 1
#p2154009##k, the Black Wing #bmad scientist at the #b#m310060000##k in the Mine, seems to be conducting a dangerous experiment.
#p2154009# let out a vicious laugh as soon as you give him the #t4032771#s. His experiment doesn't seem very pleasant...

#p2154009# says he needs #b#t4032771#s#k for a new experiment and wants you to bring them to him. You can't even imagine what he's going to do with them... Head over to the #b#m310050510##k where the Racaronis can be found.\n\n#i4032771# #t4032771# #b#c4032771# / 10#k

string.name: name
string.value: Materials for the Experiment 2
#b#p2154009##k, the Black Wing mad scientist at the #m310060000# in the Mine, seems to be conducting another iffy experiment.
#p2154009# seemed satisfied with the #t4032772#s and continued with his experiment. It seems like his experiments are getting more dangerous.

#p2154009# says he needs #t4032772#s for a new experiment and wants you bring them to him. His last experiment seemed so cruel... What's he up to this time? Find them at the #b#m310050520##k.\n\n#i4032772# #t4032772# #b#c4032772# / 10#k

string.name: name
string.value: Materials for the Experiment 3
#p2154009#, the Black Wing mad scientist in #m310060000#, is starting another experiment. You shiver just thinking about it...

#p2154009# says he needs #b#p2154012#'s Heart#k for his experiment. You worry what will happen to #p2154012# if she doesn't have a heart... Can she function? #p2154009# doesn't seem to care at all...\n\n#i4032773# #t4032773# #b#c4032773# / 1#k
You gave #p2154009# the spare heart. #p2154009# knew you didn't find the two hearts yourself, but he didn't care.

string.name: name
string.value: Zechtok-2000's Feelings
You were given a mission to steal #p2154012#'s Heart. But, while you debate yourself and get anxious, you see someone walking toward you.

#p2154007# in #m310050400# says he is willing to give you his heart in place of #p2154012#'s. But, without a heart, #p2154007# won't be able to function, either... When you tell him that, #p2154007# says #p2154003# promised to make him a heart, so he has nothing to worry about. Take the #b#t4032774# to #p2154009#, and go to #p2154003# to get #t4032774##k.

#o8105003# #p2154007# in First Square said he was willing to give you his heart in place of #p2154012#'s. But without a heart, #p2154007# wouldn't be able to function, either... When you told him that, #p2154007# said #p2154003# promised to make him a heart, so he had nothing to worry about. Take the #t4032774# to #p2154009#, and go to #p2154003# to get #t4032774#.

string.name: name
string.value: Muscat-2000's Thoughtfulness
Without a heart, #p2154007# stops functioning. To save him, you need the new heart that #p2154003# made. Go to #b#m310050100##k and see #b#p2154003##k.

#p2154003# gave you the heart that he made with his own two hands. He says it lacks energy, because it wasn't made by #p2154009#. Due to its insufficient energy efficiency, you need to take it to #b#p2154007##k after charging enough energy. Like an Energy Cartridge, #bthe energy seems to charge when you hunt monsters#k.
After receiving a new heart, #p2154007# opened his eyes. The #o8105003# siblings, who can't feel any emotions, truly had a strong sibling bond.

string.name: name
string.value: I Think There's a Burglar
Something must have happened to #bResearcher #p2154011##k in #b#m310060000##k in the Mine. Talk to #p2154011#.

#p2154011# says thieves took his research results, and he wants you to eliminate the culprit, #r#o8105000##k. From what you can gather, it doesn't seem like #p2154011# agrees with #p2154009#'s experiment...\n\n#o8105000# #r#a239691##k
You eliminated #o8105000#, which satisfied #p2154011#.

string.name: name
string.value: Can We Really Do This?
#p2154010##k #b the Lead Researcher in #m310060000# in the Mine is struggling with something.

#p2154010# is worried about the growing number of raccoons, not to mention all the other creatures #p2154009#'s experiment is putting in danger. He wants you to check what creatures have been caught by #p2154009# inside the new laboratory. Go all the way to the end of the shaft, #bwhere the raccoons are#k. \n

You found a strange creature in Mine Shaft 3 who had ores decorated on its body. When you told #p2154010#, he was surprised and exclaimed that he didn't expect a Baby Ore Muncher to be captured in there, too. An Ore Muncher is a rare creature that only lives in this shaft and is considered a mystical creature in the city...

string.name: name
string.value: Escape Plans
Since discovering that even #t4032775# was included in #p2154009#'s experiment, #b#p2154010##k is determined to do something.
#p2154010# is determined to release #t4032775# and needs your help. Find the Laboratory Key that #b#o8105001# has#k, #bopen the Laboratory door, and rescue #t4032775##k!
You delivered the #t4032775# to #p2154010#. #p2154010# seemed happy, but said it was too early for him to celebrate.

string.name: name
string.value: Erasing the Trace
Although you rescued the #t4032775#, it's not entirely over yet. You have one more thing to do. Talk to #b#p2154010##k.

#p2154010# says everything that you and he have done is probably recorded on #r#o8105001#s#k, and the records must be deleted. He says you must eliminate at least #b300#k of them to make sure all the records have been deleted from the #o8105001#s...\n\n#o8105001##r #a239721##k

You defeated all the #o8105001#s. You hope the #t4032775# will be okay now... Fortunately, #p2154010# volunteered to look after the #t4032775#. He said everything will be over if #p2154009# finds out, but he believes he can handle it on his own. He deserves a round of applause for his dedication!

string.name: name
string.value: Defeating the Broken Security System
#bAndroid #p2154012##k in #b#m310060000##k in the Mine seems to have something to say. Talk to #p2154012#.
#p2154012# wants to eliminate #o8105001#, because it is now broken and useless. Help #p2154012# defeat the #r#o8105002##k.\n\n#o8105002##r #a239731##k
You eliminated the #o8105002# with #p2154012#. But #p2154012# didn't thank you for your help at all. She really has no feelings whatsoever...

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate the Failure 1
The Black Wing mad scientist #b#p2154009##k in #m310060000# in the Mine is looking pretty unpleasant. Talk to #p2154009#.
#p2154009# says his experiments aren't going smoothly because there have been too many failure Androids. He wants you to tell #b#p2154012##k to eliminate the #o8105004#.
You told #p2154012# to eliminate the #o8105004#.

string.name: name
string.value: Eliminate the Failure 2
You delivered #b#p2154009##k's order to #p2154012#. But, #p2154012# just stood there with no expression on her face.

#p2154012# cannot eliminate the failures, because the thought of it makes her too depressed. Although #p2154012# seems to have no emotions, she cannot eliminate the #o8105004#, who is like her sibling. Help #p2154012#, and do the job for her.\n\n#o8105004##r #a239751##k
#p2154012# thanked you for your help.

string.name: name
string.value: I Need a Sample of the Cells
The Black Wing mad scientist #b#p2154009##k in #m310060000# in the Mine is obsessed with experimenting.

#p2154009# says he's so curious about the Rue creation mechanism of the #r#o8105005##k that he simply cannot stand it anymore. He wants you to find him a #b#t4032776##k. He doesn't seem like he's in his right mind... \r\n\r\n#i4032776# #t4032776# #b#c4032776# / 30
#p2154009# laughs with happiness and excitement. With this DNA Sample, cloning an Ore Muncher may be possible... You see now that #p2154009# really isn't in his right mind.

string.name: name
string.value: Council President's Order 1
Council President #bAnthony#k in #bEdelstein#k has something to tell you.
Anthony asks you to bring 10 Amethyst Ores to help develop Edelstein. You can obtain Amethyst Ore much more easily if you have Mining skill...x000D_\n\n#i4020001##t4020001# #b#c4020001# / 10#k
You brought Amethyst Ores to Anthony.

string.name: name
string.value: Council President's Order 2
Council President #bAnthony#k in #bEdelstein#k has something to tell you.

Anthony asks you to bring more resources to help develop Edelstein. He needs 2 Refined Plates. What kind of city is he running that he always needs to ask you for resources?\n\n#i4011000##t4011000# #b#c4011000# / 2#k
You brought 2 Bronze Plates to Anthony.

string.name: name
string.value: Council President's Order 3
Council President #bAnthony#k in #bEdelstein#k has something to tell you.
Anthony says the budget for Edelstein is still tight, and asks you to get a DEX Crystal for him. How is a DEX Crystal going to help the city...?\n\n#i4005002##t4005002# #b#c4005002# / 1#k
You brought a DEX Crystal to Anthony.

string.name: name
string.value: Astilda's Request
#p1033102# wants to provide music to soothe the elves in their cursed sleep. #bActivate the Muic Box in front of the library#k as #p1033102# requested.
At #p1033102#'s request, you used the Music Box outside of the library. May its music soothe your subjects as they dream...
The Black Mage's curse is freezing you along with the town of #m101050000#. You must seal the town away before the curse spreads to the outside world. Find #b#p1033102#, the Elder of Life#k, first.

string.value: Danika's Request
The Black Mage's curse is freezing you along with the town of #m101050000#. You must seal the town away before the curse spreads to the outside world. Talk to #b#p1033101#, the Elder of War#k, first.

#p1033101# warns that the #o9300422#s outside of town could disrupt the magic needed to seal the town away. She thinks you should eliminate the #r#o9300422#s#k before you do anything else. #o9300422##r #a240011##k
You eliminated the #o9300422#s. It's time to seal the town!

string.name: name
string.value: Philius's Request

The Black Mage's curse is freezing you along with the town of #m101050000#. You must seal the town away before the curse spreads to the outside world. Find #b#p1033100#, the Elder of Magic#k, to learn how.
You must activate the pentacle at the entrance of Elluel. Follow #p1033100#'s instructions by #bgoing to the west entrance to town and activating the pentacle.#k
You activated the pentacle. No one will be able to find #m101050000# now.

string.name: name
string.value: Peaceful Music
Activate the Music Box to fill the town with tranquil music.
You activated the Music Box. Peaceful music fills the town.
You activated the Music Box. Peaceful music fills the town. May your subjects have sweet dreams.

string.name: name
string.value: Barriers of Elluel
Place magical barriers around Elluel to prevent the curse from spreading. You need to create two barriers, one on the left, and one on the right side of town.
The barriers are in place. No one will enter town for at least 100 years...
The barriers are in place. No one will enter town for at least 100 years...

string.name: name
string.value: Cursed Slumber
The elders have fallen into a deep sleep. There's nothing left for you but to join them until the curse wears off...
The elders have fallen into a deep sleep. There's nothing left for you but to join them until the curse wears off...
You're awake, and snow no longer falls in Elluel! Is the curse broken? Go outside and find out what's happening.

string.name: name
string.value: The Ancient Spirit
You're finally Lv. 30, but you still can't seem to use most of your old skills. There must be a way to get them back...

In the past, you would seek out the wisdom of the #b#p1033210##k when it came time to learn new skills. You already know the skills, but you still aren't strong enough to use them. Try awakening the #p1033210# from her resting place in #b#m101050000#'s#k #b#m101050010##k.
You met the #p1033210#...

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: Monarch's Power
The #p1033210# is awake once more. Since you can't use your 2nd Advancement skills, you're worried you'll have to take the Monarch's Trial once again... Ask the #b#p1033210##k about it.

The #p1033210# is surprised by your visit. She told you about everything that's happened while you slept, and about the curse. The #p1033210# assures you that you have acted with wisdom, and that you will regain your rightful strength as ruler of the Elves.

The #p1033210# was surprised by your visit. She told you about everything that's happened while you slept, and about the curse. The #p1033210# assured you that you acted with wisdom, and that you will regain your rightful strength as ruler of the Elves. You won't have to go to her again to unlock your Job Advancements, because you already proved yourself worthy long ago.

string.value: [Job Advancement]
