string.value: Mercedes's 3rd Job Advancement

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
With the #p1033210#'s blessing, you've unlocked more of your power at Lv. 60.

string.name: name
string.value: Mercedes's 4th Job Advancement

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
With the #p1033210#'s blessing, you've unlocked more of your power at Lv. 100.

string.name: name
string.value: Elven Noble
The Great Spirit restored some of your old powers. See the Great Spirit in Elluel to discuss your progress.
The Great Spirit gave you the Elven Noble medal.
The Great Spirit gave you the Elven Noble medal.

string.name: name
string.value: Elven Hero
The Great Spirit restored some of your old powers. See the Great Spirit in Elluel to discuss your progress.
The Great Spirit gave you the Elven Hero medal.
The Great Spirit gave you the Elven Hero medal.

string.name: name
string.value: The Unfinished Battle
The #p1033210# calls to you. The spirit never contacted you directly before. Did something happen?
The #p1033210# congratulates you on regaining your old strength, and wants you to meet her face-to-face in town.

You've regained your full strength. All that remains is for you to defeat the Black Mage and free the elves from their curse. You promised to the #p1033210# that you would do everything in your power to save your people.

string.name: name
string.value: Elluel's Visitor
#p1033100#, the Elder of Magic in #m101050000#, needs to see you. Did something happen in town?
#p1033100# says an old friend has come to town, and wants to see you in #m101050000#. A visitor waiting for the Elven Monarch... Who could it be?
A friend of yours from centuries ago, a Pegasus, came to town to meet you.

string.name: name
string.value: Friend of the Monarch
Your old friend, the Pegasus #p1033240#, is back. She's been through many hardships.
After the Pegasus was set free from Elluel, she was hurt by the Black Mage. #p1033240# looks like she's starving. Give her some food.
#p1033240# rested up. Even if you tried to send her away, she'd never leave your side again. Even if the Black Mage returned, she'd go into battle with you.
Why are the Elves still cursed? The Curse of the Black Mage should have worn off by now! Yet you're the only one who's woken up. You need to think about this very carefully...
Nothing is making any sense. If the curse is still around, why did you wake up? And all by yourself? Maybe it's time you #bleave #m101050000# and see what's happening in Maple World.#k

Just as you were about to leave Elluel, you realized that you're only Lv. 10! Did the Curse of the Black Mage do that to you? And what are you going to do? You can't survive the vicious slimes outside in this state!

string.name: name
string.value: Aftermath of the Curse
It doesn't add up. You're awake, but the Curse of the Black Mage is still affecting the Elves, and for some reason your level is really low.
Your low level must be a side effect of the Black Mage's Curse. You were in that ice cube for so long... You might be on the verge of death! Check your #bstatus#k, quickly!
Aside from being Lv. 10, you were fine. Your injuries from fighting the Black Mage were all gone, and you still had the ability to level up.

string.name: name
string.value: Back to Elf School 1
Aside from losing all your levels, you seem to be okay. The only way for you to get your old strength is to train like crazy. Unfair!

This is no time to feel sorry for yourself. You need to get out of Elluel and make sure Maple World is okay. But first, you need to #btrain#k, just like when you were little... #o9300423##r #a240421##k
You eliminated Leaf Dummies and gained some experience. Still...what would your subjects think if they saw you like this?

string.name: name
string.value: Back to Elf School 2
Even if it's embarrassing, you must train as hard as you can to get your old strength back. Even destroying Leaf Dummies helped you get a little stronger.

You're still not strong enough! Remember, those #bLv. 50 Slimes that hang around outside of town#k are tough. If you want to beat them, you have to reach Lv. 50 yourself. For now, eliminate Sprout Dummies. #o9300424##r #a240431##k
You eliminated the Sprout Dummies. It's a good thing your adoring subjects weren't there to see you fighting such weak training dummies.

string.name: name
string.value: Back to Elf School 3
By buckling down and working hard you reached Lv. 13! You can do this! At this rate it will only take you...a million years...to reach your original level!
Eliminate #rFlower Dummies#k until you're strong enough to face the #o0210100#s. You can do this! Your people are counting on you! #o9300425##r #a240441##k

You've gotten a little stronger. There's a saying: 'A journey of a thousand miles begins with the first step.' Such an inspirational proverb made you realize...by the time you reach your old level, you'll be dead of old age!

string.name: name
string.value: Into the World
You can't take this training anymore! Maybe you're not ready to fight the fearsome #o0210100#s yet, but who cares? #bJust go outside already#k!
Enough training! Time to go into the world outside. If you can't handle the #o0210100#s, you can always run away. So for now, give those #r#o0210100#s#k your best shot. #o0210100##r #a240451##k
The #o0210100#s were Lv. 50 before you were cursed. It hasn't been THAT long since you fought the Black Mage, could it?

string.name: name
string.value: Foreign World
Those #o0210100#s were too weak. Maybe you were sleeping longer than you thought... You need to find out what else has changed.
The forest has changed. Things seem more peaceful, and there are signs of civilization here and there. If you follow these signs, the bridges, the buildings, perhaps you can #bfind a town#b.
You'd never seen buildings like that before. It seemed like the Elves' town, but its people were no Elves you'd ever seen. The name of the town seemed to be #m101000000#.

string.name: name
string.value: After Centuries 1
A town like this couldn't spring up overnight. How many years have passed? Will the people here even understand your language?
You recognize the people of this town as Sylphs, one of the younger races of Fairies. Perhaps that #bboy with silver hair#k can tell you what's going on.
#p1032106# wasn't very friendly. At any rate, you learned that you were asleep for centuries. Furthermore, #p1032106# says that the Elves disappeared long, long ago...

string.name: name
string.value: After Centuries 2
Is #b#p1032106##k trying to trick you? There's no way it's been hundreds of years! Ask him again.
#p1032106# is getting annoyed at you. Maybe another Fairy can help you. Visit #b#p1032100##k.
#p1032100# didn't know anything about Elves. If hundreds of years have passed, how did you survive that long, trapped in the ice?

string.name: name
string.value: After Centuries 3

Your battle with the Black Mage feels like it happened yesterday, but today people don't even remember that Elves existed. It can't be. Maybe this is all a trick of the Black Mage's! Ask #bArwen#k for help.

#p1032100# says you don't look so good. She suggests visiting #b#p1032101##k if you're sick. Rowen's healing magic is supposed to be strong, but you still can't believe what Arwen's saying. Ask Rowen about this era for now.
You really were asleep for hundreds of years. But why were you the only Elf to awaken?

string.name: name
string.value: The Changed World
After talking to 3 different Fairies, you're convinced that centuries really have passed.
#p1032101# is worried you're sick. Go to #b#m101010000##k and ask #p1032112# for a cup of Clear Tree Sap. You may not really be ill, but maybe it'll help calm your nerves.

Your battle against the Black Mage is ancient history, and your people are still cursed with eternal sleep. Even if you knew what to do, you're still too weak to do anything about it. Even though you beat him, did the Black Mage win after all?

string.name: name
string.value: The Decision
Maybe #p1032112# is right. The Black Mage is gone, and now you're just a weak, silly Elf... You need to think things over.

You are the sovereign of the Elves! It's YOUR people who are suffering under the Black Mage's Curse! #bYou can't give up now!#k You may be weak, but you'll get stronger. You may not have allies, but you'll make them. Who cares of nobody remembers who you are? Your only duty is to save your people. That's enough!

You are the sovereign of the Elves! It's YOUR people who are suffering under the Black Mage's Curse! #bYou can't give up now!#k You may be weak, but you'll get stronger. You may not have allies, but you'll make them. Who cares of nobody remembers who you are? Your only duty is to save your people. That's enough!

string.name: name
string.value: Royal Errands

Your path is set. Gain experience, increase your level, and save your people from their terrible curse! First thing you need to do is learn more about the new Maple World. #b#p1032112##k might know a thing or two that will help you out.

#p1032112# says that #b#p1032104##k in #b#m101000000##k is looking for someone to do errands for her. Maybe it's beneath you, the high and mighty ruler of the Elves, but it's all you can do for now. Go see #p1032104#.
#p103214# needed an assistant, and gave you the job. From monarch to errand monkey... Life is strange, isn't it?

string.name: name
string.value: Betty's Request 1
Luckily, #b#p1032104##k is much nicer than #p1032112#. Try working as her assistant.

#p1032104# is looking for #r#o2230100##k cell samples. In the old days, those monsters were strong, but you're guessing that they've gotten weak, like the #o0210100#s. #i4032959# #t4032959# #b#c4032959##k/20
You gave #p1032104# some #t4032959#s.

string.name: name
string.value: Betty's Request 2
#b#p1032104##k has another errand for you.
This time, #p1032104# wants you to gather #b#t4032960#s#k. #o3230100#s? You've never heard of them before, but they probably won't be hard to eliminate. #i4032960# #t4032960# #b#c4032960##k/20
You brought #p1032104# her #t4032960#s. She asked you which came first: #o2230100#s or #o3230100#s. Since you'd never seen #o3230100#s before, it was obvious that #o3230100#s came later.

string.name: name
string.value: Betty's Request 3
Of course #o3230100#s came after #o2230100#, but for some reason, #b#p1032104##k is very interested in this fact. She's intent on finding out if it's true or not.

#p1032104# believes that some #o2230100#s left their caves and at the plants outside, making them turn green and eventually turning them into #o3230100#s. #p1032104# told you to collect #bsamples#k from the #bGreen Plants#k around #m101000000#. She says you have to use #bnormal attacks#k to take the plants down, and that they look like this: #i4032206#. #i4032961# #t4032961# #b#c4032961##k/5

You gave the #t4032961#s to #p1032104#. She said she'd research why #t4032961#s have such a strong effect on #o2230100#s. You don't know why she cared so much, but it felt good to help people in need.

string.name: name
string.value: Betty's Teacher
#b#p1032104##k is looking for you again. What could she want this time?

#p1032104# says her old teacher, #b#p1022006##k, is looking for help. But you've never heard of #b#m102020400##k, and have no clue where #b#m102000000##k. You hear you can take a #bTaxi#k, but...what's a Taxi?

string.name: name
string.value: Winston's Request 1
You met #p1022006#, #b#p1032104##k's teacher, at #m102000000#. He wants your help. Could be a good way to gain some experience...

#p1022006# wants to know if a fossil he just uncovered is related to the #r#o4230400#s#k. He needs you to collect some #b#t4032962#s#k. It shouldn't be a problem for someone who took down the Black Mage, right? #i4032962# #t4032962# #b#c4032962##k/50
You gave the #t4032962#s to #p1022006#. He was deeply moved by your sheer awesomeness.

string.name: name
string.value: Winston's Request 2
#b#p1022006##k is done with his research. Find out what he uncovered.

The fossils are much bigger than the #t4032962#s, but they're definitely related. #p1022006# needs to get his hands on some historical records to see if they wore armor or not. The #t4032963# at the #m101050000# Library#k might help sort it out. Use your Elven Blessing skill to go there, then take the #bMysterious Portal#k back. #i4032963# #t4032963# #b#c4032963##k/1
#p1022006# was delighted to get his hands on a copy of the #t4032963#.

string.name: name
string.value: Betty's Friend
#b#p1032104##k back in #m101000000# is in urgent need of your help. Aren't you popular? Head back to #b#m101000000##k.

#p1032104# thanks you for all the help you gave #p1022006#, and says that another scholar could use your incredible errand-running abilities. She wants you to help #b#p1012111##k in #b#m100000000##k with his important research on mushrooms.
In your day, #m100000000# was a tiny village surrounded by vast mushroom fields. Now #m100000000# is a major city... You came there to help #p1012111# with his important research on mushrooms.

string.name: name
string.value: Bruce's Request 1
Ask #b#p1012111##k how you can help him.

#p1012111# ordered a rare spore from #m220000000#, but it was delivered to a #o5130101# by mistake. He wants you to eliminate #r#o5130101##k until you can find his #b#t4032964##k. #i4032964# #t4032964# #b#c4032964##k/1
You delivered the #t4032964# to #p1012111#.

string.name: name
string.value: Bruce's Request 2

#b#p1012111##k wants you to help him research the ancient mushroom spore you retrieved for him. He thinks it came from a mushroom that lived hundreds of years ago. It must be the Mossy Mushrooms from back in your day! Try getting #bMossy Mushroom Spore#k for him.

#p1012111# agrees that #b#t4032966##k must be the answer. He wants you to find a fresh #t4032966# for him. He warns you that it comes from a powerful monster, but with your newfound strength, it shouldn't be too hard. #i4032966# #t4032966# #b#c4032936##k/1

You brought the #t4032966# to #p1012111#. Determined to find the similarities between Zombie Mushmoms and ancient mushrooms, #p1012111# went back to his research. The scholars of #m101000000#, #m102000000#, and #m100000000# were all fired up thanks to you.

string.name: name
string.value: Philius's Call
You hear a voice calling to you. A gentle, sing-songy voice... Could it be... #p1033100#?
#b#p1033100##k, who was trapped by the Black Mage's Curse, is awake. Return to #b#m101050000##k and check on #p1033100#.

#p1033100# said that the Curse of the Black Mage hadn't been lifted yet, and thought that you were able to wake up because of your royal blood. Since you and #p1033100# were connected, he was able to wake up when you became more powerful.

string.name: name
string.value: Danika's Call
Another voice is calling to you. Did someone else break free of the curse?
The Elder of War #b#p1033101##k is awake. Even though she's weak from her long slumber, #p1033101# is as energetic as ever. At least the curse didn't hurt #p1033101#.
The Elder of War #b#p1033101##k is awake. Even though she's weak from her long slumber, #p1033101# is as energetic as ever. At least the curse didn't hurt #p1033101#.

string.name: name
string.value: Astilda's Call
#p1033101# is awake, but what about #b#p1033102##k? Check on her.

The Elder of Life, #b#p1033102##k, is awake. #p1033102# is the oldest elder, but she seems okay. It would probably take more than being frozen in ice for centuries to slow #p1033102# down. At least all the elders are awake again!

The Elder of Life, #b#p1033102##k, is awake. #p1033102# is the oldest elder, but she seems okay. It would probably take more than being frozen in ice for centuries to slow #p1033102# down. At least all the elders are awake again!

string.name: name
string.value: The Elven Court
The #bthree Elven Elders#k have awakened: the wise #p1033100#, the energetic #p1033101#, and the serene #p1033102#... With their power combined, you just might be able to break the curse!
#p1033100#, #p1033101#, and #p1033102# tried casting the #bRite of Snow#k to break the curse, but nothing happened. Maybe #p1033100# knows why it didn't work.

#p1033100# said they might still be too weak to lift the curse, but worried that there may be something else going on and went to investigate. #p1033101# and #p1033102# decided to stay behind and tend to the sleeping Elves.

string.name: name
string.value: Cursed Elves
#p1033100# is calling to you. Perhaps he learned why the Rite of Snow failed?
#p1033100# has important information about the Rite of Snow and the curse. Meet him in #b#m101050000##k.

#p1033100# told you that the Black Mage's power is growing. Either the seal holding him back has broken, or it is weakening. MapleStory is in danger, but you're not strong enough to face the Black Mage alone...

string.name: name
string.value: Mistelteinn's Guardian
How could the Black Mage break the seal you and your allies fought so hard to place on him? Maple World is in danger!

Maple World is in danger, and you need allies. #p1033100# mentioned a name you forgot long ago: #p1012100#, the young girl in charge of protecting the treasure of the Elves. She escaped before the battle against the Black Mage, and might still be alive. Maybe #b#p1032104##k has heard of her.
You've decided to ask around about #p1012100#. She probably didn't survive the Black Mage, but you don't have many other options...

string.name: name
string.value: In Search of Athena Pierce
Ask around about #p1012100#. It's doubtful anyone in Maple World know about her, but it doesn't hurt to try. Start with #b#p1032104##k.

#p1032104# knows about #p1012100#! Apparently #p1012100# is the famous Bowman Job Instructor of #b#m100000000#! To think, that young girl is more well known than you? Little matter, you should go see her right away!
After hundreds of years, you were reunited with #p1012100#. In your memory she was a whiny brat, but now she seemed even more mature than you.

string.name: name
string.value: Memories of the Past
The Elven fountainhead... Coming here brings back memories of a peaceful time, before the Black Mage...
Athena Pierce was bright, but she was just a kid. A kid who didn't always know what to do or how to act around her elders...
Athena Pierce was bright, but she was just a kid. A kid who didn't always know what to do or how to act around her elders... And now she's a Bowman Job Instructor, beloved by everyone. Unbelievable.

string.name: name
string.value: The Reunion
#p1012100# is crying, just like when she was a child. She's gone through these hundreds of years all by herself...
Comfort #p1012100#.
You calmed #p1012100# down.

string.name: name
string.value: Assailant 1
Now that #b#p1012100##k's calmed down, ask her about what's happened in the last few centuries and tell her about the Elves.

#p1012100# tells you about the world: Rumors of the Black Mage's resurrection, his servants the Black Wings, the Cygnus Knights, the return of Aran without his memories... But right now, #p1012100# just wants to go to #b#m101050000##k...
As soon as you stepped outside, you were attacked by a young boy wearing a robe. #p1012100# told you he's a Black Wing henchman and that he was eavesdropping on the conversation.

string.name: name
string.value: Assailant 2
You were attacked by one of the Black Wings, an organization bent on reviving the Black Mage. Ask #b#p1012100##k what's going on.

#p1012100# suspects the Black Wings spy on her from time to time, but this is the first time they've attacked. They must have wanted to take #bMistelteinn#k! Now that they've failed, they're probably on their way to #b#m101050000##k. You must get back and protect your home!
You made it back in time to stop their attack. Thankfully, no one was hurt in the battle.

string.name: name
string.value: A New Alliance
The village was attacked, but no one was hurt. See if #b#p1012100##k can tell you anything about the attack.

#p1012100# is certain the Black Wings know about #m101050000#. If you don't protect the village, they'll come again to try and steal Mistelteinn. Athena will write a letter of introduction, so she suggests you #bask the Cygnus Knights for their support.#k Take the letter to #b#m130000000##k and meet with #b#p1101002##k.
It was the first time you'd ever seen #m130000000# NOT in ruins...
#p1101002# says he will introduce you to #bEmpress #p1101000##k. What kind of leader is she, you wonder...

You were expecting a powerful, charismatic woman, but the empress of #m130000000# is a young, frail girl. Is this really the leader of the Cygnus Knights? How will she stand against the Black Mage? Ask #b#p1101002##k about her.
#p1101002# insisted that #p110100# is a strong, wise empress, in spite of her youth.

string.name: name
string.value: New Enemies and New Friends
The child empress, #p1101000#, has much on her shoulders, but she's not the only one.

First #p1033100# feared that the Black Mage was coming back, and #p1012100# confirmed that there were signs of his return. You made a new friend in the Cygnus Knights, but now you have to fight the Black Wings as well. At the end of the day, your mission is the same: Grow strong enough to release your people from their curse. You just have defeat the Black Mage while you're at it. Easy, right? Let #b#p1012100##k know that you've joined forces with #p1101000#. That will put her mind at ease.
You learned that you will have to fight the Black Mage again, but your first responsibility is to your people. As the monarch of the Elves, you must grow strong enough until you can lift their curse.

string.name: name
string.value: Astilda's Call 2
#p1033100# is calling to you. Did something happen in #m101050000#?
It looks like #b#p1033102##k asked #p1033100# to call you back to #m101050000#. Did something happen to the villagers?
#p1033102# told you that someone's poisoned the water. Only #t4032967# flows through #m101050000#. How could this happen?

string.name: name
string.value: Dirty Tactics
#p1033102# says that the water of #m101050000# has been poisoned. How did this happen? Talk to #b#p1033102##k.
Something must have happened to the #bfountainhead#k to taint the village water supply. Go check it out.
The Black Wings were responsible for poisoning the village water. You had to defeat them and add more security to the fountainhead to prevent this from happening again.

string.name: name
string.value: In Search of Clean Water
You drove off the Black Wings, and #t4032967# should flow through the village once again. Check in with #p1033102#.

Even with the Black Wings gone, the water won't return to normal overnight. #p1033102# worries that there won't be enough #b#t4032967##k to drink. There must be somehwere in #m101000000# to get clean water. Perhaps if you looked #bup high#k... #i4032967# #t4032967# #b#c4032967##k/1
You delivered clean water to #p1033102#. The village should have enough water to drink for a while.

string.name: name
string.value: The Challenge
You received a strange letter. What is it? Could it be...a love letter?

The mysterious letter is actually a challenge. Someone wants to fight Mercedes, legendary hero and sovereign of the Elves. Hurry over to #b#m105040300##k. #rYou must enter Sleepywood through the portal at the Six Path Crossway to proceed.
You defeated a man in a bamboo hat. Who was he? How did he know you? And who was he talking about? Maybe #p1012100# knows something about this.

string.name: name
string.value: The So-called Black Wings
You beat a mysterious stranger in a duel, but something he said is bugging you. Ask #b#p1012100##k if she knows anything about it.

After hearing the mysterious stranger's description, #p1012100# thinks he was with the #rBlack Wings#k. Still, he sounded like he's known about you a long time, and the Black Wings only just found out about you. What else could this man know? Maybe you should investigate #m105040300# and see what turns up. #b#p1061019##k seems to have sharp eyes for these things, so try asking him.
You met with #p1061019# in #m105040300# and asked if he'd seen the mysterious stranger. He had.

string.name: name
string.value: Wild Goose Chase
#b#p1061019##k in #b#m105040300##k says he's seen the mysterious stranger before. Find out more.
According to #p106109#, the mysterious stranger spent some time hunting #o6130100#s. Maybe if you hunt some yourself, you can find a clue. #bIf you do, brinng it to #p1012100##k.

You showed the document you got from the #o6130100#s to #p1012100#. It sounded like someone had a grudge against you. Maybe such a thing could have existed hundreds of years ago, but who could have a grudge against you in the present day?

string.name: name
string.value: Athena's Letter
You have a letter from #p1012100#.
According to #p1033226#, someone at the #m220000000# #bclocktower entrance#k who knows how to wake up the Elves. This is your chance to free your people!
You met #p1033227# in the #m220000000# clocktower basement. Is this the man who can save the Elves?

string.name: name
string.value: Audish's Request
You met with #p1033227#, the man mentioned in #p1033226#. Can he really save the Elves?

#p1033227# wants you to prove you're skilled enough to handle the information you want. You have to go deep inside the clocktower to prove your worthiness. What kind of wacky test is this? #o4230112##r #a240831##k
You eliminated the #o4230112#s as #p1033227# asked. He looked strangely satisfied after you did his bidding...

string.name: name
string.value: In Search of the Flame
You eliminated the #o4230112#s and proved yourself to #p1033227#. Is he satisfied now? Only one way to find out!
#p1033227# says the Flame of Revival can remove any curse. Hurry to the #bsecret entrance#k he spoke of. It should be in #b#m220040100##k.
There was no Flame of Revival. It was a Black Wing ambush! #p1033227# is nowhere to be found. It was all a trick!
Instead of finding the Flame of Revival, you were ambushed by the Black Wings. On top of that, #p1033227# is nowhere to be found. What's going on here?
#p1033227# must have sent you into a trap. But isn't #p1012100# the one who sent you to him? It's time you had a little chat with her!
#p1012100# said she never sent you a letter... Was it all the Black Wings doing? It was too perfect. They knew exactly how to draw you into their ambush.
#p1033107#, the leader of the Cygnus Knights protecting the village, needs to see you.
#p1033107# wants to know what you did with the #rkid you took from the village a few days ago#k. Kid? What's he talking about? You should return to #b#m101050000##k and find out what's happening.
Someone who looks like you came to the village and took a kid. This must be the Black Wings! Hurry over to Edelstein.

string.name: name
string.value: The Threat
Someone impersonating you took a kid from the village. This sounds like the Black Wings' doing!
A ransom note from the Black Wings says that if you want to get the kid back, you need to meet #bp2154002##k in Edelstein.
A letter from the Black Wings sent you to meet #p2154002# in Edelstein to save the missing kid.

string.name: name
string.value: Stolen Child 1
Meet #b#p2154002##k in #bVerne Mine#k at #bEdelstein#k. What kind of person steals a child like this?!
#p2154002# says the kid is in the #broom to the left#k. Once you have the kid back, you can show #rLe Tierre#k what you do to kidnappers...
The kid inside was a human from Edelstein, not an Elf. You sent the kid home, and #p2154002# said it was just a joke.

string.name: name
string.value: Medicine for Cutie
See the doctor in Edelstein to make sure the stolen child is okay.

#p2152004# says that the child is safe, but will need some proper medicine before she can make a full recovery. The people of Edelstein are as much victims as the Elves, so why not help them out? #i4000610# #t4000610# #b#c4000610##k/100
#p2152004# thanked you for your help.

string.name: name
string.value: Stolen Child 2
The Black Wings have shown their true colors! Confront #b#p2154002#k.
#p2154002# tells you to go through the #bPower Plant Entrance#k at #bPower Plant Security#k to the right. This time she means it. You can trust her, right?
You defeated #p1033230#, one of the Black Mage's commanders. At least the kid was okay. You should get him to the village quickly.

string.name: name
string.value: Wing Master
As you enter the Power Plant, you hear a familiar voice... It can't be!
#r#p1033230##k, one of the Black Mage's commanders, appears! How can she still be alive? There's no time for chit-chat! Defeat #p1033230#! #o9300435##r #a240911##k

#p1033230# was much weaker than you remember, but you still barely managed to defeat her. However, this was all the proof you needed that the Black Mage was coming back. Would you be able to beat him a second time?

string.name: name
string.value: Enemies and Allies
You're back at the village, and told the elders the whole story. Ask #b#p1033100##k if the kid is okay.

#p1033100# says the kid is okay. In fact, all traces of the Curse of the Black Mage are gone from the child. The Cygnus Knights are doubling their security so this doesn't happen again. If #p1033230# is back, the Black Mage won't be far behind... You should warn #b#p1012100##k about this.
#p1012100# was worried by your news, but she didn't lose any resolve.This time, all of Maple World is uniting against him. And what of your old allies? Perhaps it's time to look for Aran.

string.name: name
string.value: Arcon's Blood
Winston wants to thank you for your help.
Winston asks you to deliver an item called Arcon's Blood to Manji in Perion. It's pretty menial work, but at least it pays well.
You delivered the Arcon's Blood to Manji in Perion.

string.name: name
string.value: Cygnus's Apology
Lalich the Cygnus Knight needs to talk to you. Meet him in Elluel.
Lalich apologizes for accusing you of kidnapping the child. Neinheart wants to meet you in Ereve to apologize in person.
Neinheart apologized for any offense his knights may have caused. On behalf of Empress Cygnus, he gave you a new weapon.

string.name: name
string.value: The Knight and the Elf
Vel the Cygnus Knight has a question for you. Since he's never seen an Elven village before, he's curious. Why don't you meet him in Elluel?
Vel saw Elder of War Danika training, and wonders how old she must be to command such strength.
Vel was shocked to hear Danika's age. Elves and humans had less in common than he realized...

string.name: name
string.value: The Elf's Age
Vel wants to know Danika's age. What was her age again? Why don't you ask her?
Vel wants to know Danika's age. What was her age again? Why don't you ask her?
Danika told you she's 240 years old. Oh, to be so young!

string.name: name
string.value: Moonie's Depression
The kidnapped Elf child, Moonie, is back in town. As the ruler of the Elves, you should check on him and make sure he's okay.
Moonie is a sad Elf. His friends and teachers are frozen in ice, and he's all alone. Lift his spirits with a happy tune!
Moonie felt a lot better after you played him some music. Now, if only the other children weren't frozen in ice...
Neinheart, a member of the Cygnus Knights, speaks to you suddenly.

Empress Cygnus is on the verge of making an important decision, but she wants some advice from you, the ruler of the Elves and hero of the past. What could be so important to cause her to waver? Go to Ereve and find out.

The fate of Maple World hinges on the alliance. If each continent joins its forces, the heroes stand a chance of victory against the Black Mage. The mistakes of the past must be mended, Maple World must unite against the Black Mage!

string.name: name
string.value: A Proper Introduction
The time has finally come. I hope you're all ready.
All preparations are complete! As #p1402000# said, every hero has to take their first step. Head into #m130000000#. #bYou will only have to make it past the guards in the Knights Chamber.#k.
The plan was a complete success! An entrance worthy of the world's greatest thief!

string.name: name
string.value: The Erstwhile Vault

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
A grand entrance will get you a long way, but you're nowhere near as powerful as you once were. Not to worry, with a little practice, you'll be back on your feet in no time.

The first step is to reawaken the skills you used hundreds of years ago, when you were known as the Master Thief. That means you'll need access to your secret vault #b#m200000000# Cloud Park II#k. That's the quickest path to your 2nd Job Advancement.
The vault seems to be free of any lockpicks or trespassers. Not that anyone else could get inside. This is a vault for a true master.

string.name: name
string.value: That's So Raven

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
You managed to find your old treasure vault. Luckily, no one else made it in before you could.

The treasure vault is locked up tight and you lost the key hundreds of years ago. It's not the most eloquent solution, but it's time to break the lock! You try to forget how much it cost before you shatter it to pieces. \n\n#rTip: You cannot progress if you already destroyed the Lock. Please leave the vault and come back.

You found the 'Memoirs of Raven: Ultimate Thief Master,' a collection of lessons from your teacher. He was a world-renowned scoundrel, but he sure was full of himself.\n\nRaven often warned you, "don't try to rob a kingdom with a box full of bobby pins." You never did understand what that meant.

string.name: name
string.value: The Poor, the Rich, and the Phantom

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
With your newfound status, you've gotten the Black Wings' attention. It would be wise to learn some new skills.

This time, go to the secret vault at #b#m260000000##k. If things are as they were, you should have quite a fortune of treasures buried there from the unfortunately rich citizens of the desert. Onwards to #m260010600#!
#m260000000# hasn't changed a bit! The barren land stays barren, the poor stay poor, and the rich stay rich. What a dump.

string.name: name
string.value: The Lowdown

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
You came to #m260000000# in search of your secret vault. You may have to break another #o9001045# to get into this one. The price tag on these advancements is really racking up.
Unlike the vault in #m200000000#, the #o9001045# here is busted wide open. You found a bunch of scummy little #r#o9001046##k critters loitering around inside. It's time to wipe them out!

Your old journals have gotten you through your 3rd Job Advancement. Looking over the masses of wealth in this old vault, you feel a little nostalgic. Has it really been hundreds of years since you were here?

string.name: name
string.value: What's in a Phantom?

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
The final journals from your former master, Raven, should still be at the secret vault in #b#m240000000##k.
You arrived at the vault in #m240000000#. If you remember correctly, a powerful #o9001047# guards this one because of all the valuables. It might be difficult to make it inside.
You reached level 100. It's time to show the world why Phantom was known as the greatest thief of all time.

string.name: name
string.value: An Expensive Acquisition

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Check to see if the #o9001047# is still working.
The #o9001047# malfunctioned and attacked you! Its warranty must have expired. You'd better destroy it before it hurts someone else!
You destroyed the #o9001047# and, sure enough, the warranty was expired.

string.name: name
string.value: The Empress and the Thief
The #o9001047# has been dispatched and you made it inside your vault.
If you can find the journal you wrote laying out the techniques to surpass Raven, the 4th Job Advancement will be yours... but where is it? You seem to recall a picture frame.

You found the journal behind Aria's Portrait. Seeing her face again helped you make it through the 4th Job Advancement! You even remembered sending a warning to her long ago that you would take the treasure of #m130000000#.\n\nWho would've thought the great thief would become a hero...

string.name: name
string.value: The Truth About Skaia
#p1101000# wants to talk to you.
#p1101000# found one of Aria's old keepsakes and she thought that you should have it. Head over to #m130000000# to collect it.
#p1101000# found Aria's Diary, or at least a piece of it. Most of of it has burned away.\n\nIt wasn't easy to accept it, but you were the only person that Aria truly trusted.

string.name: name
string.value: Keep on Rolling
Traveling around Maple World these days is so... boring. Something's missing.
It must be a mount! The greatest thief of all time can't be seen hoofing about in his expensive loafers. Go ask #p1401000# about obtaining a ride.
Perfect timing! #p1401000# said he had already ordered you a nice convertible. He is the greatest manservant in the history of Maple World.

string.name: name
string.value: Transmission Failure
Your most excellent manservant, #p1401000#, has already ordered you a Mount. Keep your fingers crossed that it doesn't look silly.
#p1401000# ordered you a convertible, custom-made by the alchemists in #m261000000#, but it's not here yet. Why should you have to wait? Go see #p2111008# in #m261000000# right away!
#p2111008# seemed very surprised when you asked him about your ride.

string.name: name
string.value: The Taste of Luxury
#p2111008# started acting really weird when he saw the Order Request.
#p2111008# managed to break the most important part of your convertible, the Lidium Engine, and he doesn't make nearly enough money to pay for it.
You gave 10 million Mesos to #p2111008# and got yourself a sweet convertible. Kind of costly, but it looks so AWESOME!

string.name: name
string.value: High Rolling
You made it to level 200. Finally, you've returned to your former power.
You need a new car! The greatest thief in the multiverse can't show up in the same car from Level 100! Preposterous! #p1401000# will certainly understand!
#p1401000# already has a car ordered for you. That manservant really knows his master's heart in and out!

string.name: name
string.value: Lumiere Light Show
Your plan to drive Hilla away from #m130000000# was relatively successful.

Though your abilities are not anywhere near what they used to be, the #rfake skill effect show#K produced by #p1401000# and the rest of the #m150000000# crew was rather effective in driving Hilla off. You should go talk to #b#p1401000##k to say thanks.
#p1401000# scolded you for putting on such a big production, but he's just being an old codger. The greatest thief of all time should make an entrance!

string.name: name
string.value: A Fine Piece of Bluffery
#p1401000# is so strict. How could he expect the greatest thief ever to exist wouldn't show a little bit of pizazz after hundreds of years away?
However, #p1401000# may have a point. You are far too weak to battle any of the Black Mage's minions at this point. You need to do some training!\n\n#o1210102##r #a254011##k
When did the #o1210102# become such a tough beast? You used to be so tough!

string.name: name
string.value: Cash for Levels
All those sweet levels, lost to the treachery of the Black Mage. If only there were an easier way...
#p1401000# had just the thing. A container, not of liquid or gas, but of... EXP! This new Maple World technology is great! #bOpen it now#k!
You got a quick level up to... level 18?! Wait, you were supposed to go to 70!

string.name: name
string.value: There's a Limit to Everything
You reached level 18 with the power of money! It's not a lot, but it's better than being level 10.
A little monster hunting would do you good. Return to the #bTraining Center#k after you assign all of your new Skill Points.\n\n#o1140100##r #a254031##k
It was simple enough to remaster the skills you had... if only you could get stronger without all the work!
Leveling is important, but you have other matters to take care of. Talk to #p1401000# to see what else you have on your schedule.
#p1401000# mentioned that #b#p1401001##k wanted you to drop by. You remember asking her to collect some intelligence on the present-day Black Wings.
#p1401001# seems to be very excited about a new scheme she came up with to gather intel from the Black Wings.

string.name: name
string.value: Impeccable Disguise
A new source of intel on the Black Wings... things are looking up!

#p1401001# discovered that the Black Wings have been allowing someone near #m310000000# to sell a #bBlack Wings Hat#k under their noses. This might be the perfect opportunity for a little infiltration!
If you put on a Black Wings Hat and act like you're better than everybody else, they shouldn't notice that you aren't actually one of them. Head down to #m310000000# and get your disguise.

string.name: name
string.value: The Black Heart of Edelstein
The Black Wings Hat is in your hands.
You can get stronger while you spy on the Black Wings. Have #b#p1400003##k maneuver the #m150000000# into position near #b#m310000000##k.
If things get dangerous, get back to the #m150000000# right away. Until then, find out everything you can about the Black Wings.

string.name: name
string.value: Who Watches the Watchmen?
It's time to disembark from the #m150000000# and investigate the Black Wings in #m310000000#. Don't forget the hat that #p1401001# gave you...

#m310000000# had three Black Wings watchmen: Watchman #p2152017#, Watchman #p2152018#, and Watchman #p2152016#. Watchman #p2152016# is the highest ranking member, #p2152017# the lowest. #bInvestigate from the lowest rank up#k. #bPut on the Black Wings Hat first#k.

#y25408# #b(#u25408#)#k
#y25409# #b(#u25409#)#k
#y25410# #b(#u25410#)#k
#y25411# #b(#u25411#)#k
Your investigation revealed that the watchmen don't actually do anything in #m310000000#, they just keep an eye out. You'll have to look elsewhere to find the big fish.

string.name: name
string.value: Leonore the Watchman
Go see #b#p2152017##k in disguise as a Black Wings member and get some information.
Watchman #p2152017# lost a ring. You won't get her attention until she finds it. It's a bit of a pain, but go find the #bring#k for #r#o1150000##k.\n\n#i4033121# #t4033121# #b#c4033121# / 1#k
#p2152017# said she joined the Black Wings to get away from loan sharks. Her job is to analyze #o1150000# recordings. It didn't look like she was doing a great job though.

string.name: name
string.value: Wonny the Watchman 1
Go see #b#p2152018##k in disguise as a Black Wings member and get some information.

#p2152018#'s job is to make sure everything in town is running smoothly. He doesn't seem to like the job at all, but he might have information. He wants to get #bOfficer #p2152003##k to eliminate some of the #o1150001# population.
You told Officer #p2152003# what #p2152018# said.

string.name: name
string.value: Wonny the Watchman 2
Go tell #b#p2152003##k about the sign situation, as #p2152018# ordered.
#p2152003# said she was scared of the #rsigns#k. Looks like you'll have to get your hands dirty, but her sudden unwillingness is a little strange... \n\n#o1150001##r #a254101##k
According to #p2152003#, #p2152018# was a good man until the Black Wings took his girlfriend. He had no choice but to cooperate with them and do whatever they asked.

string.name: name
string.value: Bavan the Watchman
Go talk to #b#p2152016##k in disguise as a Black Wings member and get some info.
#p2152016#'s job is to supervise the other watchmen in town, but he has higher ambitions. Go get the item he wants.\n\n#i4033122# #t4033122# #b#c4033122# / 1#k
#p2152016# really wants the money and power that come with being a Black Wings officer, but he doesn't actually seem to understand what it would entail.

string.name: name
string.value: The Outsider
The town watchmen were entertaining, but hardly insightful. You're going to have to look higher up the food chain. Get some information from #b#p2152016##k.
There is another watchman named #b#p2153000##k #boutside of town#k, who's known to take supplies for himself. Could he be the one selling hats?
You met with #p2153000#, a Black Wings watchman.

string.name: name
string.value: Stephan the Watchman
#b#p2153000##k, the watchman with sharp eyes. Maybe he knows something about the Black Wing leadership.

#p2153000# really does steal supplies! He's no master thief, but he gets the job done. And boy does he love money! You could try a bribe, but he'll get suspicious. Instead, go eliminate some #r#o2150003##k machines and bring the #b#t4033123##k items they carry.\n\n#i4033123# #t4033123# #b#c4033123# / 40#k
According to #p2153000#, the Black Wings officers are outside of #m310000000# trying to collect something from the mine nearby.

string.name: name
string.value: The Suspicious Secretary
You should break down all the information you got from #p2153000#.

First, the watchmen are unimportant. They have no idea what the Black Wings are doing.

Second, the Black Wing officers are all over Maple World collecting resources, though it's more likely they are after Seal Stones.

Third, the founder of the Black Wings is collecting an incredible amount of energy from the mine nearby. 

You're on a wild goose chase unless you can find something more substantial. Follow your nose to Secretary #b#p2154002##k, but be careful.
Secretary #p2154002# was a beautiful lady with auburn hair and a sweet voice, but there's something very dangerous about her...

string.name: name
string.value: Le Tierre's Test
You're going to have to build up your reputation with #b#p2154002##k before you get any further with her.

#p2154002# wants you to prove your loyalty to the Black Wings. Eliminate #r#o3150000##k machines, and she will give you a recommendation. It seems a bit too easy, but there's no turning back now!\n\n#o3150000##r #a254151##k
#p2154002# is acting very satisfied at the outcome... why is that?

string.name: name
string.value: The Sneakiest Secretary
#b#p2154002##k looked a little too happy...

#p2154002# said she was willing to introduce you to one of the officers. She also said you would get promoted if they liked you. That seems fishy, but this may speed this whole process up! #bJust go in, even if it's a trap#k.
It was a trap. It's not certain how she figured out you were an impostor, but your time sneaking around #m310000000# is over.

string.name: name
string.value: Circling Around
You got some information from #m310000000#, but it wasn't that much of a gain... How regrettable.
Bring the intel you gathered from the people of #m310000000# back to #b#p1401001##k for processing.
#p1401001# has a theory that the Black Wing officers have never shown themselves to the lower-ranking members. It would explain the disconnect.

string.name: name
string.value: Colette the Intelligence Collector
#p1401001# has some good theories, but it's time to let her work. Get over to #b#p1401002##k to see what she's procured.
#p1401002# paid off an intelligence broker named #p1002104#. Head down to #m104000000# on #bVictoria Island#k to collect.
You met Information Dealer #p1002104# in #m104000000#, but you're not sure you can trust him just yet.

string.name: name
string.value: An Order of Black Wings
#b#p1002104# in #m104000000##k is a little bit starstruck, but he seems to have some good information.
This is the perfect opportunity to meet one of the Black Wings officers. Go to #b#m100040000##k and see #p1404000# to find out how much he knows about the Black Mage.
You met #o9300500# #p1404000# and it did not go well. What a creep!

string.name: name
string.value: Cut the Strings
#p1404000# piled up a lot of grudges, but he seems harmless.
Negotiations have broken down. Treat him to a little of the old-fashioned Phantom charm. \n\n#rTip: If you can't defeat Francis, forfeit the quest and do it again.
You almost had #p1404000# listening, but then he started CRYING. You might have overdone it a bit.

string.name: name
string.value: Francis Spills the Beans
#p1404000# is crying like a baby. This could slow down your information gathering efforts.
Bring #t4033124# items to help fix #p1404000#'s puppet. Maybe it will make him stop crying. At least the #rGolems#k you have to fight won't be crying.\n\n#i4033124# #t4033124# #b#c4033124# / 50#k

#p1404000# finally stopped crying long enough to talk. The Black Wings officers are attempting to bring back the Black Mage... and #m310000000# is their main source of energy. It still doesn't explain the Seal Stones though...

string.name: name
string.value: Like Pulling Strings
#o9300500# seems to think that he needs all of the Seal Stones to bring back the Black Mage. It doesn't make any sense. Where could that information be coming from?

#p1404000# refuses to talk any more about the leader of the Black Wings, but it's not your style to let a man walk away with something you want. Make him tell you what he knows.\n\n#rTip: If you can't defeat Francis, forfeit the quest and do it again.
The leader of the Black Wings is Orchid. It's odd. She's not really the type to use her head. Maybe she's in league with #p1404005#. Either way, it doesn't appear #p1404000# knows anything about her.

string.name: name
string.value: An Upset Puppet
#p1404000# wept like a small child, once again. He seems to be out of information, but you just can't resist poking fun at him a little longer.

For now, get some more #b#t4033124##k items from the #rGolems#k and calm #o9300500# down. It's the least you can do for all the fun he gave you.


#i4033137# #t4033137# #b#c4033137# / 70#k
#p1404000# said that the Black Mage was going to give him #m220000000# when Maple World fell to his rule. He's either delusional, or incredibly stupid.

string.name: name
string.value: Sealed Knowledge
The Black Wings seem to know nothing about the motivations of the Black Mage.

#bThe point of creating the Seal Stones was to provide a way to turn back the clock if anything bad happened.#k When the heroes discovered the Black Mage's plans to destroy Maple World, they set about to create the Seal Stones to stop him. 

#p1404000# didn't seem to know about the Black Mage's plans to destroy the world. Maybe the Black Wings are just being used.

Either way, the Seal Stone of Victoria Island is not safe. It would be best to hurry back to #b#p1002104##k with the news!
You told #p1002104# everything you learned from #p1404000#.

string.name: name
string.value: Information Analysis
You gave information to #p1002104# too. The only thing left is...
Share the information you obtained from #p1404000# with #b#p1401001##k on the #b#m150000000##k.
It's possible the Black Wings don't realize that they're being used. If you could convince them that their actions will lead to their demise, they might turn against the Black Mage. Maybe...

string.name: name
string.value: Rushing to Rien
#p1002104# contacted you again.
Suspicious people visited #bRien#k. She could be in danger if it was the Black Wings. #p1002104# said #p1404002# was rushing to the island, but you may get there faster!
Stopping the Black Wings with #p1404002#'s help was a cinch. You also met up with #p1404001# while you were there.

string.name: name
string.value: A Nagging Doubt
The Seal Stone and #p1404001# are both safe. Your idea of a damsel-in-distress went out the window when you met her. She's one tough cookie!

#p1404001# asked about something strange she noticed when researching the heroes of the past. #bShe thought it was weird that the heroes who saved Maple World were forgotten so completely.#k. 

It does seem odd. Board the #m150000000# and ask #p1401002# to collect information on the heroes of your time.
You asked #p1401002# to study the heroes of the past. Prior to the alliance, how many people knew about the heroes?

string.name: name
string.value: An Ancient Set of Memories
#b#p1401002##k has something else for you. Maybe she found something about the people who have been tampering with historical records.
Information on the heroes is scarce at best. You were told to ask someone at #b#m211000000##k who has lived for hundreds of years. That means #b#p2020005##k.
#p2020005#, a resident of #m211000000#, was born just after the time of the Black Mage. He may know something.

string.name: name
string.value: Alcaster's Laboratory
What does #b#p2020005##k know about the Black Mage and the heroes?
#p2020005# had not been born during your era, but he did learn a lot from his history teacher. He told you to go to his old laboratory in #b#m200081700##k to find the records he left behind.
#p2020005#'s Laboratory was taken over by the Black Wings and his teacher's diary is gone. #p2020005# could not figure out why anyone would want to break in there.

string.name: name
string.value: The Missing Seal Stone of El Nath
The lab was hit by the Black Wings. Were they trying to get ahold of the records, or something else? Go ask #b#p2020005##k.

It turns out there was a Seal Stone in #p2020005#'s Laboratory. That must be what the Black Wings were looking for. Hopefully they left the journals behind. #bGo back to the lab#k.\n\n#i4033125# #t4033125# #b#c4033125# / 1#k

The journals are totally illegible. According to #p2020005#, his teacher lost his life during the war 300 years ago. Many records and libraries burned at the same time, so it's likely much of that history was destroyed.\n\nYou remember yelling at Aran for dropping the ball long ago, but it looks like you lost a Seal Stone as well...

string.name: name
string.value: Helios Tower Library
#b#p1401002##k uncovered some new leads for you.

#p1401002# pointed you toward the #b#m220000000# Helios Tower <Library>#k, the place with the most books in the world. If there are no records there, it's a strong possibility that someone is systematically destroying evidence of the heroes.

string.name: name
string.value: Unwritten Records
If the books you're looking for aren't in #m222020000#, someone must be working to erase history. But who?!

#m222020000# didn't have the records. According to #p2040052#, the previous librarian moved the books to storage to make room. It would be worth checking out the #bLibrary Vault#k.\n\n#rTip: If you aren't able to defeat Wiz the Librarian, you must forfeit the quest and do it again.
There are traces of cinder in the Library Vault, precisely where the records of the heroes were kept. Someone is tampering with the history books!

string.name: name
string.value: Enemy Unknown
Only the cabinet with the books you needed were burned and Wiz was possessed by something when you went to investigate. Things are getting stranger by the minute! It's time for a breakdown.

The records of the war with the Black Mage are definitely under attack. The books in #m220000000# were burned to ash. #rSomeone is erasing the heroes from history on purpose#k.

Wiz's spirit possession is worrisome too. It's good that he came back to his old self, but #bthat weird spirit must have had control of him#k. What could it be?

A whole host of people are out for your blood! It might be a good time to get back to the #b#m150000000##k and regroup.
You told #p1401002# what happened with Wiz. She'll need more information if she's going to figure out who the perpetrator is.

string.name: name
string.value: Spirit on My Shoulder
#p1401002# contacted you to share some new intel.

#p1401002# concluded that #p2040052#'s episode was similar to a phenomenon called #rspirit possession#k, where a soul enters another person's body. #b#p1061011##k in #b#m105000000##k is supposed to be an expert on that stuff.
#p1061011# said that a soul is hanging on to your back. Could it be the same one that took over Wiz?

string.name: name
string.value: Don't Turn Around
What the heck was #p1061011# freaking out about?
If you want to see what sort of underworld nightmare is hanging out on you, you'll need a #t4033126#.\n\n#i4033126# #t4033126# #b#c4033126# / 50#k
You brought the #t4033126#. Wait for #p1061011# to complete the spirit charm.

string.name: name
string.value: There's a Phantom on Phantom
Did #b#p1061011##k complete the charm?
Take the charm to the #bShaman Rock#k in the #bHumid Swamp#k. You and the thing on your back will finally get to meet.
A familiar, half-transparent face stares back at you intently. It's Commander #p1404005#, the man you fought hundreds of years ago!

string.name: name
string.value: A Withered Lotus
Commander Orchid's twin brother, #b#p1404005##k! He was always at her side in the olden days. Why is he clinging to your back?

#p1404005#'s body lies injured, deep in slumber, but his soul roams the world causing havoc! He has learned to possess others to do his bidding. Defeat #r#p1404006##k and rid him of #p1404005#'s spirit!
#p1404005# was behind the disappearing documents, but to what purpose? He got away before you could interrogate him.

string.name: name
string.value: Driving Out the Demons
#p1404005# disappeared. Now that he's a soul, can you actually catch him? Time to do some thinking!

You were told that a roaming soul's body must be somewhere. Even #p1404005# said that his real form was somewhere in this time. \n\nThe only place an unconscious Black Wing leader would be safe is #m310000000#! Board the #b#m150000000##k and tell #b#p1401001##k to find #p1404005#'s body.
If you find #p1404005#'s body, you might be able to stop him. It's certainly not safe to just let him wander around as an evil ghost.

string.name: name
string.value: Floating Lotus
Looks like #b#p1401001##k has the results from the investigation into #p1404005#.

According to #p1401001#, the #b#m310000000# Power Plant#k is the central hub of the Black Wings' mining operations. Furthermore, she believes that Orchid's Room is buried deep inside. #p1404005#'s body must be there!
#p1404005# is trapped inside a glass chamber. It's not the most sporting way to beat your foe, but you know better than to let a good opportunity go to waste.

string.name: name
string.value: Dangerous Mistakes
#p1404005# is out cold. You should just get rid of him while you have the chance. Right?
This was all part of #p1404005#'s plans! #p1404005# can only possess those of weak minds, UNLESS that person is near his physical form! He lured you here to steal your body!
#p1404005#'s whole plan was to destroy Empress #p1101000# using Phantom's hands! How could you have fallen for his scheme?
#p1404015#'s soul appeared to save you in your time of need!

#p1404015# apologized for dragging you into everything.

#p1404015# was an Empress until the very end, ruling Maple World with love and kindness in her heart.

#p1404015# apologized for dragging you into everything.

#p1404015# was an Empress until the very end, #bruling Maple World with love and kindness in her heart#k.

string.name: name
string.value: You Are Not Alone
Go apologize to #p1101000#. After all, you almost took her life.

#p1101000# wanted to know why you left without letting her say thanks. She wants to know why you won't join their side, despite having the same enemy. 

Hundreds of years ago, there were only five people brave enough to fight the Black Mage. Now, there's a whole world waiting to take him on... 

Trust them. Join them. This time, you've got nothing to lose.

#p1101000# wanted to know why you left without letting her say thanks. She wants to know why you won't join their side, despite having the same enemy. 

Hundreds of years ago, there were only five people brave enough to fight the Black Mage. Now, there's a whole world waiting to take him on... 

Trust them. Join them. This time, you've got nothing to lose.

string.name: name
string.value: A Favor for Marguerite
Marguerite wants to tell you something.
Marguerite wants you to get her a Snake Leather Bag. For that, you'll need to hunt Serpents near Edelstein. \n\n#i4033231##t4033231# #b#c4033231##k/1
Marguerite gave you a chair in exchange for the Snake Leather Bag. Was this her plan all along? Nah, she just really wanted that bag...

string.name: name
string.value: Pressure Void Appreciation
#p1032209# wants to teach you about the Pressure Void spell.
Press left and right to aim Pressure Void after using it. Give it a try!
You learned how to aim Pressure Void with the left and right keys.

string.name: name
string.value: Spectral Light Spectacular
#p1032209# wants to teach you about the Spectral Light spell.
Press the direction keys to aim Spectral Light after using it. Give it a try!
You learned how to aim Spectral Light with the left, right, up, and down keys.

string.name: name
string.value: The Middle Road

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Vieren has finished his preparations. Can you really overcome the darkness inside you?
Vieren has finished his preparations. Can you really overcome the darkness inside you?
With Vieren's help, you gained control over the darkness inside you.

string.name: name
string.value: The Power of Crystals

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Vieren will combine the power of the crystals to purge the darkness inside you.
Vieren will combine the power of the crystals to purge the darkness inside you.
You can now control the darkness inside you.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
You suddenly understand the powers of Light and Dark.
You suddenly understand the powers of Light and Dark.
You gained a deeper understanding of Light, Dark, and the balance between them.

string.name: name
string.value: Reunion after Centuries
You hear a voice in your head. Is the darkness in your soul seeping into your brain?\n\n#b<This quest will start your 2nd Job Advancement if you haven't done the Story Quests.>#k
You hear a voice in your head. Is the darkness in your soul seeping into your brain?\n\n#b<This quest will start your 2nd Job Advancement if you haven't done the Story Quests.>#k
Vieren, who studied magic with you in Aurora centuries ago, wants to have a little chat. #bDouble-click#k on his #bVampiric Lantern#k to move to Harmony in Aurora.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: The Hidden Auguries
Vieren wants to talk to you. \n\n#b<This quest will start your 3rd Job Advancement if you haven't done the Story Quests.>#k
Vieren wants to talk to you. \n\n#b<This quest will start your 3rd Job Advancement if you haven't done the Story Quests.>#k
Vieren has collected all the powers of the Aurora Auguries. He says you can use it to conquer the darkness inside you. #bDouble-click on the Aurora Prism#k in your inventory to move to Harmony.

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

string.name: name
string.value: Airborne Invitation
Agent N wants to talk to you.
Empress Cygnus of Ereve wants to see you. Could she be related to Empress Aria, who helped you and the other 4 heroes in the war against the Black Mage?\n\nYou should go check it out.
Cygnus is gathering Maple World's powers to keep the Black Mage in check.\n\nShe knows who you are and wants you to help. Perhaps it wouldn't be a bad thing to have allies to fight by your side...

string.name: name
string.value: Lania's Distress
#p1032205# needs to see you.
#p1032205# is remembering more and more. You're the only person she can turn to for help. Go to her home before it's too late.

string.name: name
string.value: Bastion of Light
After centuries in the dark, you've returned to the Light.
After centuries in the dark, you've returned to the Light.
After centuries in the dark, you've returned to the Light.

string.name: name
string.value: In Darkness
You've become a creature of the Dark.
You've become a creature of the Dark.
You've become a creature of the Dark.

string.name: name
string.value: Conquerer of Darkness
You overcame the temptations of darkness and stand firmly in the Light.
You overcame the temptations of darkness and stand firmly in the Light.
You overcame the temptations of darkness and stand firmly in the Light.

string.name: name
string.value: Master of Darkness
The Dark has no hold over you; you are its master.
The Dark has no hold over you; you are its master.
The Dark has no hold over you; you are its master.

string.name: name
string.value: Guardian of Equilibrium
You have achieved new balance by walking the path between Light and Dark.
You have achieved new balance by walking the path between Light and Dark.
You have achieved new balance by walking the path between Light and Dark.

string.name: name

string.value: Maplemas Surprise Party!
There's an awesome Maplemas party going on in Happyville!
Extra extra! Happyville is holding an amazing party for Maplemas! For more details, please go see Rooney.
I talked to Rooney about the impending Maplemas party. Apparently it's a dress-up party, so I better go talk to Cliff about a possible potion for transformation.

string.name: name
string.value: [Happyville] In Preparation for the Party
I better go see Cliff so I can attend the party that takes place in Happyville.
I have to gather up 50 Rascal Snowpieces in order to receive the special potion required to transform.
Now that I am ready to dress-up and transform, it's time to party!

string.name: name
string.value: A Secret Note
A secret note came from the Snow Spirit of Happyville. I wonder what happened?

I finally realized the true intent of the Snow Spirit as she strives to protect Happyville from disaster. In order to ruin Scrooge's plan, she asked Alcaster of El Nath for some much needed help. I better go find him immediately!
I gave Alcaster a note from Snow Spirit. Now it's time for me to wait for his reply.

string.name: name
string.value: Alcaster's Reply
Alcaster says he has something for Snow Spirit.
He handed me a reply letter to Snow Spirit, a note that contains the exact method we should take to defeat Scrooge. I better go see her right now!

I gave the Snow Spirit Alcaster's reply letter. She stood quietly for a moment, then gave me something called Force of the Spirit, which she said was the key to defeating Scrooge. What exactly is this?

string.name: name
string.value: Save the Snowman!
Scrooge seems to have started putting his plan into reality. I better go see Snow Spirit.
Protect the snowman from Scrooge and his men!
I was able to protect the symbol of luck here in Happyville, the giant snowman. That really made my day.

string.name: name
string.value: Amoria : Red Dahlia - Pirate
Hmm, there's a man who looks a little distraught... should I help him?

I went and spoke with Ben, and he's trying to make a special flower for his wife called the Red Dahlia. He got injured and needs someone to collect the materials for him. I agreed to help, and bring back #b30 Stiff Feathers#k and #b3 Diamond Ore#k he needs to make the flower. Seems like a nice enough guy. Shame he got injured, but I can get him what he wants...
I retrieved all the materials Ben needed and he'll be able to make the Red Dahlia. In return for my help, he gave me a scroll that will help me in my travels.

string.name: name
string.value: Amoria : Cupid's Courier - Pirate

string.name: parent
string.value: Cupid's Courier - Pirate
The wife of a sailor, eh? I'll bet she needs some help.

I spoke with the lovely Angelique, and I'm going to deliver #b25 Soft Feathers#k to her husband, Richard, for her. He works on Tae Gong's ship in Aqua Road. Once I have everything, I'll head there, drop everything off, and let Angelique know her husband has everything.
I delivered the materials to Richard and he thanked me. His wife must be happy...

string.name: name
string.value: Amoria : Cupid's Courier - Pirate

string.name: parent

I delivered everything to Richard and he asked me delivered his letter to his wife.
I delivered everything to Richard and returned to Angelique. She gave me something nice, and I can go back to her anytime for a quick job.

string.name: name
string.value: Cleaning Up The Streets
There's a new sheriff in New Leaf City. I should go see who it is!

I met the new sheriff, Lita Lawless. She's an old friend of Icebyrd's, and has taken over as the new sheriff. I've agreed to help her get this town in order, by wiping out #b200 Electrophants and 200 Gryphons#k in New Leaf City. I'd better get started!
I...I did it! 200 of Electrophants and Gryphons have fallen to my might! In addition to that, I got a cool item from Lita as a 'Thank You!' I can return and help her anytime I want from now on...

string.name: name
string.value: Cool as Ice
I think it's about time Icebyrd gave me some answers...I should go speak with him.
I've spoken with Icebyrd, and he seems cryptic-what is he hiding?

Icebyrd has revealed the truth to me at last-he was contacted by Subani to establish New Leaf City as well as anchor Masteria to the Maple World. He was sworn to secrecy, and to this day, can never leave the continent. It appears that Subani and Icebyrd are the first line of defense against the demonic Naricain, and by defeating his Twisted Masters; I am now his enemy as well. He also mentioned that our adventures here have just begun...with the Twisted Masters out of the way, what's next? Perhaps answers lie within the #bKrakian Jungle#k, and the mysterious city there...only time will tell!

Kopee Relicseeker and Toh Relicseeker say they are looking for Miwok Artifacts that have been lost. Let's acquire the #bMiwok Artifact Piece#k from the monsters and take them to her.
Kopee Relicseeker was so happy to find a sign of the Miwok Artifact. She and Toh Relicseeker said they would stay for a while and further search for the Miwok Artifact.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Exp 1,000\n

string.name: name
string.value: The Legendary Tribal Ring: Circle of Ancient Thought
Happy to have found the remnant of the Miwok Artifacts, Kopee says she has something to tell me. Let's go and see her.
Kopee offered to make me a Legendary Tribal Ring using the belongings of her Miwok ancestors! I should collect every artifact I find and take my findings to Kopee.

Kopee, using the ancestors' belongings, made me a ring. I received a Circle of Ancient Thought from her! She told me she'd make me one every time I bring her an artifact. I'd better take what I find to Kopee.

string.name: name

She says if I go and talk to Toh Relicseeker and release the seal of the #bMiwok Artifact#k 20 times using the #bEnchanted Scroll#k, she'll make me the chair. It's a great opportunity for me to receive a reward and the Chief's Chair from the Miwok Artifact.
Kopee gave me a Miwok Chief's Chair as a gift, thanking me for finding the Miwok Artifact. It's an impressive chair that is both soft and cozy.

I spoke with Eurek and he's perfected his method for scrolling unequipped items. I've agreed to gather some materials for him for a trip he's taking. I'll need to get #b#p2040050##k everything he needs: 

#t1302013# #b#c1302013#/1#k
#t2043000# #b#c2043000#/1#k
#t2040000# #b#c2040000#/1#k

string.name: name
string.value: Cassandra's Trick or Treat
They say that Cassandra has prepared a fun event in commemoration of the Halloween Season. Would you like to learn more about it?

Cassandra has asked that you bring her 31 Green Halloween Stick Candies. The candies are carried by Monsters during the Halloween season, and Cassandra says that the monsters in the Haunted Mansion have more than others. Who knew that Cassandra had such a craving for sweets, but this should be easy, right?\n\n#i4032444:# #t4032444:# #c4032444# / 31

It's not certain whether Cassandra was happy because she received the candies or because she pulled off a trick... Regardless, it always feels good to help someone, no? You can receive another Halloween task if you return to Cassandra after 1 hour.

string.name: name
string.value: [Halloween] Olivia: 'Bring My Daddy'
Is she still looking through those keys? Maybe she could benefit from some helping hands.

Olivia handed you her letter asking that you deliver it to her father right away. You can rescue Joe by using the key inside the letter. Now, let's see where this place is and get him out of there quick!
There must be some relief since you were able to unlock the Piano Room and get that letter to her father. But wait, you might just have another monkey on your back...

string.name: name
string.value: [Halloween] Joe: 'Clear the Way'

Joe would like you to kill #b100 Glutton Ghouls, 1 Psycho Jack #kso that he'd be able to walk through the hallway untouched.
You were able to defeat the#b 100 Glutton Ghouls, 1 Psycho Jack #k. The hallway is now clear for him to escape.

string.name: name
string.value: [Halloween] Father: 'Dirty House'

Joe wants you to go #rfetch his butler, Steward#k, for him. Who does he think you are--his butler?
You finally located #rSteward the butler#k in the right room. He doesn't appear to be too happy at your arrival, though.

string.name: name
string.value: [Halloween] Steward: 'I'm a Butler, Not a Maid!'

The butler advised that you to collect #b10 Tombstones#k to prove to Jonas that you are serious about the mission. You can find Tombstones by hunting monsters inside the Haunted Mansion.
Yes! You were able to collect the #b10 Tombstones#k and show Jonas that you want this whole thing to end. But it's questionable whether he got it completely...

I spoke with Hannah, and she's preparing a Festival of Lights. I've agreed to help her build the Altar by gathering 25 Altar Pieces. She mentioned that the monsters would already have an axe stuck in them, so I should hunt those.
I collected the 25 Altar Pieces and returned to Hannah. She was happy, and began building the Altar. She also mentioned that I could come back for more work when I have a chance

string.name: name
string.value: New Year's Presents from Cassandra
Cassandra says she's giving out New Year's presents every day for those who log in. So go visit the ever so generous Cassandra!
What presents has #bCassandra#k prepared?
#bCassandra#k says she will give out a New Year's present every day until January 19th for simply logging in.

string.name: name
string.value: Lilin's Present 1
You have reached Level 30 and #b#p9010000##k starts a conversation with you...

#p9010000# tells you since you have reached Level 30, you can receive a #bspecial gift#k from #p1201000#.

#i1112413:# 

You are told to go straight to #b#m140000000##k and meet #b#p1201000##k.
Your received #t1112413# from #p1201000#. A special ring that can be worn by any character within the same account. It looks like an item that is not just for an Aran, but for any character.

string.name: name
string.value: Cupid's Lost Arrows
Have you heard about #bCupid's Lost Arrows#k? You can find out more from #rCassandra.#k
Please bring me #b50 Cupid's Lost Arrows.#k You can get them from any monster. I will give you an awesome Valentines present when you bring them to me!
You can repeat this quest every 2 hours until #rFebruary 23rd 2011.#k However, you'll only be able to receive the Cupid Wings Cape once. After that, you'll just receive additional #bEXP.#k

string.name: name
string.value: Mardi Gras Throws
Would you like to participate in #rthe Mardi Gras Festival?#k If so, please see #bGaga.#k

Monsters attacked the storage room and looted the Beads we were saving up for the festival, stealing everything! If you eliminate the monsters and bring me #b10 Bead Necklaces#k, I'll make you #ra Mardi Gras Feather: Green, Purple, Red#k--whichever one you want!
You have returned with 10 Bead Necklaces that will be used in #bthe Mardi Gras Festival.#k You can participate in this event until #rMarch 15, 2014#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Hunter's Luck - Week 6

The time between February and March is what many call the prime hunting season! Receive some hunting pointers from Scadur and become the best hunter on the block!#b

<Event Period>
March 22, 2010 - March 28, 2010

<How to Join the Event>
1. Receive the 2x EXP item that Scadur hands out once a week.
2. Use the item when in need of an extra boost of Luck.
3. Hunt away!

<Notes>
1. 2x EXP item will expire at midnight on Sunday.
2. New 2x item will become available the following Monday.
