string.name: name
string.value: A Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lv. 25, #p9010000# starts talking to you...
#p9010000# says that you can now receive a gift from #p9010010# and that you should go to town and meet #b#p9010010##k. She will be very happy to see you...
You received a #t1022097# that #p9010010# made herself. Work harder and reach Lv. 50 before #bMay 4#k to receive a scroll that can be used on it.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Reach Lv. 30

string.name: name
string.value: A Second Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lv. 45, #p9010010# starts talking to you...
#b#p9010010##k congratulates you for reaching Lv. 45 and tells you that she will give you a scroll that can be used when you reach Lv. 50.
You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says she will give you another scroll if you reach Lv. 60 by #bMay 4#k.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Reach Lv. 50

string.name: name
string.value: A Third Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lv. 55, #p9010010# starts talking to you...

#p9010010# congratulates you for reaching Lv. 55 and tells you that she will give you another scroll when you are ready. Just how many scrolls has #p9010010# prepared? In any case, go to town and meet #p9010010# when you reach Lv. 60.
You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says that she will give you an even better scroll if you reach Lv. 70 by #bMay 4#k.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Reach Lv. 60

string.name: name
string.value: A Fourth Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lv. 65, #p9010010# starts talking to you...

#p9010010# congratulates you for reaching Lv. 65 and tells you that she will give you the scroll she mentioned before when you reach Lv. 70. How will she react after seeing how much the Dragon she called cute before has grown? Go to town and meet with #b#p9010010##k when you are Lv. 70.
You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says that she will give you another scroll if you reach Lv. 80 by #bMay 4#k.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Reach Lv. 70

string.name: name
string.value: A Fifth Gift for the Dragon Master
When you reach Lv. 75, #p9010010# starts talking to you...
#p9010010#, in a sincere voice, congratulates you for reaching Lv. 75 and asks you to reach Lv. 80 to receive the final scroll. Go to town and meet with #p9010010# when you reach Lv. 80.
You received a scroll from #p9010010#. #p9010010# says that she has given you everything she could and that all that is left is for you to work hard and believe in yourself.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Reach Lv. 80

string.name: name
string.value: Dragon Master's Treasure Chest
The Administrator says that she will give anyone who hatches a Mini Dragon Egg the chance to obtain some precious treasures.\n

You can receive the Onyx Dragon Treasure Chest from the Administrator by bringing her all 7 symbols of the Ancient Onyx Dragon. You can find symbols of the Ancient Onyx Dragon inside the Evan Gift Box given by Cassandra.
You received the Onyx Dragon Treasure Chest from the Administrator. Rumor has it that it belonged to an ancient Dragon Master.

string.name: summary
string.value: Collect the 7 symbols of the Ancient Onyx Dragon.

string.name: name
string.value: The Shadow Knight in Dragon's Nest
The #p9010000# says that there is some news you should know about. Click on the light bulb over the #p9010000#'s head to hear the news!
The #p9010000# says to go through the Dimensional Mirror to get to Dragon's Nest, where you will find #p9201144#.
You spoke to #p9201144# in Dragon's Nest. He told you about some eggs you can obtain from the Dragon's Nest.

string.name: summary
string.value: Go to Dragon's Nest and look for #p9201144#.

string.name: name
string.value: The Shadow Knight's Request for Help
#p9201144# in #m683010000# needs your help. Go to #m683010000# via the Dimensional Mirror and talk to #p9201144#.
#p9201144# says that he is in need of a Twin Dragon's Egg and asks you to bring one back for him. You'll have to be quick before the mother dragon returns to the nest!

You've brought back a Twin Dragon's Egg for #p9201144#. He thanks you and tells you that you can gain precious treasures from the Twin Dragon's Egg by using a special Incubator found in the Cash Shop.

string.name: summary
string.value: Bring back a Twin Dragon's Egg from Dragon's Nest.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: Popularity 3

string.value: Attracting Tourists to the Golden Temple
#p9010010# is talking to you. What kind of event could be planned this time? Respond to #p9010010#.

There's a new attraction called the #b#m950100000##k in Maple World. It's a small village, but it has its own boss monster and other unique monsters. If you go now, #b#p9000078##k, the PR Manager, will give you a #t4001431# that will allow you to use the mini dungeons located near the temple. Head over to the #m950100000# through the #bDimensional Mirror#k.

You received a #t4001431# from PR Manager #p9000078#. You can use it to enter any mini dungeons near the town once. If you want to use the mini dungeons again, you can purchase a Premium Golden Ticket or obtain ticket pieces dropped by monsters.

string.value: Admin's Heart

You brought 100 Chocolates to the Maple Administrator, just the thing to help her make her dream of true love a reality!\n

string.name: name
string.value: Inkwell's One-Sided Love
The chic yet reserved Inkwell seems to have someone in mind for his own affections. Just who could've stolen his heart?\n

The lady who stole Inkwell's heart was none other than Cassandra, that haughty ball of hotness! To move her fickle heart, Inkwell wants to present her with a truly stunning present. Take the Melted Chocolate, stay logged in for 30 minutes for it to become a Heart Chocolate, and bring it to Inkwell.\n
You made the Heart Chocolate for Inkwell. Keep helping him out so he can make his Valentine's wishes come true.\n

string.name: name
string.value: Who Does Cassandra Like?
Cassandra actually knows that Inkwell likes her, but her heart belongs to someone else... Who could it be?\n

string.value: What's Quaking

string.name: parent
string.value: NLC Under Attack

string.name: parent
string.value: NLC Under Attack

The aliens had some sort of technologically advanced shovel for mining the ore beneath #b#m600000000##k. These mineral veins are the foundation for all of Masteria. If the aliens dig up all the ore, Masteria will collapse!
It's time to take the fight to the aliens. Sabotage their mining operations.
#b#p9201050##k gave you four sabo-missions to sabotage the alien mining operations. \n\nLight up a Gunpowder Mound, destroy the Galacto-Drill, steal the research samples, and break their computer.
The aliens are in disarray! However, there are a lot of townspeople trapped near their base...

Let's talk to #b#p9201190##k.

I learned how to use items! This will make life much easier!

string.name: name
string.value: Todd's How-to-Hunt
I hear Todd can teach us how to hunt...

Todd taught me to move towards upper right-hand side to attack and kill #bJr. Sentinel#k, and talk to #p9201193#...

Jr. Sentinel #b#a10181##k
#t4000142# #b#c4000142#/1#k
I killed the monster just as Todd told me.

string.name: name
string.value: Letter for Lucas
I heard Maria need a help...
I met Maria who was desperately looking for help. She gave me a letter and asked me to bring this to Lucas in Amherst...
I gave Maria's letter to Lucas in Amherst.

string.name: name
string.value: What Sen wants to eat

string.name: parent
string.value: Oldmaple-Nina and Sen's Dinner Menu
Let's talk to Nina.
I ran into Nina who was thinking about what to make for Dinner for her brother, Sen. I have to go and talk to Sen who is next to Nina, and find out what he wants to have for dinner.
I asked Sen, Nina's brother, what he wants to have for dinner. He answers he wants to have a #bMushroom Soup#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Returning to Nina

string.name: parent
string.value: Oldmaple-Nina and Sen's Dinner Menu
Sen wants to have Mushroom Soup for Dinner. Let's get back to Nina now.
I told Nina what Sen wants for dinner.

string.name: name
string.value: Bigg's Collection of Items
Let's start looking for Biggs.

I met Biggs at Southperry. He asked me if I can get him #b10 orange mushroom caps and 30 blue snail shells#k and that he'll reward me with a nice item if I do so. He doesn't look too convinced that I can do this, but... it looks like a piece of cake to me.

#i4000000##t4000000# #b#c4000000##k/30 
#i4000001##t4000001# #b#c4000001##k/10

I got Biggs from Southperry #b10 mushroom caps and 30 blue snail shells#k. How is he going to do business out of this anyway? Well, he did get me a decent weapon to use. I guess I can travel for a while with this...

string.name: name
string.value: Pio's Collecting Recycled Goods
When I see Pio, he asks me to help collecting recycled goods.

I ran into Pio who is famous in Amherst for fixing broken goods. Pio tells me to break down scrap boxes from here and there in the village and bring back #t4031161# and #t4031162#. I think I saw some scrap boxes in the village...

As Pio asked me, I broke down some useless boxes that were lying here and there in the village, and returned it to him. It was fun collecting them because I could find some useful stuff in them as well.

string.name: name
string.value: Sam's Suggestion
Sam suggested me to meet Mai...
When I talked to Sam, he first told me to go to the East...and he told me to hunt #r10#k #b#o100100##k...and meet #p9201208#. \n\n#b#o100100# #r#a10191##k
As Sam told me, I hunted #r10#k #o100100##k...and met #p12100#.

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's Training

string.name: parent
string.value: Oldmaple-Mai's Training
Mai in Maple Island seems like a Martial -Art specialist, who can train the beginners to boost up the strength...

I decided to get trained under the Famous Sword-Master, Mai, in Amherst. I guess hunting the weakest monsters is a good idea. Should I hunt Snail, Blue Snail, and Shroom in order?

#o100100# #r#a10161# #k
#o100101# #r#a10162# #k
#o120100# #r#a10163##k

 Ah, Mai told me to meet with #p20002# in Southperry and try training together...
Mai trained me, and I feel I'm a lot stronger.

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's Final Training

string.name: parent
string.value: Oldmaple-Mai's Training
Mai's training is a simple monster-hunt. But it is very useful in getting used to hunting. Let's get Mai's training, which might be the last training in Maple Island.
Mai told me to hunt stronger monsters. Of course it is important to know your own strength, but to develop your strength, you need to try to hunt stronger monsters.\n\n#o1210102# #r#a10171# #k
After getting Mai's traning, I became much stronger. I think I am going to leave Maple Island to get a job I like. Let's go to South Ferry and head to Victoria Island.

string.name: name
string.value: Mai's Request
#b#p9201208##k stands at #b#m690000007##k. They say she is the strongest in Maple Island.... Why is she here? What's her life story like? Let's see #p9201208#.

#p9201208# is a new adventurer and worker on Victoria Island. But the elder, #p9201203# in #m690000018# hired her in case of any dangerous situations on Maple Island. #p9201208# says it's a hard time now because of all the work....Let's tell #b#p9201203##k what #p9201208# said.

#p9201203# agreed with what #p9201208# said. He said it's better to hire more workers. Then he asked me to tell #b#p1002101##k in #b#m690000029##k... #m690000029# is in Victoria Island...I have to go to #b#p9201200##k in #b#m690000009##k.

string.name: name
string.value: Delivering A Letter To All The Towns
Lucas wants you to deliver a letter to the elders of all the towns. Go visit Lucas.
Deliver Lucas's Letter to the elders of Henesys, Ellinia, Perion, and Kerning City, then return to Lucas.
You've delivered the letters to the elders and returned to Lucas.

string.name: name
string.value: Shumi's Lost Coin
Let's start looking for Shumi in Kerning City.

I met this girl named Shumi in Kerning City. She was devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she was asking me to find it for her. She also told me that a bunch of guys draped in white cloth took it from her in the subway, and that they may be found at the #bConstruction Site B1#k, deep in the station ... I should go there first ...

I found the lost coin that Shumi of Kerning City was looking for, and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh ... as a reward, she gave me a whole bunch of the return scrolls ... not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at #bConstruction Site B1#k ... I should check it out later ...

string.name: name
string.value: Shumi's Lost Bundle of Money
Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.

I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. She seemed really worried about how she lost her rent money because a Stirge flew over and snatched a bundle of money away from her. Man ... do I have to walk back in there again ... can I just pay the rent for her? Anyway like last time, I need to go back in there, this time to #bConstruction Site B2#k and find the bundle of money she lost. Aye, better go in there now...

I got Shumi from Kerning City the lost bundle of money. I guess she can pay her rent now...and as a reward, she got me #b100 Mana Elixirs#k...she also said I may find other items at the #bConstruction Site B2#k...I should go check it out sometime...

string.name: name
string.value: Shumi's Lost Bundle of Money
Let's go look for Shumi in Kerning City.

I ran into Shumi again at Kerning City. A while ago, she got a favor from JM From the Streetz to get an elixir for him, only to have the sack of money fall down and lose it all in the process. I guess I can find it at the deep part of the subway station, the #bConstruction Site B3#k, again.

I got Shumi of Kerning City the lost sack of money. With that, she can finally get the stuff JM requested. As a sign of thanks, she gave me #bscroll for shoes for speed#k. Since there are other items that can be found at #bconstruction site B3#k , maybe I should head back in there sometime...

string.name: name
string.value: Maya's First Collection
Go see Maya in Henesys.

I got a favor request from Maya of Henesys, who has been collecting various items. She wanted #b50 each of snail shells, blue snail shells, mushroom spores, and tree branches#k. Maybe...well it looks like I can get these from the monsters around the prarie...
I got all the items Maya requested, but when do I get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do I have to do this??

string.name: name
string.value: Maya's Second Collection

This time Maya wanted #b50 each of Fireboar teeth, Bubbling's huge bubbles, pig ribbons, and tablecloths#k. Apparently, I can get those by hunting down the monster around the plateau, subway station, and prairies ... well, that's easy!
I got them all for Maya. Please don't tell me she wanted all these for free...
Go see Maya in Henesys.

string.name: name
string.value: Maya's Third Collection

This time, Maya requested #b10 Lupin Dolls and 50 each of Cold Eye's tail, Tortie's shell, and Iron Hog's Steel Hoof#k. Apparently I can get those through monsters at the highland, beach, and prairie. This is getting harder now...
I got them all for Maya. I'm still not getting anything?? How many more times do I have to do this??
Go see Maya in Henesys.

string.name: name
string.value: Maya's Last Collection

Maya requested, for the last time, #b50 each of Clang's claws, Dark Stone Golem's pieces of rock, the eyes of Wild Kargo, and Tauromacis's horns, along with one diamond#k. Apparently I can get those through monsters at the beach, deep forest, and deep into the Cursed Temple... this is RIDICULOUS! It's too hard!

I got all the items Maya requested for the last time...or is it? As a sign of appreciation, she gave me a pair of shoes her grandma made for Athena Pierce, the chief of this town. It may be really old, but it still looks solid like brand new!!
Go see Maya in Henesys.

string.name: name
string.value: Collecting 50 Cursed Dolls

string.name: parent
string.value: Oldmaple-Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
I think Rowen the Fairy in Ellinia has something to ask me...

You run into #bRowen#k again, the fairy who gave you fresh milk for Ronnie, Mr. Wetbottom's son. Back then, she seemed to be keeping her guard up against humans, but now, it looks like she accepts you as Ronnie's friend... Rowen is assistant to the head magician of Ellinia, Grendel the Really Old, and she tells you that Grendel is concerned about the cursed dolls that he made with his black magic a long, long time ago. The dolls had been sealed up for a while, until a bunch of Lupins took them and ran away. The Lupins have since become zombies and have been destroying the forest. To return the forest to how it was before, someone needs to take down the Zombie Lupins and take away the #bcursed dolls#k from them... So, you readily accept the request to collect #b50 cursed dolls#k, but fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...
You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b50 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you 7 ores. You hope the forest will return to normal...

string.name: name
string.value: Collecting 200 Cursed Dolls

string.name: parent
string.value: Oldmaple-Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
Rowen asks for your help one last time, this time to collect #b200 Cursed Dolls#k. You wonder why she needs so many... Is she trying to sell them or something?

You eliminated a bunch of Zombie Lupins in a forest near Ellinia and collected all #b200 Cursed Dolls#k for Rowen. In return, she gave you a nice hat. You've collected so many dolls for her, but it seems like the Zombie Lupins aren't decreasing in any way, shape, or form... you wonder what's going on. However, it seems that the fairies may not have such animosity toward humans now... at least that's a good thing.

string.name: name
string.value: Sabitrama and the Diet Medicine
Let's go look for Sabitrama in Sleepywood.

In front of Sleepywood Hotel, I met #bSabitrama#k, a medicinal herb trader who seems to be the younger brother of Chrishrama. He said he found a place where he can finally find the herb that he needed for this medicine he's working on...and that he asked if I could go in that forest and grab an herb called #bPink Anthurium#k. It consists of green grass and a small pink flower ... I better remember this well and get him the exact same one. I heard the place is near Ellinia ... I should go there and talk to this guy #bShane#k ...

Thankfully I got the flower that Sabitrama wanted from the Forest of Patience, and as a sign of appreciation, he gave me a #bscroll for the overall armor#k. Oh, and he also said that from here on out, I can enter the Forest of Patience without having to pay Shane of Ellinia. Based on what I've heard, the diet medicine Sabitrama's working on is for Shane's fiance... I better get back in the Forest of Patience when I have some time ...

string.name: name
string.value: Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine
I heard that Sabitrama in Sleepywood is making a new medicine...

I ran into #bSabitrama#k again in front of the Sleepywood hotel, the same one I helped get herbs before. This time, he said he found a place where I can get the important herb that he needed for his new medicine. He asked me if I could go into that forest and grab #bDouble-Rooted Red Ginseng#k for him. The root is in two, and red ... I should remember it well and find the same one once I get to the top. I should speak to #bShane#k of Ellinia ...

Thankfully I got the one that Sabitrama asked me to get, and for that, I got rewarded with a mysterious rock. And from here on out, I don't have to pay Shane every time I go in the Forest of Patience. From what I hear, that anti-aging medicine Sabitrama is working on may be what Shane needed ... if I have time, I should go back in there ...

Oh, he also said if I lose the Veteran Hunter medal, I have to redo the challenge so I should make sure to take good care of it.

Collect the Monster Cards, which will help you understand the tendencies, habitats, and dropped items of various monsters. Some cards have special powers that will help you in your adventures.

string.name: name
string.value: Humble Honor
#b#p1022002##k's backside radiates Ambition. You can find #p1022002# in #b#m102000000##k.
#p1022002# explains that Ambition isn't given--it's grasped. Follow #p1022002#'s example by hunting powerful monsters to build your Ambition. Defeat #r#o4230103#s#k.\n\n#o4230103##r #a295131##k
You received the #t1142266# medal from #p1022002#.

string.name: name
string.value: Bearded Ambition
#b#p2020000##k has an ambitious beard. You can find #p2020000# in #b#m211000000##k.

#p2020000# says he grew his rockin' beard with the strength of his Ambition. He learned Ambition back when he was a well-known hunter in #m211000000#... Try hunting #r#o6130103##k and #r#o6230200##k as #p2020000# once did.

#o6130103##r #a295141##k
#o6230200##r #a295142##k
You received the #t1142267# medal from #p2020000#.

string.name: name
string.value: King's Dignity
Von Leon the Lion King is said to have fearsome Ambition. Van Leon's Chief Knight, #b#p2161002##k, probably knows more.

#p2161002# tells you that the Lion King's Ambition not only gave him great power, but made him a leader worth following. He sees a similar Ambition in you, and wants you to defeat the Lion King...\n\n#y3171# #b(#u3171#)#k
You received the King's Dignity medal from #p2161002#.

string.name: name
string.value: Hawk's Eyes
With a name like #b#p1101007##k, he's got to have good Insight...right? Find him in #b#m130000000##k.
#p1101007# brags about his keen Insight. It's a little hard to believe, when #p1101007# talks so openly about the other Chief Knights' secrets.
#p1101007# went on and on about his own great Insight and the secrets of the other Chief Knights. Perhaps he wasn't the right person to ask about Insight.

string.name: name
string.value: Fairy's Pupil
Talk to #b#p1012100##k, who leads #b#m100000000##k with keen Insight.

#p1012100# is fairy-born, and is immune to the illusions that befuddle most mortals. She thinks you have the potential to develop her level of Insight, and asks you to #rdefeat some monsters#k.\n\n#o5300100##r #a295171##k
You received the Fairy's Pupil medal from #p1012100#.
The rumor has it #b#p2091001##k is #b#m250000000##k is #t1142271#. Find out the truth from #p2091001#.

#p2091001# says that he's not #t1142271#, but simply a practitioner of Taoist magic. He thinks #t1142271# is a better fit for you...if you have enough Insight to defeat the #r#o7220002##k.\n\n#o7220002##r #a295181##k
You received the #t1142271# medal from #p2091001#.

string.name: name
string.value: No Pain, No Gain

You received the #t1142272# medal from #p0020000#.

string.value: Beauty of Patience

#b#p2060002##k explains that Willpower is nothing fancy. It's all about patience. When you realize the joy of waiting, you gain Willpower. Catch a fish with #p2060002#.

#o2230109##r #a295201##k
#o2230200##r #a295202##k
#o3230104##r #a295203##k

Ericsson up in Orbis wants to talk to you.
He sounds pretty gloomy. What could be wrong?
Ericsson wants to talk about some place called Chryse. Curiosity rising!
You're on your way to Chryse.

string.name: name
string.value: The Floating Island of Chryse

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,200\nCan proceed to the Welcome to Chryse quest\n
After a whole lot of flapping, you've arrived at Chryse! Now, why does it look all smashed up?

Demos isn't much help. You'll have to talk to Chief Marione at the Chryse Hideout for the whole story.
To get inside the Hideout, you need an Entry Pass. Beat up the Rabbits Outside of Chryse 1 or 2 until you find the one that nicked it from Demos.
You got your very own Entry Pass! Time to get some answers from Chief Marione.

string.name: name
string.value: Welcome to Chryse

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 13,860\nCan proceed to the Chief Concerns quest.\n

string.name: parent
string.value: Chryse's Crisis
If anyone knows what's going on, it's the chief...hopefully. Head to the hideout and talk to Chief Marione.
The chief has some interesting priorities, but his heart's in the right place. Time to thin the Rabbit population.
Those Rabbits won't be ruining any more tailgates.

string.name: name
string.value: Chief Concerns

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 14,420\nCan proceed to the Pet Problems quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: Chryse's Crisis
The Chief says that the real culprit is Michaela. Huh.
How in the world is this Michaela's fault? Must be a good story, at least.
So it was this core thing that started this whole mess. Better find out what it is, and if you can break it.

string.name: name
string.value: Pet Problems

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,600\nCan proceed to the Secret of the Core quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: Chryse's Crisis
Will someone please explain what this core thing is?
Elder Titan should know something about the core, but you might need to fulfil his...unusual request first.
Time to find out what's so special about this core. If it just mutates monsters, the solution seems pretty obvious.

string.name: name
string.value: Secret of the Core

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 14,980\nCan proceed to the Elder's Request quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: Chryse's Crisis
All right, core time! What's the deal?
Welp, the core keeps Chryse afloat. That probably rules out smashing it. Hope Elder Titan has a better idea.
If you can't smash the core, Xerxes is the next best thing!

string.name: name
string.value: Elder's Request

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 1,800\nCan proceed to the We Need A Hero quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: The Right Stuff
Michael, the grandson of the Elder, wants to take the fight to Xerxes. That's the best plan you've heard all day!
Michael is ten gallons of manly in a five gallon hat. You're going to have to work your butt off to prove you can be a hero.
That's definitely enough Scorpies for now.

string.name: name
string.value: We Need a Hero

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 18,480\nCan proceed to the We're Holding Out For A Hero quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: The Right Stuff
Really? Taking out those Scorpies wasn't enough?
Eliminate all the Golden Scorpies to show Michael what you're really made of!
Okay, Golden Scorpies sound impressive enough to prove your worth to Mister Macho Guy.

string.name: name
string.value: We're Holding Out For A Hero

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 23,815\nCan proceed to the Secondhand Arsenal quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: Tools of War
The people of Chryse need tons of weapons to fight back! Never mind that you've only seen like 5 people since you got here!
50 Ferret's Spears sounds reasonable enough. Still don't know who's gonna use them, though...
The spears are delivered. Now all the villagers you've STILL NEVER SEEN can start practicing.

string.name: name
string.value: Secondhand Arsenal

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 28,783\nCan proceed to the Obvious Upgrade quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: Tools of War
Wait, he wants something else? If it's more spears...
Okay, shields are a bit more reasonable. Clobber some Golden Ferrets and take theirs.
There. Shields and spears. Can we get to the actual fight now?

string.name: name
string.value: A Good Defense

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 25,340\nCan proceed to the A REALLY Good Defense quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: Coliseum Crasher
Titan's tough to understand, but it sounds like he's suggesting doing a little scouting. That seeems reasonable.
Scout the Coliseum Corridor, past the Road to the Coliseum. Once you know what kind of beasties are there, report back to Michael.
Mammoths! Why did it have to be mammoths?

string.name: name
string.value: Know Your Enemy

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 4,500\nCan proceed to the Thinning the Herd quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: Coliseum Crasher
Time to clean up the Coliseum, and the Mammoths are the first to go!
Time to clean up the Coliseum, and the Mammoths are the first to go!
The Mammoths were dealt with, and Michael can hold his hair back. Life is good.

string.name: name
string.value: Thinning the Herd

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 30,800\nCan proceed to the Obliterating the Herd quest\n

string.name: parent
string.value: Coliseum Crasher
There's not much left between you and Xerxes. Keep fighting!
Eliminate the Golden Mammoth guards, and the way to Xerxes will be clear.
No more mammoths! It's go time!

string.name: name
string.value: Obliterating the Herd

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
EXP 33,600
Can proceed to the Xerxes Falls quest
Can proceed to the My Little Xerxes quest
Everything should be all set for the final battle. Check in with Michael, just to be sure.
It's go time! Eliminate Xerxes.
BOOYAH! Xerxes is toast. You totally rocked that quest, bro! Time to...shake off Michael's influence and talk normally again.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Xerxes Falls

string.name: name
string.value: Xerxes Falls

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: EXP 67,200\nCan proceed to the For the Elder quest\n
The time has come to eliminate Xerxes. But why doesn't Michaela look happy?
Oh, right...Xerxes was her pet. Maybe you can...beat him back to normal?
Welp...that was less than ideal. At least Chryse is safe.

string.name: name
string.value: My Little Xerxes
Chryse's crisis looks to be about over. Check in with the Elder for some parting words of wisdom. Hopefully not about teeth this time.\n\n
Wait, is there more to do? Is it too late to jump?
Might as well help the chief. He sounds like a good cook, at least.

string.value: Invitation to Ellin Forest

According to Spiegelmann, due to the failure in the Ludibrium Clocktower, people can now travel back in time. He asked you if you're interested in time travel, and you answered that you are curious about Maple World of the past.
Travel to the past through the #bBroken Gate of Time at Helios Tower (101st Floor)#k.
According to Spiegelmann, you can travel back in time through #bHelios Tower (101st Floor), Broken Gate of Time#k in Ludibrium. Try traveling back in time using the Broken Gate of Time.

string.name: name
string.value: Lush Forest
You arrived in a lush forest after passing through the #bBroken Gate of Time#k. Is this the past? See if anyone can confirm where...or when...you are.
Yuris looked perfectly normal, but the more you talk to her, the stranger she seems. Maybe you should find someone easier to talk to. Try that #e#bLoha#k#n person whom Yuris mentioned.
Who is Kao? Everyone keeps mentioning that name...

string.name: name
string.value: Unfamiliar Faces
Loha called you Kao, as well. Who's this Kao person?\nGo talk to Loha again.
Loha told you to stop slacking off and go with Tess to get the item Sion wanted. Great...but who are Tess and Sion?\nGo talk to Tess next to the Altaire Barrier Stone on the left side of the camp.\n
You went to see Tess, who protects the Altaire Barrier Stone.

string.name: name
string.value: Lazy Tess

Defeat #o4250000#, collect #b50 #e#t4000436##n#k items, and deliver them to Loha.

- You can find Mossy Snails in #e#m300010000##n or #e#m300030000##n.
Go see Tess over by the Altaire Barrier Stone on the left side of the camp.
You defeated #o4250000#, collected 50 #t4000436# items, and delivered them to Loha.

string.name: name
string.value: Another Me?
You collected 50 #t4000436# items from #o4250000#s and brought them to Loha, but that actually made Loha angrier. Tess might've told you to get the wrong items.
Head over to Athena Pierce at the Altaire Camp Conference Room. She might be able to explain this whole situation and who Kao is.
You met Athena Pierce at the Altaire Camp Conference Room. She looks no different...

string.name: name
string.value: Exploration Captain, Athena Pierce
Ask Athena Pierce about the current situation.
You were able to learn about the situaion in Ellin Forest from Athena Pierce. She asked you to go help #e#bPerzen#k#n, the magician who created a Barrier Stone to protect Altaire Camp.
You met Perzen on the right side of Altaire Camp.

string.name: name
string.value: Perzen's Barrier
You must help Perzen protect Altaire Camp with his Barrier Stone. Go ask him how you can help.
To keep the Barrier Stone strong, you need to collect energy from the forest's living organisms.\nCollect energy from the monsters infesting the forest.
You gave Perzen the materials needed to strengthen the Barrier Stone. Continue to collect materials whenever time permits to help Perzen.

string.name: name
string.value: Yuris' Sudden Craving
Yuris, the first elf you met in this place, has a request for you. Head over to Yuris.
Yuris wants to eat something sweet and sour. Apparently, her friend Ellin has some fresh fruit that will fit the bill.\nGo visit #eEllin#n in #r#e#m300030100##n#k and talk about Yuris's request.
You met Ellin in #e#m300030100##n.

string.name: name
string.value: Ellin, the Forest Elf
Do you really think you can get fresh fruit in this dark forest...?\nRegardless, go deliver Yuris's message to Ellin.
Ellin was surprised to hear Yuris's request, but she promised that she would give you some sweet and sour fruit if you get her 50 Moss Snail Shells.\n\n
You brought Ellin 50 Moss Snail Shells.

string.name: name
string.value: An Elven Surprise
You brought Ellin all 50 Moss Snail Shells. It's time to get some fruit from her.
Deliver the fresh Oranges to #eYuri#n.
You delivered the fresh Oranges to Yuris.\nYuris's pregnant, and her child's name will be Kyrin...\nWait a minute! Could that be the same Kyrin?

string.name: name
string.value: Lazy, Lazy Tess
Go see Tess by the Altaire Barrier Stone on the left side of the camp.
You must destroy Tree Rods and collect #e#b100 #t4000438##k#n items for the camp.\nYou can find Tree Rods in #m300020000# and #m300020100#.
You collected 100 of #t4000438# items and delivered them to Tess.

string.name: name
string.value: Athena Pierce's Concerns
Athena Pierce in the Altaire Camp Conference Room has something to tell you.
Go visit #b#eShadrion#k#n, who's investigating the Southern Region of Mossy Tree Forest, and ask about the situation there.
You met Shadrion at #m300020000# and asked about the situation there.

string.name: name
string.value: The Violent Forest
You met Shadrion at #m300020000# and heard about the situation there.
Help eliminate the furious Tree Rods and inform Athena Pierce of the South Forest situation.
You eliminated Tree Rods and notified Athena Pierce about the South Forest's situation.\nTurns out the forest is just as thick down there...

string.name: name
string.value: Town Planning
Athena Pierce at Altaire Camp Conference Room has request for you. Go hear what she has to say.
Go ask #b#eLohd#k#n in the Mushroom Hill Entrance about the situation there.
You met Lohd at #m300020200# and asked about the situation there.

string.name: name
string.value: Lohd? Dark Lord?
You found Lohd at #m300020200# and asked him about the situation there. What could be the best site for their town?
You must eliminate 150 Mossy Mushrooms and prove your strength to Lohd.

You eliminated a mess of Mossy Mushrooms as Lohd requested. Is Lohd thinking the same thing as Athena Pierce? And could this person have something to do with Dark Lord, shadowy master of Kerning City?

string.name: name
string.value: Lost Child
Loha has a request. Make sure you listen carefully this time. Last time was awful.
Go ask Sion in the Tent House if Crawls with Balrog liked the Snail Porridge, and if there is anything else she needs.
You visited Sion and asked about little Crawls with Balrog.

string.name: name
string.value: High Fever
Sion is clearly very worried about something. Go ask her what's going on.
Crawls with Balrog has a high fever. You must go explain his symptoms to Loha and get some medicine.
You told Loha that Crawls with Balrog has high fever.

string.name: name
string.value: Fever Medicine
You told Loha that Crawls with Balrog has high fever. Check with Loha again about the Fever Medicine.
Loha doesn't have any medicine at the moment, and asked you to see Perzen for some help.\nExplain the situation to Perzen and ask if he could make some Fever Medicine.
Explain the situation to Perzen and ask if he could make some Fever Medicine.

string.name: name
string.value: Child of Destiny
Ask Perzen about a way to cure Crawls with Balrog.
Perzen asked you to bring some ingredients for making medicine.
You brought the ingredients to Perzen. Will the medicine it cure Crawls with Balrog?

string.name: name
string.value: Sion's Soulmate
Go see Sion at the Tent House to see if Crawls with Balrog is really okay now.
You have to find out if Rius, Sion's soulmate, is okay.\nGo to the western side of the forest and look for #eRius#n.
You found Rius at #m300010200#, carefully studying a Stone Golem.

string.name: name
string.value: Source of Magic
You found Rius at #m300010200#, carefully studying a Stone Golem. Why would he be doing something like that?
You must collect #b#e100 Stone Bug Rubbles#n#k for Rius.\n\nStone Bugs can be found at #m300010100# and #m300010200#.
You brought 100 Stone Bug Rubbles to Rius, and he said that he'll continue his research back at camp, since Sion is so worried.\nReturn to Altaire Camp.

string.name: name
string.value: Big Boar Attack!
Loha at the clinic in the camp has something to say.
Go see #eKanderune#n at #r#eBoulder Mountain Entrance#k#n, and see if he's learned anything about the giant boar.
You met up with Kanderune at Boulder Mountain Entrance.

string.name: name
string.value: Dangerous Rocky Mountain
Meet up with Kanderune at Boulder Mountain Entrance and ask him about the giant boar.
You must eliminate #b#e100 #o5250002##n#k monsters here so that people can safely climb Boulder Moutain.
You eliminated 100 #o5250002# monsters. This area should be a bit safer now, right?

string.name: name
string.value: Boulder Mountain Menace
Kanderune says he discovered something about the giant boar.
You must eliminate #e#b150 #o5250003##n#k monsters and #e#b#o5250004##n#k, the giant boar inside the Boulder Mountain Cave.
You succeeded in eliminating 150 #o5250003# monsters and Chao. Boulder Mountain should be safe to travel now!

string.name: name
string.value: Chao's Tusk
As a proof of defeating Chao, you brought Chao's Tusk to Kanderune. Looks like he has something to say.
Time to show everyone at camp that they need not worry about Chao. Take Chao's Tusk to #b#eLoha#n#k, and bring the goof news to the people at the camp.
You brought Chao's Tusk to Loha, proving your story. People can now pass through the Boulder Mountains safely.

string.name: name
string.value: Yuris' Communication Device
Yuris at Altaire Camp is calling for you. What is it this time?
You have to go ask #b#eEllin at #m300030100##n#k what color she wants the communication device to be. Something tells you that Ellin is not gong to like this...\n
You went to go see Ellin at #m300030100#. Ellin did not care about your question, and instead had something to tell you.

string.name: name
string.value: Darkness Draws Near
Ellin in the #m300030100# has a serious look about her. That probably means she has a favor to ask.
There are fairies here who are conspiring with the Black Mage. I think they're planning something terrible for all of Victoria Island. I need you to get this news to Athena Pierce.
You told Athena Pierce about Ellin's discovery. She looks utterly shocked, and for good reason.

string.name: name
string.value: Unavoidable Fate
You told Athena Pierce about Ellin's discovery. She looks utterly shocked, and for good reason.
Perzen appeared while you were talking with Athena Pierce. See what he has to say.
Everything that Ellin said was true. For the sake of all living things on Victoria Island, you must eliminate the fairies.

string.name: name
string.value: Choosing Survival
You cannot let Victoria Island fall to the schemes of the Black Mage. You must defeat the fairies and stop the forest from being poisoned.\n\n
Ephenia, the queen of the fairies, has joined forces with the Black Mage. You must stop her.
You eliminated 150 #o5250005# monsters and 150 #o5250006# monsters. That should limit the spread of poison...for now.

string.name: name
string.value: Lady of the Corrupted Forest
One task remains, to protect Victoria Island from the Black Mage's evil schemes. Go talk to Perzen for the details.
You must defeat Queen Ephenia, who is trying to eradicate all life on Victoria Island.
You defeated Ephenia and prevented Victoria Island from falling into the hands of the Black Mage.

string.name: name
string.value: Title - Ellin Forest Guardian
By defeating Ephenia, you have saved Victoria Island from disaster. Go see Athena Pierce at the Camp Conference Room obtain the #b<Ellin Forest Guardian>#k title.\n
By defeating Ephenia, you have saved Victoria Island from disaster. Go see Athena Pierce at the Camp Conference Room obtain the #b<Ellin Forest Guardian>#k title.
In recognition of defeating Ephenia and saving Victoria Island, you received the #b<Ellin Forest Guardian>#k title.

string.name: name
string.value: [Fantasy Theme World] Awkward Celebration
Take Spiegelmann's flowers to Madame Ming to congratulate her on the opening of Fantasy Theme World, the newest branch in her line of theme parks.
Get to the #eEast side of Ludibrium#n and take the #b#eCable Car#n#k to Fantasy Theme World to deliver the congratulatory wreath to the park's owner, #r#eMadame Ming#k#n.
Spiegelmann's wreath has been delivered to Madame Ming. Oddly, they seemed to be less than friendly with one another. Something's fishy...

string.name: name
string.value: Grand Opening: Treasure Hunt
Fantasy Theme World's grand opening event is in progress... \nSpeak to Madame Ming for details.\n
Collect five Treasury Notes from monsters around the theme park to receive a gift.
You found all five of the Treasury Notes in Fantasy Theme World.

string.name: name
string.value: Enjoying the Big 3
Fantasy Theme World's grand opening event is in progress... \nSpeak to Madame Ming for details.\n

Try using all three of Fantasy Theme World's featured attractions. 
Visit the #eGhostacular Mansion, the Gyro Drop, and the Viking#n, and collect stamps for riding each one. 


#y31303# #b (#u31303#)#k
#y31304# #b (#u31304#)#k
#y31305# #b (#u31305#)#k
You visited each of the Big 3 attractions and got your stamps.

string.name: name
string.value: Ghost Mansion
Visit one of the Big 3 attractions, the Ghostacular Mansion, at the #m223010100#.\n
Make it all the way through the Ghostacular Mansion without giving up to receive a stamp. Go into the mansion and defeat 50 Ghosts and Rataculas.
There was a real ghost in the Ghostacular Mansion! That white Cuddle Bear seemed really out of place though.

string.name: name
string.value: Broken Gyro Drop
Visit one of the Big 3 attractions, the Gyro Drop, at the #e#b#m223020100##k#n.\n
The Gyro Drop is under repair. Climb to the top and see if you can figure out what is causing the malfunction.
There was a white piece of fur on top of the Gyro Drop. It might be the reason it wasn't working.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Investigate the top of the Gyro Drop: #R31304#

string.name: name
string.value: Fantastic Viking
Visit one of the Big 3 attractions, the Viking, at the #e#b#m223030100##k#n. \n
The Viking isn't a ride, it's a fight! Defeat Bearic the White.
Bearic the White has been defeated. That seemed like a weird thing to have in an amusement park. \nGo see Madame Ming, now that you've visited all three of the big attractions.

string.name: name
string.value: A Ticket to Unemployment
Go to the ticketing window and see if you need to purchase admission.
A Creeper Scarlion stole 20 tickets from the ticketing box while Aily was on break. Go to #b#m223010000##k and recover the tickets from the #e#o8145000##n before Madame Ming finds out!
You got back all 20 tickets before Madame Ming found out.

string.name: name
string.value: A Rataculous Dilemma
Aily's having trouble again. Go find out what she needs.
A nasty monster took some new hats from the gift shop! Go to #e#m223010100##n and defeat the #bRataculas#k to recover the #rFantasy Hats#k.
You found the Fantasy Hats! \n\nGo check out the new rides at the #b#e#m223010200##n#k, and make sure the new #ePart-Time Employee#n is working hard.

string.name: name
string.value: Carousel of Confusion
Checky is passing out flyers in front of the merry-go-round. Go see what he's up to.
#bDefeat the Canterbear#k causing a ruckus at #e#m223010200# near the merry-go-round#n.
The Canterbear has been defeated, as Checky requested. Everything seems nice and quiet.

string.name: name
string.value: Checky's Part-Time Job
Checky handed you a flyer, and wanted to talk to you more.
Take Checky's flyer to the Gray milling around in front of the merry-go-round at the #m223010200#.
You took Checky's flyer to the Lost Gray near the merry-go-round.

string.name: name
string.value: The Lost Grey
Go ask Alien Gray if anything is wrong.
Defeat the Canterbear at #m223010200# and recover Gray's Lost Walkie Talkie.
You found the Lost Walkie Talkie for Gray. Hopefully Gray can phone home.

string.name: name
string.value: Friends Reunited
ee if Lost Gray managed to contact its friends.
The Walkie Talkie worked! Gray's friends are coming.
The Lost Gray was able to return home with its friends.\n\nBefore it left, it suggested you investigate that #eSuspicious Cat#n at the #b#e#m223020000#, near the kiosk#n#k.

string.name: name
string.value: Perfect Stakeout 1
That cat is wearing black sunglasses and carrying a brief case. Not exactly theme park attire, even for a feline. Go see what's going on.
Agent Meow requires balloons for a perfect stakeout. Go defeat the Clowning Scarlions at #m223020000#, and get some balloons for his disguise.
You gave Agent Meow the balloons. That disguise is terrible...

string.name: name
string.value: Perfect Stakeout 2
Agent Meow needs your super secret help again.
Agent Meow needs some popsicles for his stake out. It's super hot outside! Talk to #eAl Scapone#n at the #b#e#m223020100##n near the Gyro Drop#k.
Agent Meow used you to get popsicles! Can you blame him?\nHe also told you there was a #ekindergarten field trip from Edelstein#n having a picnic at the #b#e#m223020100##k#n. Go say hi!

string.name: name
string.value: Exchanging Items
Go get Popsicles from Al Scapone, in front of the Gyro Drop.
Al Scapone wants #i4033239##t4033239# for the Popsicles. \nDefeat Colabears at the #m223020100# and collect #b30 #t4033239##k items.\n
Thirty #t4033239# for ONE #t4033241#?! The price markups at this park are ridiculous.

string.name: name
string.value: Packed Lunch For Kids
Elex, Edelstein's grumpy old kindergarten teacher, is here for a field trip with the kids. Go visit them at the #b#e#m223020100##k#n.
The kids are hungry! get Picnic Lunch Boxes from Al Scapone in #m223020100#.
You took the Picnic Lunch Boxes back to Elex to give to the kids.

string.name: name
string.value: Missing Kids
Elex looks perplexed. Go find out why.
Elex lost the kids from Edelstein kindergarten! \nGo check the airplane rides in the #e#b#m223020200##n#k. They seemed to like those.\n
Fattie was loitering around in front of the airplane at #e#b#m223020200##n#k.
You found Fattie, one of the lost kids, at #m223020200#.
You'll need to bribe Fattie with a Rice Puff to find out where the other kids are hiding.\nAl Scapone will sell you the Rice Puff, IF you defeat #e#b300 Soaring Scarlions#k#n at the #m223020200#.\n
You took down 300 Soaring Scarlions and got that Rice Puff for Fattie. #eSmartie#n is hiding at the #e#b#m223030000##k#n.

string.name: name
string.value: YOU'RE It!
#eSmartie#n is hiding at the #e#b#m223030000##k#n.
Smartie tagged you. Now you're it!! Find out what he's up to.
Smartie tagged you, and now you're it. Tell him that Elex is looking for him.

string.name: name
string.value: Scary Bus-O-Jelly
Tell Smartie to return to Elex.
#m223030000# is too dangerous for Smartie to walk through alone. Defeat the Jellybus to clear the path to Elex.
The vicious Jellybus has been defeated and Smartie returned to Elex. Follow Smartie's directions and go to #e#b#m223030100##k#n to find #eUlrika#n and #eCutie#n.

string.name: name
string.value: Adorable Kids
Find #eUlrika#n and #eCutie#n near The Viking at the #b#m223030100##k.
Ulrika said she would stop playing hide-and-seek if you got her some delicious Cotton Candy. Defeat #bBearic the White#k at #m223030100# and get #r2 Cotton Candies#k for her.
Ulrika and Cutie looked so happy about the sweet treats!

string.name: name
string.value: Strange Deal
Find Al Scapone in front of the Gyro Drop and get 5 Picnic Lunch Boxes.
Al Scapone offered you 5 Picnic Lunch Boxes if you defeat 250 Colabears.\nDefeat the Colabears and retrieve the Picnic Lunch Boxes.\n
You got 5 Picnic Lunch Boxes after defeating all those Colabears. Your mesos aren't worth anything here!

string.name: name
string.value: Making Memories
There is a boy standing next to The Viking. Go see what he's looking at.
Leave a mark near The Viking to show you've been there.
You left your mark at The Viking.

string.name: name
string.value: Graffiti Absolutely Forbidden!
Oliver, the theme park employee, saw you writing your name on the wall. You're in trouble now!
You will need some Sparkling Cleaner to clean off the graffiti you made. Go to #m223030000#, defeat the #bJellybus#k, and retrieve the #rcleaner#k.
Tagging is dumb! Stop making graffiti all over the place...

string.name: name
string.value: Strange Teddy Bear
Aily looks upset. Go find out why.
Go let Madame Ming know about the strange Teddy Bears that have been appearing around Fantasy Theme World.
You let Madame Ming know about the strange Teddy Bears.

string.name: name
string.value: Fantastic Show!
Madame Ming mentioned a great show you shouldn't miss in Fantasy Theme World. Go find out what it is.
Visit the Fantasy Crittertorium at #m223030210#. But first, find Oliver in #m223030200#.
You found Oliver in #m223030200#.

string.name: name
string.value: Dangerous Performance
Ask Oliver about the Fantasy Crittertorium.
Watch the two main attractions of the Fantasy Crittertorium, the Ursa Awesome Show and the Leaping Leo Revue, then tell Madame Ming what you thought.
You defeated the Scarboss and Targa that appeared in the Fantasy Crittertorium.

string.name: name
string.value: Uninvited Guest
There was a report that that the strange Teddy Bear that was showing up around Fantasy Theme World was also seen at the Fantasy Crittertorium show. Find that white bear!
Find out who that weird white bear was that showed up in the Fantasy Crittertorium.
That strange bear was Spiegelmann! He said he was just visiting, but something fishy's going on...

string.name: name
string.value: Title - Baby Fantastique

Madame Ming will give a special gift to any loyal patrons who visit all of the theme park attractions during the grand opening of Fantasy Theme World.\nHave fun in Fantasy Theme World, and earn the #b<Baby Fantastique>#k title!\n
Have a great time in Fantasy Theme World, and earn the #b<Baby Fantastique>#k title.
You managed to hit all of the attractions in Fantasy Theme World and earned the #b<Baby Fantastique>#k title!\n

You got the #bAncient Dragon Wing Scales#k from #bChief Tatamo#k!

string.name: name
string.value: Passing the Quiz
Meet the #b#p9250121##k.

Give the correct answer to the quiz given by the #b#p9250121##k.
Only problem is...
#rΔt = [ Δt0 ] / [ root{ 1 - ( v/c )^2} ]#k is all you can remember.
You made contact with the #b#p9250121##k.

string.name: name
string.value: The Way Home
Talk to #b#p9250122##k, who is getting a lot of attention for being clad in Chemical Protective Clothing.
Escort #b#p9250122##k at the #b#m502010010##k to the OSSS Secret Base. \r\n\r\nTalk to #b#p9250122##k and enter the #b#m502010100##k.
You successfully escorted #b#p9250122##k

string.name: name
string.value: Building a Time Machine
#b#p9250125##k is waiting for someone to collect materials for the Time Machine today.

Help #b#p9250125##k build a Time Machine.

If you complete the missions given to you by #b#p9250126##k, you will receive Completion Certificates.

Take all 6 Completion Certificates to #b#p9250125##k.
You spent the day helping #b#p9250125##k build a Time Machine.

string.name: name
string.value: Building a Time Machine 1: Deep Sea Janitor
#b#p9250126##k is looking for Mainboards, which are needed to build the Time Machine.

Use the OS4 Shuttle located in the OSSS Secret Base 
to travel to the #b#m502010200##k.

You must destroy the Space Ship parts located throughout the deep sea

and bring back 10 Mainboards #b#i04032708:##k.
You retrieved the Mainboards required for the Time Machine.

string.name: name
string.value: Building a Time Machine 2: Vegetable Oil
#b#p9250126##k is looking for Vegetable Oil needed to build the Time Machine.
Hunt the vegetable monsters in Maple World and bring back 10 containers of Vegetable Oil #b#i04032703:##k.
You collected the Vegetable Oil required for the Time Machine.

string.name: name
string.value: Building a Time Machine 3: Miner in a Gas Mask
#b#p9250126##k is looking for Fossil Minerals, which are needed to build the Time Machine.

Use the OS4 Shuttle located in the OSSS Secret Base to travel to the #b#m502010300##k.\r\n\r\nDestroy the Fossil Mineral mounds located throughout the mine and bring back 10 Fossil Minerals #b#i04032709:##k.
You brought back the Fossil Minerals required for the Time Machine.

string.name: name
string.value: Building a Time Machine 4: Carnivorous
#b#p9250126##k is looking for Animal Gas needed to build the Time Machine.
Hunt the animal monsters in Maple World and bring back 10 containers of Animal Gas #b#i04032704:##k.
You collected the Animal Gas required for the Time Machine.

string.name: name
string.value: Building a Time Machine 5: Why's the Processing Plant so Far?
#b#p9250126##k is looking for someone to deliver all the Time Machine materials to the Processing Plant.
Use the OS4 Shuttle to deliver the materials for the Time Machine to the Processing Plant.\r\n\r\nWhen the shuttle arrives at the Processing Plant, enter the Processing Plant and come back out.
You delivered the materials for the Time Machine to the Processing Plant.

string.name: name
string.value: Building a Time Machine 6: Defend, Defend, Defend!
#b#p9250126##k needs someone to help defend the Processing Plant.
Help Randall defend the Processing Plant.
You successfully helped Randall defend the Processing Plant. Great work!

string.name: name
string.value: Glorious Worker
#b#p9250125##k wants to reward you for your assistance in building the Time Machine.
#b#p9250125##k says you'll get a reward if you help for one week!\r\nHmmm, what could the reward be?
#b#p9250125##k gave you the OS4 Shuttle.
A Public Phone has been placed in every town.\r\nThe phone is ringing... Should you answer?
You picked up the phone and were connected with someone on the other line.
You must meet #b#p9250121##k, who is hidden in every town. Remember the formula: #rΔt = [ Δt0 ] / [ root{ 1 - ( v/c )^2} ]#k that #b#p9250125##k mentioned.

string.name: name
string.value: Final Visitor
The Visitor Representative turned out to be a #b#p9250124##k.\r\nHow could this be? Go find out.
You heard the entire story from #b#p9250124##k.\r\nYou must now use the Cube Conversion Device at the crashed Mothership entrance to enter Doctor Bing's Cube.
You decided to help #b#p9250124##k stop the Time Machine from being built.

string.name: name
string.value: Preventing the Creation of the Time Machine
#b#p9250124##k is waiting for someone to help stop the Time Machine from being built.
Use the #b#p9250138##k inside #b#m502040000##kand return to the past so that you can prevent the Time Machine from being built.
You helped #b#p9250124##k stop the Time Machine from being built.

string.name: name
string.value: Correcting the Past 1: Good Bye Janitor
Future Doctor Bing is looking for someone to prevent the collection of Mainboards required to build a Time Machine.
Go to the Deep Sea in the past using the #b#p9250138##k and defeat the #b#o9420069#s#k that are collecting Mainboards.
You prevented the collection of Mainboards, which are required to build a Time Machine.

string.name: name
string.value: Correcting the Past 2: Good Bye Miner
Future Doctor Bing is looking for someone to prevent the collection of Fossil Minerals required to build a Time Machine.
Go to the Mine in the past using the #b#p9250138##k and defeat the #b#o9420070#s#k that are collecting Fossil Minerals.
You prevented the collection of Fossil Minerals, which are required to build a Time Machine.

string.name: name
string.value: Correcting the Past 3: Catching Up to Tortoise
Future Doctor Bing is looking for someone to prevent the delivery of materials to the Processing Plant.
Go to the Underground Passage in the past using the #b#p9250138##k and defeat the #b#o9420073#s#k that are delivering materials for the Time Machine.
You prevented the Time Machine materials from being delivered to the Processing Plant.

string.name: name
string.value: Correcting the Past 4: Destroy, Destroy, Destroy!
Future Doctor Bing is looking for someone to destroy the OS3A machine that is defending the Processing Plant.
Go to the Processing Plant in the past using the #b#p9250138##k and defeat #b#o9420074#s#k, who is commanding the plant's defense.
You stopped #b#o9420074##k, who was defending the Processing Plant.

string.name: name
string.value: Chance for a Counter Attack
Doctor Bing says that he has some big news.\r\nGo see Doctor Bing in his laboratory.
You received information about the Mothership's crash from Doctor Bing.\r\nFind Doctor Bing's forces and head over to the Mothership crash site.
You received information from Wynn, who was analyzing the Mothership at the crash site.

string.name: name
string.value: Melted Chocolate
The chocolate has been melted! The Maple Admin wants to discuss this with you...

string.name: name
string.value: Melted Chocolate Exchange
Collect 9 #b#t3994199#s#k to exchange for any chocolate from the Maple Admin.
You received a chocolate for 9 #b#t3994199#s#k.

string.name: name
string.value: To the Future
If you're ready, talk to #b#p9250125##k.

In order to start Bing Machine - Alpha, you must go to the future and bring back some Crystanol. \r\nUse the Time Machine located in the room next to Doctor Bing and travel to the future. \r\nTo the future! That's pretty crazy...
You're finally able to equip the Bing Machine! Now all that is left is to defeat the aliens.

string.name: name
string.value: To the Energy Laboratory
A Mapler who seems to have arrived before you is hiding amongst the grass.\r\nYou should start a conversation.

You discovered the location of the Crystanol Fragment. You must take the portal to the right of #b#p9250130##k and continue until you reach the Energy Laboratory. If you meet aliens on the way, hide in the grass.
You arrived at the Energy Laboratory. \r\nBut there is an Anti-Theft Laser preventing your approach. What to do?

string.name: name
string.value: How to Enter?
You met another Mapler at the Energy Laboratory. Should you try starting a conversation?
You arrived at the Energy Laboratory but an Anti-Theft Laser is preventing your approach. There is a Teleport Device nearby which may allow you to pass through safely...
The Teleport Device has been turned on! All that is left is to retrieve a Crystanol Fragment and return to the Time Machine.

string.name: name
string.value: Crystanol Retrieval
Now that the Teleport Device has been turned on, time to find some Crystanol!
You found a Crystanol Fragment! Now it's time to return to the Time Machine. But before you do that, you should give #b#p9250130##k some detailed information about the Energy Laboratory.
Now, use the Time Machine to return to the present and deliver the Crystanol Fragment to Doctor Bing.

string.name: name
string.value: Equipping the Bing Machine-Alpha.
You've received the Bing Machine-Alpha. But #b#p9250125##k seems to have something he wants to say...
You've received the Bing Machine-Alpha. But #b#p9250125##k seems to have something he wants to say...
Talk to #b#p9250133##k.

string.name: name
string.value: OSSS Mission 1: Alien Elimination
Receive an OSSS Mission from #b#p9250133##k.

Defeat #b20 Powerful Aliens, 20 Wise Aliens, and 20 Lucky Aliens, who appear when you defeat Unidentified Powerful Aliens, Unidentified Wise Aliens, and Unidentified Lucky Aliens, respectively#k and return to #bHead Researcher Wynn#k.\r\n\r\nYou must be wearing a #bBing Machine or a Visitor Suit#k to defeat the aliens.
Receive this mission again after completing the other missions.

string.name: name
string.value: OSSS Mission 2: Protecting the Scientists
Receive an OSSS Mission from #b#p9250133##k.

Protect two scientists hard at work throughout Maple World. When you find a scientist and start a conversation, aliens will appear. You must protect the scientists. You will not be able to do the mission when another Mapler is protecting the scientist.
Receive this mission again after completing the other missions.

string.name: name
string.value: OSSS Mission 3: Alien Photo
Receive an OSSS Mission from #b#p9250133##k.
Use the #bOSSS Camera#k to take photographs of #b3 Unidentified Dexterous Aliens#k. \r\n\r\nYou can use the camera by #bdouble clicking on it in front of an Unidentified Dexterous Alien#k.
Receive this mission again after completing the other missions.

string.name: name
string.value: OSSS Mission 4: Retrieving Alien Chips and Spy Cameras
Receive an OSSS Mission from #b#p9250133##k.

The aliens have planted Spy Chips and Spy Cameras inside monsters in Maple World. Retrieve 30 of each so that the aliens can no longer monitor Maple World. You have a chance to obtain Spy Chips and Spy Cameras whenever you defeat monsters in Maple World.
Receive this mission again after completing the other missions.

string.name: name
string.value: Talk to Principal Researcher Bass
Talk to #b#p9250134##k about the Demoralizing Aliens Project proposed by OSSS.
You heard from #b#p9250134##k about the Demoralizing Aliens Project proposed by OSSS.

string.name: name
string.value: United Against Alien Scum!
Talk to #b#p9250134##k about the Demoralizing Aliens Project proposed by OSSS.
Find the friend #b#p9250134##k has chosen and raise their fame.\r\nIf the friend has disappeared, forfeit the quest and start again.
You raised the fame of a friend in Maple World and received a medal.

string.name: name
string.value: OSSS Mission Issued
OSSS is ready to issue a mission. Talk to #b#p9250133##k when you're ready.
Use the Orders given to you by #b#p9250133##k and complete each of the OSSS missions. When you complete the missions, you'll be given #b#t04310004#s#k.
You've completed all of the OSSS missions. If you want to be issued these missions again, talk to #b#p9250133##k.

string.name: name
string.value: Clearing Party Quests

Each time you clear a party quest, OSSS will issue you a #b#t04310004##k. 

Party Quest List:
#b<Moon Bunny>, <First Time Together>, <Ariant Coliseum>, <The Crack of Dimensions>, <Forest of Poison Fog>, <Monster Carnival>, <Monster Carnival 2>, <Remnant of the Goddess>, <Lord Pirate>, <Romeo and Juliet>, <Dragon Rider>#k

Return to #b#p9250134##k after clearing the party quest to receive a #b#t04310004##k.

Just remember that you can only get credit for 1 party quest a day.
You cleared the party quest and received a #b#t04310004##k from #b#p9250134##k.\r\n\r\nHold on to the #b#t04310004##k as it can be used to upgrade the Bing Machine-Alpha and Visitor equipment.

string.name: name
string.value: Demoralizing the Aliens
Show the aliens how many brave Maplers there are in Maple World! For every hour you're online, OSSS will issue you #b#t04310004##k.
Since OSSS will be issuing you #b#t04310004##k every hour you're logged in, you should stay connected and not log off.
You received #b#t04310004##k for staying online for an hour. Good job doing your part to scare away the aliens!

string.name: name
string.value: Is This A Dream?
You're back in the present and the Future Doctor Bing has sent you a message.\r\n(How did he send a message?)

The Future Doctor Bing wants you to meet his present self.
Use the Command Center Warp Capsule #i2030011# to warp to the Omega Sector.

Find Doctor Bing, who is somewhere inside.
Doctor Bing is hard at work and doesn't seem to have any idea what's going on.\r\n\r\n(Yet...)

string.name: name
string.value: OSSS Mission 5: Infiltrating the Mothership
You can now infiltrate the alien mothership!\r\nGet a new OSSS mission from #b#p9250146##k at the mothership crash site.

Enter the Cube in the air through the mothership. 
Defeat all the aliens inside and return to #b#p9250146##k to get a medal.

You can enter #bthe most difficult Cube once a day, the middle difficulty Cube three times a day, and the low difficulty Cube without limit#k.

You will be required to wear the Visitor Suit, which is upgraded from Bing Machine-Alpha Suit when entering the Cubes except for the Lv.30 Cube.
Return tomorrow to infiltrate the mothership again.\r\nDon't forget that the future of Maple World is in your hands.

string.name: name
string.value: Unidentified Spaceship
An unidentified spaceship has crashed in Maple World. Talk to #b#p9250156##k, who is in Henesys, Orbis, Ludibrium, and Omega Sector, and go to the spaceship crash site.

A spaceship presumably belonging to aliens has crash landed in Maple World. An organization called the OSSS seems to be investigating it. Investigate the cube-shaped spaceship and defeat the leader of the aliens before returning to #b#p9250154##k.
You explored the alien cube and defeated the Ultimate Visitor.\r\nBut why do you feel as if you've been here before...

string.name: name
string.value: A White Christmas
A penguin dressed like Santa has appeared in every major town!\r\nFind out what's going on.
A penguin has requested your help.\r\n\r\nGo see if there's a penguin in town dressed like Santa.
Ah, now that the tree is decorated, the holidays feel complete!

string.name: name
string.value: The Great Blacksmith

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Now that you are Lv. 30, Kyrin says she has some interesting information for you.

#bKyrin suggested that you find a skillful blacksmith to repair the broken Core Fragment.#k Ask Kyrin about the shortcut that leads to the Blacksmith Laboratory. \r\n#rTip: If you wish to go back to the Blacksmith Laboratory during the quest, you must forfeit the quest and start again.
Can a mere blacksmith really repair the broken core?

string.name: name
string.value: Enhancing the Core

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Kyrin introduced you to a talented, but arrogant, blacksmith. If he really can fix anything, maybe he can fix the core. He says he only needs Blue Ore to enhance the core.

Can the blacksmith really power up the core using only Blue Ore? The core is supposed to be the pinnacle of technology... Might as well try, since Kyrin vouched for him. \r\n#rTip: If you wish to go back to the Blue Ore Cave during the quest, you must forfeit the quest and start again.
Well, that wasn't easy, but enhancing the core should be worth it! Assuming the blacksmith can live up to his claims... Bring him the Blue Ore and see what happens.

string.name: name
string.value: Enhancing the Broken Core

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]

After plenty of daring-do, you got the Blue Ore the blacksmith asked for. You sense a strong, unusual energy within it. Seem like this could enhance the core, but can the blacksmith really do it himself? One way to find out...
The blacksmith is working hard to enhance the broken core. Seeing him in action has eliminated all of your doubts; this guy is really good! It will be interesting to see how the core comes out.
Your core is brimming with power! This means you've completed your 2nd Job Advancement! Better go find Burke and track down the last core. It's time to clear everything up once and for all!

string.name: name
string.value: Cracked Core

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Your core has been enhanced, but it's power is still unstable. Using it so much in your adventures must have damaged it. You better hope it doesn't break completely...

#bAccording to the blacksmith, you need to brave the Blast Furnace to find Fire Ore for your core.#k Why can't things ever be easy? Better get going! \r\n#rTip: If you wish to go back to the Blast Furnace during the quest, you must forfeit the quest and start again.
The core has been fully restored, and seems to be even more powerful than before! With this, you have completed your 3rd Job Advancement. Now find Burke and set the record straight!

string.name: name
string.value: Secret Trade Request

string.name: parent
string.value: Secret Alchemy Request
#p2111007# in #m261000000# has a secret request for you.

The Matter Disassembler that #b#p2111007##k at #bMagatia#k wants to make seems a bit suspicious. Since it's a request from a secret organization, perhaps it's related to the core? 

#i4000357##t4000357# #b#c4000357##k/50 
#i4000358##t4000358# #b#c4000358##k/50 
#i4000364##t4000364# #b#c4000364##k/50

string.name: name

string.name: parent

Return to #b#p2111007##k at #b#m261000000##k with the device.

string.name: parent
string.value: Secret Alchemy Request

#b#p2111007##k wants you to give the Matter Disassembler to the client at #b#m260020620##k in his place. This might be a good chance to get some more information on the core.
Looks like the secret organization wants to use the core for evil, but only your family can tap its power. Why did #b#p9270084##k let you live despite knowing this fact?

string.value: Baroq's Bunny Battlers

string.value: Power Up

string.name: name
string.value: Gachapon Reborn
Gachapons have gotten a complete overhaul. Talk to the Maple Admin to find out all the new features.

Gachapons have been revamped. 

You will now find regular, chair, mount, and Nebulite gachapons are together in one!

But wait, there's more! The rewards have been updated to be better than ever! Almost all level 70 and below equips, many cheap scrolls, lower value Gachapon food items, 15-day mounts, and D-grade Nebulites have been removed.

The existing mount/Nebulite gachapon tickets can be traded in at the Gachapon NPC. 
(Chair gachapons can still be used with a double-click.)

Gachapons have been revamped.

You will now find regular, chair, mount, and Nebulite gachapons are together in one!
