string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to The Touch of Oda 2 quest
Nobunaga's touch has definitely reached Orbis. The nearby monsters may provide some clues to his whereabouts. Start with the Star Picxies in Cloud Park I.

string.name: name
string.value: The Touch of Oda 2
Spiruna thinks you should continue your investigation. Go back and talk to her.
Spiruna wants you to hunt down some Lunar Pixies in Cloud Park III because she thinks they may be harboring the Oda clan.
You took down the Lunar Pixies, but you didn't find anything. This is starting to look a little fishy...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to the The Touch of Oda 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Touch of Oda 3
Spiruna thinks you should continue your investigation. Go back and talk to her.
Spiruna wants you to hunt down Luster Pixies in Cloud Park V.
The Luster Pixies were just as useless as the rest of them. Maybe Spiruna doesn't actually know anything...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to the The Touch of Oda 4 quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Touch of Oda 4
Spiruna says she knows something important... what could it be?
Spiruna saw one of Oda's men in the Garden of Darkness. She said she saw a man in black with long flowing hair. Sounds like Akechi Mitsuhide...
It wasn't Mitsuhide, but Nobunaga definitely had a hand in this. Get back to Momijigaoka.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to The Full Report quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Full Report
Nobunaga's influence over Maple World's monsters should not be so pervasive, but it is worth looking into. Speak with Haruaki in Momijigaoka.
Speaking of which, how is Sanada Yukimori doing? You should go back to Orbis to find out.
Yukimori told you about similar events occurring in Ludibrium. The Oda clan's reach has gone far since you arrived. Yukimori will report back to Momijigaoka while you go investigate.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to the Return Orders quest

string.name: name
string.value: Return Orders
Haruaki sent you a letter. It might be urgent.
Haruaki discovered the princess's whereabouts. Finally! Get back to Momijigaoka on the double and talk to Haruaki.
Ask Haruaki for a debriefing.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 143,742\nCan proceed to the An Eye on Honnou-ji quest

string.name: name
string.value: An Eye on Honnou-ji
Ask Tsuchimikado Haruaki about the princess.
Nobunaga still has the princess, but Takeda Shingen has a plan to rescue her. See if you can help.
Shingen's plan is to have an elite group infiltrate Honnou-ji to rescue the princess. Hey, aren't you elite?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 143,742\nCan proceed to the Honnou-ji Infiltration 1 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Honnou-ji Infiltration 1
Plan out the Honnou-ji infiltration with Shingen.
Head north from Momijigahara to meet up with Sanada Yukimura. From there, climb the Eastern Honnou-ji wall and make your way to the Eastern Wing. Yukimura will watch your back.
You and Yukimura are ready to enter Honnou-ji. Prepare for a sneaking mission!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 143,742\nCan proceed to the Honnou-ji Infiltration 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Honnou-ji Infiltration 2
Talk to Yukimura about the infiltration plan.
Princess Sakuno is here somewhere. Hurry to the Eastern Wing!
Princess Sakuno is safe! It doesn't look like Nobunaga was too rough with her either.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Saving Sakuno

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 143,742\nCan proceed to Internal Affairs quest

string.name: name
string.value: Internal Affairs
The rescue plan was a complete success and Princess Sakuno is safe. Report back to Tsuchimikado Haruaki.
Princess Sakuno has had time to regain her bearings. Go find out what she knows.
With the princess safe, all that's left is Nobunaga. Once he's gone, you can return to Japan and restore your clan's rightful place.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 143,742
Can proceed to the Movin' on Mu Lung quest
Can proceed to the Mist Cutter quest

string.name: name
string.value: Movin' on Mu Lung
The princess sent you a letter. What could it be for?
Athena Pierce sent a message to Momijigaoka about Oda forces invading Mu Lung. You should hurry to Mu Lung and talk to Tae Sang.
You arrived in Mu Lung and spoke with Tae Sang.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353\nCan proceed to the Mu Lung's Contribution quest

string.name: name
string.value: Mu Lung's Contribution
Mu Lung, the village of pandas... What a mystical place. Ask Tae Sang about anyone suspicious he may have seen.
Tae Sang saw some shady characters around Mu Lung, but he didn't pay much attention to them.
You found Tae Soo, the peach farm manager.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353\nCan proceed to the Tae Soo and You quest

string.name: name
string.value: Tae Soo and You
Ask Tae Soo if he saw anyone suspicious nearby.

Tae Soo says that the Peach Monkies and Reindeer have become more vicious ever since an unfamiliar group appeared near the farm. He wants you to get rid of them. This definitely seems to be the work of Nobunaga and the Black Wings.\r\nSearch for clues as you hunt Peach Monkies and Reindeer.
You disciplined the Peach Monkies and Reindeer that were traipsing around the peach farm. As expected, you found Oda emblems.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353\nCan proceed to the Forest Happenings quest

string.name: name
string.value: Forest Happenings
Ask Tae Soo if he has any information on the suspicious group.
Ask Do Gong if he has any information on the suspicious group.
Do Gong in the Mu Lung Temple has somehow already heard about the recent events. They don't call him master for nothing.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353\nCan proceed to the Mu Lung Mojo quest

string.name: name
string.value: Mu Lung Mojo
Listen to what Do Gong has to say about the Oda Army's appearance in Mu Lung.

Do Gong says that Maple World's energy is strongest in Mu Lung, so there have been some instances of evildoers visiting to seek energy.\r\nNobunaga is probably headed toward the Virtuous Forest, where the energy flows freely into Mu Lung. Go there and fight the Sage Cats.
The Sage Cats carried traces of Nobunaga's forces, just as Do Gong expected. What is Nobunaga up to?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353\nCan proceed to the Shadow of Chaos

string.name: name
string.value: Shadow of Chaos
Listen to what Do Gong has to say about Nobunaga's destination.
Do Gong thinks that the Oda Army is headed for the Goblin Forest in the Virtuous Forest, the center of Maple World's energy. Investigate the Goblin Forest.
Surprisingly, it wasn't Oda who colluded with the Black Wings to make the monsters go on a rampage. It was Akechi Mitsuhide, acting independently! Mitsuhide left Nobunaga to create a new faction!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353\nCan proceed to the Chaos Rising quest

string.name: name
string.value: Chaos Rising
Princess Sakuno sent a letter not long after you sent her the report on Mitsuhide's scheme. Take a look.
Princess Sakuno has advised you not to ignore Akechi Mitsuhide. She's a smart lady. It would be wise to take a moment to think before you talk to her again.
Akechi Mitsuhide's troops have splintered away from the Oda clan. You must train hard to defeat them both and restore the glory of the Matsuyama clan!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353\nCan proceed to the Unexpected Message quest

string.name: name
string.value: Unexpected Message
Princess Sakuno sent you a letter. See what she said.
The princess is ordering you to return to Momijigaoka ASAP.
You returned to Momijigaoka just as the princess ordered. What's so urgent?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320\nCan proceed to the Unexpected Messenger quest

string.name: name
string.value: Unexpected Messenger
Listen to the princess's urgent message.
It feels wrong to just ignore Hideyoshi's letter. Support the mission in any way you can.
You were briefed on the mission, but the generals could not reach an agreement. If only Haruaki would sort this out.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320\nCan proceed to The Fourth King of Heaven quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Fourth King of Heaven
You learned about the Hideyoshi rendezvous mission, but the generals still did not reach a consensus. If only Haruaki would sort this out...
Tsuchimikado Haruaki stepped in to break the stalemate. Meet with Sanada Yukimori at the Eastern Honnou-ji walls and talk to Hideyoshi.
Hashiba Hideyoshi, one of Nobunaga's Four Heavenly Kings, was waiting for you when you reached eastern Honnou-ji walls.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320\nCan proceed to the Questionable Allegiance quest

string.name: name
string.value: Questionable Allegiance
You met with Nobunaga's man outside Honnou-ji, but what does he really want? Go find out.
Hideyoshi claims to want to defect to the alliance, along with Tokugawa Ieyasu, but your meeting was cut short by a legion of Nobunaga's troops. Take care of them before you speak with him again.
Nobunaga has eyes everywhere. You beat his troops, but more will be coming.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320\nCan proceed to the No Love for the Demon King quest

string.name: name
string.value: No Love for the Demon King
These territories are no longer safe. Return to Momijigaoka and talk to Tadakatsu.
You brought Nobunaga's commanders back to Momijigaoka while Tadakatsu fended off the remaining enemy troops. It's time to report to Princess Sakuno.
Hideyoshi and Ieyasu have left the Oda ranks and joined the alliance. This will cripple Nobunaga's ambitions. The final battle is almost here!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320\nCan proceed to the Alliance Assemble quest

string.name: name
string.value: Alliance Assemble
Princess Sakuno sent you a letter. See what she said.
Shingen is calling for all members of the alliance to return to Momijigaoka.
You returned to Momijigaoka and talked Shingen. The heroes are in one place, the stage is set for victory!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028\nCan proceed to the Sengoku Showdown quest

string.name: name
string.value: Sengoku Showdown
Shingen looks ready for a pre-battle speech. Hear him out.
The chance to crush Nobunaga once and for all is here! To Honnou-ji!
Shingen stopped you at the entrance to Honnou-ji. He has a personal request...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028\nCan proceed to the The Demon's Lair 1 quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Demon's Lair 1
What does Takeda Shingen want? It's time for battle!
Shingen wants you to secure an entryway into the temple. Defeat 200 low-ranking Oda warriors.
You cleared out the low-level Oda warriors. The entrance should be secure.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028\nCan proceed to the The Demon's Lair 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Demon's Lair 2
The battle rages on. Now that the allied forces are inside the temple, talk to Takeda Shingen.
Shingen wants you to find and defeat 300 Samurai Captains.
The Oda troops are running around with no leadership! Victory is at hand!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028\nCan proceed to the The Demon's Lair 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Demon's Lair 3
The allies are on the road to victory, but Nobunaga has more tricks up his sleeve.
Enter the temple and defeat Takigawa Kazumasu, one of Oda's Four Heavenly Kings.
With Kazumasu down and Honnou-ji back under your control, you can only wonder where Nobunaga has fled. He and his cronies have escaped for now... but they will face their judgment.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028\nCan proceed to the The End of an Era quest

string.name: name
string.value: The End of an Era
The allies are victorious, Honnou-ji has been recaptured, but Nobunaga is gone. Return to Tsuchimikado Haruaki and see if there is anything else you can do.
Wherever Nobunaga is, he will not be resting. Train hard and prepare for the day you come face to face. The era of war is over, but the era of peace will need a leader...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028\n

string.name: name
string.value: Maple Adjustment Period

string.name: type
string.value: [Job Advancement]
Your short time in Maple World has made you stronger. It's time to start reclaiming your lost skills.
Your short time in Maple World has made you stronger. It's time to start reclaiming your lost skills.

string.name: name
string.value: Hayato 3rd Job Advancement

string.name: type
string.value: Job Advancement
Hayato's 3rd Job Advancement is complete!

string.name: name
string.value: Hayato 4th Job Advancement

string.name: type
string.value: Job Advancement
4th Hayato Job Advancement completed!

string.name: name
string.value: A Gift from Shingen
Takeda Shingen is looking for you. What could he need?
The Takeda clan wanted to get you a present for all your help, but Shingen is terrible at buying gifts. He thought Kikkawa Motoharu might have something for you.
Shingen granted you permission to use his favorite horse, Onikageh. The beast is treasured for being the best of its breed, so treat it well.

string.name: name
string.value: A God Among Horses
Princess Sakuno has contacted you. What could it be?
Princess Sakuno has requested your presence in Momijigaoka.
The princess complimented your abilities as a warrior and granted you a harness that was used by the former Lord Nobukageh. This new harness fits Onikageh perfectly. He seems to like it!

string.name: name
string.value: Mist Cutter
Princess Sakuno has requested your presence! What could it be?
Princess Sakuno has requested your presence! What could it be?
Though the Mist Cutter was thought lost during the battle with Nobunaga, it has been reforged by Princess Sakuno. This blade is a treasure of your family. May it serve you well.

string.name: name
string.value: Motonari the Magnanimous
Mouri Motonari has requested your presence! What could he need?
Mouri Motonari has requested your presence! What could he need?
You have received a new weapon and armor from Mouri Motonari.

string.name: name
string.value: Lost Memories Found

The Memory Keeper believes you should return to the place you began your adventure to get your memories back. Maybe it was, #m807000000#, the place where you took your first steps into Maple World. Go see #b#p9130008##k.
It's been a long time since you last met #p9130008#. He seemed pleased with your growth in Maple World.
It's been a long time since you last met #p9130008#. He seemed pleased with your growth in Maple World.

string.name: name
string.value: The Mushking Empire Incident
There's trouble in the Mushking Empire!
Take #b#p9130008##k's #brecommendation letter#k to #b#p1300005##k in the Mushking Empire.
You have met the Guard Captain of Mushking Empire with #b#p9130008##k's recommendation letter.

string.name: name
string.value: Unfamiliar Hillside
What is this strange land?
You destroyed the altar at Honnou-ji and stopped the ritual to summon the demon king, you must have passed out at some point. There's got to be someone around here.
Fortunately, Naoe Kanetsugu witnessed the event. He'll know what happened during that incident.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 621 Can proceed to the Zipangu's World quest

string.name: name
string.value: Zipangu's World
Ask Kanetsugu what happened.
Kanetsugu said something about a pillar of light and another world...maybe you should get some more details.
According to Kanetsugu, people arrived from another world and built a new base.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 621 Can proceed to the Fresh Start quest

string.name: name
string.value: Fresh Start
Kanetsugu's story is unbelievable. You can think about it while you follow Kanetsugu.
Follow Kanetsugu to the new base to gather more information.
Kanetsugu left to search for Kenshin. Meet Mouri at the base like Kanetsugu instructed.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,242 #i2001500:# #t2001500:# x100 #i2001503:# #t2001503:# x100 Can proceed to the Powerless quest
You arrived at Momijigaoka, the new base. The red maple leaves here really are quite distinctive! Someone around here must know what's going on.
Motonari and his three sons arrived on this world before anyone else and built Momijigaoka base. He showed you that you can't use your usual magic here.
Motonari explains that you feel week because the laws of physics in this world differ from those in Japan. He offers to help.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,242 Can proceed to the Adaptation 1 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Adaptation 1
Motonari has a plan to get you accustomed to the wacky physics here. It probably involves an awesome training montage.
Go to Training Dojo 1 and take down 10 Floateyes.
The familiars helped you build up your strength, but you still feel weak. You need more training!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,012 Can proceed to the Adaption 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Adaptation 2
You're beginning to adjust to this new world, but it'll still be a while before you're back at full strength.
Go to Training Dojo 2 and take down 20 Onieye enemies.
You feel a little stronger, but you're still nowhere near full strength.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 762 Can proceed to the Adaptation 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Adaptation 3
You're beginning to adjust to this new world, but it'll still be a while before you're back at full strength.
Go to Training Dojo 3 and take down 30 Conjurete enemies.
You feel a little stronger, but you're still nowhere near full strength.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 710 Can proceed to the Dark Times quest

string.name: name
string.value: Dark Times
Motonari's training helped you a little, but it's still not enough. Who knows what enemies you'll face in this new world?
This is no time for dark thoughts. It's time to move on.
You forced yourself to keep going, in spite of everything that's happened.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,242
#i2001501:# #t2001501:# x100
#i2001503:# #t2001503:# x100
Can proceed to the Blind and Battered 1 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Blind and Battered 1
Motonari is looking for you. Something must have happened at Momijigaoka.
Oda reconnaissance was sighted near Momijigaoka. Quickly dispose of the reconnaissance team and retrieve the Scout's Report before Momijigaoka is discovered!
You've defeated all the visible Oda Scouts. That should be enough to prevent the enemies from discovering the Momijigaoka.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,246 \r\n#i2430824:# #t2430824:# x1\r\nCan proceed to the Blind and Battered 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Blind and Battered 2
Your first battle in this world went off without a hitch. And Kanetsugu is back!
Kanetsugu was quite successful. You need to step it up and completely block the enemy's scouting activities. Defeat 50 more Oda Scouts.
You feel like you can do better when it comes to stopping the scouts. It has nothing to do with Kanetsugu's work. It wasn't even that impressive, really.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,575 \r\nCan proceed to the Blind and Battered 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Blind and Battered 3
There still might be scouts out there. Is there any way to completely thwart the enemy's efforts?
There should be a superior who commands the scouts. Go to Maple Hill Road 2 to try and find the commander.
You met Kenshin deeper in enemy territory. She just arrived too, but her skill with the sword is as elegant and smooth as ever. The altered physics don't seem to slow her down.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 545 \r\nCan proceed to the Blind and Battered 4 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Blind and Battered 4
Kenshin mistook you for an enemy and nearly sliced your nose off. You might want to clue her in on the situation before you lose something you like.

Kenshin has no interest in talking on the battlefield. It's a place of battle after all. Maybe you can satisfy her thirst for combat so she'll talk to you.\r\nGo back to the original plan and defeat the superior Oda Scout to gain her respect.
After showing your worth in battle, Kenshin finally settled down to talk to you, but she kept reminding you that there were enemies to slay. Maybe she's onto something.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,555 Can proceed to the Echigo's Dragon quest

string.name: name
string.value: Echigo's Dragon
You returned to Momijigaoka safely with Kenshin. You better explain the situation to Kenshin .
You returned to Momijigaoka safely with Kenshin. You'll have to explain the situation to Shingen and his vassal Yukimura as well.
The alliance is regaining its former strength little by little since Kenshin, Kanetsugu, Shingen, and Yukimura have met up. Now if there was only a talented leader to helm the group...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 3,708 #i2001502:# #t2001502:# x100 #i2001506:# #t2001506:# x100 Can proceed to the Commanding Aura quest

string.name: name
string.value: Commanding Aura
Motonari has an important task for you.
The Oda army set up an encampment at Momijigaoka and the allies plan to launch a surprise attack against them. You'll need to cast a spell to raise the allies' morale.
Haku told you there's a remarkable aura not far away. It feels familiar.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,225 Can proceed to the Aura's Origin 1 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Aura's Origin 1
Why does the aura feel so familiar? Hurry to Momijigahara and find out.
In Momijigahara, the aura is almost unbearably powerful. It must originate from somewhere very close by. Search for it and defeat the enemies.
The aura's source wasn't among the Oda infantry. It's got to be close...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,475 Can proceed to the Searching the Aura's Origin 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Aura's Origin 2
The aura's source wasn't among the Oda infantry. It's got to be close...
Only a commander could produce an aura this powerful. Charge deep into the enemy's base, Momijigahara 2 and find it!
As expected, a commander was the source of the aura. He clutched a familiar white foxtail...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 3,340 Can proceed to the Secure Retreat quest

string.name: name
string.value: Secure Retreat
The aura emanates from the Cloud Foxtail. Now that you have it, you can study it back at the base...
You're deep in enemy territory. Retreat will be nigh impossible until you weed out the enemies.
You have reduced the enemy force. Retreat to the main base and start the investigation on the Cloud Foxtail.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 4,408 Can proceed to the Fox Tail Mystery quest

string.name: name
string.value: Fox Tail Mystery
Ask Motonari if he knows anything about the Cloud Foxtail. He's currently in Momijigaoka.
Other warriors also discovered the Cloud Foxtails during the battle. As you gathered all the foxtails, Master Haruaki appeared!
Even Master Haruaki has no idea why the foxtail summoned him. Or is he hiding something?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 3,845 Can proceed to the Picking up the Pieces quest

string.name: name
string.value: Picking up the Pieces
Master Haruaki must know something about what happened at Honnou-ji.
Haruaki told you what happened at Honnou-ji. The goal of the alliance is becoming clear.\r\nHaruaki wants to tell you something privately.
Princess Sakuno will be in danger if Oda attempts to enact the ritual once again. Keep training to regain your power so you can protect her.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 3,845 Can proceed to the Native Help quest

string.name: name
string.value: Native Help
The master has returned to Momijigaoka and she has something important to tell you. Go to the main base and see Haruaki.
You need to find powerful allies to fight against Oda and his army.\r\nThere's a town with human inhabitants to the south of Momijigahara. Check there first.
You encountered Kino Konoko, the leader of the Mushroom Shrine. Maybe she knows something about the situation.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 4,614 Can proceed to the First Contact quest

string.name: name
string.value: First Contact
Ask Kino Konoko, the leader of the Mushroom Shrine, what she knows. Hopefully Oda didn't get to her first...
Kino Konoko and the residents of the Mushroom Shrine are worried by the appearance of all these new armies. Speak with her before the Oda clan has the opportunity.

Kino Konoko is just a shamaness who works at the shrine and suggested you to meet Empress Cygnus at Ereve. You can get to Ereve by riding on the Pelican from Mushroom Shrine to Victoria Island, then boarding the ship to Ereve from Victoria Island.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 4,614 Can proceed to the To Ereve quest

string.name: name
string.value: To Ereve
With Kino Konoko's information on Maple World, you can begin your investigation of this new land. First stop, Neinheart.
Find Neinheart in the town of Ereve. Speak to the World Tour Guide at the Mushroom Shrine to get to Victoria Island, then take a plane from the Six Path Crossway to Ereve.
You found Neinheart looking for you. Did you do something wrong?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 5,537 Can proceed to the Town of Fairies quest

string.name: name
string.value: Town of Fairies
Before you could find Empress Cygnus, one of her servants beckoned. Maybe you aren't worthy of speaking to the Empress directly? Listen to what this servant has to say first.

Neinheart said that Empress Cygnus is way too busy to spare a time for a conversation. Of course, he has a task you might be able to help with. Go meet a person called Hersha in the town of Ellinia on Victoria Island.
You found Hersha in Ellinia through Neinheart's introduction. However, Hersha seems less than excited to see you. Do you look that out of place?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 5,537 Can proceed to the Hersha's Request 1 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Hersha's Request 1
You finally had a conversation with Hersha after you showed him Neinheart's Letter of Introduction. Discuss the task at hand with Hersha.
Hersha asked you to defeat some monsters causing causing a ruckus at the North Cursed Forest. For now, go to the Cursed Forest and defeat Lupins.
You exterminated Lupins without a problem, but Hersha is still giving you that suspicious look. He's got a few more tasks. Maybe you can prove yourself.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 3,445 Can proceed to the Hersha's Request 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Hersha's Request 2
Talk to Hersha about the next mission.
Hersha asked you to defeat a rogue bunch of Zombie Lupins. You can find Zombie Lupins deep in the Cursed Forest at places like the Head Lupin's Nest, the Dark Forest, and the Polluted Tree.
You took care of the Zombie Lupin problem and Hersha has eased up a bit. You're so close to gaining his trust!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 3,844 Can proceed to the Hersha's Request 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Hersha's Request 3
Discuss the next mission with Hersha. He's slightly more pleasant now.
Hersha asked you to defeat the Maladies running amok in the deepest recesses of the Cursed Forest. You'll find them buried deep inside the forest at the Forest of Evil Energy 1 and 2.
You completed all of Hersha's requests, but one of the Malady monsters dropped something strange...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 4,373 Can proceed to the Nobunaga's Deceit quest

string.name: name
string.value: Nobunaga's Deceit
You took the suspicious object to Hersha and found a familiar crest carved on its surface. It' has to be a sign. \r\nDiscuss the object with Hersha.
Something evil stirs in the Forest of Evil Energy 2.\r\nLook for any signs of mischief at Forest of Evil Energy 2 and return to Neinheart at Ereve to report.
The Oda Army was behind it all! Now, Neinheart might be more interested in hearing what you have to say.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 7,974 Can proceed to the Audience with the Empress quest

string.name: name
string.value: Audience with the Empress
Hersha already sent Neinheart the report. He may be cautious, but he sure works fast! Discuss the details of the report with Neinheart.
Neinheart finally acknowledges the severity of the situation. He apologized for his lack of manners and is allowing you to meet Empress Cygnus in person. Meet the Empress and ask for help.
Empress Cygnus greeted you with kindness. The lack of suspicion was refreshing.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 19,136\nCan proceed to the Scaling the El Nath Mountains quest

string.name: name
string.value: Scaling the El Nath Mountains
Neinheart sent you a letter. Go to Victoria Island to make sure everything's all right.
According to Neinheart, there have been signs of the Oda Army in the El Nath Mountains of Orbis. Go to Orbis and then go down through the tower to reach El Nath.
You ran into Kanetsugu in Orbis. It's been a while since you last spoke.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to the To Each His Own quest

string.name: name
string.value: To Each His Own
Why is Kanetsugu all the way up here in Orbis? Listen to his story.
Kanetsugu is on a mission to explore Aqua Road. It seems like Haruaki is trying to gather information from all over the Maple World. You should go to El Nath and meet Alcaster.
You met with Alcaster in El Nath, the coldest place ever.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to the Red Snow 1 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Red Snow 1
You managed to find Alcaster in El Nath. Ask if he met any of Nobunaga's people yet.

It's clear that the Oda army appeared at outskirts of El Nath, but it's impossible to know where they are now. Maybe the enemies in the area have some clues. Start by hunting some Jr. Yetis and Dark Jr. Yetis in Watch Out for Icy Path I and II.
You hunted some Jr. Yetis and Dark Jr. Yetis, but you didn't find anything useful. Is everything in Maple World this difficult?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to the Red Snow 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Red Snow 2
You should follow Alcaster's suggestion and continue investigating. Talk to Alcaster for a plan of action.
Alcaster said the monsters tend to show more aggressive behavior as you go deeper into the Snowfield. Go a little deeper and defeat Pepes and Dark Pepes at the Cold Field.
You eliminated Pepes and Dark Pepes, but you still can't find any clues. The Oda Army certainly covers its tracks.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to the Red Snow 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Red Snow 3
You should follow Alcaster's suggestion and continue investigating. Talk to Alcaster for a plan of action.
Alcaster asks what you think about investigating the Ice Field, the deepest part of the Snowfield. Eliminate Hector and White Fang at Ice Valley and keep your eyes out for clues.
Hector and White Fang were tough, but they didn't carry any clues on The Oda Army. Maybe Nobunaga really had nothing to do with this incident?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511 Can proceed to the Fact or Fiction quest

string.name: name
string.value: Fact or Fiction
Alcaster has important news. Maybe he's found a clue! Go speak with him.
Alcaster saw Oda's men at Ice Valley II. It could be Ranmaru. Head to Ice Valley II to investigate.

It wasn't Ranmaru, but Nobunaga definitely had something to do with this incident. And to make matters worse, there's a conspiracy that involves not just Nobunaga, but the nefarious Black Wings too. You should report back to Momijigaoka quickly.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to the Deepening Suspicion quest

string.name: name
string.value: Deepening Suspicion
Nobunaga's influence over Maple World's monsters should not be so pervasive, but it is worth looking into. Speak with Haruaki in Momijigaoka.
No perfect answers are springing to mind. You should report to Tsuchimikado Haruaki in Momijigaoka for now. Speaking of which, how is Kanetsugu doing? Go to Orbis first to check on him.

Kanetsugu said Aqua Road is in the same condition as El Nath. Well, it's official: Nobunaga's influence is spreading across the entire Maple World.\n\nInvestigate the other regions while Kanetsugu reports back to Momijigaoka.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 55,511\nCan proceed to the Return Orders quest

string.name: name
string.value: An Eye on Honnou-ji
Ask Haruaki about Princess Sakuno's whereabouts.
Nobunaga still has the princess, but Shingen has a plan to rescue her. Ask him if you can help.
Shingen's plan is to have an elite group infiltrate Honnou-ji to rescue the princess. Hey, aren't you elite?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 143,742\nCan proceed to the Honnou-ji Infiltration 1 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Honnou-ji Infiltration 1
Plan out the Honnou-ji infiltration with Shingen.

You should climb the eastern Honnou-ji wall then sneak in through the eastern temple wing. Kanetsugu will keep you company. Get to the eastern Honnou-ji walls by heading north from Momijigahara then rendezvous with Kanetsugu.
You met up with Kanetsugu at the eastern Honnou-ji wall. This wall is all that separates you from the princess!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 143,742\nCan proceed to the Honnou-ji Infiltration 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: Honnou-ji Infiltration 2
You made it to the Honnou-ji entrance. Touch base with Kanetsugu and go over the infiltration plan.
The princess is in here somewhere. Hurry to the eastern wing and rescue her!
You successfully rescued the princess from Honnou-ji. Surprisingly, she seems fine.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: Saving Sakuno

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 143,742\nCan proceed to Internal Affairs quest

string.name: name
string.value: Internal Affairs
You escorted the princess back to Momijigaoka. Enemy pursuit shouldn't be a problem anymore. Report back to Haruaki about the successful rescue operation.
Now that people are done exchanging greetings, you should talk to the princess about everything that's happened.
You've safely rescued the princess. Now all you have to do is overthrow Nobunaga and return to the original Hinomaru. Piece of cake, right?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 143,742 Can proceed to the To Mu Lung quest

string.name: name
string.value: Movin' on Mu Lung
The princess sent you a letter. What could it be for?
Neinheart sent a message to Momijigaoka saying that Nobunaga's forces have shown up in Mu Lung. You should hurry to Mu Lung and talk to Tae Sang.
You arrived at Mu Lung to talk to Tae Sang.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353 Can proceed to the Mu Lung's Contribution quest

string.name: name
string.value: Mu Lung's Contribution
Mu Lung, the village of pandas... What a mystical place. Ask Tae Sang about anyone suspicious he may have seen.
Tae Sang saw some shady characters around Mu Lung, but he didn't pay much attention to them.
You found Tae Soo, the peach farm manager.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353 Can proceed to the Tae Soo from the Orchard quest

string.name: name
string.value: Tae Soo and You
Ask Tae Soo if he saw anyone suspicious nearby.

Tae Soo says that the Peach Monkies and Reindeer have become more vicious ever since an unfamiliar group appeared near the farm. He wants you to get rid of them. This definitely seems to be the work of Nobunaga and the Black Wings.\r\nSearch for clues as you hunt Peach Monkies and Reindeer.
You disciplined the Peach Monkies and Reindeer that were traipsing around the peach farm. As expected, you found Oda emblems.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353 Can proceed to the Forest Happenings quest

string.name: name
string.value: Forest Happenings
Ask Tae Soo if he has any information on the suspicious group.
Tae Soo has no idea why the Oda Army came to Mu Lung. He suggested you visit Do Gong in Mu Lung. Do Gong is at the Mu Lung Temple.
Do Gong in the Mu Lung Temple has somehow already heard about the recent events. They don't call him master for nothing.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353 Can proceed to the Mu Lung's Energy quest

string.name: name
string.value: Mu Lung Mojo
Listen to what Do Gong has to say about the Oda Army's appearance in Mu Lung.

Do Gong says that Maple World's energy is strongest in Mu Lung, so there have been some instances of evildoers visiting to seek energy.\r\nNobunaga is probably headed toward the Virtuous Forest, where the energy flows freely into Mu Lung. Go there and fight the Sage Cats.
The Sage Cats carried traces of Nobunaga's forces, just as Do Gong expected. What is Nobunaga up to?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353 Can proceed to the Shadow of Chaos quest

string.name: name
string.value: Shadow of Chaos
Listen to what Do Gong has to say about Nobunaga's destination.
Do Gong thinks that the Oda Army is headed for the Goblin Forest in the Virtuous Forest, the center of Maple World's energy. Investigate the Goblin Forest.
Surprisingly, it wasn't Oda who colluded with the Black Wings to make the monsters go on a rampage. It was Akechi Mitsuhide, acting independently! Mitsuhide left Nobunaga to create a new faction!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353 Can proceed to the Chaos Rising quest

string.name: name
string.value: Chaos Rising
Princess Sakuno sent a letter not long after you sent her the report on Mitsuhide's scheme. Take a look.
Princess Sakuno says Mitsuhide must be stopped at all costs. But how?
Nobunaga and Ranmaru are threatening Maple World. All you can do right now is train until you're strong enough to stop Nobunaga and protect Princess Sakuno. It's time to pull out all the stops!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 424,353 Can proceed to the Unexpected Message quest

string.name: name
string.value: Unexpected Message
Princess Sakuno sent you a letter. See what she said.
The princess is ordering you to return to Momijigaoka ASAP.
You returned to Momijigaoka just as the princess ordered. What's so urgent?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320 Can proceed to the Unexpected Messenger quest

string.name: name
string.value: Unexpected Messenger
Listen to the princess's urgent message.
It feels wrong to just ignore Hideyoshi's letter. Support the mission in any way you can.
You learned about the mission, but the generals are arguing over what to do. If only the master would sort this out...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320 Can proceed to the Honnou-ji Again quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Fourth King of Heaven
You learned about the Hideyoshi rendezvous mission, but the generals still did not reach a consensus. If only Haruaki would sort this out...
Haruaki thankfully stepped in and sorted things out. It's been decided that you should meet with Hideyoshi. \r\nHead to the eastern Honnou-ji wall that Hideyoshi decided.
Toyotomi Hideyoshi, one of Nobunaga's Four Heavenly Kings, was waiting for you when you reached eastern Honnou-ji walls.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320 Can proceed to the Questionable Allegiance quest

string.name: name
string.value: Questionable Allegiance
You met with Nobunaga's man outside Honnou-ji, but what does he really want? Go find out.
Hideyoshi claims to want to defect to the alliance, along with Tokugawa Ieyasu, but your meeting was cut short by a legion of Nobunaga's troops. Take care of them before speak with him again.
Nobunaga has eyes everywhere. You beat his troops, but more will be coming.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320 Can proceed to the No Love for the Demon King quest

string.name: name
string.value: No Love for the Demon King
These territories are no longer safe. Return to Momijigaoka and talk to Tadakatsu.
You brought Nobunaga's commanders back to Momijigaoka while Tadakatsu fended off the remaining enemy troops. It's time to report to Princess Sakuno.
Hideyoshi and Ieyasu have left the Oda ranks and joined the alliance. This will cripple Nobunaga's ambitions. The final battle is almost here!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,006,320 Can proceed to the Alliance Assemble quest

string.name: name
string.value: Alliance Assemble
Princess Sakuno sent you a letter. See what she said.
Shingen is calling for all members of the alliance to return to Momijigaoka.
You returned to Momijigaoka and talked Shingen. The heroes are in one place, the stage is set for victory!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028 Can proceed to the Sengoku Showdown quest

string.name: name
string.value: Sengoku Showdown
Shingen looks ready for a pre-battle speech. Hear him out.
The chance to crush Nobunaga once and for all is here! To Honnou-ji!
Shingen stopped you at the entrance to Honnou-ji. He has a personal request...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028 Can proceed to The Demon's Lair 1 quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Demon's Lair 1
What does Takeda Shingen want? It's time for battle!
Shingen wants you to secure an entryway into the temple. Defeat 200 low-ranking Oda warriors.
You cleared out the low-level Oda warriors. The entrance should be secure.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028 Can proceed to The Demon's Lair 2 quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Demon's Lair 2
The battle rages on. Now that the allied forces are inside the temple, talk to Takeda Shingen.
Shingen wants you to find and defeat 300 Samurai Captains.
The Oda troops are running around with no leadership! Victory is at hand!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028 Can proceed to The Demon's Lair 3 quest

string.name: name
string.value: The Demon's Lair 3
The allies are on the road to victory, but Nobunaga has more tricks up his sleeve.
Enter the temple and defeat Takigawa Kazumasu, one of Oda's Four Heavenly Kings.
With Kazumasu down and Honnou-ji back under your control, you can only wonder where Nobunaga has fled. He and his cronies have escaped for now... but they will face their judgment.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 2,922,028 Can proceed to The End of an Era quest

string.name: name
string.value: The End of an Era
The allies are victorious, Honnou-ji has been recaptured, but Nobunaga is gone. Return to Tsuchimikado Haruaki and see if there is anything else you can do.
Wherever Nobunaga is, he will not be resting. Train hard and prepare for the day you come face to face. The era of war is over, but the era of peace will need a leader...

Princess Sakuno has requested your presence. Don't keep her waiting!

Mouri Motonari needs to speak with you. Find out what's bugging him.

It's been a long time since you last met #p9130008#. He seemed pleased with your growth in Maple World.

Tsuchimikado Haruaki wants to return the favor.
Tsuchimikado Haruaki wants to return the favor.
Something feels weird. Is this what it feels like to be famous?

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Principal Researcher Bass
Neinheart wants to tell you about the big issues in Aqua Road.
Neinheart wants you to talk to #b#p9390005##k.
You found #b#p9390005##k.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Population Control
#b#p9390005##k wants to talk to you.
#p9390005# wants you to hunt down 300 #o9390003##k monsters. ONLY 300, eh?
You took out 300 #o9390003##k monsters.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Inkier Than Thou
Talk to #p9390005##k again.
To continue the investigation, #p9390005##k wants you to hunt #o9390004##k creatures.
You hunted down the #o9390004##k.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Slime Rage
Talk to Principal Researcher Bass.
Collect loot from #o9390005##k monsters to find out why the monsters are changing.
You delivered the goods to Bass.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Stone Samples
#p9390005##k seems really agitated. Find out why.
#p9390005## needs you to find more samples for the monster investigation. The stalwart #o9390006# would make a good subject.
You delivered the samples.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Ghostly Research
Talk to #p9390005#.
#p9390005# found something suspicious in the latest reports. You should hunt down a #o9390013# and see what you can learn.
You delivered the #o9390013# goods to #p9390005#.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] The Next Researcher
Talk to #p9390005##k.
#p9390005##k believes that the change to the Aqua Road is heavily connected to the changes in monsters.
#p9390004##k needs your help.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Little Help!
Discuss the future plans with #p9390004##k.
Talk to #p9390004##k about Aqua Road.
Things aren't looking good here either.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] A Light Warm-Up
Talk to #p9390004##k after your preparations.
Hunt 500 #r#o9390007##k monsters as a warm-up (?) exercise.
You hunted 500 #o9390007# monsters. All that hunting DID get your juices flowing...

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Toes in First
Listen to #p9390004#'s first request.
#o9390008# monsters are hindering your investigation. Get rid of them!
You hunted down 500 #o9390008# monsters, as requested.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Dive In
Listen to #p9390004#'s second request.
#p9390004# is convinced that #o9390014# monsters are responsible for destroying the Aqua Road ecosystem. Hunt 500 of them.
You hunted #o9390014# monsters for #p9390004#.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] The Hearsay War
Wynn was wrong about the culprits behind Aqua Road's recent events. Maybe she won't be wrong this time?
You've been asked to hunt down the #o9390015# monsters this time. This is a goose chase!
The #o9390015# monsters weren't up to anything!

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] The Culprit?
Ask #p9390004# what's going on.
#p9390004# is looking for a monster with incredible negative energy. You've been asked to bring back some loot for... research.
You hunted down the monster for #p9390004#, and brought back the loot.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] One Fancy Fish
Find out what #p9390004#'s investigation turned up.
#p9390004# believes the terrifying monster behind all this trouble is actually called #b#o9390001##k. It's supposedly from a noble family.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Into the Depths
#p9390004# seems to be busy. Find out why.
#p9390004# thinks that the #o9390001# incident is just a small part of the bigger picture. You might as well tag along with her.
You followed #p9390004# to #m860000020#.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] I Ain't Afraid of No Ghost
Help out Wynn, since you're here anyway.
Was that a ghost? Wynn seems strangely excited about the potential destruction of the laws of nature. Exorcise the ghosts for Wynn and bring back the loot.
You exorcised all of the ghosts. Where did you learn to do that?!

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Onyxology
Is #p9390007# done researching the ghost's onyx? Go find out.
Having only one type of onyx isn't going to be enough. You have to collect other types of onyx for research.
You delivered other types of onyx.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] A Dangerous Investigation
Ask about onyx.
These onyxes have a connection to the Black Mage! Wynn wants you to continue the investigation...
You were expecting more ghosts this time, but you got a giant serpent instead. That's strangely comforting.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Arkarium's Little Snooky-Wooky
Find out more about the serpent.
The serpent's name was #o9390002#, and it was Arkarium's pet! It looked like a surprisingly labor-intensive pet for such an old geezer.
The Black Mage seems to be connected to what's going on in Aqua Road.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Deep Blue Sea
Talk to Wynn about her future plans.
Wynn seems riled up to find out that Arkarium was involved. You'll need to get rid of the #o9390012# monsters that are blocking your path to continue.
You cleared the #o9390012# monsters off of the path.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] A Serious Response
Talk to Wynn about your next step.
Wynn seems to have located the epicenter of the vibrations, but many of Arkarium's monsters are guarding it. Open up the path by defeating #o9390017# monsters.
You defeated #o9390017# monsters to open up the first path.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Breaking Rad
You found it! Talk to Wynn.
The cave entrance is very well-guarded. Or at least it WOULD be, if you weren't so awesome. Mop up these #o9390016# monsters.
You got rid of all the #o9390016# monsters. Wynn already went ahead to the cave.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Something's Fishy
You finally reached the source of the vibrations. Time to get down to business!
You hear strange noises coming from the cave depths. What's inside?
Surprise! It was a giant fish monster.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Identity
You've had enough rest. Time to talk to Wynn.
Wynn's research indicates that the monster you hunted was actually the king of a lost kingdom.
You learned about Antoinette.

string.name: name
string.value: [Aqua Road] Back to Neinheart
Say your last farewells to Wynn.
Wynn wants you to report back to Neinheart now that everything is settled. Back to the Aquarium!
You reported back to Neinheart.

string.name: name
string.value: The Curbrock in the Grass
#p1061005# in Sleepywood is looking for a brave adventurer.
#p1061005# wants you to look into the rumors of a powerful monster named Curbrock. \n#r<< To restart, please forfeit the quest first. >>
You found out that Curbrock is real the hard way.

string.value: Talk to #e#b#p1061005##k#n

string.name: name
string.value: The New Me
#p1061005# at Sleepywood is looking for a strong adventurer.
#p1061005# thinks you might be able to beat Curbrock if I use my strongest attack. \n#r<< To restart, please forfeit the quest first. >>
Curbrock ran off after you hit him. But if he ever returns, the town will be in danger...

string.name: name
string.value: Curbrock's Revenge
Rumor has it that Curbrock is back.\n#p1061005# should know the truth.
This is your chance to finish Curbrock off once and for all!\nBe weary of his Seal, Blind, and Stun spells. \n#r<< To restart, please forfeit the quest first. >>
You sent Curbrock back to the snake pit he slithered out of.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Fairynappers
Fanzy the cat, one of Grendel the Really Old's pupils, would like your help in the North Forest's Giant Tree.

Fanzy has a favor to ask. Go to the Lake in front of the Ellinel Fairy Academy for details.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] You Can Do It
Talk to Fanzy in front of Ellinel Lake.
Fanzy explains about the Ellinel Fairy Academy and suggets swimming across the lake. Is this really a good idea...? Better jump in.
Well, that didn't work out at all. You should find another way.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Fanzy's Magic 1
#b#p1500010##k said you need magical materials to cross the lake. Keep talking to #b#p1500010##k at the #b#m101070000##k.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Fanzy's Magic 2
Continue the conversation with #b#p1500010##k at the #b#m101070000##k.
#b#p1500010##k said he needs more magical materials. Defeat #r#o3501001##k at the #b#m101070300##k and gather 5 #b#t4033825##k.

Continue the conversation with #b#p1500010##k at the #b#m101070000##k.
You can get to Ellinel Fairy Academy if you walk straight east. Meet #b#p1500001##k at the #b#m101072000##k.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Ivana's Misunderstanding
Continue the conversation with #b#p1500001##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
It would be good idea for you to listen to #b#p1500000##k, too. Talk to #b#p1500000##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
You have talked to #b#p1500001##k at the #b#m101072000##k. It seems like the misunderstanding is already out of hand.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Clearing up Cootie 1
Keep talking with #b#p1500000##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
You need to prove #b#p1500000##k's innocence. Defeat #r#o3501002##k or #r#o3501003##k at the #b#m101071000##k to find #b#t4033826##k. Then, show it to #b#p1500001##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
In order to prove #b#p1500000##k's innocence, you found #b#t4033826##k and showed it to #b#p1500001##k.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Clearing up Cootie 2
Keep talking with #b#p1500000##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
It seems like you may need more clear evidence to fix things. Defeat #r#o3501009##k at the #b#m101071200##k to gather 20 #b#t4033827##k. Then, deliver those to #b#p1500001##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
You have collected #b#t4033827##k and showed it to #b#p1500001##k. You're not out of the woods yet, but he at least released the binding.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Cootie's Suggestion
Things are still sticky, but Cootie the Really Small is free for now. Talk to #b#p1500000##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
Cootie the Really Small suggested working together improve fairy-human relations. Talk to #b#p1500001##k at the #b#m101072000##k.
#b#p1500001##k granted you permission to search the school.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Combing the Academy 1
Meet #b#p1500011##k at the #b#m101072200##k of Ellinel Fairy Academy.
Looks like you can get #b#t2431768##k from #r#o3501004##k at the #b#m101072200##k or #b#m101072300##k. Open up the message yourself to check it out, and keep going until you find something useful.
You've found something! The children have a secret...

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Combing the Academy 2
You should find the children's secret out yourself. Talk to #b#p1500011##k at the #b#m101072200##k.
Check Ellinel Fairy Academy's #b2nd floor dormitory wings#k.
You sure did search those dorms.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Clue Number One

You found the #b#t4033828##k that the kids hid. Return to Cootie the Really Small in #b#m101072200##k. #b#e(Forfeit then restart the quest if you lose the item.)#k\n
You found #b#t4033828##k in the dormitory for #b#p1500011##k.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Combing the Academy 3

You found out that the girls have been making something in secret.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Combing the Academy 4
Look for any suspicious spots while you search both wings of the Ellinel Fairy Academy 3F Dormitories.
You decided to search the 3F Dormitories for clues.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Clue Number Two

Talk to #b#p1500000##k in #b#m101072000##k on the first floor.
Everything was just a misunderstanding. Talk to #b#p1500001##k in #b#m101072000##k.
You proved that all of this was a misunderstanding. #b#p1500001##k in #b#m101072000##k apologized and asked that you help find the children.

#b#p1032100##k asked that you tell #b#p1032101##k about this as well. #b#p1032100##k wants some time to think about this.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Cootie Sense 1

You worked with Cootie the Really Small to find the missing children. While Cootie used the Directional Sonar, you went to the #b#m101073000##k behind Ellinel and defeated 60 #r#o3501006##k monsters.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] The First Rescue
Talk to Cootie the Really Small in the Onion Plantation.
Cootie the Really Small located the Fairy City with the Directional Sonar. Use the portal next to Cootie and save Fariy City from the monsters!
You used the portal and saved Fariy City by defeating the monsters.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Cootie's Suspicions
Talk to Cootie the Really Small in the Onion Plantation.
Cootie the Really Small has left for the Turnip Plantation to save more children. Go and talk to him.
He went to the Turnip Plantation to save more children.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] Cootie Sense 2
Work with Cootie the Really Small to find the other missing children. Talk to him at the Turnip Plantation.
While Cootie uses the Directional Sonar, go to the Turnip Plantation behind Ellinel and defeat 80 Turnipies.
You went to the Turnip Plantation behind Ellinel and defeated the Turnipy monsters.

string.name: name
string.value: [Ellinel Fairy Academy] The Second Escape
Talk to Cootie the Really Small in the Turnip Plantation.
Cootie the Really Small located Phiny and Ephony by using the Directional Sonar. Use the portal next to Cootie and save them!
You used the portal and saved Phiny and Ephony by defeating the monsters.

string.name: name

string.name: name

You defeated the Mole King and saved Woonie and Tracy!

string.name: name
string.value: 길잃은 루돌프 찾기
#p2001000# 할아버지에게 걱정거리가 생겼다는데... 무슨 일일까? #b#m209000000##k로 가서 #b#p2001000##k 할아버지를 만나보자.
#p2001000# 할아버지는 수심이 가득한 표정으로 썰매를 타고 이동하던 중에 #b루돌프#k 한 마리가 없어져 버렸다고 말했다. 아무래도 길을 잃은 것 같다는데... 그러면서 그는 메이플 월드 어딘가에 있는 루돌프를 발견하면 #b마법의 지팡이#k를 소비해 길들여서 데려다 달라고 말했다. \n\n#t4031887# #b#c4031887##k/1
#p2001000# 할아버지에게 루돌프를 데려다 주었다. 그러자 그는 루돌프의 뿔처럼 생긴 멋진 머리띠를 주었다.

string.name: name
string.value: 크리스마스 요정은 어디에?!
행복한 마을의 산타 할아버지 #b클리프#k가 실종된 크리스마스 요정들을 애타게 찾고 있다. 일단 차원의 거울을 이용해서 행복한 마을로 가서 클리프에게 크리스마스 요정들이 어떻게 사라지게 되었는지 물어보자.
행복한 마을의 산타 클리프는 크리스마스 선물을 포장할 때 크리스마스 요정들이 상자 속으로 섞여 들어가서 모두 실종되었다면서 크리스마스를 맞이하여 할 일이 많으니, 크리스마스 선물상자를 조사해서 숨어 있는 요정 10마리를 데려오라고 했다.
몬스터가 드롭하는 크리스마스 선물상자를 뒤져서 숨어 있던 요정 10마리를 모두 찾아냈다 클리프에게 요정 10마리를 데려다 주자. 이젠 밀렸던 일을 모두 할 수 있게 되었다면서 좋아했다.

string.name: name
string.value: 산타고양이의 선물상자
행복한 마을의 산타 고양이가 부탁하고 싶은 일이 있다고 하는데... 차원의 거울을 이용해서 행복한 마을로 가보자.
행복한 마을에 있는 산타고양이가 토르에게 줄 빨간코 선물상자를 가지고 도망간 불량 루돌프를 잡아서 자신의 선물상자를 되찾아 달라고 부탁했다. 불량 루돌프는 메이플 여기저기서 예고없이 나타난다고 하는데...도대체 어디가서 찾아내지?

string.name: name
string.value: 코르바에게 자장면 배달
사람의 발길이 잘 닿지 않는 리프레 마을에서도 외진 곳인 승강장에서 고독을 씹고 있는 #b코르바#k. 카산드라는 그에게 선물을 해주는 것이 어떻겠냐고 하는데...
카산드라는 리프레에 있는 #b코르바#k에 대해서 이야기 해줬다. 코르바가 있는 승강장은 하프링들도 잘 오지 않는 외진 곳이어서 코르바가 항상 외로워 한다는 것이다. 외로워 하는 #b코르바#k에게 #b솔로부대의 자장면#k을 전해주라고 했다.

카산드라는 메이플월드에서 사람의 발길이 잘 닿지 않는 미나르숲의 리프레에 있는 #b코르바#k에 대해서 이야기 해줬다. 코르바가 있는 승강장은 리프레 마을의 하프링들도 잘 오지 않는 외진 곳이어서 코르바가는 항상 외로워 한다는 것이다. 카산드라의 부탁으로 발렌타인데이와 화이트데이에도 아무도 그를 찾아가지 않았다면서 우울증에 빠진 #b코르바#k에게 #b솔로부대의 자장면#k을 전해주었다.

수련의 숲에서 남쪽으로 가면 #b라이딩교관 #p1102002##k를 만날 수 있다고 한다. #t4032115#을 가지고 가면 몬스터 라이딩에 대해 알려줄 거라는데....

string.name: name
string.value: Mimiana Egg
You can learn about the Monster Riding of the knights if you go to #bthe Mount Trainer #p1102002##k...

#p1102002# gave you a #t4220137#, telling you that the knights ride #t1902005#s. He said that #bthe egg can be awakened by sharing your experiences with him#k... Only a #t1902005# that has awakened like this will truly obey its owner. Raise a #t4220137#.
You have awakened your #t4220137#.

string.name: name
string.value: 키리두의 소개장
#t1902005#를 깨우는데 성공했다. 몬스터 라이딩의 다음 단계는 뭘까? #b#p1102002##k에게 물어보자.
#t1902005#는 깨어났지만 라이딩을 하려면 #t1912005#이 필요하다. #t1912005# 만드는 실력은 그보다는 #b아쿠아로드#k의 #b#p2060005##k가 낫다고 하니 #p2060005#에게 가서 #t1912005#을 구해 보라는데... #t4032116#을 가지고 #p2060005#에게 가보자.

string.name: name
string.value: 안장 만들기
몬스터 라이딩에 필요한 #t1912005#을 #b#p2060005##k에게 구할 수 있는 것 같은데...
#p2060005#는 #t1912005#을 만드는 건 어렵지 않지만 재료비는 줘야 한다며, #p1102002#의 소개를 받아 왔으니 특별히 싸게 해서 #b1000만 메소#k를 달라고 말했다...\n\n #b10,000,000만 메소

string.name: name
string.value: 기사의 라이딩
#t1912005#까지 구했으니 이제 다시 #b#p1102002##k에게 가자.
#p1102002#에게서 몬스터 라이딩 스킬을 배우고 라이딩용 #t1902005#를 받았다. 좋아, 이제 #p1101002#에게 무시당하지 않고 기사의 품위를 유지할 수 있겠지...
#p1102002#에게서 몬스터 라이딩 스킬을 배우고 라이딩용 #t1902005#를 받았다. 좋아, 이제 #p1101002#에게 무시당하지 않고 기사의 품위를 유지할 수 있겠지...

string.name: name
string.value: 티티아나를 잃어버렸어요!
#t1902005#를 잃어버리고 말았다. 어떻게 하지? #b라이딩교관 #p1102002##k를 찾아가 보자.
환상생물인 #t1902005#는 주인과 일정 시간 이상 떨어져 있으면 자연히 소멸해 버리기에 다시 #t1902005#를 갖고 싶다면 #b처음부터 알에서 다시 깨워야 한다#k고 한다. 열심히 사냥해서 다시 #t1902005#를 깨워 보자.
다시 한 번 #t1902005#를 깨웠다. #p1102002#는 다시는 잃어버리지 말라고 신신당부 했다.

string.name: name
string.value: 기사의 품격
#p1101002#가 뭔가 또다시 할 말이 있는 것 같은데...
#p1101002#는 레벨이 90이 되었는데 아직도 일반 #t1902005#를 타고 있는 건 상급기사의 품격에 어울리지 않는다며, 몬스터 라이딩에 관한 새로운 정보를 알려주었다. #b라이딩교관 #p1102002##k에게 가면 더 강력한 라이딩에 대해 알 수 있을 거라는데...
#p1101002#는 레벨이 90이 되었는데 아직도 일반 #t1902005#를 타고 있는 건 상급기사의 품격에 어울리지 않는다며, 몬스터 라이딩에 관한 새로운 정보를 알려주었다. #p1102002#에게 가면 더 강력한 라이딩에 대해 알 수 있을 거라는데...

string.name: name
string.value: 티티아나의 탈피
#b#p1102002##k에게 더 강력한 라이딩에 대해 물어보자.
경험을 축적한 #t1902005#는 탈피하여 더 강력한 힘을 가질 수 있게 된다고 한다. 하지만 탈피하는 동안에는 매우 쇠약해진다는데... 탈피하는 동안에는 타고 다닐 수 없다고 하니 #t1902005#를 필요로 하는 일이 있다면 모두 처리하고 오자.

string.name: name
string.value: 유리온실 돌보기
#p1102001#에게 맡겨둔 #t1902005#를 받아 탈피시켜 보자.
탈피를 위해 #t4220138#에 들어가 있는 #t1902005#를 돌보자. 먹이는 #b#m240000000##k의 #b#p2081004##k이 만드는 농축 이유식이다... 모든 먹이를 주어 #t1902005#를 온전히 탈피시킨 후 #p1102001#에게 돌아오자.
#p1102001#는 #t4220138#에서 탈피가 끝난 #t1902005#를 꺼내 주었다. 하지만 당장 타기는 어려울 것 같다는데...

string.name: name
string.value: 티티오의 탄생
농축 이유식을 먹여가며 #t1902005#를 길렀다. 이제 탈피한 #t1902005#를 탈 수 있는 걸까? #p1102001#에게 가보자.
#t1902005#의 탈피는 완료 되었지만, 탈피로 인해 쇠약해져 있더 당장 타기는 무리라고 한다. #b#t4032117##k를 먹이면 금세 기운을 차릴 것 같다는데... #m230000000#로 가서 #b#p2060005##k에게 #t4032117#를 구입하자.

string.name: name
string.value: 켄타의 영양제
#t1902005#를 탈피시키기 위해서는 #p2060005#의 #t4032117#가 필요하다고 한다. #b#p2060005##k를 만나 보자.
#t4032117#는 아는 사람이라 싸게 해서 #b2500만 메소#k라고 한다... 도대체 영양제의 재료가 뭘까. 새삼 궁금해진다... \n\n#b25,000,000 메소#k

string.name: name
string.value: 티티아나를 탈피시키고 싶어요!
잃어버려서 다시 키우게 된 #t1902005#를 #t1902006#로 탈피시키고 싶다면 #b라이딩교관 #p1102002##k를 찾아가 보자.
#p1102002#는 특제온실에서 탈피를 마친 #t1902006#를 꺼내 주었다.

string.name: name
string.value: Find the lost Memories

According to the words of the Inspector, you must start an adventure to find the lost memories. Start an adventure... if that's the case then it's probably around the time when I was surrounded by those lies. Let's share stories during the time at #bZero's Temple#k.
They talked excitedly with each other. It was confusing at that time but, it's still nice meeting another me that can also think of me.

string.name: name
string.value: [메이플지기] 메이플 싸인받기
다른 친구들은 얼마나 오랫동안 메이플 월드를 여행한 것일까? #p9010000#가 다른 친구들과 10주년의 즐거움을 나눌 수 있는 방법을 제시한다고 한다.

#p9010000#는 #r#e1년 지기 이상#k#n의 다른 유저에게 싸인을 받으면 #e#b프렌드 포인트(FP)#k#n를 받을 수 있고, 프렌트 포인트를 모으면 모을수록 좋은 선물을 받을 수 있다고 했다. 
메이플스토리를 오랫동안 했던 유저에게 싸인을 받을 수록 더 많은 프렌드 포인트를 얻을 수 있다고 하는데...
#e<프렌드 포인트(FP) 획득 방법>#n
1) 싸인을 받고 싶은 캐릭터에게 마우스를 올리고 마우스 오른쪽 버튼을 누른다.
2) #r'메이플싸인받기'#k메뉴를 선택한다.
3) 싸인받기 버튼을 눌러서 싸인을 받기에 성공하면 프렌드 포인트(FP)를 얻는다.

필드의 일반 몬스터를 #r500마리#k 퇴치한 후 10주년 메이플 파크에 있는 별이에게 말을 걸어보자. 단 , 자신보다 #b11이상 높거나 21이상 낮은#k 레벨의 몬스터는 제외하고!
자, 이제 몬스터 퇴치도 완료했으니, 다음 해야할 일을 알아볼까?

string.name: name
string.value: [10주년 파티] 10주년 파티 현수막 걸기
메이플 10주년 파티를 기념하여 제작된 현수막을 걸어보자.
10주년 기념 공원 이곳 저곳에 흩어져 있는 상자를 일반 타격으로 부수면 현수막 걸기에 필요한 재료들을 구할 수 있다고 한다. 재료들을 모아 카산드라에게 가져다 주자.
휴, 드디어 행사를 알리는 현수막 걸기까지 완료했다. 자, 조금만 더 힘을 내 볼까?

string.name: name
string.value: [10주년 파티] 파티는 신나는 음악과 함께!
파티에는 음악이 빠지면 안 된다는 카산드라. 그녀의 부탁을 들어주도록 하자.
필드의 일반 몬스터들을 사냥하면 떨어지는 음표 모양의 #i2431716##b#t2431716##k을 #r1000#k 까지 채운 후 카산드라에게 말을 걸어보자.
이것이 바로 신나는 음악의 힘! 저절로 흥이 난다!

string.name: name
string.value: [10주년 파티] 10주년 파티 초대가수 섭외하기
10주년 파티를 빛내줄 초대가수를 섭외해야 한다는데...카산드라에게 자세한 이야기를 들어보자.
초대가수 섭외 1순위 #b혁이는 커닝스퀘어 로비#k에서 만날 수 있다. 혁이에게 자초지종을 말하고 초대가수로 와 달라고 부탁해보자.
초대가수 혁이 섭외 완료! 파티 준비는 점점 무르익어 간다!

string.name: name
string.value: [10주년 파티] 선물은 30분 후에 공개됩니다!
파티하면 빠질 수 없는 것이 바로 선물! 카산드라가 파티를 위한 선물을 준비했다는데...
카산드라가 준 선물 상자는 30분 뒤에 열어볼 수 있다고 한다. 단, #r도중에 로그 아웃을 하면 선물이 사라지고 다시 처음부터 기다려야 하니#k 꼭 한 번에 완료하도록 하자!
카산드라의 선물 상자를 열어보고 멋진 선물을 받았다!

string.name: name
string.value: [안내] 메소다이저를 완성하라!
메소다이저 의자를 입수하자 김 박사가 나타났다. 메소다이저 의자와 관련하여 이벤트를 진행중이라고 하는데 어디 한 번 들어볼까?
김 박사의 말에 따르면, 메소다이저 의자를 가진 사람들과 모여 메소다이저를 완성할 경우 지구방위대의 자격을 주는 이벤트를 진행 중이라고 한다.
김 박사가 메소다이저 의자와 관련된 이벤트 내용에 대해 설명해 주었다. 메소다이저 의자를 가지고 있는 사람들을 찾아 메소다이저를 완성하고 홈페이지에 스크린샷을 올려 놀라운 경품에 도전해보도록 하자.
