#bSpiegelmann#k's last request. You've eliminated all #b#o9101045##k and #b#o9101046##k monsters.

string.name: name
string.value: Emergency Mission

#r#p2410008##k, the strongest knight in #m321000100#, suspects a conspiracy. The Darklings that threaten the world, and the Shadow Knights who battle them... Just how far does the deceit extend? Why is #p2410008# forbidden from leaving Shadowvale? There's just not enough information.
A dose of #rShade Neutralizer#k is required before undertaking any Shadow Knight missions, but the medicine has made #p2410008# susceptible to brainwashing. He stopped taking it some time ago.
But why? Is everyone taking the Shade Neutralizer? Or is #p2410008# the only one?

string.name: name
string.value: Dark Days

Something always crops up anytime #p2410008# becomes suspicious about the Shadow Knights. But has #p2410008# seen through the convenient timing of the Darkling attacks. He'll have to continue his mission to keep up appearances.
#p2410008# was sent to eliminate all of the #r#o9300744##k monsters near #b#m321000300##k. #p2410003# came along as backup, but he proved to be very little help.
Hunting down the #o9300744# monsters was easy. #p2410008# has come to believe that the monsters possess no special powers, certainly not anything like he had been told.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 590000 \r\n
With all of the #o9300744# monsters taken care of, Alpha decides to distract #b#p2410003##k, and use the time to head into the #m321000600#.
The monsters that were supposed to inhabit the #m321000600# were a lie. #p2410008#'s conviction about hunting Darklings was faltering, but his curiosity about the #b#m321000600##k was just beginning.

Inside the #m321000600#, #p2410008# in the #m321000500# and confronted a mysterious statue. It was here he found the girl, tangled in spider web, but still alive. The conspiracies of #m321000100# revolve around her, and so did the truth.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: #questorder1#Enter the Umbra Temple (#R40006ExclearRef40002#)\r\n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 17700 \r\n

string.name: name
string.value: World Record
#p2410008# spotted an old scroll at the foot of the #b#p2410006##k. It seems to have a strange shimmer to it. He decides to grab it.
Alpha took care of the #o9300744# monsters quickly enough, but he needed to get back to #b#m321000100##k before he aroused suspicions. He'd have to take the scroll with him.

The scroll proved to be more confusing than helpful. Maple World. The Black Mage. The Transcendents. The Goddess Rhinne... and her child. #p2410008#'s feelings stirred at these strange tales, though he would not have time to look further...

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: #questorder1#Return to the Barracks (#R40010ExclearRef40003#)\r\n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 801000 \r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Stop the Temple Raid
#p2410008# awoke to find the other knights worked into a fervor. With his two recent successes, he couldn't see why there would be such an uproar. Someone must know what's happening...
The decision to raid the #m321000600# bewildered #p2410008#, especially when he was told to stay put. #p2410008# worried that this could be a trap, or that someone was on to him.

#p2410008# decided that he could not afford to let the other Shadow Knights reach the #m321000600# before he had a chance to awaken the girl. His choice would put him face to face with the only family he's ever known.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 810800 \r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Maple World and Mirror World
#b#p2400000##k told the duo that this world is actually a fake, based on a place called Maple World. Perhaps she can explain more...

#p2400005# and #p2400006# found themselves trapped in Mirror World. Though they could visit Maple World via the #b#m320000100##k, they could not interact with objects or obtain experience--they could only watch.
Alpha and Beta's ties to Mirror World will only be broken when their powers are awakened. Only then can they be at home in Maple World.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: #questorder1# Visit Maple World (#R40068ExRef40050#)\r\n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 895200 \r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Mirror World Map
#p2400000#'s tale has made one thing clear. #p2400005# and #p2400006# must find the Goddess Teardrops to awaken their powers at the Transcendent of Time. It's the only way to defeat #p2410000#.

To find their way around Mirror World, Alpha and Beta had to find a #bMirror World Map#k, but locating one was no easy task. Then Alpha remembered he had seen a similar map before... in #p2410000#'s #b#m321190140##k in Shadowvale.
Mirror World is a bizarre, puzzle-like place. #p2400005# and #p2400006# must plan for their next step.

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: #questorder1# Find the Mirror World Map in the Treatment Room (#R40069ExclearRef40051#)\r\n

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1060000 \r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Dowsing Time
You found the Mirror World Map. Travel Mirror World to find the Goddess Teardrops.

Dowsing is an old technique for finding underground water or minerals. #p2400008# claims to be able to locate strands of time with this technique. Doing so, he might be able to find the Goddess Teardrops.
The Dowsing led you to a Time Relic! You need it to control your power of time.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 130000 \r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Rage of the Dragon

#p2400005# and #p2400006# head to #b#m321100000##k when they learn that the Goddess's relic takes precedence over the Goddess Teardrops. But the scene they find is dark and troubled, and only #b#p2411000##k seems to know why.

#p2411000#’s town has been besieged by a savage dragon! The great Onyx Dragon, Afrien, could be of help, if only a warrior strong enough to make it through the #bdungeon portal#k to #b#MDmap321190200##k were around.

When they arrived in Afrien’s cave, they found the great beast asleep! But Afrien’s only child, #p2411009#, was there to greet them. He spoke of an evil dragon named Horntail, and the duo realized their journey was just beginning.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 115000

string.name: name
string.value: Dragon Tough
On the search for the noble Afrien, Alpha and Beta met its child, #b#p2411009##k! Perhaps this little dragon knows something about the relic. A trip to the #b#m321100000##k was the only answer...

#p2411009# believed the duo was destined for the frying pan, so it’s requiring a test of strength! The duo must defeat #r#o2600000##k and #r#o2600001##k monsters in #b#MDmirrorD_321_0_##k, beyond the #bdungeon portal#k.
After passing #p2411009#'s test, Mir directed Alpha and Beta toward the #b#MDmap321190300##k, and toward one mean dragon.

string.name: placeSummary
string.value: [Dungeon] #MDmirrorD_321_0_#

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 659000

string.name: name
string.value: Horntail? Horntail!

#p2400005# and #p2400006# set off to find the dragon that most likely held the relic. They were told by #p2411009# that the dragon would be near #b#MDmap321190300##k. Surely things will go easier this time...
Alpha and Beta encountered #p2411011#! Would they find a friend in this mighty monster, or yet another battle?

The fight with #p2411011# was quicker than they could have imagined... and then the dragon began to cry! #p2400005# and #p2400006# didn’t know what to do, but a man named #p2411010# appeared to console the monster before they could act... Things were getting strange.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 790800

string.name: name
string.value: The Saddest Dragon 1

With #p2411011#’s weeping fit fading into history, Alpha and Beta decided to return to #b#MDmap321190300##k to explain all the weird things that happened in #m321100000#. The man named #b#p2411010##k would surely have some answers.

#p2400005# and #p2400006# sang a sweet #blullaby#k to console #p2411011# for #p2411010#, but the dragon was an emotional wreck! In the end, they decided that the only thing for the safety of the village was to tranquilize the dragon. Luckily, #b#p2411001##k in #b#m321100000##k knew of a sleep-inducing instrument.
#p2411001# in #m321100000# knew of the instrument! The duo was on their way to sleepytown.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 273000

string.name: name
string.value: The Saddest Dragon 2

Alpha and Beta learned of a young Halflinger girl named #p2411001# in #b#m321100000##k who was an expert on music. They ventured to her in search of an instrument that would put that weepy #p2411011# to sleep, before things got any more awkward.

#p2411001# suggested that the duo use her magical music box, a gift from #b the Fairy Queen #k, but lamented that it had been broken in a completely unavoidable on-stage smashfest. But spirits were still high, because the items needed to repair it were nearby!\r\n\r\nThe duo headed to the #bdungeon portal#k to enter the #b#MDmirrorD_321_1_##k, and find the parts.
With the parts in hand, the duo returned to #p2411001#. The sweet lullaby maker was almost theirs!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 770000 \r\n

string.name: name
string.value: The Saddest Dragon 3
With the parts in hand, the duo returned to #p2411001#. The sweet lullaby maker was almost theirs!

Alpha and Beta got the music box from #p2411001#, along with a strange lecture on dissonant cycles. They hoped against hope that the little box would be able to subdue the great #p2411011#, but they would need to see #b#p2411010##k in #b#MDmap321190300##k before they could be sure.

#p2411011# fell right to sleep when the music box played near it, and #p2411010# told the duo the strange events that had led to its rampage. The giant known as #p2411011# had been a baby mere days before, when it stumbled into a strange relic that looked like a hourglass. Could the relic be responsible?

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 554000

string.name: name
string.value: A Curse in Time
#p2411010# believes that #p2411011# was cursed by the time relic. Alpha and Beta knew they would need to speak with the priests in the Temple of Time to confirm his suspicions...

With the truth that #p2411011# had definitely been cursed by the relic, #p2400000# put out the idea that the relic only wanted to be handled by its owner. With the strange notion of a relic having feeling in their heads, the duo set back to visit #b#p2411010##k in #b#m321100000##k #b#MDmap321190300##k.
Alpha and Beta returned to #p2411010# and explained how to break the curse. As luck would have it, this was one of #p2411010#’s specialties! #p2400005# was quite impressed.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 193000 \r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Breaking the Curse
The time curse required a rather elaborate ritual to reverse, but #b#p2411010##k in #b#MDmap321190300##k knew just what to do.

Three ingredients were needed to break the spell: b#t4033805##k, #b#t4033806##k, and Leviathan Scales. #p2411010# had the Leviathan Scale in his store room, but the others would need to be collected from #b#MDmirrorD_321_1_##k and #b#MDmirrorD_321_2_##k.
With the materials gathered, it came time to break the curse! But #p2411010# was in for some surprises.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 808000 \r\n
#p2411010#’s reckless incantations broke the curse, but also blew him up a little. He wasn’t gravely injured, but #p2400005# and #p2400006# felt more than a little guilty.

Once #p2411010# was healed, he told #p2400005# and #p2400006# that the shockwaves from the explosion had made the area unstable, then sent them away. They wondered if they would ever meet this wizard again...
Was #p2411010# the same strange man in Maple World? #p2400005# and #p2400006# may not ever find out, but they had preparations to make for the relic.

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 819000

string.name: name
string.value: Relic World 1

Alpha and Beta were shocked to find that the Time Relic has a conscience, and they would need to pass a test to become its owner! They would have to talk to #p2400007# enter the relic’s inner dimension.

Alpha and Beta attempted to enter the relic, but only #p2400006# managed to get inside! She found herself in a place that almost looked like a temple, where a spirit named #p2400009# demanded she pass his #btest#k.
#p2400006# passed the test, and obtained control over #p2400009#! But the relic was still incomplete. To combine their powers, #p2400005# would have to prove himself to #p2400010#...

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1706000

string.name: name
string.value: Relic World 2
It was Alpha’s turn to face judgment by the spirit #p2400010# inside the Relic World. He steeled himself, and went to #p2400007# to get him there.
#p2400005# arrived at a beautiful temple, just like #p2400006#, and met #p2400010#. She offered her allegiance in exchange for a #btest#k...
#p2400005# earned #p2400010#’s respect, and her allegiance! #p2400005# and #p2400006# joined forces with the Time Relic’s guardians, #p2400009# and #p2400010#!

string.name: rewardSummary
string.value:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1706000

string.name: name
string.value: Ariant, the Desert Town

string.name: demandSummary
string.value: #questorder1# Gather intel in Ariant (#R40115ExRef40100#)\r\n

The egg doesn't have much time left until it hatches. It would be sad to watch it hatch without a mother. Kumo believes the monsters in the Minar Forest has done something with the egg's mother. Go find information on the mother by eliminating #r#o2600002##k and #r#o2600006##k.

Jasmin is concerned since her son is old and hasn't found a job. The rumor is that it is easy to get a low level job by kissing up to the queen. Jasmin has requested that you deliver the silk that she has made by working on it day and night to Areda in the #bAriant Palace.#k

Aldin tells you that he has been in love with the pretty dancer named Sirin for a while but he hasn't been able to talk to her once because he is shy. Go get #r#t4000936##k for Aldin so that he can see the beautiful Sirin up close.

Shati wants you to go to the #bSand Bandits#k and deliver a message, requesting that they steal her father's wealth.

string.name: name
string.value: The Start of Adventure

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/501/0#
It began with a tree, a maple tree. As you left its comforting embrace, you sensed that an adventure beyond your wildest dreams loomed ahead. A Maple Leaf brushed your shoes, and you tucked it into your Explorer Book as a reminder of your origins. 

And so, your adventure began.
#eThe Start of Adventure\r\n\r\n#bLv 10#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The New Seal Stone

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/510/2#
Fascinated, you watched as the Maple Leaf transformed into a jewel.

Suddenly, power filled your veins and your attacks began to have an effect. It was the blessing of a Goddess.

You gave it everything you had, and in the end, you vanquished the darkness.

The Goddess revealed she was spirit of Maple Island, who dwelled in the Maple Tree.

She sensed that the world was in danger, and sent her other self, Sugar, to keep watch.

She said the Maple Leaf had become the Seal Stone of Maple Island, formed out of your friends' desire to save the island.

Using its power, you restored Maple Island to its original form.

Then, you hugged your friends goodbye.

And so this story drew to a close, but others had yet to begin. More adventures awaited those with the will to search for them.
#eThe New Seal Stone\r\n\r\n#bLv 100#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Start of Adventure

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/101/0#
It began with a tree, a maple tree. As you left its comforting embrace, you sensed that an adventure beyond your wildest dreams loomed ahead. A Maple Leaf brushed your shoes, and you tucked it into your Explorer Book as a reminder of your origins. 

And so, your adventure began.
#eThe Start of Adventure\r\n\r\n#bLv 10#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: A Very Un-Explorer-like Girl

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/102/0#
While exploring Victoria Island, you bumped into a girl named Sugar.

She was headed for Ellinia to take her Job Advancement test, but her fear of bugs got in her way.

You took care of the bugs with ease, but Sugar had a new problem: she said the tree was crying out in pain. And so, you brought medicine for the tree.

You couldn't help but wonder. Sugar was scared of bugs and could hear trees. Was she really suited to be an Explorer?

Sugar admitted to sharing your doubts, but she said she had no choice but to keep moving forward, for she had to stop the disaster that was headed toward Maple World...
#eA Very Un-Explorer-like Girl\r\n\r\n#bLv 25#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Stolen Jewel

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/103/0#
You were settling into your new life when you heard a news flash: An important jewel that belonged to the Explorer's Guild was stolen by a masked thief!

Athena Pierce requested your help in retrieving it, which is how you ended up chasing the thief up and down the outskirts of Henesys. When you finally stopped the thief and got the jewel, an Explorer named Olive appeared.

Olive said she was the one who was supposed to deliver the jewel to Athena Pierce in the first place and that she wanted to finish her delivery.

Olive laughed when you handed her the jewel, which gave you a bad feeling. So you were hardly surprised when Athena Pierce told you that Olive never showed up.

Athena Pierce also revealed that the jewel was actually a Seal Stone, an artifact of immense but mysterious powers. Who stole the Seal Stone? What evil plans were they hatching upon Maple World? And none of this was your fault, was it?
#eThe Stolen Jewel\r\n\r\n#bLv 45#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Real Culprit

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/104/0#
You traveled to Ereve in search of Olive and the Seal Stone.

When you confronted her, Olive adamantly denied having anything to do with the Seal Stone. She blamed someone called the 'Master of Disguise.'

You thought maybe she was telling the truth, but before you could decide, someone from the Thieves Guild arrived and snatched Olive away.

As she was being dragged off, Olive begged you to talk to Neinheart in Ereve to find proof of her innocence.

Neinheart confirmed that the 'Master of Disguise' did in fact exist and that his disguises were flawless.

But now you wondered, who in Maple World was this so-called Master of Disguise?
#eThe Real Culprit\r\n\r\n#bLv 60#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Master of Disguise

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/105/0#
With your latest lead, you finally felt like you were putting together the pieces to the puzzle.

Sugar, Tess, Rondo, and Olive met you at the El Nath Crystal Passageway to pursue the Master of Disguise.

While there, Rondo overheard some Black Wings saying that their leaders were collecting Seal Stones, though they weren't sure why.

With Sugar's help, you managed to defeat the Master of Disguise! You returned the Seal Stone to Athena Pierce, in person this time.

Everything worked out in the end, but the questions lingered.

What were the Seal Stones? What was the Black Wings' ultimate goal?

And most importantly of all, was the Black Mage directly involved in all of this?
#eThe Master of Disguise\r\n\r\n#bLv 70#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Broken Seal

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/106/0#
You checked on various towns to make sure Maple World was prepared for the Black Mage's potential return, and in the process, discovered that the Gate of the Present was open.

You ventured through the gate, and at the end of a long corridor... you encountered the Black Mage himself. Upon further investigation, you discovered that one of his seals had broken.

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/106/1#
Using the Seal Stone Athena Pierce had in her possession to replace the broken seal might stop the Black Mage from breaking free, or so you hoped.

But as you were installing the Seal Stone, an unfamiliar voice spoke, sending chills tingling down your spine.

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/106/2#
#e'Do not be a fool. Give in to the darkness.'#n

You continued your mission, despite your fears, but just as you were screwing in the final bolt, the seal broke. A dark voice reverberated, then grew faint.

#e'You will pay for your foolishness...'#n
#eThe Broken Seal\r\n\r\n#bLv 80#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: Maple Island Disaster

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/107/0#
Before you could recover from your shock, Sugar contacted you, begging you to return to Maple Island. When you stepped off the ferry, you saw your beloved island was in flames.

Amidst the chaos, you learned that Sugar had fled. You headed toward Maple Tree Hill and found her battling a fire.

It wasn't until after you put out the fire that you saw that Sugar was hurt. When you brought her water to cool her wounds, she poured it onto the tree and said that all was now well.

As you and your friends mourned the island together, you suddenly realized... Perhaps you could use the Seal Stones to restore Maple Island! But you needed more information on how the stones worked.

There was only one thing left to do. You had to visit the Heroes who created the stones and tap them for knowledge.
#eMaple Island Disaster\r\n\r\n#bLv 90#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: Aran, the Warrior Hero

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/108/0#
Aran, so you visited Rien Island, where Lilin peppered you with questions, testing your intentions.

In the midst of Lilin's quizzes, Aran appeared. But he had amnesia and could remember nothing of use.

He showed you a Seal Stone, and together, you pieced together that each continent had its own stone, specific to it. Unfortunately, many of those stones were in the hands of the Black Wings.

Aran promised he'd be around if you ever needed him, and you returned to Maple Island.

When the others reconvened, you put together this knowledge:

#eMaple Island had no Seal Stone.#n
#eAran, the Warrior Hero\r\n\r\n#bLv 90#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Darkness Returns

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/109/0#
Even without a Seal Stone, you knew you couldn't give up on Maple Island.

As you and the others rebuilt Maple Island, brick by brick, a darkness crept back toward the island.

It was as dark as night, but you recognized it... the Black Mage's Shadow.

His shadow held but a fraction of the Black Mage's true powers...

...yet not even your most powerful strikes could maim it.

The others grew weary, as you fought futilely. The end was nigh.

Your friends poured the last of their strength into you. You knew it wouldn't be enough, but you were determined to try. Suddenly, a mystic glow poured out of you and a Maple Leaf floated before your eyes.
#eThe Darkness Returns\r\n\r\n#bLv 100#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The New Seal Stone

Fascinated, you watched as the Maple Leaf transformed into a jewel.

Suddenly, power filled your veins and your attacks began to have an effect. It was the blessing of a Goddess.

You gave it everything you had, and in the end, you vanquished the darkness.

The Goddess revealed she was spirit of Maple Island, who dwelled in the Maple Tree.

She sensed that the world was in danger, and sent her other self, Sugar, to keep watch.

She said the Maple Leaf had become the Seal Stone of Maple Island, formed out of your friends' desire to save the island.

Using its power, you restored Maple Island to its original form.

Then, you hugged your friends goodbye.

And so this story drew to a close, but others had yet to begin. More adventures awaited those with the will to search for them.
#eThe New Seal Stone\r\n\r\n#bLv 100#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Start of Adventure

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/201/0#
It began with a tree, a maple tree. As you left its comforting embrace, you sensed that an adventure beyond your wildest dreams loomed ahead. A Maple Leaf brushed your shoes, and you tucked it into your Explorer Book as a reminder of your origins. 

And so, your adventure began.
#eThe Start of Adventure\r\n\r\n#bLv 10#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Better To Hear You With

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/202/0#
While exploring the Six Path Crossway, you bumped into a stranger.

He ignored you, so you playfully snatched away his hat... only to discover he sported a pair of unusually large ears. 

He grumpily revealed that his name was Rondo and that he was searching Maple World for others like himself.

You accompanied him to Grandis, where you learned about the Anima tribe.

But you couldn't get to the Anima village, since Grandis was at war.

You traveled as far as the border, but a barrier prevented you from proceeding.

Rondo vowed to return someday to find out if the Anima tribe were really his people.
#eThe Better To Hear You With\r\n\r\n#bLv 25#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Stolen Jewel

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/203/0#
You were settling into your new life when you heard a news flash: An important jewel that belonged to the Explorer's Guild was stolen by a masked thief!

Athena Pierce requested your help in retrieving it, which is how you ended up chasing the thief up and down the outskirts of Henesys. When you finally stopped the thief and got the jewel, an Explorer named Olive appeared.

Olive said she was the one who was supposed to deliver the jewel to Athena Pierce in the first place and that she wanted to finish her delivery.

Olive laughed when you handed her the jewel, which gave you a bad feeling. So you were hardly surprised when Athena Pierce told you that Olive never showed up.

Athena Pierce also revealed that the jewel was actually a Seal Stone, an artifact of immense but mysterious powers. Who stole the Seal Stone? What evil plans were they hatching upon Maple World? And none of this was your fault, was it?
#eThe Stolen Jewel\r\n\r\n#bLv 45#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Real Culprit

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/204/0#
You traveled to Ereve in search of Olive and the Seal Stone.

When you confronted her, Olive adamantly denied having anything to do with the Seal Stone. She blamed someone called the 'Master of Disguise.'

You wondered if she was actually telling the truth, but before you could decide, Rondo arrived and tried to snatch her away on behalf of the Thieves Guild.

He refused to believe she was innocent, so you had no choice but to mention his ears.

Rondo hid, embarrassed, and you escorted Olive to Neinheart to get evidence about the Master of Disguise.

Neinheart confirmed that the Master of Disguise did in fact exist and Olive triumphantly rubbed it in Rondo's face. 

But now you wondered, who in Maple World was this so-called Master of Disguise?
#eThe Real Culprit\r\n\r\n#bLv 60#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Master of Disguise

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/205/0#
With your latest lead, you finally felt like you were putting together the pieces to the puzzle.

Sugar, Tess, Rondo, and Olive met you at the El Nath Crystal Passageway to pursue the Master of Disguise.

While there, Rondo overheard some Black Wings saying that their leaders were collecting Seal Stones, though they weren't sure why.

With Sugar's help, you managed to defeat the Master of Disguise! You returned the Seal Stone to Athena Pierce, in person this time.

Everything worked out in the end, but the questions lingered.

What were the Seal Stones? What was the Black Wings' ultimate goal?

And most importantly of all, was the Black Mage directly involved in all of this?
#eThe Master of Disguise\r\n\r\n#bLv 70#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Broken Seal

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/206/0#
You checked on various towns to make sure Maple World was prepared for the Black Mage's potential return, and in the process, discovered that the Gate of the Present was open.

You ventured through the gate, and at the end of a long corridor... you encountered the Black Mage himself. Upon further investigation, you discovered that one of his seals had broken.

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/206/1#
Using the Seal Stone Athena Pierce had in her possession to replace the broken seal might stop the Black Mage from breaking free, or so you hoped.

But as you were installing the Seal Stone, an unfamiliar voice spoke, sending chills tingling down your spine.

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/206/2#
#e'Do not be a fool. Give in to the darkness.'#n

You continued your mission, despite your fears, but just as you were screwing in the final bolt, the seal broke. A dark voice reverberated, then grew faint.

#e'You will pay for your foolishness...'#n
#eThe Broken Seal\r\n\r\n#bLv 80#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: Maple Island Disaster

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/207/0#
Before you could recover from your shock, Sugar contacted you, begging you to return to Maple Island. When you stepped off the ferry, you saw your beloved island was in flames.

Amidst the chaos, you learned that Sugar had fled. You headed toward Maple Tree Hill and found her battling a fire.

It wasn't until after you put out the fire that you saw that Sugar was hurt. When you brought her water to cool her wounds, she poured it onto the tree and said that all was now well.

As you and your friends mourned the island together, you suddenly realized... Perhaps you could use the Seal Stones to restore Maple Island! But you needed more information on how the stones worked.

There was only one thing left to do. You had to visit the Heroes who created the stones and tap them for knowledge.
#eMaple Island Disaster\r\n\r\n#bLv 90#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: Evan, the Magician Hero

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/208/0#
You were assigned to speak to Evan, so you traveled to a farm in Henesys. As Evan's brother greeted you, another boy came whooshing in on a dragon.

Although Evan didn't know much about Seal Stones himself, he gathered some information from Afrien, a dragon friend of his.

Though you had to run a small errand in exchange for the information...

You and Evan commented on how young the other was, and then you returned to Maple Island.

When the others reconvened, you put together this knowledge:

#eMaple Island had no Seal Stone.#n
#eEvan, the Magician Hero\r\n\r\n#bLv 90#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Darkness Returns

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/209/0#
Even without a Seal Stone, you knew you couldn't give up on Maple Island.

As you and the others rebuilt Maple Island, brick by brick, a darkness crept back toward the island.

It was as dark as night, but you recognized it... the Black Mage's Shadow.

His shadow held but a fraction of the Black Mage's true powers...

...yet not even your most powerful strikes could maim it.

The others grew weary, as you fought futilely. The end was nigh.

Your friends poured the last of their strength into you. You knew it wouldn't be enough, but you were determined to try. Suddenly, a mystic glow poured out of you and a Maple Leaf floated before your eyes.
#eThe Darkness Returns\r\n\r\n#bLv 100#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The New Seal Stone

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/210/2#
Fascinated, you watched as the Maple Leaf transformed into a jewel.

Suddenly, power filled your veins and your attacks began to have an effect. It was the blessing of a Goddess.

You gave it everything you had, and in the end, you vanquished the darkness.

The Goddess revealed she was spirit of Maple Island, who dwelled in the Maple Tree.

She sensed that the world was in danger, and sent her other self, Sugar, to keep watch.

She said the Maple Leaf had become the Seal Stone of Maple Island, formed out of your friends' desire to save the island.

Using its power, you restored Maple Island to its original form.

Then, you hugged your friends goodbye.

And so this story drew to a close, but others had yet to begin. More adventures awaited those with the will to search for them.
#eThe New Seal Stone\r\n\r\n#bLv 100#k#n requirement

string.value: Olive Makes a Request

While exploring Victoria Island, you bumped into a girl named Olive, who was obsessed with all things shiny, including a special jewel that was property of the Thieves Guild.

Olive sent you into a secret Thieves Guild room to scope out the jewel, only for you to encounter a masked intruder!

You managed to defeat the intruder. When you filled Olive in, she complained that all the shiny stuff she liked was always stolen by other people first.

You realized that it could be a concerted effort by a malicious organization. Olive agreed, noting that the group must be powerful to make it into the Thieves Guild's hideout...
#eOlive Makes a Request\r\n\r\n#bLv 25#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Stolen Jewel

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/403/0#
A masked stranger stole the Explorer Guild's precious gem!
You tracked down that masked stranger to the Outskirts of Henesys and recovered the gem. And suddenly Olivia the Explorer appeared and said, 'Thank you for getting the gem back.' 
You sense something is wrong because Olivia is treating you too politely, as if she's never met you before. When you point it out, Olivia turned into someone else and that person ran away.
Athena Pierce said the gem is not just a regular gem, but a 'Seal Stone' with mysterious powers, and that it's desired by many. Who are they? And what are its powers?
#eThe Stolen Jewel\r\n\r\n#bLv 45#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: Digging for the Truth

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/404/0#
The Dark Lord suspected that the Seal Stone was stolen by the Master of Disguise, a member of the Black Wings.

But none of the Job Instructors understood why the Black Wings would want a Seal Stone. They needed more information.

They sent you to Ereve to gather intel from the Cygnus Knights and to Edelstein, to speak to the Resistance.

Both Neinheart, the cold-hearted tactician of the knights, and Claudine, a leader of the notoriously close-lipped Resistance, provided you with all the knowledge they could.

Slowly, you pieced together that the Black Wings wanted to cause strife within the Explorer ranks. But why?
#eDigging for the Truth\r\n\r\n#bLv 60#k#n requirement

You had to prepare for the expedition. Leon probably knew what you needed to pack. He said it'd be different this time, because you were going to be at sea... You realized he wasn't being all that helpful.

Leon asked you to gather supplies from the General Store while he put together a crew. You went to pick up the items.\n

Leon asked you to gather supplies from the General Store while he put together a crew. You went to pick up the items, but were overwhelmed by all the stuff. The guys at the store said they were told to deliver the stuff straight to the harbor, and then you ran into the Robed Lady...

The items Leon ordered were going to be delivered straight to the harbor, so there wasn't much for you to do, but... you kept running into that Robed Lady.\n

The items Leon ordered were going to be delivered straight to the harbor, so there wasn't much for you to do, but... you kept running into that Robed Lady. Later, you discovered Leon knew the store delivered. You felt so used!

You followed Leon to the harbor and ran into the Robed Lady... again. She wanted to be part of the expedition.
You followed Leon to the harbor and ran into the Robed Lady... again. She wanted to be part of the expedition, so you brought her along.

Leon was already on board. You felt you should tell him you brought a virtual stranger along with you.
Leon was already on board. You felt you should tell him you brought a virtual stranger along with you, and he got really upset.

Leon was already on board. You felt you should tell him you brought a virtual stranger along with you, and he got really upset. You agreed it wasn't the smartest move, and suddenly, Leon stopped you. What was with him?

Things seemed calm. You started to grow sleepy.\n
Things seemed calm. You started to grow sleepy. Then someone sighted the pirates!
Things seemed calm. You started to grow sleepy. Then someone sighted the pirates! You defeated them but saw no sign of Captain Blood. You thought you might have to hunt him down!

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] Arg! Chase!
You defeated a bunch of pirates, and finally tracked down Captain Blood's ship.
You defeated a bunch of pirates, and finally tracked down Captain Blood's ship. His evil henchmen started to board your ship.

You defeated a bunch of pirates, and finally tracked down Captain Blood's ship. His evil henchmen started to board your ship. You took care of them all, but noted they were stronger than the first batch.\n

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] Close Up with Captain Blood
With his crew eliminated, Captain Blood showed up to the fight himself. It was going to be a true pirate showdown! \n
With his crew eliminated, Captain Blood showed up to the fight himself. It was going to be a true pirate showdown!
With his crew eliminated, Captain Blood showed up to the fight himself. It was going to be a true pirate showdown! But the evil captain was no match for you. Maybe he'll think twice next time.

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] Outlaw of the Sea
Grosso Polpo appeared when you were trying to lock up Captain Blood, and Leon was right in its path. You'd have to let the pirate go to save your unlucky friend.\n
Grosso Polpo appeared when you were trying to lock up Captain Blood, and Leon was right in its path. You'd have to let the pirate go to save your unlucky friend.
You shooed away Grosso Polpo, but the beast certainly lived up to its nickname, the outlaw of the sea. It seemed to be toying with you... but will it ever come face you in earnest?\n

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] The Fall of Captain Blood
Your fight with Grosso Polpo almost made you forget about Captain Blood... until the Robed Lady reminded you.
Captain Blood sped away, floating off into the horizon... that guy is definitely the pirate king.\n
The man once called the Pirate King has been taken down by an unnamed Robed Lady...

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] Back to San Commerci
Captain Blood has escaped, and there's no way to catch him now... Return to San Commerci.
Captain Blood has escaped, and there's no way to catch him now... Return to San Commerci.

Captain Blood has escaped, and there's no way to catch him now. Upon arrival in San Commerci, the Robed Lady took her reward and disappeared. And then Leon seemed disappointed. What is going on in this town?!\n

string.value: [Commerci] Heaven Empire
Rumor has it that an envoy from the Heaven Empire is on his way. Maybe Leon will tell you what that means...\n
Rumor has it that an envoy from the Heaven Empire is on his way. Leon gave you a little rundown of why that was important.\n
Leon told you that the #rHeaven Empire#k is the most powerful nation in Dawnveil, and an envoy in Commerci can only mean trouble.\n

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] Troubling Reports
Despite all the craziness, you headed back to Gilberto to let him know about Captain Blood.
Despite all the craziness, you headed back to Gilberto to let him know about Captain Blood.
You told Gilberto about defeating the pirates and your victory over Captain Blood, but he seemed distracted by the news of the Heaven Empire envoy.

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] A Funny Kind of Peace
The delegate from the Heaven Empire has arrived, and Gilberto's looking pretty nervous. Is the Heaven Empire that powerful?\n
The delegate from the Heaven Empire has arrived, and Gilberto's looking pretty nervous. The envoy, Zion, proposed a number of unfair treaties in the name of 'peace'.\n

The delegate from the Heaven Empire has arrived, and Gilberto's looking pretty nervous. The envoy, Zion, proposed a number of unfair treaties in the name of 'peace'. In a rage, Leon kicked the delegate out.\n

string.value: [Commerci] Playing Courier
Leon took off after Zion. Before you could give chase, Gilberto said he had a favor to ask...\n
Leon took off after Zion. Before you could give chase, Gilberto said he had a favor to ask... He had a letter for Vaughn Tremier.\n
You delivered Gilberto's letter to Vaughn Tremier, and were met with scoffing laughter. It was harsh, but you're in no position to question him. Gilberto will need to know.

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] Don't Even Ask
You delivered the letter to Vaughn Tremier, the second most powerful man in Commerci. He was not quite what you were expecting, and he has quite a bit to say.\n
Vaughn Tremier claimed that Gilberto's karma was finally catching up to him, and scoffed at his letter. It wasn't pretty, but Gilberto will need to know.
You delivered Vaughn Tremier's message to Gilberto, asking him to take full responsibility for the Heaven Empire's demands. Gilberto did not take it well.\n

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] Screaming in the Night
Things weren't going so well in San Commerci, so you decided to go out for a stroll.\n
Things weren't going so well in San Commerci, so you decided to go out for a stroll. But you heard a scream, and found Zion on the ground, surrounded by what looked like assassins!\n

While you were out walking the streets, you found Zion on the ground, surrounded by what looked like assassins! They were highly-trained, but they took off once they heard Gilberto's group heading this way.\n

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] False Charges
The Assassins fled, but YOU were the one standing over the Heaven Empire envoy's body when help arrived. You're in a pickle!\n
The Assassins fled, but YOU were the one standing over the Heaven Empire envoy's body when help arrived. You're in a pickle! Vaughn Tremier insisted that you were the culprit.

The Assassins fled, but YOU were the one standing over the Heaven Empire envoy's body when help arrived. You're in a pickle! Vaughn Tremier insisted that you were the culprit, but the Robed Lady saved you from arrest. \n

The Robed Lady has saved your hide three times already! This mysterious woman needs to be unmasked! See if you can find out who she really is.\n
The Robed Lady has saved your hide three times already! This mysterious woman needs to be unmasked! But when you tried to talk to her, a roaming pack of Lupos came out of nowhere!\n

The Robed Lady has saved your hide three times already! This mysterious woman needs to be unmasked! After you fended off the wolf attack, you found yourself in the middle of nowhere... It's dangerous out here.\n

string.value: [Commerci] Who's That Lady?
With the Lupos out of the picture, you returned to your goal of unmasking the Robed Lady, but she doesn't seem to think it's such a great idea.\n
With the Lupos out of the picture, you returned to your goal of unmasking the Robed Lady, but she doesn't seem to think it's such a great idea. Leon doubled down on his reward to try and entice her.
With the Lupos out of the picture, you returned to your goal of unmasking the Robed Lady, and Leon's reward worked! Claire Tremier, the daughter of Vaughn Tremier, revealed herself as the Robed Lady!

string.value: [Commerci] Claire's Story
Claire Tremier was the one who helped you get away from her own father's accusations. Leon wanted to know more.\n
Claire Tremier was the one who helped you get away from her own father's accusations. Leon wanted to know more.\n
Claire Tremier was the one who helped you get away from her own father's accusations. Claire's story was a sad one, but she had nothing to do with the false charges placed on you by her father.\n

string.name: name
string.value: [Commerci] Dances with Wolves 2
Now that you've heard Claire's story, you're going to need to make some plans. This place is dangerous!

Now that you've heard Claire's story, you're going to need to make some plans. This place is dangerous! You looked around the area, and found a big pack of Lupos. Hunt some down to make an escape route.\n
Now that you've heard Claire's story, you're going to need to make some plans. This place is dangerous! You cleared out some of the Lupos, but found Leon making a big fuss. What's he on about now?\n

Claire Tremier is gone! Where did she go? Leon said that Claire disappeared when the masked assailants showed up... Another group appeared while you were talking, so you beat them up. Something strange is going on.\n

You took out the assassins, but Leon seems to be having a mental breakdown. You calmed him down, and discussed your plans going forward.
Leon is convinced that Claire was kidnapped. You've both decided that these secrets need to be laid open before anything bad happens.\n

You found the Assassin's hideout and took out the guards. It's time to go inside.\n

Zion is alive, and he and Claire know each other. You tried to listen in on their conversation, but they were just talking too quietly. Then Leon ruined the whole thing when he rushed out to confront them.\n

Leon rushed in on them and Zion was shocked. He obviously didn't want anybody to see him here... But then a strange man appeared: the man called Il Capo had set a deadly trap! But you were able to destroy it.\n

You took care of Il Capo, and now you should interrogate Zion. He was clearly confused as to where to turn. Question Zion.

You took care of Il Capo, and interrogated Zion. He was clearly confused as to where to turn. Zion, scared as a mouse, revealed that the Heaven Empire is planning to isolate Commerci from the rest of the nations.\n

Zion was assassinated on the way to prove your innocence to Gilberto. With the only proof of the Heaven Empire's plot to cripple Commerci gone, you turned to #b#p9390237##k. But she was preoccuppied with a strange feeling she had...

Your only witness is gone, but complaining won't bring Zion back to life. You were about to head back to San Commerci to talk to Gilberto, but Claire stopped you. She senses something evil. And nearby, you found a new barrier!\n

You discovered an invisible barrier, the evil presence Claire was feeling. Someone would need to get past it. You decided to go in alone, and found something very powerful within. You need to get back to town and report this.\n

The strange barrier will have to wait until you clear your good name, and warn Gilberto about the Heaven Empire's plot. Return to San Commerci. You returned to speak with Gilberto, but found Vaughn Tremier instead...

You spill the beans to Gilberto: Zion's fake death, and real death, the assassins, their leader, and the true conspirator behind it all, the Heaven Empire.

You spill the beans to Gilberto: Zion's fake death, and real death, the assassins, their leader, and the true conspirator behind it all, the Heaven Empire. But Vaughn Tremier would not have it. He demanded your immediate arrest, and would have had it, if it hadn't been for Claire.\n

Vaughn Tremier turned his attention to Claire. Finally, you have the opportunity to speak with Gilberto. You told him everything there was to know, but with no evidence, there was nothing he could do. But he surprised you with a request...\n

Gilberto has something he wants you to do. He wants you to broker a peace with Maple World. Can this be true?\n

With Gilberto's trust won, you went to find Leon at the harbor to return to Maple World. Only, when you arrived, he and Claire were speaking to each other! You gave Leon's letter to Claire.\n

You decide to go thank Claire, and do a favor for Leon at the same time. But, when you gave her Leon's letter, she didn't seem interested at all... You felt bad for Leon.

Your time in Commerci has made you homesick for Maple World. You talked to Leon Daniella, and got on the boat back to Maple World, but you ran into Parbell when you got off! The old timer gave you a gift.

Captain Blood was shocked to see you bring down his men. But right when you thought you had him cornered, he escaped to his ship! Guess that's why he's the Pirate King. Leon didn't think you'd have another chance like this, so he proposed chasing Captain Blood onto his ship.
You knew better than to send your own captain, Leon, so you boarded Captain Blood's ship alone. Of course, It was a trap.

Captain Blood finally faced you in combat, but he was no match for your skills. With his crew defeated, it was time to capture him. But then something went wrong on your ship. What happened?

Captain Blood finally faced you in combat, but he was no match for your skills. With his crew defeated, it was time to capture him. But then something went wrong on your ship. The kraken, #rGrosso Polpo#k, attacked your crew!

Parbell's gift was pretty nice. You thought he might know more about you then he let on, but you didn't bring it up. Instead, you went to see the Empress. She and Neinheart were very happy to see you. You told them all about Commerci and the peace agreement you managed to obtain at last.

string.name: name
string.value: I: To the Ends of the World

Those shock waves that Pepper mentioned in Tynerum...
What could be causing them? What's beyond the Tynerum barrier? As you pondered those questions, you received a message from #p1101002#.
#p1101002# sent you an invitation to #m130000000#, on behalf of the Empress.
In #m130000000#, the Empress revealed something rather horrifying.
She said the shock waves were getting stronger because the barrier was getting weaker. She wasn't sure what would happen to Maple World if the barrier were to completely disappear...
She asked you to venture past the barrier to see what you could discover. You agreed, eager to conquer the unknown.

Neinheart called you to Ereve for an urgent meeting.
The Empress asked to look into this new land, and propose a peaceful alliance if possible. 
You traveled to the southernmost tip of Shadow Veil Forest, but you didn't find anything strange until you met an old man named #b#e#p9390200##k#n. 
Once you'd located his missing Emerald, he told you about the continent of #e#bDawnveil#k#n. It sounded like a call to adventure.
Dawnveil, the lost continent... #p9390200# offered to send you there, and it was then you were sure this was the land the Empress had spoken of. A new adventure was just around the bend...

string.name: name
string.value: II: A New Friend?

Those shock waves that Pepper mentioned in Tynerum...
What could be causing them? What's beyond the Tynerum barrier? As you pondered those questions, you received a message from #p1101002#.
#p1101002# sent you an invitation to #m130000000#, on behalf of the Empress.
In #m130000000#, the Empress revealed something that rather horrifying.
She said the shock waves were getting stronger because the barrier was getting weaker. She wasn't sure what would happen to Maple World if the barrier were to completely disappear...
She asked you to venture past the barrier to see what you could discover. You agreed, eager to conquer the unknown.

Neinheart called you to Ereve for an urgent meeting.
The Empress asked to look into this new land, and propose a peaceful alliance if possible. 
You traveled to the southernmost tip of Shadow Veil Forest, but you didn't find anything strange.
Until you met an old man named #b#e#p9390200##k#n. 
Once you'd located his missing Emerald, he told you about the continent of #e#bDawnveil#k#n. It sounded like a call to adventure.
Dawnveil, the lost continent... #p9390200# offered to send you there, and it was then you were sure this was the land the Empress had spoken of. A new adventure was just around the bend...

You arrived in #e#r#m865010200##k#n, a small town in Dawnveil, where you met #b#e#p9390201##n#k. 
#p9390201# seemed to be the only citizen of his own small fishing village in the #e#rCommerci Republic#k#n, on the western coast of Dawnveil.
You stuck around and ran some errands for the Mayor, and he eventually introduced you to #b#e#p9390202##k#n, of the Daniella Merchant Union.
#p9390202# was a very spirited man, and pleasant to be around. He was finishing up some business, and asked you to meet him in #e#b#m865000000##k#n, the capital city of the Commerci Republic. This could be an opportunity to form an alliance with Ereve!
And then you finally arrive at San Commerci.

string.name: name
string.value: III: The Trade Nation
You decided to go to the Daniella Merchant Union and meet #e#bGilberto Daniella#k#n. You needed to find a way to gain his trust if you wanted to establish peaceful relations with Commerci.

You tried to find the Daniella Merchant Union in San Commerci, but the city was so enormous! You asked around to see if anyone could point you toward #e#bGilberto Daniella#k#n, but nobody was all that helpful. 
Was this guy really that influential?
There was a robbery! Tepes, from the Daniella Merchant Union, left some goods at the trading post. Supposedly, he picked them up later, but he denied ever doing so. 
What a mystery! You decided to investigate, thinking that solving this debacle would get you a shot at meeting Gilberto.
When you investigated at the Trading Post, they claimed Tepes picked up the goods himself.
Maestra FIametta said she noticed something strange, though. Although the goods looked ready to be shipped, they were taken away in a cart instead of straight to a boat. This seemed like a solid clue... You took some time to really think about what you learned so far.
You concluded that the thief escaped via the canals, and headed there. Then, you ran into the thief! The thief ditched the goods, and you couldn't leave the goods behind, so the thief got away. You returned the goods to Tepes, who was relieved.
You asked Tepes to set up a meeting with Gilberto of the Daniella Merchant Union. He agreed, though he said it'd be difficult. He told you to go to the white building east of fountain square.
You tried to talk to Gilberto there, but were rebuffed. He said he didn't talk to anyone without an appointment. Argh!
You decided to try again. Tepes appeared and explained how you had helped him out, so you finally had a chance to introduce yourself to Gilberto, though you suspected he'd think you were a devil if you told him you came from across the barrier.
Unfortunately, Leon arrived on the scene and revealed that fact anyway. Gilberto said nothing, but you could tell he was deep in thought. Gilberto's reaction earlier was troubling you. Did he think you were a liar? Leon said you were over-thinking things and suggested checking out the guild. 
Not a bad idea, but Gilberto's reaction still lingered on your mind.
Voices from below caught your attention, and you learned that you were right, Gilberto didn't trust you. You needed to find a way to gain his trust if you wanted to establish peaceful relations with Commerci.

string.name: name
string.value: I: Canal Warfare

During your first morning in #b#m865000000##k, the capital of the Commerci Republic, you realize the prime minster of Commerci, #b#p9390203##k, didn't trust you. You needed to find a way to gain his trust if you wanted to establish peaceful relations with Commerci.

During your first morning in #b#m865000000##k, the capital of the Commerci Republic, you realized the prime minster of Commerci, #b#p9390203##k, didn't trust you. You needed to find a way to gain his trust if you wanted to establish peaceful relations with Commerci. You found your opportunity when you learned that the land roads were sealed by the Delfinos living below the canals... 
You saw this as an opportunity to win #p9390203#'s trust.
You fought the #rDelfinos#k, learning that they didn't get aggressive until Commerci started developing canals. 
Leon kept plowing forward. You thought you smelled a trap, and you were right. You weren't sure how you could find a way out of your predicament...

string.name: name
string.value: II: Odd Lady

You realized the prime minster of Commerci, #b#p9390203##k, didn't trust you. You needed to find a way to gain his trust if you wanted to establish peaceful relations with Commerci, so you went on a mission to secure land routes with #b#p9390202##k, #p9390203#'s son. Leon was tricked by the Delfino, and now all hope looked lost.

You realized the prime minster of Commerci, #b#p9390203##k, didn't trust you. You needed to find a way to gain his trust if you wanted to establish peaceful relations with Commerci, so you went on a mission to secure land routes with #b#p9390202##k, #p9390203#'s son. Leon was tricked by the Delfino, and now all hope looked lost. \r\nOut of the dust stepped the thief who stole the goods from the Daniella Merchant Union. You reported to Prime Minister Daniella after defeating the Delfinos, but you didn't mention Leon's little mistake. He was just trying to get his father's approval... \r\nYou hoped Gilberto was starting to trust you.

string.name: name
string.value: I: Living Dangerously
You defeated the Delfinos and reopened land routes to earn #b#p9390203##k's trust, but he still didn't seem to trust you. You weren't sure what to do next.

You defeated the Delfinos and reopened land routes to earn #b#p9390203##k's trust, but he still didn't seem to trust you. You weren't sure what to do next. Suddenly, a sailor showed up with urgent news.
There was trouble with the sea trade! The nefarious #r#o9390817##k was unifying the pirates against the Daniella Trade Union.
Gilberto grew very angry when he heard about his ships being attacked by Captain Blood. Leon claimed he could get rid of Captain Blood... with your help. Gilberto scolded Leon, concerned about his health, then later pulled you aside to ask you to watch over his son. Leon asked you to gather supplies from the General Store while he put together a crew.
You kept running into #b#p9390204##k. She seemed to want to join the expedition.

string.name: name
string.value: II: Collision at Sea
You defeated the Delfinos and reopened land routes to earn #b#p9390203##k's trust. Now you had to defeat #r#o9390817##k with #b#p9390202##k.

You defeated the Delfinos and reopened land routes to earn #b#p9390203##k's trust. Now you had to defeat #r#o9390817##k with #b#p9390202##k. #b#p9390204##k seemed to want to join the expedition, so you brought her along. Leon got upset until he saw her.
You defeated a bunch of pirates, and finally tracked down Captain Blood's ship.

But peace is a frail thing. Especially when Captain Blood is sailing the seas! The pirates attacked, and you chased them off.

But this Captain Blood was different from your previous battles. They were more organized, and more dangerous. You defeated them, but something strange happened when you tried to capture the Captain.

The great #rGrosso Polpo#k, the outlaw of the Dawnveil seas appeared to stop you!

You were able to fend off the great kraken, but it was almost as if Grosso Polpo was toying with you... and in the ensuing battle, Captain Blood got away.

You watched in disbelief as the woman you'd met stepped forward to curse Captain Blood, the reigning pirate king.

string.name: name
string.value: I: Unwelcome Guest
You've traveled across land and sea, trying to gain acceptance in the Commerci Republic. You defeated #r#o9390817##k, one Dawnveil's number one enemies, but returned to find Commerci in disarray.

You've traveled across land and sea, trying to gain acceptance in the Commerci Republic. You defeated #r#o9390817##k, one Dawnveil's number one enemies, but returned to find Commerci in disarray. A nearby sailor told you that an envoy from the #rHeaven Empire#k is on his way.

According to #p9390202#, the Heaven Empire is the most powerful among the seven nations of Dawnveil. They have long acted as if they ruled all seven nations, but Commerci's rise to financial independence has threatened their hold on the region. 

The Heaven Empire's envoy, #r#p9390207##k, has come with a peace treaty packed full of unreasonable conditions, but the Daniellas refused to accept it. This could be bad for Commerci.

Giberto sent you to his greatest merchant rival, #b#p9390206##k, with a letter that turned out to be a plea for help. But #b#p9390206##k was no soft-hearted fool. He scoffed at the idea of helping Gilberto, and sent you back to break the bad news.

string.name: name
string.value: II: A Lady You Know

The celebration for your recent success in clearing up Commerci's trade routes is brief at best. The #rHeaven Empire#k has dispatched a set of impossible terms for continued peace. Now everyone in Commerci is in danger...

With the troubles of the nation on your shoulders, you went to blow off some steam in San Commerci. But a sudden scream brought you face to face with the body of #r#p9390207##k, the peace envoy! The assassins were still there, and you were under attack... Until Giberto's group drove them off. You were left standing over the body of a political messenger, and #r#p9390206##k charged you with murder! His son, Leon, tried to stand up for you, but the two of you were suddenly whisked away by a flash of light...

The #b#p9390204##k saved you both. You and Leon convinced her to reveal her true identity, and found none other than #b#p9390205##k beneath the robes. 

She returned to Commerci from the Heaven Empire to raise money for her training as a magician, but your conversation was interrupted before you could find out more. It was a wolf attack! And while you were busy fighting them off, Claire disappeared.

string.name: name
string.value: III: Disrobing the Conspiracy

You and Leon escaped arrest for the murder of the Heaven Empire envoy, Zion, but were rescued by the #b#p9390204##k. In an even bigger twist, she turned out to be #b#p9390205##k, the daughter of the man who implicated you in the murder... But she disappeared before you could find out more.

You and Leon decided that Claire must have been kidnapped by the masked assailants from earlier. You trailed two of them back to a hideout in the deep forest, and took them out to get inside, where you found... #r#p9390207##k, alive and well!

The strangest thing was that he seemed to know Claire. But before you could hear what they were saying to one another, Leon rushed in to save her. You had no choice but to follow him.

Zion, surprised by the intrusion, sends #r#o9390822##k to eliminate you and Leon. But you managed to break through his trap, and capture Zion. He confessed that the Heaven Empire was plotting to cripple Commerci's trade routes, but you'd need to get him back to Gilberto to clear your name. But, before you could escape, the assassin called Il Capo, assassinated Zion from afar!

With your evidence lost, and a huge conspiracy in front of you, you needed to return to San Commerci and tell Giberto. But before you could leave, Claire felt an evil energy. You made a quick sweep of the area, and found an invisible barrier. A quick investigation revealed something big, so you headed for town.

You returned to Giberto to clear your name, and to tell him about the Heaven Empire's conspiracy. But with him, you found Vaughn Tremier.

You spill the beans to Gilberto: Zion's fake death, and real death, the assassins, their leader, and the true conspirator behind it all, the Heaven Empire. But Vaughn Tremier would not have it. He demanded your immediate arrest, and would have had it, if it hadn't been for Claire.

Vaughn Tremier was startled to see his daughter in town. With the Tremiers distracted, you had the opportunity to speak with Gilberto. You told him everything there was to know, but with no evidence, there was nothing he could do. But he surprised you with a request... to broker a peace deal with Maple World.

With Gilberto's trust won, you went to find Leon at the harbor to return to Maple World. Only, when you arrived, he and Claire were speaking to each other! 

You decide to go thank Claire, and do a favor for Leon at the same time. But, when you gave her Leon's letter, she didn't seem interested at all... 

Your time in Commerci made you homesick for Maple World. You talked to Leon Daniella, and got on the boat back to Maple World, but you ran into Parbell when you got off! The old timer gave you a gift.

string.name: name
string.value: Tess, the Strange Explorer

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/502/0#Your stay on Victoria Island began with a summons from Kyrin, who wanted you to visit Athena Pierce, the famed Bowman Instructor. Athena Pierce asked if you knew someone named Tess, but you didn't recognize the name.

But fate was on your side, and you ran into him at the Six Path Crossway, mere moments after leaving Athena Pierce.

Tess kept calling you 'Kao' and wanted you to help him battle a rabbit. You agreed, but he had to promise to answer some questions afterwards.

Even with your help, the rabbit got away. Tess tried to slip away too, but you stopped him in time.

He revealed that he was investigating an evil organization. He hinted that something horrible was going to happen to Maple World soon.

His parting words were a plea to keep his identity a secret, until he had a chance to tell Athena Pierce himself.
#eTess, the Strange Explorer\r\n\r\n#bLv 25#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Stolen Jewel

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/503/0#
You were settling into your new life when you heard a news flash: An important jewel that belonged to the Explorer's Guild was stolen by a masked thief!

Athena Pierce requested your help in retrieving it, which is how you ended up chasing the thief up and down the outskirts of Henesys. When you finally stopped the thief and got the jewel, an Explorer named Olive appeared.

Olive said she was the one who was supposed to deliver the jewel to Athena Pierce in the first place and that she wanted to finish her delivery.

Olive laughed when you handed her the jewel, which gave you a bad feeling. So you were hardly surprised when Athena Pierce told you that Olive never showed up.

Athena Pierce also revealed that the jewel was actually a Seal Stone, an artifact of immense but mysterious powers. Who stole the Seal Stone? What evil plans were they hatching upon Maple World? And none of this was your fault, was it?
#eThe Stolen Jewel\r\n\r\n#bLv 45#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: Thieving, Scheming Black Wings

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/504/0#\nA summons brought you to the Bowman Instructional School, where your 'old friend' Tess revealed that the Black Wings were behind the robbery./r/n/r/nYou traveled to Edelstein, the Black Wings stronghold, to investigate, but quickly realized you needed to Black Wing Hat to infiltrate further./r/n/r/nA boy passing by gave you a hat, but said it was pointless. Even if you got into their base, the Black Wing leaders wouldn't be around./r/n/r/nAs you pondered how a young boy could know so much, he reappeared and handed you a file loaded with information about the Black Wing leaders. He left, claiming to be part of a 'Resistance.'/r/n/r/nThe file revealed information about a Master of Disguise... So, the Black Wings were the ones responsible for the theft, not Olive?
#eThieving, Scheming Black Wings\r\n\r\n#bLv 60#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Master of Disguise

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/505/0#
With your latest lead, you finally felt like you were putting together the pieces to the puzzle.

Sugar, Tess, Rondo, and Olive met you at the El Nath Crystal Passageway to pursue the Master of Disguise.

While there, Rondo overheard some Black Wings saying that their leaders were collecting Seal Stones, though they weren't sure why.

With Sugar's help, you managed to defeat the Master of Disguise! You returned the Seal Stone to Athena Pierce, in person this time.

Everything worked out in the end, but the questions lingered.

What were the Seal Stones? What was the Black Wings' ultimate goal?

And most importantly of all, was the Black Mage directly involved in all of this?
#eThe Master of Disguise\r\n\r\n#bLv 70#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Broken Seal

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/506/2#
You checked on various towns to make sure Maple World was prepared for the Black Mage's potential return, and in the process, discovered that the Gate of the Present was open.

You ventured through the gate, and at the end of a long corridor... you encountered the Black Mage himself. Upon further investigation, you discovered that one of his seals had broken.

Using the Seal Stone Athena Pierce had in her possession to replace the broken seal might stop the Black Mage from breaking free, or so you hoped.

But as you were installing the Seal Stone, an unfamiliar voice spoke, sending chills tingling down your spine.

#e'Do not be a fool. Give in to the darkness.'#n

You continued your mission, despite your fears, but just as you were screwing in the final bolt, the seal broke. A dark voice reverberated, then grew faint.

#e'You will pay for your foolishness...'#n
#eThe Broken Seal\r\n\r\n#bLv 80#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: Maple Island Disaster

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/507/0#
Before you could recover from your shock, Sugar contacted you, begging you to return to Maple Island. When you stepped off the ferry, you saw your beloved island was in flames.

Amidst the chaos, you learned that Sugar had fled. You headed toward Maple Tree Hill and found her battling a fire.

It wasn't until after you put out the fire that you saw that Sugar was hurt. When you brought her water to cool her wounds, she poured it onto the tree and said that all was now well.

As you and your friends mourned the island together, you suddenly realized... Perhaps you could use the Seal Stones to restore Maple Island! But you needed more information on how the stones worked.

There was only one thing left to do. You had to visit the Heroes who created the stones and tap them for knowledge.
#eMaple Island Disaster\r\n\r\n#bLv 90#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: Luminous, the Final Hero

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/508/0#
You were assigned to find Luminous, so you headed for the Forest Edge around Ellinia to search for him.

You stumbled upon a robot, which seemed out of place. It called you an intruder, so you fought it, thinking it had to be evil.

Luminous, the Magician of Light, showed up just as you defeated the robot, which turned out not to be an enemy after all.

After you calmed him down, Luminous revealed that Seal Stones were created to seal the Black Mage away, but that this method wouldn't work a second time. He couldn't help you further.

You parted with Luminous to return to Maple Island.

When the others reconvened, you put together this knowledge:

#eMaple Island had no Seal Stone.#n
#eLuminous, the Final Hero\r\n\r\n#bLv 90#k#n requirement

string.name: name
string.value: The Darkness Returns

#fEtc/episodBookImg.img/adventureBook/509/0#
Even without a Seal Stone, you knew you couldn't give up on Maple Island.

As you and the others rebuilt Maple Island, brick by brick, a darkness crept back toward the island.

It was as dark as night, but you recognized it... the Black Mage's Shadow.

His shadow held but a fraction of the Black Mage's true powers...

...yet not even your most powerful strikes could maim it.

The others grew weary, as you fought futilely. The end was nigh.

Your friends poured the last of their strength into you. You knew it wouldn't be enough, but you were determined to try. Suddenly, a mystic glow poured out of you and a Maple Leaf floated before your eyes.
#eThe Darkness Returns\r\n\r\n#bLv 100#k#n requirement

string.value: Pia's Letter

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
#b#p1012102##k wants to read you a letter that some pretty girl sent...\r\nTalk to #b#p1012102##k.

You went to see #b#p9390336##k, like #b#p1012102##k suggested, but ran into a trap! Time to teach somebody a lesson!\r\n\r\n#r(Tip: To re-start the quest, talk to #p1012102# in Henesys, or forfeit the quest and accept it again.)#k

You went to find the place #b#p1012102##k told you about, but it was a trap that #b#p9390336##k's crew set up. You'd already be in their hands if it weren't for Eka. #b#p9390336##k and her lot are a villainous crew known as Triple Volt.

string.value: Strange Odor

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
#b#p9390342##k smells something funky. Talk to #b#p9390342##k.
#b#p9390342##k points you toward #m100040000#, where the odor seems to be coming from.
You found Evan's older brother #b#p9390344##k at the place #b#p9390342##k led you to.

string.value: Habitat for Utah 1

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Talk to Utah. He has some favors to ask before he introduces Evan to you. Totally not a problem for a hero like yourself.
Utah is trying to gather materials to build a house back in his hometown. Go to #b#m100040200##k and hunt #b#o5150002##k monsters to get 70 #i4000671# items to build the columns for his house.
You got 70 #i4000671# items for Utah's house.

You got 70 #i4000672# items for Utah's house.

string.value: So Where Is Evan?
Talk to Utah, who hasn't yet told you a single thing about Evan...
(To restart the quest, forfeit the quest then restart.)
Evan appeared as you were talking to Utah! FINALLY!

string.value: [Beast Tamer]
