string.value: Splitting Evan's Work

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Evan wants you to take care of one of two different requests that came in for him. Talk to him.
Choose one of Evan's two requests, and head toward the quest location.
You chose one of Evan's two requests, and on your way to take care of it.

string.name: name
string.value: Seeking Cygnus

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Talk to Evan. He says it's time!
Evan wants to introduce to you to the Maple Alliance. Tag along with him!
You traveled to Ereve with Evan. Talk to Cygnus.

string.name: name
string.value: Evan's Whereabouts 3

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Talk to #b#p1012102##k about Evan.
Talk to #b#p1012102##k on the left side of the town. He has some information on Evan.
You talked to #b#p1012111##k to find out about Evan.\r\n

string.name: name
string.value: Neinheart the Skeptic

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Neinheart has no faith in you or your abilities.
Neinheart says he needs to test you to trust you.\r\nTalk to the Chief Knight of Light, #bMihile#k, who will meet you on the way to the Knights Chamber.
The first test takes place in Kerning Square.

string.name: name
string.value: That Was Truly Wretched

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
You run into Triple Volt at the entrance to Kerning Square. Looks like they're up to no good...

Vicky, a Triple Volt member, comes to Kerning Square to participate in a singing audition. Vicky is excited but loses her ticket! You decide to help, hoping you can get Vicky to share some information on the Spirit of Rock. Hunt some Cherry Bubble Teas and get Vicky 40 Audition Scratch Cards.
You didn't find any winning tickets in any of your Cherry Bubble Teas.

string.name: name
string.value: The Maple-Factor

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Triple Volt isn't giving up. Ask Vicky about their new plan.

Vicky says Triple Volt isn't ready to give up! She needs you to bring her 50 more audition Scratch Cards, which you can acquire by hunting Mango Bubble Teas. The more Cards you collect, the better their chances of getting that audition!
You didn't find any winning tickets in this batch either. Sad face.

string.name: name
string.value: Maple's Got Talent

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Triple Volt are still not giving up. Ask Vicky about what they've got in store next.
It's so hard to find an actual entry ticket that Vicky is literally passing out. The search must go on! Let her rest and hunt some Melon Bubble Teas to find 60 VIP Audition Scratch Cards.
Victory! You finally found an Audition Pass.

string.name: name
string.value: Maybe This Will Change Your Mind...

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vincent seems happy now that Vicky has a shot at the audition, but there's something amiss...

Vicky wants to bribe the judges for a sure chance at winning. Yup. That definitely sounds like something Triple Volt would do. You decide to help, but only because you still need information on the Spirit of Rock. Bring Vincent 55 Yeti Keychains from the 3rd and 4th floors of the Shopping Center.
Vicky wrapped up the Yeti Keychains for the judges, but something tells you it's not going to be enough.

string.name: name
string.value: Let's Play Gift... Or Bribe?

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vincent is making sure Vicky's bribe is as bribe-y as possible. Help him just a bit more and you might learn something about the Spirit of Rock...
Vincent says that in order to really convince the judges, Triple Volt will need three different kinds of gifts for each one. Bring Vincent 60 Jr. Pepe Keychains to help him seal the deal.
Vincent wrapped up the Yeti Keychains for the judges, but something tells you that's not going to cut it.

string.name: name
string.value: The Best Gift is a Sweet Bribe

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vincent is making sure Vicky's bribe is as bribe-y as possible. Help him just a bit more and you might learn something about the Spirit of Rock...
The only things Vincent still needs are some Orange Mushroom Dolls. They're a really hot item right now, so bring him 65 Orange Mushroom Dolls.
You successfully collected all the Orange Mushroom Dolls Vincent asked for.

string.name: name
string.value: Vicky's Passion

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vincent is wrapping the gifts up all nicely for Vicky. Now he's standing next to you... awkwardly. Sigh. He must have another favor to ask you.

Vincent hands you Vicky's beautifully wrapped bribe... er... gift. He asks you to give it to Vicky and make sure she knows this is all his idea. He wants to get in her good graces... maybe he likes her?
Vicky rejected the bribe without hesitation. Wait a minute... is that actually Vicky from Triple Volt?

string.name: name
string.value: Stylist Vincent I

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vicky is mad at Vincent for trying to bribe the judges. She may be a good singer, but can she really hope to enter the audition on skill alone? Talk to Vicky.
Vicky says she will let Vincent handle the band's styling. You want to put someone more responsible in charge... but don't want to hurt Vincent's feelings and inform him anyway.
Vincent was super happy to learn he's been put in charge of styling. Oh no... what hideous horrors will he unleash?

string.name: name
string.value: Stylist Vincent II

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vicky is putting Vincent in charge of styling. You think this will be a disaster, but ask Vincent what his plan is anyway.
Vincent wants you to find a hip fragrance for Vicky's audition. He wants 3 samples to try. The perfume shop is on the #b5th Floor 6th Floor Area A Music Shop#k.
Vicky loved the fragrance Vincent chose. Guy's got a good nose, but how does he fare with fashion?

string.name: name
string.value: Stylist Vincent III

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vincent needs more help with Vicky's styling. If you get Vicky looking like a true rock star, maybe you can learn something about the Spirit of Rock...
Vincent wants you to get a Bunny Suit for Vicky. This sounds like a terrible plan. Go to the 5th and 6th Floor of Kerning Square and hunt Kid Mannequins to collect 50 Bunny Suits.
Surprisingly, Vicky also loved the Bunny Suit. At this point you should probably be doubting Vicky's sense of style.

string.name: name
string.value: Stylist Vincent IV

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vincent says an aromatic fragrance and eye-catching outfit are not enough. Help him finalize Vicky's look to get info on the Spirit of Rock.
Vincent says Vicky needs a wig to complete her fashionable outfit. Go to the #b5th and 6th Floor#k of Kerning Square to get #b50 Wigs#k for Vincent.
You brought Vincent the wigs.

string.name: name
string.value: Stylist Vincent V

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vincent wants to style a flashy blonde wig that you got for Vicky. What crazy hairdo will he concoct? Talk to him to find out.
You make the wig into something truly special. Bring it to Vicky.
Vicky is once again in love with the wig you helped Vincent make. This outfit is getting out of control... You worry the judges will laugh in Vicky's face.

string.name: name
string.value: Stylist Vincent VI

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vincent wants more accessories to accentuate Vicky's beauty. You begrudgingly help him, hoping against hope that you'll learn something about the Spirit of Rock.
Vincent wants to give Vicky one of the fedoras often worn by Male Mannequins. Bring #b70 Fedoras#k to Vicky.
Vicky bizarrely loved the fedoras as well. So, a singer wearing a Bunny Suit, fedora and a blonde wig? Now you're just confused.

string.name: name
string.value: Tonight I Will Be Performing...

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vicky looks... well, stylish probably isn't the right word, but she looks... something. Vincent winks at you. Ask him what's up.
Vincent says Vicky still needs to decide on a song to perform. He's too shy to ask Vicky what song she wants, so ask her for him.
You told Vicky she needs to figure out what song to sing.

string.name: name
string.value: Greatest Hits

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vicky is pondering what song she should sing at the audition. For Pete's sake, when will Triple Volt hand over information on the Spirit of Rock? Talk to Vicky.

Vicky doesn't have a specific song in mind, so she wants to listen to a couple different ones. Go to the Music Shop at #b7th and 8th Floor of Kerning Square#k and bring #r35#k #bLatest Hits Compilation#k to Vicky.
You brought Vicky the Latest Hits Compilation but she said the songs are too fast for her.

string.name: name
string.value: Sooooo Retro

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vicky still can't decide on a song. Talk to her to see how you can help.
Vicky says a retro sound is in style. Bring her some Greatest Oldies. Hmm, 55 should do the trick!
You got Vicky the Greatest Oldies compilation. She dug it.

string.name: name
string.value: Victor the Audiophile

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vicky is listening to the Greatest Oldies compilation but still can't figure out exactly which song suits her. Speak to her.

Vicky likes all the songs but can't decide which one to pick. She tells you that Victor is a classical music enthusiast and should be good at picking out a song. Classical? What does that have to do with anything? Whatever. Speak to Victor.
You asked Victor about which song Vicky should pick.

string.name: name
string.value: Sing Your Heart Out

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Victor listens to the Greatest Oldies. Talk to him to see if he has made a decision.
Victor likes the 10th track. Go tell Vicky.
Vicky now has a song to sing. But how will the actual audition pan out?

string.name: name
string.value: Eye of the Singer/Songwriter Tiger

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vincent looks like he has something to say. Go talk to him.
Victor says the first round of auditions is about to start. Let Vicky know.
You told Vicky that the first round of auditions is about to start.

string.name: name
string.value: That Was Truly Wretched

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Vicky is very nervous about the audition. Talk to her.

Vicky is too busy preparing for the preliminary round of auditions, so she can't help you with the Spirit of Rock. She says to ask Victor and then come back once you've obtained it. \r\n\r\n#rTip: You can complete this quest after completing the quest, [Finally, the Spirit of Rock!]
Unfortunately, Vicky failed her audition.

string.name: name
string.value: Finally, the Spirit of Rock!

string.name: type
string.value: [Beast Tamer]
Ask Victor about the Spirit of Rock's location.
Victor says you can find the Spirit of Rock on the #7th Floor 8th Floor Area D#k at Kerning Square. Eliminate the Spirit of Rock and its underlings, Cheap Amplifier and Fancy Amplifier.
Rock and roll! You defeated the Spirit of Rock!
